brtse chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/nub kun gyis bod rig pa zhes ming nas 'bod cing / spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi lam bur bskyod pa'i 'gro ba mi'i rigs gtso bor gyur pa'i/ skye bo rnam dpyod can mang po zhig gis nang sems kyi bde skyid sgrub pa'i thabs lam ma nor ba zhig tu shes te/ yid dbang med du 'phrogs nas bkres pa zas dang / skom pa chu'i dpe ltar sbyang brtson byed bzhin pa ni mthong chos su gyur pa lags/ des na yun ring gi bde skyid 'tshol ba'i gang zag zhig yin phyin chad/ spyir bsam blo'i slob gso dang / nyams myong gi mthong rgya/ khyad par du bod kyi rig gzhung nas bshad pa'i sems bzang dang / spyod bzang la bslab tshul 'di dag bde skyid sgrub pa'i lam phyogs zhig tu rtsa 'dzin byed pa ni/ gtan bde 'tshol ba'i kha phyogs ma nor ba zhig yin pa mngon thub kyi yod/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir na rang re'i mes po gong mas dka' ba brgya dang ngal ba stong gis bsgrubs pa'i rin bral gyi shes rig 'di dag /dus rabs kyi 'gyur ba dang bstun te bya thabs gsar gtod kyis/ nyam pa slar gso/ mi nyam gong 'phel gyi sgo nas/ sbyong spyod spel gsum byas te rang gi shes 'jon gyi nus pa mtho ru gtong ba tsam du ma zad/ 'dzam gling gi skye 'gro kun la ya rabs spyod bzang gi legs skyes 'bul thub pa bya rgyu ni/ rang re'i phrag thog tu bab pa'i 'os 'gan zhig yin/ de lta bu'i bod kyi rig gzhung chen mo de la brgyud srol tha dad pa'i sgo nas dbye na/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad ces grags pa las/ da 2

sngon 'gro'i gtam/lam 'dir sgrub rgyud shing rta chen po brgyad kyi ya gyal du gyur pa che ba bcu gcig ldan pa'i lam 'bras dang / bshad rgyud 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu'i nang gses dpal sa skya pa po'i bshad srol te/ mdo sngags bshad sgrub gnyis ldan gyi bka' srol bla na med pa zhig /da sngon bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongasa'adir gnas pa'i skye 'gro'i bsod nams kyi bgo skal du gyur pa la/ gnas gzhi'i ming chos brgyud la chags te dpal ldan sa skya pa zhes mtshan thogs pa de la/mkhas grub kyi skyes chen gser ri'i phreng ba ltar bar ma chad par byon pa rnams kyi gsung / rim bzhin myur skyobs kyis legs sgrig dang dpe sdur sogasakyis par skrun byas dang byed bzhin pa 'di ni/ thog mar 7sa skya khri 'dzin rin po che dang / mkhan rin po che yon tan bzang po/ mkhan rin po che rgya mtsho sogasakyis slob ston gyi bdag rkyen las byung ba zhig yin zhing / da sngon dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis rgyab skyor 'og /sa skya gong ma rnam lnga'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma par skrun 'grel spel zhus te/ rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba dang chabs cig /da dung mu mthud de chos brgyud 'dir gtogs kyi dpe rnying dpe dkon rnams gtso bor gyur pa myur skyobs bya ched/ dpal sa skya'i dpe rnying nyams gso khang zhes pa'i las khang zhig ched gnyer byas pa'i spyi khyab gtso 'dzin pa/ lhag bsam rnam par dkar ba'i mkhan po rta mgrin rdo rje dang / dpe sgrig zhu chen pa/ shes rig dang nyams myong 3

'tshe chen 'od pal / sa skya'i chosang gces bsdus/gi lang tsho rdzogs pa'i dgen thub bstan smon lam/ las ka'i 'gan 'dzin pa/sku zhabs ngag dbang bzang po sogs kyis gnang ba brgyud/ rgyun par las mi lnga drug tsam gyis 'bad brtson byed bzhin yod pa las/da lam 'dir bod kyi lo rgyus rig gnas zhib 'jug pa rnams kyi dgos mkho skong ched/ lo rgyus chos 'byung skor gtso bor byas pa'i deb drug dang / grwa sa khag gi slob gnyer gsar bu ba rnams kyi dgos mkho skong ched bsdus blo rtags gsum phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa rnams/ da lam par bskrun zhus te rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba'o/ /'byung char/ rang re'i mes po'i shul bzhag chos rig kun la kha zhe gnyis mtshungs kyi lhag bsam dkar ba'i mkhyen ldan rnams kyis/ phan tshun gshog 'degs kyi sgo nas las gzhi 'di'i rigs la mthun sbyor gang mang gnang rgyu'i re smon dang bcas/dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas 2008lo'i zla8tshes3la po glu bde legs kyis/

'tshechen 'od pal / saskya'i mosa'abyung gcesabasdus/gi lang tsho rdzogs pa'i dgen thub bstan smon lam/ lasaka'i 'gan 'dzin pa/sku zhabs ngag dbang bzang po sogs kyis gnang ba brgyud/ rgyun par las mi lnga drug tsam gyis 'bad brtson byed bzhin yod pa las/da lam 'dir bod kyi lo rgyus rig gnas zhib 'jug pa rnamasakyi dgos mkho skong ched/ lo rgyus chos 'byung skor gtso bor byas pa'i deb drug dang / grwa sa khag gi slob gnyer gsar bu ba rnams kyi dgos mkho skong ched bsdus blo rtags gsum phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa rnams/ da lam par bskrun zhus te rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba'o/ /'byung char/ rang re'i mes po'i shul bzhag mosarig kun la kha zhe gnyis mtshungs kyi lhag bsam dkar ba'i mkhyen ldan rnams kyis/ phan tshun gzhog 'degs kyi sgo nas las gzhi 'di'i rigs la mthun sbyor gang mang gnang rgyu'i re smon dang bcas/dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas 2008lo'i zla8tshes3la podze bde legs kyis/

bsdu sgrig pa'i gtam/༈ cho rigasarin chen lha yi 'phrul lasabyu nga / /byuX 'di rin chen mi lus mdzes pa'i rgyan / /rgyan mchog rin chen bsgrun pas dben pa'i brgyu da/ /brgyud pa rin chen shākya'i gdung de rgyal/ /de yang deng dus go la khyon du sna tshogs pa'i shes rig gi tsha rlabs dang 'gran rtsod kyi rno ngar brtas pa'i dus 'dir bzang phyogs nas go chod pa'i dngos rigs sna tshogs thon pa dang / ngan phyogs nas rkyen chung ngus kyang rang gzhan dmigs med kyi gnas su 'phen par byed pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs bzo skrun byed pa'i dus skabs 'dir phan tshun brtse sems dang bsam zhig gis 'byor phyug ldan pa'i zhi bde'i 'dzam gling zhig bskrun par/ skye bo mi re ngo re'i lhag bsam dang 'bad rtsol la bsnyen dgos/ de'ang nga tshos sngar 'das zin pa'i gnas tshul la phyi mig zhig bltas nas da lta skyon yon la blang dor bya dgos pas/ re zhig lo rgyus yig tshang du 'khod pa/ 'dzam gling spyi'i chags 'jigs 'phel 'grib kyi gnas tshul dang yang sgos mi'i rigs kyi byung rim dang 'phel rim/ de'i nang gi rgyal rabs dang / rig gnas/ chos lugs dar tshul sogs la rtogs zhib mdzad de snang tshul dang gnas tshul/ drang bden dang brdzun pa / ya rabs dang ma rabs/ mthun sgril dang ngo lkog rang don dang lhag bsam/

bsdu sgrig pa'i gtam/༈ cho rigasarin chen lha yi 'phrul lasabyu nga / /byuX 'di rin chen mi lus mdzes pa'i rgyan / /rgyan mchog rin chen bsgrun pas dben pa'i brgyu da/ /brgyud pa rin chen shākya'i gdung de rgyal/ /de yang deng dus go la khyon du sna tshogs pa'i shes rig gi tsha rlabs dang 'gran rtsod kyi rno ngar brtas pa'i dus 'dir bzang phyogs nas go chod pa'i dngos rigs sna tshogs thon pa dang / ngan phyogs nas rkyen chung ngus kyang rang gzhan dmigs med kyi gnas su 'phen par byed pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs bzo skrun byed pa'i dus skabs 'dir phan tshun brtse sems dang bsam zhig gis 'byor phyug ldan pa'i zhi bde'i 'dzam gling zhig bskrun par/ skye bo mi re ngo re'i lhag bsam dang 'bad rtsol la bsnyen dgos/ de'ang nga tshos sngar 'das zin pa'i gnas tshul la phyi mig zhig bltas nas da lta skyon yon la blang dor bya dgos pas/ re zhig lo rgyus yig tshang du 'khod pa/ 'dzam gling spyi'i chags 'jigs 'phel 'grib kyi gnas tshul dang yang sgos mi'i rigs kyi byung rim dang 'phel rim/ de'i nang gi rgyal rabs dang / rig gnas/ chos lugs dar tshul sogs la rtogs zhib mdzad de snang tshul dang gnas tshul/ drang bden dang brdzun pa / ya rabs dang ma rabs/ mthun sgril dang ngo lkog rang don dang lhag bsam/

bgechen 'od snang/ saskya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/gzur gnas dang phyogs res/ dgos dbang dang rang 'dod/ yar rgyas dang rjes lus/ shes ldan dang me+ongs pa/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug sogs la phan bde zhes pa ngo ma gang dang gang gis 'ong gi yod med kyi blang dor ma nor ba zhig byed par nges par du spyi dang bye brag gi lo rgyus la blta rtog mdzad de snyigs 'dor bcud len bya rgyu ni shin tu nas gal po che yin/ des na cung zad shes yon ldan pa rnams kyis kyang rang kho na yongs grags bya rgyu'i slob rtsom rnams dor nas sngar gyi lo rgyus yig tshang sogs la 'chad spel rgyun bsrings mdzad rgyu dang dpal 'byor dang go thob cung zad ldan pa rnams kyis kyang rgyan po 'gyes pa dang / phan med kyi 'gran rtsod dang / 'chal rgyug bya ba/ shul bzhag gi rig dngos la nyo tshong byed pa sogs dor nas rang re'i ma 'ongs pa'i blo gsar rnams kyis 'dzam gling 'di'i thog nga tsho shar phyogs pa'i mi rigs kyi rig gnas dang srol rgyun thun min rnams 'dzin skyong dang 'phel rgyas kyi phyogs su bskyod thub pa'i rmang gzhi zhig 'jog par 'bung 'tshal zhes kho bos gsol ba 'debs pa lags so//des na rang ljongs 'dir yang ris su ma chad pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i rgyal rabs dang / chos 'byung / lo rgyus/ 'bel gtam gyi rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig mchis pa kun gyi rang rang so so'i khyad chos rtsal 'don la bsams te bltas na rin thang bral ba kho na yin kyang / 'dir nged sa skya'i dpe rnying bsdu sgrig khang 'di'i shes dpal zung gi nus pas ma lcogs pas gnas skabs grub mtha' bye brag pa zhig gi mkhas pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i bstan 2

bgechen 'od snang/ saskya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/gzur gnas dang phyogs res/ dgos dbang dang rang 'dod/ yar rgyas dang rjes lus/ shes ldan dang me+ongs pa/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug sogs la phan bde zhes pa ngo ma gang dang gang gis 'ong gi yod med kyi blang dor ma nor ba zhig byed par nges par du spyi dang bye brag gi lo rgyus la blta rtog mdzad de snyigs 'dor bcud len bya rgyu ni shin tu nas gal po che yin/ des na cung zad shes yon ldan pa rnams kyis kyang rang kho na yongs grags bya rgyu'i slob rtsom rnams dor nas sngar gyi lo rgyus yig tshang sogs la 'chad spel rgyun bsrings mdzad rgyu dang dpal 'byor dang go thob cung zad ldan pa rnams kyis kyang rgyan po 'gyes pa dang / phan med kyi 'gran rtsod dang / 'chal rgyug bya ba/ shul bzhag gi rig dngos la nyo tshong byed pa sogs dor nas rang re'i ma 'ongs pa'i blo gsar rnams kyis 'dzam gling 'di'i thog nga tsho shar phyogs pa'i mi rigs kyi rig gnas dang srol rgyun thun min rnams 'dzin skyong dang 'phel rgyas kyi phyogs su bskyod thub pa'i rmang gzhi zhig 'jog par 'bung 'tshal zhes kho bos gsol ba 'debs pa lags so//des na rang ljongs 'dir yang ris su ma chad pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i rgyal rabs dang / chos 'byung / lo rgyus/ 'bel gtam gyi rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig mchis pa kun gyi rang rang so so'i khyad chos rtsal 'don la bsams te bltas na rin thang bral ba kho na yin kyang / 'dir nged sa skya'i dpe rnying bsdu sgrig khang 'di'i shes dpal zung gi nus pas ma lcogs pas gnas skabs grub mtha' bye brag pa zhig gi mkhas pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i bstan 2

bsdu sgrig pa'i gtam/bcos 'ga' zhig rnam dpyod bkra ba'i rig 'dzin pa rnams kyi spyan sngar phyogs bsdus byas te khyon deb drug bsgrigs pa las/ deb dang po'i nang rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan 6147 1216)gyis mdzad pa'i rgya bod rgyal rabs dang /rgya bod kyi sde pa'i gyes mdo/ chos rje sa paṇa 61827251)gyis mdzad pa'i chos 'byung chen mo/ 'gro mgon chos 'phags 62347280)kyis mdzad pa'i bod kyi rgyal rabs/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan63127399)gyisamadzad pa'i rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long bcas tshan pa lnga dang / deb gnyis pa'i nang bu ston rin po che rin chen grub 62907364)kyis mdzad pa'i chos 'byung / deb gsum pa'i nang stag tshang rdzong pa dpal 'byor rgya mtshos ('khrungasa'adasagasal po med kyang rnam thar cung zad stag tshang lo tsā ba'i rang rnam du yod pasader gzigs 'tshal/)mdzad pa'i rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ deb bzhi pa'i nang mkhas pa chen po dkon mchog lhun grub 6497755mngoras waṃ mosaldan gyi gdan rabasabacu pa/)kyis mdzad pa'i chos 'byung la mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogadra'ilo64977sangor mgon pa'igadan rabs nyer drug pa/)kyis kha skong mdzad pa de dang / deb lnga pa'i nang rtag nag mkhan chen chos rnam rgyal rtag nag thub bstan rnam rgyal dgon gyi gdan rabs bcuganyisapa/)gyisamadzad pa'i chos 'byung dang / mang thos paṇ+ḍi ta klu sgrub rgya mtshos 6523 mkha yod bya rgod gzhangasakyi gdan rabasalnga pa/)mdzad pa'i bstan rtsis kun btus gnyis/ deb drug pa'i nang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos shānangagasar lnga rig slob gling gi mkhan thog dang po/)padzad pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs dang / lo rgyus dang rnam thar shin tu mang po ngo mtshar lha'i pad tshal/ dbus gtsang gi gnas 3

bsdu sgrig pa'i gtam/bcos 'ga' zhig rnam dpyod bkra ba'i rig 'dzin pa rnams kyi spyan sngar phyogs bsdus byas te khyon deb drug bsgrigs pa las/ deb dang po'i nang rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan 6147 1216)gyis mdzad pa'i rgya bod rgyal rabs dang /rgya bod kyi sde pa'i gyes mdo/ chos rje sa paṇa 61827251)gyis mdzad pa'i chos 'byung chen mo/ 'gro mgon chos 'phags 62347280)kyis mdzad pa'i bod kyi rgyal rabs/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan63127399)gyis mdzad pa'i rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long bcas tshan pa lnga dang / deb gnyis pa'i nang bu ston rin po che rin chen grub 62907364)kyis mdzad pa'i chos 'byung / deb gsum pa'i nang stag tshang rdzong pa dpal 'byor rgya mtshos (ga khyungs 'das gsal po med kyang rnam thar cung zad stag tshang lo tsā ba'i rang rnam du yod pas der gzigs 'tshal/)mdzad pa'i rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ deb bzhi pa'i nang mkhas pa chen po dkon mchog lhun grub 6497755lo ngor e waṃ chos ldan gyi gdan rabs bcu pa/)kyis mdzad pa'i chos 'byung la mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun gabs6649775ngor mgon pa'i gdan rabs nyer drug pa/)kyis kha skong mdzad pa de dang / deb lnga pa'i nang rtag nag mkhan chen chos rnam rgyal rtag nag thub bstan rnam rgyal dgon gyi gdan rabs bcu gnyis pa/)gyis mdzad pa'i chos 'byung dang / mang thos paṇ+ḍi ta klu sgrub rgya mtshos lo523 mkha yod bya rgod gzhongs kyi gdan rabs lnga pa/)mdzad pa'i bstan rtsis kun btus gnyis/ deb drug pa'i nang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos (rdzong gsar lnga rig slob gling gi mkhan thog dang po/)mdzad pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs dang / lo rgyus dang rnam thar shin tu mang po ngo mtshar lha'i pad tshal/ dbus gtsang gi gnas 3

brtse chen 'od snang/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/yig gangs ri'i khrod kyi klog pa nyan bshad pa rnams la springs yig yang gangs ri'i khrod kyi spong ba bsam gtan pa rnams la springs yig /paṇa chen shāka mchog 64287507thub bstan gser mdog can gyi gdan sa gnyis pa/) gis mdzad pa'i tshad ma'i chos 'byung dang dbu ma'i chos 'byung /de jog lo chen pos gangs can du bstan pa ji ltar bskyangs pa'i tshul mdor tsam du byas pa dang / mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags 6572—1641dgung lo so dgu la thub bstan yangs pa can gyi mkhan po mdzad/ slar dgung lo re dgu la 'dar grang mo che'i gdan sa mdzad/da kyis mdzad pa'i pod chen drug gi 'bel gtam bcas spyan bstar zhus pa 'dis mkhas dbang skya ser kun gyis skabs 'di'i 'brel yod yig cha kun 'byor dka' ba'i ngal ba sel phyir yig rnying lo rgyus sngar bskrun zin pa dang ma zin pa'i phyogs mchungs rnams legs bsgrigs byas pa'i dpe tshogs 'di bla ldan skyes bu'i phongs sel dam par 'gyur ba'i 'dun pa'ang bcangs bzhin yod la thugs 'dun legs par bskong ba'i grogs su'ang 'gyur nges lags so/ /'dir mdzad pa po'i rnam thar ni yongs grags yin pas ngal ba ma byas te mkhyen 'dod rnams kyis 'brel yod yig cha rnams las rtogs par 'tshal lo/ /skabs 'di'i legs sgrig gi brgyud rim nang rnam dkar kho nas rogs ram mdzad pa nged dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhi kha 'jug khang gi rgan ga me bde legs lags sogs las rogs lhan rgyas la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin la/ slad mar phyogs gang spyi'i thad nas rogs ram zhug par thugs rje mi chung bar zhu zhes gsol ba'ang 'debs pa lagasaso/ / zhes sa skya'i dpe rnying bsdu sgrig khang nas thub bstan smon lam gyis/

dkar chagagangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus ngo mtshar pad+mo'i dga' tshal zhes bya ba bsdokyigs so// 'jam dbyangasamakhyen brtse'i dbang po/(1)gsang sngags rnying ma'i gdan rabs kyi skor/ (2)gsang sngags gsar ma'i skar/ (32)bka' gdamasapa/ (32)sa skya pa/ (36)bka' brgyud pa/ (88)dge ldan pa/ (105)zhar byung gdams pa 'ga' zhig zur du smros pa/ (134)mdo sngags bstan pa rin po che'i chos kyi byung tshul las brtsams pa'i lo rgyus dang rnam thar shin tu mang po ngo mtshar lha'i pad tshal zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po/(154)bdag rkyen sangs rgyas byon nas chos 'khor bskor tshul/ (154)bka' bsdu ba ji ltar byas pa'i chul/ (155)bstan skyong rnamasakyis ji ltar bkral zhing bskyangs pa'i skor/ (155)1

brtse 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ltas/rgya gar du ji ltar bskyangasatshul/ (155)bod du ji ltar bskyangs tshul/ (163)rnal 'byor gyi rgyud sde byung tshul/ (180)rgya gar du dar tshul/ (180)bod du dar tshul/ (182)legs par sbyar ba'i bstan bcos kyi byung tshul cung zad bshad pa ngo mtshar zla gsar pa'i 'dzum phreng zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 'jam dbyangasamakhyen brtse'i dbang po/(184)dbus gtsang gi gnas rten rags rim gyi mtshan byang mdor bsdus dad pa'i sa bon zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 'jam dbyangasamakhyen brtse'i dbang po/(193)gangs ri'i khrod kyi klog pa nyan bshad pa rnams kyi snyan du springs pa thos bsam 'chi med bdud rtsi zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 'jam dbyangasamakhyen brtse'i dbang po/(221)gangs ri'i khrod kyi spong ba bsam gtan pa rnams kyi snyan du 2

dkar chagasprings pa bsgom pa 'chi med bdud rtsi zhes bya ba bsdokyigs so// 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po/(235)tshad ma'i mdo dang bstan bcos kyi shing rta'i srol rnams ji ltar byung ba'i tshul gtam du bya ba nyin mor byed pa'i snang bas dpyod ldan mtha' dag dga' bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos bsdokyigs so// paṇa chen shāka mchog(254)dbu ma'i byung tshul rnam par bshad pa'i gtam yid bzhin lhun po zherbasdo bya ba bsdokyigarbasdo so// paṇa chen shāka mchog(397)rngog lo tsā ba chen pos bstan pa ji ltar bskyangs pa'i tshul mdo tsam du bya ba ngo mtshar gtam gyi rol mo zhes bya ba bsdo/gas so// paṇa chen shāka mchog gis brtsams/(437)bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel ba'i gtam skyes dpyod ldan mkhas pa'i lus rgyan rin chen mdzes pa'i phra tshom bkod pa bzhugs so//3

༄༅/ /gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus ngo mtshar pad+mo'i dga' tshol zhes bya ba bzhus/sa sa/ /༄7/ /na ma gu ru mañju gha ṣā ya/ bla ma 'jam dpal gzhan nu dang / /risamed mkhasagrub rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /gnyisasu ma mchisazhabasapad+mo/ /dad brgya'i gtsug gisartag tu mchod/ /de la 'phags mchog phyag na pakhro'i ye shesakyi gzigasapa lhag par 'jug pa'i gnas/ sa'i cha glang po che'i spyi gtsug ltar mtho ba'i phyogs thamasacad kha ba'i rdul brtsegs kyis bskor ba'i ljongs 'dir mkhas pa dang / grub pa'i skyes bu ji snyed cig byon pa rnams kyi ring lugs 'dzin pa'ang de snyed cig mchis pa las/ thog mar gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi ring lugs 'dzin pa ni bstan pa snga dar gyi dus sngags phyogs su gsang chen rnying ma las gzhan pa'i chos lugs mi gcig pa med pas mchod gnas sde gnyis po 'phel rgyas che zhing bshad sgrub shin tu dar na'ang / phyi dar gyi dus su chos lugs dang grub mtha' mi 'dra ba du ma dar zhing / de dag gis kyang rang rang so so'i ring lugs la gzi byin bsgrubs pa'i shugs kyis gcig shos rim gyis bag la zha bar gyur mod/ de lta na'ang rgyal ba'i thugs rje dang phrin las ni tshad med pa'i phyir/ stod mnga' ris nas smad rgya mchams la thug gi bar/ lho

༄7/ /gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus ngo mtshar pad+mo'i dga' tshal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄0/ /na mo gu ru mañju sto ṣā ya/ bla ma wom dpal ga smo nu dang / /ris med mkhas grub rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /gnyis su ma mchis zhabs pad+mo/ /dad brgya'i gtsug gis rtag tu mchod/ /de la 'phags mchog phyag na pa blo'i ye shesakyi gzigs pa lhag par 'jug pa'i gnas/ sa'i cha glang po che'i spyi gtsug ltar mtho ba'i phyogs thams cad kha ba'i rdul brtsegs kyis bskor ba'i ljongs 'dir mkhas pa dang / grub pa'i skyes bu ji snyed cig byon pa rnams kyi ring lugs 'dzin pa'ang de snyed cig mchis pa las/ thog mar gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi ring lugs 'dzin pa ni bstan pa snga dar gyi dus sngags phyogs su gsang chen rnying ma las g.yin pa'i chos lugs mi gcig pa med pas mchod gnas sde gnyis po 'phel rgyas che zhing bshad sgrub shin tu dar na'ang / phyi dar gyi dus su chos lugs dang grub mtha' mi 'dra ba du ma dar zhing / de dag gis kyang rang dzog dzog mtsho ri rme ri rme ri rme mi 2 ri 2 mi zu ri —gyi tsho ༷༷/rang sa sa 'a rang lugs la gza byan bsgrubs pa' shugs kyas gcag shas ma gyis bag la zha bar gyur mod/ de lta na'ang rgyal ba'i thugs rje dang phrin las ni tshad med pa'i phyir/ stod mnga' ris nas smad rgya mchams la thug gi bar/ lho

ba chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gcesabasdus/ ()mon nas sog yul tshun gyi ljongs rnams su dgon sde che phra ji snyed cig gis ma khyab pa med pa lta bur snang bas na/ mtha' dag sus brjod par spobs/ 'on kyong grags che ba dang / deng sang chos brgyud dar rgyas su bzhugs pa 'ga' zhig smas na/ gsang sngags rnying ma ba'i gdan rabs kyi skor/ thog mar rnying ma bka' ma'i ring lugs 'dzin pa/ sngags pa'i rgyal po so zur gnubs so ye shesadabang phyugazur shes rab 'byung gnas/ gnubasabla chen byang snying gsum ma grogs mdzad pas de skad du grags so / / gsum zhes grags pa las zur gyi gdan sa lug pa lung dang /gser mdog can dang nye ba'i sban thag ma'i lung bur yod/ gsang sngags gzhisaka rtse'i shar thad du yod/chos gling pa sogs sngar dar rgyas ha cang che yang / deng sang gsang sngags chos gling pa'i gdung brgyud ma chad tsam las bshad sgrub sogs rgya cher mi snang ngo / /gter ma'i phyogs la gter kha gong ma/ mnga' bdag nyang rin po che'i gdan sa lho brag shar smra bo cog gi gdan rabs ni/ thog mar khri srong rnam 'phrul gter chen nyang nyi ma 'od zer gyis btab/ de nas sras 'gro mgon nam mkha' dpal/de sras blo ldan shes rab/ de sras gsang bdag bdud 'dul/ de sras mdo sde seṅge/ de sras pad+ma don grub/ de sras 'jam dpal nor bu/ de sras kun dga' rgyal mtshan ste/ 'di dus tsam nas gdung brgyud khag mang du gyes shing / bar 'dir/ mnga' bdag nor bu 'phel ba dang / kun dga' 'od zer gnyis kyis gdan sa thog re mdzad/ de nas kun dga' rgyal mtshan sras lha'i rgyal mtshan/de sras bzang po lhun grub/ de sras nyang rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang / mnga' bdag 2

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/kun dga' 'od zer gyi sras kun dga' 'phel/ de sras mnga' bdag kun dga' lhun grub/ kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ bstan 'dzin nor bu/ bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyi bar du byon cing / 'di tsam nas smra bo cog gi gdung 'dzin med par mngon/ gzhan nyang gi gdung ches mang ba deng sang yang yod/ smra bo cog gi gdan sa ni chosadabang rin po che'i gdung gis 'dzin par snang ngo / /gter kha 'og ma gu ru chos dbang gi gdan sa'i gtso bo lho brag nub la ya ga gu ru lha khang ni / deng sang gsung sprul rin po ches skyong / gzhan chos dbang gi sras pad+ma dbang chen gyi brgyud las/ lho brag shar btsan 'gro gnas gzhi dgon dang /yar stod lha bro ba/ gtsang nas kha mo ba sras chung mnga' bdag nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi gdung e brag sna chos rje sogs te/ phal cher deng sang gi bar du gdung brgyud ma chad par yod/ gter chen rat+na gling pa'i gdan sa/ lho mdo mkhar lhun grub pho brang ni/ sngar dar rgyas che bar byung yang deng sang rgya cher yod par ma mngon/ lho brag shar chag byang chub gling ni/ pad gling gter slob byang chub gling pa'i gdan sa ste/ deng sang smin gling nas skyong / /lho brag mkhar chu bdud 'joms gling ni lnga pa rin po ches btab/ gter kha gong 'og dang / byang gter/rgya can sogs la nyams len byed pa'i grwa gtsang zhig yod cing / gtso bor gzhung dang rdor brag nas skyong / lho brag gu ru lha khang ni gsung sprul rin po ches bskyangs te/ de'i gdan rabs kyi thog ma ni/ pad+ma gling pa'i sprul sku bstan 'dzin grags pa/ de'i slob ma pad gling gdung sras zla ba rgyal mtshan gyi sras pad+ma phrin las/ 'di la chos mdzad rgyal po don grub kyis gu ru lha khang phul nas 3

ba chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i mosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()bzung gdan sa'i mthil du gnang / de nas rim par pad gling gsum pa gsung sprul rin po che mkhas grub chen po tshul khrims rdo rje/ sras zla ba rgyal ma gyi sprul sku rim par byon pa'i bzhi pa thugs sras sprul pa'i sku bstan 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rje 'di nyid lnga pa rin po che'i thugs sras kyi dwangs mar gyur te/ lha lung me tog 'di sngar bka' brgyud pa'i gdan sa yin/lha nang theg mchog rab rgyas gling gi dgon ma lag dang bcas pa sbyor 'jags mdzad pa nas bzung gdan sa'i gtso bor mdzad/ pad gling bzhi pa ngag dbang kun bzang rdo rje thugs sras lnga pa 'gyur med mchog grub dpa' 'bar bzang po/ pad gling lnga pa bstan 'dzin grub mchog rdo rje/ thugs sras drug pa bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma/ pad gling drug pa kun bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ thugs sras drug pa sprul sku gnyis byung ba'i sde pu shud sar 'byungs pa des gdan sa mdzad/ gcig shas bstan 'dzin ngag dbang phrin las ni rdor brag tu bzhugs/ pad gling bdun pa kun bzang pad+ma bstan 'dzin ni/ mon bum thang du 'khrungs/ bstan pa'i gsal byed chen por bzhugs kyang / dgung lo nyi shu rtsa grangs las ma bzhugaba'ipar sku gshegs/thugs sras brgyad pa ni/ lho mdo mkhar du 'khrungs nas/ deng sang zhabasapad brtan bzhin pa'o/ /mon phyogs su 'brug ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyi gdan sayang dkar rnying zung 'brel yin la/ dgongs 'dus dang / pad gling skor dar cha che/gzhan yang bstan 'dzin legs pa don grub kyi sku skye rim byon dang / pad gling pa'i gdung brgyud so sor phog pa'i dgon gnas che phra du ma/ 'bras mo gshong du lha btsun nam mkha' 'jigs med kyi sku skye 'bras gshong rdzogs chen pa rim 4

bgechen 'od palas/ saskya'i chosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()gter dang / tshe bdag sogasal gtso bor mdzad/ gzhan yang rgyang mosasde sogs dgon gnas phran bu mang tsam dang / mes ston/ skyi ston/ rta nag sgrol ma phug pa sogs sngags brgyud mang ngo / /gtsang la stod nub dgon ni/ dang po sus btab ma nges/ phyis byamasapa chosakyi rgyal mtshan/ thugasasrasablo gros rgyal mtshan sogs rim par byon cing / khams lung pa rig 'dzin dbang rgyal nas bzung / khams lung dbon dang skye sprul rim byon gyis gdan samadzad cing rdor brag pas skyong / gtsang gangs ra nges gsang rdo rje gling ni/ rong gter 'jam dpal rdo rjes btab/ de rjes snang rtse'i chos bdag nyi zla gragasapa dang /de'i dbon lo chen ngag gi dbang po/ de'i dbon mkhas grub chen po lo chen gzhan phan rdo rje rnams bzhugs/ lnga pa rin po ches sman lung pa blo mchog rdo rje la gnang ba nas bzung / de'i skye sprul rim byon gyisagadan samadzad/ gtsang smad du phung po ri bo che bdud dpung zil gnon gling ni lnga pa rin po ches btab/snye mo bde chen gling / bresadagon gsar/ bon lung pad+ma chos gling sogasasu/bon lung sprul sku dang / chu bzang sprul sku sogs rnying ma'i bstan 'dzin mang du bzhugs/ gtsang nyang stod rgyal rtse'i mnga' khul lha ri sgrol ma phug gi nye 'dabs/ o rgyan 'gro 'dren gling ni/ rig 'dzin yol mo ba'i rnam 'phrul gtsang pa sgrub chen pa pad+ma bshes gnyen gyis btab cing / de'i sprul sku rig 'dzin 'jigs med dpa' bo bzhugs/ theg mchog gling ni/ 'brug pa pad+ma dkar pos btab/ lnga pa rin po ches ning dgon du bsgyur/ byang gter dang rgya can gtso bo gyur pa'i nyams bzhes dang / phyis su kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling 6

ba tshe chen 'od pal / sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()gter dang / tshe bdag sogs la gtso bor mdzad/ gzhan yang rgyang chos sde sogs dgon gnas phran bu mang tsam dang / mes ston/ skyi ston/ rta nag sgrol ma phug pa sogs sngags brgyud mang ngo / /gtsang la stod nub dgon ni/ dang po sus btab ma nges/ phyis byams pa cho me kyi rgyal mtshan/ thugs sras blo gros rgyal mtshan sogs rim par byon cing / khams lung pa rig 'dzin dbang rgyal nas bzung / khams lung dbon dang skye sprul rim byon gyis gdan sa mdzad cing rdor brag pas skyong / gtsang gangs ra nges gsang rdo rje gling ni/ rong gter 'jam dpal rdo rjes btab/ de rjes snang rtse'i chos bdag nyi zla grags pa dang /de'i dbon lo chen ngag gi dbang po/ de'i dbon mkhas grub chen po lo chen gzhan phan rdo rje rnams bzhugs/ lnga pa rin po ches sman lung pa blo mchog rdo rje la gnang ba nas bzung / de'i skye sprul rim byon gyis gdan sa mdzad/ gtsang smad du phung po ri bo che bdud dpung zil gnon gling ni lnga pa rin po ches btab/snye mo bde chen gling / bres dgon gsar/ bon lung pad+ma chos gling sogs su/bon lung sprul sku dang / chu bzang sprul sku sogs rnying ma'i bstan 'dzin mang du bzhugs/ gtsang nyang stod rgyal rtse'i mnga' khul lha ri sgrol ma phug gi nye 'dabs/ o rgyan 'gro 'dren gling ni/ rig 'dzin yol mo ba'i rnam 'phrul gtsang pa sgrub chen pa pad+ma bshes gnyen gyis btab cing / de'i sprul sku rig 'dzin 'jigs med dpa' bo bzhugs/ theg mchog gling ni/ 'brug pa pad+ma dkar pos btab/ lnga pa rin po ches ning dgon du bsgyur/ byang gter dang rgya can gtso bo gyur pa'i nyams bzhes dang / phyis su kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling 6

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/pa phebs nas sgyu 'phrul zhi khro sogs btsugs pa'i rgyun deng sang yang yod/dbus phyogs su/ yar klung 'phyong rgyas dpal ri theg mchog gling ni/ 'phreng po gter chen shes rab 'od zer gyis btab/ de rjes rgyal sras ga me kun bzang /mtsho rgyal sprul sku rig 'dzin phrin las rnam rgyal/ ngag dbang kun bzang pad+ma/ngag dbang blo bzang pad+ma/ pad+ma chos ra rgya mtsho/ bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma rnams bzhugs/ de dang nye bar don mkhar lung pa'i phur/ tshe ring ljongs pad+ma 'od gsal theg mchog gling ni/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pas btab/ re zhig rje nyid kyi dbon po 'od zer phrin las dang / sgom chen ngag dbang chos grags sogs bzhugs kyang deng sang sde pa phu shud pa dang / dpal ri bas skyong ba tsam las brgyud 'dzin cher med/ lcags zam chu bo ri'i tshe chu sgrub sde ni thang stong pas btab/ thugs sras skyob pa bzang po'i yang srid lcags zam sprul sku rim byon gyi gdan sa mdzad cing / bstan 'dzin ye shes lhun grub sogs mkhas grub chen po mang du byon/ khyad par yul dbus 'dir yongs su grags pa'i chos sde chen po ni rdor smin gnyis te/ de la dang po thub bstan rdo rje brag gi gdan rabs la chos brgyud gang las byung ba dang / gdan sa dngos gnyis las/dang po ni/ gter ston rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem 'phru can dngos grub rgyal mtshan/de sras rnam rgyal mgon po/ sngags 'chang rdo rje dpal ba dang / rdo rje mgon po ste / rdo rje rnam gnyis/ mchan ldan byams pa bshes gnyen/ mtshan ldan ngag dbang grags pa/ chos rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang / sngags 'chang chos rgyal bsod nams/ thugs sras nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rig 'dzin yol mo ba 7

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/pa phebs nas sgyu 'phrul zhi khro sogs btsugs pa'i rgyun deng sang yang yod/dbus phyogs su/ yar klung 'phyong rgyas dpal ri theg mchog gling ni/ 'phreng po gter chen shes rab 'od zer gyis btab/ de rjes rgyal sras game kun bzang /mtsho rgyal sprul sku rig 'dzin phrin las rnam rgyal/ ngag dbang kun bzang pad+ma/ngag dbang blo bzang pad+ma/ pad+ma chosa'abyor rgya mtsho/ bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma rnams bzhugs/ de dang nye bar don mkhar lung pa'i phur/ tshe ring ljongs pad+ma 'od gsal theg mchog gling ni/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pasabatab/ re zhig rje nyid kyi dbon po 'od zer phrin las dang / sgom chen ngag dbang chos grags sogs bzhugs kyang deng sang sde pa phu shud pa dang / dpal ri bas skyong ba tsam las brgyud 'dzin cher med/ lcags zam chu bo ri'i tshe chu sgrub sde ni thang stong pasabatab/ thugs sras skyob pa bzang po'i yang srid lcags zam sprul sku rim byon gyi gdan sa mdzad cing / bstan 'dzin ye shes lhun grub sogs mkhas grub chen po mang du byon/ khyad par yul dbus 'dir yongs su grags pa'i chos sde chen po ni rdor smin gnyis te/ de la dang po thub bstan rdo rje brag gi gdan rabs la chos brgyud gang las byung ba dang / gdan sa dngos gnyis las/dang po ni/ gter ston rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem 'phru can dngos grub rgyal mtshan/de sras rnam rgyal mgon po/ sngags 'chang rdo rje dpal ba dang / rdo rje mgon po ste / rdo rje rnam gnyis/ mchan ldan byams pa bshes gnyen/ mtshan ldan ngag dbang grags pa/ chos rje sangasargyas dpal bzang / sngags 'chang chos rgyal bsod nams/ thugs sras nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rig 'dzin yol mo ba 7

ba 'od pal / saskya'i mosa'abyungagacesabasdus/ ()gter ston shākya bzang po/ de'i slob ma mnga' ris rig 'dzin chen po sku mched las/ rgod ldem gyi skye srid gnyisapa rig 'dzin legs ldan rje/ de'i slob ma byang bdag bkra shib(stobabasargyal 'di dusagu ru pad+ma'is waṃ lcog sgar gragasapa'igrwa tshang zhig yodabaderdor zaganisakholin/gyi bar du byon pa yin la/ gnyis pa gdan rabasadangos kyi thog ma ni/ legs ldan rje'i yang srid rgod ldem gsum pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po ste/ de'ang byang bdag bkra shis stobasargyal gyi srasasu lcagasa'abrug lor 'khrungs/ 'disathub bstan rdo rje brag gi chosasde thog mar btab/sa yosalor sku gshegs/ de rjesayol mo sprul sku bstan 'dzin nor bus gdan tshab mdzad/ rgod ldem bzhi pa zhabasadrung kun bzang pad+ma phrin lasani/ mon mkhar rnam srasab4 yasakyi thad gling du 'khrungs/ zur chen dang lnga pa rin po che sogs bsten nasamakhas btsun grub pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab/ sku tshe'ang ring por bzhugs shing / mthar yid srubs kyi bdag po ljongs 'gar ba'i jun gar dpung chen lhags pa'i rkyen gyis gshegs tshul bstan/ de'i yang srid rgod ldem lnga pa skal bzang pad+ma dbang phyug ni/ spo 'bor sgang gi nang tshan nyag rong lcags mdud ces par sku 'khrungs/ thub bstan rdo rje brag nyams gso phul du byung ba mdzad/ snga 'gyur bstan pa'i gsal byed chen por gyur cing /dgongs gter dag snang gi skor yang rgya che bar yod/ de'i sprul sku rgod ldem drug pa kun bzang 'gyur med lhun grub rdo rje ni/ dar mdo lcags la'i rgyal khab dang nye ba'i gser rtog zhes par 'brungs/ dag snang lung bstan/ 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad bzang ngo mtshar che bar gnang / yang sku tshe mthar ma phyin 8

chen 'od pal / sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ ()gter ston shākya bzang po/ de'i slob ma mnga' ris rig 'dzin chen po sku mched las/ rgod ldem gyi skye srid gnyis pa rig 'dzin legs ldan rje/ de'i slob ma byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal 'di dus gu ru pad+ma'i 'a waṃ lcog sgar zhes grags pa'i grwa tshang zhig bod pa de rdor zag ni sa 'a na/gyi bar du byon pa yin la/ gnyis pa gdan rabasadangos kyi thog ma ni/ legs ldan rje'i yang srid rgod ldem gsum pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po ste/ de'ang byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi sras su lcagasa'abrug lor zhakhrungs/ 'dis thub bstan rdo rje brag gi chos sde thog mar btab/sa yos lor sku gshegs/ de rjes yol mo sprul sku bstan 'dzin nor bus gdan tshab mdzad/ rgod ldem bzhi pa zhabs drung kun bzang pad+ma phrin las ni/ mon mkhar rnam srabs pa yas kyi thad gling du 'khrungs/ zur chen dang lnga pa rin po che sogs bsten nas mkhas btsun grub pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab/ sku tshe'ang ring por bzhugs shing / mthar yid srubs kyi bdag po ljongs 'gar ba'i jun gar dpung chen lhags pa'i rkyen gyis gshegs tshul bstan/ de'i yang srid rgod ldem lnga pa skal bzang pad+ma dbang phyug ni/ spo 'bor sgang gi nang tshan nyag rong lcags mdud ces par sku 'khrungs/ thub bstan rdo rje brag nyams gso phul du byung ba mdzad/ snga 'gyur bstan pa'i gsal byed chen por gyur cing /dgongs gter dag snang gi skor yang rgya che bar yod/ de'i sprul sku rgod ldem drug pa kun bzang 'gyur med lhun grub rdo rje ni/ dar mdo lcags la'i rgyal khab dang nye ba'i gser rtog zhes par 'brungs/ dag snang lung bstan/ 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad bzang ngo mtshar che bar gnang / yang sku tshe mthar ma phyin 8

gangasacan bod yuladu byon pa'igasang sngagasogasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/par gshegs/ de'i sprul sku rgod ldem bdun pa ngag dbang 'jam dpal mi 'gyur lhun grub rdo rje ni/ mon mkhar rnam srasagling du 'brungs so/ /'og min o rgyan smin grol gling gi gdan rabs la/ thog mar chos brgyud gang las byung ba'i tshul ni/ gter chen rat+na gling pa'i sprul sku sna tshogasarang grol ni/ lho brag sman thang du 'khrungs/ thosabasam sgom gsum gyi pha rolatu son/ dgung lo zhe gnyisapar grwa nang dar rgyas chos sding gi ri khrod btab/don bdun par gshegs/ de rjes pad+ma gling pa'i sprul sku bstan 'dzin grags pa/smyon ston mkhas grub chen po mdo sngagasabastan 'dzin/ de sras rig 'dzin phrin lasalhun grub kyi bar dar rgyas chos sdingasasu bzhugs/ gdan rabs kyi thog ma ni/ de srasabe+e ro'i rnam 'phrul gcen gter chen 'gyur med rdo rje'am/ 'gro 'dul gter bdag gling pa ste/ de yang rab byung bcu pa'i me khyi lor sku 'byungs/yab rje dang lnga pa rin po che sogs brten nas mkhas shing grub pa'i pha rol tu son/ dgung lo bco brgyad par g.ya' ma lung nas rig 'dzin thugs thig sogs rim par zab gter kyang mang du spyan drangs/ snga 'gyur bstan pa'i srog shing 'gran zla dang bral ba des/ me 'brug lor grwa phyi o rgyan smin grol gling btab/ re dgu pa shing rta lor sku gshegs/ sku 'bring ba mkhan rabs dang po rgyal sras bstan pa'i nyi ma ni/ shes bya rig pa'i gnas lnga mkhyen pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po gyur kyang / nyer bdun par gshegs/ gcung g.yu sgra'i rnam 'phrul mkhan chen lo cwa ba dharma shrī ni mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan gyis mngon par mtho ba'i snga 'gyur bstan pa'i mig gcig bur gyur/ smin gling mkhan rabs 9

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/par gshegs/ de'i sprul sku rgod ldem bdun pa ngag dbang 'jam dpal mi 'gyur lhun grub rdo rje ni/ mon mkhar rnam sras gling du 'khrungs so/ /'og min o rgyan smin grol gling gi gdan rabs la/ thog mar chos brgyud gang las byung ba'i tshul ni/ gter chen rat+na gling pa'i sprul sku sna tshogasarang grol ni/ lho brag sman thang du gzungs/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi pha rolatu son/ dgung lo zhe gnyis par grwa nang dar rgyas chos sding gi ri khrod btab/don bdun par gshegs/ de rjes pad+ma gling pa'i sprul sku bstan 'dzin grags pa/smyon ston mkhas grub chen po mdo sngags bstan 'dzin/ de sras rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub kyi bar dar rgyas chos sdings su bzhugs/ gdan rabs kyi thog ma ni/ de sras be+e ro'i rnam 'phrul gcen gter chen 'gyur med rdo rje'am/ 'gro 'dul gter bdag gling pa ste/ de yang rab byung bcu pa'i me khyi lor sku 'khrungs/yab rje dang lnga pa rin po che sogs brten nas mkhas shing grub pa'i pha rol tu son/ dgung lo bco brgyad par g.ya' ma lung nas rig 'dzin thugs thig sogs rim par zab gter kyang mang du spyan drangs/ snga 'gyur bstan pa'i srog shing 'gran zla dang bral ba des/ me 'brug lor grwa phyi o rgyan smin grol gling btab/ re dgu pa shing rta lor sku gshegs/ sku 'bring ba mkhan rabs dang po rgyal sras bstan pa'i nyi ma ni/ shes bya rig pa'i gnas lnga mkhyen pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po gyur kyang / nyer bdun par gshegs/ gcung g.yu sgra'i rnam 'phrul mkhan chen lo cwa ba dharma shrī ni mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan gyis mngon par mtho ba'i snga 'gyur bstan pa'i mig gcig bur gyur/ smin gling mkhan rabs 9

ba ho 'od pal / sa skya'i cho yong sa bsdug rtonaganyis par mdzad/ re lnga par gshegs/ sa su rnying ma'i bka' gter gyi bstan pa la gter chen sku mched 'di gnyis kho na bka' drin che/ khri rabs gnyis pa pad+ma 'gyur med rgya mtsho ni yab gter chen chos kyi rgyal po dang / yum yon tan sgrol ma'i sras su zhabrungs/ sum cu par khrir phebs/ so gsum par gshegs/ rgyal sras yid bzhin legs grub ni/ yab gter chen dang / yum phun tshogs dpal 'dzom gyi sras su 'byungs/ lo chen las bsnyen par rdzogs/'on kyang rkyen dbang gis gshegs/ khri rabs gsum pa rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal ni/ dus 'gyur gyi skabs kyang mon bod brgyud nas khams phyogs su lhag rong lcags mdud bar phebs pas brdzi bar ma nus/ slar dbus su phebs nas gdan sa'i nyams gso gnang zhing bstan pa la bka' drin che/ re lnga par gshegs/ gcung mo rje btsun ma mi 'gyur dpal gyi sgrol mas kyang / bstan pa la bshad sgrub sogs bya ba rgya cher mdzad cing / don gcig par gshegs/ rin chen rnam rgyal la sras khri rabs bzhi pa 'gyur med pad+ma bstan 'dzin dang /mkhan chen o rgyan bstan 'dzin rdo rje gnyis 'khrungs/ 'gyur med pad+ma bstan 'dzin gyi sras khri rabs lnga pa 'gyur med phrin las rnam rgyal dang / mkhan chen 'gyur med gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ phrin las rnam rgyal gyi sras khri rabasadrug pa 'gyur med pad+ma dbang rgyal dang / mkhan chen o rgyan chos 'phel/ rje bcun ma phrin las chos sgron/ pad+ma dbang rgyal sras khri rabs bdun pa 'gyur med sangs rgyas kun dga'/ de sras khri rabs brgyad pa 'gyur med yid bzhin dbang rgyal te/ mkhas dang grub pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho'i dpal gyis mngon par 10

'tsheho 'od pal / saskya'i chogalung r+sāsabasdug ()gnyis par mdzad/ re lnga par gshegs/ phyisasu rnying ma'i bka' gter gyi bstan pa la gter chen sku mched 'di gnyis kho na bka' drin che/ khri rabs gnyis pa pad+ma 'gyur med rgya mtsho ni yab gter chen mosakyi rgyal po dang / yum yon tan sgrol ma'i sras su 'khrungs/ sum cu par khrir phebs/ so gsum par gshegs/ rgyal sras yid bzhin legs grub ni/ yab gter chen dang / yum phun tshogs dpal 'dzom gyi sras su 'khrungs/ lo chen las bsnyen par rdzogs/'on kyang rkyen dbang gis gshegs/ khri rabs gsum pa rgyal srasarin chen rnam rgyal ni/ dus 'gyur gyi skabs kyang mon bod brgyud nas khams phyogs su lhag rong lcags mdud bar phebs pas brdzi bar ma nus/ slar dbus su phebasanas gdan sa'i nyams gso gnang zhing bstan pa la bka' drin che/ re lnga par gshegs/ gcung mo rje btsun ma mi 'gyur dpal gyi sgrol mas kyang / bstan pa la bshad sgrub sogs bya ba rgya cher mdzad cing / don gcig par gshegs/ rin chen rnam rgyal la sras khri rabs bzhi pa 'gyur med pad+ma bstan 'dzin dang /mkhan chen o rgyan bstan 'dzin rdo rje gnyis 'khrungs/ 'gyur med pad+ma bstan 'dzin gyi sras khri rabs lnga pa 'gyur med phrin las rnam rgyal dang / mkhan chen 'gyur med gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ phrin las rnam rgyal gyi sras khri rabasadrug pa 'gyur med pad+ma dbang rgyal dang / mkhan chen o rgyan chos 'phel/ rje bcun ma phrin las chos sgron/ pad+ma dbang rgyal sras khri rabs bdun pa 'gyur med sangs rgyas kun dga'/ de sras khri rabs brgyad pa 'gyur med yid bzhin dbang rgyal te/ mkhas dang grub pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho'i dpal gyis mngon par 10

gangasacan bod yuladu byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/mtho ba dang bcas/ deng sang zhabasapad brtan bzhin par bzhugs so/ /spyir dbus gtsang gi rnying dgon che phra thams cad/ sog po ljongasa'agar thunagar/gyi dusanyamasachag shin tu che bar byung yang / phyisargyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtshos sngar rgyun ltar nyams gso dgos pa'i bka' lung phebs pa nas bzung phal cher rim gyis sor chud de sngar dang cha 'dra ba tsam yod/ rgyal ba 'bri gung pa'i gdan sani/ thog mar mi nyag sgom ring zhesapasabatab/ de nasaskyob pa rin po chesabaskyang ba nas bzung gdung rabs bcu gsum tsam gyi bar bka' brgyud kyi gdan sachen por gyur/ de nasaskyob pa rin po che'i rnam 'phrul gter chen rin chen phun tshogasakyi dus nas rnying lugs la gtso bor mdzad pas/ de phyin gyi gdan rabs mdo tsam ni/ rin chen phun tshogs kyi srasachos rgyal phun tshogs/de la sras sku mched lnga tsam bzhugs pa'i nang nas/ brgyud 'dzin gyi sras/zhabasadrung nā ro pa/ rje dkon mchog rat+na/ rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa ste gsum las/ chos kyi grags pa ni rin chen phun tshogs pa'i sprul sku yin cing /'di dus gdung brgyud chad de/ phyis nas skye sprul rim byon gyis zhal 'dzin gnang bas/ de yang rim par/ rje dkon mchog rat+na'i skye ba dkon mchog phrin lasabazang po/ chos kyi grags pa'i skye ba 'jang yul du 'khrungs pa'i don grub chos kyi rgyal po/ dkon mchog phrin las bzang po'i rnam 'phrul/ dkon mchog bstan 'dzin/ don grub chos rgyal gyi skye ba chos kyi nyi ma/ dkon mchog bstan 'dzin gyi skye ba kong po kra ti sngags 'chang gi sras bstan 'dzin pad+ma'i rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi nyi ma'i skye ba kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa'i rgyal sras 11

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/mtho ba dang bcas/ deng sang zhabs pad brtan bzhin par bzhugs so/ /spyir dbus gtsang gi rnying dgon che phra thams cad/ sog po ljongs 'gar thun gar/gyi dus nyams chag shin tu che bar byung yang / phyis rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtshos sngar rgyun ltar nyams gso dgos pa'i bka' lung phebs pa nas bzung phal cher rim gyis sor chud de sngar dang cha 'dra ba tsam yod/ rgyal ba 'bri gung pa'i gdan sa ni/ thog mar mi nyag sgom ring zhes pas btab/ de nas skyob pa rin po chesabaskyang ba nas bzung gdung rabs bcu gsum tsam gyi bar bka' brgyud kyi gdan sa chen por gyur/ de nas skyob pa rin po che'i rnam 'phrul gter chen rin chen phun tsho gis kyi dus nas rnying lugs la gtso bor mdzad pas/ de phyin gyi gdan rabs mdo tsam ni/ rin chen phun tshogs kyi sras chos rgyal phun tshogs/de la sras sku mched lnga tsam bzhugs pa'i nang nas/ brgyud 'dzin gyi sras/zhabs drung nā ro pa/ rje dkon mchog rat+na/ rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa ste gsum las/ chos kyi grags pa ni rin chen phun tshogs pa'i sprul sku yin cing /'di dus gdung brgyud chad de/ phyis nas skye sprul rim byon gyis zhal 'dzin gnang bas/ de yang rim par/ rje dkon mchog rat+na'i skye ba dkon mchog phrin las bzang po/ chos kyi grags pa'i skye ba 'jang yul du 'khrungs pa'i don grub chos kyi rgyal po/ dkon mchog phrin las bzang po'i rnam 'phrul/ dkon mchog bstan 'dzin/ don grub chos rgyal gyi skye ba chos kyi nyi ma/ dkon mchog bstan 'dzin gyi skye ba kong po kra ti sngags 'chang gi sras bstan 'dzin pad+ma'i rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi nyi ma'i skye ba kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa'i rgyal sras 11

bgechen 'od snang la / saskya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()'jigs med nyin byed 'od zer rnams byon cing / de gnyis kyi yang srid rin po che zla ba tshes pa lta bu deng sang zhabs pad brtan bzhin pa'o/ /lho brgyud gnyal dang lo ro'i phyogs su/ rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i zhal slob sha gzugs pa ngag dbang bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi skye sprul rim byon dang / 'brug smyon gdan sa dre'u lhas pa'i sprul sku rim byon/ lo ror bo dong pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi rnam 'phrul sbyor ra thams cad mkhyen pa rim byon sogs rnying ma'i bstan 'dzin 'ga' zhig bzhugs la/ e rong phyogasasu/ rong pa rdzongs chen pa nam mkha' 'brug sgra bzang pos btab pa'i rtsa sgrub sde ni/ de'i sprul sku rim byon gyis bskyang / gzhan yang las 'phro gling pa'i gdan sa e sbe lcog dang / chos rje o rgyan bstan 'dzin gyi gdan sa brag sna ba sogs kyang ma nub tsam yod/ /dwags po'i phyogs su/ dwags ston dbang phyug rdo rje nas rim par byon pa'i kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer gyis rtse le dgon btab/ de'i slob ma rgya ra klong chen pa sogs byung / phyis su rig 'dzin bsod nams rnam rgyal gyis rtse le dgon gsar btab cing bshad sgrub shin tu dar yang / deng sang rgya cher yod par ma mngon zhing / 'dzin skyong smin gling nas gnang / /dwags lha sga po'i gdan rabs ni/thog mar mnyam med dwags po rin po ches btab/ gdan rabs bcu bdun tsam gyi bar phal cher dbon brgyud kho nas 'dzin zhing / bka' brgyud pa'i lugs srol bzung ba sha stag byung / phyis su dwags po rin po che'i rnam 'phrul kun mkhyen bkra shis rnam rgyal ni/ dwags po rang gi dbon brgyud du 'khrungs/de'i sprul sku 'dzam gling nor bu rgyan pa nas rnying lugs gtso bor mdzad de/ de'i 12

bgechen 'od snang las/ saskya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()'jigs med nyin byed 'od zer rnams byon cing / de gnyis kyi yang srid rin po che zla ba tshes pa lta bu deng sang zhabs pad brtan bzhin pa'o/ /lho brgyud gnyal dang lo ro'i phyogs su/ rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i zhal slob sha gzugs pa ngag dbang bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi skye sprul rim byon dang / 'brug smyon gdan sa dre'u lhas pa'i sprul sku rim byon/ lo ror bo dong pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi rnam 'phrul sbyor ra thams cad mkhyen pa rim byon sogs rnying ma'i bstan 'dzin 'ga' zhig bzhugs la/ e rong phyogasasu/ rong pa rdzongs chen pa nam mkha' 'brug sgra bzang pos btab pa'i rtsa sgrub sde ni/ de'i sprul sku rim byon gyis bskyang / gzhan yang las 'phro gling pa'i gdan sa e sbe lcog dang / 'otshos rje o rgyan bstan 'dzin gyi gdan sa brag sna ba sogs kyang ma nub tsam yod/ /dwags po'i phyogs su/ dwags ston dbang phyug rdo rje nas rim par byon pa'i kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer gyis rtse le dgon btab/ de'i slob ma rgya ra klong chen pa sogs byung / phyis su rig 'dzin bsod nams rnam rgyal gyis rtse le dgon gsar btab cing bshad sgrub shin tu dar yang / deng sang rgya cher yod par ma mngon zhing / 'dzin skyong smin gling nas gnang / /dwags lha sga po'i gdan rabs ni/thog mar mnyam med dwags po rin po ches btab/ gdan rabs bcu bdun tsam gyi bar phal cher dbon brgyud kho nas 'dzin zhing / bka' brgyud pa'i lugs srol bzung ba sha stag byung / phyis su dwags po rin po che'i rnam 'phrul kun mkhyen bkra shis rnam rgyal ni/ dwags po rang gi dbon brgyud du 'khrungs/de'i sprul sku 'dzam gling nor bu rgyan pa nas rnying lugs gtso bor mdzad de/ de'i 12

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/slob ma spyan snga bsod nams rin chen/ mchog sprul gter chen bzang po rdo rje/bde ba'i rdo rje lhun grub nges don dbang po/ mchog sprul kun bzang nges don dbang po/ zhwa dmar mchog sprul zur pa gar dbang rgya mtsho/ mchog sprul rin po che drug pa 'jam dpal phrin las dbang po'am/ gter chen gter chos gsang bdag drag po'i skor sogs yod/ rdo rje rgyal po'i bar du byon pa rnams ni rnying lugs kyi bstan 'dzin chen por gyur/ gzhan yang dwags phyogs su rnying dgon phra mo du ma zhig yod do/ /dpal stag lung ba/ mtshar phu ba/ 'brug pa rin po che sogabashakyis kyang / dzir rnying zung 'brel du skyong bar gnang yang so so'i gdan rabs 'dir ma bkod do/ /kong po'i phyogs su/ gter chen sangs rgyas gling pa'i gdung rabs snyi phu ba ni/ gter chen gyi sras ye shes rdo rje/ sangs rgyas blo gros/chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ game bzang po/ grub mchog bzang po/ de la thugs sras garma gsang sngags rnam rgyal/ game rig 'dzin snying po/ dme bstan skyong gsum byon cing / de rnams las gdung brgyud ma 'phel yang / grub mchog bzang po'i mched cig las 'phel ba'i gdung brgyud mkhar rgya bor gtan chags pa dang /gzhan yang sangs gling chos bdag bla ma bya khyung pa dpal ldan seṅges btab pa'i bya khyung dgon pa ni gdung brgyud rim byon gyis bskyang / thang 'brog dgon ni/mtshungs med bstan 'dzin rdo rjes btab/ de'i sprul sku rtse le sna tshogs rang grol lam mkhas mchog pad+ma legs grub/ de'i sprul sku kun bzang pad+ma legs grub/ de'i sprul sku 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi bar du byon/ kong po rtswa nang du dri med lhun po'i gdan sa dang / bang ring 'ja' tshon pa'i gdan sa 13

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/slob ma spyan snga bsod nams rin chen/ mchog sprul gter chen bzang po rdo rje/bde ba'i rdo rje lhun grub nges don dbang po/ mchog sprul kun bzang nges don dbang po/ zhwa dmar mchog sprul zur pa gar dbang rgya mtsho/ mchog sprul rin po che drug pa 'jam dpal phrin las dbang po'am/ gter chen gter chos gsang bdag drag po'i skor sogs yod/ rdo rje rgyal po'i bar du byon pa rnams ni rnying lugs kyi bstan 'dzin chen por gyur/ gzhan yang dwags phyogs su rnying dgon phra mo du ma zhig yod do/ /dpal stag lung ba/ mtshar phu ba/ 'brug pa rin po che sogasakyis kyang / dzir rnying zung 'brel du stong bar gnang yang so so'i gdan rabs 'dir ma bkod do/ /kong po'i phyogs su/ gter chen sangs rgyas gling pa'i gdung rabs snyi phu ba ni/ gter chen gyi sras ye shes rdo rje/ sangs rgyas blo gros/chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ ga me bzang po/ grub mchog bzang po/ de la thugs sras ga me gsang sngags rnam rgyal/ ga me rig 'dzin snying po/ dme bstan skyong gsum byon cing / de rnams las gdung brgyud ma 'phel yang / grub mchog bzang po'i mched cig las 'phel ba'i gdung brgyud mkhar rgya bor gtan chags pa dang /ga 6 na yang sangs gling chos bdag bla ma bya khyung pa dpal ldan seṅges btab pa'i bya khyung dgon pa ni gdung brgyud rim byon gyis bskyang / thang 'brog dgon ni/mtshungs med bstan 'dzin rdo rjes btab/ de'i sprul sku rtse le sna tshogs rang grol lam mkhas mchog pad+ma legs grub/ de'i sprul sku kun bzang pad+ma legs grub/ de'i sprul sku 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi bar du byon/ kong po rtswa nang du dri med lhun po'i gdan sa dang / bang ring 'ja' tshon pa'i gdan sa 13

'tshechena'odasnongalas/ saskya'i mosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()rnams kyang ma nyams par yad/ /spo bo'i phyogs su/ dga' ba lung du gter ston stag sham pa'i gdan sar/ skye sprul rim byon gyis bskyang / dpal kha gsang sngags chos gling ni/ rig 'dzin chos kyi rgya mtsho'i rnam 'phrul rim byon gyis gdan sa mdzad pa las/ deng song lho brag gsung sprul gong ma'i sras su 'khrungs pa'i mkhye+on rtogs can zhig yad/ grwa sa'ang lha brag lha lung du zhugs sral snang nga / /mad smad 'ba' yul du rdor brag gi ring lugs 'dzin pa grub pa dgon dang / rgya bla rabs bcu gsum gyi gdan sa gnam bskos gsang sngags chos gling sogs deng sang yang dar rgyas che tsam yod/ khyad par bod chen po'i ljongs kyi thig ler stobs kyi 'khor losasgyur ba sde dge chos kyi rgyal po'i mnga' khul 'dir ni/ snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa kho na dar rgyas che bas dgon gnas che phra'ang mang du bzhugs shing / de thams cad kyang rgyal ba gaḥthog pa dang / grub dbang rdzogs chen pa'i phrin las lasabyung ba sha stag yin pas/ de'i tshul mdo tsam brjod na/ thog mar shar rgyal ba gaḥthog pa'i gdan rabs kyi thog ma/ zur pa mes dbon gsum du grags pa'i nang tshan/ sgro phug pa shākya seṅge'i thugs sras 'dzom ston 'gro ba'i mgon po sogasakyi zhal slob/ dam pa bde gshegs shesarab seṅge ni/ rje phag mo gru pa dang /yum mched du rab byung gnyis pa'i chu stag lor 'brungs/ dpe war 'besayo+onang /'dzam ston rin po che'i lung bstan bzhin sa yos lor kāḥthog rdo rje gdan btab/ don gcig par gshegs/ de nasarim par/ 1 chosarje gtsang stod rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ 2 rgyal tshab byams pa 'bum pa/'disakarma pak+shi bsnyen par rdzogs/ 314

ba tshe chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()rnams kyang ma nyams par yod/ / spo bo'i phyogs su/ dga' ba lung du gter ston stag sham pa'i gdan sar/ skye sprul rim byon gyis bskyang / dpal kha gsang sngags chos gling ni/ rig 'dzin chos kyi rgya mtsho'i rnam 'phrul rim byon gyis gdan sa mdzad pa las/ deng sang lho brag gsung sprul gong ma'i sras su 'brungs pa'i mkhyen rtogs can zhig yod/ grwa sa'ang lho brag lha lung du zhugs srol snang ngo / /mdo smad 'ba' yul du rdor brag gi ring lugs 'dzin pa grub pa dgon dang / rgya bla rabs bcu gsum gyi gdan sa gnam bskos gsang sngags chos gling sogs deng sang yang dar rgyas che tsam yod/ khyad par bod chen po'i ljongs kyi thig ler stobs kyi 'khor losasgyur ba sde dge chos kyi rgyal po'i mnga' khul 'dir ni/ snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa kho na dar rgyas che bas dgon gnas che phra'ang mang du bzhugs shing / de thams cad kyang rgyal ba gaḥthog pa dang / grub dbang rdzogs chen pa'i phrin las las byung ba sha stag yin pas/ de'i tshul mdo tsam brjod na/ thog mar shar rgyal ba gaḥthog pa'i gdan rabs kyi thog ma/ zur pa mes dbon gsum du grags pa'i nang tshan/ sgro phug pa shākya seṅge'i thugs sras 'dzom ston 'gro ba'i mgon po sogasakyi zhal slob/ dam pa bde gshegs shes rab seṅge ni/ rje phag mo gru pa dang /yum mched du rab byung gnyis pa'i chu stag lor 'byungs/ dpe war 'be monang /'dzam ston rin po che'i lung bstan bzhin sa yos lor kāḥthog rdo rje gdan btab/ don gcig par gshegs/ de nas rim par/ 1 chos rje gtsang stod rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ 2 rgyal tshab byams pa 'bum pa/'dis karma pa lha bsnyen par rdzogs/ 314

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar ning gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/spyan snga bsod namasa'abum pa/ 4 dbu 'od ye shesa'abum pa/ 'phagasangasi po ྾ dbang phul/ 5 rgyal tshab byang chub dpal ba/ 6 rgyal tshab bsod nams bzang po / 'di skabasatsam nasanyang mosadabang sogasakyi gter mosayang cung zad dar babyung / 7 rgyal tshab kun dga' 'bum pa/ 8 rgyal tshab blo gros 'bum pa/ 9 rgyal tshab blo gros seṅge/ 10 rgyal tshab byang chub blo gros/ 11 de'i rgyal tshab byang chub seṅge dang /12 byang chub rgyal mtshan/ byang chub rgyal mtshan gyi slob ma 13 gnyags chen ye shes gzhon nu'i rnam 'phrul bu 'bor ba mkhas grub ye shes rgyal mtshan ste/'di yan chad laḥthog bla rabs bcu gsum zhes rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam 'phrul zam ma chad par byon cing / snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa shin tu dar ba mdzad/gzhan yang dam pa bde gshegasakyi slob ma/ shesarab rgyal mtshan/ shesarab dpal ba/ shes rab rdo rje ste rong po thosamachog rnam gsum/ lung bstan bu bzhir grags pa ni/ 'bru tsha sgang pas bu rong gzhag gsum kha ba dkar po yan chad du dgon gnas brgya rtsa brgyad btab/ rtsa sde spyan snga nam mkha' rdo rjes go 'jo rtsa sde dgon btab/ me+og ston 'jam dpal seng ges 'bri rgyud du dgon pa mdzad cing / khong lasagrub thob rmog rab bcu gsum du gragasapa byung / grub thob ma ṇi rin chen gser rag cog tu bzhugs shing / mthar 'od phung du gshegs pa sogs mkhas grub kyi tshad chen po brdol/ bla rabs bcu gsum gyi rjes su drung rabasabacu gsum byon yang / bka' ma rnams rim gyisalhag phra nas/ gter ma'i phyogasadar rgyasasu gyur/ de yang mkhas grub ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi slob ma/ lab stod nam mkha' rin chen/ de nas drung nam mkha' seng 15

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar ning gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/spyan snga bsod nams 'bum pa/ 4 dbu 'od ye shes 'bum pa/ 'phags pa po cher dbang phul/ 5 rgyal tshab byang chub dpal ba/ 6 rgyal tshab bsod nams bzang po / 'di skabs tsam nas nyang chos dbang sogs kyi gter chos yang sung zad dar ba byung / 7 rgyal tshab kun dga' 'bum pa/ 8 rgyal tshab blo gros 'bum pa/ 9 rgyal tshab blo gros seṅge/ 10 rgyal tshab byang chub blo gros/ 11 de'i rgyal tshab byang chub seṅge dang /12 byang chub rgyal mtshan/ byang chub rgyal mtshan gyi slob ma 13 gnyags chen ye shes gzhon nu'i rnam 'phrul bu 'bor ba mkhas grub ye shes rgyal mtshan ste/'di yan chad laḥthog bla rabs bcu gsum zhes rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam 'phrul zam ma chad par byon cing / snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa shin tu dar ba mdzad/gzhan yang dam pa bde gshegs kyi slob ma/ shes rab rgyal mtshan/ shes rab dpal ba/ shes rab rdo rje ste rong po thos mchog rnam gsum/ lung bstan bu bzhir grags pa ni/ 'bru tsha sgang pas bu rong gzhag gsum kha ba dkar po yan chad du dgon gnas brgya rtsa brgyad btab/ rtsa sde spyan snga nam mkha' rdo rjes go 'jo rtsa sde dgon btab/ rmog ston 'jam dpal seng ges 'bri rgyud du dgon pa mdzad cing / khong las grub thob rmog rab bcu gsum du grags pa byung / grub thob ma ṇi rin chen gser rag cog tu bzhugs shing / mthar 'od phung du gshegs pa sogs mkhas grub kyi tshad chen po brdol/ bla rabs bcu gsum gyi rjes su drung rabs bcu gsum byon yang / bka' ma rnams rim gyis lhag phra nas/ gter ma'i phyogs dar rgyas su gyur/ de yang mkhas grub ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi slob ma/ lab stod nam mkha' rin chen/ de nas drung nam mkha' seng 15

ba chen 'od snangalas/ saskya'i mosa'abyung khesabasdus/ ()ge 'di nas bzung gdan sa 'dzin pa re dang / 'chad nyan pa re zur du byung ba'i srol dod pa las/ gdan sapa drung rdo rje blo gros/ 'chad nyan pa bsod namasa'abum/ gdan sa pa drung rgyal ma rdo rje/ 'chad nyan pa dge 'dun 'bum/gdan sa pa drung mgon po rdo rje/ 'chad nyan pa nam mkha' dpal/ 'di dusa.a rdo dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis rdzogs chen dgongs pa zangs thal spel bas dar rgyas che bar byung / gdan sa pa drung lha dbang rdo rjes mdzad/ dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi slob ma rong po dkon mchog rdo rje/ de'i slob ma hor po shākya rgyal mtshan/ de'i slob ma mtshungasamed byang chub seṅge ste/ 'di'i sku tshe'i mjug tsam la / bu 'bor pa bkra shis rgya mtsho byon/ 'di dus gdan sa pa drung rnam par dge ba'i mtshan can gyis mdzad/ bkra shis rgya mtsho'i slob ma rmog tsha he pa chos 'byung / rgyal thang ba bstan pa seng ge dpal mo/ shes rab bzang po/ rgyal rong ba sogs slob ma mang / gdan sa pa drung rta mgrin zhes pas mdzad/ de dus bla ma tshe mdo'i mtshan can dang / grub thob ma la bla ma sogs bzhugs/ g.yin yang / sngo kha sangs rgyas rin chen dang / dpal 'bar ba nam mkha' rgya mtsho sogs byon/ nam mkha' rgya mtsho'i slob ma bso dbang drag rgya mtsho/ de'i slob ma sgar rje chos skyong rgya mtsho/ de'i slob ma byang chub rgyal mtshan te gter chen klong gsal snying po/ yang rgyal thang ba'i slob ma a rdo dkon mchog seṅge/ de'i slob ma gter chen bdud 'dul rdo rje/ de'i slob ma klong gsal snying po/ yang /dkon mchog seng ge'i slob ma gser lo bstan pa rgyal mtshan dang / chos nyid rgya mtsho gnyis/ de gnyis ga'i slob ma rig 'dzin kun bzang shes rab yin la/16

yo chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chosang gces bsdus/ ()ge 'di nas bzung gdan sa 'dzin pa re dang / 'chad nyan pa re zur du byung ba'i srol dod pa las/ gdan sa pa drung rdo rje blo gros/ 'chad nyan pa bsod namasa'abum/ gdan sa pa drung rgyal mtshan rdo rje/ 'chad nyan pa dge 'dun 'bum/gdan sa pa drung mgon po rdo rje/ 'chad nyan pa nam mkha' dpal/ 'di dus a rdo dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis rdzogs chen dgongs pa zangs thal spel bas dar rgyas che bar byung / gdan sa pa drung lha dbang rdo rjes mdzad/ dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi slob ma rong po dkon mchog rdo rje/ de'i slob ma hor po shākya gyol mtshan/ de'i slob ma mtshudas med byang chub seṅge ste/ 'di'i sku tshe'i mjug tsam la / bu 'bor pa bkra shis rgya mtsho byon/ 'di dus gdan sa pa drung rnam par dge ba'i mtshan can gyis mdzad/ bkra shis rgya mtsho'i slob ma rmog tsha he pa chos 'byung / rgyal thang ba bstan pa seng ge dpal mo/ shes rab bzang po/ rgyal rong ba sogs slob ma mang / gdan sa pa drung rta mgrin zhes pas mdzad/ de dus bla ma tshe mdo'i mtshan can dang / grub thob ma la bla ma sogs bzhugs/ g.yin yang / sngo kha sangs rgyas rin chen dang / dpal 'bar ba nam mkha' rgya mtsho sogs byon/ nam mkha' rgya mtsho'i slob ma bso dbang drag rgya mtsho/ de'i slob ma sgar rje chos skyong rgya mtsho/ de'i slob ma byang chub rgyal mtshan te gter chen klong gsal snying po/ yang rgyal thang ba'i slob ma a rdo dkon mchog seṅge/ de'i slob ma gter chen bdud 'dul rdo rje/ de'i slob ma klong gsal snying po/ yang /dkon mchog seng ge'i slob ma gser lo bstan pa rgyal mtshan dang / chos nyid rgya mtsho gnyis/ de gnyis ga'i slob ma rig 'dzin kun bzang shes rab yin la/16

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/rgyal rong ba'i slob ma stag phu bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang / de'i slob ma dbon sangs rgyas bkra shis rnams so/ /'di skabs tsam na lang gro lo tsā ba'i rnam 'phrul gter chen rig 'dzin klong gsal snying po byon te/ de yang dam po gnas dang nye ba'i dpra ba zhes pa'i nang tshan zhig tu 'brungs/ sgar rje chos skyong rgya mtsho dang / rig 'dzin bdud 'dul rdo rje sogs bsten cing / thos bsam sgom gsum gyi pha mthar son/ dgung lo so gnyis par gter gyi kha byang byung ba la brten/ so bzhi pa nas bzung / khe mi 'gyur rdo rje'i brag sogs nas klong gsal rdo rje snying pos mtshon zab gter kyang mang du bzhes/ sde dge chos rgyal chen po'i bkas bskul te gaḥthog tu bzhugs nas bstan pa'i nyams gso mdzad/ de dus rkaḥthog tu nyin dgon bla ma sangs rgyas bkra shis bzhugs pa yin no/ /rgyal sras bsod nams lde'u btsan ni/ yab rje gter chen klong gsal dang / yum rigs ldan lha skyid ces pa'i sras su zhabrungs/ bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi rigs kyi cod pan rnal 'byor pa nus ldan rdo rje dang 'brog ban lo tsā sogs kyi rnam rol gter chen bdud 'dul rdo rje'i sku'i skye ba 'phos ma thag pa yin/ dgung lo zhe dgu par gshegs/ rigs srasazhig byung ba rgyal sras bstan 'phel yin no/ /de rjes gdan sa dbon po tshe dbang phrin las kyis gnang / chos brgyud 'chad spel ni drung nam mkha' rgya mtshos mdzad/ rgyal sras bsod nams lde'u btsan gyi yang srid dri med zhing skyong mgon po ste/ mdo smad 'ba' yul du/ gter chen pad+ma chos rgyal gyi sras su 'khrungs/ drung nam mkha' rgya mtsho dang / kun mkhyen si tu rin po che sogs bsten nas mkhas btsun grub 17

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/rgyal rong ba'i slob ma stag phu bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang / de'i slob ma dbon sangs rgyas bkra shis rnams so/ /'di skabs tsam na lang gro lo tsā ba'i rnam 'phrul gter chen rig 'dzin klong gsal snying po byon te/ de yang dam po gnas dang nye ba'i dpra ba zhes pa'i nang tshan zhig tu 'brungs/ sgar rje chos skyong rgya mtsho dang / rig 'dzin bdud 'dul rdo rje sogs bsten cing / thos bsam sgom gsum gyi pha mthar son/ dgung lo so gnyis par gter gyi kha byang byung ba la brten/ so bzhi pa nas bzung / khe mi 'gyur rdo rje'i brag sogs nas klong gsal rdo rje snying pos mtshon zab gter kyang mang du bzhes/ sde dge chos rgyal chen po'i bkas bskul te gaḥthog tu bzhugs nas bstan pa'i nyams gso mdzad/ de dus rkaḥthog tu nyin dgon bla ma sangs rgyas bkra shis bzhugs pa yin no/ /rgyal sras bsod nams lde'u btsan ni/ yab rje gter chen klong gsal dang / yum rigs ldan lha skyid ces pa'i sras su 'khrungs/ bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi rigs kyi cod pan rnal 'byor pa nus ldan rdo rje dang 'brog ban lo tsā sogs kyi rnam rol gter chen bdud 'dul rdo rje'i sku'i skye ba 'phos ma thag pa yin/ dgung lo zhe dgu par gshegs/ rigs srasazhig byung ba rgyal sras bstan 'phel yin no/ /de rjes gdan sa dbon po tshe dbang phrin las kyis gnang / chos brgyud 'chad spel ni drung nam mkha' rgya mtshos mdzad/ rgyal sras bsod nams lde'u btsan gyi yang srid dri med zhing skyong mgon po ste/ mdo smad 'ba' yul du/ gter chen pad+ma chos rgyal gyi sras su 'khrungs/ drung nam mkha' rgya mtsho dang / kun mkhyen si tu rin po che sogs bsten nas mkhas btsun grub 17

ba tshe chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab cing 'khor lo gsum gyi phyag rjes rgya che/ 'di skabs lo chen be+e ro tsā na dang / shud pu dpal gyi seṅge zung du 'jug pa'i ye shesasgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rol gar 'khrul zhig dbang drag rgya mtsho dang / gter chen mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku'i skye ba rmog ston rig 'dzin nam mkha' chos dbang zhes grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po de'ang bzhugs/ de gnyis kyi zhal slob kyi gtso bo ni/dbon po tshe dbang phrin las kyi yang srid daḥpaṇ+ḍi ta 'gyur med tshe dbang mchog grub dang / dge rtse khro shul dpon tshang du gzungs/ bdud 'dul klong gsal gnyis ka'i chos bdag lung zin sbra mgo brtson 'grus rgya mtsho'i rnam rol kun bzang nges don dbang po ste/ phyag tsha dbon sgo du 'brungs/ snga mas gdan tshab yun ring du mdzad/gzhan yang si tu paṇ+ḍi ta'i sprul pa'i bye brag o rgyan bsam 'grub sogs byon/de rjes dri med zhing skyong mgon po'i yang srid rin po che snga ma'i dbon brgyud du 'khrungs pa 'jigs med rig 'dzin mgon pos gdan sa'i khur bsnams shing /rmog grub rin po che'i rnam rol 'jigs bral chos dbyings rdo rje dang / nyin dgon sprul pa'i sku 'od gsal rdo rje snying po sogs kyang bzhugs shing / slar yang 'jigs med rig 'dzin mgon po'i yang srid snga ma rigs kyi 'khri shing las son pa zhabs pad brtan bzhin pa dang / sku skye o rgyan bsam 'grub kyi yang srid mchog sprul rin po che chos kyi blo gros zhes bstan pa'i gsal byed chen por bzhugs pas mtshon/ bshad sgrub kyi phrin las lhag par dar ba 'di lags so/ / dpal yul rnam rgyal byang chub gling ni/ rig 'dzin kun bzang shes rab 18

ba chen 'od snang la / saskya'i mosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab cing 'khor lo gsum gyi phyag rjes rgya che/ 'di skabs lo chen be+e ro tsā na dang / shud pu dpal gyi seṅge zung du 'jug pa'i ye shesasgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rol gar 'khrul zhig dbang drag rgya mtsho dang / gter chen mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku'i skye ba rmog ston rig 'dzin nam mkha' chos dbang zhes grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po de'ang bzhugs/ de gnyis kyi zhal slob kyi gtso bo ni/dbon po tshe dbang phrin las kyi yang srid daḥpaṇ+ḍi ta 'gyur med tshe dbang mchog grub dang / dge rtse khro shul dpon tsha du gzungs/ bdud 'dul klong gsal gnyisaga'i chos bdag lung zin sbra mgo brtson 'grus rgya mtsho'i rnam rol kun bzang nges don dbang po ste/ phyag tsha dbon sgo du 'brungs/ snga mas gdan tshab yun ring du mdzad/gzhan yang si tu paṇ+ḍi ta'i sprul pa'i bye brag o rgyan bsam 'grub sogs byon/de rjes dri med zhing skyong mgon po'i yang srid rin po che snga ma'i dbon brgyud du 'khrungs pa 'jigs med rig 'dzin mgon pos gdan sa'i khur bsnams shing /me+og grub rin po che'i rnam rol 'jigs bral chos dbyings rdo rje dang / nyin dgon sprul pa'i sku 'od gsal rdo rje snying po sogs kyang bzhugs shing / slar yang 'jigs med rig 'dzin mgon po'i yang srid snga ma rigs kyi 'khri shing las son pa zhabs pad brtan bzhin pa dang / sku skye o rgyan bsam 'grub kyi yang srid mchog sprul rin po che chos kyi blo gros zhes bstan pa'i gsal byed chen por bzhu+ogs pas mtshon/ bshad sgrub kyi phrin lasalhag par dar ba 'di lags sa/ /dpal yul rnam rgyal byang chub gling ni/ rig 'dzin kun bzang shes rab 18

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/kyis/bskyangs te/ de yang dpal yul gyi bye brag a 'khyog zhes par 'khrungs/sgar rje chos skyong rgya mtsho la gtsug phud phul/ gser lo bstan pa rgyal mtshan dang / chos nyid rgya mtsho/ rig 'dzin klong gsal snying po sogasadang / khyad par gter chen mi 'gyur rdo rje dang / rig 'dzin rkarma chagasamed gnyis rtsa ba'i bla mar bzung ste thos bsam sgom pa'i pha rol tu gshegs/ dgung lo sum cu par sa skyong sde dge'i lung gis dpal yul rnam rgyal rtser phebs nas 'khor lo gsum gyi mnga' thang gong du 'phel/ sku tshe'i smad la lha ri 'od gsal 'da' kho sgang gi ri khrod btab nas bzhugs/ re gsum par gshegs/ de rjes rje nyid kyi dbon pad+ma lhun grub rgya mtsho/ de'i thugs sras mtshungs med pad+ma nor bu/kun bzang shes rab kyi dbon brgyud mkhyen nus kyi mnga' bdag bla ma rkarma bkra shis rnams rim par byon nas gdan sa mdzad/ bar 'dir game bkra shis kyi snag dbon bla ma a bsam dang / dbang phyug gnyis kyis re zhig gdan sa'i 'dzin skyong dang / slar yang bla ma game bkra shis kyi yang srid rin po che rkarma 'gyur med ngesadon dang / bla ma dbang phyug gi sku skye sogs bzhugs shing bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i skabs so/ /gzhan yang gtsang gshis phyogs su 'khrungs pa'i bla ma pad+ma rgyal mtshan ni/ mkhas grub sog bzlog pa dang / zhig gling gi slob mar gyur/ de'i slob ma mkhas grub chen po stag bla pad+ma ma ti/ de'i slob ma bla ma tshe ring rdo rje dang / pad+ma rig 'dzin gnyisabyung ba las/ snga ma'i dbon kun bzang ye shesamathong grol dang / kun bzang khyab brdal lhun grub gnyis/ de'i dbon kun bzang ye shes dang / kun bzang 19

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/kyi ba'i bskyangs te/ de yang dpal yul gyi bye brag a 'a shes ga zhes par 'khrungs/sgar rje chos skyong rgya mtsho la gtsug phud phul/ gser lo bstan pa rgyal mtshan dang / chos nyid rgya mtsho/ rig 'dzin klong gsal snying po sogs dang / khyad par gter chen mi 'gyur rdo rje dang / rig 'dzin rkarma chags med gnyis rtsa ba'i bla mar bzung ste thos bsam sgom pa'i pha rol tu gshegs/ dgung lo sum cu par sa skyong sde dge'i lung gis dpal yul rnam rgyal rtser phebs nas 'khor lo gsum gyi mnga' thang gong du 'phel/ sku tshe'i smad la lha ri 'od gsal 'da' kho sgang gi ri khrod btab nas bzhugs/ re gsum par gshegs/ de rjes rje nyid kyi dbon pad+ma lhun grub rgya mtsho/ de'i thugs sras mtshungs med pad+ma nor bu/kun bzang shes rab kyi dbon brgyud mkhyen nus kyi mnga' bdag bla ma dme bkra shis rnams rim par byon nas gdan sa mdzad/ bar 'dir ga me bkra shis kyi snag dbon bla ma a bsam dang / dbang phyug gnyis kyis re zhig gdan sa'i 'dzin skyong dang / slar yang bla ma ga me bkra shis kyi yang srid rin po che ga me 'gyur med nges don dang / bla ma dbang phyug gi sku skye sogs bzhugs shing bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i skabs so/ /gzhan yang gtsang gshis phyogs su 'khrungs pa'i bla ma pad+ma rgyal mtshan ni/ mkhas grub sog bzlog pa dang / zhig gling gi slob mar gyur/ de'i slob ma mkhas grub chen po stag bla pad+ma ma ti/ de'i slob ma bla ma tshe ring rdo rje dang / pad+ma rig 'dzin gnyisabyung ba las/ snga ma'i dbon kun bzang ye shes mthong grol dang / kun bzang khyab brdal lhun grub gnyis/ de'i dbon kun bzang ye shes dang / kun bzang 19

ba tshe chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ltas/rnam rgyal gnyis/ kun bzang khyab brdal gyi sprul sku rdo rje dpa' bo dang / de'i sprul sku yid bzhin dbang rgyal gyi bar du byon pa ste brag dmar pa dang / pad+ma rig 'dzin gyi dbon po pad+ma blo ldan dang / pad+ma nor bu/ de'i dbon po bla ma bskal bzang dang / pad+ma nor bu'i skye ba ni rig 'dzin chen po tshe dbang nor bu zhes nyi zla ltar yongs su grags pa'i mkhas grub chen po de nyid de/ jo mo nang ngam gnas nang bar grags pa sogs dang / sgar rje chos skyong rgya mtsho'i dbon brgyud rim byon gyi gdan sa khams gong dgon sogs kyis mtshon 'ba' dang rong gnas mtshams/ go brag gtsang gnyis/ re khe/ nyag rong stod smad/ rdog ser mgu log shar rgyal mo rong gi bar du rgyal ba gnyis pa gaḥthog pa dang /dpal yul ba'i phrin las las byung ba'i dgon gnas che phra mtha' klas so/ /grub dbang rdzogs chen pa'i gdan rabs la/ chos brgyud gang las byung ba dang / gdan rabs dngos bshad pa la gnyis/ dang po ni/ rdzogs pa chen po snying thig gi bka' srol spyi dang / de yang dus gsum mkhyen pa o rgyan chen pos ye shes ḍak+ki mtsho rgyal ma la mnog chos su stsal zhing / lha lcam pad+ma gsal gyi chos skal du deng lung khra mo brag tu sbas pa pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis gter nas spyan drangs te kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer gyis dar rgyas su mdzad pa nas bzung / gu ru ye shes rab 'byams sogs las rim par brgyud pa'i man ngag gi bdud rtsis rang gzhan rnams smin grol la 'god par mdzad pas chos kyi ming gang zag la chags pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen gtsug tor can dang / bram ze chen po sar ha/ paṇ+ḍita bi ma la mi tra la 20

bzuchen 'od snang las/ saskya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()rnam rgyal gnyis/ kun bzang khyab brdal gyi sprul sku rdo rje dpa' bo dang / de'i sprul sku yid bzhin dbang rgyal gyi bar du byon pa ste brag dmar pa dang / pad+ma rig 'dzin gyi dbon po pad+ma blo ldan dang / pad+ma nor bu/ de'i dbon po bla ma bskal bzang dang / pad+ma nor bu'i skye ba ni rig 'dzin chen po tshe dbang nor bu zhes nyi zla ltar yongs su grags pa'i mkhas grub chen po de nyid de/ jo mo nang ngam gnas nang bar grags pa sogs dang / sgar rje chos skyong rgya mtsho'i dbon brgyud rim byon gyi gdan sa khams gong dgon sogs kyis mtshon 'ba' dang rong gnas mtshams/ go brag gtsang gnyis/ rikhre/ nyag rong stod smad/ rdog ser mgu log shar rgyal mo rong gi bar du rgyal ba gnyis pa gaḥthog pa dang /dpal yul ba'i phrin las las byung ba'i dgon gnas che phra mtha' klas so/ /grub dbang rdzogs chen pa'i gdan rabs la/ chos brgyud gang las byung ba dang / gdan rabs dngos bshad pa la gnyis/ dang po ni/ rdzogasapa chen po snying thig gi bka' srol spyi dang / de yang dus gsum mkhyen pa o rgyan chen pos ye shes ḍāk+ki mtsho rgyal ma la mnog chos su stsal zhing / lha lcam pad+ma gsal gyi chos skal du deng lung khra mo brag tu sbas pa pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis gter nas spyan drangs te kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer gyis dar rgyas su mdzad pa nas bzung / gu ru ye shes rab 'byams sogs las rim par brgyud pa'i man ngag gi bdud rtsis rang gzhan rnams smin grol la 'god par mdzad pas chos kyi ming gang zag la chags pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyasarin chen gtsug tor can dang / bram ze chen po sar ha/ paṇ+ḍita bi ma la mi tra la 20

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasang rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/sogs pa'i ye shes sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rol gar grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma rig 'dzin zhes grags pa de nyid ni/ khams ri bo che'i phyogs su sku 'brungs/ mkhas grub game chagasamed/ rig 'dzin bdud 'dul rdo rje/ gnam chos mi 'gyur rdo rje / rig 'dzin chos kyi rgya mtsho sogs lasagasan bsam gyi sgro 'dogs bcad de / bsgom pas thugs nyamagasu bzhes pas gdod ma'i rgyal sar gshegs shing / phyag na pad+mo lnga pa chen pos kyang bsngags brjod kyi me tog lhag par 'thor/ dgung lo drug cu par khamasaphyogasasu phebs shing / sde dge sangasargyasabastan pa dang yon mchod du 'brel bas/ re gcig par shing glang lor ru ngam skyid phram lung par sgrub sde o rgyan bsam gtan chos gling 'di nyid btab/ don gsum par gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus so/ /de nas gdan sar rim pa bzhin du/ dpon slob nam mkha' 'od gsal ni/ nag shod du 'khrungs/ grub chen me long rdo rje'i sprul par grags/ sku tshe yang mthar phyin par bzhugs/rdzogs chen gnyis pa 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin ni/ ru ngam g.yang 'khyil du sog po'i rgyal po kun dga' dwa chings kyi 'bangs rigs su 'khrungs/dpon slob rin po che gter chen 'gyur med rdo rje sogs yongs 'dzin rgya mtsho lta bu bsten nasamakhas grub kyi go 'phang mthon por gshegs/ 'khor lo gsum gyi phyag rjesagong 'phel du gyur/ dbon rin po che 'gyur med pad+ma kun grol rnam rgyal ni/ dpon slob rin po che'i dbon du 'khrungs/ gter chen bdud 'dul rdo rje'i rnam 'phrul du grags/ rdzogasachen gnyis pa'i rjes su gdan sa'i khur bzhes/ re bdun par gshegs/ rdzogs chen gsum pa ngesadon bstan 21

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsang rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/sogs pa'i ye shes sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rol gar grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma rig 'dzin zhes grags pa de nyid ni/ khams ri bo che'i phyogs su sku 'brungs/ mkhas grub ga me chags med/ rig 'dzin bdud 'dul rdo rje/ gnam chos mi 'gyur rdo rje / rig 'dzin chos kyi rgya mtsho sogs las gsan bsam gyi sgro 'dogs bcad de / bsgom pas thugs nyams su bzhes pas gdod ma'i rgyal sar gshegs shing / phyag na pad+mo lnga pa chen pos kyang bsngags brjod kyi me tog lhag par 'thor/ dgung lo drug cu par khams phyogs su phebs shing / sde dge sangs rgyasabastan pa dang yon mchod du 'brel bas/ re gcig par shing glang lor ru ngam skyid phram lung par sgrub sde o rgyan bsam gtan chos gling 'di nyid btab/ don gsum par gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus so/ /de nas gdan sar rim pa bzhin du/ dpon slob nam mkha' 'od gsal ni/ nag shod du 'khrungs/ grub chen me long rdo rje'i sprul par grags/ sku tshe yang mthar phyin par bzhugs/rdzogs chen gnyis pa 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin ni/ ru ngam g.yang 'khyil du sog po'i rgyal po kun dga' dwa chings kyi 'bangs rigs su 'khrungs/dpon slob rin po che gter chen 'gyur med rdo rje sogs yongs 'dzin rgya mtsho lta bu bsten nas mkhas grub kyi go 'phang mthon por gshegs/ 'khor lo gsum gyi phyag rjes gong 'phel du gyur/ dbon rin po che 'gyur med pad+ma kun grol rnam rgyal ni/ dpon slob rin po che'i dbon du 'byungs/ gter chen bdud 'dul rdo rje'i rnam 'phrul du grags/ rdzogs chen gnyis pa'i rjes su gdan sa'i khur bzhes/ re bdun par gshegs/ rdzogs chen gsum pa nges don bstan 21

ba ho 'od palas/ saskya'i mosayangagacespobasdus/ ()'dzin bzang po ni/ zla rgyud du ho pa zhes pa'i char 'khrungs/ nyi sprul gnyisapa dang / dbon rin po che sogs lasagasan pa rgya mtsho lta bu mdzad/ bka' ma'i sgrub mchod btsugs pa sogs phyag rjesargya che/ solnga par gshegs/ dpon slob gnyis pa pad+ma gsang sngagasabastan 'dzin ni/ gdan sa po dang nye ba'i phyogs shig tu 'khrungs/ rtogs pa'i dbang phyug chen por bzhugs/ 'on kyang gdan sa'i khur re zhig las ma mdzad/ phrin lasamatha' klasapa'i ngang don bzhi par gshegs/ de'i sprul sku ru ngam du 'khrungasapa'i nam mkha' chosakyi rgya mtsho dang / de'i sprul sku yid lhung la thog tu 'khrungs pa'i 'jigs med chosadabyings 'od gsal zhes da lta zhal bzhugs pa 'di'o/ /mkhas btsun bla ma nam mkha' tshe dbang mchog grub ni/ g.yu sgra'i rnam 'phrul hor tre ho bla ma 'gyur med skal bzang gi yang srid du yid lhung gi sa'i char 'brungs/ dbon rin po che sogs bsten nas mkhas grub chen por gyur/ rdzogasachen gyi gdan g.yang yun ring du mdzad nas bstan pa la bka' drin che/ rdzogasachen bzhi pa mi 'gyur nam mkha' rdo rje'am/ 'jigasamed mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug ni/ ldan yul du zhabrungs/ bla ma lha srung spyi dang / khyad par kun mkhyen 'jigasamed gling pa'i lung gis som nyi'i dra ba bcad de gdan sachen por zhabasabakod/ thugasarje dang phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pas bstan 'gro'i don mdzad bzhin par zhabs pad brtan pa 'di'o/ /zhar byung rgya rong rtag brtan sgrub sde ni/ rje dbon rin po chesadagung lo so bdun par zhabs kyis bcagasashing rim par btab/ de nasanam mkha' tshe dbang mchog grub dang / rje dbon rin po che'i yang srid nyi grags gsum pa'i 22

'tshe' 'od pal / sa skya'i chosang gces bsdus/ ()'dzin bzang po ni/ zla rgyud du ho pa zhes pa'i char zhakhrungs/ nyi sprul gnyis pa dang / dbon rin po che sogs las gsan pa rgya mtsho lta bu mdzad/ bka' ma'i sgrub mchod btsugs pa sogs phyag rjes rgya che/ so lnga par gshegs/ dpon slob gnyis pa pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin ni/ gdan sa chen po dang nye ba'i phyogs shig tu 'khrungs/ rtogs pa'i dbang phyug chen por bzhugs/ 'on kyang gdan sa'i khur re zhig las ma mdzad/ phrin las mtha' klas pa'i ngang don bzhi par gshegs/ de'i sprul sku ru ngam du 'khrungs pa'i nam mkha' chos kyi rgya mtsho dang / de'i sprul sku yid lhung la thog tu 'khrungs pa'i 'jigs med chos dbyings 'od gsal zhes da lta zhal bzhugs pa 'di'o/ /mkhas btsun bla ma nam mkha' tshe dbang mchog grub ni/ g.yu sgra'i rnam 'phrul hor tre ho bla ma 'gyur med skal bzang gi yang srid du yid lhung gi sa'i char 'brungs/ dbon rin po che sogs bsten nas mkhas grub chen por gyur/ rdzogs chen gyi gdan g.yang yun ring du mdzad nas bstan pa la bka' drin che/ rdzogs chen bzhi pa mi 'gyur nam mkha' rdo rje'am/ 'jigs med mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug ni/ ldan yul du 'khrungs/ bla ma lha srung spyi dang / khyad par kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa'i lung gis som nyi'i dra ba bcad de gdan sa chen por zhabs bkod/ thugs rje dang phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pas bstan 'gro'i don mdzad bzhin par zhabs pad brtan pa 'di'o/ /zhar byung rgya rong rtag brtan sgrub sde ni/ rje dbon rin po ches dgung lo so bdun par zhabs kyis bcags shing rim par btab/ de nas nam mkha' tshe dbang mchog grub dang / rje dbon rin po che'i yang srid nyi grags gsum pa'i 22
