gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/gcung kun bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma dang / slar yang de'i yang srid yid lhung du 'brungs pa'i gar dbang thugs mchog rdo rje dang / nam mkha' rin po che'i yang srid dpon slob bzhi pa'i mched kun bzang theg mchog rdo rje bcas kyis 'dzin skyong gnang bzhin du bzhugs so/ yi/ba dbang rdzogs chen pa'i thugs sras gter chen nyi ma grags pa rtsal ni/ 'phags mchog sems nyid ngal gso dang /lo chen 'khon klu dbang srung ba sogs dag pa'i skye srid bgrangs las 'das pa'i mthar/ sgom sde nang chen gyi sa'i cha ban ru gru ya zhes par sku 'khrungs/grub dbang rin po che dang / gter chen bdud 'dul rdo rje sogs la bsten nasamakhas grub chen por gyur/ dgung lo nyer gsum par tsā ri nas gter gyi kha byang phyag tu son pa la brten/ nyer brgyad pa shing stag lor srid rdzong rdo rje snying rdzong nas rtsa gsum gsang ba snying tig gis mtshon/ rim par zab gter rgya mtsho lta bu spyan drangs/ chu bya lor stag mo sgang skal bzang phun tshogs gling dang / chu lug lor chag ru 'od gsal sgrub sde btab/ lcags stag lor gshegs/ de'i zhal slob bla ma skal bzang dbang ldan dang / bla ma blo gros rgya mtsho gnyis kyi/snga ma las nyi sprul gnyis pa dang / phyi ma las rdzogs chen dbon rin po chesagasan nas chos brgyud rgya cher 'phel/ gzhan yang hor lo chen dang / bka' bcu bkra shis dpal ldan sogs mang ngo / /gdan rabs gnyis pa rgyal srasa.o rgyan bstan 'dzin ni/ yab gter chen dang / yum ṭā ki tshe ring dbang mo'i sras su 'brungs/ dwags po bzang po rdo rje'i skye bar grags/ nyer bdun par gshegs/ de la sprul sku lnga tsam byon kyang sku na mthar ma son par gshegs23

gangasacan bod yuladu byon pa'i gsang sngagasagapar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/gcung kun bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma dang / slar yang de'i yang srid yid lhung du 'byungs pa'i gar dbang thugs mchog rdo rje dang / nam mkha' rin po che'i yang srid dpon slob bzhi pa'i mched kun bzang theg mchog rdo rje bcas kyis 'dzin skyong gnang bzhin du bzhugs so/ khuspyab dbang rdzogs chen pa'i thugasasras gter chen nyi ma grags pa rtsal ni/ 'phags mchog sems nyid ngal gso dang /lo chen 'khon klu dbang srung ba sogasadag pa'i skye srid bgrangs lasa'adas pa'i mthar/ sgom sde nang chen gyi sa'i cha ban ru gru ya zhes par sku zhabrungs/grub dbang rin po che dang / gter chen bdud 'dul rdo rje sogs la bsten nasamakhas grub chen por gyur/ dgung lo nyer gsum par tsā ri nas gter gyi kha byang phyag tu son pa la brten/ nyer brgyad pa shing stag lor srid rdzong rdo rje snying rdzong nas rtsa gsum gsang ba snying tig gisamatshon/ rim par zab gter rgya mtsho lta bu spyan drangs/ chu bya lor stag mo sgang skal bzang phun tshogasagling dang / chu lug lor chag ru 'od gsal sgrub sde btab/ lcagabakastag lor gshegs/ de'i zhal slob bla ma skal bzang dbang ldan dang / bla ma blo gros rgya mtsho gnyisakyi/snga ma las nyi sprul gnyis pa dang / phyi ma las rdzogs chen dbon rin po chesagasan nas chosabargyud rgya cher 'phel/ gzhan yang hor lo chen dang / bka' bcu bkra shis dpal ldan sogs mang ngo / /gdan rabasaganyisapa rgyal srasa.o rgyan bstan 'dzin ni/ yab gter chen dang / yum ṭā ki tshe ring dbang mo'i sras su 'khrungs/ dwags po bzang po rdo rje'i skye bar grags/ nyer bdun par gshegs/ de la sprul sku lnga tsam byon kyang sku na mthar ma son par gshegs23

ba chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chosang gces bsdus/ ()shing / deng sang dwags po gter chen sras nyi sprul bzhi pa'i gcen du 'khrungs pa gter ston bde chen gling par grags pa de'o/ /gdan rabs gsum pa nyi sprul gnyis pa pad+ma theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan nam/ rig 'dzin bstan skyong rgya mtsho ni nag shod smad du 'khrungs/ dgung lo lnga par gdan sar phebs/ rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho/ rgyal sras rin chen dang / bla ma skal bzang dbang ldan sogs yongs 'dzin rgya mtsho lta bur bsten/ thos bsam sgom gsum dang mkhas btsun grub pa'i pha rol tu son pas bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen du bsngags/ bka' srol 'dzin nges kyi slob ma'ang / dbon po pad+ma 'jigs med dang / dpa' bo las rab rtsal/ khro shul rig 'dzin rgya mtsho/mkhas dbang ngag dbang blo gros sogs mang du byon cing gsung gi bdud rtsi bzhes pa'i slob tshogs ni bsam gyis mi khyab/ gdan rabs bzhi pa gu gu bla ma bstan 'dzin snying po ni/ sog rong stod du 'brungs/ nyi sprul gnyis pa sogs bsten/ sku btsun zhing grub pa'i nyams myong sogs khyad par du 'phags/ gdan sa gong 'og gnyis kur phebs/ gdan rabs lnga pa nyi sprul gsum pa rin po che mi 'gyur phan bde rgya mtsho ni/ byang yid lhung gi sa'i char chen po gling gi rigasasu 'khrungs/ dgung lo lnga par stag sgang du gdan drangs/ rdzogs chen gsum pa/dpa' bo las rab rtsal/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa sogs bsten nasathos bsam sgom pa'i yon tan la dbang 'byor/ 'khor lo gsum gyi phyag rjesargya che/ 'on kyang sku tshe mthar ma phyin par gshegs/ rje de yi yang srid ni/dwags po gter chen rdo rje rgyal po'i sras su 'khrungs shing / deng sang zhabs pad 24

ba chen 'odasnang las/ saskya'i mosa'abyung gtsesabasdus/ ()shing / deng sang dwags po gter chen sras nyi sprul bzhi pa'i gcen du zhabrungasapa gter ston bde chen gling par grags pa de'o/ /gdan rabs gsum pa nyi sprul gnyis pa pad+ma theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan nam/ rig 'dzin bstan skyong rgya mtsho ni nag shod smad du 'khrungs/ dgung lo lnga par gdan sar phebs/ rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho/ rgyal srasarin chen dang / bla ma skal bzang dbang ldan sogs yongasa'adzin rgya mtsho lta bur bsten/ thos bsam sgom gsum dang mkhas btsun grub pa'i pha rol tu son pas bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi dge ba'i bshesaganyen du bsngags/ bka' srol 'dzin nges kyi slob ma'ang / dbon po pad+ma 'jigs med dang / dpa' bo lasarab rtsal/ khro shul rig 'dzin rgya mtsho/mkhas dbang ngag dbang blo gros sogs mang du byon cing gsung gi bdud rtsi bzhes pa'i slob tshogs ni bsam gyis mi khyab/ gdan rabs bzhi pa gu gu bla ma bstan 'dzin snying po ni/ sog rong stod du 'khrungs/ nyi sprul gnyis pa sogs bsten/ sku btsun zhing grub pa'i nyams myong sogasakhyad par du 'phags/ gdan sa gong 'og gnyis kur phebs/ gdan rabs lnga pa nyi sprul gsum pa rin po che mi 'gyur phan bde rgya mtsho ni/ byang yid lhung gi sa'i char chen po gling gi rigasasu 'khrungs/ dgung lo lnga par stag sgang du gdan drangs/ rdzogasachen gsum pa/dpa' bo las rab rtsal/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa sogs bsten nasathos bsam sgom pa'i yon tan la dbang 'byor/ 'khor lo gsum gyi phyag rjesargya che/ 'on kyang sku tshe mthar ma phyin par gshegs/ rje de yi yang srid ni/dwags po gter chen rdo rje rgyal po'i sras su 'khrungs shing / deng sang zhabasapad 24

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/brtan bzhin bzhugs pa dang / zhal slob kyang nag shod gter chen klong chen rol pa rtsal dbon sprul o rgyan nyi ma/ grub dbang bstan 'dzin snying po'i sku skye 'gro mgon phrin las bstan dar dang / bla ma pad+ma bstan 'dzin gyi yang srid o rgyan chos rgyal sogs so/ /grub dbang rdzogs chen pa'i bstan pa spel ba'i byed po mtshungs med smra ba'i seng ge rab mas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan ni/ sangasargyas mya ngan med kyi rnam rol slob dpon hūm̐ kā ra dang / 'brog ban lo tsā ba rngog legs pa'i shes rab sogs dam pa'i skye srid brgyud mar bzung ba'i mthar/dbu ru 'phan yul du sku 'khrungs/ 'bras yul skyed tshal du mtshan nyid kyi gzhung mang por sbyangs shing grwa skor la phebs pas rab 'byams pa'i mtshan gyi cod pan dpyangs/ mdo sngags rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son/ yer par grub dbang rin po che mjal nas snying tig gi bdud rtsi gsol/ dpon slob lhan cig khams su phebs nas sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ dgung grangasang lnga par gshegs/de'i slob ma hor bla ma pad+ma dbang phyug gi gtso bor gyur pa rnams kyis zhe chen o rgyan chos rdzong gi 'dabs su sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ rab 'byams gnyis pa 'gyur med kun bzang rnam rgyal ni/ rdzogs chen gnyis pa'i gcung du 'khrungs/ gsan bsam sgom pa mthar phyin nas grub pa'i dbang phyug chen por gyur/ nyer lnga pa shing stag lor zhe chen bstan gnyis dar rgyasang btab/ nga brgyad par gshegs/ gdan sa gnyis pa rgyal tshab pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin chos rgyal ni/ gnubs chen nam mkha'i snying po la sogs pa'i rnam 'phrul rab 'byams pa'i slob ma grub dbang pad+ma rgyal mtshan gyi yang srid de/ lho ke chu 25

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/brtan bzhin bzhugs pa dang / zhal slob kyang nag shod gter chen klong rol pa rtsal dbon sprul o rgyan nyi ma/ grub dbang bstan 'dzin snying po'i sku skye 'gro mgon phrin las bstan dar dang / bla ma pad+ma bstan 'dzin gyi yang srid o rgyan chosargyal sogs so/ /grub dbang rdzogs chen pa'i bstan pa spel ba'i byed po mtshungasamed smra ba'i seng ge rab 'byamasabastan pa'i rgyal mtshan ni/ sangasargyas mya ngan med kyi rnam rol slob dpon hūm̐ kā ra dang / 'brog ban lo tsā ba rngog legasapa'i shes rab sogs dam pa'i skye srid brgyud mar bzung ba'i mthar/dbu ru 'phan yul du sku 'khrungs/ 'bras yul skyed tshal du mtshan nyid kyi gzhung mang por sbyangs shing grwa skor la phebs pas rab 'byams pa'i mtshan gyi cod pan dpyangs/ mdo sngagasargya mtsho'i pha rol tu son/ yer par grub dbang rin po che mjal nas snying tig gi bdud rtsi gsol/ dpon slob lhan cig khamasasu phebasanas sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ dgung grangasang lnga par gshegs/de'i slob ma hor bla ma pad+ma dbang phyug gi gtso bor gyur pa rnams kyis zhe chen o rgyan chos rdzong gi 'dabs su sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ rab 'byams gnyis pa 'gyur med kun bzang rnam rgyal ni/ rdzogasachen gnyis pa'i gcung du 'khrungs/ gsan bsam sgom pa mthar phyin nasagrub pa'i dbang phyug chen por gyur/ nyer lnga pa shing stag lor zhe chen bstan gnyisadar rgyasagling btab/ nga brgyad par gshegs/ gdan saganyis pa rgyal tshab pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin chos rgyal ni/ gnubs chen nam mkha'i snying po la sogs pa'i rnam 'phrul rab 'byams pa'i slob ma grub dbang pad+ma rgyal ma gyi yang srid de/ lho ke chu 25

bge' 'od snangal / saskya'i mosayang sa bsdus/ ()rgyud du yon dge mi 'gyur rdo rje'i dbon rigs su 'khrungs/ rab 'byams gnyis pa sogs brten nasamakhas grub chen po gyur/ zhe chen gyi gdan sar bzhugs nas 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad bzang gong 'phel du gnang / rab 'byams gsum pa rig 'dzin dpal 'byor rgya mtsho ni/ rgya rong sgrub sde dang nye ba'i phyogs su 'khrungs/ smin gling khri gyi sku mched/ rgyal tshab rin po che/kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa sogasabasten nas mang du gsan pa'i pha rol tu son/ shing stag lor sgrub sde pad+ma 'od gling gsar du btab pa sogasamadzad pa med du byungayang sku tshe mthar ma 'khyol bar gshegs/ de nas grub dbang pad+ma rgyal mtshan gyi dbon sangs rgyas rab brtan gyi yang srid gnas lnga rig pa'i ma hā paṇ+ḍita 'gyur med mthu stobs rnam rgyal dang / rab 'byamasabazhi pa gar dbang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rgyal tshab rin po che'i yang srid o rgyan rang byung rdo rje sogs da lta zhabs pad brtan bzhin bzhugs pa 'di lagasaso/ /de la spyir gsang sngagasasnga 'gyur zhes pa ni/ mdo phyogs la gsar rnying gi dbye ba med cing / sngagasala'ang rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi sgo nas dbye ba ma yin te/ gtso bo rdo rje theg pa bla med kyi phyogs la paṇ+ḍi ta smṛ ti byon pa yan la bsgyur pa'i nang rgyud sde gsum yan lag dang bcas pa snga 'gyur ram/ rnying ma zhesagragasashing /chosakyi bka' srol yang ring brgyud bka' ma/ nye brgyud gter ma/ zab mo dag snang ma ste gsum du yod pa las/ bka 'a ma ni/ gtso bor chosakyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku ring la/ paṇ+ḍita pad+ma 'byung gnasadang / bi ma mi tra dang /lo tsā ba be+e ro tsā na/ gnyags dz+nyā na ku mā ra/ gnubs chen sangasargyasame shes26

gye chen 'od snang la/ sa skya'i chos 'byung sa bsdus/ ()rgyud du yon dge mi 'gyur rdo rje'i dbon rigs su 'khrungs/ rab 'byams gnyis pa sogs brten nas mkhas grub chen po gyur/ zhe chen gyi gdan sar bzhugs nas 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad bzang gong 'phel du gnang / rab 'byams gsum pa rig 'dzin dpal 'byor rgya mtsho ni/ rgya rong sgrub sde dang nye ba'i phyogs su 'khrungs/ smin gling khri chen gyi sku mched/ rgyal tshab rin po che/kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa sogs bsten nas mang du gsan pa'i pha rol tu son/ shing stag lor sgrub sde pad+ma 'od gling gsar du btab pa sogs mdzad pa med du byung yang sku tshe mthar ma 'byol bar gshegs/ de nas grub dbang pad+ma rgyal mtshan gyi dbon sangs rgyas rab brtan gyi yang srid gnas lnga rig pa'i ma hā paṇ+ḍita 'gyur med mthu stobs rnam rgyal dang / rab mas bzhi pa gar dbang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rgyal tshab rin po che'i yang srid o rgyan rang byung rdo rje sogs da lta zhabs pad brtan bzhin bzhugs pa 'di lags so/ /de la spyir gsang sngags snga 'gyur zhes pa ni/ mdo phyogs la gsar rnying gi dbye ba med cing / sngags la'ang rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi sgo nas dbye ba ma yin te/ gtso bo rdo rje theg pa bla med kyi phyogs la paṇ+ḍi ta 'e ti byon pa yan la bsgyur pa'i nang rgyud sde gsum yan lag dang bcas pa snga 'gyur ram/ rnying ma zhes grags shing /chos kyi bka' srol yang ring brgyud bka' ma/ nye brgyud gter ma/ zab mo dag snang ma ste gsum du yod pa las/ bka 'a ma ni/ gtso bor chos kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku ring la/ paṇ+ḍita pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / bi ma mi tra dang /lo tsā ba be+e ro tsā na/ gnyags dz+nyā na ku mā ra/ gzhubs chen sangs rgyas me shes26

gangs can bod skul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gdan rab mdor bsdus/sogs kyis bsgyur pa'i bskyed pa ma hā yo ga rgyud sde sgyu 'phrul zhi khro dang /sgrub sde bka' brgyad/'jam dpal sku/pad+ma gsung/yang dag thugs/bdud rtsi yon to/phur po phrin las/ma mo rbod gto me /'jig rten mchod bstod/dmod pa drag sngags rnams so//lung a nu yo ga 'dus pa mdo/man ngag rdzogs pa chen po sems sde bco brgyad/klong dgu man ngag sde rgyud bcu bdun sogs/dbang rgyud bshad/bskyed rim/rdzogs rim ste snga 'gyur bka' babs kyi chu bo bzhi dang ldan pa rnams yin la/deng sang yang /1'dus pa mdo/2sgyu 'phrul zhi khro/3mnyam sbyor/4dong sprugs/5gshin rje gshed ru mtshon dmar nag6yang dag sa lugs dang /sgo lugayo tshe blo/7phur pa rong lugs//rog lugs/9'khon lugs/sa phur/10lung lugs tshe sgrub/11bka' brgyad rdzong 'phrang /gu ru drag dmar 'o bran lugs/rgyud mgon legs ldan rnams kyi dbang lung sgrub mchod/deng 4 bas r+sā sa su gong gi rtags can bas gcig dang /smin gling rdor sems/cha gsum bcas dkyil 'khor bas gsum gyi sgrub mar yod/sgyu 'phrul gsang ba snying po'i rgyud bshad/grol lam gyi khrid/semasasde a don bco brgyad kyi dbang /klong sde rdo rje zam pa'i dbang lung khrid gsum/man ngag sde rgyud bcu bdun gyi dbang sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang /rgyab rten gyi lung rnying ma rgyud 'bum pod chen nyer lngas mtsho ni rgya cher bzhugs so//nye brgyud gter ma ni/sa gter dang /dgongs gter gnyis las/dang po sa gter la/gter r+ṣa brgya rtsa dang /gter phran stong rtsa sogs byon cing /de yang gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i lam tshang la ma nor bar ston pa la gter chen/gzhan yang las tshogos phran bu re tsam thon pa la gter phran zhes2

gangasacan bod skuladu byon pa'igasang sngagasagasar rnying gdan rab mdor bsdus/sogasakyisabasgyur pa'i bskyed pa ma hā yo ga rgyud sde sgyu 'phrul zhi khro dang /sgrub sde bka' brgyad/wom dpalasku/pad+ma gsung/yang dgatsos/bdud rtsiyon to/phur paphrin las/ma mo rbodagatong /'jig rten ma bstod/dmod pa drag sngagasarnamasaso//lung a nu yo ga 'dusapa mdo/man ngag dzo+ogasapa chen po semasasde bco brgyad/klong dgu man ngag sde rgyud bcu bdun sogs/dbang rgyud bshad/bskyed rim/rdzogs rim ste snga 'gyur bka' babs kyi chu bo bzhi dang ldan pa rnamasayin la/deng sang yang /1'dusapa mdo/2sgyu 'phrul zhi khro/3mnyam sbyor/4dong sprugs/5gshin rje+o gshed ru mtshono dmar nag6yong dag salugasadang /soluga'akhol/7phur pa rang lugs//rag lugs/9'khan lugs/saphur/10lung lugs tshe sgrub/11bka' brgyad rdzong 'phrang /gu ru drag dmar 'o bran lugs/rgyud mgon legasaldan rnamasakyi dbang lung sgrub mchod/deng 4 sosar+sā rnasasugong gi rtagasacan bstogacig dang /smin gling rdor sems/cha gsumabacasadakyila'akhor bstogasumagyi sgrub maro+oyod/sgyu 'phrul gsang ba snying po'i rgyud bshad/grol lam gyi khrid/semasasde a don bco brgyad kyi dbang /klong sde rdo rje zam pa'i dbang lang khrid gsum/༄man ngag sde rgyud bcu bdun gyi dbang sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang /rgyab rten gyi lung rnying ma rgyud 'bum pod chen nyer lngasamatshon rgya cher bzhugs so//nye brgyud gter ma ni/sagater dang /dgongasagater gnyisalas/dang po sagater la/gter chen brgya rtsa dang /gter phran stong rtsa sogasabyon cing /de yang gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i lam tshang la ma nor bar ston pa la gter chen/gzhan yang lasatshogasaphra/ bu re tsam thon pa la gter phran zhes

ba 'od snang las/ saskya'i chos 'byung gcesabasdus/ ()gter bdag gling pa bzhed de/ snga ma ni mnga' bdag nyang yab sras lta bu dang /phyi ma ni skal ldan byis pa gter ston lta bu la 'jog snga phyir gter ston shin tu mang bar byon pa las/ deng sang grags che zhing gtso bor gyur pa/ 7 mnga' bdag nyang gi bka' brgyad bder 'dus pod/ 13 gu ru chos dbang bka' brgyad gsang pod/ 4 byang gter rgod ldem can gyi bka' brgyad rang shar pod/4 bka' brgyad rnam gsum/ sangs rgyas gling pa'i dgongs 'dus pod/13 chos dbang phur pa spu gri dang / rat+na gling pa'i phur pa yang gsang bla med sogs phur pa'i skor te bka' dgongs phur gsum dang / byin rlabs can bla ma zhi drag gi skor la/ chos dbang gsang 'dus dang / byang gter thugs sgrub/pad gling bla ma nor bu rgya mtsho rat+na gling lnga'i )thugs sgrub dang / nyang gi drag dmar dang / rata gling drag dmar skor sogs/ zab lam thams cad kyi mthar thug rdzogs pa chen po'i skor la/ ldang ma lhun rgyal gyi bi ma snying tig de'i snying po klong chen pa'i bla ma yang tig las 'brel rtsal gyi mkha' 'gro snying tigade'i don rgyas par phye ba klong pa'i mkha' 'gro yang tig ste snying thig ya bzhi/snying thig gnyis ga'i don gyi bcud phyung ba zab mo yang tig ste/ 'di rnamasalas bi ma snying tig dang / mkha' 'gro yang tig gi dbang lung khrid gsum/ gzhan rnams kyi dbang lung / byang gter dgongs pa zang thal dang / pad gling kun bzang dgongs 'dus/ rata gling klong gsal sogs rdzogs chen skor/ bod gangs can gyi lha skal thugs rje chen po'i sgrub skor la/ grub thob dngos grub dang nyang gi gter byon rgyal po bka' 'bum ma ṇi bka' 'bum/ gyi dbang lung khrid 28

ba 'od snang las/ saskya'i chos 'byung gcesabasdus/ ()gter bdag gling pa bzhed de/ snga ma ni mnga' bdag nyang yab sras lta bu dang /phyi ma ni skal ldan byis pa gter ston lta bu la 'jog snga phyir gter ston shin tu mang bar byon pa las/ deng sang grags che zhing gtso bor gyur pa/ 7 mnga' bdag nyang gi bka' brgyad bder 'dus pod/ 13 gu ru chos dbang bka' brgyad gsang pod/ 4 byang gter rgod ldem can gyi bka' brgyad rang shar pod/4 bka' brgyad rnam gsum/ sangs rgyas gling pa'i dgongs 'dus pod/13 chos dbang phur pa spu gri dang / rat+na gling pa'i phur pa yang gsang bla med sogs phur pa'i skor te bka' dgongs phur gsum dang / byin rlabs can bla ma zhi drag gi skor la/ chos dbang gsang 'dus dang / byang gter thugs sgrub/pad gling bla ma nor bu rgya mtsho rat+na gling lnga'i )thugs sgrub dang / nyang gi drag dmar dang / rata gling drag dmar skor sogs/ zab lam thams cad kyi mthar thug rdzogs pa chen po'i skor la/ ldang ma lhun rgyal gyi bi ma snying tig de'i snying po klong chen pa'i bla ma yang tig las 'brel rtsal gyi mkha' 'gro snying tigade'i don rgyas par phye ba klong pa'i mkha' 'gro yang tig ste snying thig ya bzhi/snying thig gnyis ga'i don gyi bcud phyung ba zab mo yang tig ste/ 'di rnamasalas bi ma snying tig dang / mkha' 'gro yang tig gi dbang lung khrid gsum/ gzhan rnams kyi dbang lung / byang gter dgongs pa zang thal dang / pad gling kun bzang dgongs 'dus/ rata gling klong gsal sogs rdzogs chen skor/ bod gangs can gyi lha skal thugs rje chen po'i sgrub skor la/ grub thob dngos grub dang nyang gi gter byon rgyal po bka' 'bum ma ṇi bka' 'bum/ gyi dbang lung khrid 28

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/gsum/ chos dbang yang snying 'dusapa/ smin gling bde gshegs kun 'dus sogs thugs rje chen po'i skor te bla rdzogs thugs gsum du grags pa dang /gzhan yang zhang khrom gyi gshin rje tshe bdag lcagasa'adra/ lcagasasdig byang lugasagatso che/ yang zlog 'bri lugasagatso che/ sogs gshed skor/ rin chen gling pa'i nā ga rak+ṣa/ gter ston gsum tshogs kyi rta mgrin yang gsang khrosapa dang / skyer sgang lugs kyi gsang sgrub/ nyang gter rta nag sogasarta mgrin skor/ nyang gter khros nag dang / nyang chos dbang gi lo k+ṇi sogs kyis mtshon phrin las kyi lha dang / nyang gter phyag bzhi/ chosadabang ma ning / sdi ri chos gragasakyi tshogasabadag lasa'abrel rtsal gyi gza' bdud/ rata gling dam can/ snying tig gi e ka dzā ṭī sogs chos srung gi skor bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bzhugs shing/gter ston gyi gtso bo yang / o rgyan rin po ches/ gter ston rgyal po lnga la bran brgyasabaskor/ /zhes gsungasapa ltar/ gter kha gong ma nyang / 'og ma chosadabang / pad gling / rdor gling / mdo sngags gling pa lnga dang / khyad par/ nyang chos dbang rgod ldem ste mchog gi sprul sku rnam gsum/ las 'brel rtsal zhang khrom lho gter pad gling / rat+na gling pa/ kong gter sangs rgyasagling pa rnams ni tshad ldan yongs grags dang / phyisasu/ gter bdag gling pa/ 'ja' tshon snying po / bdud 'dul rdo rje/ klong gsal snying po/ nyi ma grags pa/ stag sham/ chos gling / mi 'gyur rdo rje/ rol pa'i rdo rje sogs phrin las rgya cher byung ngo / /dgongs gter ni/ kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i mdzod bdun/ snying tig skor sogs zab cing rgya che ba/ gnam chos mi 'gyur rdo rje'i dgongs gter dang 29

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/gsum/ chos dbang yang snying 'dus pa/ smin gling bde gshegs kun 'dus sogs thugs rje chen po'i skor te bla rdzogs thugs gsum du grags pa dang /gzhan yang zhang khrom gyi gshin rje tshe bdag lcags 'dra/ lcags sdig byang lugasagatso che/ yang zlog 'bri lugs kho che/ sogs gshed skor/ rin chen gling pa'i nā ga rak+ṣa/ gter ston gsum tshogs kyi rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa dang / skyer sgang lugs kyi gsang sgrub/ nyang gter rta nag sogs rta mgrin skor/ nyang gter khros nag dang / nyang chos dbang gi lo k+ṇi sogs kyis mtshon phrin las kyi lha dang / nyang gter phyag bzhi/ chos dbang ma ning / sdi ri chos grags kyi tshogasabadag las 'brel rtsal gyi gza' bdud/ ra ta gling dam can/ snying tig gi e ka dzā ṭī sogs chos srung gi skor bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bzhugs shing/gter ston gyi gtso bo yang / o rgyan rin po ches/ gter ston rgyal po lnga la bran brgyas bskor/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gter kha gong ma nyang / 'og ma chosadabang / pad gling / rdor gling / mdo sngags gling pa lnga dang / khyad par/ nyang chos dbang rgod ldem ste mchog gi sprul sku rnam gsum/ las 'brel rtsal shad khrom sto gter pad gling / rat+na gling pa/ kong gter sangs rgyas gling pa rnams ni tshad ldan yongs grags dang / phyis su/ gter bdag gling pa/ 'ja' tshon snying po / bdud 'dul rdo rje/ klong gsal snying po/ nyi ma grags pa/ stag sham/ chos gling / mi 'gyur rdo rje/ rol pa'i rdo rje sogs phrin las rgya cher byung ngo / /dgongs gter ni/ kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i mdzod bdun/ snying tig skor sogs zab cing rgya che ba/ gnam chos mi 'gyur rdo rje'i dgongs gter dang 29

yo chen 'od snang lag sa skya'i chosang so zhes bsdus/ ()gnam chos/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa'i klong chen snying thig sogs kyi rgyun mang du bzhugs/ zab mo dag snang ma la/ g.yu thog yon tan mgon po'i snying tig lha btsun nam mkha' 'jigs med pa'i rig 'dzin srog sgrub/ rgyal dbang lnga pa rin po che'i dag snang rgya can nyer lnga sogs mang tsam mchisaso / / de bzhin rjes 'brel bla ma'i gsung 'bum skor klong chen pa'i mdzod bdun sogs dang / rdor brag pad gling bka' 'bum/ gter bdag gling pa'i bka' 'bum/ lo chen rin po che'i bka' 'bum/ 'jigs med gling pa'i bka' 'bum pod dgu sogs kyi rgyun yang bzhugs so/ /de yang rnying ma bka' ma mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi gzhung bsrangs nas/ gter ma'i man ngag zab mos brgyan te nyams su len dgos pa yin cing / rnying ma bka' ma'i phyogs la bka' drin che ba/ gnyags gnubs zer gsum/ ngam gtsang byams gsum/ rong zom paṇ+ḍi ta sogs dang bka' gter gnyis ka la g.yung ston rdo rje dpal/ mnga' risapaṇa chen/ 'bri gung rin chen phun tshogs/ kun mkhyen shes rab 'od zer/ byang pa rig 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje/ dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ sog bzlog pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ gangs rwa lo chen gzhan phan rdo rje/ gsung sprul tshul khrims rdo rje/ rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub sogs dang / khyad par rgyal dbang lnga pa rin po che/ rdor brag pad+ma phrin las/ smin gling gter chen sku mched/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa slob brgyud dang bcas pa'i bka' drin gyis deng sang yang rgyun ma nub par yod pa ste/ slar yang snga 'gyur rnying ma'i bstan 'dzin rnams kyi sngar smos pa'i bka' gter gyi chos tshul tshad ldan de rnams la bshad 30

'tshe' 'odasnangalag saskya'i chosayangagacesabasdus/ ()gnam chos/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa'i klong chen snying thig sogasakyi rgyun mang du bzhugs/ zab mo dag snang ma la/ g.yu thog yon tan mgon po'i snying tig lha btsun nam mkha' 'jigasamed pa'i rig 'dzin srog sgrub/ rgyal dbang lnga pa rin po che'i dag snang rgya can nyer lnga sogs mang tsam mchisaso / / de bzhin rjesa'abrel bla ma'i gsung 'bum skor klong chen pa'i mdzod bdun sogs dang / rdor brag pad gling bka' 'bum/ gter bdag gling pa'i bka' 'bum/ lo chen rin po che'i bka' 'bum/ 'jigs med gling pa'i bka' 'bum pod dgu sogs kyi rgyun yang bzhugs so/ /de yang rnying ma bka' ma mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi gzhung bsrangs nas/ gter ma'i man ngag zab mosabargyan te nyams su len dgos pa yin cing / rnying ma bka' ma'i phyogs la bka' drin che ba/ gnyags gnubs zer gsum/ ngam gtsang byams gsum/ rong zom paṇ+ḍi ta sogs dang bka' gter gnyis ka la g.yung ston rdo rje dpal/ mnga' risapaṇa chen/ 'bri gung rin chen phun tshogs/ kun mkhyen shesarab 'od zer/ byang pa rig 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje/ dpal bkra shisastobasargyal/ sog bzlog pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ gangs rwa lo chen gzhan phan rdo rje/ gsung sprul tshul khrims rdo rje/ rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub sogs dang / khyad par rgyal dbang lnga pa rin po che/ rdor brag pad+ma phrin las/ smin gling gter chen sku mched/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa slob brgyud dang bcas pa'i bka' drin gyis deng sang yang rgyun ma nub par yod pa ste/ slar yang snga 'gyur rnying ma'i bstan 'dzin rnams kyi sngar smos pa'i bka' gter gyi chos tshul tshad ldan de rnams la bshad 30

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/sgrub gtso bor 'dzin pas rgyun mi nyams zhing 'phel ba dang rang rang gi lugs srol rnams kyis gzhan don sogs phrin las skyong bar rigs so/ /snga 'gyur rnying ma'i lo rgyus rgyas par rtogs par 'dod na/ sgrol chen bsam 'grub rdo rjesamadzad pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyi lo rgyus/ pad+ma phrin las dang smin gling lo chen gyi mdo dbang gi chos 'byung/ bi ma snying tig gi lo rgyus chen mo dang / babs lugs bdun pa/ smin gling gter chen gyi snying tig bla brgyud kha stong / phur 'grel 'bum nag smin gling mkhan chen o rgyan bstan 'dzin rdo rje'i chos 'byung nyung ngu / kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa'i rgyud 'bum rin po che'i rtogs brjod 'dzam gling tha grur khyab pa'i rgyan/ āḥthog paṇ+ḍita'i rgyud 'bum rin po che'i dkar chag lha'i rnga bo che lta bu'i gtam/ stag sgang mkhas mchog ngag dbang blo gros kyis mdzad pa'i snga 'gyur rnying ma bka' gter dag snang gdan rabs sogs kyi chos 'byung chen mo ngo mtshar gtam gyi rol mtsho pod 'di nang ga ma'i skor ram gdan rabs skor shin tu rgyas sogs las shes par bya zhing / rnying ma'i phyogs la 'gos khug pa lha btsas/ 'bri gung dpal 'dzin dang / rkarma pa mi bskyod rdo rje sogs kyis dgag pa du ma mdzad pa'i lan yang / kun mkhyen klong chen pa/mnyam med bsam gtan gling pa/ mnga' ris paṇ+ḍita rnams kyi rtsod spong / rkarma pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i rang lan/ dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba'i rtsod spong / bla ma sog bzlog pa'i lan tshigs bcad lhun gnyis/ smin gling rab 'byams pa o rgyan chos grags kyi lung rigs rdo rje'i gad rgyangs/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa'i chos 'byung dang / gtam tshogs las 'byung ba/ gaḥthog paṇ+ḍita sa 31

gangasacan bod yuladu byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/sgrub gtso bor 'dzin pas rgyun mi nyamagazhing 'phel ba dang rang rang gi lugs srol rnams kyis gzhan don sogs phrin lasaskyong bar rigs so/ /snga 'gyur rnying ma'i lo rgyusargyas par rtogs par 'dod na/ sgrol bsam 'grub rdo rjesamadzad pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyi lo rgyus/ pad+ma phrin lasadang smin gling lo chen gyi mdo dbang gi chos 'byung/ bi ma snying tig gi lo rgyusachen mo dang / babs lugs bdun pa/ smin gling gter chen gyi snying tig bla brgyud kha skong / phur 'grel 'bum nag smin gling mkhan chen o rgyan bstan 'dzin rdo rje'i chos 'byung nyung ngu / kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa'i rgyud 'bum rin po che'i rtogs brjod 'dzam gling tha grur khyab pa'i rgyan/ āḥthog paṇ+ḍita'i rgyud 'bum rin po che'i dkar chag lha'i rnga bo che lta bu'i gtam/ stag sgang mkhas mchog ngag dbang blo gros kyis mdzad pa'i snga 'gyur rnying ma bka' gter dag snang gdan rabs sogs kyi chos 'byung chen mo ngo mtshar gtam gyi rol mtsho pod 'di nangagakho ma'i skor ram gdan rabs skor shin tu rgyasasogs las shesapar bya zhing / rnying ma'i phyogs la 'gos khug pa lha btsas/ 'bri gung dpal 'dzin dang / podze pa mi bskyod rdo rje sogs kyis dgag pa du ma mdzad pa'i lan yang / kun mkhyen klong chen pa/mnyam med bsam gtan gling pa/ mnga' risapaṇ+ḍita rnams kyi rtsod spong / rkarma pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i rang lan/ dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba'i rtsod spong / bla ma sog bzlog pa'i lan tshigs bcad lhun gnyis/ smin gling rab 'byams pa o rgyan chos grags kyi lung rigs rdo rje'i gad rgyangs/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa'i chos 'byung dang / gtam tshogs las 'byung ba/ gaḥthog paṇ+ḍitas 31

ba 'od pal / saskya'i mosa'abyung gces bsdus/ ()mdzad pa'i rtsod spong le tshan/ thu'u kun dharma badz+ra gyi gsung sogs las rtogs par bya'o/ /rdzogs pa chen po zhes pa'i sgra don ni/ ma hā sid+dha ma hā sam dhi zhes zur chag pa ste/ ting 'dzin chen po zhes pa la 'jug par 'dod pa'ang yod/zhes pa'i sgra las drangs na yang dag pa'i bsam gtan chen po'am/ mnyam pa'i blo chen po sogs 'gyur te/ theg brgyad blo yi grub mthas ma gos pa'i phyir yang dag pa'i bsam gtan dang / de las gong na gzhan med pas chen po zhes pa/gzhi mthun pa'i bsdu ba'am yang na rdzogs rim chen po zhes bshad kyang rung ste/'jam dpal zhal lung las/ rdzogs pa chen po ye shes spyi yi gzugs/ /zhes pa'i 'grel par/ rdzogs pa chen po ni rim pa gnyis pa'i rim pa gnyis pa'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /lko gsang sngags gsar ma ni/ gtso bor lo chen rin chen bzang pos 'gyur mgo tshugs nas bzung / lo che chung 'brog 'gos mar gsum la sogs pas bsgyur 'chad sgom sgrub kyis gtan la phabs pa ste/ de yang bstan pa phyi dar gyi thog ma nas ring zhig song ba na/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha bod du phebs/ slob ma 'brom rngog khu gsum la sogs pa rgya cher 'phel ba las jo bo bka' gdams pa zhes phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pa de byung / sngar ha cang dar rgyas che bas dgon gnas dang gdan rabs sogs smos kyis mi langs kyang gtso che ba 'ga' zhig brjod na/ byang rwa sgrengs rgyal ba'i dben gnas ni/spyan ras gzigs dngos 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis jo bos lung bstan pa ltar dgung lo nga gcig pa me lug lor btab/ la lar 'brom ston dgung lo 32

ba 'od palas/ saskya'i chosa'abyung gces bsdus/ ()mdzad pa'i rtsod spong le tshan/ thu'u kun dharma badz+ra gyi gsung sogs las rtogs par bya'o/ /rdzogs pa chen po zhes pa'i sgra don ni/ ma hā sid+dha ma hā sam dhi zhes zur chag pa ste/ ting 'dzin chen po zhes pa la 'jug par 'dod pa'ang yod/zhes pa'i sgra las drangs na yang dag pa'i bsam gtan chen po'am/ mnyam pa'i blo chen po sogs 'gyur te/ theg brgyad blo yi grub mthas ma gos pa'i phyir yang dag pa'i bsam gtan dang / de las gong na gzhan med pas chen po zhes pa/gzhi mthun pa'i bsdu ba'am yang na rdzogs rim chen po zhes bshad kyang rung ste/'jam dpal zhal lung las/ rdzogs pa chen po ye shes spyi yi gzugs/ /zhes pa'i 'grel par/ rdzogs pa chen po ni rim pa gnyis pa'i rim pa gnyis pa'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /lko gsang sngags gsar ma ni/ gtso bor lo chen rin chen bzang pos 'gyur mgo tshugs nas bzung / lo che chung 'brog 'gos mar gsum la sogs pas bsgyur 'chad sgom sgrub kyis gtan la phabs pa ste/ de yang bstan pa phyi dar gyi thog ma nas ring zhig song ba na/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha bod du phebs/ slob ma 'brom rngog khu gsum la sogs pa rgya cher 'phel ba las jo bo bka' gdams pa zhes phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pa de byung / sngar ha cang dar rgyas che bas dgon gnas dang gdan rabs sogs smos kyis mi langs kyang gtso che ba 'ga' zhig brjod na/ byang rwa sgrengs rgyal ba'i dben gnas ni/spyan ras gzigs dngos 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis jo bos lung bstan pa ltar dgung lo nga gcig pa me lug lor btab/ la lar 'brom ston dgung lo 32

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'igasang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/nga gnyisapa lalor btab par bzhad/ bka' gdams bstan pa'i chu mgo lta bur gyur/deng sang chos brgyud dmigs bsal med kyang dgon gnas dga' ldan pa'i khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan gyi skye sprul rim byon gyis bzung nas dar rgyas che/dpal gsang phu ne'u thog lha sanam thur du yong ba'i snye thang gi thad kyi gtsang po'i pha rir yod/ chos grwa ni/ 'jam dbyangs rnam 'phrul rngog legasapa'i shesarab kyisalcags phag lor btab/ phyis rngog lo bstan pa'i nyi ma blo ldan shes rab kyisabaskyangs nas mtshan nyid grwa tshang thams cad kyi 'byung khungs lta bur gyur kyang /deng sang ni sku gsung thugs rten tsam las dge 'dun gyi sde gang yang med/ yar klung sol nag thang po che ni/dgon thang 'bum pa dang nye bar yod/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi thog mar klu mes chen po'i dus su dge ba'i bshes gnyen gru mer sogs kyis btab/ phyis phyag rdor rnam 'phrul khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung gi gdan samadzad/ bar skabs dar rgyas che yang / deng sang ni dge 'dun gyi sde chung ngu zhig las med/ gtsang snar thang chos grwa ni/ gtum ston blo gros grags kyis rab byung dang po'i chu bya lor btab/ deng sang bkra shis lhun po nas zhal 'dzin gnang /dbus kyi dpal rtse thang gi chos grwa ni/bkra shisalhun po dang nye bar yod/ tā'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis btab/ bar skabs dar rgyas che bar byung ba sogs sngar bka' gdams pa'i gdan sa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig byon mod/ deng sang ni chos brgyud kyang bka' brgyud pa dang / dge lugs pa sogs dang 'dres nas gdan sa las zur du med cing / dgon gnas kyang phal cher ming tsam las med pas zhib par ma smos la/ rgyas par bka' gdams glegs bam rin po 33

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/nga gnyis pa la lor btab par bzhad/ bka' gdams bstan pa'i chu mgo lta bur gyur/deng sang chos brgyud dmigs bsal med kyang dgon gnas dga' ldan pa'i khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan gyi skye sprul rim byon gyis bzung nas dar rgyas che/dpal gsang phu ne'u thog lha san ma thur du yong ba'i snye thang gi thad kyi gtsang po'i pha rir yod/ chos grwa ni/ 'jam dbyangs rnam 'phrul rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyisalcags phag lor btab/ phyis khrog lo bstan pa'i nyi ma blo ldan shes rab kyisabaskyangs nas mtshan nyid grwa tshang thams cad kyi 'byung khungs lta bur gyur kyang /deng sang ni sku gsung thugs rten tsam las dge 'dun gyi sde gang yang med/ yar klung sol nag thang po che ni/dgon thang 'thum pa dang nye bar yod/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi thog mar klu mes chen po'i dus su dge ba'i bshes gnyen gru mer sogs kyis btab/ phyis phyag rdor rnam 'phrul khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung gi gdan samadzad/ bar skabs dar rgyas che yang / deng sang ni dge 'dun gyi sde chung ngu zhig las med/ gtsang snar thang chos grwa ni/ gtum ston blo gros grags kyis rab byung dang po'i chu bya lor btab/ deng sang bkra shis lhun po nas zhal 'dzin gnang /dbus kyi dpal rtse thang gi chos grwa ni/bkra shis lhun po dang nye bar yod/ tā'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis btab/ bar skabs dar rgyas che bar byung ba sogs sngar bka' gdams pa'i gdan sa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig byon mod/ deng sang ni chos brgyud kyang bka' brgyud pa dang / dge lugs pa sogs dang 'dres nas gdan sa las zur du med cing / dgon gnas kyang phal cher ming tsam las med pas zhib par ma smos la/ rgyas par bka' gdams glegs bam rin po 33

'tshe' 'od snang las/ saskya'i choga'agrang gtsesabasdus/ ()che'i lo rgyus dang / rtse gdong las chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyisamadzad pa'i chos 'byung mo dang / 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i bka' gdams chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed sogs las rtogs par bya'o/ /bka' gdams ces pa'i sgra don ni rgyal ba'i bka' thams cad gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i gdams ngag tu go bas chos kyi ming gang zag la chagasapa yin no/ /bka' gdams pa'i chosaskor la/ sngar gzhung dang / gdamasangag dang / man ngag gsum gyi bka' srol bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / deng sang skyesatshom dad pa'i sa/ bslab spyod spyod pa'i sa/ sa rgyan ting nge 'dzin gyi sa ste bka' gdamasagazhung drug tu grags pa dang/ jo bo'i thugs dam chos chung brgya rtsa sogs kyi lung / gdams ngag blo sbyong don bdun ma thun brgyad ma tshig rkang brgyad ma sogs kyi khrid/ blo sbyong skor gyi yig cha gsar rnying mang po'i lung / man ngag gsang chos glegs bam rin po che'i thig le bcu drug gi dbang khrid lung gsum/thams cad kyi gzhir gyur pa byang chub lam rim chen mo'i khrid/ gzhan yang dpe chos rin spungs/ man ngag rin spungs/ bka' gdamasathor bu/ dpe bum sngon po / gro lung pa'i bstan rim rtsa ba/ bka' gdams chos 'byung chen mo'i lung sogs dang / jo bo nasabargyud pa'i thogs med lugs kyi semasabaskyed/ gsang 'dus spyan ras gzigs dang / rnal 'byor rgyud sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis/ mi 'khrugs pa sogs kyi dbang / bka' gdams lha bzhi'i rjesaganang dang khrid/snar thang pa'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa sogs kyi rjes gnang / gnas brtan bcu drugaklu dbang rgyal po/ spyan ras gzigs/ sgrol ma nyer gcig sme brtsegs/ dze+e 34

ba chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ ()che'i lo rgyus dang / rtse gdong las chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i chos 'byung chen mo dang / 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i bka' gdams chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed sogs las rtogs par bya'o/ /bka' gdams ces pa'i sgra don ni rgyal ba'i bka' thams cad gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i gdams ngag tu go bas chos kyi ming gang zag la chags pa yin no/ /bka' gdams pa'i chos skor la/ sngar gzhung dang / ga dmasang ga dang / man ngag gsum gyi bka' srol bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / deng sang skyes tshomi dad pa'i sa/ bslab spyod spyod pa'i sa/ sa rgyan ting nge 'dzin gyi sa ste bka' gdamasagazhung drug tu grags pa dang/ jo bo'i thugs dam chos chung brgya rtsa sogs kyi lung / gdams ngag blo sbyong don bdun ma thun brgyad ma tshig rkang brgyad ma sogs kyi khrid/ blo sbyong skor gyi yig cha gsar rnying mang po'i lung / man ngag gsang chos glegs bam rin po che'i thig le bcu drug gi dbang khrid lung gsum/thams cad kyi gzhir gyur pa byang chub lam rim chen mo'i khrid/ g.yin yang dpe chos rin spungs/ man ngag rin spungs/ bka' gdams thor bu/ dpe bum sngon po / gro lung pa'i bstan rim rtsa ba/ bka' gdams chos 'byung chen mo'i lung sogs dang / jo bo nas brgyud pa'i thogs med lugs kyi sems bskyed/ gsang 'dus spyan ras gzigs dang / rnal 'byor rgyud sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis/ mi 'khrugs pa sogs kyi dbang / bka' gdams lha bzhi'i rjes gnang dang khrid/snar thang pa'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa sogs kyi rjes gnang / gnas brtan bcu drugaklu dbang rgyal po/ spyan ras gzigs/ sgrol ma nyer gcig sme brtsegs/ rdza 34

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'igasang sngagasagasar rnyingagi gdan rab mdor bsdus/dkar sogasarjesaganang dang man ngag thor bu mang po/ mgon po gri gug gi rigasa'aga' zhig gi rjesaganang sogs chos rje ri bo dge ldan pa gtso bor gyur pa rnamasal bzhugasashing / bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu ni/ khu rngog 'brom gsum/sku mched rnam gsum/ glang shar nyi zla zung gcig sogs bsam gyisami khyab pa zhig byon cing / de thamasacad kyi rnam thar mdor bsdusan/ 'brom ston rin po ches/ ngo mtshar bka' ni sde snod gsum yin te/ /gdamasapa skyesabu gsum gyi rgyan gyisamadzes/ /bka' gdamasarin chen gser gyi phreng ba la/ /'gro ba gang gisabagrangasakyang don yod 'gyur/ /cesagasungasapa ltar/ bka' sde snod gsum gyis gzhung bsrang / gdams pa skyesabu gsum gyis nyamasasu blangs pas 'dul ba kā ri kā nas/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa man chad gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i cha rkyen tu rtogs nasabastan pa thams cad 'gal med du gzigs/ de thamasacad kyi don rang gi sems rgyud 'dul bar sbyar nasagasung rab ma lus pa gdams par shar/ byang chub kyi semasadang yang dag pa'i lta ba rtsal du bton pas rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bde blag tu rnyed/ zhen log dang ngesa'abyung snying la shar ba tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rnam par dag cing nyesaspyod chen po rang 'gags su song / nang du ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo dang / lhag pa'i lhasarjes su bzung ba sogs yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa brnyes kyang bum nang gi mar me ltar sba ba la brtson pas 'phags pa'i sar mngon sum du gshegs/ mdor na mkhas la btsun zhing grub pa'i nyams myong gis brgyan pa ste/ bka' gdamasakyi rnam thar phyi gtsang nang gtsang pad+ma'i sbubs lta bu zhes kun la rlung ltar du 35

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rab mdor bsdus/dkar sogs rjes gnang dang man ngag thor bu mang po/ mgon po gri gug gi rigs 'ga' zhig gi rjes gnang sogs chos rje ri bo dge ldan pa gtso bor gyur pa rnams la bzhugs shing / bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu ni/ khu rngog 'brom gsum/sku mched rnam gsum/ glang shar nyi zla zung gcig sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig byon cing / de thams cad kyi rnam thar mdor bsdus na/ 'brom ston rin po ches/ ngo mtshar bka' ni sde snod gsum yin te/ /gdams pa skyes bu gsum gyi rgyan gyis mdzes/ /bka' gdams rin chen gser gyi phreng ba la/ /'gro ba gang gis bgrangs kyang don yod 'gyur/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ bka' sde snod gsum gyis gzhud bsrang / gdams pa skyes kha bu gsum gyis nyams(su blangs pas 'dul ba kā ri kā nas/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa man chad gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i cha rkyen tu rtogs nas bstan pa thams cad 'gal med du gzigs/ de thams cad kyi don rang gi sems rgyud 'dul bar sbyar nas gsung rab ma lus pa gdams par shar/ byang chub kyi sems dang yang dag pa'i lta ba rtsal du brtan pas rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bde blag tu rnyed/ zhen log dang ngesa'abyung snying la shar ba tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rnam par dag cing nyes spyod chen po rang 'gags su song / nang du ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo dang / lhag pa'i lhas rjes su bzung ba sogs yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa brnyes kyang bum nang gi mar me ltar sba ba la brtson pas 'phags pa'i sar mngon sum du gshegs/ mdor na mkhas la btsun zhing grub pa'i nyams myong gis brgyan pa ste/ bka' gdamasakyi rnam thar phyi gtsang nang gtsang pad+ma'i sbubs lta bu zhes kun la rlung ltar du 35

ba tshe chen 'od snang la / sa skya' chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()grags/ lha bzhis sdo/sa/ thub pa spyan ras gzigs mi g.yo ba sgrol ma/sde 11da ga sdo/ma gyis ngag bslab pa gsum gyis sems brgyan pas lha chos bdun ldan gyi bstan pa'i bdag po zhes rgyal ba dgyes pa'i bshes gnyen ming don dang mtshungs par gyur pa yin no/ // de rjes dpal sa skya pa'i ring lugs rgyas par gyur te/ de yang rgya gar rdo rje gdan nas byang phyogs su dpag tshad brgya bgrod pa'i sa mtshams gangs can bod kyi rdo rje gdan gtsang la stod grom pa sa skya ni/ 'bon dkon mchog rgyal pos dgung lo bzhi bcu pa chu glang lor btab/ sras sa chen kun dga' snying po sogs deng sang bar gdung brgyud ma chad pas 'dzin skyong gnang zhing /bar skabs lha sa rdzong pa'i dus nyams chag che nges byung yang / sngags 'chang chen po kun dga' rin chen gyis nyams gso mdzad pa nas bzung gong 'phel du gyur pas/ phyis su sa skya pa'i bstan pa la 'di kho na bka' drin che ba'o/ /de yang rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du mang pos bkur ba'i gdung rabs dang / gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir 'khon sa skya pa'i gdung rabs kyi rtogs pa brjod pa ni bsod nams tshad med pa'i 'jug ngogs nyid do/ /zhes mkhas pa rnams kyis bsngags pa'i rjes su 'brangs te 'dir smu/tshon tsam zhig brjod na/ yul mtho zhing gtsang ba mnga' ris kyi stod dam/ byang gi shel tsha rgyal mo'i gangs 'gram du 'od gsal gnam lha mched gsum bsil ldongs bsod nams kyi mgron du babs pa las bar pa g.yu ring dang dmu bza' ldem bu'i sras ma sangs spun bdun byon pa'i gcen drug yab bcas lha yul du gshegs/ bdun pa ma sangs spyi rje 36

bgechen 'od snangal / saskya'i mosa'agrang gcesabasdus/ ()grags/ lha bzhis lus/ thub pa spyan rasagazigs mi g.yo ba sgrol ma/sde snod gsum gyis ngag bslab pa gsum gyis sems brgyan pas lha chos bdun ldan gyi bstan pa'i bdag po zhes rgyal ba dgyes pa'i bshes gnyen ming don dang mtshungs par gyur pa yin no/ // de rjes dpal sa skya pa'i ring lugs rgyasapar gyur te/ de yang rgya gar rdo rje gdan nas byang phyogs su dpag tshad brgya bgrod pa'i samatshamasagangs can bod kyi rdo rje gdan gtsang la stod grom pa saskya ni/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal pos dgung lo bzhi bcu pa chu glang lor btab/ sras sa chen kun dga' snying po sogs deng sang bar gdung brgyud ma chad pas 'dzin skyong gnang zhing /bar skabs lha sa rdzong pa'i dus nyams chag che nges byung yang / sngagasa'achang chen po kun dga' rin chen gyis nyams gso mdzad pa nas bzung gong 'phel du gyur pas/ phyis su sa skya pa'i bstan pa la 'di kho na bka' drin che ba'o/ /de yang rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du mang pos bkur ba'i gdung rabs dang / gangasacan gyi ljongs 'dir 'khon sa skya pa'i gdung rabs kyi rtogs pa brjod pa ni bsod nams tshad med pa'i 'jug ngogs nyid do/ /zhes mkhas pa rnams kyis bsngags pa'i rjes su 'brangs te 'dir smu/tshon tsam zhig brjod na/ yul mtho zhing gtsang ba mnga' ris kyi stod dam/ byang gi shel tsha rgyal mo'i gangs 'gram du 'od gsal gnam lha mched gsum bsil ljongs bsod nams kyi mgron du babs pa las bar pa g.yu ring dang dmu bza' ldem bu'i sras ma sangs spun bdun byon pa'i gcen drug yab bcas lha yul du gshegs/ bdun pa ma sangs spyi rje 36

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang stogs gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/dang / thog lcam 'ur mo'i sras dpa' bo stag de'i sras stag po 'od can te/'di rnams mi las 'das pa'i gzugs bzung ste bar snang du bzhugs/ de'i sras g.ya' spang skyes te 'di yan la 'od gsal lha'i rigs ces grags/ des srin po khrag med ma bsad cing / de'i chung ma g.ya' 'brug si li ma khab tu bzhes pas/ lha dang srin po 'khon pa'i bar der sras gcig 'khrungs pa 'khon bar skyes zhes btags shing 'khon gyi gdung du mtshan chags/ de sras 'khon dpal bo che/ de'i sras gcen slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi thugs sras mkhan chen bo dhi satwa las bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sad mi mi bdun gyi nang tshan nā ga rnye rak+ṣi ta ste klu dbang srung ba zhes grags pa dang / gcung rig sngags grub pa rdo rje rin chen mched gnyis/ rdo rje rin chen gyi sras bdun byon pa las gdung brgyud kyang mang du 'phel zhing / drug pa shes rab yon tan gyi sras gsum gyi nang tshan tshul khrims rgyal po/ de la sras gsum byon pa'i/ gtsug tor shes rab/ de la sras bdun gcung dang bcas pa byon pa las che ba dge mthong gi sras bal po/ de sras shākya blo gros/ de sras shes rab tshul khrims dang / 'gran zla med pa'i mkhas grub dkon mchog rgyal po gnyis las/ shes rab tshul khrims yan gsang sngags rnying ma'i rig pa 'dzin pa zam ma chad par byon zhing /yi dam yang phur gyi sgo nas dngos grub gnyis brnyes/ chos skyong dkar bdud lcam dral sogs bran du khol/ dkon mchog rgyal po'i sngon smon lam dang phrin las kyi sgo phyi 'gyur gsar ma la byed/ dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po btab pa nas bzung 'khon sa skya pa zhes grags te/ de ltar na lha rigs 'khon gdung sa37

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/dang / thog lcam 'ur mo'i sras dpa' bo stag de'i sras stag po 'od can te/'di rnams mi las 'dasapa'i gzugs bzung ste bar snang du bzhugs/ de'i sras g.ya' spang skyes te 'di yan la 'od gsal lha'i rigs ces grags/ des srin po khrag med ma bsad cing / de'i chung ma g.ya' 'brug si li ma khab tu bzhes pas/ lha dang srin po 'khon pa'i bar der sras gcig 'khrungs pa 'khon bar skyes zhes btags shing 'khon gyi gdung du mtshan chags/ de sras 'khon dpal bo che/ de'i sras gcen slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi thugs sras mkhan chen bo dhi satwa las bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sad mi mi bdun gyi nang tshan nā garnye rak+ṣi ta ste klu dbang srung ba zhes gragasapa dang / gcung rig sngags grub pa rdo rje rin chen mched gnyis/ rdo rje rin chen gyi sras bdun byon pa las gdung brgyud kyang mang du 'phel zhing / drug pa shes rab yon tan gyi sras gsum gyi nang tshan tshul khrims rgyal po/ de la sras gsum byon pa'i/ gtsug tor shes rab/ de la sras bdun gcung dang bcas pa byon pa las che ba dge mthong gi srasabal po/ de srasashākya blo gros/ de sras shes rab tshul khrimasadang / 'gran zla med pa'i mkhas grub dkon mchog rgyal po gnyis las/ shesarab tshul khrims yan gsang sngags rnying ma'i rig pa 'dzin pa zam ma chad par byon zhing /yi dam yang phur gyi sgo nas dngos grub gnyis brnyes/ chos skyong dkar bdud lcam dral sogs bran du khol/ dkon mchog rgyal po'i sngon smon lam dang phrin las kyi sgo phyi 'gyur gsar ma la byed/ dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po btab pa nas bzung 'khon sa skya pa zhes grags te/ de ltar na lha rigs 'khon gdung sa37

'tshezuga'odasnangalag saskya'i chosatshang sa bsdus/ ()skya zhes mtshan mchog gsum ldan gyi grags dkar 'dzam gling thamasacad du khyab/ de sras spyan ras gzigs dngosadapal brtse ba chen po kun dga' snying po ni / chung ngu nasadam pa'i rigasasad/ dgung lo bcu gcig par rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis rjes su bzung bas pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam gyi gnad thamasacad dus gcig tu gzigs/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug grub birnya pa dngos su byon nasargyud sde rgya mtsho'i gsang ba'i mdzod chen po byin/ brang ti dar ma snying po sogasalasamado phyogasadang / rang gi yab dang / bla ma ba ri lo tsā ba/ mal lo tsā ba sogasalasagasang sngagasaspyi dang / shad ston chosa'abar las gsung ngag rin po che'i bdud rtsi gsol bsanyamasartogs kyi pad+mo gsar du bzhad pa'i tshul bzung / mya ngan lasa'adasapa'i tshe/ sku'i rnam 'phrul bzhin bstan nas dag pa'i zhing so sor gshegs pa'i snang bsamatshon rdzu 'phrul rdo rje'i bkod pa zad mi shesapa la dbang 'byor/ slob ma yang mchog thob pa gsum dang / bzod thob pa bdun sogasamakhasagrub nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa byung / de srasakun dga' 'bar/ bsod namasartsemo/ gragasapa rgyalamatshan/ dpal chen 'od po rnams las/ kun dga' 'bar rgya gar du gshegs/slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo ni 'phags yul gyi chu bo gaṅgā tshun chad du mkhas pa'i grags pas khyab/ ye shes kyi ḍā ki ma rnamasakyisardo rje gdan gyi sgo gong du mi thub zla ba'i rnam 'phrul gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen por bsngags pa'i yi ger bkod/ bshad sgrub kyi phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang 'ja' lus rdo rje'i go 'phang chen por byon/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan 38

ba tshe zug 'od snang lag sa skya'i chogang gtses bsdus/ ()skya zhes mtshan mchog gsum ldan gyi grags dkar 'dzam gling thams cad du khyab/ de sras spyan ras gzigs dngos dpal brtse ba chen po kun dga' snying po ni / chung ngu nas dam pa'i rigs sad/ dgung lo bcu gcig par rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis rjes su bzung bas pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam gyi gnad thams cad dus gcig tu gzigs/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug grub chen birnya pa dngos su byon nas rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i gsang ba'i mdzod chen po byin/ brang ti dar ma snying po sogs las mdo phyogs dang / rang gi yab dang / bla ma ba ri lo tsā ba/ mal lo tsā ba sogs las gsang sngags spyi dang / shad ston chos 'bar las gsung ngag rin po che'i bdud rtsi gsol bas nyams rtogs kyi pad+mo gsar du ba 'ad pa'i tshul bzung / mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshe/ sku'i rnam 'phrul bzhin bstan nas dag pa'i zhing so sor gshegs pa'i snang bas mtshon rdzu 'phrul rdo rje'i bkod pa zad mi shes pa la dbang 'byor/ slob ma yang mchog thob pa gsum dang / bzod thob pa bdun sogs mkhas grub nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa byung / de sras kun dga' 'bar/ bsod nams rtse mo/ grags pa rgyalamatshan/ dpal chen 'od po rnams las/ kun dga' 'bar rgya gar du gshegs/slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo ni 'phags yul gyi chu bo gaṅgā tshun chad du mkhas pa'i grags pas khyab/ ye shes kyi ḍa ki ma rnam ba'i kyis rdo rje gdan gyi sgo gong du mi thub zla ba'i rnam 'phrul gan/ lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen por bsngags pa'i yi ger bkod/ bshad sgrub kyi phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang 'ja' lus rdo rje'i go 'phang chen por byon/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan 38

gangasacan bod yuladu byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/ni / 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangasakyis rjes su bzung bas sde snod dang rgyud sde rab 'byams la mkhyen pa'i gter mdzod grol/ rje btsun saskya pasa'od gsal gyi ngang dulam 'bras nye brgyud kyi gdams pa stsal zhing grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs/ mkhas btsun grub pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ ma byon sangasargyas gsum pa kha che paṇ+ḍita shākya shrī bha dras kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa gsang ba 'dusapa zhes bsngags pa'i brgyud mang bsgrengs/ khengs pa'i ru mtshon dbyings su brtul nas/ gtsug gi nor bus zhabasabartan gyi pad+mo la phyag byas te/ gsung gi bdud rtsi gsol bar mdzad pas 'phags bod rdo rje 'dzin pa bye ba'i gtsug rgyan du nges pa rnyed/ sku tshe'i 'du byed kyang yun ring du byin gyis brlabasate zab rgyas kyi bstan pa nam langs pa'i rjes su nyi ma shar ba ltar mdzad/ gcung grub pa'i rig 'dzin dpal chen 'od po la sras sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta dang / zangasatsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan gnyis 'khrungs pa'i/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇ+ḍita chen po ni/ mi nas mir gyur pa'i skye ba nyi shu rtsa lngar rje btsun brtan pa'i 'khor los dge ba'i bshes su mdzad pas/ sku tshe 'dir yang phyi nang rig pa'i gnasamatha' dag lan re'am/ zung re gsan pa tsam gyis khong du chud/ lhag par lam zab bla ma'i byin rlabs la brten nas rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / 'jam dpal dbyangs dbyer med du gzigs pa'i phyi nang gsang ba'i rten 'brel thams cad der 'grigs/ mkhas shing grub pa'i yon tan dang / gzhan phan phrin las kyi klong brdol/ 'phagasayul nasargya nag gi bar du snyan pa'i grags pas khyab/ rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la shin 39

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/ni / 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis rjes su bzung bas sde snod dang rgyud sde rab 'byams la mkhyen pa'i gter mdzod grol/ rje btsun sa skya pas 'od gsal gyi ngang dul ma 'bras nye brgyud kyi gdams pa stsal zhing grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs/ mkhas btsun grub pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ ma byon sangs rgyas gsum pa kha che paṇ+ḍita shākya shrī bha dras kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa gsang ba 'du rung pa zhes bsngags pa'i brgyud mang bsgrengs/ khengs pa'i ru mtshon dbyings su brtul nas/ gtsug gi nor bus zhabs brtan gyi pad+mo la phyag byas te/ gsung gi bdud rtsi gsol bar mdzad pas 'phags bod rdo rje 'dzin pa bye ba'i gtsug rgyan du nges pa rnyed/ sku tshe'i 'du byed kyang yun ring du byin gyis brlabs te zab rgyas kyi bstan pa nam langs pa'i rjes su nyi ma shar ba ltar mdzad/ gcung grub pa'i rig 'dzin dpal chen 'od po la sras sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta dang / zangs tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan gnyis 'khrungs pa'i/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇ+ḍita chen po ni/ mi nas mir gyur pa'i skye ba nyi shu rtsa lngar rje btsun brtan pa'i 'khor los dge ba'i bshes su mdzad pas/ sku tshe 'dir yang phyi nang rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag lan re'am/ zung re gsan pa tsam gyis khong du chud/ lhag par lam zab bla ma'i byin rlabs la brten nas rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / 'jam dpal dbyangs dbyer med du gzigs pa'i phyi nang gsang ba'i rten 'brel thams cad der 'grigs/ mkhas shing grub pa'i yon tan dang / gzhan phan phrin las kyi klong brdol/ 'phags yul nas rgya nag gi bar du snyan pa'i grags pas khyab/ rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la shin 39

ba chen 'od sna pa la / sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()tu byang zhing 'jig rten pa'i lha las dngos grub kyang thob pa phyi rol pa'i ston chen 'phrog byed dga' bo sogs drug lung dang / rigs pa dang / lhag pa'i lhasarjes su bzung ba'i mthus btul nas nang pa'i bstan pa la bcug mthar rgya nag go dan rgyal pos spyan drangs te byang phyogs sprul pa sde'i lha khang du ngo mtshar ba'i rnam 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pas gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus/ zangasatsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan la sras chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa dang / grub pa'i dbang phyug 'gro mgon phyag na gnyis 'khrungs pa las/ cho khrig rgyal 'phags pa rin po che blo gros rgyal mtshan ni/ sa chen po la bzhugs pa'i byang chub semasadapa' bsam bzhin du mi'i srid par bzung bas/ thog ma nas rigs dang /brtse ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod tshul sogs gzhan las ches khyad par du gyur pas/ 'phags pa zhes pa'i mtshan gyi me tog phye/ rig pa dang grol ba'i spobs pa zad mi shes pa'i gter brdol/ yan lag lnga mtshon rnon pos so sor phral ba rgyal ba rigs lnga'i bkod par bstan pa sogs rdzu tsol gyi spyod pa dang / sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa phun sum tshogs pas gdug can hor gyi rgyal po'ang mi byed pa'i dad pa 'khrungs te dbang bskur lan gsum gsan pa'i/dang po'i dbang yon du dbus gtsang khri stor gsum/ bar par bod chol kha gsum/ tha ma rgya yi li yul chen mo phul bas phan bde'i nyer 'tsho bla na med par gyur/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ yi ge dhi dhi zhes pa blo gros kyi skad dod yin pasama' gyi zur dang po bstan/zhes sdom brtson nyid/ /ston pa'i bstan pa gsal bar byed/ /ces lung gis bstan pa ltar/ sdom brtson rgyal po'i tshul bzung nas/40

ba r+sā 'od snangal / saskya'i chosa'abyung gtsespobasdus/ ()tu byang zhing 'jig rten pa'i lha las dngos grub kyang thob pa phyi rol pa'i ston chen 'phrog byed dga' bo sogs drug lung dang / rigs pa dang / lhag pa'i lhasarjes su bzung ba'i mthus btul nas nang pa'i bstan pa la bcug mthar rgya nag go dan rgyal pos spyan drangs te byang phyogs sprul pa sde'i lha khang du ngo mtshar ba'i rnam 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pas gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus/ zangasatsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan la sras chos kyi rgyal po 'phagasapa dang / grub pa'i dbang phyug 'gro mgon phyag na gnyis 'khrungs pa las/ chozla/rgyal 'phags pa rin po che blo grosargyal mtshan ni/ sa chen po la bzhugs pa'i byang chub semasadapa' bsam bzhin du mi'i srid par bzung bas/ thog ma nasarigs dang /brtse ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod tshul sogs gzhan las ches khyad par du gyur pas/ 'phags pa zhes pa'i mtshan gyi me tog phye/ rig pa dang grol ba'i spobs pa zad mi shes pa'i gter brdol/ yan lag lnga mtshon rnon pos so sor phral ba rgyal ba rigs lnga'i bkod par bstan pa sogs rdzu'aphrul gyi spyod pa dang / sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa phun sum tshogs pas gdug can hor gyi rgyal po'ang mi byed pa'i dad pa 'khrungs te dbang bskur lan gsum gsan pa'i/dang po'i dbang yon du dbus gtsang khri sko+or gsum/ bar par bod chol kha gsum/ tha ma rgya yi li yul chen mo phul bas phan bde'i nyer 'tsho bla na med par gyur/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ yi ge dhi dhi zhesapa blo grosakyi skad dod yin pasama' gyi zur dang po bstan/zhes sdom brtson nyid/ /ston pa'i bstan pa gsal bar byed/ /ces lung gis bstan pa ltar/ sdom brtson rgyal po'i tshul bzung nas/40

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/grub mtha' la nye 'khon med par bskyangs pas yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i bshad sgrub dang / gangs can gyi bde skyid nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad/ mang du thosapa'i mchog snar thang pa bcom ldan rig pa'i ral gri yang grub pa'i yon tan gyis rang dbang med pa'i dad par bkod pa sogasarnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab cing / khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por bsngags pa'i springs yig 'jig rten gsum na grags pa nyid do/ /'gro mgon phyag na'i sras chos skyong srung bas gdan sa lo shas mdzad cing / de nas zangs tsha'i sras slob dpon ye shes 'byung gnas kyi sras bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal gdan sar phebs/ de la btsun mo bdun zhes pa las sras ming sring bco lnga 'khrungs pa'i ti shrī kun dga' blo gros kyis gcung rnams la bla brang khag bzhir bgos nas gnang bas/gzhi thog bla brang / bla brang rin chen sgang pa/ lha khang bla brang / dusamachod bla brang bzhin byung ba las/ gzhi thog bla brang ni/ mkhas btsun nam mkha' legs pa nas bdag chen blo gros dbang phyug gi bar du mkhas grub mang du byon/ bla brang rin chen sgang par/ kun dga' nyi ma/ 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan/dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan te sku mched gsum las/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan ni mkhas shing grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba chen por gyur/ snyan brgyud rgya mtsho lta bu'i bka' babs/ gangs can gyi mkhasagrub phal mo ches zhabs pad la btud pas thugs sras kyang / sngags kyi rgyal chab chen po gnyis/ gsung gi gsang ba 'dzin pa brgyad/ yongs grags kyi mkhas pa bcu gcig sogs bsam gyis mi khyab par byon te/ deng sang gi bar 4/

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/grub mtha' la nye 'khon med par bskyangs pas yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i bshad sgrub dang / gangs can gyi bde skyid nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad/ mang du thosapa'i mchog snar thang pa bcom ldan rig pa'i ral gri yang grub pa'i yon tan gyis rang dbang med pa'i dad par bkod pa sogasarnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab cing / khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por bsngags pa'i springs yig 'jig rten gsum na grags pa nyid do/ /'gro mgon phyag na'i sras chos skyong srung bas gdan sa lo shas mdzad cing / de nas zangs tsha'i sras slob dpon ye shes 'byung gnas kyi sras bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal gdan sar phebs/ de la btsun mo bdun zhes pa las sras ming sring bco lnga 'khrungs pa'i ti shrī kun dga' blo gros kyis gcung rnams la bla brang khag bzhir bgos nas gnang bas/gzhi thog bla brang / bla brang rin chen sgang pa/ lha khang bla brang / dusamachod bla brang bzhin byung ba las/ gzhi thog bla brang ni/ mkhas btsun nam mkha' legs pa nas bdag chen blo gros dbang phyug gi bar du mkhas grub mang du byon/ bla brang rin chen sgang par/ kun dga' nyi ma/ 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan/dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan te sku mched gsum las/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan ni mkhas shing grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba chen por gyur/ snyan brgyud rgya mtsho lta bu'i bka' babs/ gangs can gyi mkhasagrub phal mo ches zhabs pad la bshud pas thugs sras kyang / sngags kyi rgyal chab chen po gnyis/ gsung gi gsang ba 'dzin pa brgyad/ yongs grags kyi mkhas pa bcu gcig sogs bsam gyis mi khyab par byon te/ deng sang gi bar 4/

'tshe' 'odasnang las/ saskya'i chogayang sa bsdus/ ()du rje btsun saskya pa'i tshogs dang / slob mar bshad pa'i snyan brgyud rnamasam nyams par gnas pa 'di rje nyid kyi phrin las kho na yin/ 'jam dbyangasadon yod rgyal mtshan gyi sras bla kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ de srasa'ajam dbyangasanam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ de srasargya gar ba shesarab rgyal mtshan dang / snyan brgyud rgya mtsho'i gter mdzod bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan sogasakyi bar du byon nas mgon po che chung sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa zhal ngo nang brgyud du gragasapas mtshon bstan pa'i srog shing mtshungs pa med par gyur/ lha khang bla brang pa ni/ ngag dbang kun dga' legasapa'i 'byung gnas dang / kun dga' rgyal mtshan mched gnyis nas bzung / chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang kun dga' legs pa'i bar mkhas btsun grub pa'i yon tan can du byon/ dus mchod bla brang ni da lta'i gdung rabs 'di nyid kyi rtsa ba ste/ de yang bzang po dpal gyi sras bdag kun dga' legs 'byung sogasamached gsum/ kun dga' legs 'byung sras grags pa rgyal mtshan/ de sras rnam srasargyal mtshan/de sras nam mkha' legasapa/ de sras nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ de sras sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje rab mdzes/ kun dga' bsod nams/ ngag gi dbang phyuga'ajam dpal grags pa/ sangasargyasatshe brtan te mched bzhi las/ phyi ma la sras gcen bdag chen kun dga' bsam grub dang/ gcung sngags 'chang chen po kun dga' rin chen gnyis 'brungs pa las/ snga ma rtse gdong du bzhugs nas/ngag dbang nor bu rgyan pa'i bar gyi rtse gdong gi gdung brgyud rnams byon/ lo chen be+e ro dang rje btsun grags pa sogasakyi rnam 'phrul sprul pa'i skyes mchog 42

ba 'a 'od snang la / sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()du rje btsun sa skya pa'i tshogs dang / slob mar bshad pa'i snyan brgyud rnams ma nyams par gnas pa 'di rje nyid kyi phrin las kho na yin/ 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan gyi sras bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ de sras 'jam dbyangasanam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ de sras rgya gar ba shes rab rgyal mtshan dang / snyan brgyud rgya mtsho'i gter mdzod bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan sogs kyi bar du byon nas mgon po che chung sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa zhal ngo nang brgyud du grags pas mtshon bstan pa'i srog shing mtshungs pa med par gyur/ lha khang bla brang pa ni/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas dang / kun dga' rgyal mtshan mched gnyis nas bzung / chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang kun dga' legs pa'i bar mkhas btsun grub pa'i yon tan can du byon/ dus mchod bla brang ni da lta'i gdung rabs 'di nyid kyi rtsa ba ste/ de yang bzang po dpal gyi sras bdag chen kun dga' legs 'byung sogs mched gsum/ kun dga' legs 'byung sras grags pa rgyal mtshan/ de sras rnam sras rgyal mtshan/de sras nam mkha' legs pa/ de sras nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ de sras sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje rab mdzes/ kun dga' bsod nams/ ngag gi dbang phyuga'ajam dpal grags pa/ sangs rgyas tshe brtan te mched bzhi las/ phyi ma la sras gcen bdag chen kun dga' bsam grub dang/ gcung sngags 'chang chen po kun dga' rin chen gnyis 'khrungs pa las/ snga ma rtse gdong du bzhugs nas/ngag dbang nor bu rgyan pa'i bar gyi rtse gdong gi gdung brgyud rnams byon/ lo chen be+e ro dang rje btsun grags pa sogs kyi rnam 'phrul sprul pa'i skyes mchog 42

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/sngags lang chen mo dpal sa skyar byon/ sa lo chen po dang dkon mchog lhun grub sogs bsten nas lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho la dbang 'byor/ gdan sa chen por bar skabs nyams chag ches byung ba la thugasakyis ma bzod pa/ rdo rje'i chos skyong rnams bran du bkol bas phas rgol rnams ming gi lhag mar byas/ phyi gtsug lag gi khang / nang dkon mchog gi rten/ bar dge 'dun gyi sde/ mtshan nyid kyi bshad srol sngags kyi phyag len/ snying po'i nyams bzhes sogs ra lo gsum gyi mdzad pas dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa sde dang bcas pa la bka' drin chen pos khyab par mdzad/ de la sras 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po dang / sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros gnyis 'khrungs/ 'di nas bzung ste bar skabs su gdan sa chen por snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa cung zad nyag phra bar gyur pa'ang rim gyis 'phel ba'i mgo tshugs/ phyi ma'i sras 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ bsod nams dbang po mched dang / mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags sogs dam pa du ma bsten nas mdo sngags snyan brgyud dang bcas pa'i gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu gsan/ 'chad spel gyi phrin las dang / bde gsang gshed skor kye rdor phur pa sogs kyi chos 'byung dang rnam bshad kyis mtshon gsung rtsom kyang mang du mdzad/ de sras 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug gis yab dang / zha lu mkhan chen sogs las gsan bsam mdzad cing chos srid kyi phrin las gong du 'phel/ de sras ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis kyis a mes zhabs yab sras43

gangasacan bod yuladu byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/sngagasa'achang mo dpal saskyar byon/ salo chen po dang dadzi+on mchog lhun grub sogasabasten nas lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho la dbang 'byor/ gdan sachen por bar skabasanyamasachag chesabyung ba la thugasakyis ma bzod pa/ rdo rje'i chos skyong rnams bran du bkol bsaphas rgol rnams ming gi lhag mar byas/ phyi gtsug lag gi khang / nang dkon mchog gi rten/ bar dge 'dun gyi sde/ mtshan nyid kyi bshad srol sngagasakyi phyag len/ snying po'i nyams bzhesasogasa'akhor lo gsum gyi mdzad pas dpal ldan saskya pa'i bstan pa sde dang bcas pa la bka' dri+on chen pos khyab par mdzad/ de lo sros 'jam dbyangasabasad nams dbang pa dang / sngags 'chang grags pa bla gras gnyis 'khrungs/ 'di nas bzung ste bar skabs su gdan sa por snyan brgyud kyi gdamasapa cung zad nyag phra bar gyur pa'ang rim gyis 'phel ba'i mgo tshugs/ phyi ma'i srasa'ajam mgon a mes zhabs kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ bsod namasadabang po mched dang / mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos gragasasogs dam pa du ma bsten nas mdo sngags snyan brgyud dang bcas pa'i gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu gsan/ 'chad spel gyi phrin las dang / bde gsang gshed skor kye rdor phur pa sogs kyi chos 'byung dang rnam bshad kyis mtshon gsung rtsom kyang mang du mdzad/ de srasa'ajam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug gisayab dang / zha lu mkhan chen sogs las gsan bsam mdzad cing chos srid kyi phrin las gong du 'phel/ de sras ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis kyis a mes zhabasayab sras43

'tshechen 'od snang las/ saskya'i mosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()dang / byams pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ lhun grub dpal ldan/ byamasapa ngag dbang lhun grub/ bzang po rgyal mtshan/ smin gling lo chen sogs bsten cing gsung gi bdud rtsi gsol/ de srasa'ajam mgon bsod namasarin gyisayab rje dang / bco brgyad pa mkhyen brtse rab brtan/ spro lung pa bsod namasachos 'phel/ ngor chen bsod nams bzang po/ thar rtse nam mkha' bsam grub sogs yongs 'dzin du ma las gsan bsam mdzad/ de srasasnyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma/ 'jam mgon ngag gi dbang po kun dga' blo grosamached gnyis sogs byon pa las/ 'jam mgon kun dga' blo grosani/ 'phagasamachog phyag na pad+mo'i ye shes sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rnam rol las/ 'phagasapa'i yul du 'chi med grub pa'i dbang phyug ji tā ri dgra las rnam rgyal dang / gangasacan gyi ljongs 'dir brtse chen kun dga' snying po dang / bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo grosargyal mtshan sogs dam pa'i skyes bu brgyud mar 'khrungs shing / sku tshe 'dir yang gsung bye ba tsam nas a ra pa tsa na dhī zhes gsal bar gsungs pas mtshon mkhyen rab kyi pad+mo bye/ thugs rje'i grib bsil rgyas/ dam pas bsngags pa'i yon tan thams cad la dbang 'byor/ yab rje dang / rje btsun mkha' spyod dbang mo / thar rtse nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ brag rtsa ba blo gsal bstan 'dzin/ ngor chen sangs rgyas ye shes sogs yongs 'dzin du ma las rang lugs gtso bor gyur pa'i grub mtha' ris med kyi dbang lung man ngag bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / khyad par gnas gsar pa ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas las lam 'bras slob bshad sogs snyan brgyud kyi skor yongs su rdzogs 44

ba tshe chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()dang / byams pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ lhun grub dpal ldan/ byams ka pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ bzang po rgyal mtshan/ smin gling lo chen sogs bsten cing gsung gi bdud rtsi gsol/ de sras 'jam mgon bsod nams rin chen gyisayab rje dang / bco brgyad pa mkhyen brtse rab brtan/ spro lung pa bsod namasachos 'phel/ ngor chen bsod nams bzang po/ thar rtse nam mkha' bsam grub sogs yongs 'dzin du ma las gsan bsam mdzad/ de sras snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma/ 'jam mgon ngag gi dbang po kun dga' blo gros mched gnyis sogs byon pa las/ 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros ni/ 'phags ma chag phyag na pad+mo'i ye shes sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rnam rol las/ 'phags pa'i yul du 'chi med grub pa'i dbang phyug ji tā ri dgra las rnam rgyal dang / gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir brtse chen kun dga' snying po dang / bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo grosargyal mtshan sogs dam pa'i skyes bu brgyud mar 'khrungs shing / sku tshe 'dir yang gsung bye ba tsam nas a ra pa tsa na dhī zhes gsal bar gsungs pas mtshon mkhyen rab kyi pad+mo bye/ thugs rje'i grib bsil rgyas/ dam pas bsngags pa'i yon tan thams cad la dbang 'byor/ yab rje dang / rje btsun mkha' spyod dbang mo / thar rtse nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ brag rtsa ba blo gsal bstan 'dzin/ ngor chen sangs rgyas ye shes sogs yongs 'dzin du ma las rang lugs gtso bor gyur pa'i grub mtha' ris med kyi dbang lung man ngag bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / khyad par gnas gsar pa ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas las lam 'bras slob bshad sogs snyan brgyud kyi skor yongs su rdzogs 44

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/pa dang / rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che sogs zab rgyas kyi gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu gsan/ dpal kye rdo rje'i gzhi bsnyen lan gsum sogs dus dang /rgyun du'ang lhag pa'i lha sum cur nye ba sogs kyi sgom bzlas kyis mtshon thugs dam nyams bzhes rtse gcig tu gnang bas lhag pa'i lha du mas rjes su bzung /rdo rje'i chos srung rnams kyis phrin las sgrub par khas blangs/ dam can pu tra lcam sring dang / phur srung dkar bdud kyis bran bzhin du bya ba byed/ dbang dang gdams khrid sogs ji lta bu zhig gsung na'ang thugs nas shar gyis gsung ba sogs mkhas pa dang / lam 'bras slob bshad dus bir srung phyi ma gnang skabs nyi 'dzin yong bar byed grub dgongs mthun du ri mos gtan la phebs kyang / rje de nyid kyis rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi skur bzhengs te ro ma'i rlung dhā tir zhugs su ma ster bas nyi 'dzin mi mngon par byin gyis brlabs pa sogaso grub pa'i mtshan ma 'byams klas/ snga phyir rten bzhengasamang po dang / khyad par 'chad spel gyi phrin las rgyun mi 'chad cing / gsung rtsom kyang pod chen bcu gnyis tsam gnang bas bstan pa'i srog mthud pa lta bu'i bka' drin bskyangs/zhal slob kyi gtso bo gdung sras sku mched/ thar rtse rdo rje 'chang nam mkha' 'chi med/ gnas gsar mchog sprul nam mkha' legadra'ipa/ bco brgyad khri chen mched/ gzim 'og sprul sku bstan 'dzin phrin las/ sa skya'i zur 'chad pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ lnga rig pa kun dga' bkra shis/ ri khu sprul sku kun dga' mkhas grub dbang po sogs bstan pa 'dzin nges kyi skyes bu dam pa mang du byon pa las/ deng sang yang rje btsun sa skya pa'i dbang lung man ngag phyag 'khrid 45

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/pa dang / rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che sogs zab rgyas kyi gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu gsan/ dpal kye rdo rje'i gzhi bsnyen lan gsum sogs dus dang /rgyun du'ang lhag pa'i lha sum cur nye ba sogs kyi sgom bzlas kyis mtshon thugs dam nyams bzhes rtse gcig tu gnang bas lhag pa'i lha du mas rjes su bzung /rdo rje'i chos srung rnams kyis phrin las sgrub par khas blangs/ dam can pu tra lcam sring dang / phur srung dkar bdud kyis bran bzhin du bya ba byed/ dbang dang gdams khrid sogs ji lta bu zhig gsung na'ang thugs nas shar gyis gsung ba sogs mkhas pa dang / lam 'bras slob bshad dus bir srung phyi ma gnang skabs nyi 'dzin yong bar byed grub dgongs mthun du ri mos gtan la phebs kyang / rje de nyid kyis rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi skur bzhengs te ro ma'i rlung dhā tir zhugs su ma ster bas nyi 'dzin mi mngon par byin gyis brlabs pa sogaso grub pa'i mtshan ma 'byams klas/ snga phyir rten bzhengasamang po dang / khyad par 'chad spel gyi phrin las rgyun mi 'chad cing / gsung rtsom kyang pod chen bcu gnyis tsam gnang bas bstan pa'i srog mthud pa lta bu'i bka' drin bskyangs/zhal slob kyi gtso bo gdung sras sku mched/ thar rtse rdo rje 'chang nam mkha' 'chi med/ gnas gsar mchog sprul nam mkha' legadra'ipa/ bco brgyad khri chen mched/ gzim 'og sprul sku bstan 'dzin phrin las/ sa skya'i zur 'chad pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ lnga rig pa kun dga' bkra shis/ ri khu sprul sku kun dga' mkhas grub dbang po sogs bstan pa 'dzin nges kyi skyes bu dam pa mang du byon pa las/ deng sang yang rje btsun sa skya pa'i dbang lung man ngag phyag 'khrid 45

'tshe' 'og pa / sa skya'i cho ཿnga sa bsdus/ ()sogs kyi bka' srol ma nyams par yod pa 'di kho na'i bka' drin yin/ de sras 'jam mgon dbang sdud snying po dang / kun dga' phan bde rgya mtsho mched zhal gyis/ yab rje gtso bor gyur pa'i dam pa du ma las gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu gsan/ 'chad spel dang grub pa'i phrin las kyis bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel/ snga ma'i sras khri chen pad+ma bdud 'dul dbang phyug gam kun dga' bkra shis/ sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ 'jam mgon kun dga' rgyal mtshan/mgon po dngos grub dpal 'bar rnams byon pa las/ yab rje dang / gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍita kun dga' bkra shis las rang lugs gtso bor gyur pa'i gdams pa'i gsan bsam nyams bzhes 'chad spel sogs gnang / khri chen sras khri chen bkra shis rin chen gyis yab rje dang / thar rtse rdo rje 'amang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin las gsan bsam dang / sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen sras 'jam mgon rdo rje rin chen gyis yab rje dang / 'jam mgon kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ yongs 'dzin blo gros rgya mtsho sogs las zab rgyas kyi gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu gsan/ sku na phra mo nas dam pa'i rigs sad pa'i spyod pa ngo mtshar bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / 'chad spel gyi phrin las rgyun mi 'chad par mkhas dang grub pa'i gtsug gi nor bur zhabs kyi pad+mo brtan bzhin pa 'di ltar lags so/ /gdan sa 'og ma gtsang rtse gdong ni/ bdag chen kun dga' bsam 'grub sogs dus mchod bla brang gi gdung rabs rnams kyis skyong / khri chen bsod nams lhun grub sogs bstan 'dzin dam pa'ang mang du byon/ phyis su 46

'tshe' 'og dz+walas/ saskya'i chogaḥng khesabasdus/ ()sogs kyi bka' srol ma nyamasapar yod pa 'di kho na'i bka' drin yin/ de srasa'ajam mgon dbang sdud snying po dang / kun dga' phan bde rgya mtsho mched zhal gyis/ yab rje gtso bor gyur pa'i dam pa du ma las gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu gsan/ 'chad spel dang grub pa'i phrin las kyis bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel/ snga ma'i sras khri pad+ma bdud 'dul dbang phyug gam kun dga' bkra shis/ sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ 'jam mgon kun dga' rgyal mtshan/mgon po dngos grub dpal 'bar rnamasabyon pa las/ yab rje dang / gnasalnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍita kun dga' bkra shis las rang lugs gtso bor gyur pa'i gdams pa'i gsan bsam nyams bzhes 'chad spel sogasaganang / khri chen sras khri chen bkra shis rin chen gyisayab rje dang / thar rtse rdo rje 'chang byamasapa kun dga' bstan 'dzin las gsan bsam dang / sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen sras 'jam mgon rdo rje rin chen gyis yab rje dang / 'jam mgon kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ yongs 'dzin blo gros rgya mtsho sogs las zab rgyas kyi gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu gsan/ sku na phra mo nas dam pa'i rigs sad pa'i spyod pa ngo mtshar bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / 'chad spel gyi phrin lasargyun mi 'chad par mkhas dang grub pa'i gtsug gi nor bur zhabs kyi pad+mo brtan bzhin pa 'di ltar lags sa/ /gdan sa'og ma gtsang rtse gdong ni/ bdag chen kun dga' bsam 'grub sogasadus mchod bla brang gi gdung rabasarnams kyisaskyong / khri chen bsod namasalhun grub sogasabastan 'dzin dam pa'ang mang du byon/ phyis su 46

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/gdung rabs med kyang / bar skabs skye sprul rim byon dang / deng sang sa skya nas zhal 'dzin gnang / /gzhan yang dpal sa skya pa'i brgyud 'dzin grags che ba 'ga' zhig gi gdan sal/ ngor e waṃ chos ldan ni/ 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍita chen po'i ye shes gzigs pa'i nor bu'i me long gtsang mar ji ltar shar ba bzhin rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos dgung lo zhe brgyad pa sa bya lor btab/ de la rje rdo rje 'chang 'di nyid ni/ 'phags pa dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su 'dzin pa'i mdo las/ gang tshe 'jig rten mgon po'i sprul pa 'byung / /de tshe dge slong kun dga' bzang por sprul/ /tshul khrims kyis kyang khyad par 'phags gyur la / / thos pa mang zhing pha rol phyin pas 'phags/ khes sogs dang / mdo sde pad+ma dkar po las/ kun dga' bzang po nga yi chos 'dzin pa/ /bde gshegasabye ba drug cu mchod byas nas/ /ma 'ongs dus kyi tshe na rgyal bar 'gyur/ /zhes rdo rje'i lung gis gsal bar bsngags pa bzhin 'od gsal 'khon gyi rigs su 'khrungs/ chung ngu nas dad brtson shes rab sogs rigs kyi rtags rnams sad/shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ grub chen burnya shrī/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhen nu blo gros sogs las zab kyi rgyas gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu gsan/ mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa la thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs bcad/ bsgom pas nyams su blangs pas grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs/ 'od gsal gyi snang bar rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras sogs kyis rjes su bzung / 'chad spel gyi phrin las sa rgyal ba'i bstan pa la ston pa gnyis pa'i bya ba mdzad/ sngags phyogs gtso bor gyur pa'i gsung rab glegs bam bzhi bzhugs/ lhag par rgyud 47
