gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/gdung rabasamed kyang / bar skabs skye sprul rim byon dang / deng sang sa skya nas zhal 'dzin gnang / /gzhan yang dpal saskya pa'i brgyud 'dzin grags che ba 'ga' zhig gi gdan sal/ ngor e waṃ chosaldan ni/ 'jam mgon saskya paṇ+ḍita chen po'i ye shes gzigs pa'i nor bu'i me long gtsang mar ji ltar shar ba bzhin rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang posadagung lo zhe brgyad pa sa bya lor btab/ de la rje rdo rje 'chang 'di nyid ni/ 'phagasapa dge ba'i rtsa ba yongasasu 'dzin pa'i mdo las/ gang tshe 'jig rten mgon po'i sprul pa 'byung / /de tshe dge slong kun dga' bzang por sprul/ /tshul khrimasakyisakyang khyad par 'phags gyur la / / thosapa mang zhing pha rol phyin pasa'aphags/ khesasogasadang / mdo sde pad+ma dkar po las/ kun dga' bzang po nga yi chosa'adzin pa/ /bde gshegasabye ba drug cu mchod byas nas/ /ma 'ongs dus kyi tshe na rgyal bar 'gyur/ /zhes rdo rje'i lung gis gsal bar bsngags pa bzhin 'od gsal 'khon gyi rigs su zhabrungs/ chung ngu nasadad brtson shes rab sogs rigs kyi rtagasarnams sad/shar chen ye shesargyalamatshan/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ sabazang 'phagasapa gzhon nu blo gros soganasalas zab rgyasakyi gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu gsan/ mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa la thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs bcad/ bsgom pas nyams su blangs pas grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs/ 'od gsal gyi snang bar rje btsun saskya pa yab sras sogs kyis rjes su bzung / 'chad spel gyi phrin lasakyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa la ston pa gnyis pa'i bya ba mdzad/ sngags phyogs gtso bor gyur pa'i gsung rab glegasabam bzhi bzhugs/ lhag par rgyud 47

bge 'odasnang la / saskya'i chosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()sde bzhi'i smin grol gyi gdams pa mkha' khyab tu spel bas rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa la bka' drin mtshungs pa med pa'i phyir rtsod pa'i dus kyi rdo rje 'chang zhes grags dkar gyi yi ge phyogs kyi bu mo'i rna lung du bkod/ mkhas shing dngos grub brnyes pa'i zhal slob kyang bsam gyisami khyab pa byon pas stod mnga' ris nas smad rgya mtshams yan chad du phrin las kyi rgyun skyong ba'i chos sde che phra bgrang gisami lang / de ltar rje rdo rje 'chang nyid dgung lo don lnga par grub mtha' rnyogs nas gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus pa'i rjes gdan sar 'khor lo sdom pa ngur smrig gar gyis rol pa mus chen sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan bzhugs te/ de yang musastag mo gling skyar zhad gi rigs su 'khrungs/rong ston dang / rdo rje 'chang sogs yongasa'adzin bzhi bcu tsam bsten nas thosabasam sgom gsum gyi pha rol son/ rdo rje 'chang gshegasarjes gdan sa lo gsum du mdzad cing / gshegasarjesakyi bya ba dang / 'chad spel/ gsung lathumapod gcig yod/rgyun bsrings/ zhal slob kyang kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge sogs tshogs bshad dang / bdag chen rdo rje 'chang sogs slob bshad kyi brgyud 'dzin rnams byon pas tshogs slob thams cad kyi 'byung gnas kyang rje 'di nyid yin no / / phyis mus bsam gtan phug tu thugs dam gong 'phel du mdzad cing grub pa'i sar gshegs/ dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa gsum par gzugs sku'i spros pa bsdus/ de nas rim par gtsang chu mig pa 'gar ston 'jam dbyangs shesarab rgya mtsho/'jam dbyangs sapaṇa gyis rjes su bzung /gsung rab mang tsam zhugs/ngor chen gyi dbon grub chen birnya pa'i rnam 'phrul rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug gsung

brtse chen 'od snang las/ tsho skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()sde bzhi'i smin grol gyi gdams pa mkha' khyab tu spel bas rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa la bka' drin mtshungs pa med pa'i phyir rtsod pa'i dus kyi rdo rje 'chang zhes grags dkar gyi yi ge phyogs kyi bu mo'i rna lung du bkod/ mkhas shing dngos grub brnyes pa'i zhal slob kyang bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon pas stod mnga' ris nas smad rgya mtshams yan chad du phrin las kyi rgyun skyong ba'i chos sde che phra bgrang gis mi lang / de ltar rje rdo rje la4 nyid dgung lo don lnga par grub mtha' rnyogs nas gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus pa'i rjes gdan sar 'khor lo sdom pa ngur smrig gar gyis rol pa mus chen sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan bzhugs te/ de yang mus stag mo gling skyar zhang gi rigs su 'khrungs/rong ston dang / rdo rje 'amang sogs yongs 'dzin bzhi bcu tsam bsten nas thosabasam sgom gsum gyi pha rol son/ rdo rje 'chang gshegs rjes gdan sa lo gsum du mdzad cing / gshegs rjes kyi bya ba dang / 'chad spel/ gsung la bum pod gcig yod/rgyun bsrings/ zhal slob kyang kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge sogs tshogs bshad dang / bdag chen rdo rje 'chang sogs slob bshad kyi brgyud 'dzin rnams byon pas tshogs slob thams cad kyi 'byung gnas kyang rje 'di nyid yin no / / phyis mus bsam gtan phug tu thugs dam gong 'phel du mdzad cing grub pa'i sar gshegs/ dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa gsum par gzugs sku'i spros pa bsdus/ de nas rim par gtsang chu mig pa 'gar ston 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gyis rjes su bzung /gsung rab mang tsam zhugs/ngor chen gyi dbon grub chen birnya pa'i rnam 'phrul rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug gsung

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/'bum pod gcig yod/ dpal sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin mdo sngags gnyis ka la mkhas pa go bo rab 'byams pa kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge sngags phyogasaglegs bam bzhi dang / mdo phyogs shin tu mang bar bzhugs/ ste/ 'di yan tham bas cad rdo rje 'chang gi thugs sras yin/ ngor chen dbon brgyud yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ 'di skabs rdo rje 'chang gi bstan pa dkar mas su btang / lung bstan gnang ba ltar bska pa dar rgyas che/ mus chen dbon mkhas grub chen po sangs rgyas rin chen/ lam 'bras khrid yig sogs gsung 'bum pod gcig slob dpon bsod nams rtse mos rjes su bzung ba'i rgyal ba lha mchog seng ge ngor wo dbon brgyud/ nges par thams cad mkhyen dngos yongs 'dzin rin po tsho snag dbon/'jam dbyangs dkon mchog lhun grub/ bka' 'bum pod bzhi bzhugs/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i rnam 'phrul mdo sngags rab 'byams smra ba 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas seng ge ngor chen dbon brgyud/ mkhas shing dngos grub brnyes pa'i mtshungs med dkon mchog dpal ldan/ dkon mchog lhun grub rus dbon brgyud yin/ gsung rab kyang 'ga' zhig yod/ brang ti mkhas pa'i rigs 'khrungs gnas lnga rig pa'i ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang /rdor phreng sogs legs bshad bod gsum/ dpal sa skya pa'i sku 'ad bdag chen shar pa'i gsangs byamatha/pa kun dga' bkra shis/ dpal sa skya pa rtse gdong khri chen 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/sa skya'i dbon r+ṣa 'od zer seṅge'i brgyud par 'khrungs/ gsung rab pu ti gcig yod pa legs bshad rgya che/ brang ti mkhan chen grub pa'i dbang phyug nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ dpal ldan a ti sha'i rnam 'phrul 49

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'igasang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/'bum pod gcig bod/ dpal sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin mdo sngags gnyis ka la mkhas pa go bo rab 'byams pa kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge sngagasaphyogasaglegasabam bzhi dang / mdophyogasashin tu mang bar bzhugs/ ste/ 'di yan thamaba'icad rdo rje 'chang gi thugs sras yin/ ngor chen dbon brgyud yongasa'adzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ 'di skabasardo rje 'chang gi bstan pa dkar 'byamasasu btang / lung bstan gnang ba ltar bska pa dar rgyasache/ musachen dbon mkhasagrub chen po sangasargyasarin chen/ lko 'brasakhrid yig sogasagasung 'bum pod gcig slob dpon bsod namaba'irtse mos rjeba'isu bzung ba'i rgyal ba lha mchog seng ge ngor wo dbon brgyud/ nges par thams cad mkhyen dngos yongasa'adzin rin po che'i snag dbon/'jam dbyangs dkon mchog lhun grub/ bka' 'bum pod bzhi bzhugs/ chosakyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i rnam 'phrul mdo sngagasarab 'byams smra ba 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas seng ge ngor chen dbon brgyud/ mkhas shing dngos grub brnyesapa'i mtshungs med dkon mchog dpal ldan/ daspu+on mchog lhun grub rusadabon brgyud yin/ gsung rab kyang 'ga' zhig yod/ brang ti mkhas pa'i rigs 'khrungs gnas lnga rig pa'i ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang /rdor phreng sogasalegasabashad pod gsum/ dpal saskya pa'i sku zhang bdag chen shar pa'i rigasa'akhrungs byamasapa kun dga' bkra shis/ dpal sa skya pa rtse gdong khri 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/saskya'i dbon r+ṣa 'odazer seṅge'i brgyud par zhabrungs/ gsung rab pu ti gcigayod pa legasabashad rgya che/ brang ti mkhan chen grub pa'i dbang phyug nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ dpal ldan a ti sha'i rnam 'phrul 49

gye' 'od pas/saskya' mro+oyang sa bsdus/'amakhyen rab dang phrin las r+sā med pa shar r+sā shesarab ཿnga gnas/brang ti mkhan r+sā nam mkha' rin /bdag po rgyal rtse ba byang pa ngag dbang zlosod nams rgyal mas/ngor sgo gnyisaka'i bas yon/snarathangad/lasti+or ngapa khang gsar mkhan chen bsod namasargya mtsho/sgrub khang pa dbon mkhan wo 'jam dbyangasadasal mchog yi mas/'a/ sde dger phebasapa'i mag rabasakyi thogam/to+o se chen gan gya brgyud lasa'akhrungs zlo' 'asgo mchog nam mkha' dpal bzang 'disathar rtseragadan chamadzad/shar kro ston pa 'jam mgon lhun grub dpal ldan/mnga' risasmad pa snyigasadusabastan pa'i nyi ma mkhan r+ṣa 415ri ///re/11ngo'ajam pa' dbyangs sangs rgyasaphun tshogs/bdag r+pā shar pa gsaXkhrungs byang tso semasadapa' r+pā po sangasargyasabastan 'dzin/shabasdu stod rdzalung pa mkhan r+ṣa byams pa shes bya bzang po/thar rtse'iswā da༅ོ/shar nyag sgang pa 'jam dbyangs ngur smig gar rol byamasapa tshul mas dpal bzang /gtsang phyug g.yi spel skya ba mtshungs med bsod nams dpal ldan/mkha sangasargyas phun rdzasakyi phyag phyir sdodager yang phebs/khang gsar pa grub pa'i dbang phyug 'jam mgon byams pa bsod nams bzang zlo+o/dpal mar me mdzad kyi rnam rol /tsang mdo mkhar ba mkhan wo /spyo shasalhunagrub/mkhyen rab mtha' yas/'amanga'abadagasnrasapas masalhun grubaltar dar rtse mdor tsongs/brang ta mkhan wo /ba pa dbang phyug byams pa nam mkha' bsam grub/rnal sti+or dbang phyug rnam phrul mkhan r+ṣa rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chosaskyong /ngor sprel grod du ltos/mtshungs med mkhas 0shing grub pa 'jam mgon sangasargyas

ba 'a 'od pa las/sa skya' chosang sa bsdus/()mkhyen rab dang phrin las tshad med pa shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/brang ti mkhan chen nam mkha' rin chen/bdag po rgyal rtse ba byang pa ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ngor sgo gnyis ka'i bas 'dzan/snar thang dpal 'byor gling pa khang gsar mkhan chen bsod nams rgya mtsho/sgrub khang pa'i dbon mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/'di sde dger phebs pa'i ma༅ rabs kyi thog ma/hor se chen gan gyi brgyud las zhabrungs pa'i 'dren mchog nam mkha' dpal bzang 'dis thar rtser gdan tshar mdzad/shar mi nyag gi ston pa 'jam mgon lhun grub dpal ldan/mnga' ris smad pa snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/bdag chen shar pa'i rigasa'akhrungs byang chub sems dpa' chen po sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin/shabs stod rdzi lung pa mkhan chen byams pa shes bya bzang po/thar rtse'i snag da'/shar mi nyag sgang pa 'jam dbyangs ngur smig gar rol byams pa tshul khrims dpal bzang /gtsang phyug gzhung spel skya ba mtshungs med bsod nams dpal ldan/mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tsho gis kyi phyag phyir sde dger yang phebs/khang gsar pa grub pa'i dbang phyug 'jam mgon byams pa bsod nams bzang po/dpal mar me mdzad kyi rnam 'phrul gtsang mdo mkhar ba mkhan chen bkra shis lhun grub/mkhyen rab mtha' yas pa'i mnga' bdag byams pa tshul khrims lhun grub ltar dar rtse mdor ga spungs/brang ti mkhan chen grub pa'i dbang phyug byams pa nam mkha' bsam grub/rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi rnam 'phrul mkhan chen rdo rje la4 dpal ldan chos skyong /ngor sprel grod du 'gros/mtshungs med mkhas shing grub pa 'jam mgon sangs rgyas0

gangasacan bodayul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/dpal bzang / khang gsar pa mkhan chen byams pa bsod nams lhun grub/shar chen byang chub semasadapa' rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bkra shis lhun grub sku dbon 'jam dbyangs chos kyi bla ma sangs rgyas ye shes/'jam dbyangs chos kyi rje dkon mchog grags pa/ khang gsar pa ngag dbang chos skyong bzang po/ mkhasagrub sangs rgyas grags pa/ mtshungs med phun tshogasadon grub/ mkhasagrub chen po byamasapa kun dga' bsod nams/ brang ti mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa byams pa nam mkha' 'chi med/ rab 'byams shes bya kun gzigasamakhas grub ngag dbang dam chos/ smra ba'i dbang phyug mkhan chen bsod nams dpal 'byor/ brang ti mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ khang gsar pa ngag dbang blo gros bzang po/rab 'byams smra ba'i dbang po yongs 'dzin paṇ+ḍi ta dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong gi sku dbon rin chen mchog grub kyi rnam 'phrul byamasapa dpal ldan bzang po/ brang ti mkhan chen byang chub sems dpa' rig brgya'i khyab bdag rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po/ khang gsar pa mkhan chen mtshungasamed ngag dbang blo grosabastan 'dzin gyi bar du byon nas paṇ+ḍi tas bshad/ lo tsā bas bsgyur/ grub thob kyis bsgom/ mkhas pa rnams la tshad mar grags pa'i mdo rgyud bstan bcos dang bcas pa rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras dang ngor chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos ji ltar bkral ba bzhin du lung rigasakyi bshad pa/ sgom sgrub kyi nyamasalen/ cho ga'i phyag len phra mo tshun chad kyang gzhan dang ma 'dresapar bskyangs pas dpyad pa gtsang zhing blo gros kyi pad+mo 51

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/dpal bzang / khang gsar pa mkhan chen byams pa bsod nams lhun grub/shar chen byang chub sems dpa' rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bkra shis lhun grub sku dbon 'jam dbyangs chos kyi bla ma sangs rgyas ye shes/'jam dbyangs chos kyi rje dkon mchog grags pa/ khang gsar pa ngag dbang chos skyong bzang po/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas grags pa/ mtshungs med phun tsho gos don grub/ mkhas grub chen po byams pa kun dga' bsod nams/ brang ti mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa byams pa nam mkha' 'chi med/ rab 'byams shes bya kun gzigs mkhas grub ngag dbang dam chos/ smra ba'i dbang phyug mkhan chen bsod nams dpal 'byor/ brang ti mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ khang gsar pa ngag dbang blo gros bzang po/rab 'byams smra ba'i dbang po yongs 'dzin paṇ+ḍi ta dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong gi sku dbon rin chen mchog grub kyi rnam 'phrul byams pa dpal ldan bzang po/ brang ti mkhan chen byang chub sems dpa' rig brgya'i khyab bdag rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po/ khang gsar pa mkhan chen mtshungs med ngag dbang blo gros bstan 'dzin gyi bar du byon nas paṇ+ḍi tas bshad/ lo tsā bas bsgyur/ grub thob kyis bsgom/ mkhas pa rnams la tshad mar grags pa'i mdo rgyud bstan bcos dang bcas pa rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras dang ngor chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos ji ltar bkral ba bzhin du lung rigs kyi bshad pa/ sgom sgrub kyi nyams len/ cho ga'i phyag len phra mo tshun chad kyang gzhan dang ma 'dres par bskyangs pas dpyad pa gtsang zhing blo gros kyi pad+mo 51

brtse 'od snang las/ saskya'i chosa'abyung gces bsdus/ ()rgyas pa rnams kyis gcig tu bsngags pa'i gzhir gyur pa yin no/ /'phan yul nā len+d+ra ste bod skad du rgyun gyi dbang por grags pa'i chos grwa ni / paṇ+ḍi ta ka ma la shi la dang / rma lo tsā ba rin chen mchog gi rnam 'phrul rong ston smra ba'i seṅge shes bya kun mkhyen shākya'i rgyal mtshan gyis dgung lo bdun cu pa me 'brug lor btab/ gzim khang 'og ma kun mkhyen bkra shis rnam rgyal sogs kyis bskyangs/ sngar mtshan nyid kyi grwa sa chen por gyur kyang / bar skabs nyams chag byung ba'i rkyen gyis bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis/lo tsā ba lce khyi 'brug sogs kyi rgyud las 'khrungs pa zha lu sku zhang mkhyen rab chos rje rin chen mchog grub 'byon par bskul te sngags kyi grwa tshang du bsgyur bas/ phyis mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po dang / mkhyen rab byamasapa ngag dbang lhun grub/ dbon mkhyen brtse rab brtan sogs chos rje bco brgyad pa gong 'og rnams dang / zhabs drung nor bu lags kyi sku skye mkhas grub sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin/ thams cad mkhyen pa byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin phrin las/ lce btsun byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin snyan grags bar gyi gzim khang 'og sku phreng rim byon gyis zab gsang slob bshad kyi seṅge'i sgra chen po sgrogs pas mtshon/ rgyud dang man ngag rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs su gyur/gong dkar rdo rje gdan ni/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug bu ston kun dga' rnam rgyal gyis btab/ sa skya rdzong lugs dang / bu lugs 'dres ma'i chos rgyun bskyangs/ bar skabs su dar rgyas shin tu che bar byung zhing / deng sang yang rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i smin grol sgrub mchod sogs rgyun phal cher ma nyams 52

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/par yad/gtsang ngams ring gi chos sder/ mkhan po shākya seṅge sogs rim par byon/ ma nyid kyi grwa sa che shas gcig yin/gtsang rong 'bras yul skyed tshal ni/ byams chen rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas 'phel gyis dgung lo so dgu pa sa sprul lor btab cing / mtshan nyid kyi grwa sa chen por gyur/ de las mtshan nyid pa'i grwa sa'ang mang du yod/ /gtsang gser mdog can ni/ paṇa chen don yod dpal bas btab/paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan dgung lo zhe gnyis lon pa'i tshe phebs nas dar rgyas su mdzad pas/ bar skabs dgon ma lag dang bcas pa shin tu dar bar gyur kyang / deng sang ni dge 'dun gyi sde ma stong tsam las med/ /gtsang rta nag thub bstan rnam rgyal gling ni/ kun mkhyen go bo rab 'byams pa bsod nams seṅges dgung lo zhe lnga pa chu sprul lor btab/ deng sang yang bshad grwa ma nyams par yod cing / dpal sa skya pa'i lha khang chen mo'i mtshan nyid grwa tshang yang 'di'i bshad rgyun las byung ba sogs dgon lag kyang mang du 'phel/ /gnyan yod bya rgod gshong ni/ paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pas dgung lo nga bdun pa sa bya lor btab/ mtshan nyid kyi ring lugs 'dzin pa che shos shig yin/ /gtsang nyang stod shel mkhar rgyal rtse'i chos sde ni/ chos rgyal rab brtan kun bzang 'phags kyis btab/ sa bu dge gsum gyi grwa tshang khag bcu drug tsam 53

ba chen 'od snang lag sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()yod cing deng sang yang dar rgyas che/ /gtsang stod 'dar grang mo che ni/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho'i gdan sa'i mthil du mdzad/ deng sang yang de'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i sde ma nyams par yod/yar klung bkra shis chos sde ni/ tshar chen gyi slob ma mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug yol ba rdo rje 'chang gzhen nu blo gros kyis btab/ phyis su khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan sogs gnas gsar ba'i dbon dang sku skye rim byon gyis skyong / de yang dpal sa skya pa'i snyan brgyud rgya mtsho'i mdzod 'chang ba/ chos rje tshar pa'i lugs srol 'di ni/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa gtso bo ngor chen rdo rje 'chang nas mus chen sems dpa' chen po dang / des bdag chen rdo rje 'chang nyid la chig brgyud du gnang / gzhan yang yab 'jam dbyangs chos rje nas brgyud pa sogs brgyud srol gsum gyi bka' thams cad bdag chen rdo rje 'chang la babs/ de bzhin du gser chos bcu gsum dang / mgon po che chung sogs chos rje bla ma dam pa nasayar klung klu pa rnams la brgyud pa dang / zhal ngo chig brgyud du byon pa sogasadapal brtse ba chen po'i rnam 'phrul/ mkhas pa'i cod pan/ grub pa'i gtsug rgyan/ zab rgyas gdams pa'i rgya mtsho bdag chen rdo rje 'chang nyid la bka' babs/ de la zhal gyi bdud rtsi bzhes pa'i slob ma bsam gyis mi khyab kyang /thun mong ma yin pa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa bum pa gang byor stsal ba'i yul ni / sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig nyid 'phags bod kyi mkhas grub du ma'i skye 54

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/ba'i phreng ba brgyud mar byon pa'i rje btsun rdo ring pa kun spangs kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma blo ldan shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po nyid yin te/ rje 'dis spyir rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po yab sras sogs gsar rnying ris med kyi mkhas grub dam pa bdun cu rtsa gnyis bsten/ mdo sngags kyi gdams pa rgya mtshor lung rigs kyis sgro 'dogs bcad/ khyad par bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi zhabs pad mnyes pa gsum gyis bsten nas gsung ngag rin po ches mtshon pa'i snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan gyi gdams pa mtha' dag gsan bsam mthil phyin par mdzad/ phyag len phra mo tshun chad kyang byang chub/ kha'u brag rdzong nag po'i ri khrod sogs dben pa'i ri sul rnams su sku tshe ril por thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor las nam yang mi 'da' bas grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs/ zab gsang seṅge'i sgra dbyangs rgyun mi 'chad par bsgrags te snyan brgyud zab mo'i gdams pa srid mthar spel bas rje btsun kha'u pa'i ring lugs ces grags pa'i rgyud mang bsgrengs/ de la slob ma mang du byon pa'i nang nas nang thugs kyi sras gcig pu tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po blo gsal rgya mtsho ni/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du grub chen bi rū pa dang gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir rtsod pa'i dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin chen grub sogs mkhas pa dang grub pa'i skye ba'i phreng ba me tog mnā ra'i phreng ba lta bu tshar du dngar ba bzung ba'i mthar/mang mkhar mu gu lung dang nye ba'i nor 'dzin gyi thig ler mtshan dpe'i me tog thog mar 'khrungs pa nas mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan ngang gis sad/ rdo rje'i chos srung rnams kyis rnam 'phrul du mas phrin las bsgrubs/ gdan gsum 55

'tshe chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chosang gces bsdus/ ()rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar zig gas pa sogs dang / ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar du ma dang bcas chos grwa chen po bkra shis lhun por mtshan nyid kyi theg pa la sbyangs pas lung rigs smra ba rnams kyi khengs pa'i ru mtshon brtul/ sngon gyi smon lam sad pas rje btsun sa skya pa'i ring lugs dang / grub pa'i khyu mchog rdo ring par 'phrog tu med pa'i dad pas rgyu byas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mas mngon sum du lung gi skabs dbye bas rkyen sbyar te gangs ri'i khrod kyi u ḍi ya na gnyis pa kha'u brag rdzong nag po'i ri khrod du phebs/ sa skya tshad kyi rna brjo ma grags pa'i slob bshad snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan gyis mtsho ni/ zab rgyas kyi gdams pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsan/ de yang gsan 61 tsam du ma bzhag par phyag len phra mo tshun bsam byung gis sgro 'dogs bcad de/ bsgoms pas nyams su blangasapas drod rtags mngon du gyur/ chos nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes gzigs/chos can gyi snang ba thams cad lha'i 'bor lor shar/ rdo rje'i chos skyong rnams kyis bran bzhin du bya ba byed/ khyad par kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che'i khri la zhabs pad bkod pa na 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rjes dam tshig gi rdo rje spyi bor blangs pas dpyod ldan rnams kyis 'jam dpal khros pa ngur smrig gi gar gyis rol par nges pa rnyed/ gzhan yang ris med pa'i dam pa drug cu rtsa gsum bsten nas gangs can gyi ljongs su yod do cog gi mchog thun gyi dngos grub sgrub pa'i gdams pa zab mo mtha' dag gi bka' babs pas snyigs dus kyi rdo rje 'chang ga shes par gyur/ 'dar grang mo che/ mang mkhar thub bstan dge 'phel/ cha lung rdo rje'i brag rdzong sogs su bzhugs nas bshad sgrub spel mar mdzad pas gsung 56

'tshe 'od snangal / saskya'i chosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar gzigasapa sogasadang / ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar du ma dang bcas chos grwa chen po bkra shis lhun por mtshan nyid kyi theg pa la sbyangs pas lung rigs smra ba rnams kyi khengs pa'i ru mtshon brtul/ sngon gyi smon lam sad pasarje btsun saskya pa'i ring lugasadang / grub pa'i khyu mchog rdo ring par 'phrog tu med pa'i dad pas rgyu byas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mas mngon sum du lung gi skabs dbye bas rkyen sbyar te gangs ri'i khrod kyi u ḍi ya na gnyis pa kha'u brag rdzong nag po'i ri khrod du phebs/ sa skya tshad kyi rna bar ma gragasapa'i slob bshad snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan gyisamatshon/ zab rgyasakyi gdamasapa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsan/ de yang gsan lo tsam du ma bzhag par phyag len phra mo tshun bsam byung gis sgro 'dogs bcad de/ bsgoms pas nyamasasu blangasapasadrod rtags mngon du gyur/ chos nyid lhan cig skyesapa'i ye shesagazigs/chos can gyi snang ba thams cad lha'i 'bor lor shar/ rdo rje'i chos skyong rnams kyis bran bzhin du bya ba byed/ khyad par kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che'i khri la zhabs pad bkod pa na 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rjes dam tshig gi rdo rje spyi bor blangs pas dpyod ldan rnams kyis 'jam dpal khros pa ngur smrig gi gar gyis rol par nges pa rnyed/ gzhan yang ris med pa'i dam pa drug cu rtsa gsum bsten nas gangs can gyi ljongs su yod do cog gi mchog thun gyi dngos grub sgrub pa'i gdams pa zab mo mtha' dag gi bka' babs pas snyigs dus kyi rdo rje 'chang gar+sha shes par gyur/ 'dar grang mo che/ mang mkhar thub bstan dge 'phel/ cha lung rdo rje'i brag rdzong sogs su bzhugs nas bshad sgrub spel mar mdzad pas gsung 56

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/rab pod bzhi tsam bod/ mkhas pa dang grub pa'i pad+ma'i rdzing bu dar la babs pa'i grags dkar sbrang rtsi'i bsung zhim gyis rang dang gzhan gyi dam pa'i skyes bu skal bzang gi bung ba'i tshogs sprin bzhin du ngang gis 'du ba la/ snyan brgyud zab mo'i bdud rtsi lhug par stsal bas lung dang / mngon par rtogs pas rgyud phyug pa'i zhal slob bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig byung ba las/ gtso bor gsung gi gsang ba ji bzhin du 'dzin pa ni sku'i skye ba du mar yab sras su 'brel bas sku tshe 'dir yang tshar chen yab sras zhes mtshan gyi yi ge 'brel mar gsal zhing nang thugs kyi sras gcig pur gyur pa lha rigs 'a zhwa'i brgyud du 'khrungs pa gnas gsar pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug ste/ dam pa 'dis bdag chen dang / rdo ring pa gnyis ka'i thugs sras rje btsun sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa dang / rje tshar chen gtso bor gyur pa'i gsar rnying gi mkhas grub du ma las gsar ma'i phyogs la dbang bka' chen po brgya dang bcu drugabyin rlabs dgu bcu rtsa bzhi/ rjes gnang zur bka' brgya dang don brgyad/ khrid bka' brgya dang nyer gcig lhag pa/ rnying ma'i phyogs la dbang chen brgya dang don gcig dbang phran sum cu rtsa gcig khrid bka' sum cu rtsa brgyad sogasadang / de dag gi rgyab brten lung gi rim pa glegs bam brgya phrag mang por gsan bsam gyis sgro 'dogs bcad/ dpe cha dang dkyil thang sogs bzhengs/tha na gtor bshams dang / rdor dril 'dzin lugs sogs phyag len phra mo tshun chad kyang ma 'dres par mkhyen/ mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs rgya mtshor bshad sgrub kyi phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam zhing bu ston rin po che'i gdan sa'ang 57

gangasacan bod yuladu byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/rab pod bzhi tsapa yod/ mkhas pa dang grub pa'i pad+ma'i rdzing bu dar la babasapa'i grags dkar sbrang rtsi'i bsung zhim gyis rang dang gzhan gyi dam pa'i skyes bu skal bzang gi bung ba'i tshogs sprin bzhin du ngang gisa'adu ba la/ snyan brgyud zab mo'i bdud rtsi lhug par stsal bas lung dang / mngon par rtogs pas rgyud phyug pa'i zhal slob bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig byung ba las/ gtso bor gsung gi gsang ba ji bzhin du 'dzin pa ni sku'i skye ba du mar yab sras su 'brel bas sku tshe 'dir yang tshar chen yab sras zhes mtshan gyi yi ge 'brel mar gsal zhing nang thugs kyi sras gcig pur gyur pa lha rigasa' zhwa'i brgyud du 'khrungs pa gnas gsar pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug ste/ dam pa 'dis bdag chen dang / rdo ring pa gnyisaka'i thugs sras rje btsun sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa dang / rje tshar chen gtso bor gyur pa'i gsar rnying gi mkhas grub du ma lasagasar ma'i phyogs la dbang bka' chen po brgya dang bcu drugabyin rlabs dgu bcu rtsa bzhi/ rjes gnang zur bka' brgya dang don brgyad/ khrid bka' brgya dang nyer gcig lhag pa/ rnying ma'i phyogasal dbang chen brgya dang don gcig dbang phran sum cu rtsa gcig khrid bka' sum cu rtsa brgyad sogasadang / de dag gi rgyab brten lung gi rim pa glegs bam brgya phrag mang por gsan bsam gyis sgro 'dogs bcad/ dpe cha dang dkyil thang sogasabazhengs/tha na gtor bshams dang / rdor dril 'dzin lugasasogs phyag len phra mo tshun chad kyang ma 'dresapar mkhyen/ mdo sngagasakyi gzhung lugs rgya mtshor bshad sgrub kyi phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam zhing bu ston rin po che'i gdan sa'ang 57

ba 'a 'odasnangalag saskya'i mosayang r+sāsabasdus/ ()mdzad/ lhag par snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan gyi skor la thosabasam sgom gsum gyisamathar son/ gsung sgros zin ngesakyi bka' rtsom snyan brgyudagatsogyur glegasabam bzhi/ yang mang du gnang bsabargyud 'dzin rnamasakyi mig gcig pur gyur/ mdor na mkhyen brtse nusagasum gyi yon tan gyi mkhas pa rnamasamagu zhing grub pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis phyag bya ba'i yul du 'os pa kho nar nges/gzhan yang 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍitas byin gyis brlabs pasamakhyen rab tshad med pa/ rig par smra ba thamasacad kyi gtsug gi nor bu/ mnyan yod bya rgod gshongs kyi mkhan chen dbyangs can mgrin par chagasapa dpal mang du thos pa klu sgrub rgya mtsho mdo sngagasaganyisaka'i phyogs gsung rtsom pod bcu gcig tsam tshig don phun sum tshogasapar yod/ mnyan yod sbasapa'i rnal 'byor gyi rnam 'phrul mkhasabatsun grub pa'i yon tan 'gran zla dang bral ba sne gdong rtse tshogs mkhan chen yol pa gzhon nu blo gros/ snyan brgyud kyi mnga' bdag mthu stobs nusapa'i dbang phyug bod mkhar ba mi tri don grub rgyal mtshan bzhi ni thugs sras kyi gtso bo dang /gzhan yang yab sras gnyis rka'i slob ma mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan dang / rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan sogs mtha' klas so/ /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug la slob ma mang du byon pa'i nang nas bo dong mkhan chen ram sding ma ba bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ sku'i dbon gnasagasar pa rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug 'bras bu'i sngags 'chang dgon gsar pa bsod nams chos 'phel gsum lasarim par brgyud de/tshar chen rin po che'i rnam 'phrul khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po//58

ba chen 'od snang lag sa skya'i chosang gtses bsdus/ ()mdzad/ lhag par snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan gyi skor la thos bsam sgom gsum gyis mthar son/ gsung sgros zin nges kyi bka' rtsom snyan brgyud gtso gyur glegs bam bzhi/ yang mang du gnang bas brgyud 'dzin rnams kyi mig gcig pur gyur/ mdor na mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi yon tan gyi mkhas pa rnams mgu zhing grub pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis phyag bya ba'i yul du 'os pa kho nar nges/gzhan yang 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍita sa byin gyis brlabs pas mkhyen rab tshad med pa/ rig par smra ba thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bu/ mnyan yod bya rgod gshongs kyi mkhan chen dbyangs can mgrin par chags pa dpal mang du thos pa klu sgrub rgya mtsho mdo sngags gnyis ka'i phyogs gsung rtsom pod bcu gcig tsam tshig don phun sum tshogs par yod/ mnyan yod sbas pa'i rnal 'byor gyi rnam 'phrul mkhas btsun grub pa'i yon tan 'gran zla dang bral ba sne gdong rtse tshogs mkhan chen yol pa gzhen nu blo gros/ snyan brgyud kyi mnga' bdag mthu stobs nus pa'i dbang phyug bod mkhar ba mi tri don grub rgyal mtshan bzhi ni thugs sras kyi gtso bo dang /gzhan yang yab sras gnyis rka'i slob ma mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan dang / rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan sogs mtha' klas so/ /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug la slob ma mang du byon pa'i nang nas bo dong mkhan chen ram sding ma ba bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ sku'i dbon gnas gsar pa rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug 'bras bu'i sngags 'chang dgon gsar pa bsod nams chos 'phel gsum las rim par brgyud de/tshar chen rin po che'i rnam 'phrul khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po//58

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/gnas gsar dbon rin po che mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag zha lu mkhan rin po che bsod nams mchog grub/ dpal nā len+t+ra'i mkhan chen bco brgyad pa lce btsun mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma mdo sngags rab 'byams smra ba'i dbang phyug rmor chen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba'i rnam 'phrul gnas gsar pa ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ dpal sa skya pa 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros/ gnas gsar pa'i rnam 'phrul yar klung mchog sprul rin po che nam mkha' legs pa lhun grub zhal slob dang bcas pa dang / rje de nyid kyi mchog sprul bstan pa'i snang byed chen po 'di nyid kyi bar du byon nas slob bshad thun mong ma yin pa'i bstan pa nyin mo ltar mdzad/gzhan yang mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug gzhen nu blo gros las/ sa skya pa 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang pos bka' chos cung zad gsan pas gdan sa chen por yab chos dar ba'i rten 'brel 'grigs/ mang thos klu sgrub dang / sngagasa'achang bsod nams chos 'phel gnyis pa'i slob ma mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags nas/ dpal sa skya pa 'jam mgon a mes zhabs sogs sa skya dang /rgyal rtse ba ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan sogs kyis ngor e waṃ pa'i phyogs su'ang dar/ bod mkhar bas zhwa ser bstan pa'i nyi ma rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho rjes su bzung bas ri bo dge ldan pa'i phyogs su phrin las kyi sgo bye / bka' 'gyur ba dang zha lu mkhan chen las rgyal dbang lnga pa rin po chesasnyan brgyud mtha' dag gsan pas slob bshad bstan pa'i sman yon chen por

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'igasang sngagasagasar rnying gigadan rabasamador bsdus/gnasagasar dbon rin po che mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag zha lu mkhan rin po che bsod nams mchog grub/ dpal nā len+d+ra'i mkhan chen bco brgyad pa lce btsun mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ snyigasadus bstan pa'i nyi ma mdo sngags rab 'byams smra ba'i dbang phyug me+or chen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba'i rnam 'phrul gnas gsar pa ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ dpal sa skya pa 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros/ gnas gsar pa'i rnam 'phrul yar klung mchog sprul rin po che nam mkha' legs pa lhun grub zhal slob dang bcas pa dang / rje de nyid kyi mchog sprul bstan pa'i snang byed chen po 'di nyid kyi bar du byon nas slob bshad thun mong ma yin pa'i bstan pa nyin mo ltar mdzad/gzhan yang mthu stobasakyi dbang phyug gzhon nu blo gros las/ sa skya pa 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang pos bka' chos cung zad gsan pas gdan sa chen por yab chos dar ba'i rten 'brel 'grigs/ mang thosaklu sgrub dang / sngagasa'achang bsod nams chos 'phel gnyis pa'i slob ma mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags nas/ dpal saskya pa 'jam mgon a mes zhabasasogs sa skya dang /rgyal rtse ba ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan sogs kyis ngor e waṃ pa'i phyogs su'ang dar/ bod mkhar bsazhwa ser bstan pa'i nyi ma rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho rjes su bzung bas ri bo dge ldan pa'i phyogs su phrin las kyi sgo bye / bka' 'gyur ba dang zha lu mkhan chen las rgyal dbang lnga pa rin po chesasnyan brgyud mtha' dag gsan pas slob bshad bstan pa'i sman yon chen por

ba chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chosang gces bsdus/ ()gyur/ bka' 'gyur ba dang / rmor chen la sogs las rdo rje brag rig 'dzin pad+ma phrin las dang / rig 'dzin gter bdag gling pa sogs kyis kyang zab chos kyi bdud rtsi bzhes pas gsang chen rnying ma'i bstan 'dzin chen po rnams kyang phyogs 'di la thugs mos kyi pad+mo lhag par bye/ lhag par khyab bdag gnas gsar ba las/ 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros kyis snyan brgyud mtha' dag gsan pas gdan sa chen po gtso bor gyur pa'i gtsang dbus khams gsum gyi slob bshad bstan pa'i chu mgo lta bur gyur/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa dang / de'i sku dbon mkhyen brtse rab brtan/ rtse gdong khri chen mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ gnas gsar pa'i zhal slob rdzong shar bod 'brug pa chos rje blo gsal phun tshogs/ de'i zhal slob bco brgyad khri chen ngag dbang kun dga' mkhyen rab/ 'jam mgon kun blo'i zhal slob rtse gdong khri chen dge 'dun bkra shis dpal 'byor dang / gzims 'og pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin phrin las gong 'og sogs kyis dpal rtse gdong srid gsum rnam rgyal dang / nā le rgyur slob bshad kyi bdud rtsi spel/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba dang / zha lu mkhan chen/ rmor chen rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis dpal zha lu/ rdo rje gdan/ thub bstan ra ba smad sogs kyang slob bshad kyi brgyud 'dzin du gyur/ thar rtse mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa byams pa nam mkha' 'chi med kyis dpal e waṃ chos ldan dang sde dge lhun grub steng sogs su slob bshad zab mo'i shing rta'i srol gsar du phye bas sku'i dbon rnam gnyis kyis gtsos snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan gyi bstan 'dzin mtha' klas pa bskrun pa sogs mdor na tshar chen chos kyi 60

'tshechen 'od snang las/ saskya'i mosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()gyur/ bka' 'gyur ba dang / rmor chen la sogs las rdo rje brag rig 'dzin pad+ma phrin las dang / rig 'dzin gter bdag gling pa sogs kyis kyang zab chos kyi bdud rtsi bzhes pas gsang chen rnying ma'i bstan 'dzin chen po rnams kyang phyogs 'di la thugs modra'ikyi pad+mo lhag par bye/ lhag par khyab bdag gnas gsar ba las/ 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros kyis snyan brgyud mtha' dag gsan pas gdan sa chen po gtso bor gyur pa'i gtsang dbus khams gsum gyi slob bshad bstan pa'i chu mgo lta bur gyur/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa dang / de'i sku dbon mkhyen brtse rab brtan/ rtse gdong khri chen mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ gnas gsar pa'i zhal slob rdzong shar bod 'brug pa chos rje blo gsal phun tshogs/ de'i zhal slob bco brgyad khri chen ngag dbang kun dga' mkhyen rab/ 'jam mgon kun blo'i zhal slob rtse gdong khri chen dge 'dun bkra shis dpal 'byor dang / gzims 'og pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin phrin las gong 'og sogs kyisadapal rtse gdong srid gsum rnam rgyal dang / nā len+d+rar slob bshad kyi bdud rtsi spel/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba dang / zha lu mkhan chen/ rmor chen rdo rje 'chang sogasakyisadapal zha lu/ rdo rje gdan/ thub bstan ra ba smad sogs kyang slob bshad kyi brgyud 'dzin du gyur/ thar rtse mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa byams pa nam mkha' 'chi med kyis dpal e waṃ chos ldan dang sde dge lhun grub steng sogs su slob bshad zab mo'i shing rta'i srol gsar du phye bas sku'i dbon rnam gnyis kyis gtsos snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan gyi bstan 'dzin mtha' klas pa bskrun pa sogs mdor na tshar chen chos kyi 60

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/rgyal po'i phrin las kyis rang dang gzhan gyi grub mtha' phal mo cher khyab par gyur pas snyigs ma'i dus 'dir rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang bye brag rdo rje theg pa'i lam srol la ston pa gnyis pa'i bya ba mdzad pa yin no/ /bod chen po'i ljongs kyi thig le phal mo cher bsod nams stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba/ sde dge chos kyi rgyal po rim byon gyi gdan sa dpal lhun grub steng zhes grags pa'i me tog dregs ldan bye ba'i gtsug na ngal 'tsho ba de nyid ni/ slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa mngal skyes kyi tshul du byon pa grub thang stong rgyal po dang / sde dge bo thar bkra shis seng ge mchod yon gyis btab/grub chen 'di ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi slob ma yin pas deng dus chos rje ngor pa'i phrin las kyi rgyun skyong ba'i rten 'brel du gyur/ de yang bar skabs su sde dge sku phreng rim byon bzhugs shing / phyis su shar chen kun dga' bkra shis thog mar phebs/ de rjes bla chen byams pa phun tshogs kyis sgrub khang pa dpal mchog rgyal mtshan ched kyis spyan drangs te ltar snang chos ltar bcos pa thams cad sun phyung / lung rigs kyi bshad pa/ cho ga'i phyag len/ snying po'i nyams bzhes thams cad ngor chen rdo rje 'chang chen po'i bka' srol ji lta ba bzhin phye/ngor lugs dkyil 'khor rnam pa lngas khobadun namatshon pa'i sgrub mchod kyi rgyun btsugs/ de nas rim par mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ 'jam mgon bkra shis lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong / shar chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang chos skyong bzang po/ brang ti nam mkha' 'chi med/ rje de nyid kyi sku'i dbon dang / thugs kyi sras rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 61

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/rgyal po'i phrin las kyis rang dang gzhan gyi grub mtha' phal mo cher khyab par gyur pas snyigs ma'i dus 'dir rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang bye brag rdo rje theg pa'i lam srol la ston pa gnyis pa'i bya ba mdzad pa yin no/ /bod chen po'i ljongs kyi thig le phal mo cher bsod nams stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba/ sde dge chos kyi rgyal po rim byon gyi gdan sa dpal lhun grub steng zhes grags pa'i me tog dregs ldan bye ba'i gtsug na ngal 'tsho ba de nyid ni/ slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa mngal skyes kyi tshul du byon pa grub thang stong rgyal po dang / sde dge bo thar bkra shis seng ge mchod yon gyis btab/grub chen 'di ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi slob ma yin pas deng dus chos rje ngor pa'i phrin las kyi rgyun skyong ba'i rten 'brel du gyur/ de yang bar skabs su sde dge sku phreng rim byon bzhugs shing / phyis su shar chen kun dga' bkra shis thog mar phebs/ de rjes bla chen byams pa phun tshogs kyis sgrub khang pa dpal mchog rgyal mtshan ched kyis spyan drangs te ltar snang chos ltar bcos pa thams cad sun phyung / lung rigs kyi bshad pa/ cho ga'i phyag len/ snying po'i nyams bzhes thams cad ngor chen rdo rje 'chang chen po'i bka' srol ji lta ba bzhin phye/ngor lugs dkyil 'khor rnam pa lngas khobadun namatshon pa'i sgrub mchod kyi rgyun btsugs/ de nas rim par mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ 'jam mgon bkra shis lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong / shar chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang chos skyong bzang po/ brang ti nam mkha' 'chi med/ rje de nyid kyi sku'i dbon dang / thugs kyi sras rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 61

brtse' 'od snangalas/ saskya'i mosa'abyung gtsesabasdus/ ()'dzin dang / rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po mched gnyis kyi bar du byon pa dang / g.yin yang 'jam mgon bkra shisadapal ldan/ mkhasagrub sangasargyal dpal bzang / 'jam dbyangasasangasargyasaye shes/ mkhas btsun kun dga' chosa'aphel/ bla ma bkra shisadabang phyug slob dpon 'jam dpal gragasapa dang / mkhan zhi ba 'tsho'i rnam 'phrul zhu chen ma hā paṇ+ḍita tshul khrims rin chen sogasadam pa du masangor e waṃ pa'i ring lugasasrid mthar spel/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug yab sras kyi phrin lasal brten nas/ khri chen bla ma sangs rgyasabastan pasadapal sa skya pa'i yab mosabacom ldan 'dasardo rje gzhon nu'i sgrub mchod btsugs pa nas bzung rje btsun sa skya pa'i ring lugs gong du 'phel zhing / saskya sman la bla ma dang / phur pa bla ma rim byon gyisade'i rgyun skyong / byang chub sems dpa' bstan pa tshe ring gis gnas gsar pa ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnasaspyan drangasate/ bcom ldan 'dasadusakyi 'bor lo'i sgrub mchod bu lugasadang / lhag par pho brang gi shar du tshar lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i phyag bzhes ltar rdo rje nag po chen po gtso 'khor gyi snang brnyan gsar du bzhengs/ rgyun dang dusagator btsugs/ thub bstan mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan dang / me+or chen slob ma mkhas grub sangasargyas rgya mtsho sogs kyis chos rje tshar pa'i phrin las kyi sgo phye/ phyis su gnas gsar ba mchog sprul rin po che gong 'og dang / sde dge bla chen byamasapa kun dga' sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mchod yon sogs kyis snyan brgyud zab mo'i bstan pa ches cher dar bar mdzad/ de ltar gtso bor dpal ldan sa ngor tshar 62

gas chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()'dzin dang / rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po mched gnyis kyi bar du byon pa dang / gzhan yang 'jam mgon bkra shis dpal ldan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyal dpal bzang / 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas ye shes/ mkhas btsun kun dga' chos 'phel/ bla ma bkra shis dbang phyug slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pa dang / mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho'i rnam 'phrul zhu chen ma hā paṇ+ḍita tshul khrims rin chen sogs dam pa du mas ngor e waṃ pa'i ring lugs srid mthar spel/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug yab sras kyi phrin las la brten nas/ khri chen bla ma sangs rgyas bstan pas dpal sa skya pa'i yab chos bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhen nu'i sgrub mchod btsugs pa nas bzung rje btsun sa skya pa'i ring lugs gong du 'phel zhing / sa skya sman la bla ma dang / phur pa bla ma rim byon gyis de'i rgyun skyong / byang chub sems dpa' bstan pa tshe ring gis gnas gsar pa ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas spyan drangs te/ bcom ldan 'dasadus kya 'khor lo'i sgrub mchod bu lugs dang / lhag par pho brang gi shar du tshar lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i phyag bzhes ltar rdo rje nag po chen po gtso 'khor gyi snang brnyan gsar du bzhengs/ rgyun dang dus gtar btsugs/ thub bstan mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan dang / rmor chen slob ma mkhas grub sangs rgyas rgya mtsho sogs kyis chos rje tshar pa'i phrin las kyi sgo phye/ phyis su gnas gsar ba mchog sprul rin po che gong 'og dang / sde dge bla chen byams pa kun dga' sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mchod yon sogs kyis snyan brgyud zab mo'i bstan pa ches cher dar bar mdzad/ de ltar gtso bor dpal ldan sa ngor tshar 62

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/gsum dang / gzhan yang 'jam dpal tshe bdag sogs gsang chen rnying mas mchen grub mtha' ris med kyi bshad sgrub dar/ mkhan chen bkra shis lhun grub dang / dpal ldan chos skyong sogs kyis rim par bskul ba las rgyal ba'i bka' bstan 'gyur/ dpal sa skya pa'i bka' 'bum sogs ngo mtshar spar gyi phyi mo mang po bzhengs pas dam pa'i chos kyi mdzod gcig pur gyur to/ /de la gdan sa 'dir bka' drin che ba'i sde dge gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar ni drung yig bstan 'dzin gyi rgyal rabs sogs dang / mkhan chen dpal mchog rgyal mtshan nas chos skyong bzang po yan chad kyi rtogs pa brjod pa ni so so'i rnam thar las shes par bya zhing / 'dir skabs su babs pa brang ti mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang byams pa nam mkha' 'chi med dang / byamangs pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin mched zhal bcas bka' drin che ba'i bla ma gsum gyi rnam thar sa bon tsam brjod na/mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa byam ba'i pa nam mkha' 'chi med ni/ sngon gyi dusan bod chos rgyal 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos lha btsan po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi bla sman mkhas pa mi dgu zhes grags pa'i ya gyal brang ti rgyal gnyen mkhar phug dang / brang ti lo tsā ba dza ya rak+ṣi ta dang / brang ti dar ma snying po sogs mkhas shing dngos grub brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu bar ma chad par byon pa'i brgyud du skye ba'i 'khri shing bzung ste/ gzhon nu'i dus nas byis pa'i spyod pa las 'das pa'i dam pa'i rigs kyi me tog bye/ sngon gnas rjes su dran/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i mtshan nyid gzigs shing cir yang sems su rtogs pa sogs yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga'/ de nas shrī e waṃ chos ldan thar pa chen po'i 63

gangasacan bod yuladu byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/gsum dang / gzhan yang 'jam dpal tshe bdag sogs gsang chen rnying mas mtshon grub mtha' ris med kyi bshad sgrub dar/ mkhan chen bkra shisalhun grub dang / dpal ldan chos skyong sogasakyis rim par bskul ba las rgyal ba'i bka' bstan 'gyur/ dpal saskya pa'i bka' 'bum sogasango mtshar spar gyi phyi mo mang po bzhengasapasadam pa'i chosakyi mdzod gcig pur gyur to/ /de la gdan sa'adir bka' drin che ba'i sde dge gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar ni drung yig bstan 'dzin gyi rgyal rabasasogs dang / mkhan chen dpal mchog rgyal mtshan nas chos skyong bzang po yan chad kyi rtogs pa brjod pa ni so so'i rnam thar las shes par bya zhing / 'dir skabs su babs pa brang ti mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang byams pa nam mkha' 'chi med dang / byamasapa kun dga' bstan 'dzin ma zhal bcas bka' drin che ba'i bla ma gsum gyi rnam thar sa bon tsam brjod na/mkhan chen thamasacad mkhyen pa byamasapa nam mkha' 'chi med ni/ sngon gyi dusan bod chos rgyal 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos lha btsan po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi bla sman mkhas pa mi dgu zhes grags pa'i ya gyal brang ti rgyal gnyen mkhar phug dang / brang ti lo tsā ba dza ya rak+ṣi ta dang / brang ti dar ma snying po sogs mkhas shing dngos grub brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu bar ma chad par byon pa'i brgyud du skye ba'i 'khri shing bzung ste/ gzhon nu'i dus nas byis pa'i spyod pa las 'das pa'i dam pa'i rigs kyi me tog bye/ sngon gnas rjes su dran/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i mtshan nyid gzigs shing cir yang sems su rtogs pa sogs yon tan bsam gyisami khyab pa mnga'/ de nas shrī e waṃ chos ldan thar pa chen po'i 63

ba zuga'ogasnangalag saskya'i chogayang tsosabasdus/ ()dga' ba'i tshal gyi yang rtser phebs nas thub bstan rin po che'i gdugs dkar po'i grib mar zhugs/ phyi nang gi rig gnasadang/ dkyil 'khor bri thig lasarab 'byams thamasacad la byang chub/ kun tu dgos pa'i gzhung bdun dang /rgyud chung bzhi sogs mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs du ma thugs la bzung zhing thogasapa med par smra ba'i paṇ+ḍitar gyur/ khang gsar mkhan chen ngag dbang chos skyong bzang po las gsung ngag rin po che'i bdud rtsi bzhes/ lhag par gangs can bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i thub bstan lha khang du mkhan chen byams pa sbyin pa bkra shisalas paṇa chen shākya shrī dang / 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa sogs las brgyud pa'i bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa rnam par dag pa dang / 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros las sems bskyed srol gnyis dang / dpal kye rdo rje'i rgyu dus kyi dbang bskur phyin ci ma log par gsan pas sdom pa gsum ldan du mdzad cing so so'i bslab bya la mig gi 'bras bu ltar gces spras kyis bskyangs/ khyad par 'jam mgon de nyid las dpal sa skya pa'i lam 'bras tshogs slob gnyis kyis thog drangs pa'i snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan gyi gdams pa mtha' dag la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs bcad/ bsgom pas nyams ྅/spre blangs pas bstan pa'i bdag por dbang bskur ba'ang thob/ gzhan yang phan bde khang sku dbon rin chen mchog grub/ skyo mda' ba mang thos kun dga' bsod nams sogs yongs 'dzin dam pa bcu phrag lnga lhag las zab rgyas gdams pa'i bdud rtsi ngoms pa med par gsol/ phyag len phra mo tshun chad la'ang gces spras kyis bzung / dus dang rgyun gyi nyams bzhes thun bzhi'i rnal 64

ba zug 'od snang lag sa skya'i chosaḥng sa bsdus/ ()dga' ba'i tshal gyi yang rtser phebs nas thub bstan rin po che'i gdugs dkar po'i grib mar zhugs/ phyi nang gi rig gnas dang/ dkyil 'khor bri thig lasarab 'byams thams cad la byang chub/ kun tu dgos pa'i gzhung bdun dang /rgyud chung bzhi sogs mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs du ma thugs la bzung zhing thogs pa med par smra ba'i paṇ+ḍita ra gyur/ khang gsar mkhan chen ngag dbang chos skyong bzang po las gsung ngag rin po che'i bdud rtsi bzhes/ lhag par gangs can bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i thub bstan lha khang du mkhan chen byams pa sbyin pa bkra shis las paṇa chen shākya shrī dang / 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa sogs las brgyud pa'i bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa rnam par dag pa dang / 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros las sems bskyed srol gnyis dang / dpal kye rdo rje'i rgyu dus kyi dbang bskur phyin ci ma log par gsan pas sdom pa gsum ldan du mdzad cing so so'i bslab bya la mig gi 'bras bu ltar gces spras kyis bskyangs/ khyad par 'jam mgon de nyid las dpal sa skya pa'i lam 'bras tshogs slob gnyis kyis thog drangs pa'i snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan gyi gdams pa mtha' dag la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs bcad/ bsgom pas nyams ྅/spre blangs pas bstan pa'i bdag por dbang bskur ba'ang thob/ gzhan yang phan bde khang sku dbon rin chen mchog grub/ skyo mda' ba mang thos kun dga' bsod nams sogs yongs 'dzin dam pa bcu phrag lnga lhag las zab rgyas gdams pa'i bdud rtsi ngoms pa med par gsol/ phyag len phra mo tshun chad la'ang gces spras kyis bzung / dus dang rgyun gyi nyams bzhes thun bzhi'i rnal 64

gangasacan bod yuladu byon ba'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/'byor lasam g.yel bsas lam kyi go 'phang mthon por gshegs/ grub pa'i slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa sogs lhag pa'i lha rab 'byams kyis rjes su bzung /rdo rje'i mosaskyong rnams kyis bka'i cod pan spyi bor 'dzin/ 'chi 'pho skye ba sogs 'byung 'gyur mngon sum du gzigasapa dang / sra mkhregs kyi brag la phur pa btab pa sogs grub pa'i mtshan ma'ang skal ba dang ldan pa rnams kyi ngor snang / mdor na mkhasabatsun grub pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho'i mthar son kyang /rang gi yon tan bum nang gi mar me ltar sba bar mdzad pa jo bo bka' gdams pa'i rnam thar la thugs phyogs pasarang nyid mkhas pa dang grub par nam yang zhal gyisami bzhesapas 'di kho na'i ngo mtshar kyang bsam gyis mi khyab/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi khri la zhabs pad bkod de/ ngor e waṃ pa'i phyogs su gtogs pa rnams bal dmag gi 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa sogs chos dang 'jig rten gyi sgo nas phan 'dogasapa mdzad/ de lta bu'i snyan pa'i grags pas thugs 'phrogasate/ sa skyong sde dge chos rgyal yum sras kyis spyan drangs te gus pas mchod/ dpal lhun grub steng sogs phyogs de'i chos sde che phra du mar dbang lung man ngag gi 'chad spel dang / cho ga'i phyag len/ rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor sogs bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa 'khrul med du spel/ snga phyir gsung ngag tshogs bshad lan du ma dang / slob bshad lan gnyis kyis mtshon zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo rtag tu bskor ba'i grub 'bras sku'i dbon mched sogs bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu mang du bskrun/ bshad sgrub las gsum gyi phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang re zhig zhing 'di'i gdul bya de tsam du gzigs nas dbon rin po 65

gangs can bod yul du byon ba'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/'byor las ma g.yel bsas lam kyi go 'phang mthon por gshegs/ grub pa'i slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa sogs lhag pa'i lha rab 'byams kyis rjes su bzung /rdo rje'i chos skyong rnams kyis bka'i cod pan spyi bor 'dzin/ 'chi 'pho skye ba sogs 'byung 'gyur mngon sum du gzigs pa dang / sra mkhregs kyi brag la phur pa btab pa sogs grub pa'i mtshan ma'ang skal ba dang ldan pa rnams kyi ngor snang / mdor na mkhas btsun grub pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho'i mthar son kyang /rang gi yon tan bum nang gi mar me ltar sba bar mdzad pa jo bo bka' gdams pa'i rnam thar la thugs phyogs pas rang nyid mkhas pa dang grub par nam yang zhal gyis mi bzhes pas 'di kho na'i ngo mtshar kyang bsam gyis mi khyab/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi khri la zhabs pad bkod de/ ngor e waṃ pa'i phyogs su gtogs pa rnams bal dmag gi 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa sogs chos dang 'jig rten gyi sgo nas phan 'dogs pa mdzad/ de lta bu'i snyan pa'i grags pas thugs gas te/ sa skyong sde dge chos rgyal yum sras kyis spyan drangs te gus pas mchod/ dpal lhun grub steng sogs phyogs de'i chos sde che phra du mar dbang lung man ngag gi 'chad spel dang / cho ga'i phyag len/ rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor sogs bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa 'khrul med du spel/ snga phyir gsung ngag tshogs bshad lan du ma dang / slob bshad lan gnyis kyis mtshon zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo rtag tu bskor ba'i grub 'bras sku'i dbon mched sogs bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu mang du bskrun/ bshad sgrub las gsum gyi phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang re zhig zhing 'di'i gdul bya de tsam du gzigs nas dbon rin po 65

'tsher+sā 'odasnang las/ saskya'i chogaḥng gcegabasdus/ ()che byams pa rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po la phyi mtha'i zhal chems lhug par stsal zhing dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa drug par ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te dpal lhun grub steng gi bla brang phan bde kun khyab gling du gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdu ba'i tshul bstan/ gshegs rjes kyi bya ba rnams sku'i dbon mchog dang / sde dge chos rgyal chen po mchod yon gyisamathar phyin par mdzad do/ /rje 'di nyid kyi sku'i dbon dang thugs kyi sras su gyur pa bdag cag lha dang bcas pa'i skyabs gcig mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang chen po mched zhal gnyis te/ de la rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang byamasapa kun dga' bstan 'dzin ni/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i me sprel lor brang ti mkhas pa'i rigs su 'khrungs/ sku gzhon nu nas yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi bla brang thar pa rtser phebs/ nges 'byung snying rje ngang gis 'khrungs/ mkhyen rab kyi gter mdzod grol bas rgyun gyi bya ba chos spyod nas brtsams te/ kun tu dgosapa'i gzhung bdun sogs mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs chen po'i bar thamasacad dka' ba med par thugs su chud/ rdo rje 'chang nam mkha' 'chi med las sdom pa gsum gyi bka' drin nos te thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i nor bu'i khri la zhabs bkod/ bcas pa dang rang bzhin nyes lhung phra mos kyang ma gos pa'i phyir tshul khrims kyi dri bsung zhim pos gar bzhugs kyi phyogasathams cad du khyab/ mkhan chen dam pa gtso bor gyur pa'i yongs 'dzin nyi shu rtsa lnga las rje btsun sa skya pa'i snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan sogs zab rgyas kyi gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu gsan cing / de dag gi tshig 66

ba chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i cho song gces bsdus/ ()che byams pa rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po la phyi mtha'i zhal chems lhug par stsal zhing dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa drug par ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te dpal lhun grub steng gi bla brang phan bde kun khyab gling du gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdu ba'i tshul bstan/ gshegs rjes kyi bya ba rnams sku'i dbon mchog dang / sde dge chos rgyal chen po mchod yon gyis mthar phyin par mdzad do/ /rje 'di nyid kyi sku'i dbon dang thugs kyi sras su gyur pa bdag cag lha dang bcas pa'i skyabs gcig mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang chen po mched zhal gnyis te/ de la rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin ni/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i me sprel lor brang ti mkhas pa'i rigs su 'byungs/ sku gzhen nu nas yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi bla brang thar pa rtser phebs/ nges 'byung snying rje ngang gis 'khrungs/ mkhyen rab kyi gter mdzod grol bas rgyun gyi bya ba chos spyod nas brtsams te/ kun tu dgos pa'i gzhung bdun sogs mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs chen po'i bar thams cad dka' ba med par thugs su chud/ rdo rje 'chang nam mkha' 'chi med las sdom pa gsum gyi bka' drin nos te thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i nor bu'i khri la zhabs bkod/ bcas pa dang rang bzhin nyes lhung phra mos kyang ma gos pa'i phyir tshul khrims kyi dri bsung zhim pos gar bzhugs kyi phyogs thams cad du khyab/ mkhan chen dam pa gtso bor gyur pa'i yongs 'dzin nyi shu rtsa lnga las rje btsun sa skya pa'i snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan sogs zab rgyas kyi gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu gsan cing / de dag gi tshig 66

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/gi sdeb sbyor/ don gyi dgongs pa/ phyag len phra mo tshun la'ang bsam byung gisasgro 'dogs bcad pas 'khrul med du mkhyen/ dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i bsnyen pa lan gnyis sogs lhag pa'i lha du ma'i gzhi'i bsnyen pa dang / rgyun gyi nyams bzhes rim gnyis zab mo'i rnal 'byor rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes gzigs/ byang chub sems gnyis 'byongs/ thub dbang gnas brtan bcu drug dang / slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pa sogs kyis dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal bstan/ rdo rje'i srung ma dang dkar phyogs skyong ba'i gzhi bdag rnams kyis phrin las sgrub/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi chos kyi khri la bgrang bya dgu'i bar du bzhugs nas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang / mkhyen brtse nus pa'i phrin las kyis rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan pa nyin mo ltar mdzad/ skabs der sde dge chos rgyal chen pos spyan drangs te zhabs pad shing rta'i kha lo bod chen po'i bsod nams kyi mgron du snga phyir lan gnyis bsgyur te 'brel tshad don ldan gyi phrin las bskyangs/ smin grol phyag len gyi rgyun nyams pa gsos/ med pa gsar du spel/ 'khrul pa'i dri ma thams cad bsal te yongs rdzogs bstan 'gro spyi dang / lhag par brtse chen snying po'i ring lugs la bka' drin chen pos khyab par mdzad/ chos rgyal chen po nyid bsnyen par rdzogs/ gdan sa gong 'og sogs su lam 'bras tshogos bshad tshar du ma/ slob bshad tshar gsum/ rdo rje phreng ba tshar gnyis sogs chos kyi 'khor lo bar med du bskor bas gsung gi gsang ba 'dzin pa'i thugs sras kyang / dpal sa skya pa khri chen 'jam mgon kun dga' bkra shis/ de sras bkra shis rin chen/ yar klung mchog sprul rin 67

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/gi sdeb sbyor/ don gyi dgongs pa/ phyag len phra mo tshun la'ang bsam byung gisasgro 'dogs bcad pas 'khrul med du mkhyen/ dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i bsnyen pa lan gnyis sogs lhag pa'i lha du ma'i gzhi'i bsnyen pa dang / rgyun gyi nyams bzhes rim gnyis zab mo'i rnal 'byor rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes gzigs/ byang chub sems gnyis 'byongs/ thub dbang gnas brtan bcu drug dang / slob dpon sangasargyas gnyisapa sogs kyis dgyesapa'i 'dzum zhal bstan/ rdo rje'i srung ma dang dkar phyogs skyong ba'i gzhi bdag rnams kyisaphrin lasasgrub/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi chos kyi khri la bgrang bya dgu'i bar du bzhugs nas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang / mkhyen brtse nus pa'i phrin las kyis rgyal ba gnyisapa'i bstan pa nyin mo ltar mdzad/ skabs der sde dge chos rgyal chen pos spyan drangs te zhabs pad shing rta'i kha lo bod chen po'i bsod nams kyi mgron du snga phyir lan gnyis bsgyur te 'brel tshad don ldan gyi phrin lasabaskyangs/ smin grol phyag len gyi rgyun nyams pa gsos/ med pa gsar du spel/ 'khrul pa'i dri ma thams cad bsal te yongs rdzogs bstan 'gro spyi dang / lhag par brtse chen snying po'i ring lugs la bka' drin chen pos khyab par mdzad/ chos rgyal chen po nyid bsnyen par rdzogs/ gdan sa gong 'og sogasasu lam 'brasatshogasabashad tshar du ma/ slob bshad tshar gsum/ rdo rje phreng ba tshar gnyis sogs chos kyi 'khor lo bar med du bskor bas gsung gi gsang ba 'dzin pa'i thugs sras kyang / dpal sa skya pa khri chen 'jam mgon kun dga' bkra shis/ de sras bkra shis rin chen/ yar klung mchog sprul rin 67

ba chen 'od snang las/ saskya'i mosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()po che/ sde dge bla chen byams pa kun dga' sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/sku'i dbon yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i nyi ma kun dga' 'jam dpal grags pa dang / mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug mtshungs med zhabasadrung gcung rin po che sogs kyis mtshon/ mdor na dus 'dir dpal ldan sa ngor tshar gsum gyi bstan 'dzin rnams kyi gtsug na sangs rgyas gnyis pa ltar 'tsho zhing bzhes pa ste / slar yang ji srid bskal pa rgya mtshor zhabs pad rdo rje'i khamasasu brtan cing phrin las mkha' mtha' brdal bar gsol ba 'debs pa lags so/ /rje 'di nyid kyi sku mched rdo rje 'chang byams pa rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po ni/rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa mo bya yi lor dam pa'i rigasasu 'brungs/ ngor e waṃ chos ldan du byon nas rdo rje 'chang nam mkha' 'chi med kyi spyan sngar thub bstan rin po che'i sgor zhugs/ rim gyis gzhung lugs che phra thugs 'dzin sogasabaslab sbyong la brtson pa'i skabs rnams su 'od gsal gyi snang bar/ rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dang / dpal sa skya pa chen pos yang yang byin gyisabarlabs/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa byams pa bsod nams dpal 'byor las/ dpal e waṃ pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams las rim par brgyud pa'i sdom rgyun rnam par dag pa las bsnyen par rdzogs shing tshul khrims kyi bslab pas gzhi bzung ste/ rdo rje 'chang nam mkha' 'chi med kyi zhabs pad mnyes pa gsum gyis bsten nas mdo sngags kyi gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu gsan zhing /bsam byung gis sgro 'dogs bcad/ rim gnyis zab mo'i nyams bzhes la rtse gcig tu gzhol bas nges 'byung dang snying rje chen po rtsol med du 'khrungs/ bla ma 68

ba chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()po che/ sde dge bla chen byams pa kun dga' sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/sku'i dbon yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i nyi ma kun dga' 'jam dpal grags pa dang / mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug mtshungs med zhabs drung gcung rin po che sogs kyis mtshon/ mdor na dus 'dir dpal ldan sa ngor tshar gsum gyi bstan 'dzin rnams kyi gtsug na sangs rgyas gnyis pa ltar 'tsho zhing bzhes pa ste / slar yang ji srid bskal pa rgya mtshor zhabs pad rdo rje'i khams su brtan cing phrin las mkha' mtha' brdal bar gsol ba 'debs pa lags so/ /rje 'di nyid kyi sku mched rdo rje 'chang byams pa rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po ni/rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa mo bya yi lor dam pa'i rigs su 'brungs/ ngor e waṃ chos ldan du byon nas rdo rje 'chang nam mkha' 'chi med kyi spyan sngar thub bstan rin po che'i sgor zhugs/ rim gyis gzhung lugs che phra thugs 'dzin sogs bslab sbyong la brtson pa'i skabs rnams su 'od gsal gyi snang bar/ rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dang / dpal sa skya pa chen pos yang yang byin gyis brlabs/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa byams pa bsod nams dpal 'byor las/ dpal e waṃ pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams las rim par brgyud pa'i sdom rgyun rnam par dag pa las bsnyen par rdzogs shing tshul khrims kyi bslab pas gzhi bzung ste/ rdo rje 'chang nam mkha' 'chi med kyi zhabs pad mnyes pa gsum gyis bsten nas mdo sngags kyi gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu gsan zhing /bsam byung gis sgro 'dogs bcad/ rim gnyis zab mo'i nyams bzhes la rtse gcig tu gzhol bas nges 'byung dang snying rje chen po rtsol med du 'khrungs/ bla ma 68

gangasacan bod yuladu byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamadorda bsdus/dang lhag pa'i lha dbyer med du gzigs nas bcos min gyi mos gus mnga' ba sogs nang du yang dag pa'i yon tan brnyes/ nyams len dang phyag len phra rags thams cad mkhan chen bla ma'i phyag bzhes ji lta ba 'khrul med du skyong /gzhan yang yongs 'dzin du ma las zab rgyas kyi gdams pa mtha' klas pa gsan/ dus rgyun du'ang cis kyang dgos med thugs la mnga' zhing chos brgyad kyi snang ba thams cad rmi lam lta bur gzigs/ chos dang 'jig rten gang gi thad nas kyang chags sdang phyogs lhung gi rtog pa gtan nas mi mnga' ba 'di kho na'ang ngo mtshar bsam gyis mi khyab/ rdo rje 'chang nam mkha' 'chi med kyisaye shes gzigs pa dam pas lung bstan pa bzhin kun mkhyen gnyis pa bzang po'i chos kyi khrir lo bdun du bzhugs nas chos dang zang zing gi dga' ston spel/ 'dus sde'i sgrig lam kun spyod sogs kyang dam pa gong ma'i dus ltar gong 'phel du gnang bas ngor e waṃ par phyi mtha'i bar du bka' drin chen pos khyab par mdzad/ de nas lam zab mo'i sgrub pa la gzhol ba'i thugs 'dun thun mong ma yin pa mnga' na'ang / bstan pa'i sbyin bdag sde dge chos rgyal chen po dam tshig rdo rje mched zhal gyisaspyan drangs te lhun grub steng gi chos grwar phebs/ mchog dman thams cad kyi gus pas mchod cing so sor bsdu ba'i dngos po rnam bzhi'i sgo nas 'brel tshad phan bder sbyor ba'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang 'tsho zhing gzhes pa ste/ slar yang rgyal ba gnyis pa ma pham pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsis 'dzam gling snang bar mdzad pa'i bar du sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du brtan cing / phrin las kyi 'jug pa zla bas reg pa'i chu gter bzhin du rgyas 69

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/dang lhag pa'i lha dbyer med du gzigs nas bcos min gyi mo gus mang 'ab sogs nang du yang dag pa'i yon tan brnyes/ nyams len dang phyag len phra rags thams cad mkhan chen bla ma'i phyag bzhes ji lta ba 'khrul med du skyong /gzhan yang yongs 'dzin du ma las zab rgyas kyi gdams pa mtha' klas pa gsan/ dus rgyun du'ang cis kyang dgos med thugs la mnga' zhing chos brgyad kyi snang ba thams cad rmi lam lta bur gzigs/ chos dang 'jig rten gang gi thad nas kyang chags sdang phyogs lhung gi rtog pa gtan nas mi mnga' ba 'di kho na'ang ngo mtshar bsam gyis mi khyab/ rdo rje 'chang nam mkha' 'chi med kyis ye shes gzigs pa dam pas lung bstan pa bzhin kun mkhyen gnyis pa bzang po'i chos kyi khrir lo bdun du bzhugs nas chos dang zang zing gi dga' ston spel/ 'dus sde'i sgrig lam kun spyod sogs kyang dam pa gong ma'i dus ltar gong 'phel du gnang bas ngor e waṃ par phyi mtha'i bar du bka' drin chen pos khyab par mdzad/ de nas lam zab mo'i sgrub pa la gzhol ba'i thugs 'dun thun mong ma yin pa mnga' na'ang / bstan pa'i sbyin bdag sde dge chos rgyal chen po dam tshig rdo rje mched zhal sa spyan drangs te lhun grub steng gi chos grwar phebs/ mchog dman thams cad kyi gus pas mchod cing so sor bsdu ba'i dngos po rnam bzhi'i sgo nas 'brel tshad phan bder sbyor ba'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang 'tsho zhing gzhes pa ste/ slar yang rgyal ba gnyis pa ma pham pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsis 'dzam gling snang bar mdzad pa'i bar du sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du brtan cing / phrin las kyi 'jug pa zla bas reg pa'i chu gter bzhin du rgyas 69

ba r+sā 'od palas/ saskya'i motholcing khesabasdus/ ()par gsol ba 'debasan de de bzhin du 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/de ltar chos grwa chen po lhun grub steng gis gtsos mdo khams sde dge'i mnga' khul du gtso bor ngor e waṃ pa'i ring lugs 'dzin pa 'dus sde che phra mang du mchis kyang phal cher khri chen sangs rgyas bstan pa dang / bstan pa tshe ring sogs kyi dus nyamasagaso gnang ba tsam las/ dang por sus btab zhib par ma nges/ gzhan yang sga stod du skye rgu don grub gling sogs chosasde che phra du ma dang / a mdo lnga pa'i nang gdu bu chos rje'am a li chos rjer gragasapa'i gdan sa / sngags dang ma nyid zung 'brel gyi grwa tshang che bsamatshon/ stod mnga' ris nas bzung ste/ smad ñcā na'i yul gru la thug gi bar du chos sde che phra mang du mchis pa so sor smos kyis mi lang ba nyid do/ /der ma zad gangs ri'i phreng bas bskor ba'i ljongs 'dir grub pa'i mtha' mi 'dra ba du ma zhig mchis kyang / de dag phal cher dngosadang brgyud pa'i sgo nas rje btsun sa skya pa'i ring lugs las byung ba dang gus pa can sha stag yin te / gsang sngags rnying mar gragasapa'i so zur gnubasagasum gyi gdung rigs dang / sprul pa'i gter ston gu ru chosakyi dbang phyug sogs bka' gter gyi skyesachen du ma dang/ bka' gdamasabya yul ba/ do ko ba/ nam mkha' 'bum/mchims nam mkha' grags/ bcom ldan rig pa'i ral gri sogs chen por rlom pa du mas kyang chos rje khu dbon gyi gsung gi bdud rtsi blangs/ bsil ljongs thub pa'i rgyal tshab rngog lo chen po'i brgyud 'dzin rig pa'i dbang phyug phywa pa chen po dang / nyang bran pa chos kyi seṅge sogs kyis sa chen gyi dngos slob skyur a seng 70

ba chen 'od pal/ sa skya'i chosang gces bsdus/ ()par gsol ba 'debs na de de bzhin du 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/de ltar chos grwa chen po lhun grub steng gis gtsos mdo khams sde dge'i mnga' khul du gtso bor ngor e waṃ pa'i ring lugs 'dzin pa 'dus sde che phra mang du mchis kyang phal cher khri chen sangs rgyas bstan pa dang / bstan pa tshe ring sogs kyi dus nyams gso gnang ba tsam las/ dang por sus btab zhib par ma nges/ gzhan yang sga stod du skye rgu don grub gling sogs chos sde che phra du ma dang / a mdo lnga pa'i nang gdu bu chos rje'am a li chos rjer grags pa'i gdan sa / sngags dang mtshan nyid zung 'brel gyi grwa tshang che bas mtsho ni/ stod mnga' ris nas bzung ste/ smad ca na'i yul gru la thug gi bar du chos sde che phra mang du mchis pa so sor smos kyis mi lang ba nyid do/ /der ma zad gangs ri'i phreng bas bskor ba'i ljongs 'dir grub pa'i mtha' mi 'dra ba du ma zhig mchis kyang / de dag phal cher dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas rje btsun sa skya pa'i ring lugs las byung ba dang gus pa can sha stag yin te / gsang sngags rnying mar grags pa'i so zur gnubs gsum gyi gdung rigs dang / sprul pa'i gter ston gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug sogs bka' gter gyi skyes chen du ma dang/ bka' gdams bya yul ba/ do ko ba/ nam mkha' 'bum/mchims nam mkha' grags/ bcom ldan rig pa'i ral gri sogs chen por rlom pa du mas kyang chos rje khu dbon gyi gsung gi bdud rtsi blangs/ bsil ljongs thub pa'i rgyal tshab rngog lo chen po'i brgyud 'dzin rig pa'i dbang phyug phywa pa chen po dang / nyang bran pa chos kyi seṅge sogs kyis sa chen gyi dngos slob skyur a seng 70

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasogasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/las zab don gyi smin grol gsan/ bka' brgyud stong gi chu mgo lta bu dpal phag mo gru pa ni sa chen gyi zhabs pad lo bcu gnyisasu bsnyen/ lam 'brasakyi gzhung bshad mdzad/ phyis rje btsun grags pa la'ang gsung gi bdud rtsi gsol te nyamasartogs kyi pad+mo rgyas pa nyid/ dwags po rin po ches bogs 'don par mdzad pas brgyud 'dzin gyi slob ma grags pa can yin zhing / 'di las 'bri stag khro gling 'brug pa sogs bka' brgyud phal mo che byung / dam tshang bka' brgyud kyi thog ma game pa dus gsum mkhyen pas sa chen gyi dngos slob dpal rgya lo / khams pa a seng / gshen rdor seng rnamasalasalam 'brasasogasagasan/shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi grub chen rmog cog pas khams pa a seng dang /gnyen ston sbas pa'i rnam 'byor gyis rje btsun grags pa'i zhabs pad yun ring du bsten nas lam 'bras sogs zab don blangs/ kun mkhyen bu ston rin po ches sa skya pa nas brgyud pa'i sngags dang mtshan nyid phal cher gsan nas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum rtsal du bton/ rje btsun grags pas ye shes kyi skus rjes su bzung / jo nang pa kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer ni sa paṇa gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma yin zhing / dol bu pa shes rab rgyal mtshan yang sa skyar mtshan nyid kyi phyogs la sbyangs shing / sku tshe'i smad la sa skya paṇ+ḍitas byin gyis brlabasapas thal 'gyur ba'i lta ba thugs la 'khrungs zhes kyang gtam du grags/ shong ston lo tsā ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan nas bzung ste bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi bar du byon pa rnams saskya pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du gtogs shing / phyogs las rnam rgyale gyis grub mtha' sa skya par zhal gyis 'ches tshul rnam thar na gsal/71

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/las zab don gyi smin grol gsan/ bka' brgyud stong gi chu mgo lta bu dpal phag mo gru pa ni sa chen gyi zhabs pad lo bcu gnyis su bsnyen/ lam 'bras gzhung bshad mdzad/ phyis rje btsun grags pa la'ang gsung gi bdud rtsi gsol te nyams rtogs kyi pad+mo rgyas pa nyid/ dwags po rin po ches bogs 'don par mdzad pas brgyud 'dzin gyi slob ma grags pa can yin zhing / 'di las 'bri stag khro gling 'brug pa sogs bka' brgyud phal mo che byung / dam tshang bka' brgyud kyi thog ma ga me pa dus gsum mkhyen pas sa chen gyi dngos slob dpal rgya lo / khams pa a seng / gshen rdor seng rnams las lam 'bras sogs gsan/shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi grub chen rmog cog pas khams pa a seng dang /gnyen ston sbas pa'i rnam 'byor gyis rje btsun grags pa'i zhabs pad yun ring du bsten nas lam 'bras sogs zab don blangs/ kun mkhyen bu ston rin po ches sa skya pa nas brgyud pa'i sngags dang mtshan nyid phal cher gsan nas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum rtsal du brtan/ rje btsun grags pas ye shes kyi skus rjes su bzung / jo nang pa kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer ni sa paṇa gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma yin zhing / dol bu pa shes rab rgyal mtshan yang sa skyar mtshan nyid kyi phyogs la sbyangs shing / sku tshe'i smad la sa skya paṇ+ḍita sa byin gyis brlabs pas thal 'gyur ba'i lta ba thugs la 'khrungs zhes kyang gtam du grags/ shong ston lo tsā ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan nas bzung ste bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi bar du byon pa rnams sa skya pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du gtogs shing / phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis grub mtha' sa skya par zhal gyis 'ches tshul rnam thar na gsal/71

ba tshe tshe na 'od thal/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()rgyal sras thogs med pas kyang chos rje bla ma dam pa sogs las sa lugs kyi gdams pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsan/ deng dus nyi zla ltar ri bo dge ldan pa'ang / sa skya'i las chen red mda' ba gzhon nu blo gros kyi slob ma rab 'byams smra ba bdun gyi nang tshan/ sras kyi mchog gyur blo bzang grags pa dang /rtsod pa'i mchog gyur dar ma rin chen dang zhes gsungs pa'i yab sras 'di gnyis byung ba yin zhing / gzhan yang rje rin po ches bla ma dam pa dang / sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen sogs las zab chos mang du gsan/ mtshan nyid sa lugs dang / sngags bu lugs gtso bor ston pa'i tshul 'jam mgon bla ma rang nyid kyi rnam thar las kyang 'byung bas mtsho ni/ ji skad du/ 'dzam gling thub pa'i rgyal tshab sa skya pa'i/ /chos kyi brgyud pa 'dzin pa'i slob ma sa /ma gyur gangasari'i khrod 'dir bstan 'dzin du/ /zhal gyis 'ches pa'i mkhas pa 'ga' yod min/ /zhes ched du brjod pa'ang don gyi snying pos lci ba nyid do/ /de lta bu'i dpal sa skya pa'i bstan pa la bka' drin mchog tu che ba ni/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po'i dus su gsang sngags phyi 'gyur gyi bstan pa'i dbu brnyes/ dpal brtse ba chen pos srol btod/ rje btsun sku mched kyis dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/chos rje khu dbon gyi sku ring la gangs can thams cad sa skya pa'i chos srid kyi gdugs dkar po'i grib mar dbang du bsdus te shin tu dar bar mdzad pa las/bshad pa'i rgyun thams cad shar nub gung gsum/ sgrub pa'i rgyun tshogs nyan zhang gsum sogs kyis bzung chos rje bla ma dam pa la bshad sgrub thams cad kyi bka' babs/ de rjes mdo la mkhas pa g.yag phrug sangs rgyas dpal dang /72

'tshechena'od thalas/ saskya'i 4ོ5'gung gcesabasdus/ ()rgyal sras thogabashamed pasakyang chos rje bla ma dam pa sogasalas sa lugs kyi gdams pa bsam gyisami khyab pa gsan/ deng dus nyi zla ltar ri bo dge ldan pa'ang / sa skya'i lasachen red mda' ba gzhon nu blo gros kyi slob ma rab 'byams smra ba bdun gyi nang tshan/ sras kyi mchog gyur blo bzang grags pa dang /rtsod pa'i mchog gyur dar ma rin chen dang zhes gsungs pa'i yab sras 'di gnyis byung ba yin zhing / gzhan yang rje rin po ches bla ma dam pa dang / sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen sogs las zab chos mang du gsan/ mtshan nyid sa lugs dang / sngagasabu lugs gtso bor ston pa'i tshul 'jam mgon bla ma rang nyid kyi rnam thar lasakyang 'byung bsamatshon/ ji skad du/ 'dzam gling thub pa'i rgyal tshab saskya pa'i/ /chosakyi brgyud pa 'dzin pa'i slob ma sa /ma gyur gangasari'i khrod 'dir bstan 'dzin du/ /zhal gyis 'chesapa'i mkhas pa 'ga' yod min/ /zhes ched du brjod pa'ang don gyi snying pos lci ba nyid do/ /de lta bu'i dpal sa skya pa'i bstan pa la bka' drin mchog tu che ba ni/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po'i dus su gsang sngags phyi 'gyur gyi bstan pa'i dbu brnyes/ dpal brtse ba chen pos srol btod/ rje btsun sku mched kyis dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/chos rje khu dbon gyi sku ring la gangs can thams cad sa skya pa'i chos srid kyi gdugs dkar po'i grib mar dbang du bsdus te shin tu dar bar mdzad pa las/bshad pa'i rgyun thams cad shar nub gung gsum/ sgrub pa'i rgyun tshogs nyan zhang gsum sogs kyis bzung chos rje bla ma dam pa la bshad sgrub thams cad kyi bka' babs/ de rjes mdo la mkhas pa g.yag phrug sangs rgyas dpal dang /72

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/kun mkhyen rong ston shesabya kun rig ste/ g.yag rong rnam gnyis sam/ red mda' ba gzhon nu blo gros te g.yag gzhon rnam gnyis/ sngags la mkhasapa ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po dang / rdzong pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan ste kun dga' rnam gnyis/ gnyis ka la mkhas pa kun mkhyen go bo rab 'byams pa bsod nams seṅge dang / gser mdog paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan te go shāka rnam gnyis zhes rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin gangs can mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan drug byon nas bshad sgrub kyi dga' ston phyogs brgyar spel/gzhan yang nya dbon kun dga' dpal dang / mkhan chen brtson 'grusadapal te mkhas pa nya brtson rnam gnyis/ semasadapa' chen po gzhon nu rgyal mchogabyams chen rab 'byamasapa sangs rgyas 'phel/ smar khams grags pa bzang po/kun mkhyen nam mkha' bsod nams/ rong ston don yod dpal/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' chos bzang / mus rab 'byams pa byams pa thugs rje dpal bzang / 'bum rab 'byams pa byams pa chos kyi don grub/ gzhung brgya pa dngos grub dpal 'bar/ mnga' ris pa lha dbang blo gros/ stag phyag pa kun dga' dpal 'byor/ shel grogs khrong )paṇa chen blo gros chos kyi rgyal po/ gzi bka' bcu pa shākya blo gros/ mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ ngag dbang bstan pa'i rdo rje sogs bgrang gis mi lang ba zhig byon nas/ pod chen drug gtsor bo gyur pa'i dpal sa skya pa'i mtshan nyid kyi bka' srol la 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis gtan la phab cing / bshad rgyun 'khrul med du 'dzin pa'i chos grwa chen po mang du btab/ khyad par sngags phyogs 73

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/kun mkhyen rong ston shes bya kun rig ste/ g.yag rong rnam gnyis sam/ red mda' ba gzhen nu blo gros te g.yag gzhen rnam gnyis/ sngags la mkhas pa ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po dang / rdzong pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan ste kun dga' rnam gnyis/ gnyis ka la mkhas pa kun mkhyen go bo rab 'byams pa bsod nams seṅge dang / gser mdog paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan te go shāka rnam gnyis zhes rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin gangs can mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan drug byon nas bshad sgrub kyi dga' ston phyogs brgyar spel/gzhan yang nya dbon kun dga' dpal dang / mkhan chen brtson sa dpal te mkhas pa nya brtson rnam gnyis/ sems dpa' chen po gzhen nu rgyal mchogabyams chen rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas 'phel/ smar khams grags pa bzang po/kun mkhyen nam mkha' bsod nams/ rong ston don yod dpal/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' chos bzang / mus rab 'byams pa byams pa thugs rje dpal bzang / 'bum rab 'byams pa byams pa chos kyi don grub/ gzhung brgya pa dngos grub dpal 'bar/ mnga' ris pa lha dbang blo gros/ stag phyag pre kun dga' dpal 'byor/ shel grogs khrong )paṇa chen blo gros chos kyi rgyal po/ gzi bka' bcu pa shākya blo gros/ mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ ngag dbang bstan pa'i rdo rje sogs bgrang gis mi lang ba zhig byon nas/ pod chen drug gtsor bo gyur pa'i dpal sa skya pa'i mtshan nyid kyi bka' srol la 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis gtan la phab cing / bshad rgyun 'khrul med du 'dzin pa'i chos grwa chen po mang du btab/ khyad par sngags phyogs 73
