'tshe tshen 'od pal / 4skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ ()la / dpal sa skya pa'i gdan sa gong 'og tu/ theg chen chos rje kun dga' bkrashis/ rgya gar ba shes rab rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ sa lo kun dga' bsod nams/ sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen nas/ ngag gi dbang po kun dga' blo gros yab sras brgyud 'dzin dang bcas pa dang / rtse gdong khri chen bsod nams lhun grub rnams bka' drin che zhing / spyir yang thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis/ mi shes gdol pa'i phru gu phongs pa yi/ /'khor gyis btags la 'jig rten 'dren pa zhes/ /smig rgyur 'bab chur sgrogs pa'i grags stong sgras/ /'jig rten yam yor byed dang 'di mi mtshungs/ /zhes pa ltar gdung brgyud rin po che 'di rnams mkhyen rab dang /mthu stobs sogs skyes thob kyi yon tan kho na'ang gzhan sprul pa'am/ gdung brgyud ches chen por rlom pa rnams kyis kyang cha tsam bskrun du med pa ni deng sang gi bar du mngon sum tshad mas grub/ bye brag tu ngor chen rdo rje 'am pa chen po'i bka' srol 'dzin pa la/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / sgrub khang pa mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ 'jam mgon sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ zhu chen ma hā paṇ+ḍita tshul khrims rin chen rnams ni 'gran zla dang bral ba'i mkhas grub yin zhing gzhan yang mkhan chen bkra shis lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong / rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan sogs mkhyen rab dang phrin las rgya che ba'ang mang du byon/ rdzong pa'i bka' srol la/ mus sras pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang / kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa 74

'tshe 'od palas/ 4skya'i chosa'agrang gcesabasdus/ ()la / dpal saskya pa'i gdan sa gong 'og tu/ theg chen chosarje kun dga' bkrashis/ rgya gar ba shesarab rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen blo grosargyal mtshan/ salo kun dga' bsod nams/ sngagasa'achang kun dga' rin chen nas/ ngag gi dbang po kun dga' blo gros yab sras brgyud 'dzin dang bcasapa dang / rtse gdong khri chen bsod nams lhun grub rnamasabaka' drin che zhing / spyir yang thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis/ mi shes gdol pa'i phru gu phongs pa yi/ /'bor gyisabatags la 'jig rten 'dren pa zhes/ /smig rgyur 'bab chur sgrogasapa'i gragasastong sgras/ /'jig rten yam yor byed dang 'di mi mtshungs/ /zhesapa ltar gdung brgyud rin po che 'di rnamasamakhyen rab dang /mthu stobasasogs skyes thob kyi yon tan kho na'ang g.yin sprul pa'am/ gdung brgyud ches chen por rlom pa rnams kyis kyang cha tsam bskrun du med pa ni deng sang gi bar du mngon sum tshad mas grub/ bye brag tu ngor chen rdo rje 'chang po'i bka' srol 'dzin pa la/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / sgrub khang pa mkhasagrub dpal ldan don grub/ 'jam mgon sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ zhu chen ma hā paṇ+ḍita tshul khrims rin chen rnams ni 'gran zla dang bral ba'i mkhas grub yin zhing gzhan yang mkhan chen bkra shis lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong / rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan sogs mkhyen rab dang phrin las rgya che ba'ang mang du byon/ rdzong pa'i bka' srol la/ mus srasapa rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang / kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa 74

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/kun dga' rnam rgyal sogs brgyud 'dzin dang bcas pas bshad sgrub mdzad/snyan brgyud rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag tshar pa chos rje'i ring lugs ni/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan sogs nas/ gnas gsar ba ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas sku gong 'og gi bar du byon pa'i slob bshad rtsa ba'i brgyud pa dang / gzhan yang mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ bod mkhar ba me tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ dgon gsar ba bsod nams chos 'phel/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ rgyal dbang lnga pa rin po che ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ grub chen sangs rgyas rgya mtsho sogs kyis spel/ chos rje tshar pa'i brgyud pa las byung ba'i nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i skor sogs snyan brgyud gser chos kyi skor rnams rmor chen nas/ 'jam dbyangs bde ba'i rdo rje/ stag phu pa blo bzang bstan rgyan/ lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje / thu'u bkwan blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma/ stag phu pa chos kyi dbang phyug sogs dang / gnab(gsar pa las zhi ba lha 'phags pa dge legs rgyal mtshan gyisagasan pas dge lugs pa'i phyogs su shin tu dar zhing yig cha'ang mang du mdzad snang ngo / /de ltar dpal sa skya pa brgyud 'dzin dang bcas pa'i rnam thar rgyas pa ni / dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i bstan pa spyi'i chos 'byung bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen 'jam mgon sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyi zhal skong dang bcas pa/ mang thos klu sgrub pa'i bstan rtsis/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi pod chen drug gi 'bel gtam rin chen mdzes pa'i phra tshom/thub bstan pa chos rnam rgyal gyi chos 'byung 'bel gtam nyung ngu me tog gsar 75

gangasacan bod yuladu byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gigadan rabasamadorabasdus/kun dga' rnam rgyal sogs brgyud 'dzin dang bcasapas bshad sgrub mdzad/snyan brgyud rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag tshar pa chos rje'i ring lugs ni/ 'jam dbyangasamakhyen brtse'i dbang phyug mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan sogs nas/ gnasagasar ba ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnasasku gong 'og gi bar du byon pa'i slob bshad rtsaba'i brgyud pa dang / gzhan yang mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ bod mkhar ba me tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ dgon gsar ba bsod namasachosa'aphel/ mkhan chen ngag dbang mosagrags/ rgyal dbang lnga pa rin po che ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ grub sangasargyas rgya mtsho sogasakyis spel/ chos rje tshar pa'i brgyud pa lasabyung ba'i nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i skor sogasasnyan brgyud gser chosakyi skor rnams me+or chen nas/ 'jam dbyangs bde ba'i rdo rje/ stag phu pa blo bzang bstan rgyan/ lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje / thu'u bkwan blo bzang mosakyi nyi ma/ stag phu pa mosakyi dbang phyug sogs dang / gnasagasar pa las zhi ba lha 'phags pa dge legs rgyal mtshan gyisagasan pas dge lugs pa'i phyogs su shin tu dar zhing yig cha'ang mang du mdzad snang ngo / /de ltar dpal sa skya pa brgyud 'dzin dang bcasapa'i rnam thar rgyas pa ni / dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i bstan pa spyi'i chos 'byung bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen 'jam mgon sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyi zhal skong dang bcasapa/ mang thos klu sgrub pa'i bstan rtsis/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi pod chen drug gi 'bel gtam rin chen mdzes pa'i phra tshom/thub bstan pa chos rnam rgyal gyi chos 'byung 'bel gtam nyung ngu me tog gsar 75

yo chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chosang gces bsdus/ ()pa'i do shal/ dkon mchog lhun grub kyi sa skya'i gdung rabs tshigs bcad dang / a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i gdung rabs chen mo ngo mtshar bye ba'i bang mdzod/ de'i kha skong kun blos mdzad pa/ sa lo chen po dang / sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen nas/ kun blo yab sras bar so so'i rnam thar rgyas pa/ rje btsun birnya pa nas mkhan chen bkra shis lhun grub yan ngor lugs gsung ngag dang gdan rabs kyi rnam thar rgyas pa pod gsum/ de phyin dpal chos/ mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan/ chos skyong bzang po sogs so so'i rnam thar/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'i ngor pa'i gdan rabs nor bu'i phreng ba dang /de'i kha skong dpal chos sogs kyis mdzad pa dkon mchog grags pa yan gyi rnam thar mdor bsdus/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang nas gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas bar gyi tshar lugs bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar pod lnga/ 'di lasazha lu mkhan chen yan 'bras spungs su par yod/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses mdzad pa'i slob bshad khog phub kha skong dang bcas pa/ 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyisamadzad pa'i lam 'bras chos 'byung chen mo rtsa 'grel/ bde mchog gsang 'dus/gshed skor/ mgon po rnams kyi chos 'byung / phur pa'i rnam bshad kyi thog ma'i lo rgyus tshar chen dang ngag dbang chos grags sogs kyis mdzad pa/ mgon po'i chos 'byung / ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i lam 'bras/ bde mchogagashed skor sogs kyi lo rgyus/ dmar po skor gsum gyi lo rgyus so so'i glegs bam las 'byung ba/ thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi mas mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus sogs las shes par bya zhing / de lta bu'i bstan 'dzin gyi 76

'tshe' 'od snangalas/ saskya'i chosayang rnyasabasdus/ ()pa'i do shal/ dkon mchog lhun grub kyi sa skya'i gdung rabs tshigs bcad dang / a mes zhabasakyis mdzad pa'i gdung rabs chen mo ngo mtshar bye ba'i bang mdzod/ de'i kha skong kun blosamadzad pa/ salo po dang / sngagasa'achang kun dga' rin chen nas/ kun blo yab sras bar so so'i rnam thar rgyasapa/ rje btsun birnya pa nas mkhan chen bkra shis lhun grub yan ngor lugs gsung ngag dang gdan rabasakyi rnam thar rgyasapa pod gsum/ de phyin dpal chos/ mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan/ chos skyong bzang po sogs so so'i rnam thar/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'i ngor pa'i gdan rabs nor bu'i phreng ba dang /de'i kha skong dpal chos sogs kyis mdzad pa dkon mchog grags pa yan gyi rnam thar mdor bsdus/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang nas gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas bar gyi tshar lugs bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar pod lnga/ 'di lasazha lu mkhan r+ṣa yan 'bras spungasasu par yod/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses mdzad pa'i slob bshad khog phub kha skong dang bcas pa/ 'jam mgon a mesazhabs kyisamadzad pa'i lam 'bras chos 'byung chen mo rtsa 'grel/ bde mchog gsang 'dus/gshed skor/ mgon po rnams kyi chos 'byung / phur pa'i rnam bshad kyi thog ma'i lo rgyus tshar chen dang ngag dbang chos grags sogs kyis mdzad pa/ mgon po'i chos 'byung / ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i lam 'bras/ bde mchogagashed skor sogs kyi lo rgyus/ dmar po skor gsum gyi lo rgyus so so'i glegs bam las 'byung ba/ thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi mas mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus sogs las shes par bya zhing / de lta bu'i bstan 'dzin gyi 76

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/skyes bu dam pa tshad ldan rnams kyi don gyi rnam thar kyang mdor bsdu na/ rje btsun sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen pos/ thog mar shesabya kun la mkhas par bya/ /bar du mkhas pa'i tshogs su legs par bshad/ /tha ma 'dris pa'i don la brtson pas bsgom/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi bzhed gzhung yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/gzhi tshul khrims rnam par dag pas bzung te/ paṇ+ḍita dang lo tsā chen po rnams kyis bsgyur zhing gtan la phab/ mkhas grub rnams kyis bshad cing nyamasasu blangs pas blo gros dang ldan pa thams cad la tshad mar grags shing grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs rgya mtsho lta bu la mang du thos pa'i mthar son par byas/ de dag gi tshig gi sdeb sbyor/ don gyi dgongasa'agrel/ cho ga'i phyag len phra mo tshun chad la'ang dngos dang btags pa/ dgongs gzhi dang dgos pa/ rang gzhan gyi grub mtha'i khyad par sogs bsam byung gi rig pas sgro ciradogs zhib mor bcad/ gzhan la 'chad pa dang / bstan bcos rtsom pa sogs gang gi tshe'ang lung dang rigs pas grub cing / bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag las ji ltar 'byung ba 'khrul med du skyong ba las gzhan gzhung gi zer sgros dang / rang babo'i dri ma phra mo tsam gyi bsre bslad kyang mi mdzad/ zab mo'i lam spyi dang / khyad par khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po dang grub chen birlu pa nas rgya bod kyi mkhas grub zam ma chad par brgyud cing / mi bar du khyi ma zhugs/ mkha' 'gro'i zhal rlangasam yal ba'i gsung ngag rin po che snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan thugs nyams su bzhes te/ dang po rgyu dus kyi dbang gisasmin par byas/ bar du lam dus kyi dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa thun bzhir blangs pas gsos te rim pa gnyis kyi lam 77

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/skyes bu dam pa tshad ldan rnams kyi don gyi rnam thar kyang mdor bsdu na/ rje btsun sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen pos/ thog mar shes bya kun la mkhas par bya/ /bar du mkhas pa'i tshogs su legs par bshad/ /tha ma 'dris pa'i don la brtson pas bsgom/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi bzhed gzhud yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/gzhi tshul khrims rnam par dag pas bzung te/ paṇ+ḍita dang lo tsā chen po rnams kyis bsgyur zhing gtan la phab/ mkhas grub rnams kyis bshad cing nyams su blangs pas blo gros dang ldan pa thams cad la tshad mar grags shing grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs rgya mtsho lta bu la mang du thos pa'i mthar son par byas/ de dag gi tshig gi sdeb sbyor/ don gyi dgongs 'grel/ cho ga'i phyag len phra mo tshun chad la'ang dngos dang btags pa/ dgongs gzhi dang dgos pa/ rang gzhan gyi grub mtha'i khyad par sogs bsam byung gi rig pas sgro re dogs zhib mor bcad/ gzhan la 'chad pa dang / bstan bcos rtsom pa sogs gang gi tshe'ang lung dang rigs pas grub cing / bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag las ji ltar 'byung ba 'khrul med du skyong ba las gzhan gzhung gi zer sgros dang / rang bzo'i dri ma phra mo tsam gyi bsre bslad kyang mi mdzad/ zab mo'i lam spyi dang / khyad par khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po dang grub chen birlu pa nas rgya bod kyi mkhas grub zam ma chad par brgyud cing / mi bar du khyi ma zhugs/ mkha' 'gro'i zhal rlangasam yal ba'i gsung ngag rin po che snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan thugs nyams su bzhes te/ dang po rgyu dus kyi dbang gis smin par byas/ bar du lam dus kyi dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa thun bzhir blangs pas gsos te rim pa gnyis kyi lam 77

ba chen 'od snangal / saskya'i chosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()bzhi la goms pas/ mthar 'bras bu'i dus kyi dbang gisatshe 'di'am bar do sogs su nges par phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub la gshegs pa'i lam gzhan las chesakhyad par du 'phags pa dang / gzhan yang mchog sgrub pasathun mong zhan la 'byung ba dang / thun mong sgrub pas mchog zhar la 'byung ba'i zab rgyas kyi gdams pa lag tu lon nges pa du mas rang gzhan thams cad la gnasaskabs dang mthar thug gi dngos grub rnam gnyis la bde blag tu sbyor bar mdzad pa yin la/ gzhan yang rang gi grub mtha' ma 'khrul bar skyong ba lasagazhan lugs kyi rjes su mi 'brang yang / de dag lung rigasakyi dpyad pa re tsam ma gtogs rgyu mtshan med pa'i sdang zhen gyis smod pa sogs grub mtha'i chags sdang mi mdzad/ nang du nyamasartogasadang / mngon par shes pa sogasargya che ba mnga' yang sbasapa'i ngang tshul lta bur mdzad de/ dpal gsang ba 'dusapa las/ phyi ru nyan thos spyod pa skyong / /nang du 'dus pa'i don la dga'/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phyag len du btab pas/ mdo sngagasarig gnasadang bcasapa'i gzhung lugs rab 'byams rgya bod kyi shing rta chen po rnams kyi bzhed srol ji lta ba bzhin du smra ba'i paṇ+ḍita dang / rgyud sde nasagasungasapa'i lam zhabrul med bsgomasapas phyag rgya chen po'i ye shesadang sa lam gyi yon tan mtshan nyid rgyud la skyes pa'i grub thob rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig byon pa yin no/ /de dag gis bshad sgrub mdzad pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs deng sang rgyun bzhugs pa'ang / bstan pa rin po che'i sgor zhugasapa dang / zhugasapa'i rten de 78

ba chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()bzhi la goms pas/ mthar 'bras bu'i dus kyi dbang gis tshe 'di'am bar do sogs su nges par phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub la gshegs pa'i lam gzhan las tshes khyad par du 'phags pa dang / gzhan yang mchog sgrub pas thun mong zhan la 'byung ba dang / thun mong sgrub pas mchog zhan la 'byung ba'i zab rgyas kyi gdams pa lag tu lon nges pa du mas rang gzhan thams cad la gnasaskabs dang mthar thug gi dngos grub rnam gnyis la bde blag tu sbyor bar mdzad pa yin la/ gzhan yang rang gi grub mtha' ma 'byul bar skyong ba las gzhan lugs kyi rjes su mi 'brang yang / de dag lung rigs kyi dpyad pa re tsam ma gtogs rgyu mtshan med pa'i sdang zhen gyis smod pa sogs grub mtha'i chags sdang mi mdzad/ nang du nyams rtogs dang / mngon par shes pa sogs rgya che ba mnga' yang sbas pa'i ngang tshul lta bur mdzad de/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las/ phyi ru nyan thos spyod pa skyong / /nang du 'dus pa'i don la dga'/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phyag len du btab pas/ mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs rab 'byams rgya bod kyi shing rta chen po rnams kyi bzhed srol ji lta ba bzhin du smra ba'i paṇ+ḍita dang / rgyud sde nas gsungs pa'i lam 'khrul med bsgoms pas phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes dang sa lam gyi yon tan mtshan nyid rgyud la skyes pa'i grub thob rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig byon pa yin no/ /de dag gis bshad sgrub mdzad pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs deng sang rgyun bzhugs pa'ang / bstan pa rin po che'i sgor zhugs pa dang / 'i zhugs pa rten de 78

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying shigadan rabasamador bsdus/dang thosabasam bya ba'i yul gnyis/ dang po ni/ sosothar pa'i sdom rgyun/ paṇa chen shākya shrī nasa'ajam dbyangasasapaṇa saskya lha khang mo'i sdom rgyun/ sogasanasabargyud pa dang / mkhan chen rdo rje dpal sogasanasathams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' bzang po yab srasalasabargyud pa'i sdom rgyun ngor pa'i sdoms/ phyag len dang bcasarnam par dag pa/ gnyisapa la/ rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang /'brasabu gsang sngagasardo rje theg pa gnyisalas/ dang po ni/ lasadang po pa 'jug pa'i sgo bsdus tshad kyis rig pa'i lam phye nas/ tshad ma rnam 'grel dang /rigs gter sogasatshad ma'i gzhung dang / 'dul ba mdo rtsa/ mngon pa mdzod/phar phyin mngon rtogasargyan/ dbu ma 'jug pa/ mdo sngagasaspyi'i gzhung sdom gsum ste pod chen drug gi bshad srol phul du byung ba sa skya thub bstan lha khang chen mo/ rta nag rnam rgyal/ skyed tshal gong 'og thub bstan ra ba smad/ rnam rab dwagasapo grwa tshang / a mdo gdu bu dgon sogasasu rgya cher dar zhing / des mtshon pa'i gzhung mang po'i lung sems bskyed lugasaganyis/ blo sbyong chen pa bzhi bral dang / don bdun ma sogasanyamasalen gyi skor rnamasaso/ /gnyisapa la spyir rgyud sde bzhi'i skor dang / bye brag tu slob bshad gser chos kyi skor dang /rjes 'brel bla ma'i gsung 'bum rnams las/ dang po la'ang spyi bka' dang /zur bka' gnyisalas/ dang po ni/ rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang / sgrub thabasabargya rtsa/rgya mtsho/ snar thang brgya rtsasogasakyi rjes gnang dang / gnyisapa la/ thog mar bya ba spyi'i rgyud la rigs gsum spyi'i dbang bskur ba/ so so'i rgyud la/ de bzhin gshegasapa'i rigasakyi gtso bo thub dbang gnas brtan bcu drug 'od 79

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/dang thos bsam bya ba'i yul gnyis/ dang po ni/ so so thar pa'i sdom rgyun/ paṇa chen shākya shrī nas 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa sa skya lha khang chen mo'i sdom rgyun/ sogs nasabargyud pa dang / mkhan chen rdo rje dpal sogs nas thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' bzang po yab sras las brgyud pa'i sdom rgyun ngor pa'i sdoms/ phyag len dang bcas rnam par dag pa/ gnyis pa la/ rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang /'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ las dang po pa 'jug pa'i sgo bsdus tshad kyis rig pa'i lam phye nas/ tshad ma rnam 'grel dang /rigs gter sogs tshad ma'i gzhung dang / 'dul ba mdo rtsa/ mngon pa mdzod/phar phyin mngon rtogs rgyan/ dbu ma 'jug pa/ mdo sngags spyi'i gzhung sdom gsum ste pod chen drug gi bshad srol phul du byung ba sa skya thub bstan lha khang chen mo/ rta nag rnam rgyal/ skyed tshal gong 'og thub bstan ra ba smad/ rnam rab dwags po grwa tshang / a mdo gdu bu dgon sogs su rgya cher dar zhing / des mtshon pa'i gzhung mang po'i lung sems bskyed lugs gnyis/ blo sbyong chen pa bzhi bral dang / don bdun ma sogs nyams len gyi skor rnams so/ /gnyis pa la spyir rgyud sde bzhi'i skor dang / bye brag tu slob bshad gser chos kyi skor dang /rjes 'brel bla ma'i gsung 'bum rnams las/ dang po la'ang spyi bka' dang /zur bka' gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang / sgrub thabs brgya rtsa/rgya mtsho/ snar thang brgya rtsa sogs kyi rjes gnang dang / gnyis pa la/ thog mar bya ba spyi'i rgyud la rigs gsum spyi'i dbang bskur ba/ so so'i rgyud la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gtso bo thub dbang gnas brtan bcu drug 'od 79

'tshe 'od snangalag saskya'i chosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()zer dri med/ sman bla/ klu dbang rgyal po sogasadang / rigs kyi bdag po 'jam dpal ma ti lugs/ gang blo ma/ shesarab 'khor lo/ smra seng sogasakyi skor/rigasakyi yum/ srung ba lha lnga'i dbang / 'od zer can/ gza' yum/ rigasakyi gtsug tor gdugs dkar lha nyer bdun ma dang / lha bcu bdun ma/ gtsug tor dri med sogs kyi dbang / rigs kyi khro bo mi g.yo ba dkar sngon gyi skor/pad+ma'i rigasakyi gtso bo tshe dpag med lha dgu dang / 'chi med rnga sgra/ me tri'i lugasakyi tshe dpag dkar po/ sgra mi snyan gyi rang gzungs/ rigs kyi bdag po spyan ras gzigs klu sgrub lugasalha so bdun ma'i dbang / bcu gcig 'kho dpal mo lugs/ thugs rje po skyer sgang lugs/ sa lugs thugasarje chen po dang phyag rgya po zung 'jug dang / gtso 'khor gsum pa/ don yod zhags pa lha lnga/ seṅge sgra sogs kyi rjes gnang man ngag dang bcasapa/ rigs kyi yum sgrol dkar bka' babs dgu ldan dang / 'od zer drug sbrags kyi rjesaganang zab khrid man ngag dang bcas pa/ seng ldeng nags sgrol gtso rkyang / jo lugs sgrol ma nyer gcig dang / sgrol ma bar chad kun sel/ dbang gi sgrol ma dmar mo sogasakyi rjes gnang / maṇ+ḍal bzhi pa'i man ngag lha mo shra ma ṇa'i skor/rigs kyi khro bo rta mgrin zla rgyal lugs/ grub rgyal lugs/ rigs kyi khro mo ri khrod ma ser mo'i rjes gnang man ngag dang bcas pa/ rdo rje'i rigs kyi gtso bo mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i dbang / rigasakyi bdag po phyag na rdo rje 'gro bzang lugs/ rnam 'joms ba ri lugs/ rigs kyi pho nya sme brtsegasasalugasadang /jo lugasaman ngag bcas/ rigasakyi pho nya mo/ khro mo sme brtsegasasogasaso/ /80

ba tshe chen 'od snangs ga sa skya'i chosang gces bsdus/ ()zer dri med/ sman bla/ klu dbang rgyal po sogs dang / rigs kyi bdag po 'jam dpal ma ti lugs/ gang blo ma/ shes rab 'khor lo/ smra seng sogs kyi skor/rigs kyi yum/ srung ba lha lnga'i dbang / 'od zer can/ gza' yum/ rigs kyi gtsug tor gdugs dkar lha nyer bdun ma dang / lha bcu bdun ma/ gtsug tor dri med sogs kyi dbang / rigs kyi khro bo mi g.yo ba dkar sngon gyi skor/pad+ma'i rigs kyi gtso bo tshe dpag med lha dgu dang / 'chi med rnga sgra/ me tri'i lugs kyi tshe dpag dkar po/ sgra mi snyan gyi rang gzungs/ rigs kyi bdag po spyan ras gzigs klu sgrub lugs lha so bdun ma'i dbang / bcu gcig 'kha dpal mo lugs/ thugs rje chen po skyer sgang lugs/ sa lugs thugs rje chen po dang phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug dang / gtso 'khor gsum pa/ don yod zhags pa lha lnga/ seṅge sgra sogs kyi rjes gnang man ngag dang bcas pa/ rigs kyi yum sgrol dkar bka' babs dgu ldan dang / 'od zer drug sbrags kyi rjes gnang zab khrid man ngag dang bcas pa/ seng ldeng nags sgrol gtso rkyang / jo lugs sgrol ma nyer gcig dang / sgrol ma bar chad kun sel/ dbang gi sgrol ma dmar mo sogs kyi rjes gnang / maṇ+ḍal bzhi pa'i man ngag lha mo shra ma ṇa'i skor/rigs kyi khro bo rta mgrin zla rgyal lugs/ grub rgyal lugs/ rigs kyi khro mo ri khrod ma ser mo'i rjes gnang man ngag dang bcas pa/ rdo rje'i rigs kyi gtso bo mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i dbang / rigs kyi bdag po phyag na rdo rje 'gro bzang lugs/ rnam 'joms ba ri lugs/ rigs kyi pho nya sme brtsegs sa lugs dang /jo lugs man ngag bcas/ rigs kyi pho nya mo/ khro mo sme brtsegs sogs so/ /80

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/nor can gyi rigs/ ba ri lugs kyi rdza ser nag jo lugs dkar 'brug zhen man ngag dang bcas pa/ rnam sras ser chen sogs rjes gnang rigs mi 'dra me bcu bdun 'di la rgyud sde gong 'og ci rigs par yod/dang / man ngag rab tu mang po'i lugs bcas bzhugs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa spyod rgyud la/ gshegs rigs kyi bdag po 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na lha lnga'i dbang dang / dpal gcig pa'i rjes gnang / gsum pa/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la cha mthun gyi rgyud sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis dang / kun rigaphyag rdor 'chi 'joms sogs dang / kun rig gi gzhung gzhan phan skor gsum sogs yig cha mang po'i lung / rgyud sde bzhi pa bla med kyi rgyud la gsum las dang po pha rgyud la/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ spyan ras gzigs rnams kyi dbang lung / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang zab 'khrid dang bcas pa/ dgra nag ba lcogasum ma/ 'jigs byed sa lugs dang / rwa lugs ro langs brgyad skor/ rwa lugs bcu gsum ma rnams kyi dbang / skyo lugs rwa rtse sems 'dzin dang / rwa lugs mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud kyi 'khrid/ rgyab brten lung pod bzhi/ dug dbang rma bya rgyas pa dang / 'jigs byed dpa' gcigalas gshin rigs bzhi dang bcas pa rjes gnang / de dag gi rgyab brten lung pod bzhi/ gnyis pa ma rgyud la sgo drug las/ he ru ku'i rigs kyi rgyud bde mchog dus 'khor ltar bkral ba mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang / rnal 'byor gsang mtha' ltar bkral pa lū dril nag gsum dang / bde mchog bong zhal can gyi dbang / dpyal lugs phag mo'i skor dang / phag dkar shes rab gsal byed 81

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gigadan rabasamadorabasdus/nor can gyi rigs/ ba ri lugs kyi dze+e ser nag jo lugs dkar 'brug zhon man ngag dang bcasapa/ rnam srasaser chen sogasarjesaganang rigasami 'dra me bcu bdun 'di la rgyud sde gong 'og ci rigasapar yod/dang / man ngag rab tu mang po'i lugs bcas bzhugs pa yin no/ /gnyisapa spyod rgyud la/ gshegs rigs kyi bdag po 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na lha lnga'i dbang dang / dpal gcig pa'i rjesaganang / gsum pa/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la cha mthun gyi rgyud sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis dang / kun rigaphyag rdor 'chi 'jomasasogs dang / kun rig gi gzhung gzhan phan skor gsum sogs yig cha mang po'i lung / rgyud sde bzhi pa bla med kyi rgyud la gsum las dang po pha rgyud la/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ spyan ras gzigs rnams kyi dbang lung / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang zab 'khrid dang bcas pa/ dgra nag bstogasum ma/ 'jigs byed salugasadang / rwa lugasaro langs brgyad skor/ rwa lugs bcu gsum ma rnamasakyi dbang / skyo lugs rwa rtse sems 'dzin dang / rwa lugasamakha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud kyi 'khrid/ rgyab brten lung pod bzhi/ dug dbang rma bya rgyas pa dang / 'jigasabyed dpa' gcigalas gshin rigs bzhi dang bcasapa'i rjes gnang / de dag gi rgyab brten lung pod bzhi/ gnyis pa ma rgyud la sgo drug las/ he ru ku'i rigasakyi rgyud bde mchog dus 'khor ltar bkral ba mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang / rnal 'byor gsang mtha' ltar bkral pa lū dril nag gsum dang / bde mchog bong zhal can gyi dbang / dpyal lugasaphag mo'i skor dang / phag dkar shesarab gsal byed 81

'tshechen 'od snang la / saskya'i mosa'abyung gtsespobasdus/ ()rnams kyi byin rlabs/ pad+ma gar dbang gi rigasasu gtogasapa/ ku ru kul+le lha lnga'i dbang / tshe dpag 'di rgyud sde'i rigasasu he ru da'i rigasasu gtogs/grub rgyal lugs kyi byin rlabs/ thugs rje po tshom bu lugs kyi khrid/ 'di ma rgyud du bzhed pa'ang yod/ rta mchog gi rigs bcom ldan 'dasardo rje gzhon nu'i dbang bskur man ngag dang bcas pa/ nyi sbas lugs kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang /gsum pa gnyis med kyi rgyud la/ dpal kye rdo rje man ngag lugs/ 'grel ba lugs mtsho skyes lugs/ nag po lugs sku gsum thugs snying po kye rdo rje dang bcas bka' bababa'ibazhi la dbang ka bdun/ yum bka' bdag med lha mo bco lnga / bshad rgyud rdo rje gur/ cha mthun gyi rgyud/ sam bu ṭa rnams kyi dbang / gur gyi las rgyas pa'i lha gsum zhes phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed/ sher phyin dkar mo/ 'di'i zur kayod med dpyad/ so 'brang dkar mo rnamasakyi rjesaganang /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku gsum thugs yongasardzogs kyi dbang / rgyud de nyid las gsungasapa'i las rgyasapa'i lha gsum zhes/ rdo rje shugs/ rdo rje khyung khra / sna tshogs yum rnams kyi rjes gnang sogs so/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa snyan brgyud gser chos kyi skor la/ thog mar gsung ngag rin po cher/ dpal kye rdo rje man ngag lugasakyi rgyu dbang / ani'i bzlasalung / lam dbang / yig brgya'i bzlasalung / lam zab phyi nang / bla ma rin 'byung / tshar gsum khug pa/bir srung phyi nang / bdag med ma/ lam sbasabashad/ brda don gsal ba/ brda chig brgyud thun mong dang / thun min/ sgrub pa lung sbyin/ gsang bcu'i rgyas gdab/ rnam 'joms bir lugs/ rten 'brel srung ba rnamasakyi byin rlabs/82

yo chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chosang gces bsdus/ ()rnams kyi byin rlabs/ pad+ma gar dbang gi rigs su gtags pa/ ku ru kul+le lha lnga'i dbang / tshe dpag 'di rgyud sde'i rigs su he ru da'i rigs su gtogs/grub rgyal lugs kyi byin rlabs/ thugs rje chen po tshom bu lugs kyi khrid/ 'di ma rgyud du bzhed pa'ang yod/ rta mchog gi rigs bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhen nu'i dbang bskur man ngag dang bcas pa/ nyi sbas lugs kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang /gsum pa gnyis med kyi rgyud la/ dpal kye rdo rje man ngag lugs/ 'grel ba lugs mtsho skyes lugs/ nag po lugs sku gsum thugs snying po kye rdo rje dang bcas bka' babs bzhi la dbang ka bdun/ yum bka' bdag med lha mo bco lnga / bshad rgyud rdo rje gur/ cha mthun gyi rgyud/ sam bu ṭa rnams kyi dbang / gur gyi las rgyas pa'i lha gsum zhes phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed/ sher phyin dkar mo/ 'di'i zur /yod med dpyad/ so 'brang dkar mo rnams kyi rjes gnang /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku gsum thugs yongs rdzogs kyi dbang / rgyud de nyid las gsungs pa'i las rgyas pa'i lha gsum zhes/ rdo rje shugs/ rdo rje khyung khra / sna tshogs yum rnams kyi rjes gnang sogs so/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa snyan brgyud gser chos kyi skor la/ thog mar gsung ngag rin po cher/ dpal kye rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi rgyu dbang / a spyi'i bzlas lung / lam dbang / yig brgya'i bzlas lung / lam zab phyi nang / bla ma rin 'byung / tshar gsum khug pa/bir srung phyi nang / bdag med ma/ lam sbas bshad/ brda don gsal ba/ brda chig brgyud thun mong dang / thun min/ sgrub pa lung sbyin/ gsang bcu'i rgyas gdab/ rnam 'joms bir lugs/ rten 'brel srung ba rnams kyi byin rlabs/82

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/lam 'bras lugs kyi mgon rkyang gi rjes gnang / lam 'bras tshogs bshad dang / slob bshad so so'i nyams khrid/ lus sbyong dang 'phrul 'khor gyi phyag len/ rgyab rten lung gi rim par/ tshogs slob soso'i rnam thar glegasabam du ma / lam 'bras glegs bam pod ser lam skor dang bcas pa/ pod dmar/pod nag stong ra ba'i pod sngon/ gzhung bshad srasadon ma/ tshar chen gyi rnam bshad nyi zer sogasadang / mkhyen brtse'i khrid yig sogs/ klu sgrub dang / ngag dbang chos grags/ ngag dbang brtan rdor sogs bla ma phyi ma'i gsung rab bcas rab tu mang po'i lung dang / lcags ri'i khongs las mi 'da' ba'i snyan brgyud gser chos bcu gsum zhes grags pa la mchog sgrub pas thun mong zhar la 'byung ba dmar mo skor gsum mam/ mkha' spyod skor gsum zhes grags par/ nā ro mkha' spyod ma ngor lugasadang / tshar lugs so so'i byin rlabs/bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams khrid/ chos nyid dngos bstan gyi byin rlabs/ rtsa dbu ma che ba'i 'khrid/ in+t+ra dang / mai tri+o mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs/rgyob rten lung pod gsum/ thun mang sgrub pas mchag zhan la 'byung ba dmar pa skar gsum la/ ku ru kul+le phyi ba/ngor lugasathun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rjesaganang / tshar lugs nang sgrub/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rjesaganang / ḍom+bhi lugasakyi gsang sgrub lha lnga'i byin rlabs/ lung pod gcig tshogs bdag dmar chen ngor lugasathun mong ma yin pa/ tshar lugs dmar chen phyag bcu gnyisapa thun mong ma yin pa/ dmar chen khyad par can/ jo lugasatshogs bdag dkar po chagasapa rdo rje dang / phyag bzhi pa'i rjesaganang ste lnga/ khro bo dag chol 'dod pa'i rgyal 83

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/lam 'bras lugs kyi mgon rkyang gi rjes gnang / lam 'bras tshogs bshad dang / slob bshad so so'i nyams khrid/ lus sbyong dang 'phrul 'khor gyi phyag len/ rgyab rten lung gi rim par/ tshogs slob so so'i rnam thar glegs bam du ma / lam 'bras glegs bam pod ser lam skor dang bcas pa/ pod dmar/pod nag stong ra ba'i pod sngon/ gzhung bshad sras don ma/ tshar chen gyi rnam bshad nyi zer sogs dang / mkhyen brtse'i khrid yig sogs/ klu sgrub dang / ngag dbang chos grags/ ngag dbang brtan rdor sogs bla ma phyi ma'i gsung rab bcas rab tu mang po'i lung dang / lcags ri'i khongs las mi 'da' ba'i snyan brgyud gser chos bcu gsum zhes grags pa la mchog sgrub pas thun mong zhar la 'byung ba dmar mo skor gsum mam/ mkha' spyod skor gsum zhes grags par/ nā ro mkha' spyod ma ngor lugs dang / tshar lugs so so'i byin rlabs/bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams khrid/ chos nyid dngos bstan gyi byin rlabs/ rtsa dbu ma che ba'i 'khrid/ in+t+ra dang / mai tri mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs/ rgyab rten lung pod gsum/ thun mong sgrub pas mchog zhan la 'byung ba dmar po skor gsum la/ ku ru kul+le phyi ba/ngor lugs thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang / tshar lugs nang sgrub/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang / ḍom+bhi lugs kyi gsang sgrub lha lnga'i byin rlabs/ lung pod gcig tshogs bdag dmar chen ngor lugs thun mong ma yin pa/ tshar lugs dmar chen phyag bcu gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa/ dmar chen khyad par can/ jo lugs tshogos bdag dkar po chagasapa rdo rje dang / phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang ste lnga/ khro bo dag chol 'dod pa'i rgyal 83

ba 'odasnangalas/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gcesabasdus/ ()po la ngor lugs thun mong ma yin pa 'dod pa lha'i rjes gnang dang / gsang sngags sgra'i rjesaganang gnyis/ lung pod gcig de rnams kyi phyag len dmar khrid kyi rgyun dang bcasapa/ dmar chung skor gsum mam gnyan lo'i dbang gi lha gsum du grags pa/ ku ru kul+le dpal mo gser gyi snying thag can/ nor rgyun ma dmar mo/ lha mo ti nu ma rnams kyi rjes gnang man ngag gi lung dang bcas pa/seng gdong sngon mo/ 'jam dpal nag po/ rdo rje khyung khra/ j-i dmar srog sgrub rnams kyi rjes gnang / so so'i man ngag gi lung dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang gser chosabacu gsum gyi steng / seṅge sgra'i ngag srung 'grol gyi rjes gnang lung dang bcas pa bsnan pas/ klu pa'i gser chos bcu bzhi grags shing / gser chos su gtogasapa tshe dpag med sprul sku'i rjes gnang / gnyan lo'i gser chos dze+e bha la sum bsgril gyi sgom lung / lha mo dbyu gu spun gsum gyi man ngag gi lung bcas sa/ /dpal sa skya pa yab sras rnams la bstan pa srung pa'i mtshon cha rdo rje'i chos srung rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bka' babs pa las gtso bor gyur pa ni rdo rje nag po chen po gur zhal gnyis te/ de yang gur gyi mgon po'i skor la bka' babs bzhi las/ ga ya dh+wa ra nas brgyud pa lam 'bras lugs kyi mgon rkyang dang /sgrub thabs brgya rtsa nas 'byung ba'i ba ri lugs kyi mgon rkyang gnyis kyi rjes gnang / so so'i man ngag gi lung / kha che paṇ+ḍita nas brgyud pa'i spu gri skor gsum gyi lung / shin tu zab cing rgya che ba bla ma mal las brgyud pa'i skor la/smin grol rgyab rten dang bcas pa las/ dang po la/ dbang bka' ma nub pa dang /84

ba chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()po la ngor lugs thun mong ma yin pa 'dod pa lha'i rjes gnang dang / gsang sngags sgra'i rjes gnang gnyis/ lung pod gcig de rnams kyi phyag len dmar khrid kyi rgyun dang bcas pa/ dmar chung skor gsum mam gnyan lo'i dbang gi lha gsum du grags pa/ ku ru kul+le dpal mo gser gyi snying thag can/ nor rgyun ma dmar mo/ lha mo ti nu ma rnams kyi rjes gnang man ngag gi lung dang bcas pa/seng gdong sngon mo/ 'jam dpal nag po/ rdo rje khyung khra/ rdza dmar srog sgrub rnams kyi rjes gnang / so so'i man ngag gi lung dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang gser chos bcu gsum gyi steng / seṅge sgra'i ngag srung 'grol gyi rjes gnang lung dang bcas pa bsnan pas/ klu pa'i gser chos bcu bzhi grags shing / gser chos su gtags pa tshe dpag med sprul sku'i rjes gnang / gnyan lo'i gser chos dzo bha la sum bsgril gyi sgom lung / lha mo dbyu gu spun gsum gyi man ngag gi lung bcas so/ /dpal sa skya pa yab sras rnams la bstan pa srung pa'i mtshon cha rdo rje'i chos srung rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bka' babs pa las gtso bor gyur pa ni rdo rje nag po chen po gur zhal gnyis te/ de yang gur gyi mgon po'i skor la bka' babs bzhi las/ ga ya dh+wa ra nas brgyud pa lam 'bras lugs kyi mgon rkyang dang /sgrub thabs brgya rtsa nas 'byung ba'i ba ri lugs kyi mgon rkyang gnyis kyi rjes gnang / so so'i man ngag gi lung / kha che paṇ+ḍita nas brgyud pa'i spu gri skor gsum gyi lung / shin tu zab cing rgya che ba bla ma mcho las brgyud pa'i skor la/smin grol rgyab rten dang bcas pa las/ dang po la/ dbang bka' ma nub pa dang /84

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/rjes gnang bka' ma nub pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ mgon po lha lnga/ lha brgyad/lha bcu gcig ma/ gri gug 'di g.ya dha ra nasabargyud pa yin/ lha lnga snyan brgyud lugs kyi dbang bcasalnga/ gnyis pa la/ lcam dral/ lha gsum/ lha brgyad thun mong dang / thun mong ma yin pa/ ngor lugs lha brgyad/ lha bcu gnyisathun mong dang /thun mong ma yin pa/ phyi khrid khro bcu/ gsang khrid lha dgu/ zhan byung mo rkyang du sgrub pa dud sol ma phyi sgrub dang / gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang gcer bu zangs gri can/ ber nag zangs gri can/ pu tra thun mong dang thun min/ bran bdud nag po thun mong dang / thun min rnamasaso/ /gnyis pa la/ phyi khrid/ gsang khrid/ zhan byung mgon po dkar po'i tshe khrid bcas/ gsum pa la/ glegs bam me 'bar ma / kha skong / snyan brgyud/ yang skong ste snyan brgyud 'dzin pa phyi ma'i gsung rab/yang skyo mda' bsod nams dbang phyug gis bsgrigs pa'i kha skong pod chen gnyis kyi/ ljang pod/ dud sol pod bcas so/ /zhing skyong zhal bzhi pa'i skor la / bsnyen dusathun mong / sgrub dus thun mong / thun mong ma yin pa/ gdong brnyan can/ gsang khrid sngon 'gro'i rjes gnang / dkar po tshe 'phel thun mong dang / thun mong ma yin pa/ ser po rgyas byed/ dmar po dbang bsdud/ sngon po bgegs 'joms/ nor sgrub ser po lha dgu/ gnad dbabs mgon po/ khyung zhal can/ shisabastan pa/ bram ze mngags gtad/ ye shes kyi mgon po seṅge nag po/ bram nag bshad pa drug skor/ ngor lugs bsnyen dus/ de'i bka' srung bestse lcam sring lha gsum dang / 'khor mang rnams kyi rjes gnang / zhal gyi gsang khrid tshe khrid dang bcas pa/ thun mong ba dkar chag nor bu'i do shal gyis 85

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/rjes gnang bka' ma nub pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ mgon po lha lnga/ lha brgyad/lha bcu gcig ma/ gri gug 'di g.ya dha ra nas brgyud pa yin/ lha lnga snyan brgyud sdo/gas kyi dbang bcas lnga/ gnyis pa la/ lcam dral/ lha gsum/ lha brgyad thun mong dang / thun mong ma yin pa/ ngor lugs lha brgyad/ lha bcu gnyis thun mong dang /thun mong ma yin pa/ phyi khrid khro bcu/ gsang khrid lha dgu/ zhan byung mo rkyang du sgrub pa dud sol ma phyi sgrub dang / gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang gcer bu zangs gri can/ ber nag zangs gri can/ pu tra thun mong dang thun min/ bran bdud nag po thun mong dang / thun min rnams so/ /gnyis pa la/ phyi khrid/ gsang khrid/ zhan byung mgon po dkar po'i tshe khrid bcas/ gsum pa la/ glegs bam me 'bar ma / kha skong / snyan brgyud/ yang skong ste snyan brgyud 'dzin pa phyi ma'i gsung rab/yang skyo mda' bsod nams dbang phyug gis bsgrigs pa'i kha skong pod chen gnyis kyi/ ljang pod/ dud sol pod bcas so/ /zhing skyong zhal bzhi pa'i skor la / bsnyen dus thun mong / sgrub dus thun mong / thun mong ma yin pa/ gdong brnyan can/ gsang khrid sngon 'gro'i rjes gnang / dkar po tshe 'phel thun mong dang / thun mong ma yin pa/ ser po rgyas byed/ dmar po dbang bsdud/ sngon po bgegs 'joms/ nor sgrub ser po lha dgu/ gnad dbabs mgon po/ khyung zhal can/ shis bstan pa/ bram ze mngags gtad/ ye shes kyi mgon po seṅge nag po/ bram nag bshad pa drug skor/ ngor lugs bsnyen dus/ de'i bka' srung bestse lcam sring lha gsum dang / 'khor mang rnams kyi rjes gnang / zhal gyi gsang khrid tshe khrid dang bcas pa/ thun mong ba dkar chag nor bu'i do shal gyis 85

chen 'od sna pa las/ sa skya'i chosang gces bsdus/ ()zin pa pod gcig thun mong ma yin pa chig brgyud ha la nag po ma bu pod gcig me lce'i pod gcig gzhan yang mgon dkar dmag zor ma dur khrod bdag po yab yum rnams kyi rjes gnang / so so'i man ngag gi glegs bam/gnubs lugs stag zhen/ legs ldan mched bya rgyud/ gsum sogs kyi rjes gnang bzhugs so/ /gsum pa gsung 'bum skor la/ sa ska gong ma lnga'i bka' 'bum pod bco lnga/ rgyal sras thogs med bka' 'bum thod gcig ngor chen rdo rje 'chang bka' 'bum pod bzhi/ mus chen gcig kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge'i sngags phyogs bzhi/ dkon mchog lhun grub bzhi/ dpal ldan don grub gcigazhu chen paṇ+ḍi ta bcu rnams kyi bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs dang tshar chen yab sras/paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / ngag dbang chos grags/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rmor chen kun dga' blo gros sogs kyi gsung 'bum thor bu bcas kyis mtshon mdo sngags kyi zab chos rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bzhugs shing / sa ngor tshar gsum gyi ring lugs 'dzin pa'i dgon sde rnams su'ang / bya rgyud tshe dpag lha dgu/ rnga sgra/ mi 'brugs pa/ rnam rgyal/ rnam 'joms/ sgrol dkar/ rnal 'byor rgyud kun rig 'chi 'joms rnams/ bla med pha rgyud gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa/ 'jam rdor/ ma rgyud bde mchog lha nag gnyis/ gnyis med rgyud kye rdor man ngag lugs/ gur/ sa'i ṭa ste ngor lugs dkyil 'khor bdun du grags pa dang / bdag med lha mo bco lnga/ gshin rje gshed dmar nag 'jigs gsum/ 'jigs byed bcu gsum/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ yab chos yang 86

'tshechena'od snapalas/ saskya'i chosa'abyung gtsesabasdus/ rtonazin pa pod gcig thun mong ma yin pa chig brgyud ha la nag po ma bu pod gcig belce'i pod gcig gzhan yang mgon dkar dmag zor ma dur khrod bdag po yab yum rnams kyi rjes gnang / so so'i man ngag gi glegs bam/gnubs lugs stag zhon/ legs ldan mched bya rgyud/ gsum sogs kyi rjes gnang bzhugs sa/ /gsum pa gsung 'bum skor la/ sa skya gong ma lnga'i bka' 'bum pod bco lnga/ rgyal sras thogs med bka' 'bum pod gcig ngor chen rdo rje 'chang bka' 'bum pod bzhi/ mus chen gcig kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge'i sngags phyogs bzhi/ dkon mchog lhun grub bzhi/ dpal ldan don grub gcigazhu chen paṇ+ḍi ta bcu rnams kyi bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs dang tshar chen yab sras/paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / ngag dbang chos grags/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ me+or chen kun dga' blo gros sogs kyi gsung 'bum thor bu bcas kyis mtshon mdo sngags kyi zab chos rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bzhugs shing / sa ngor tshar gsum gyi ring lugs 'dzin pa'i dgon sde rnamasasu'ang / bya rgyud tshe dpag lha dgu/ rnga sgra/ mi 'khrugs pa/ rnam rgyal/ rnam 'joms/ sgrol dkar/ rnal 'byor rgyud kun rig 'chi 'joms rnams/ bla med pha rgyud gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa/ 'jam rdor/ ma rgyud bde mchog lū nag gnyis/ gnyisamed rgyud kye rdor man ngag lugs/ gur/ sa'i ṭa ste ngor lugs dkyil 'khor bdun du grags pa dang / bdag med lha mo bco lnga/ gshin rje gshed dmar nag 'jigs gsum/ 'jigs byed bcu gsum/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ yab chos yang 86

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/phur gnyis/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo sogs kyi sgrub mchod dang / bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed dang / rdo rje nag po chen po sogs kyi gtor zlog gisamatshon te bshad sgrub kyi phrin las gong 'phel gong dkar rdo rje gdan dang / ba po shis chosasde sogs su sa lugs dang / bu lugs 'dres ma'i sgrub mchod shin tu mang bar bzhugs so/ /du bzhugs pa lags the rgo/ /sa skya pa zhes grags pa'i sgra don ni/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhal snga nas/ sa dkar po seṅge'i gdong pa 'dra/ /dpal ldan sa skya seṅge'i lus/ /'gro drug gi bsam pa 'gengs pa po/ /rje rdo rje 'chang gi bzhugasaganas yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gnas kyi ming gang zag la chags pa yin no / / dpal sa skya pa'i ring lugs la dgag pa mdzad mkhan cher ma byung mod/'on kyang mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang sogs dge lugs pa'i phyogs dang / kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che dang / bo dong pa phyogs las rnam rgyal sogs kyis kyang cung zad dgag pa gnang ba'i lan ngor chen rdo rje 'chang dang /kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge sogs kyis gsung rab las shes par bya zhing /paṇa chen shāka mchog pas sdom gsum la dogs pa dri ba bkod pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa pad+ma dkar pos kyang sdom gsum gyi thad nas dgag sgrub cung zad dang / brtag gnyis 'chad pa rnams la dri ba gnang ba sogs kyi lan kun mkhyen rin po che/ glo bo mkhan chen/ klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ ngag dbang chos grags sogs kyis rim par gnang ba dang / chos rje ngor pa la rdzong lugs pas dgag pa byas pa'i lan thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub dang / ngag dbang 87

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/phur gnyis/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo sogs kyi sgrub mchod dang / bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed dang / rdo rje nag po chen po sogs kyi gtor zlog gisamatshon te bshad sgrub kyi phrin lasagong 'phel gong dkar rdo rjegadan dang / bkrashisamothosde sogs su sa lugasadong / bu lugasa'adresama'i sgrub mchod shin tu mang bar bzhugs so/ /du bsdo/gas pa 05gas sa/ /sa skya pa zhes gragasapa'i sgra don ni/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhal snga nas/ sadakar po seṅge'i gdong pa 'dra/ /dpal ldan sa skya seṅge'i lus/ /'gro drug gi bsam pa 'gengasapa po/ /rje rdo rje 'chang gi bzhugasaganas yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gnas kyi ming gang zag la chags pa yin no / / dpal sa skya pa'i ring lugs la dgag pa mdzad mkhan cher ma byung mod/'on kyang mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang sogs dge lugs pa'i phyogs dang / kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che dang / bo dong pa phyogs las rnam rgyal sogs kyis kyang cung zad dgag pa gnang ba'i lan ngor chen rdo rje 'chang dang /kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge sogs kyis gsung rab las shes par bya zhing /paṇa chen shāka mchog pas sdom gsum la dogs pa dri ba bkod pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa pad+ma dkar pos kyang sdom gsum gyi thad nas dgag sgrub cung zad dang / brtag gnyis 'chad pa rnams la dri ba gnang ba sogs kyi lan kun mkhyen rin po che/ glo bo mkhan chen/ klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ ngag dbang chosagrags sogs kyis rim par gnang ba dang / chos rje ngor pa la rdzong lugs pas dgag pa byas pa'i lan thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub dang / ngag dbang 87

ba chen 'od snangalas/ saskya'i mosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()brtan pa'i rdo rje sogs kyis mdzad pa dang / jo nang pa sogs kyi phyogs nas gsang chen slob bshad pa'i ring lugs la zur za mdzad par/ mang thosaklu sgrub dang / mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis lan zab cing rgya che bar gnang ba rnams la blo gros kyi mig bsgrubs na log rtog gi dri ma dang bral nas slar yang rgyu mtshan shes nas mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob par 'gyur ro/ // sa skya dang dus mnyam tsam du mnyam med dwags po bka' brgyud kyi ring lugs kyang shin tu dar bar gyur te/ de la dwagasal sgam po ni/ mnga' bdag mar pa'i sgrub brgyud kyi ka chen mi la bzhad pa rdo rje'i thugs sras nyi ma lta bu dwags po rin po che bsod nams rin chen gyis dgung lo bzhi bcu rtsa grangs dus su btab/ bka' brgyud thams cad kyi 'byung khungasasu gyur/ phyis sgam tshul khrims snying po sogs dbon dang / kun mkhyen bkra shis rnam rgyal sogs skye sprul rim byon gyis skyong / ngams shad phag mo gru kun tu bzang po'i nags khrod gdan samathil/ni/ 'gro ba'i mgon po phag gru rdo rje rgyal pos dgung lo zhe dgu par btab/ re zhig 'bri stag gnyis kyis cung zad bskyang zhing / phyis lha gzigs rlangs kyi gdung las zhakhrungs pa spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas sogs lha gzigs spyan snga rim byon gyis gdan sa mdzad kyang / deng sang ni rten gsum tsam las chos brgyud cher mi bzhugs/ phag gru'i slob ma/ 'bri stag gnyis/ g.ya' shug gnyis/ smar yel gnyis/ khro gling gnyisate bka' brgyud zung bzhi ya brgyad du grags pa byung ba las/ 'bri gung mthil byang gling rdo rje'i gdan ni/ thog mar phag gru rin po che'i slob ma mi nyag sgom ring zhes pas 88

ba chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chosang gces bsdus/ ()brtan pa'i rdo rje sogs kyis mdzad pa dang / jo nang pa sogs kyi phyogs nas gsang chen slob bshad pa'i ring lugs la zur za mdzad par/ mang thos klu sgrub dang / mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis lan zab cing rgya che bar gnang ba rnams la blo gros kyi mig bsgrubs na log rtog gi dri ma dang bral nas slar yang rgyu mtshan shes nas mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob par 'gyur ro/ // sa skya dang dus mnyam tsam du mnyam med dwags po bka' brgyud kyi ring lugs kyang shin tu dar bar gyur te/ de la dwags la sgam po ni/ mnga' bdag mar pa'i sgrub brgyud kyi ka chen mi la ba 'ad pa rdo rje'i thugs sras nyi ma lta bu dwags po rin po che bsod nams rin chen gyis dgung lo bzhi bcu rtsa grangs dus su btab/ bka' brgyud thams cad kyi 'byung khungs su gyur/ phyis sgam tshul khrims snying po sogs dbon dang / kun mkhyen bkra shis rnam rgyal sogs skye sprul rim byon gyis skyong / ngams shod phag mo gru kun tu bzang po'i nags khrod gdan nas mthal/ni/ 'gro ba'i mgon po phag gru rdo rje rgyal pos dgung lo zhe dgu par btab/ re zhig 'bri stag gnyis kyis cung zad bskyang zhing / phyis lha gzigs rlangs kyi gdung las 'khrungs pa spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas sogs lha gzigs spyan snga rim byon gyis gdan sa mdzad kyang / deng sang ni rten gsum tsam las chos brgyud cher mi bzhugs/ phag gru'i slob ma/ 'bri stag gnyis/ g.ya' shug gnyis/ smar yel gnyis/ khro gling gnyis te bka' brgyud zung bzhi ya brgyad du grags pa byung ba las/ 'bri gung mthil byang gling rdo rje'i gdan ni/ thog mar phag gru rin po che'i slob ma mi nyag sgom ring zhes pas 88

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/btab/ phyis 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi rnam 'phrul skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po dgung lo so brgyad par phebs nas bzhugs/ de nas mkhan chen gu ra ba dang /dbon bsod nams grags pa sogs dbon brgyud dang / dpal chos kyi gragasapa sogs skye sprul rim byon gyis skyong / byang stag lung gi chos grwa ni/ stag lung thang pa rin po che bkra shis dpal ldan gyis dgung lo so bdun par btab/de'i dbon rin chen mgon sogs dang / phyis skye sprul rim byon gyis skyong zhing 'di gnyis deng sang dar rgyas che/ khams su ri bo che ni/ thang pa rin po che'i dbon brgyud gsum pa sangs rgyas dbon gyis btab/ grwa ra bas za ra dgon ni / skal ldan ye shes seng ges btab/ de'i slob ma rgyal ba g.ya' bzang pa sogs kyis skyong / snye phu shug gseb dgon ni/ yar klung pa gyer sgom chen posabatab cing bar skabs phrin las kyang rgyas par byung / khams su shwa dgon pa ni/chos rje smar pa shes rab ye shes kyis btab/ deng sang chos brgyud cung zad dpal yul ba la yod/ shar rdo rdzong / lho yel phug byang rta rna rnams ni 'gro mgon sangs rgyas yel pa ye shes brtsegs kyis btab/ deng sang dgon gnasatsam las chos brgyud cher med pa 'dra/ gtsang du khro phu dgon ni/ gnubs nam mkha'i snying po'i gdung rigs rin po che rgyal tsha dang / kun ldan ras chung mched gnyis kyis btab/ de'i dbon khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis paṇa chen shākya shrī ra sogs gdan drangs/ byams chen khru brgyad cu pa bzhengs pas mtsho ni phyag rjes rgya che/ brgyud par bcas pa rnams la khro phu bka' brgyud du grags/deng sang dgon gnas tsam las brgyud 'dzin zur pa med mod/ 'on kyang kun 89

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/btab/ phyis 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi rnam 'phrul skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po dgung lo so brgyad par phebs nas bzhugs/ de nas mkhan gu ra ba dang /dbon bsod nams grags pa sogs dbon brgyud dang / dpal chosakyi gragasapa sogs skye sprul rim byon gyis skyong / byang stag lung gi chosagrwa ni/ stag lung thang pa rin po che bkra shis dpal ldan gyis dgung lo so bdun par btab/de'i dbon rin chen mgon sogs dang / phyis skye sprul rim byon gyisaskyong zhing 'di gnyis deng sang dar rgyas che/ khams su ri bo che ni/ thang pa rin po che'i dbon brgyud gsum pa sangs rgyas dbon gyis btab/ grwa ra bas za ra dgon ni / skal ldan ye shesaseng ges btab/ de'i slob ma rgyal ba g.ya' bzang pa sogs kyis skyong / snye phu shug gseb dgon ni/ yar klung pa gyer sgom chen posabatab cing bar skabs phrin las kyang rgyas par byung / khams su shwa dgon pa ni/chos rje smar pa shes rab ye shes kyis btab/ deng sang chos brgyud cung zad dpal yul ba la yod/ shar rdo rdzong / lho yel phug byang rta rna rnamasani 'gro mgon sangs rgyas yel pa ye shesabartsegs kyis btab/ deng sang dgon gnasatsam lasachos brgyud cher med pa 'dra/ gtsang du khro phu dgon ni/ gnubasanam mkha'i snying po'i gdung rigs rin po che rgyal tsha dang / kun ldan ras chung mched gnyis kyis btab/ de'i dbon khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis paṇa chen shākya shrīr sogs gdan drangs/ byamasachen khru brgyad cu pa bzhengasapasamatshon phyag rjes rgya che/ brgyud par bcas pa rnams la khro phu bka' brgyud du grags/deng sang dgon gnas tsam las brgyud 'dzin zur pa med mod/ 'on kyang kun 89

bam chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chosang gces bsdus/ ()mkhyen bu ston rin po che yang / gtso bo 'di'i chos brgyud las byung ba yin no/ /dbus su sna phu chas lung dgon ni/ rdor brag dang nye bar yod/rtogs pa mthar phyin chos lung ras pa pad+ma rdo rjes btab/ deng sang dgon gnas tsam las brgyud 'dzin zur pa med na'ang / khong las don brgyud 'brug pa'i grub mtha' byung ba yin pas phrin las kyi rgyun nam mkha' dang mnyam par song ngo / /byang 'ba' rom dgon ni/ dwags po'i slob ma 'ba' ram ras pa dar ma dbang phyug gis btab/ phyis ti shrī ras pa sogs kyis dar rgyas su mdzad/ tshal gung thang ni/dwags po sgam tshul gyi slob ma skye med zhang 'gro ba'i mgon po g.yu brag pa dar ma grags kyis btab/ mnyam med shākya ye shes sogs kyis bskyangs te bar skabs su dar rgyas che bar byung / stod lung mtshur phu mdo bo lung gi gdan sa ni/dwags po'i slob ma rje dus gsum mkhyen pas dgung lo brgyad cu par btab/spyir 'di nyid kyis dgung lo nga lnga par khams rka po gnas dang / don bdun par ga me'i dgon sogs kyang btab/ gdan sar la yag pa byang chub dngos grub sogs bzhugs/ de nas dmi pa k+shi sogs sprul pa'i sku rim byon gyis bskyangs pas sgrub brgyud thams cad kyi snying po rka tshang bka' brgyud zhes yongs su grags pa 'di byung / de yang dpal ga me pa chen po ni 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo bsam bzhin du mi'i srid par bzung ste/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pa bod chen po'i sa'i thig le tre shod du 'khrungs/ dbus gtsang du byon nas 'gro mgon dwags po lha rje gtso bor gyur pa las thos bsam dang / nyams bzhes kyi bka' drin bskyangs pas grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs pa'i tshul bstan/ ye 90

ba 'od snang la / saskya'i mosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()mkhyen bu ston rin po che yang / gtso bo 'di'i chos brgyud las byung ba yin no/ /dbus su sna phu chosalung dgon ni/ rdor brag dang nye bar yod/rtogasapa mthar phyin chos lung rasapa pad+ma rdo rjes btab/ deng sang dgon gnas tsam las brgyud 'dzin zur pa med na'ang / khong las don brgyud 'brug pa'i grub mtha' byung ba yin pas phrin las kyi rgyun nam mkha' dang mnyam par song ngo / /byang 'ba' rom dgon ni/ dwags po'i slob ma 'ba' ram ras pa dar ma dbang phyug gis btab/ phyis ti shrī rasapa sogs kyisadar rgyas su mdzad/ tshal gung thang ni/dwags po sgam tshul gyi slob ma skye med zhang 'gro ba'i mgon po g.yu brag pa dar ma grags kyis btab/ mnyam med shākya ye shes sogs kyis bskyangs te bar skabasasu dar rgyas che bar byung / stod lung mtshur phu mdo bo lung gi gdan sa ni/dwags po'i slob ma rje dus gsum mkhyen pas dgung lo brgyad cu par btab/spyir 'di nyid kyis dgung lo nga lnga par khams kai po gnas dang / don bdun par kame'i dgon sogs kyang btab/ gdan sar la yag pa byang chub dngos grub sogs bzhugs/ de nas dmi pak+shi sogs sprul pa'i sku rim byon gyis bskyangs pas sgrub brgyud thams cad kyi snying po rka tshang bka' brgyud zhes yongs su grags pa 'di byung / de yang dpal rkarma pa chen po ni 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo bsam bzhin du mi'i srid par bzung ste/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pa bod chen po'i sa'i thig le tre shod du 'brungs/ dbus gtsang du byon nas 'gro mgon dwags po lha rje gtso bor gyur pa las thos bsam dang / nyams bzhes kyi bka' drin bskyangs pas grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegasapa'i tshul bstan/ ye 90

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/shes kyi ḍā gi ma rnams kyis zhwa nag po gser mdangs can cod pan du bcings pa gzigs pas/ grol ba bzhi ldan gyi dbu zhwa de lta bu bzhes pa na zhwa nag por grags pa'i āt+pal thog mar phye/ gong du smos pa'i dgon gnabashasogs btab nas don brgyud kyi bstan pa sangs rgyas ras chen la gtad/ dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa bzhi par zhi ba'i dbyings su dgyes pa'i spyan zur lhung / de'i skye sprul rim par/ gnyis pa game pak+shi ni/ mdo smad le'i tshag tor 'khrungs/ rdzu'aphrul gyi bkod pa dang phrin las mtha' klas/ don brgyud kyi bstan pa grub chen o rgyan pa rin chen dpal la gtad/ dgung lo don bzhi par gshegs/ gsum pa thams cad mkhyen pa rang byung rdo rje ni mang yul gung thang du 'khrungs/ mngal gyi dri mas cung zad kyang ma bsgrib par sngon gnas rjes su dran pas mtshon ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab/ thugs srasakyi thu bo zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa'i thog mar grags pa seṅge dang / don brgyud g.yung ston pa rdo rje dpal la gtad/ bzhi pa chos rje rol pa'i rdo rje ni/ rngod a la rong du 'khrungs/ rje btsun blo bzang grags pa'ang dam pa 'di nyid kyis chos sgor bcug par mdzad/lnga pa de bzhin gshegs pa ni nyang po 'od gsal gyi yul du 'khrungs/ rgya nag tā ming g.yung lo rgyal po sogs che rgu du mas mchod/ thugs rje dang phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab/ drug pa mthong ba don ldan ni ngom gyi sacha /me dgon dang nye bar 'khrungs/ thugs sras kyang rgyal tshab na rim gyi thog ma go shrī dpal 'byor don grub sogs byon/ bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho ni/ rngod kyi mdor zhabrungs/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi phrin las rgya cher bskyangs/ brgyad pa 91

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/shes kyi ḍa gi ma rnams kyis zhwa nag po gser mdangs can cod pan du bcings pa gzigs pas/ grol ba bzhi ldan gyi dbu zhwa de lta bu bzhes pa na zhwa nag por grags pa'i ut+pal thog mar phye/ gong du smos pa'i dgon gnas sogs btab nas don brgyud kyi bstan pa sangs rgyas ras chen la gtad/ dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa bzhi par zhi ba'i dbyings su dgyes pa'i spyan zur lhung / de'i skye sprul rim par/ gnyis pa ga me pa khri ni/ mdo smad le'i tshag tor 'brungs/ rdzu phral gyi bkod pa dang phrin las mtha' klas/ don brgyud kyi bstan pa grub chen o rgyan pa rin chen dpal la gtad/ dgung lo don bzhi par gshegs/ gsum pa thams cad mkhyen pa rang byung rdo rje ni mang yul gung thang du 'khrungs/ mngal gyi dri mas cung zad kyang ma bsgrib par sngon gnas rjes su dran pas mtshon ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab/ thugs 'a sras kya thu bo zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa'i thog mar grags pa seṅge dang / don brgyud g.yung ston pa rdo rje dpal la gtad/ bzhi pa chos rje rol pa'i rdo rje ni/ khrod a la rong du 'brungs/ rje btsun blo bzang grags pa'ang dam pa 'di nyid kyis chos sgor bcug par mdzad/lnga pa de bzhin gshegs pa ni nyang po 'od gsal gyi yul du 'khrungs/ rgya nag tā ming g.yung lo rgyal po sogs che rgu du mas mchod/ thugs rje dang phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab/ drug pa mthong ba don ldan ni ngom gyi sa cha /me dgon dang nye bar 'byungs/ thugs sras kyang rgyal tshab na rim gyi thog ma go shrī dpal 'byar don grub sogs byon/ bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho ni/ rjod kyi mdor 'khrungs/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi phrin las rgya cher bskyangs/ brgyad pa 91

ba chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chosang gces bsdus/ ()kun mkhyen mi bskyod rdo rje ni/ ngam gyi yul du 'brungs/ shes bya rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag thogs pa med par smra ba'i paṇ+ḍita chen por gyur/ bstan bcos kyang shin tu mang bar mdzad/ dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje ni/ khams yul tre smad kha ba glang ri'i zhol du 'brungs/ bcu pa chos dbyings rdo rje ni mgu log gi smar stod mgu mdar 'khrungs/ 'di dus dkar bstan la nyams chag che bar byung na'ang / rje de nyid 'jang yul sogs su phebs pas brdzi bar ma nus/ bcu gcig pa ye shes rdo rje mgu log gi yul du 'brungs/ bcu gnyis pa byang chub rdo rje ni sde dge'i mnga' khul dbon stod dkyil le zhes par 'brungs/ bcu gsum pa bdud 'dul rdo rje ni lho gnas dge ri dang nye bar 'khrungs/ bcu bzhi pa khyab bdag theg pa mchog gi rdo rje ni ri bo che'i mnga' khul 'og min ga me'i dgon dang nye bar 'khrungs/ shes bya rig pa'i gnas thams cad la mkhyen rab kyi pad+mo bye zhing / 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum sogs 'khor lo gsum gyi phrin las gong du 'phel ba'i ngang da lta zhabs pad brtan bzhin pa 'di'o/ /mdor na rje sku phreng 'di rnams sku 'khrungs ma thag nas sngon gnas rjes su dran pa dang / mkhas pa dang grub pa'i rnam thar ngang gis sad pa sogs sprul par sgro btags pa gzhan las ches khyad par du gyur pa kun gyi mig dang rna ba'i spyod yul du gyur to/ /byang bde chen yangs pa can gyi chos grwa ni/ zhwa dmar rim byon gyi gdan sa mdzad de/ de yang sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi ye shes thun mong gdul bya'i mkhas grub kyi skye ba brgyud mar bzung ba'i mthar/ rje gsum pa'i thugs srabang zhwa dmar pa rtogs ldan grags pa seṅge/ bu 'bor shwa yi yul du 'byungs/ dpal 92

ba chen 'odasnang las/ saskya'i motho'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()kun mkhyen mi bskyod rdo rje ni/ ngam gyi yul du 'brungs/ shes bya rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag thogs pa med par smra ba'i paṇ+ḍita chen por gyur/ bstan bcosakyang shin tu mang bar mdzad/ dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje ni/ khamasayul tre smad kha ba glang ri'i zhol du 'brungs/ bcu pa chos dbyings rdo rje ni mgu log gi smar stod mgu mdar 'khrungs/ 'di dus dkar bstan la nyams chag che bar byung na'ang / rje de nyid 'jang yul sogs su phebs pasabardzi bar ma nus/ bcu gcig pa ye shes rdo rje mgu log gi yul du 'brungs/ bcu gnyis pa byang chub rdo rje ni sde dge'i mnga' khul dbon stod dkyil le zhes par 'khrungs/ bcu gsum pa bdud 'dul rdo rje ni lho gnas dge ri dang nye bar 'brungs/ bcu bzhi pa khyab bdag theg pa mchog gi rdo rje ni ri bo che'i mnga' khul 'og min kurma'i dgon dang nye bar 'khrungs/ shes bya rig pa'i gnas thams cad la mkhyen rab kyi pad+mo bye zhing / 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum sogs 'khor lo gsum gyi phrin las gong du 'phel ba'i ngang da lta zhabs pad brtan bzhin pa 'di'o/ /mdor na rje sku phreng 'di rnams sku 'khrungs ma thag nas sngon gnas rjes su dran pa dang / mkhas pa dang grub pa'i rnam thar ngang gis sad pa sogs sprul par sgro btags pa g.yin lasaches khyad par du gyur pa kun gyi mig dang rna ba'i spyod yul du gyur to/ /byang bde chen yangs pa can gyi chos grwa ni/ zhwa dmar rim byon gyi gdan samadzad de/ de yang sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi ye shes thun mong gdul bya'i mkhas grub kyi skye ba brgyud mar bzung ba'i mthar/ rje gsum pa'i thugs srabakazhwa dmar pa rtogs ldan grags pa seṅge/ bu 'bor shwa yi yul du goyis/ dpal 92

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/mkha' spyod dbang po/ gnam gyi bye ma lung / sprul sku chorme/dpal ye shes/ nyangapo gebragamador/ chosakyi gragadra'ipa ye shesadapal bzang po/ tre shod khagasar/ dkon mchog yan lag kong po tsha rkyen gzhung / chos kyi dbang phyug 'brigung pa'igadung / ye shesasnying po/mgo log smad/ dpal chos kyi don grub/ yol mogangasarar/ dgu pa rje no/zhagrungasargya mtsho'i sde pa bkrashisartse/ bar byon nas/ mkhas btsun grub pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pas 'phags bod mkhas grub thams cad kyis bsngags pa'i me tog 'thor ba'i yul gcig tu gyur na'ang / dgu pa chos grub rgya mtsho'i dusabastan pa'i gegs chag lta bus gor+ṣa'i dus zing skabs gzhung sa nas dgongasaphog gi yangs pa can gyi chos grwa dge lugs par bsgyur zhing / slad nasaspru'akhapa'i sku'ang khrir 'khod du med pa sogs mdzad mod/ 'on kyang rgyal ba'i phrin las rtag cing khyab dang lhun gyis grub par 'jug pa ni su zhig gis 'gog par nus/ /mdo khams sde dge'i mnga' khul shar dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'bor gling zhes bshad sgrub kyi chu gter chen po 'di nyid ni/ dus gsum mkhyen pa pad+ma saṃ bhā was ye shes gzigs pa'i spyan can du rdo rje'i lung gis mngon par bsngags pa si tu rin po che kun mkhyen bstan pa'i nyin byed kyis dgung lo nyer dgu pa me lug lor btab/ de'i dbon dang mchog sprul rim byon gyis skyong /'jang yul yan chad du dgon lag kyang mang du 'phel zhing dar rgyas che/ de yang si tu rin po che ni/ 'phags pa'i yul du grub chen ḍom+bhi pa dang / gangasacan 'dir lho brag mar pa lo tsā sogs dag pa'i rnam 'phrul tshad med pa las/ bye 93

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/mkha' spyod dbang po/ gnam gyi bye ma lung / sprul sku ga dpal ye shes/ nyang po khe bragamador/chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po/ tre shod khags ra/ dkon mchog yan lag kong po tsha rkyen gzhung /chos kyi dbang phyug 'bri gung pa'i gdung / ye shes snying po/mgo log smad/ dpal chen chos kyi don grub/ yol mo gangs rar/ dgu pa rje chos grubargya mtsho'i sde pa ba po shis rtse/ bar byon nas/ mkhas btsun grub pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pas 'phags bod mkhas grub thams cad kyis bsngags pa'i me tog 'thor ba'i yul gcig tu gyur na'ang / dgu pa chos grub rgya mtsho'i dusabastan pa'i gegs chag lta bus gosa'i dus zing skabs gzhung sa nas dgongasaphog gi yangs pa can gyi chos grwa dge lugs par bsgyur zhing / slad nas spru'asapa'i sku'ang khrir 'khod du med pa sogs mdzad mod/ 'on kyang rgyal ba'i phrin las rtag cing khyab dang lhun gyis grub par 'jug pa ni su zhig gis 'gog par nus/ /mdo khams sde dge'i mnga' khul shar dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling zhes bshad sgrub kyi chu gter chen po 'di nyid ni/ dus gsum mkhyen pa pad+ma saṃ bhā was ye shes gzigs pa'i spyan can du rdo rje'i lung gis mngon par bsngags pa si tu rin po che kun mkhyen bstan pa'i nyin byed kyis dgung lo nyer dgu pa me lug lor btab/ de'i dbon dang mchog sprul rim byon gyis skyong /'jang yul yan chad du dgon lag kyang mang du 'phel zhing dar rgyas che/ de yang si tu rin po che ni/ 'phags pa'i yul du grub chen ḍom+bhi pa dang / gangs can 'dir lho brag mar pa lo tsā sogs dag pa'i rnam 'phrul tshad med pa las/ bye 93

ba tshe chen 'od sna pa las/ sa skya'i chosang gces bsdus/ ()brag rkarma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa'i thugs sras ras chen bsod nams grags pa / pa zhi'i nye gnas ye shes 'od/ rang byung rdo rje'i dus ri mgo ba rat+na kā ra/rol pa'i rdo rje'i dus gnas brtan spyan 'dren pa'i tā zhing rdzu 'phrul can rnams dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i dus na skyes mchog chos kyi rgyal mtshan ni 'og min ga me pa'i dbon brgyud/ gdan sa bar mar las ka bskos pas rgya nag tā ming rgyal pos si tu zhes pa'i mtshan dang / shel dam sogs gnang ba la brten de phyin chad mtshan de skad du chags/ de nas si tu bkra shis rnam rgyal dang /bkra shis dpal 'byor rnams gdan sa bar pa'i dbon brgyud du 'brungs/ mi zhabrugs chos kyi go cha zur mang rtsis mdar 'khrungs shing shar phyogs spungs rir bzhugs/ de'i phyi ma si tu nor bu bsam 'phel/ de'i sprul sku si tu chos kyi rgyal mtshan dge legs dpal bzang po/ de'i sprul sku mi pham phrin las rab brtan sde dge'i mnga' khul rme shod du 'khrungs shing 'di yan gdan sa bar ma dme'i dgon du bzhugs/ de yi rnam 'phrul kun mkhyen chos kyi 'byung gnas ni/ mdo khams sde dge'i mnga' khul a ta rong gi a lo ding ring sgang du 'bru'i rigs las/ sa mo yos kyi lor mtshan dpe'i pad+mo bzhad/ rigs sad pa'i yon tan gsal bas snyan pa'i grags pas phyogs thams cad du khyab/ bla ma ga me dpal grub dang / rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu las sgra/ bla ma chos dbang las snyan dngags/ de la dmar dge bshes las rtsis/ skyed tshal drung ram pa bsod nams rnam rgyal sogs las tshad ma dang / 'dul mngon dbu phar/ kong po sprul sku ba las lha bris/ phyag mdzod skyes mchog dang / dbon tshang ye shes bsam 94

ba chen 'od snangalas/ sa skya'i chosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()brag rkarma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa'i thugs sras ras chen bsod nams grags pa / pak+shi'i nye gnas ye shes 'od/ rang byung rdo rje'i dusari mgo ba rat+na kā ra/rol pa'i rdo rje'i dus gnas brtan spyan 'dren pa'i tā zhing rdzu 'phrul can rnams dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i dus na skyes mchog chos kyi rgyal mtshan ni 'og min game pa'i dbon brgyud/ gdan sa bar mar las ka bskos pas rgya nag tā ming rgyal pos si tu zhes pa'i mtshan dang / shel dam sogs gnang ba la brten de phyin chad mtshan de skad du chags/ de nas si tu bkra shis rnam rgyal dang /bkra shis dpal 'byor rnams gdan sa bar pa'i dbon brgyud du 'brungs/ mi 'khrugs chos kyi go cha zur mang rtsis mdar 'khrungs shing shar phyogs spungs rir bzhugs/ de'i phyi ma si tu nor bu bsam 'phel/ de'i sprul sku si tu chosakyi rgyal mtshan dge legs dpal bzang po/ de'i sprul sku mi pham phrin las rab brtan sde dge'i mnga' khul rme shod du 'khrungs shing 'di yan gdan sa bar ma rkarma'i dgon du bzhugs/ de yi rnam 'phrul kun mkhyen chosakyi 'byung gnas ni/ mdo khams sde dge'i mnga' khul a ta rong gi a lo ding ring sgang du 'bru'i rigs las/ sa mo yos kyi lor mtshan dpe'i pad+mo bzhad/ rigs sad pa'i yon tan gsal bas snyan pa'i grags pas phyogs thams cad du khyab/ bla ma game dpal grub dang / rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu las sgra/ bla ma chos dbang lasasnyan dngags/ de la dmar dge bshes las rtsis/ skyed tshal drung ram pa bsod nams rnam rgyal sogs las tshad ma dang / 'dul mngon dbu phar/ kong po sprul sku ba las lha bris/ phyag mdzod skyes mchog dang / dbon tshang ye shes bsam 94

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/gtan sogs rgya dkar nag bod ljongs kyi mkhas pa mang po las gso rig sogs thun mong gi rig gnas mtha' dag la gsan sbyong gi tshul tsam gnang bas thams cad las phul du byung bar mkhyen/ zhwa dmar brgyad pa dpal chen chos kyi don grub lasasdom pa gsum gyi bka' drin nos shing / de nyid dang / rje rgyal ba'i dbang po bcu gnyisapa/ dpal rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu sogs las mdo sngags kyi zab chos rgya mtsho lta bu gsan/ thun mong gi rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag smra ba la rje btsun sapaṇa dang / shong dpang yab sras zhi bar gzims pa'i rjes rje 'di kho nar mkhyen rab tshad mar gyur pa ni mkhas pa thams cad kyi yid kyi me long du gsal bar 'char na'ang blun po phyogs 'dzin can rnams kyis ga la mthong / lar yang 'phags yul gyi paṇ+ḍita chen po khyab 'jug bdag po dang / rab stobs sogs kyis bsngagasapa'i me tog nyin bzhin du 'thor na gzhan bod blun po kha cig mgu min la ltosadagos pa'ang ci/ dus dbang gis ma gtogs rtsod pa'i dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa rin 'byung zhi ba dang / a bhā ya dang / shākya shrī sogs dang mkhyen rtogasamanyam par 'khumasaso//gsung rtsom yang tshig gi zla ba re rer legs bshad kyi bdud rtsi 'bum du 'dzag pa 'phags yul mkhas pa'i gsung rab dang dbyer mi phyed pa/ legs sbyar gyi bstan bcos gtso bor gyur pa pod chen bco lnga bzhugs shing / gdan sabar mar phebs pa'i 'os yin kyang / sde dge chos rgyal chen po'i lung gis bskul te dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling gsar du btab ste bzhugs/ thugs kyi sras rje bcu gsum pa dang / zhwa dmar dgu pa/ dpa' bo rin po che sogs 95

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/gtan sogs rgya dkar nag bod ljongs kyi mkhas pa mang po las gso rig sogs thun mong gi rig gnas mtha' dag la gsan sbyong gi tshul tsam gnang bas thams cad las phul du byung bar mkhyen/ zhwa dmar brgyad pa dpal chen chos kyi don grub las sdom pa gsum gyi bka' drin nos shing / de nyid dang / rje rgyal ba'i dbang po bcu gnyis pa/ dpal rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu sogs las mdo sngags kyi zab chos rgya mtsho lta bu gsan/ thun mong gi rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag smra ba la rje btsun sa paṇa dang / lha/nga dpang yab sras zhi bar gzims pa'i rjes rje 'di kho nar mkhyen rab tshad mar gyur pa ni mkhas pa thams cad kyi yid kyi me long du gsal bar 'char na'ang blun po phyogs 'dzin can rnams kyis ga la mthong / lar yang 'phags yul gyi paṇ+ḍita chen po khyab 'jug bdag po dang / rab stobs sogs kyis bsngags pa'i me tog nyin bzhin du 'thor na gzhan bod blun po kha cig mgu min la ltos dgos pa'ang ci/ dus dbang gis ma gtogs rtsod pa'i dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa rin 'byung zhi ba dang / a bhā ya dang / shākya shrī sogs dang mkhyen rtogs mnyam par 'khums so//gsung rtsom yang tshig gi zla ba re rer legs bshad kyi bdud rtsi 'bum du 'dzag pa 'phags yul mkhas pa'i gsung rab dang dbyer mi phyed pa/ legs sbyar gyi bstan bcos gtso bor gyur pa pod chen bco lnga bzhugs shing / gdan sa bar mar phebs pa'i 'os yin kyang / sde dge chos rgyal chen po'i lung gis bskul te dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling gsar du btab ste bzhugs/ thugs kyi sras rje bcu gsum pa dang / zhwa dmar dgu pa/ dpa' bo rin po che sogs 95

'tshechena'odasnangalagasaskya'i chosayang sa bsdus/ ()mchog gi dngosagrub brnyesapa du ma dang / 'brug yongasa'adzin rin po che/ sgra skor sogasarig gnasakyi zin brisamang / khams sprul chos kyi nyi ma/ snyan ngag dang nang don mdzod 'grelaso+ogs/ sku'i gcung sats+tsha sku skye rkarma ngesalegasabastan 'dzin/ sa rtsisaskor podagasum/ ma hā paṇ+ḍita tshe dbang kun khyab sgra dang sdeb sbyor rtsisaskoranangadon gosakyi zin brisamang du yod/sogasarig pa smra ba dang / gzhan yang gso ba rig pa dang /bzo rig pa sogs kyisamatshon deng sang gi bar du kun mkhyen chen po 'di nyid kyi bka' drin kho na la brten nas gtsug lag rab 'byams kyi gnasakun ma 'khrul bar smra zhing lag len du 'debasapa ji snyed cig byon pa yin no/ /gdan sar sku'i gcung rig 'dzin klong gsal snying po'i sku skye game bsam 'phel dang /g.yu thog yon tan mgon po'i rnam 'phrul rkarma bsam gtan sogs bzhugs shing / slar yang rje de nyid kyi mchog sprul rin po che mkhas btsun grub pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rka tshang pa'i ring lugs 'dzin pa mtha' dag gi gtsug gi nor bu gcig pu/ dus gsum mkhyen pa o rgyan chen pos pad+ma'i ljagasaldan drug gi dang por lung bstan pa dpal pad+ma dbang chen nam/ pad+ma nyin byed dbang po dang / dbon bsam 'phel gyi rnam 'phrul dbang gi rdo rje gong 'og karma nges legs bstan 'dzin gyi mchog sprul garma rin chen/ bsam gtan mchog sprul rin po che rkarma nges don bstan 'phel sogs kyis 'khor lo gsum gyi phyag rjes gong 'phel du mdzad do/ /dbus su gnas nang rgyal ba'i ri khrod ni/ thog mar zhwa dmar grags pa seṅges btab/ phyis su dpa' bo rim byon gyis gdan sar mdzad de/ de yang 96

chen 'od thal ga sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ ()mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa du ma dang / 'brug yongs 'dzin rin po che/ sgra skor sogs rig gnas kyi zin bris mang / khams sprul chos kyi nyi ma/ snyan ngag dang nang don mdzod 'grel sogs/ sku'i gcung la sku skye rkarma nges legs bstan 'dzin/ sa rtsisasgor po dgasum/ ma hā paṇ+ḍita tshe dbang kun khyab sgra dang sdeb sbyor rtsis skor nang don gos kyi zin bris mang du bod/sogs rig pa smra ba dang / gzhan yang gso ba rig pa dang /bzo rig pa sogs kyis mtsho ni deng sang gi bar du kun mkhyen chen po 'di nyid kyi bka' drin kho na la brten nas gtsug lag rab 'byams kyi gnas kun ma 'khrul bar smra zhing lag len du 'debs pa ji snyed cig byon pa yin no/ /gdan sar sku'i gcung rig 'dzin klong gsal snying po'i sku skye ga me bsam 'phel dang /g.yu thog yon tan mgon po'i rnam 'phrul ga me bsam gtan sogs bzhugs shing / slar yang rje de nyid kyi mchog sprul rin po che mkhas btsun grub pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rka tshang pa'i ring lugs 'dzin pa mtha' dag gi gtsug gi nor bu gcig pu/ dus gsum mkhyen pa o rgyan chen pos pad+ma'i ljags ldan drug gi dang por lung bstan pa dpal pad+ma dbang chen nam/ pad+ma nyin byed dbang po dang / dbon bsam 'phel gyi rnam 'phrul dbang gi rdo rje gong 'og karma nges legs bstan 'dzin gyi mchog sprul ga me rin chen/ bsam gtan mchog sprul rin po che ga me nges don bstan 'phel sogs kyis 'khor lo gsum gyi phyag rjes gong 'phel du mdzad do/ /dbus su gnas nang rgyal ba'i ri khrod ni/ thog mar zhwa dmar grags pa seṅges btab/ phyis su dpa' bo rim byon gyis gdan sar mdzad de/ de yang 96

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/gter ston rin chen gling pa'i sprul sku lho brgyud lo ror byon pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang dang / gzhen nu lhun grub/ dpa' bo zhes pa'i mtshan thog mar grags pa chos dbang lhun grub yar 'brog tu 'khyungs/ yan rnying ma yin la/ 'di dusarje bdun pas lho gro bo lung dang sras mkhar gyi bdag por bskos pas bka' brgyud par gyur/ de'i sprul sku thams cad mkhyen pa gtsug lag phreng ba snying thang sgang brgyud/ nas ( rim par/ gtsug lag rgya mtsho/ 'khar yul ban+de lung / phrin las rgya mtsho/ rta'u shes khog tu 'khrungs/ 'di dus dkar bstan nyams chag skabs yin kyang rje 'di kun mkhyen lnga pas gzigs phyogs leg pas gnas nang dang / bsgrags sngags grwa sogs 'dzin skyong chog par mdzad/ gtsug lag don grub/ chu shul/ gtsug lag dga' ba'i dbang po/ dbon stod/gtsug lag chos rgyal gi tu rin po che'i gas rnams kyi bar byon nas mkhas grub kyi snang bas blo ldan yid kyi pad+mo kha bye bar mdzad do/ /khams su zur mang dgon ni/ drung rma se blo gros rin chen gyis thog mar btab/ kai tshang bka' brgyud kyi nang gses zur mang bka' brgyud ces deng sang yang dar rgyas che/ ngom yul gnas mdo dpal ri rtse'i sgrub khang ni/ zhwa dmar chos kyi dbang phyug gi zhal slob/ rje brgyad pa'i sku'i rnam 'phrul du grags shing /dkar rnying gnyis ga'i bstan pa'i sgron me grub chen ga me chags med kyis btab cing skye sprul rim byon gyis skyong / 'di las gnas mdo bka' brgyud ces phrin las kyi sgo phyogs thams cad du bye ba byung / gsung rtsom yang pod lnga bcu tsam yod par grags shing phal cher 'gro phan dar so che'o /gtsang nyang stod ra lung ni/ grub pa'i slob dpon mtsho skyes zhabs kyis/97

gangasacan bod yuladu byon pa'igasang sngagasagasar rnying gigadan rabasamador bsdus/gter ston rin chen gling pa'i sprul sku lho brgyud lo ror byon pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang dang / gzhon nu lhun grub/ dpa' bo zhes pa'i mtshan thog mar gragasapa chosadabang lhun grub yar 'brogatu 'brungs/ yan rnying ma yin la/ 'di dusarje bdun pas lho gro bo lung dang sras mkhar gyi bdag por bskos pas bka' brgyud par gyur/ de'i sprul sku thams cad mkhyen pa gtsug lag phreng ba snying thang sgang brgyud/ nasarim par/ gtsug lag rgya mtsho/ 'khar yul ban+de lung / phrin las rgya mtsho/ rta'u shesakhog tu 'khrungs/ 'di dusadakar bstan nyamasachag skabasayin kyang rje 'di kun mkhyen lnga pasagazigasaphyogasaleg pasaganasanang dang / bsgragasasngagasagrwa sogasa'adzin skyong chog par mdzad/ gtsug lag don grub/ chu shul/ ga lnga/lag dga' ba'i dbang po/ dbonastod/gtsug lag chos rgyal gitu rin po che'i gas rnams kyi bar byon nas mkhas grub kyi snang bas blo ldan yid kyi pad+mo kha bye bar mdzad do/ /khams su zur mang dgon ni/ drung rma se blo gros rin chen gyis thog mar btab/ kai tshang bka' brgyud kyi nang gses zur mang bka' brgyud ces deng sang yang dar rgyas che/ ngom yul gnas mdo dpal ri rtse'i sgrub khang ni/ zhwa dmar chos kyi dbang phyug gi zhal slob/ rje brgyad pa'i sku'i rnam 'phrul du grags shing /dkar rnying gnyis ga'i bstan pa'i sgron me grub chen game chags med kyis btab cing skye sprul rim byon gyis skyong / 'di las gnas mdo bka' brgyud ces phrin las kyi sgo phyogs thams cad du bye ba byung / gsung rtsom yang pod lnga bcu tsam yod par grags shing phal cher 'gro phan dar so che'o /gtsang nyang stod ra lung ni/ grub pa'i slob dpon mtsho skyes zhabs kyis/97

ba tshe chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()sar la zhes bya'i lung gsum mdor/ /nor bu 'dzin pa'i sprul pa 'byung/ /zhesardo rje'i lung gis bstan pa bzhin/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje chen po'i ye shes gzugs su shar ba phyag na pad+mo'i rnam 'phrul mtshan gzhan du bsgyur ba na rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du grub chen nā ro ta par gyur te rdo rje theg pa'i seṅge'i sgra chen po bsgrags/ de nyid gangs can 'dir rgya gar gyi chu bo gaṅgā tshun chad du rtogs pa mtho bar grags shing / dpal sar ha chen po'i sprul zlar 'os pa gling ras pad+ma rdo rje'i slob ma gtsang pa rgya ras ye shes rdo rje zhes bya bar sprul te / rje de la grub chen gling ras kyis lung bstan nas gdan sa 'di nyid dang /zhang gis lung bstan nas klong brdol dgon dang / ga me pa dus gsum mkhyen pas lung bstan nas 'brug dgon pa rnams btab/ gdan sa gong mar rje 'di nyid kyi dbon ras dar ma seṅge nas rim par/ chos rje gzhen nu seṅge/ byang sems nyi ma seṅge/ rgyal sras seṅge shes rab spos skya pa seṅge rin chen/ bcu gsum seṅge rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' seṅge/ 'jam dbyangs blo grosaseṅge/ sprul sku shes rab seṅge ste mnyam med seṅge dgu tshar du grags pa dang / ye shes rin chen/ nam mkha' dpal bzang / rgya ras rnam 'phrul rgyal dbang chosarje kun dga' dpal 'byor/ ngag dbang chos rgyal rnams dang / rgyal dbang rje'i skye ba byar khri dbon gyi rigs su 'khrungs pa 'jam dbyangs chos kyi grags pa dang / de'i skye ba kong por 'khrungs pa thams cad mkhyen pa pad+ma dkar po zhes shes bya rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag thogs pa med par 'chad cing rtsod pa dang /legs bshad kyang mang du rtsom pa/ phrin las rgya che ba de nyid byon/ de nas 98

bgechen 'od snang las/ saskya'i motho'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()saral zhes bya'i lung gsum mdor/ /nor bu 'dzin pa'i sprul pa 'byung/ /zhesardo rje'i lung gis bstan pa bzhin/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje chen po'i ye shes gzugs su shar ba phyag na pad+mo'i rnam 'phrul mtshan gzhan du bsgyur ba na rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du grub chen nā ro ta par gyur te rdo rje theg pa'i seṅge'i sgra chen po bsgrags/ de nyid gangs can 'dir rgya gar gyi chu bo gaṅgā tshun chad du rtogs pa mtho bar grags shing / dpal sar ha chen po'i sprul zlar 'os pa gling ras pad+ma rdo rje'i slob ma gtsang pa rgya ras ye shes rdo rje zhes bya bar sprul te / rje de la grub chen gling ras kyis lung bstan nas gdan sa 'di nyid dang /zhang gis lung bstan nas klong brdol dgon dang / rkarma pa dusagasum mkhyen pas lung bstan nas 'brug dgon pa rnams btab/ gdan sa gong mar rje 'di nyid kyi dbon ras dar ma seṅge nas rim par/ chos rje gzhon nu seṅge/ byang sems nyi ma seṅge/ rgyal sras seṅge shesarab sposaskya pa seṅge rin chen/ bcu gsum seṅge rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' seṅge/ 'jam dbyangs blo grosaseṅge/ sprul sku shes rab seṅge ste mnyam med seṅge dgu tshar du grags pa dang / ye shes rin chen/ nam mkha' dpal bzang / rgya ras rnam 'phrul rgyal dbang chosarje kun dga' dpal 'byor/ ngag dbang chos rgyal rnams dang / rgyal dbang rje'i skye ba byar khri dbon gyi rigs su 'khrungs pa 'jam dbyangs chos kyi grags pa dang / de'i skye ba kong por 'khrungs pa thams cad mkhyen pa pad+ma dkar po zhes shes bya rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag thogs pa med par 'chad cing rtsod pa dang /legs bshad kyang mang du rtsom pa/ phrin las rgya che ba de nyid byon/ de nas 98
