gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/dpag bsam dbang po dang / bka' brgyud phrin las shing rta dang / chos kyi snang ba gong 'og sogs thams cad mkhyen pa'i mtshan gyi grags dkar 'jig rten na nyi ma bzhin du gsal ba rnams byon nas don brgyud kyi phrin las nam mkhar brdal/ gzhan yang rgya ras slob ma rgod tshang pa las stod 'brug gnam gyi skar ma lta bu dang / rgyal ba lo ras pa las smad 'brug sa'i dreg pa lta bu zhes grags pas mtshon/ zhal slob khri tsho lnga byung ba phal cher gyis 'ja' lus grub/ rdo rje phag mos bstan pa bya rgod po'i nyin lam bco brgyad du khyab par lung bstan pa bzhin/ o ḍi yā na dang / dza lan+ta ra tshun chad slob brgyud kyis gang zhing / mi phyed 'brug pa/ 'brug phyed sprang po/ sprang phyed grub thob zhes 'jig rten na gtam du sgrags sa/ /byar bkra shis mthong smon ni/ 'brug pa rgyal dbang rje'i yang srid 'jam dbyangs chos kyi grags par mkha' 'gro ma su kha sid+dhis lung bstan nas btab cing / skye sprul rim pas skyong / khyad par kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar po'i dus su phrin las rgyas par byung bas dgon gnas mang tsam dang / rje ngag dbang rnam rgyal lho mon du phebs/ mon pa tsho bzhi sogs ting nge 'dzin gyis dbang du bsdus nas spong klog gi 'dus sde mang po btsugs te lho 'brug zhes lugs gnyis kyi mnga' thang la gzhan dring min 'jog pa 'di dang / dbus su'ang bde mchog chos 'khor dang / grwa nang sding po che/ khams su kham/sa spru la rin po che'i gdan sas mtshon mnga' ris nas bzung ste khams kong yan du deng sang yang dar rgyas shin tu che bar gnas so/ /

brtse chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()de ltar gangs ri'i khrod kyi grub rigs rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas bka' brgyud rin po che de rnams kyi skyes bu dam pa bstan pa la bka' drin che ba ni/spyir mar mi dwags gsum ras chung pa dang / dpal phag mo gru pa rnams ni bka' brgyud rin po che'i spyi mes lta bu yin la/ bye brag kai tshang bka' brgyud la rje dus gsum mkhyen pa dang / rtogs ldan grags pa seng ge sogs rgyal ba yab sras rim byon dang / de las kyang kun mkhyen rang byung zhabs/ rje chos grags rgya mtsho/ mi bskyod rdo rje/ zhwa dmar chos kyi grags pa/ dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba sogs mkhas shing dngos grub brnyes par grags che zhing / phyis su dus kyi dbang gis bstan pa la nyams chag byung ba'i tshe/ dpal chen chos kyi don grub dang / thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi 'byung gnas yab sras brgyud pa dang bcasapa gcig tu bka' drin che'o/ /de bzhin du dpal stag lung pa ngag dbang grags pa dang / 'bri gung rin chen phun tshogs dang / chos kyi grags pa/ 'brug pa rgyal dbang rje dang / pad+ma dkar po sogs snyan pa'i grags dkar nyin bzhin du gsal zhing / de lta bu'i skyes mchog rnams kyi don gyi rnam thar kyang mdor bsdu na / nyan thos kyi nges 'byung / theg chen gyi sems bskyed/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig rnams gzhir bzhag cing / mos gus phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor gyis nges don snying po'i lam la rtse gcig tu gzhol ba'i steng / so so'i khyad chos/ mar rngog gi rgyud bshad/ mi la'i snying rus dang gdams ngag sgam po pa'i ngo ba'i ga dar/ dme pa'i rlang sems dbyer med/ zhang gi lam mchog mthar thugaphag gru'i gsang sngags/ 'ba' rom pa'i bsre 'pho gseb lam/ stag lung pa'i /00

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/rnam thar so dgu/ 'bri gung pa'i sdom gsum gnad gcig gtsang pa rgya ras kyi rten 'brel dang ro snyoms/ lo rgod kyi mos gus dang / zhen log rnams ni cha mthun khyad 'phags zhes re re la'ang thams cad tshang bar yod de/ gang la rtsal du bton nas rang rang gi thugs nyams su bzhes pa dang / slob ma 'khrid cing skyong bar mdzad pa la khyad par gyi 'byed chos su'ang bzhag tu rung zhing / de yongs su rdzogs pa la'ang bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa dang / de nyid rgyud la mnga' ba rnams la bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu zhes 'jig rten gsum na snyan par grags so / / de dag las brgyud pa'i gdams pa la'ang / spyir mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i tshig gi bshad srol/ don gyi brgyud pa/ snying po'i nyams len bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bzhugs na'ang / bye brag bka' brgyud rin po che rang gi khyad chos kyi dbang du byas na nges don phyag rgya chen po dang / zab lam nā ro chos drug gnyis gtso bor dar zhing / de las kyang kai tshang bka' brgyud la sngar mtshur lugs kyi rgyud sde brgya rtsa dang / yangs can gyi dkyil 'khor zhe gnyis sogs rgya cher bzhugs na'ang / deng dus bya rgyud tshe dpag mi 'khrugs sogs nyer mkho'i dbang bka'i skor dang / rjes gnang zur bka' mang po/ rnal 'byor rgyud kun rig bla med la thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ bde mchog lha sgo lnga/ phag mo sogs kyi dbang rgya gzhung bod gzhung mang po'i lung man ngag dang bcas pa/ phyag rdor gtum chen gtum chung / bla ma rngog pa rnams nas brgyud pa'i dkyil 'khor bdun zhes/ kye rdor yab bka' dang yum bka' bdag med ma / rdo rje gur/ ma hā mā ya/ gdan bzhi yab bka' dang / yum bka' ye shes/01

ba chen 'odasnang las/ saskya'i mos 'byung gcesabasdus/ ()dbang phyug ma/ 'jam dpal gsang ldan rnal 'byor rgyudarnams dang / spyi bka' rdor phreng shākya shrī sogs nas brgyud pa dang / paṇ+ḍi ta nags kyi rin chen sogs nas brgyud pa so so/ grub chen mi tra'i thugasadam dkyil 'khor brgya rtsa/ sgrub thabasargya rgya ma/ rin 'byung sogs dang / rje dgu pa'i mngon rtogs zhi phreng / drag phreng /chos skyong glog phreng rnams kyi rjes gnang / khyad par ngesadon phyag rgya chen po'i nyams khrid dang / rgya gzhung dang bod gzhung rab tu mang po'i lung / zab lam nā ro chos drug gi nyams khrid/ chos drug srasamakhar ma'i lugs zab mo nang don gyi bshad srol/ zur mang snyan brgyud kyi dbang lung man ngag gi skor bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ zab mo bdud kyi gcod yul skor gyi dbang lung nyams khrid/rje btsun jo nang pa nas brgyud pa'i skor la/ dus 'khor dbang yongs rdzogs mchog dbang bdag dbang dang bcas pa/ bde mchog stod 'grel/ lū dril nag gsum/ lhan skyesabadag dbang / bde mchog rab 'byams/ kye rdor salugs/ma yā rngog lugs/ gdan bzhi/ yum bka'/ sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma/ mkha' spyod rigs gsum/ phur pa rgyud lugs/ gsang 'dusa'aphagasazhabs lugs gnyis/ gshed dmar lha lnga/ dgra nag zhang lugs/ 'jigasabyed bcu gsum ma / ro langasabargyad skor/ gshin rje rab 'byams/ mi g.yo ba bla med/ shangasalugs rgyud sde lnga/ mi 'khrugs longasasku/ tshe dpag lha dgu rnamasakyi dbang /sbyor drug dang / ni gu chos drug nyams khrid/ grol mchog khrid brgya/ chos skyo nga ber nag can gyi dbang / rjes gnang / rang byung rgyal mo dang ma mgon 'bor lnga/bkra shis tshe ring la sogasakyi rjes gnang / mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i dbang 102

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/sogs bzhugs/ rgyab rten lung la/ mar mi'i rnam mgur/ dwags po dang /phag gru'i gsung tshang ma/ rngeg 'grel rin chen rgyan 'dra/ dus mkhyen bka' 'thum tshang ma/ rang byung ba'i nang don sogs thor bu/ mi bskyed khrid thung pu ti sogs/ dbang phyug rdo rje/ zhwa dmar mkha' spyod dbang po/ dkon mchog ya na lag chos kyi 'byung gnabs sog kyi bka' 'bum/ rkarma chags med kyi gsung rab mang po/ dol po'i ri chos/ tā ra nā tha'i bka' 'bum sogs mang du bzhugs la/ bar skababa'i nas rnying ma'i phyogs la'ang thugs dam nyams bzhes mdzad pas/ gter kha gong 'og sangs gling / ra ta gling / ga me gling pa sogasakyi gter chos ci rigs pa dang / 'ja' tshon pa/ bdud 'dul/ gnam chos/stag sham/ chos gling / rol rdor sogs dang / lhag par yongs dge mi 'gyur rdo rje'i zhi khro pad+ma badz+ra/ tshe sgrub thabs shes kha sbyor/ rdo rje gro lod rnams ni shin tu dar ro/ /don brgyud 'brug pa'i ring lugs la spyir rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i spyi bka' zur bka' sogs phal cher sngar ltar la/ khyad par lta ba gtso bor ston pa gdams ngag phyag rgya chen po/ sgom pa gtso bor ston pa gdams ngag nā ro chos drug spyod pa gtso bor ston pa gdams ngag 'byung ba ro snyoms/'bras bu gtso bor ston pa gdams ngag rten 'brel bar bdun/ kun la gces pa'i gdams ngag lam zab bla ma sgrub pa'i skor dang / 'brug lugs 'phral mkho'i rjes gnang / sgrub thabs skor lnga zhes/ bde mchog dngos grub kyi skor/phag mo byin rlabs kyi skor/ gtum po nus mthu'i skor/ bde mchog lhan skyes ku swā la'i skor/ mgon po bya rog bstan srung ma'i skor/ dbang lung man ngag shin tu mang /103

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'igasang sngags gsar ning gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/sogasabazhugs/ rgyab rten lung la/ mar mi'i rnam mgur/ dwagasapo dang /phag gru'i gsung tshang ma/ rngog 'grel rin chen rgyan 'dra/ dus mkhyen bka' 'bum tshang ma/ rang byung ba'i nang don sogs thor bu/ mi bskyod khrid thung pu ti sogs/ dbang phyug rdo rje/ zhwa dmar mkha' spyod dbang po/ dkon mchog ya na lag chos kyi 'byung gnasasogabashakyi bka' 'bum/ rkarma chags med kyi gsung rab mang po/ dol po'i ri chos/ tā ra nā tha'i bka' 'bum sogs mang du bzhugs la/ bar skababatanas rnying ma'i phyogs la'ang thugs dam nyams bzhes mdzad pas/ gter kha gong 'og sangs gling / rata gling / rkarma gling pa sogasakyi gter chosaci rigs pa dang / 'ja' tshon pa/ bdud 'dul/ gnam chos/stag sham/ chos gling / rol rdor sogs dang / lhag par yongs dge mi 'gyur rdo rje'i zhi khro pad+ma badz+ra/ tshe sgrub thabasashesakha sbyor/ rdo rje gro lod rnams ni shin tu dar ro/ /don brgyud 'brug pa'i ring lugasal spyir rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i spyi bka' zur bka' sogs phal cher sngar ltar la/ khyad par lta ba gtso bor ston pa gdams ngag phyag rgya chen po/ sgom pa gtso bor ston pa gdams rig nā ro chos drug spyod pa gtso bor ston pa gdams ngag 'byung ba ro snyoms/'bras bu gtso bor ston pa gdams ngag rten 'brel bar bdun/ kun la gces pa'i gdams ngag lam zab bla ma sgrub pa'i skor dang / 'brug lugs 'phral mkho'i rjes gnang / sgrub thabs skor lnga zhes/ bde mchog dngos grub kyi skor/phag mo byin rlabs kyi skor/ gtum po nus mthu'i skor/ bde mchog lhan skyes ku swa la'i skor/ mgon po bya rog bstan srung ma'i skor/ dbang lung man ngag shin tu mang /103

'tshe' 'odasnang la / saskya'i chogayangagacetshobasdus/ ()nyams len 'phral dgosabazhi zhes/ rdor semasanyesalhung 'khrud pa'i chos kai ka ni ngan song sbyong ba'i chos/ tshe dpag med 'chi med grub pa'i chos rasas lugasa'adi la phyi nang gsangagasum sogasamang / thugasarje chen po rgyud byin gyisabarlabs pa'i chos/ dpalamo lugs/ gzhan yang ras chung pa'i snyan brgyud gsar rnying / stod 'brug rgod tshang pa'i khrid chen brgyad/ o rgyan pa'i rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub/yang dgon pa'i ri chos skor gsum/ smad 'brug lo rasakyi thub pa lnga/ thugasadam dge sbyor bdun pa/ bka' brgyud kyi bka' 'bum la/ gling ras rgya ras/mnyam med seṅge dgu tshar/ rgyal dbang rje/ pad+ma dkar po rnamasakyi gsung rab rnams so/ /de bzhin dpal stag lung pa'i chos drug yid bzhin nor bu dang /thang pa snga phyi sogs kyi bka' 'bum/ mgon po phyag bzhi'i skor gser pod dang bcas pa/ 'bri gung pa'i dgongs gcig dang gnad gcig phyag chen lnga ldan sogs rgya cher mchis so/ /bka' brgyud rin po che rnams kyi rnam thar rgyas pa ni/bka' brgyud so so'i rnam mgur gyi glegs bam shin tu mang po dang / kun mkhyen bstan pa'i nyin byed dang paṇ+ḍi ta tshe dbang kun khyab kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub brgyud kurma kai tshang gi rnam thar rab 'byams zla ba nor bu chu shel gyi phreng ba/'gos lo thams cad mkhyen pa g.yi+on nu dpal/ deb ther sngon po po da gcig 'brug pa pad+ma dkar po/ pad dkar rgyas pa'i wo byed pod gcig stag lung pa ngag dbang grags pa / dpa' bo gcug lag phreng ba mkhas pa'i dga' ston pod gnyis/ rnams kyi chos 'byung gi bka' brgyud pa'i skabs sogs las shes par bya'o/ /bka' brgyud ces pa'i sgra don ni/ dwags po rin po ches thog mar jo bo rje nas brgyud pa'i /04

ba chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chos 'byung gnyes bsdus/ ()nyams len 'phral dgos bzhi zhes/ rdor sems nyes lhung 'khrud pa'i chos kai ka ni ngan song sbyong ba'i chos/ tshe dpag med 'chi med grub pa'i chos ras yo lugs 'di la phyi nang gsang gsum sogs mang / thug bas rje chen po rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i chos/ dpal mo lugs/ gzhan yang ras chung pa'i snyan brgyud gsar rnying / stod 'brug rgod tshang pa'i khrid chen brgyad/ o rgyan pa'i rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub/yang dgon pa'i ri chos skor gsum/ smad 'brug lo ras thub pa lnga/ thugasadam dge sbyor bdun pa/ bka' brgyud kyi bka' 'bum la/ gling ras rgya ras/mnyam med seṅge dgu tshar/ rgyal dbang rje/ pad+ma dkar po rnams kyi gsung rab rnams so/ /de bzhin dpal stag lung pa'i chos drug yid bzhin nor bu dang /thang pa snga phyi sogs kyi bka' 'bum/ mgon po phyag bzhi'i skor gser pod dang bcas pa/ 'bri gung pa'i dgongs gcig dang gnad gcig phyag chen lnga ldan sogs rgya cher mchis so/ /bka' brgyud rin po che rnams kyi rnam thar rgyas pa ni/bka' brgyud so so'i rnam mgur gyi glegs bam shin tu mang po dang / kun mkhyen bstan pa'i nyin byed dang paṇ+ḍi ta tshe dbang kun khyab kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub brgyud ga me rka tshang gi rnam thar rab 'byams zla ba nor bu chu shel gyi phreng ba/'gos lo thams cad mkhyen pa gzhen nu dpal/ deb ther sngon po po da gcig 'brug pa pad+ma dkar po/ pad dkar rgyas pa'i nyin byed pod gcig stag lung pa ngag dbang grags pa / dpa' bo gcug lag phreng ba mkhas pa'i dga' ston pod gnyis/ rnams kyi chos 'byung gi bka' brgyud pa'i skabs sogs las shes par bya'o/ /bka' brgyud ces pa'i sgra don ni/ dwags po rin po ches thog mar jo bo rje nas brgyud pa'i /04

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamadorabasdus/bka' gdams pa'i gdamasangag gsan cing / phyis mar pa nas brgyud pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i brgyud pa rin po che la zhugs te/ de gnyis zung 'brel du skyong bas gdams pa'i ming gang zag la chags pa yin zhing / 'brug pa ni/ gtsang pa rgya ras kyisadagon gnas 'debs pa'i+o phyogs der byon pa'i tshe/ 'brug ma smad dgu babs nas 'dug pa nam mkhar sang / 'brug sgra drag pa'ang lan gsum du grags pas gnas kyi phur dgon pa btab pa la 'brug ces btags par bshad pa'i phyir gnas kyi ming gang zag la chags pa yin no/ // de nasaphyis su mnyam pa med pa'i phrin lasacan ri bo dge ldan pa byon te/ de la gdan sa thams cad kyi rtsa ba lta bu 'brog ri bo dge ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling ni/ shar tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pas dgung lo nga gsum pa chu glang lor btab/ 'di lor lha ldan smon lam chen mo'ang thog mar btsugs pa yin no/ /de nas rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen sogs khri rabs rim byon gyis gdan sa mdzad/ chos sde 'di la rgyal tshab rje'i gdan sa byang rtser khang tshan khrag bcu gsum dang / mkhas grub rje'i gdan sa shar rtser khang tshan khag bcu gsum ste sdom nyer drug yod/ de la 'jam mgon blo bzang grags pa ni/ 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ 'jig rten nga ni mya ngan 'das/ /sa yi steng 'di stong gyur nas/ khyod nyid byis pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed par 'gyur/ /de tshe dgon chen rab dga' ba/ kha ba can nang yod pa yin/ /ces dang / ston pa'i gzugs brnyan yid 'ong byed/ /blo ldan dang po yi ge ma/ mati bha dra kirti/ zhes sogs rten dang brten par bcas pa lung gis gsal bar bstan pa 105

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/bka' gdams pa'i gdam ba(ngag gsan cing / phyis mar pa nas brgyud pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i brgyud pa rin po che la zhugs te/ de gnyis zung 'brel du skyong bas gdams pa'i ming gang zag la chags pa yin zhid / 'brug pa ni/ gtsang pa rgya ras kyis dgon gnas 'debs pa'i phyogs der byon pa'i tshe/ 'brug ma smad dgu babs nas 'dug pa nam mkhar song / 'brug sgra drag po'ang lan gsum du grags pas gnas kyi phur dgon pa btab pa la 'brug ces btags par bshad pa'i phyir gnas kyi ming gang zag la chags pa yin no/ // de nas phyis su mnyam pa med pa'i phrin las can ri bo dge ldan pa byon te/ de la gdan sa thams cad kyi rtsa ba lta bu 'brog ri bo dge ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling ni/ shar tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pas dgung lo nga gsum pa chu glang lor btab/ 'di lor lha ldan smon lam chen mo'ang thog mar btsugs pa yin no/ /de nas rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen sogs khri rabs rim byon gyis gdan sa mdzad/ chos sde 'di la rgyal tshab rje'i gdan sa byang rtser khang tshan khrag bcu gsum dang / mkhas grub rje'i gdan sa shar rtser khang tshan khag bcu gsum ste sdom nyer drug yod/ de la 'jam mgon blo bzang grags pa ni/ 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ 'jig rten nga ni mya ngan 'das/ /sa yi steng 'di stong gyur nas/ khyod nyid byis pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed par 'gyur/ /de tshe dgon chen rab dga' ba/ kha ba can nang yod pa yin/ /ces dang / ston pa'i gzugs brnyan yid 'ong byed/ /blo ldan dang po yi ge ma/ ma ta bha dra kirti/ zhes sogs rten dang brten par bcas pa lung gis gsal bar bstan pa 105

ba chen 'od snang la / sa skya' chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()bzhin/ rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i rnam rol gzugs gzhan du bsgyur ba na mdo smad kyi yul tsong kha zhes bya bar me mo bya'i lo cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bcur ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas te lhums kyi pad+mo las grol/ de ma thag dngos grub brnyes pa'i chos rje don grub rin chen gyis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sprul par lung bstan/ dgung lo gsum par rgyal dbang ma me pa rol pa'i rdo rje las yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes/ mtshan kun dga' snying por gsol/ bdun par chos rje don grub rin chen las rab tu byung bas blo bzang grags pa zhes snyan pas khyab/ de nyid las gsan bsam yang rgya cher mdzad/ slar bcu bdun par dbus su phebs te/ snga phyir tshal gung thang du gso rig lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal dang / sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen las sgra/ lo tsā ba nam mkha' bzang po las snyan dngags sogs phyi rig pa dang / red mda' ba las dbu tshad phar phyin/ mngon pa gong 'og dang /skyor mo lung du 'dul ba/ lho brag nam mkha' rgyal mtshan las bka' gdams lam rim/ bla ma dam pa las bde mchog dril bu pa/ gong gsum pa bde chen chos kyi dpal ba las dus 'khor/ khyung po lhas pa gzhen nu bsod nams lasa'adus pa sogs rgyud sde bzhis mtshon nang don rig pa'i sde snod rgya mtsho lta bu la mang du gsan pa dang / de dag gi don la bsam byung gi rig pas zhib mor dpyad pas lung gi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa brnyes kyang de tsam du ma bzhag par/ dgung lo so drug pa nas 'khor dag pa rnam brgyad khrid de bya bral ba'i tshul gyis bla ma 'jam dpal dbyer med la gsol ba 'debs pa dang /106

ba chen 'odasnang las/ saskya'i choga'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()bzhin/ rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs sku gsung thugasaye shes rdo rje'i rnam rol gzugs gzhan du bsgyur ba na mdo smad kyi yul tsong kha zhes bya bar me mo bya'i lo cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bcur ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas te lhums kyi pad+mo las grol/ de ma thag dngos grub brnyes pa'i chos rje don grub rin chen gyis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sprul par lung bstan/ dgung lo gsum par rgyal dbang marma pa rol pa'i rdo rje las yongasardzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes/ mtshan kun dga' snying por gsol/ bdun par chos rje don grub rin chen las rab tu byung bsablo bzang gragasapa zhesasnyan pas khyab/ de nyid las gsan bsam yang rgya cher mdzad/ slar bcu bdun par dbusasu phebasate/ snga phyir tshal gung thang du gso rig lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal dang / sabazang ma ti paṇa chen las sgra/ lo tsā ba nam mkha' bzang po las snyan dngags sogasaphyi rig pa dang / red mda' ba las dbu tshad phar phyin/ mngon pa gong 'og dang /skyor mo lung du 'dul ba/ lho brag nam mkha' rgyal mtshan las bka' gdams lam rim/ bla ma dam pa las bde mchog dril bu pa/ gong gsum pa bde chen chos kyi dpal ba las dus 'khor/ khyung po lhasapa g.yi+on nu bsod namasalasa'adus pa sogs rgyud sde bzhis mtshon nang don rig pa'i sde snod rgya mtsho lta bu la mang du gsan pa dang / de dag gi don la bsam byung gi rig pas zhib mor dpyad pas lung gi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa brnyes kyang de tsam du ma bzhag par/ dgung lo so drug pa nas 'khor dag pa rnam brgyad khrid de bya bral ba'i tshul gyis bla ma 'jam dpal dbyer med la gsol ba 'debs pa dang /106

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/gzhung chen por bsam byung gis dpyad de rtse gcig tu nyams su bzhes pas bla ma dang lhag pa'i lhas rjes su bzung / khyad par mgon po klu sgrub yab sras kyis byin gyis brlabs pa la brten/ 'grel pa bud+dha pā li tar gzigs pas/ rtsa she'i rab byed brgyad pa'i brten nas 'byung ba med pa yi/ /zhes sogs kyi 'grel ba la brten nas stong nyid gsar du rtogs pa'i tshul bstan/ de ltar rang nyid lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan mtha' dag la dbang 'byor nas gzhan rjes su bzung ba'i slad/ dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i phyag len phra zhib kyis gzhi bzung / sdom pa gong ma gnyis kyi bcas pa'i mtshams las nam yang mi 'da' ba'i bslab pas bstan pa'i rmang btsugs te/ mon mkhar bkra shis gdong du nyin re bzhin gzhung lugs chen po bco lnga re'i tshig don 'byul med du gsungs pas mtshon 'chad pa dang / gsang phu/ sa skya/ rtse gdong rnams su ka pod lnga la grwa skor mdzad pa'i tshe phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i grags pas khyab pa sogs rtsod pa dang / jo bo yab sras dang / rgya gar gyi paṇa grub mang pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i snang ba la brten nas byang chub lam rim che chung dang / sngags rim chen mo sogs kyi rtsom pa ut+pal gzhon nu'i chun po pod chen bco brgyad tsam blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyi rna ba'i rgyan du byon/ nga gsum pa glangalor lha ldan du smon lam mo btsugs te dge 'dun khri la bsnyen bkur mdzad/ de'i dpyid gar lha dang bla mas lung bstan te 'brog dge ldan na ma par rgyal ba'i gling btab nas 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad bzang gong du 'phel/ de lta bu'i 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi grub 'bras gsung gi bdud rtsi 107

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/gzhung chen por bsam byung gis dpyad de rtse gcig tu nyams su bzhes pas bla ma dang lhag pa'i lhas rjes su bzung / khyad par mgon po klu sgrub yab sras kyis byin gyis brlabs pa la brten/ 'grel pa bud+dha pā li tar gzigs pas/ rtsa she'i rab byed brgyad pa'i brten nas 'byung ba med pa yi/ /zhes sogs kyi 'grel ba la brten nas stong nyid gsar du rtogs pa'i tshul bstan/ de ltar rang nyid lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan mtha' dag la dbang 'byor nas gzhan rjes su bzung ba'i slad/ dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i phyag len phra zhib kyis gzhi bzung / sdom pa gong ma gnyis kyi bcas pa'i mtshams las nam yang mi 'da' ba'i bslab pas bstan pa'i rmang btsugs te/ mon mkhar bkra shis gdong du nyin re bzhin gzhung lugs chen po bco lnga re'i tshig don 'khrul med du gsungs pas mtshon 'chad pa dang / gsang phu/ sa skya/ rtse gdong rnams su ka pod lnga la grwa skor mdzad pa'i tshe phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i grags pas khyab pa sogs rtsod pa dang / jo bo yab sras dang / rgya gar gyi paṇa grub mang pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i snang ba la brten nas byang chub lam rim che chung dang / sngags rim chen mo sogs kyi rtsom pa ut+pal gzhon nu'i chun po pod chen bco brgyad tsam blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyi rna ba'i rgyan du byon/ nga gsum pa glangalor lha ldan du smon lam mo btsugs te dge 'dun khri la bsnyen bkur mdzad/ de'i dpyid gar lha dang bla mas lung bstan te 'brog dge ldan na ma par rgyal ba'i gling btab nas 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad bzang gong du 'phel/ de lta bu'i 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi grub 'bras gsung gi bdud rtsi 107

bgechen 'od snangal / saskya'i choga'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()las skyes pa'i slob ma la'ang / rang gi bla ma chos 'brel gsan pa bzhi/ snga tshar bzhi/ 'khor dag pa rnam brgyad/ khyad par du 'phagasapa'i srasagasum/ phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bu chen bzhi/ dbus gtsang gi bstan pa'i sgron me bcu/ gzhan don lhun gyis grub pa'i semasadapa' bcu/ mi dbang gtsug na mdzes pa'i ti shrī gnyis/ rgya chen mang du thos pa'i dbon srasaganyis/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan 'dzin pa'i lcog che chung gnyis/ bstan pa phyogs mthar spel ba'i dar chen drug sogs/ mdor na dus der gangs can du byon pa'i sa rngog bka' phyag gi bstan 'dzin phal cher gyis zhabs kyi pad+mo gus pas bsten pa na/thams cad mkhyen pa 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal gyis/ de dus sa chen po 'di rje btsun tsong kha pa'i gdugasadakar po gcig gis khyab yod pa yin/ ces ched du brjod pa'ang don la gnas so/ /slob ma'i gtso bo ni/ rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ rgyal tshab rje/ mkhasagrub rje/ 'jam dbyangasachos rje/ byams chen pa sher seng / dge 'dun grub/ sher bzang rnam gnyis rnamasaso/ /de ltar mkhyen brtse nus pa'i phrin las thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang rnam dbyer med pas rgyal ba'i bstan pa la ston pa gnyis pa'i bya ba mdzad de/ mthar dgung lo re gsum pa sa phag hor zla bcu pa'i dmar phyogs kyi tshes bcur sprul sku'i bkod pa bsdus/ de la brten nas dga' ldan lnga mchod ces deng sang gi bar du dar ba 'di gcig pu'i rnam dkar gyi phrin las kyang bsam par ga la nus/blun po 'ga' zhig gis dam pa ma yin pa'i sprul par sgro btags pa sogs ni mi bzad pa'i las su nges pas na bag yod par bya'o/ /de ltar thub dbang 108

pa tshe chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()las skyes pa'i slob ma la'ang / rang gi bla ma chos 'brel gsan pa bzhi/ snga tshar bzhi/ 'khor dag pa rnam brgyad/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i sras gsum/ phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bu chen bzhi/ dbus gtsang gi bstan pa'i sgron me bcu/ gzhan don lhun gyis grub pa'i sems dpa' bcu/ mi dbang gtsug na mdzes pa'i ti shrī gnyis/ rgya chen mang du thos pa'i dpon sras gnyis/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan 'dzin pa'i lcog che chung gnyis/ bstan pa phyogs mthar spel ba'i dar chen drug sogs/ mdor na dus der gangs can du byon pa'i sa rngog bka' phyag gi bstan 'dzin phal cher gyis zhabs kyi pad+mo gus pas bsten pa na/thams cad mkhyen pa 'gos lo gzhen nu dpal gyis/ de dus sa chen po 'di rje btsun tsong kha pa'i gdugs dkar po gcig gis khyab yod pa yin/ ces ched du brjod pa'ang don la gnas so/ /slob ma'i gtso bo ni/ rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ rgyal tshab rje/ mkhas grub rje/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje/ byams chen pa sher seng / dge 'dun grub/ sher bzang rnam gnyis rnams so/ /de ltar mkhyen brtse nus pa'i phrin las thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang rnam dbyer med pas rgyal ba'i bstan pa la ston pa gnyis pa'i bya ba mdzad de/ mthar dgung lo re gsum pa sa phag hor zla bcu pa'i dmar phyogs kyi tshes bcur sprul sku'i bkod pa bsdus/ de la brten nas dga' ldan lnga mchod ces deng sang gi bar du dar ba 'di gcig pu'i rnam dkar gyi phrin las kyang bsam par ga la nus/blun po 'ga' zhig gis dam pa ma yin pa'i sprul par sgro btags pa sogs ni mi bzad pa'i las su nges pas na bag yod par bya'o/ /de ltar thub dbang 108

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/gangs ri'i dbang po las babs pa'i mdo sngags kyi chu klung 'bum phrag gcig tu 'khyil ba'i chu gter/ bshad sgrub lasagasum dang / bslab pa gsum dang rim pa gnyis kyi yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas/ mkhas grub gdengs can bye ba'i bsti gnas dpal mnyam med ri bo dge ldan pa'i gser khrir khri thog dang po/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po shar tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal nyid dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa gsum par phebs/ drug cu re gsum gyi bar lo bcur bzhugs/ de nas rim par gtsang nyang stod ri nang pa rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen/ la stod byang gi ldog lod pa mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang /lcags ra ba/ 'di yan la rje yab sras gsumazhesagrags/ gtsang zha sdo/ ba legs pa rgyal mtshan/ gtsang rong g.yag sde pa blo gros 'otshogaskyong / chos lung tshogs pa/ mkhan(grub rin po che'i sku mched chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ 'di la sprul pa'i glegs bam yang phyag tu byung / gtsang pa rje blo gros(bstan pa 'disadwagasapo grwa tshang btab/ la stod byang pa/ rje smon lam dpal legs pa'i blo gros/ rgyal tshab nasa'adi'i bar la 'jam dbyangasagatsang pa bdun du grags/ rje rin po che'i sku tsha klu 'bum blo bzang / shangasamagron khang gnas ning ba/ nyi ma khams ldan ma/ 'bras spungs sgo mang / blo gsal gling pa shar rtse ye shes bzang po/ 'di bar lo gnyis ma tshang / gtsang 'dar pa shar rtse blo bzang grags pa/ e pa nyi ma thang pa/ byang rtse 'jam dbyangagashesarab legs pa'i blo gros/ stod mda' pa shar rtse/ blo gsal gling pa/ chos kyi bshes gnyen/ stod lung pa mda' pa/ zhi bzang blogleng / byang rtse rin chen 'od zer/ rtsed dwangasanang pa ral ma pa'i sras shar rtse nyi ma thang dar ser byesapa/ paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa'i 109

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/gangs ri'i dbang po las babs pa'i mdo sngags kyi chu klung 'bum phrag gcig tu 'khyil ba'i chu gter/ bshad sgrub las gsum dang / bslab pa gsum dang rim pa gnyis kyi yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas/ mkhas grub gdengs can bye ba'i bsti gnas dpal mnyam med ri bo dge ldan pa'i gser khrir khri thog dang po/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po shar tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal nyid dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa gsum par phebs/ drug cu re gsum gyi bar lo bcur bzhugs/ de nas rim par gtsang nyang stod ri nang pa rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen/ la stod byang gi ldog lod pa mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang /lcags ra ba/ 'di yan la rje yab sras gsum zhes grags/ ga sgyu ming zha sdo/ ba legs pa rgya95 mtshan/ gtsang rong g.yag sde pa blo gros chos skyong / chos lung tshogs pa/ mkhasagrub rin po che'i sku mched chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ 'di la sprul pa'i glegs bam yang phyag tu byung / gtsang pa rje blo gros bstan pa 'dis dwags po grwa tshang btab/ la stod byang pa/ rje smon lam dpal legs pa'i blo gros/ rgyal tshab nas 'di'i bar la 'jam dbyangs gtsang pa bdun du grags/ rje rin po che'i sku tsha klu 'bum blo bzang / shangs mgron khang gnas rnying ba/ nyi ma khams ldan ma/ 'bras spungs sgo mang / blo gsal gling pa shar rtse ye shes bzang po/ 'di bar lo gnyis ma tshang / gtsang 'dar pa shar rtse blo bzang grags pa/ e pa nyi ma thang pa/ byang rtse 'jam dbyangs shes rab legs pa'i blo gros/ stod mda' pa shar rtse/ blo gsal gling pa/ chos kyi bshes gnyen/ stod lung pa mda' pa/ zhi bzang blo nga / byang rtse rin chen 'od zer/ rtsed dwangs nang pa ral ma pa'i sras shar rtse nyi ma thang dar ser byes pa/ paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa'i 109

brtse chen 'od palas/ saskya'i motho'abyung gce4bsdus/ ()dpal rnam dpyod mchog gi sde/ dbusastod rgya ra gur pa b.ragrwa tsā / byang rtse chos skyong rgya mtsho/'disargyud smad khri wo brgyad mdzad/ khams mi nyag ser smad shar rtse rdo rje bzang po/ stod lung mda'i dngos gzhi pa shar rtse ngag dbang chos grags/dbus stod stag phu ba ser byes byang rtse chos grags bzang po/ 'ol kha gyang gsar pa shar rtse bsam gling ba/ bde ba can pa dge legs dpal bzang / rlung shod dbu sna pa bar grwa tsha / byang rtse dge 'dun bstan pa dar rgyas/ rtsed dwangs pa shar rtse tshe brtan rgya mtsho/ dbus stod zhogs pa gam gru/ byang rtse mngon dga' ba byams pa rgya mtsho/ stod lung spa ra ba rwa ba stod pa shar rtse rgyal khang rtse pa dpal 'byor rgya mtsho/ gtsang gnasapa byang rtse dmar chos 'bar/ mal gro rin chen gling pa dga' ldan nyag rong pa shar rtse sangs rgyas rin chen/ lha sa lum pa shag pa byang rtse ser byesapa/ dge 'dun rgyal mtshan/ mdo smad co ne ser smad shar rtse bshams grags pa'am mtshan gzhan bsod nams don grub/ stod lung mda' pa ra ba stod byang rtse khri chen stag lung gragasapa blo grosargya mtsho/ 'di rgyagarashu chu bo gaṅgā tshun chod du mkhas par grags/ khams 'jang zhabs pa blo gsal gling shar rtse 'jam dbyangs dam chos dpal ba/ gtsang nyang stod 'brong rtse ba ser byes byang rtse tshul khrims chos 'phel/ dbus stod ge re shar rtse grags pa rgya mtsho/ rwa ba stod dang bar grwa tshang pa/ 'phan yul de gong pa gsal khang sku skye byang rtse ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ 'disargyal dbang lnga pa wo po'i yongasa'adzin mdzad/4gra nang pa dwags po dang rwa ba stod shar rtse 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog chos 'phel/ kong po bkra shis rab brtan dwags po grwa tshang byang rtse bstan 'dzin legs bshad/ 'di'i skabasasu shar 110

brtse chen 'od pa las/ sa skya'i chosang gce4bsdus/ ()dpal rnam dpyod mchog gi sde/ dbus stod rgya ra gur pa bar grwa tsā / byang rtse chos skyong rgya mtsho/'dis rgyud smad khri wo brgyad mdzad/ khams mi nyag ser smad shar rtse rdo rje bzang po/ stod lung mda'i dngos gzhi pa shar rtse ngag dbang chos grags/dbus stod stag phu ba ser byes byang rtse chos grags bzang po/ 'ol kha gyang gsar pa shar rtse bsam gling ba/ bde ba can pa dge legs dpal bzang / rlung shod dbu sna pa bar grwa tsha / byang rtse dge 'dun bstan pa dar rgyas/ rtsed dwangs pa shar rtse tshe brtan rgya mtsho/ dbus stod zhogs pa gam gru/ byang rtse mngon dga' ba byams pa rgya mtsho/ stod lung spa ra ba rwa ba stod pa shar rtse rgyal khang rtse pa dpal 'byor rgya mtsho/ gtsang gnas pa byang rtse dmar chos 'bar/ mal gro rin chen gling pa dga' ldan nyag rong pa shar rtse sangs rgyas rin chen/ lha sa lum pa shag pa byang rtse ser byes pa/ dge 'dun rgyal mtshan/ mdo smad co ne ser smad shar rtse bshams grags pa'am mtshan g.yin bsod nams don grub/ stod lung mda' pa ra ba stod byang rtse khri chen stag lung grags pa blo gros rgya mtsho/ 'di rgya gar shu chu bo gaṅgā tshun chod du mkhas par grags/ khams 'jang 'khas pa blo gsal gling shar rtse 'jam dbyangs dam chos dpal ba/ gtsang nyang stod 'brong rtse ba ser byes byang rtse tshul khrims chos 'phel/ dbus stod ge re shar rtse grags pa rgya mtsho/ rwa ba stod dang bar grwa tshang pa/ 'phan yul de gong pa gsal khang sku skye byang rtse ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ 'dis rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pa'i yongs 'dzin mdzad/4gra nang pa dwags po dang rwa ba stod shar rtse 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog chos 'phel/ kong po bkra shis rab brtan dwags po grwa tshang byang rtse bstan 'dzin legs bshad/ 'di'i skabs su shar 110

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/ byang gnyis gleng gzhi byung bar brten sde pa gtsang pasalo bdun re resamosadagosapa byas/ 'jang tham pa ser smad shar rtse dge 'dun rin chen/ dwags gro mda' pa dwags po grwa tshang byang rtse bstan pa rgyal mtshan nam chos rgyal bkra shis/ stod lung chu bzang pa 'bras sgo mang shar rtse dkon mchog chos bzang / 'di lha smo pa dang po'i dusakyi gcig yin/ mnga' risaspri ti brang mkhar ba mnga' ris grwa tshang byang rtse dpal ldan rgyal mtshan nam mtshan gzhan ngag dbang rdo rje/ rtsed dwangs pa ra ba stod shar rtse blo bzang rgyal mtshan/ dbusastod zhog pa 'phan lan/ ser byes byang rtse blo bzang don yod/ 'di la 'ga' zhig gisakhri rnam dag rdo rje yang zer/ rgyal sa dwags po grwa tshang shar rtse gling yag pa byams pa bkra shis/ a mdo sku 'bum pa 'bras spungs sgo mang byang rtse ngag dbang blo gros rgya mtsho/ 'di la khri r+ṣa rgya nag pa'ang zer a mdo co ne zho bzang pa ser smad shar rtse 'jam dbyangs tshul khrims dar rgyas/ 'disargyal ba si r+ṣa tshangasadabyangasargya mtsho'i yongasa'adzin mdzad/ a mdo bsam blo 'bras spungs sgo mang byang rtse bka' 'gyur ba sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ 'di langag dbang dpal bzang yangazer/ khams yang steng pa ser smad shar rtse blo bzang chos 'phel/ kre nag tshang pa 'bras spungs sgo mang byang rtse don grub rgya mtsho/ 'disakyang rgyal ba rin po che tshangasadabyangasargya mtsho'i yongasa'adzin mdzad/ a mdo co ne a gzigasathang pa/ ser smad shar rtse blo bzang dar rgyas/'di kyang rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i yongasa'adzin mdzad/ a mdo bya bral ba wa shul/ 'bras spungs sgo mang byang rtse dge 'dun phun tshogs/ 'di la khri gung thang ba'ang zer/ a mdo rta 'on to+o tshangago nyin pa/ 'brasasgo mang shar rtse dpal ldan grags pa/ 'disakyang rgyal ba skal bzang rgya 50 yongasa'adzin mdzad/ tsa ri g.yag zhol ba dwags po grwa tshang byang rtse 111

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/ byang gnyis gleng gzhi byung bar brten sde pa gtsang pas lo bdun re res mos dgos pa byas/ 'jang tham pa ser smad shar rtse dge 'dun rin chen/ dwags gro mda' pa dwags po grwa tshang byang rtse bstan pa rgyal mtshan nam chos rgyal bkra shis/ stod lung chu bzang pa 'bras sgo mang shar rtse dkon mchog chos bzang / 'di lha smo pa dang pa'i dus kyi gcig yin/ mnga' ris spi ti brang mkhar ba mnga' ris grwa tshang byang rtse dpal ldan rgyal mtshan nam mtshan gzhan ngag dbang rdo rje/ rtsed dwangs pa ra ba stod shar rtse blo bzang rgyal mtshan/ dbus stod shog pa 'phan sh+ka/ ser byes byang rtse blo bzang don yod/ 'di la 'ga' zhig gis khri rnam dag rdo rje yang zer/ rgyal sa dwags po grwa tshang shar rtse gling yag pa byams pa bkra shis/ a mdo sku 'bum pa 'bras spungs sgo mang byang rtse ngag dbang blo gros rgya mtsho/ 'di la khri r+ṣa rgya nag pa'ang zer a mdo co ne zho bzang pa ser smad shar rtse 'jam dbyangs tshul khrims dar rgyas/ 'dis rgyal ba rin chen tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i yongs 'dzin mdzad/ a mdo bsam blo 'bras spungs sgo mang byang rtse bka' 'gyur ba sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ 'di lang ga dbang dpal bzang yang zer/ khams yang steng pa ser smad shar rtse blo bzang chos 'phel/ kre nag tshang pa 'bras spungs sgo mang byang rtse don grub rgya mtsho/ 'dis kyang rgyal ba rin po che tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i yongasa'adzin mdzad/ a mdo co ne a gzigs thang pa/ ser smad shar rtse blo bzang dar rgyas/'di kyang rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i yongs 'dzin mdzad/ a mdo bya bral ba wa shul/ 'bras spungs sgo mang byang rtse dge 'dun phun tshogs/ 'di la khri gung thang ba'ang zer/ a mdo rta 'on hor tshang go wo pa/ 'bras sgo mang shar rtse dpal ldan grags pa/ 'dis kyang rgyal ba skal bzang rgya 50 yongs 'dzin mdzad/ tsa ri g.yag zhol ba dwags po grwa tshang byang rtse 111

ba 'od snang la / saskya'i chosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()ngag dbang tshe 'phel/ a mdo rta 'on chosa'akhor ba 'bras sgo mang shar rtse rgyal mtshan seng she sa mdo bya khyung ba ser byes byang rtse zhwa ser bstan pa'i gsal byed a chi thu no min han ngag dbang mchog ldan/ 'disakyang rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i yongasa'adzin mdzad/ a mdo gzhung pa mi+og ri ldan thang pa 'bras sgo mang shar rtse ngag dbang nam mkha' bzang po'am mtshan gzhan blo bzang dpal ldan/ khams shog drug pa 'bras blo gling byang rtse spo 'bor blo bzang dri med/ dbus stod lo mda' phag mo chos sde ba 'brasablo gling shar rtse bsam gtan phun tshogs/ 'di rje rin po che'i sprul par rje rang nyid kyisalung bstan pa yin no/ /a mdo bya khyung ba ser byes byang rtse ngag dbang chos grags/ 'disargyal ba 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i yong sa'adzin mdzad/ stod lung chu bzang ba ser smad shar rtse ngag dbang chos grags/ 'di la khri lha thob yang zer/khams tsha ba ra lo ba/ ser byesabyang rtse blo bzang bstan pa/ 'disakyang rgyal ba 'jam dpal rgya mtsho yongasa'adzin mdzad/ a mdo co ne+e ser smad tsha thor ba shar rtse no min han ngag dbang tshul khrims/ 'dis bod kyi srid skyong dang rgyal ba 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i yongs 'dzin gnyisakamadzad/ khams rgyal rong spro snang pa 'brasablo gling pa byang rtse blo bzang smon lam/ 'phan yul bas grong pa ser smad shar rtse blo bzang mkhas mchog zla ba drug tre'o brag mgo'i zhabs na 'dzoms pa dar rgyas dgon pa ser byes byang rtse blo bzang bkra shis/ khams rgyal thang pa yang thang / ser smad shar rtse dge 'dun tshul khrims/ a mdo bya khyung pa ser byesabyang rtse ngag dbang snyan grags/ 'disargyal ba lung rtogasargya mtsho dang tshul khrimasargya mtsho gnyisarka'i yongasa'adzin mdzad/ khams mu li ba 'bras blo gling shar rtse bka' 'gyur ba 'jam dbyangs smon lam/ zla ba gsum/112

ba chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chosang gces bsdus/ ()ngag dbang tshe 'phel/ a mdo rta 'on chos 'khor ba 'bras sgo mang shar rtse rgyal mtshan seng she sa mdo bya khyung ba ser byes byang rtse zhwa ser bstan pa'i gsal byed a chi thu no min han ngag dbang mchog ldan/ 'dis kyang rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i yongs 'dzan mdzad/ a mdo gzhung pa rmog ri ldan thang pa 'bras sgo mang shar rtse ngag dbang nam mkha' bzang po'am mtshan gzhan blo bzang dpal ldan/ khams shog drug pa 'bras blo gling byang rtse spo 'bor blo bzang dri med/ dbus stod lo mda' phag mo chos sde ba 'bras blo gling shar rtse bsam gtan phun tshogs/ 'di rje rin po che'i sprul par rje rang nyid kyis lung bstan pa yin no/ /a mdo bya khyung ba ser byes byang rtse ngag dbang chos grags/ 'dis rgyal ba 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i yong sa 'dzin mdzad/ stod lung chu bzang ba ser smad shar rtse ngag dbang chos grags/ 'di la khri lha thob yang zer/khams tsha ba ra lo ba/ ser byes byang rtse blo bzang bstan pa/ 'dis kyang rgyal ba 'jam dpal rgya mtsho yongs 'dzin mdzad/ a mdo co ba ser smad tsha thor ba shar rtse no min han ngag dbang tshul khrims/ 'dis bod kyi srid skyong dang rgyal ba 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i yongs 'dzin gnyis ka mdzad/ khams rgyal rong spro snang pa 'bras blo gling pa byang rtse blo bzang smon lam/ 'phan yul bas grong pa ser smad shar rtse blo bzang mkhas mchog zla ba drug tre'o brag mgo'i zhabs na 'dzoms pa dar rgyas dgon pa ser byes byang rtse blo bzang bkra shis/ khams rgyal thang pa yang thang / ser smad shar rtse dge 'dun tshul khrims/ a mdo bya khyung pa ser bye ba'i byang rtse ngag dbang snyan grags/ 'disargyal ba lung rtogs rgya mtsho dang tshul khrims rgya mtsho gnyis ka'i yongs 'dzin mdzad/ khams mu li ba 'bras blo gling shar rtse bka' 'gyur ba 'jam dbyangs smon lam/ zla ba gsum/112

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/'phan yul rgyal sa ser smad tsha ba byang rtse blo bzang dge legs/ khams cha 'phrin bsam 'phel gling pa dga' ldan nyag rong shar rtse byang chub chos 'phel/'disakyang rgyal ba lung rtogasargya mtsho'i yongasa'adzin mdzad/ 'bras sgo mang hor bka' 'gyur ba byang rtse ngag dbang chorunga'aphel/ 'disakyang rgyal dbang tshul khrimasargya mtsho'i yongasa'adzin mdzad/ kong po 'bru la ba ser smad shar rtse ye shes thar 'dod/ gtsang thob rgyal ba ser byes byang rtse 'jam dpal tshul khrims/ mdo smad rtse ne ba ser smad shar rtse no min han ngag dbang 'jam dpal tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ bod kyi srid skyong dang rgyal ba tshul khrimasargya mtsho'i yongasa'adzin mdzad/ rgyal rong tsha go mchog rtse ba ser smad byang rtse blo bzang lhun sdo/ba 'disargyal dbang thamasacad mkhyen pa mkhas grub rgya mtsho'i yongasa'adzin mdzad kyi bar la khri rabs bdun cu rtsa bzhi/ don lnga pa gling pa shar rtse ngag dbang lung rtogs yon tan rgya mtsho/ don drug pa rgyal rong byang blo bzang mkhyen rab dbang phyug don bdun pa spom 'bor shar rtse tshul khrims dar rgyas/ don brgyad pa rgyal rong byang rtse 'jam dbyangs dam chos/ don dgu pa dga' ldan phu khang ba shar blo bzang sbyin pa/ brgyad cu pa bsam blo byang rtse gragasapa don grub/ gya gcig pa zung chu shar ngag dbang nor bu/ gya gnyis pa rgyal rong dar rtse mdo pa byang rtse ye shes chos 'phel byon nas bshad sgrub phrin las kyi snang bas sa gsum bstan 'gro'i rgud pa'i smag rum mtha' dag bsal te/ phan bde'i pad+mo ches cher rgyas par mdzad do/ /dpal 'bras spungs kyi chos grwa ni/ rje rin po che'i dngos slob 'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan zhes mdo phyogs kyi pu ti brgya dang brgyad 113

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/'phan yul rgyal sa ser smad tsha ba byang rtse blo bzang dge legs/ khams cha 'phrin bsam 'phel gling pa dga' ldan nyag rong shar rtse byang chub chos 'phel/'dis kyang rgyal ba lung rtogs rgya mtsho'i yongs 'dzin mdzad/ 'bras sgo mang hor bka' 'gyur ba byang rtse ngag dbang chob/'phel/ 'dis kyang rgyal dbang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i yongs 'dzan mdzad/ kong po 'bru la ba ser smad shar rtse ye shes thar 'dod/ gtsang thob rgyal ba ser byes byang rtse 'jam dpal tshul khrims/ mdo smad rtse ne ba ser smad shar rtse no min han ngag dbang 'jam dpal tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ bod kyi srid skyong dang rgyal ba tshur khrims rgya rma'i yongs 'dzan mdzad/ rgyal rong tsha go mchog rtse ba ser smad byang rtse blo bzang lhun sdi/ba 'dis rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa mkhas grub rgya mtsho'i yongs 'dzan mdzad kyi bar la khri rabs bdun cu rtsa bzhi/ don lnga pa gling pa shar rtse ngag dbang lung rtogs yon tan rgya mtsho/ don drug pa rgyal rong byang blo bzang mkhyen rab dbang phyug don bdun pa spom 'bor shar rtse tshul khrims dar rgyas/ don brgyad pa rgyal rong byang rtse 'jam dbyangs dam chos/ don dgu pa dga' ldan phu khang ba shar blo bzang sbyin pa/ brgyad cu pa bsam blo byang rtse grags pa don grub/ gya gcig pa zung chu shar ngag dbang nor bu/ gya gnyis pa rgyal rong dar rtse mdo pa byang rtse ye shes chos 'phel byon nas bshad sgrub phrin las kyi snang bas sa gsum bstan 'gro'i rgud pa'i smag rum mtha' dag bsal te/ phan bde'i pad+mo ches cher rgyas par mdzad do/ /dpal 'bras spungs kyi chos grwa ni/ rje rin po che'i dngos slob 'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan zhes mdo phyogs kyi pu ti brgya dang brgyad 113

'tshechen 'od snang las/ saskya'i mosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()thugs las shar gyis gsungs pas mtshon mkhas shing grub pa'i mngon rtogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa des dgung lo so brgyad pa me spel lor btab/ 'di la sngar sgo mang / blo gsal gling / bde yangs/ shag sgor/ 'dul ba/ sngags pa grwa tshang ste bdun byung yang / phyisasgo mang / khang 'a gcodrug blo gsal gling / bde yangs/ sngags pa bzhir dril/ de yang sgo mang du gung ru chos 'byung dang /'jam dbyangs bayid pa/ blo gsal gling du/ kun mkhyen legasapa chosa'abyor ram 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i blo gros/ paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa/bde yangs su grwa tshang yon tan rgya mtsho/ shag sgor du snar thang pa rab mchogathos bsam gling du nyan po shākya rgyal mtshan rnams kyis 'chad nyan dang yig cha sogs rgya cher mdzad/se ra theg chen chos gling ni/ rje'i dngos slob byams chen chos rje shākya ye shes zhes lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan rje rang nyid dang mtshungs par bsngags te/ shar phyogs 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po'i mchod gnas su mnga' gsol ba de nyid kyis sa mo glang gi lor btab/ sngar grwa tshang khrag lnga yod pa las/ phyisasu byesapa/ smad pa/ sngagasapa grwa tshang gsum du dril/ byesapar 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i slob ma mus srid pa blo gros rin chen dang / smad par kun mkhyen byang chub 'bum gyis 'chad nyan mdzad nas rim par dar/ gzhan yang gu ru rgyal mtshan bzang po/ gnyal ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan sogs rig par smra ba'i dbang phyug du ma byon/gtsang bkra shis lhun po dpal gyi sde chen phyogs thams cad las rnam 114

ba tshe chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()thugs las shar gyis gsungs pas mtshon mkhas shing grub pa'i mngon rtogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa des dgung lo so brgyad pa me spel lor btab/ 'di la sngar sgo mang / blo gsal gling / bde yangs/ shag sgor/ 'dul ba/ sngags pa grwa tshang ste bdun byung yang / phyis sgo mang / khang 'a bas drug blo gsal gling / bde yangs/ sngags pa bzhir dril/ de yang sgo mang du gung ru chos 'byung dang /'jam dbyangs bzhad pa/ blo gsal gling du/ kun mkhyen legs pa chos ra ram 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i blo gros/ paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa/bde yangs su grwa tshang yon tan rgya mtsho/ shag sgor du snar thang pa rab mchogathos bsam gling du nyan po shākya rgyal mtshan rnams kyis 'chad nyan dang yig cha sogs rgya cher mdzad/se ra theg chen chos gling ni/ rje'i dngos slob byams chen chos rje shākya ye shes zhes lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan rje rang nyid dang mtshungs par bsngags te/ shar phyogs 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po'i mchod gnas su mnga' gsol ba de nyid kyis sa mo glang gi lor btab/ sngar grwa tshang khrag lnga yod pa las/ phyas su byes pa/ smad pa/ sngags pa grwa tshang gsum du dril/ byes par 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i slob ma mus srid pa blo gros rin chen dang / smad par kun mkhyen byang chub 'bum gyis 'chad nyan mdzad nas rim par dar/ gzhan yang gu ru rgyal mtshan bzang po/ gnyal ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan sogs rig par smra ba'i dbang phyug du ma byon/gtsang bkra shis lhun po dpal gyi sde chen phyogs thams cad las rnam 114

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/par rgyal ba'i gling ni/ bka' gdams glegs bam rin po cher/ mtho bkra shis brtan pa lhun po'i gnas/ /nor pad+ma rā ga lta bu bdun/ /zhes dang / lta bas mi ngoms gzi brjid can/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i bkra shis gnas/ /bkra shis (lhun po rgyal 'gyur lha rdzog /zhes sogs lung gis gsal bar zin pa bzhin paṇa chen dge 'dun grub pas dgung lo nga bdun par me yos lor btab/ dga' ldan bto nas lo nyer dgu lon/ byams chen sogs sku gsung thugs rten bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhengs/ bka' gdams pa'i sku mched gsum ga'i rnam thar 'khyongs pa ra mdzad/ gya bzhi pa shing rta lo'i rgyal zla'i tshes brgyad la gshegs/ de nasagadan sar paṇa chen bzang po bkra shis/ paṇa chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen ye shes rtse mo/ rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho sogs nas/ paṇa chen lha dbang blo gros kyi rjes su paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan bzhugs te/ de yang rje 'di nyid sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi ye shes sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rnam rol rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du bdag cag gi ston pa'i spyan sngar 'dri zhing lan ldon pa'i mchog 'phags pa rab 'byor dang / gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir lo tsā ba 'gos khug pa lhas btsas dang / 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa sogs dam pa'i skye ba brgyud mar bzung ba'i mthar/ rje rin po che'i nang thugs kyi sras gcig pu mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang nas rim par/ chos kyi rje bsod nams phyogs kyi dbang po/ rgyal ba dben sab blo bzang don grub/ de'i skye ba ni paṇa chen 'di nyid de gtsang rong ldan du bru rgyal ba'i zhal ngor 'khrungs ma thag ā li kā li'i sgra sgrog pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar bzung / bcu bzhi par mkhas 115

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar ning gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/par rgyal ba'i gling ni/ bka' gdams glegs bam rin po cher/ mtho bkra shis brtan pa lhun po'i gnas/ /nor pad+ma rā ga lta bu bdun/ /zhesadang / lta bsami ngoms gzi brjid can/ /mtshungasapa med pa'i bkra shis gnas/ /bkra shis (lhun po rgyal 'gyur shog /zhes sogs lung gis gsal bar zin pa bzhin paṇa chen dge 'dun grub pas dgung lo nga bdun par me yos lor btab/ dga' ldan btab nas lo nyer dgu lon/ byams chen sogs sku gsung thugs rten bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhengs/ bka' gdams pa'i sku mched gsum ga'i rnam thar 'khyongs pa ra mdzad/ gya bzhi pa shing rta lo'i rgyal zla'i tshesabargyad la gshegs/ de nasagadan sar paṇa chen bzang po bkra shis/ paṇa chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ paṇa ye shes rtse mo/ rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho sogs nas/ paṇa chen lha dbang blo gros kyi rjes su paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan bzhugs te/ de yang rje 'di nyid sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi ye shes sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rnam rol rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du bdag cag gi ston pa'i spyan sngar 'dri zhing lan ldon pa'i mchog 'phags pa rab 'byor dang / gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir lo tsā ba 'gos khug pa lhas btsas dang / 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa sogs dam pa'i skye ba brgyud mar bzung ba'i mthar/ rje rin po che'i nang thugs kyi srasagacig pu mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang nas rim par/ chos kyi rje bsod nams phyogs kyi dbang po/ rgyal ba dben sab blo bzang don grub/ de'i skye ba ni paṇa chen 'di nyid de gtsang rong ldan du bru rgyal ba'i zhal ngor 'khrungs ma thag ā li kā li'i sgra sgrog pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar bzung / bcu bzhi par mkhas 115

ba chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()grub sangs rgyas ye shes las rab tu byung / rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ 'ja' lus mngon gyur grub chen chos rje rdo rje/ dben sa pa blo bzang don grub/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes rnams las rim par brgyud pa'i dga' ldan bka' brgyud dam dben sa snyan brgyud ces grags pa'i gdams pas mtshon zab rgyas kyi gdams ngag rgya mtsho lta bu gsan/ bkra shis lhun por mdo phyogs la sbyangs/ paṇa chen dam chos yar 'phel las bsnyen par rdzogs/ rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho la bsnyen par rdzogs pa yin/ nyer bdun par gangs can chos 'phel dang / sum cu par bkra shis lhun po'i seṅge'i khrir phebs/ rgyal ba yon tan rgya mtsho dang / blo bzang rgya mtsho gnyis ga'i yongs 'dzin gnang bas mtshon 'khor lo gsum gyi phrin las rje bla ma rang nyid slar yang byon pa lta bur gyur pas gsung 'bum pod lnga phyis byon gyi dge ldan pa rnams 'di kho nar bsngags brjod che/ kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che'i gdan sa yang mdzad/ go gsum pa chu stag nag zla'i tshes bcu gnyis la dga' ldan chos kyi 'dun sar gshegs/ de nas rim par paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes gtsang thob rgyal du 'brungs/kyis rgyal ba bdun pa'i yongs 'dzin mdzad/bka' 'bum pod bzhi/ chos srid kyi stobs 'byor 'di dus kho na che/ paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes shangs phu sde pa bkra shis rtser lto zhwa dmar dgu pa dang mched du ga srungs sa rgyal ba brgyad pa'i yongs 'dzin mdzad/ gong ma chan lung rgyal pos gdan drangs nas rgya nag tu phebs te sku gshegs/bka' la bum pod lnga/ paṇa chen blo bzang dpal ldan bstan pa'i nyi mas shangs thob rgyal du 116

ba chen 'odasnangalas/ saskya'i chosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()grub sangs rgyas ye shes lasarab tu byung / rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ 'ja' lus mngon gyur grub chen chosarje rdo rje/ dben sa pa blo bzang don grub/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes rnams las rim par brgyud pa'i dga' ldan bka' brgyud dam dben sa snyan brgyud ces grags pa'i gdams pas mtshon zab rgyas kyi gdams ngag rgya mtsho lta bu gsan/ bkra shis lhun por mdo phyogs la sbyangs/ paṇa chen dam chos yar 'phel las bsnyen par rdzogs/ rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho la bsnyen par rdzogasapa yin/ nyer bdun par gangs can chos 'phel dang / sum cu par bkra shis lhun po'i seṅge'i khrir phebs/ rgyal ba yon tan rgya mtsho dang / blo bzang rgya mtsho gnyis ga'i yongs 'dzin gnang bas mtshon 'khor lo gsum gyi phrin las rje bla ma rang nyid slar yang byon pa lta bur gyur pas gsung 'bum pod lnga phyis byon gyi dge ldan pa rnams 'di kho nar bsngags brjod che/ kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che'i gdan sa yang mdzad/ go gsum pa chu stag nag zla'i tshes bcu gnyis la dga' ldan chos kyi 'dun sar gshegs/ de nas rim par paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes gtsang thob rgyal du 'brungs/kyis rgyal ba bdun pa'i yongs 'dzin mdzad/bka' 'bum pod bzhi/ chos srid kyi stobs 'byor 'di dus kho na che/ paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes shangasaphu sde pa bkra shisartser lto zhwa dmar dgu pa dang mched du 'grungasakyis rgyal ba brgyad pa'i yongs 'dzin mdzad/ gong ma chan lung rgyal pos gdan drangs nas rgya nag tu phebs te sku gshegs/bka' lathum pod lnga/ paṇa chen blo bzang dpal ldan bstan pa'i nyi mas shangasathob rgyal du 116

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/lubrungasapa/ rgyal ba dgu pa dang / bcu pa/ bcu gcig pa bcas kyi yongs 'dzin mdzad/ da lta zhabs pad brtan bzhin pa 'di'o/ / bka' 'bum pod dgu/ chos grwa 'dir shar rtse/ dkyil khang / thos bsam gling / sngagasapa ste bzhi las/ shar rtser dang po shangs ston dri med/ drug pa blo gros rgya mtsho/ dkyil khang nas brgyad pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dang / bcu pa mkhas grub bstan dar/ thos bsam gling du dang po kun mkhyen chos 'byor bzang po dang / bzhi pa khyung phrug byams pa bkra shis/ sngags par sngags chen paṇa chen chos rgyan dusadang por btsugasadakon mchog rgyal mtshan sogs mkhas grub mang du byon nas yig cha sogs rgya cher mdzad do / / ma 'ongs pa na paṇa chen nyid sham+bha la'i rigasaldan chos rgyal drag po 'khor lo can dang / rgyal dbang rin po che dmag dpon ha nu man+t+ra/ lcang skya rin po che dmag dpon drag po rnams su gyur te kla klo'i dpung tshogs bcom/ las sa dum bu bcu gnyis thams cad 'bras bu'i theg pa'i smin grol dang / rdzogs ldan gyi dga' ston la sbyor bar 'gyur zhes ye shes gzigs pa rnams gsungs so/ /de ltar se 'bras dge gsum bkra shis lhun po bzhi la grwa sa chen po bzhi zhes yongs su grags shing / gzhan yang rwa dwags mnga' gsum du grags pa ni/ snye thang stag tshang rwa ba stod ni smar khams grags pa bzang po sogs kyis bskyangs shing / tshad ma rigs pa'i 'byung gnas su gyur/ lho rgyud dwags po grwa tshang ni/dga' ldan gyi khri rabs bdun pa shangs pa blo gros brtan pas btab/ lho rgyud mnga' ris grwa tshang ni/ rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtshos dgung lo re drug par btsugs pa rnams kyang mtshan nyid kyi grwa sa che shos yin/ srid rgyud pa grwa tshang 117

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/'khrungs pa/ rgyal ba dgu pa dang / bcu pa/ bcu gcig pa bcas kyi yongs 'dzin mdzad/ da lta zhabs pad brtan bzhin pa 'di'o/ / bka' 'bum pod dgu/chos grwa 'dir shar rtse/ dkyil khang / thos bsam gling / sngags pa ste bzhi las/ shar rtser dang po shangs ston dri med/ drug pa blo gros rgya mtsho/ dkyil khang nas brgyad pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dang / bcu pa mkhas grub bstan dar/ thos bsam gling du dang po kun mkhyen chos 'byor bzang po dang / bzhi pa khyung phrug byams pa bkra shis/ sngags par sngags chen paṇa chen chos rgyan dus dang por btsugs dkon mchog rgyal mtshan sogs mkhas grub mang du byon nas yig cha sogs rgya cher mdzad do / / ma 'ongs pa na paṇa chen nyid sham+bha la'i rigs ldan chos rgyal drag po 'khor lo can dang / rgyal dbang rin po che dmag dpon ha nu man+t+ra/ lcang skya rin po che dmag dpon drag po rnams su gyur te kla klo'i dpung tshogs bcom/ las sa dum bu bcu gnyis thams cad 'bras bu'i theg pa'i smin grol dang / rdzogs ldan gyi dga' ston la sbyor bar 'gyur zhes ye shes gzigs pa rnams gsungs so/ /de ltar se 'bras dge gsum bkra shis lhun po bzhi la grwa sa chen po bzhi zhes yongs su grags shing / gzhan yang rwa dwags mnga' gsum du grags pa ni/ snye thang stag tshang rwa ba stod ni smar khams grags pa bzang po sogs kyis bskyangs shing / tshad ma rigs pa'i 'byung gnas su gyur/ lho rgyud dwags po grwa tshang ni/dga' ldan gyi khri rabs bdun pa shangs pa blo gros brtan pas btab/ lho rgyud mnga' ris grwa tshang ni/ rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtshos dgung lo re drug par btsugs pa rnams kyang mtshan nyid kyi grwa sa che shos yin/ srid rgyud pa grwa tshang 117

'tshechen 'od snangalas/ sa skya'i chosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()dang / lha sa'i rgyud smad pa ni rje shes rab seng shes btab/ rje lhu po tshere slob ma/rgyud stod pa ni rje shes rab seng ge'i slob ma rgyud chen kun dga' don grub kyis btab/ 'di gsum dge lugs pa'i sngags pa grwa tshang gi rtsa ba lta bu yin/ chos srid zung du 'brel ba'i pho brang chen po po ta la ni/ rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po dgung lo nyer lnga bzhes pa'i dus go shrī bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis bod khri skor bcu gsum thog mar phul zhing / dus der chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i gzim phug nyid lte ba lta bur mdzad nas bzhengs/ de yang rgyal dbang rin po che ni/'phags mchog lag na pad+mo bsam bzhin du sprul pa'i rnam rol du mar bzung ste gangs can gyi 'gro ba kun la bu gcig ma ltar lhag par brtse ba las/bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po dang / phyi dar gyi tshe rgyal ba 'brom ston pa sogs mtshan dang sku'i bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mthar/ rje rin po che'i spyan sngar paṇa chen dge 'dun grub pa ni/ dpal sa skya'i nye 'dabs srad gur ma ru ba zhes pa lcags mo lug gi lor 'khrungs/ dpal snar thang du chos sgor zhugs/ rgya ston tsan+d+ra de ba las klog bris/ mkhan shākya dpal las yig rigasadang / lo tsā ba saṃ gha shrī lasasnyan ngag dang mngon brjod/phyis sgra pa thugs rje dpal las sgra dang sdeb sbyor/ 'jam dbyangs rin rgyal las skar rtsis/ gnas de nyid dang gsang phu sogs su tshad masamatshon thun mong gi rig gnas dang / snar thang mkhan rabs bcu bzhi pa grub pa shes rab las rab tu byung zhing bka' gdams kyi gdams ngag dang / 'phan yul grong par 'dul ba/ 'jam dbyangs rin rgyal lasa'adul mdzod/ rje rin po che dang rgyal 118

'tshe chen 'od sna pa la / sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()dang / lha sa'i rgyud smad pa ni rje shes rab seng shes btab/ rje lhu po tshe'i slob ma/rgyud stod pa ni rje shes rab seng ge'i slob ma rgyud chen kun dga' don grub kyis btab/ 'di gsum dge lugs pa'i sngags pa grwa tshang gi rtsa ba lta bu yin/ chos srid zung du 'brel ba'i pho brang chen po po ta la ni/ rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po dgung lo nyer lnga bzhes pa'i dus go shrī bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis bod khri skor bcu gsum thog mar phul zhing / dus der chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i gzim phug nyid lte ba lta bur mdzad nas bzhengs/ de yang rgyal dbang rin po che ni/'phags mchog lag na pad+mo bsam bzhin du sprul pa'i rnam rol du mar bzung ste gangs can gyi 'gro ba kun la bu gcig ma ltar lhag par brtse ba las/bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po dang / phyi dar gyi tshe rgyal ba 'brom ston pa sogs mtshan dang sku'i bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mthar/ rje rin po che'i spyan sngar paṇa chen dge 'dun grub pa ni/ dpal sa skya'i nye 'dabs srad gur ma ru ba zhes pa lcags mo lug gi lor 'khrungs/ dpal snar thang du chos sgor zhugs/ rgya ston tsan+d+ra de ba las klog bris/ mkhan shākya dpal las yig rigs dang / lo tsā ba saṃ gha shrī las snyan ngag dang mngon brjod/phyis sgra pa thugs rje dpal las sgra dang sdeb sbyor/ 'jam dbyangs rin rgyal las skar rtsis/ gnas de nyid dang gsang phu sogs su tshad mas mtsho ni thun mong gi rig gnas dang / snar thang mkhan rabs bcu bzhi pa grub pa shes rab las rab tu byung zhing bka' gdams kyi gdams ngag dang / 'phan yul grong par 'dul ba/ 'jam dbyangs rin rgyal las 'dul mdzod/ rje rin po che dang rgyal 118

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnyingagi gdan rabasamador bsdus/tshab las dbu phar gyi gzhung dang rgyud 'grel sogs gsan cing / mdor na mkhas grub yongs 'dzin drug cu tsam lasaphyi nang rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag gsan cing byang chub pas ma hā paṇ+ḍita'i mtshan gyi snyan pa dang phrin las kyis sa gsum du khyab/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo sogasalhag pa'i lhasarjesasu bzung / 'dul ṭika dang / gleng 'bum chen mos mtshon gsung rtsom yang pu ti bdun tsam bzhugs so/ /rje de'i rnam 'phrul rgyal ba gnyisapa dge 'dun rgya mtsho ni/ gtsang rta nag tu sngags 'chang chen po kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi srasasu rab byung brgyad pa'i shing lug lor 'khrungs/ bcu gcig par bkra shis lhun por paṇa chen lung rigs rgya mtsho las rab tu byung / bcu gsum par 'bras spungs su 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen las mdo sngags kyi gsan bsam mdzad/ gzhan yang mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtsho sogs bsten/ sgra dbyangs lha mos rjes su bzung bas ja sbyor rer sho lo ka brgya phrag tsam thugs la zin pa sogs mkhyen rab bsam gyis mi khyab/ sa sbrul lor chos 'khor rgyal me tog thang btab/ ser 'bras dang bkra shis lhun po sogs kyi mkhan po mdzad/ gsung rtsom yang mtshan brjod 'grel chen sogasapod lnga bzhugasaso/ /gsum pa bsod nams rgya mtsho ni/ rje gong ma zhing gshegs ma thag pad+ma 'od du phebs pas/ slob dpon chen posalung gi bskul te slar yang stod lung mda' rtse dga' khang gsar du me'i rigs su mtshan dpe'i me tog bzhad/ 'bras spungs su paṇa chen bsod nams gragasapa sogs laba'igasan bsam mdzad/ sog yul du phebs nasa.a la than chos kyi rgyal pos mchod cing / tā la'i bla ma badz+ra 119

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/tshab las dbu phar gyi gzhung dang rgyud 'grel sogs gsan cing / mdor na mkhas grub yongs 'dzin drug cu tsam las phyi nang rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag gsan cing byang chub pas ma hā paṇ+ḍita'i mtshan gyi snyan pa dang phrin las kyis sa gsum du khyab/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo sogs lhag pa'i lhas rjes su bzung / 'dul ṭika dang / gleng 'bum chen mos mtshon gsung rtsom yang pu ti bdun tsam bzhugs so/ /rje de'i rnam 'phrul rgyal ba gnyis pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho ni/ gtsang rta nag tu sngags 'chang chen po kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi sras su rab byung brgyad pa'i shing lug lor 'khrungs/ bcu gcig par bkra shis lhun por paṇa chen lung rigs rgya mtsho las rab tu byung / bcu gsum par 'bras spungs su 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen las mdo sngags kyi gsan bsam mdzad/ gzhan yang mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtsho sogs bsten/ sgra dbyangs lha mos rjes su bzung bas ja sbyor rer sho lo ka brgya phrag tsam thugs la zin pa sogs mkhyen rab bsam gyis mi khyab/ sa sbrul lor chos 'khor rgyal me tog thang btab/ ser 'bras dang bkra shis lhun po sogs kyi mkhan po mdzad/ gsung rtsom yang mtshan brjod 'grel chen sogs pod lnga bzhugs so/ /gsum pa bsod nams rgya mtsho ni/ rje gong ma zhing gshegs ma thag pad+ma 'od du phebs pas/ slob dpon chen pos lung gi bskul te slar yang stod lung mda' rtse dga' khang gsar du me'i rigs su mtshan dpe'i me tog bzhad/ 'bras spungs su paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa sogs las gsan bsam mdzad/ sog yul du phebs nas a la than chos kyi rgyal pos mchod cing / tā la'i bla ma badz+ra 119

'tsher+sā 'od snang las/ saskya'i chogalngang r+sāsabasdus/ ()dhā ra zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ phyogs der dgon sde che phra mang du btab nas gshegs/ bka' 'thum pod gcig bzhi pa mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug yon tan rgya mtsho ni/ chen po hor gyi yul du jing gir gnam gyi rgyal po'i rigasasu 'brungs/blo bzang chos rgyan sogs las gsan bzhes gnang / mngon spyod kyi lasasbyor kyang mang du mdzad/ sku tshe mthar ma phyin par gshegs/ lnga pa khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho ni/ yar lung 'phyongasargyasa'aphying bar stag rtser za hor gyi rigs su me sprul lor 'khrungs/ o rgyan chen pos kyang gter kha du ma nas mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyi phrin las kyi sprul par lung bstan shin tu gsal/ 'khrungs lor byang bdag ngag gi dbang po las tshe dbang gsan pas rnying lugs la thugs phyogs pa'i rten 'brel du gyur/ chu khyi lor dpal ldan 'bras spungs su phebs/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan la gtsug phud phul/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel las mtshan nyid kyi phyogs dang /smon 'gro paṇ+ḍi ta yab sras las sgra snyan sdeb sbyor mngon brjod/ zlum po pa las skar rtsis/ zur chen las nag rtsis sogasadang /rngog r+yā rnam phral/ snga phyir paṇa chen chos rgyan/ pha bong kha pa 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ dpal 'byor phrin las rab rgyasakyangazer/ bka' 'gyur ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zha lu ba bsod nams mchog grub/ tshe dbang lhun grub rab brtan/ sman lung ba blo mchog rdo rje/ chos kyi rgyal po gter bdag gling pa sogs las gsar rnying gi chos tshul rgya mtsho lta bu gsan pas thams cad mkhyen pa'i mtshan don mtshungs par gyur cing gsan yig kyang pod chen bzhi bzhugs/ rnying 120

ba chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()spyi ra zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ phyogs der dgon sde che phra mang du btab nas gshegs/ bka' 'bum pod gcig bzhi pa mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug yon tan rgya mtsho ni/ chen po hor gyi yul du jing gir gnam gyi rgyal po'i rigs su 'brungs/blo bzang chos rgyan sogs las gsan bzhes gnang / mngon spyod kyi las sbyor kyang mang du mdzad/ sku tshe mthar ma phyin par gshegs/ lnga pa khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho ni/ yar lung 'phyongs rgyasang bar stag rtser za hor gyi rigs su me sprul lor 'khrungs/ o rgyan chen pos kyang gter kha du ma nas mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyi phrin las kyi sprul par lung bstan shin tu gsal/ 'khrungs lor byang bdag ngag gi dbang po las tshe dbang gsan pas rnying lugs la thugs phyogs pa'i rten 'brel du gyur/ chu khyi lor dpal ldan 'bras spungs su phebs/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan la gtsug phud phul/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel las mtshan nyid kyi phyogs dang /smon 'gro paṇ+ḍi ta yab sras las sgra snyan sdeb sbyor mngon brjod/ zlum po pa las skar rtsis/ zur chen las nag rtsis sogs dang /rngog lo'i rnam phral/ snga phyir paṇa chen chos rgyan/ pha bong kha pa 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ dpal 'byar phrin las rab rgyas kyang zer/ bka' 'gyur ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zha lu ba bsod nams mchog grub/ tshe dbang lhun grub rab brtan/ sman lung ba blo mchog rdo rje/ chos kyi rgyal po gter bdag gling pa sogs las gsar rnying gi chos tshul rgya mtsho lta bu gsan pas thams cad mkhyen pa'i mtshan don mtshungs par gyur cing gsan yig kyang pod chen bzhi bzhugs/ rnying 120

gangasacan bod yuladu byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/phyogs nas byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal dang / gsar mar 'jam dbyangasamakhyen brtse'i dbang phyug kho nar bsngags brjod che/ gong ma shukyis rgyal posaspyan drangs te/ nub phyogs mchog tu dge ba'i zhing gi rgyal dbang sa steng gi rgyal bstan yongs kyi bdag po thams cad mkhyen pa badz+ra dhā ra/ zhes pa'i 'ja' sadang shel tham phul/ bshad sgrub las gsum gyi phrin las rgya gar gyi chu bo gaṅgā tshun chad nasashar phyogs tong ku'i yul gyi bar du khyab/ gsung rtsom kho na'ang /phyi rnam thar dang / rig gnas mtshan nyid kyi skor/ nang gsang sngagasaspyi'i skor/gsang ba gsang chen rnying ma'i skor/ yang gsang dag snang rgya can gyi skor rnamasal pod chen sum cu tham pa bzhugs so/ /re drug par dbo zla ba'i tshes nyer lnga la gshegs/ drug pa blo bzang rin chen tshangasadabyangasargya mtsho ni/ lho mon shing lo'i tshal du pad+ma gling pa'i gdung rigs su 'khrungs/ sngags kyi spyod pa bskyangs shing nyer lnga par rgya nag tu phebs lam gshegs/ bdun pa bskal bzang rgya mtsho ni/ li thang du 'khrungs/ paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes dang / khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan sogs las gsan bzhes mdzad/ mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan 'gran zla dang bral/ 'gar thar rnam par rgyal ba'i gling btab/gsang 'dus dbang gi rnam bshad chen po rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal lung sogs gsung rtsom legs bshad phul che ba —pod bdun bzhugs/ brgyad pa 'jam dpal rgya mtsho ni/ yul dbus su 'byungs/ paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shesadang yongs 'dzin paṇ+ḍita ye shes rgyal mtshan sogasalas gsan bsam mdzad/ dgu pa ngag dbang lung rtogs rgya mtsho ni/ khams 'dan yul chos 'khor du zhabrungs/121

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/phyogs nas byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal dang / gsar mar 'jam dbyangasamakhyen brtse'i dbang phyug kho nar bsngags brjod che/ gong ma shu kyis rgyal posaspyan drangs te/ nub phyogs mchog tu dge ba'i zhing gi rgyal dbang sa steng gi rgyal bstan yongs kyi bdag po thams cad mkhyen pa badz+ra ge ra/ zhes pa'i 'ja' sadang shel tham phul/ bshad sgrub las gsum gyi phrin las rgya gar gyi chu bo gaṅgā tshun chad nas shar phyogs tong ku'i yul gyi bar du khyab/ gsung rtsom kho na'ang /phyi rnam thar dang / rig gnas mtshan nyid kyi skor/ nang gsang sngags spyi'i skor/gsang ba gsang chen rnying ma'i skor/ yang gsang dag snang rgya can gyi skor rnamasal pod chen sum cu tham pa bzhugs so/ /re drug par dbo zla ba'i tshes nyer lnga la gshegs/ drug pa blo bzang rin chen tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho ni/ lho mon shing lo'i tshal du pad+ma gling pa'i gdung rigs su 'khrungs/ sngags kyi spyod pa bskyangs shing nyer lnga par rgya nag tu phebs lam gshegs/ bdun pa bskal bzang rgya mtsho ni/ li thang du 'khrungs/ paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes dang / khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan sogs las gsan bzhes mdzad/ mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan 'gran zla dang bral/ 'gar thar rnam par rgyal ba'i gling btab/gsang 'dus dbang gi rnam bshad chen po rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal lung sogs gsung rtsom legs bshad phul che ba rtse pod bdun bzhugs/ brgyad pa 'jam dpal rgya mtsho ni/ yul dbus su 'khrungs/ paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes dang yongs 'dzin paṇ+ḍita ye shes rgyal mtshan sogs las gsan bsam mdzad/ dgu pa ngag dbang lung rtogs rgya mtsho ni/ khams 'dan yul chos 'khor du 'brungs/121

ba 'a 'od snang la / saskya'i mosaphung tsosabasdus/ ()bcu pa tshul khrims rgya mtsho ni/ li thang du 'khrungs/ bcu gcig pa mkhasagrub rgya mtsho ni/ 'gar thar du 'khrungasashing / paṇa chen bstan pa'i nyi ma dang / khri chen blo bzang lhun grub sogs las gsan bsam mdzad cing gangs can bstan 'gro'i gtsug rgyan dam par zhabasapad brtan bzhin pa 'di'o/ /de bzhin lha ldan rang du rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i slob ma 'bor dag pa rnam brgyad kyi nang tshan dge slong 'jam dkar ba'i rnam 'phrul rim byon/ de mo hu thog thu'i gdan sabastan rgyas gling / rje'i dngos slob dga' ldan khri rabs drug pa ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi rnam 'phrul rta tshag rje drug rin po che'i gdan sa dbus gtsang kun bde gling / lo tsā ba lcog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan sogs kyi rnam 'phrul dga' ldan khri thog re gcig pa shar rtse no mi han ngag dbang tshul khrims gong 'og gi gdan sa tshe smon gling sogs kyang so so'i skye sprul rim byon gyisaskyong / lha ldan gyi thad grib tshe mchog bsam gtan gling ni/ rgyal ba brgyad pa'i yongs 'dzin paṇ+ḍita ye shesargyal mtshan gyisabatab/bka' lathum pod r+ṣa d+ku+o brgyad/ de'i skye sprul bzhugs/ stod mnga' ris su/ mang yul sngags mo'i chosagrwa ni/ rje shesarab bzang pos rje'i dngosaslob btab cing / de'i dbon shesarab pas khrigs se'i chos sde btsugs pa sogs dar rgyas che/ yar klung 'phyong rgyas ri bo bde chen ni/mkhas grub rje'i slob ma nyi khri 'dzin pa blo gros dpal bzang gis btab cing rgya cher 'phel/ 'ol dwags gnyis kyi mtshams su/ chosa'akhor rgyal me tog thang ni / rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtshos btab/ mdo smad yod ༄ya mdo mosazhabor byams gling ni/ byang sems shes rab bzang pos btab/ rje'i dngosaslob phyis su rje 122

ba chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()bcu pa tshul khrims rgya mtsho ni/ li thang du 'khrungs/ bcu gcig pa mkhas grub rgya mtsho ni/ 'gar thar du 'khrungs nga / paṇa chen bstan pa'i nyi ma dang / khri chen blo bzang lhun grub sogs las gsan bsam mdzad cing gangs can bstan 'gro'i gtsug rgyan dam par zhabs pad brtan bzhin pa 'di'o/ /de bzhin lha ldan rang du rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i slob ma 'khor dag pa rnam brgyad kyi nang tshan dge slong 'jam dkar ba'i rnam 'phrul rim byon/ de mo hu thog thu'i gdan sabastan rgyas gling / rje'i dngos slob dga' ldan khri rabs drug pa ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi rnam 'phrul rta tshag rje drug rin po che'i gdan sa dbus gtsang kun bde gling / lo tsā ba lcog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan sogs kyi rnam 'phrul dga' ldan khri thog re gcig pa shar rtse no mi han ngag dbang tshul khrims gong 'og gi gdan sa tshe smon gling sogs kyang so so'i skye sprul rim byon gyis skyong / lha ldan gyi thad grib tshe mchog bsam gtan gling ni/ rgyal ba brgyad pa'i yongs 'dzin paṇ+ḍita ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis btab/bka' 'bum pod r+ṣa bco brgyad/ de'i skye sprul bzhugs/ stod mnga' ris su/ mang yul sngags mo'i chos grwa ni/ rje shes rab bzang pos rje'i dngos slob btab cing / de'i dbon shes rab pas khrigs se'i chos sde btsugs pa sogs dar rgyas che/ yar klung 'phyong rgyas ri bo bde chen ni/mkhas grub rje'i slob ma nyi khri 'dzin pa blo gros dpal bzang gis btab cing rgya cher 'phel/ 'ol dwags gnyis kyi mtshams su/ chos 'khor rgyal me tog thang ni / rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtshos btab/ mdo smad yod cing mdo chos 'khor byams gling ni/ byang sems shes rab bzang pos btab/ rje'i dngos slob phyis su rje 122

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/rin po che'i dngos slob ku cor rtogs ldan gyi sras 'phags pa lha rim byon dang /de'i thugasasras zhi ba lha dang / lcags ra sprul sku rim byon rnamasakyis gdan sa mdzad/ smar khams sgang du brag g.yab no mi han gyi gdan sa ni/ nyag re bka' bcu gragasapa rgya mtshos btab/ de'i skye sprul rim byon la sprul sku che tshang dang /bka' bcu grags rgyal gyi slob ma sangs rgyas bkra shis rim byon la sprul sku chung tshang du grags pa'i skye sprul rim byon gyis skyong / dpal li thang gi chos grwa ni / rje bsod nams rgya mtsho'i phrin las lasabyung / mi lhag ra ba sgang gi sa yi char 'gar thar gyi chos sde ni/ rgyal ba bdun pa bskal bzang rgya mtsho phyogs der lo bdun bzhugs pa'i tshe gong ma g.yu shing ngam chan lung rgyal pos sbyin bdag mdzad nasabatab/ a mdo'i phyogasasu/ bya khyung dgon ni/ rje tsong kha pa'i bla ma don grub rin chen gyis btab/ rje sku 'bum byamasapa gling /ni spar dgon gnas kyi ming tsam zhig chagasapar/ rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i lung gis bskul nas/ chosarje 'od zer rgya mtshos mtshan nyid dang / sngagasapa/ phyisasman pa grwa tshang bcasabatsugs/ dgon lung byams pa gling ni/ rgyal ba yon tan rgya mtshos/ rgyal ba'i sras po mgon po rgya mtshor bkas bskul te btab/ phyis lcang skya rdo rje 'chang dang / rje thu'u bkwan rin po che sogs kyang byon/ yang byams chen chos rje shākya ye shesasogs kyi rnam 'phrul ngag dbang blo bzang mchog ldan gong ma bde skyid rgyal pos gdan drangs te/ tā go shrī zhes chab srid kyi bla ma chen por bsngags pa'i gser yig dang gser tham phul/ pho brang chen por gtsug lag khang 'ga' zhig dang mtsho bdun du lha khang chen po gsar du bskrun cing dge 123

brtsechen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()'dun gyi sde btsugs/ de'i sprul sku lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje gsung lathum pod bdun yod gong ma g.yung ṭing chen pos spyan drangs te sngar bzhin mtshan dang tham ka phul/de'i sprul sku ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan du grags pa'i bar byon yang gong ma g.yung shing gis sems dpa' chen po thu'u bkwan pa ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho pho brang gi bla mar mnga' gsol/ de'i sprul sku mkhas grub chen po blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma 'don cha gtso bor gyur pa pod bcu bdun yod/ de nas mkha' spyod skor pod gcig to mgrin gsang sgrub skor pod gsum yod/ gong 'og sogs byon/ gser khog dga' ldan dam chos gling ni/ dgon lung mkhan po btsan po don grub rgya mtshos btab/ phyis smin grol no mi han gyis rim gyis skyong / g.yer gshong grwa tshang ni/ sngags ram pa 'jam dbyangs blo gros kyis btsugs/ a mdo lho rgyud chos sde bkra shis 'khyil ni/ rje rin po che'i bla ma dbu ma pa la dpa' bo rdo rje'i rnam 'phrul 'jam dbyangs ba'ad pa ngag dbang brtson 'grus kyis btab/bka' 'bum pod bdun yod/de'i skye sprul dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po bka' 'bum pod lnga yod/ sogs kyis skyongs/ khri gung thang pa'i rnam 'phrul 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me bka' 'bum pod bcu yod/dang / dpal mang mkha' chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan bka' 'bum pod drug yod/ sogs deng sang gi bar du mkhas grub mang du byon/ thosabasam gling / rgyud pa/ dus 'khor/ sman pa grwa tshang ste bzhi yod cing / mdo smad tsam na che/ co ne+e dgon ni/ co ne'i dbon brgyud chos rje rin chen lhun pos btab/ phyis grags pa bshad sgrub gzhung mang po'i 'grel ba sogasabaka' 'bum pod bcu gcig yod/ sogs byon/ sog po'i phyogs su dgon gnas 124

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/thams cad kyi nang nas che shos hal ha'i yul gyi ri bo dge rgyas gling ni/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan sogs kyi skye brgyud/ rje btsun dam pa tā ra nā tha'i sku'i skye ba blo bzang bstan rgyan gyis btab/ de'i skye sprul rim byon bzhugs/ rgya nag tu/ gong ma g.yung ṭing chen pos/ pho brang chen po dga' ldan srid chags gling zhes pa'i chos sde dang / zhes ho'u zhes pa'i char yang gtsug lag khang dang / grwa tshang khag mang po btsugs pa sogs/ mdor na 'phagasayul rgya gar gyi sa mtshamasanas bzung ste/ shar phyogs rgya nag dang / sog po'i bar gyi yangs pa'i rgyal khams kun tu rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa'i ring lugs 'dzin pas ma khyab pa 'ga' yang med pa'i phyir mtshan tsam yang brjod par dka' ba nyid do/ /de ltar dpal mnyam med ri bo dge ldan pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig byon pa las yongs su grags pa ni/rje rin po che dngos kyi slob ma'i gtso bo sngar smos pa rnams dang / rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ bsod namaba'irgya mtsho/ lnga pa rin po che/ bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen rin po che sku phreng bzhi/ lcang skya rdo rje 'chang gong 'og sngags chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ skyi shod sprul sku bstan 'dzin phrin las/ 'jam dbyangs bayid pa sku gong 'og phur bu lcog byams pa rin po che/ 'jam dbyangs bde ba'i rdo rje/ stag phu rin po che/ ka chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ zhi bzang 'phags pa dge legs rgyal mtshan/ thu'u bkwan rin po che/ klong brdol grub chen ngag dbang blo bzang / gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs sogs byon zhing / de rnams kyi don gyi rnam par thar pa'ang / nges 'byung gis rgyud sbyangs te khas 125
