ba chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnam par dag pas gzhi bzung / mdo sngags kyi shing rta'i lam srol chen po rnams kyi gsung rab la thos bsam gyi sgra 'dogs bcad pas gzhung lugs ma lus pa gdams par shar 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi seṅge'i sgra chen po bsgrags pas bstan pa nyin mor ltar mdzad/bsgoms pas nyams su blangs pas byang chub sems bcos min du 'byongs/zab mo dbu ma'i man ngag la brten nas yang dag pa'i lta ba mngon du gyur/slar yang dpal gsang ba 'dus pa dang / 'khor lo bde mchog dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed sogs chos zab pa'i rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor yan lag dang bcas pas bar do tshun chad du zung 'jug go 'phang chen por gshegs pa ste/mdor na rje rin po che'i rtogs brjod mdun legs ma las dang por rgya chen thos pa mang du btsal//bar du gzhung lugs thams cad gdams par shar/ /tha ma nyin mtshan kun tu nyams su blangs/ /kun kyang bstan pa rgyas pa rgyu ru bsngos/ /ces sogs gsungs pa bzhin thugs nyams su bzhes pas mkhas shing dngos grub brnyes pa'i skyes bu dam pa ji snyed cig byon pa yin no/ /de dag las brgyud pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs bzhugs pa la/ thog mar dbang bka' la bya rgyud thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod/ dri med rnam gnyis/ gdugs dkar lha bcu bdun ma/ brgyud pa ma tshang / lha so lnga ma/ legs ldan mched gsum rjes gnang bcas/ bcu gcig zhal dpal lugs kyi dbang / rgyal sras thogs med nas brgyud pa/de dang 'brel ba'i mkha' 'gro lnga skor gyi rjes gnang mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu dang /bcu gsum ma sman bla so bdun ma sbyong rgyud/ 'di shin tu dkon/ rnam snang mngon 126

'tsher+ṣa 'od snang la / sa skya'i chosa'agrang khesabasdus/ ()blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnam par dag pas gzhi bzung / mdo sngags kyi shing rta'i lam srol chen po rnams kyi gsung rab la thos bsamo gyi sgra 'dags bcad pas gzhung lugs ma lus pa gdams par shar 'chad rtsad rtsam gsum gyi seṅge'i sgra chen po bsgrags pas bstan pa nyin mor ltar mdzad/bsgoms pas nyams su blangs pas byang chub sems bcos min du 'byongs/zab mo dbu ma'i man ngag la brten nas yang dag pa'i lta ba mngon du gyur/slar yang dpal gsang ba 'dus pa dang / 'khor lo bde mchog dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed sogs chos zab pa'i rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor yan lag dang bcas pas bar do tshun chad du zung 'jug go 'phang chen por gshegs pa ste/mdor na rje rin po che'i rtogs brjod mdun legs ma las dang por rgya chen thos pa mang du btsal//bar du gzhung lugs thams cad gdams par shar/ /tha ma nyin mtshan kun tu nyams su blangs/ /kun kyang bstan pa rgyasapa'i rgyu ru bsngos/ /ces sogs gsungs pa bzhin thugs nyams su bzhes pas mkhas shing dngos grub brnyes pa'i skyes bu dam pa ji snyed cig byon pa yin no/ /de dag las brgyud pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs bzhugs pa la/ thog mar dbang bka' la bya rgyud thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod/ dri med rnam gnyis/ gdugs dkar lha bcu bdun ma/ brgyud pa ma tshang / lha so lnga ma/ legs ldan mched gsum rjes gnang bcas/ bcu gcig zhal dpal lugs kyi dbang / rgyal srasathogasamed nasabargyud pa/de dang 'brel ba'i mkha' 'gro lnga skor gyi rjes gnang mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu dang /bcu gsum ma sman bla so bdun ma sbyong rgyud/ 'di shin tu dkon/ rnam snang mngon 126

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang stags gsar rnyang gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/byang /rnal 'byor rgyud rdor dbyings la/'jam dpal gsang ldan/kun rigasbyong dkyil bcas/bla med la/gsang 'dus rigs gsum/sngags btu'i byin rlabs bde mchog lugs gsum/dril bu lus dkyil/sngags btu/bong zhal shārwa dro /bye/ tsho ci ri zla dzog ma shā spra/tso/bye/can/'a shā byu rig bye mod ma/dpa' gcag ra langs brgyad skar/sngags na rlabs dpa' gcig rjes gnang /zhal phyag yongs rdzogs yum bcas kyi rjes gnang /dug dbang rma bya rgyas pa/dmar po mda' 'gengs rjes gnang /'jigs byed zhe dgu ma/gangs dkar gshed dmar lha lnga/bcu gsum ma dgra nagaphyag rdor lor r+pā lha/kye rdor thod pa can/dus ra sku gsung thugasayongs rdzogs/gas yang bde mchog ྾ rdzong snyan brgyud dbang /bka' gdams thig le/rta mgrin yang gsang dbang lung /dben sa snyan brgyud lugs kyi rta mgrin gsang sgrub dbang /rjes gnang zur bka' mang tsam/dbang spyi bka'/rdor phreng /mi tra/sgrol ma/rjes gnang sgrub thabs brgya rtsargyas pa snar thang brgya rtsa bcas/rin sting rnams dang /lung gi skor la/rgyal ba'i bka' lngar rin po che/bstan 'gyur las lung rgyun yod rigs pod lhagabaka' gdams rnying ma'i skor sngar smos pa dang /g.yin yang zhal gdams sna tshogs/bka' gdams gsar ma la/rje rin po che/rgyal tshab/mkhas grub rnams kyi gsung rags rim/'dul 'dzin pa'i gsung 'ga' zhig bod phyed rma/sto ston pa'i blo sbyong /spyan snga blo gros sto mas btso 'bum/rgyal ba dge bon grub/dge bon rgya mtsho gnyis kyi gsung yongs rdzogs/bsod nams rgya mtsho'i lam 'khrid gser tso gur gyi gtor chog lnga pa rin po che'i gsung cha

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang stagasagasar rnyang gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/byang /byela'abyorargyud gi+or dbyings la/'aXm dpal gsang ldan/kusdo /gasbyong da la bcas/bla med la/gasdung 'dus ragasnru gsum/sngags btu' byan rlabs/sa mchog lugasagasum/'dral bu lusad la/sngagasabatu/dbongaspyil can/'gasabyed ma/dpa' gcag ro langasabargyad skor/sngagasabatu'i —na rlabs dpa' gcig rjes gnang /zhal phyag yongs rdzogasayum bcas kyi rjes gzhung /dug dbang rma bya rgyas pa/dmar po mda' 'gengs rjes gnang /'jags byed zhe dgu ma/gangasadakar gshed dmar lha lnga/bcu gsum ma dgra nagaphyag rdor 'khor chen lha/kye rdor thod pa can/dusa'akhor sku gsung thugasayongs rdzogs/gzhan yang bde mchog ngam rdzong snyan brgyud dbang /bka' gdams thig le/rta mgrin yang gsang dbang lung /dben sa snyan brgyud 95 rtenalugs ñcā rta man gsang /ba dbang /rjes gnang zur bka' mang tsam/dbang — bka'/rdoraphreng/ gh+ri/sgrol ma/rjesaganang sgrubagi thabasabargya rtsargyasapa snar thang bas rtsa bcas/ na 'byungarnams dang /lung (skoral/rgyal ba' bka' 'gyuzlo ranazlo che/bstan 'gyur las lung rgyun yod gas pod lhagazloka' gdams rnyang ma skor sngar smos pa sdong /gzhan yang zhal gdams sna gas/kyibaka' gdams/sar ma la/rje ran po che/rgyal tshab/mkhasagrub rnams kyisung rags ram/'dul 'dzin pa'i gsung 'ga' zhig bod phyed r+yā/hor ston pa' blo sbyong /spyanasnga blos+t+ri+os sbyalamatshanabaga' 'bum/rgyal ba dge 'dun grub/dge 'dun rgya mtsho gnyas gsung yongs rdzogs/bsod nams rgya mtsho'i lam 'khrid gser zhun gur gyi gtor chogalnga pa rin po che'i gsung cha

ba tshe chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chosang gces bsdus/ ()tshang / tshangs dbyangs pa'i ja mchod pad dkar lhar bsngags ma/ bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung yongs rdzogs/ 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i yongs 'dzin rnam thar dang / zhabs brtan cha shas/ paṇa chen chos rgyan/ blo bzang ye shes/ dpal ldan ye shes/ bstan pa'i nyi ma bcas kyi gsung yongs rdzogs/ sngags chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang / dwags po ngag dbang grags pa'i lam rim/paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa dang / thang sag pa dngos grub rgya mtsho'i 'jigs byed bskyed rdzogs/ skyid sprul gong 'og zhog don yod mkhas grub/'jam dbyangs bde ba'i rdo rje/ phur bu lcog byams pa/ lcang skya ngag dbang blo bzang mchog ldan/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan/ stag phu ba gong 'og zhi bzang dge legs rgyal mtshan/ 'on rgyal sras/ klong brdol bla ma/ rwa sgrengs khri chen/ sked tshang sprul sku 'jam dbyangs smon lam/ a mdo bkra shis 'khyil 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa ngag dbang brtson 'grus/ dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po/ khri gung thang pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me/ dbal mang dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ dgon lung thu'u bkwan rin po che/srog po lcang lung paṇ+ḍi ta rdo rje grags pa rnams kyi gsung 'bum dang / gzhan yang yul phran so so'i dam pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i gsung rab mtha' klas pa zhig gi rgyun bzhugs so/ /bshad lung nyams khrid kyi skor la/ rje rin po che'i bka' 'bum nas/ lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung rkyang pa/ mtshan bzhi bsgrags kyi bshad pa/ lam rim chung ba/ legs bshad snying po rten 'brel bstod pa rnams kyi bshad lung / lam rim bsdus don dang / lam gtso/ yon 128

ba chen 'odasnang las/ saskya'i mosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()tshang / tshangs dbyangasapa'i ja mchod pad dkar lhar bsngagasam/ bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung yongs dzo+ogs/ 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i yongasa'adzin rnam thar dang / zhabasabartan cha shas/ paṇa chen chos rgyan/ blo bzang ye shes/ dpal ldan ye shes/ bstan pa'i nyi ma bcas kyi gsung yongs rdzogs/ sngags chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang / dwags po ngag dbang grags pa'i lam rim/paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa dang / thang sag pa dngos grub rgya mtsho'i 'jigs byed bskyed rdzogs/ skyid sprul gong 'og zhog don yod mkhas grub/'jam dbyangs bde ba'i rdo rje/ phur bu lcog byams pa/ lcang skya ngag dbang blo bzang mchog ldan/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ yongs 'dzin ye shesargyal mtshan/ stag phu ba gong 'og zhi bzang dge legs rgyal mtshan/ 'on rgyal sras/ klong brdol bla ma/ rwa sgrengs khri chen/ sked tshang sprul sku 'jam dbyangs smon lam/ a mdo bkra shes 'khyil 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa ngag dbang brtson 'grus/ dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po/ khri gung thang pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me/ dbal mang dkon mchog rgyal ma / dgon lung thu'u bkwan rin po che/srog po lcang lung paṇ+ḍi ta rdo rje grags pa rnams kyi gsung 'bum dang / gzhan yang yul phran so so'i dam pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i gsung rab mtha' klas pa zhig gi rgyun bzhugs so/ /bshad lung nyams khrid kyi skor la/ rje rin po che'i bka' 'bum nas/ lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung rkyang pa/ mtshan bzhi bsgrags kyi bshad pa/ lam rim chung ba/ legs bshad snying po rten 'brel bstod pa rnams kyi bshad lung / lam rim bsdus don dang / lam gtso/ yon 128

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/tan gzhi gyur ma rnams kyi lung khrid/ sngags rim chen mo/ gsang 'dus 'grel pa bzhi bsgrags/ rim lnga gsal sgron/ bde mchog rgyud 'grel sbas don kun gsal/ de'i bskyed rim rnams kyi bshad lung / gsang 'dus rim lnga gdan rdzogs kyi nyams khrid/ chos drug yid ches sum ldan dang / 'pho khrid gser gyi sgo 'byed kyi bshad lung / sbyin sreg dngos grub rgya mtsho'i bshad khrid sgra mi snyan gyi tshe khrid bcas/ rgyal tshab rje'i tshad ma'i brjed byang chen mo'i bshad lung /dus 'khor 'grel chen dri med 'od la mkhas grub rje'i ṭīka chen sbyar ba'i bshad pa/ gsang 'dus dang / 'jigs byed bskyed rim bshad lung / 'phrul 'khor gyi khrid/ mgon po'i dpe bum gyi khrid/ slo tra pā la rte'u 'khrid ma'i khrid/rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i lam rim gser zhun khrid lung / lnga pa rin po che'i 'jam dpal zhal lung gi nyams khrid/ dmigs brtse ma'i ṭī ska'i steng nas rigs gsum spyi sgrub 'od 'bar ma'i khrid/ gzungs 'bul gyi phyag khrid/ paṇa chen chos rgyan gyi bka' 'bum las/ bde lam gyi khrid thun mong dang / thun min/sher seng nas brgyud pa'i lta khrid dran pa bzhi ldan/ thun drug bde mchog lū hi pa dang / 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid/ lcags mkhar mtshon cha 'bar ba'i 'phrul 'khor gyi khrid/ lcags mkhar drag cu pa'i khrid/sngon 'gra'i khrid chen bzhi zhes skyabs 'gro/ rdor sems/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/maṇ+ḍal rnams kyi khrid/ rtsa tshig la yongs 'dzin gyi yig cha sbyar ba'i steng nas phyag chen gyi khrid/ ba so ba'i lta khrid nas pa'i bshad lung / bsngas pa'i khrid/blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid srol mi 'dro ba gnyis/ glang thang dro'i tshig rkang 129

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/tan gzhi gyur ma rnamasakyi lung khrid/ sngags rim chen mo/ gsang 'dusa'agrel pa bzhi bsgrags/ rim lnga gsal sgron/ bde mchog rgyud 'grel sbas don kun gsal/ de'i bskyed rim rnamasakyi bshad lung / gsang 'dus rim lnga gdan rdzogs kyi nyamasakhrid/ chos drug yid ches sum ldan dang / 'pho khrid gser gyi sgo 'byed kyi bshad lung / sbyin sreg dngos grub rgya mtsho'i bshad khrid sgra mi snyan gyi tshe khrid bcas/ rgyal tshab rje'i tshad ma'i brjed byang chen mo'i bshad lung /dus 'bor 'grel chen dri med 'od la mkhas grub rje'i ṭīka chen sbyar ba'i bshad pa/ gsang 'dus dang / 'jigs byed bskyed rim bshad lung / 'phrul 'khor gyi khrid/ mgon po'i dpe bum gyi khrid/ k+ṣe tra pā la rte'u 'khrid ma'i khrid/rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i lam rim gser zhun khrid lung / lnga pa rin po che'i 'jam dpal zhal lung gi nyams khrid/ dmigs brtse ma'i ṭīk+ka'i steng nas rigs gsum spyi sgrub 'od 'bar ma'i khrid/ gzungs 'bul gyi phyag khrid/ paṇa chen chos rgyan gyi bka' 'bum las/ bde lam gyi khrid thun mong dang / thun min/sher seng nas brgyud pa'i lta khrid dran pa bzhi ldan/ thun drug bde mchog lū hi pa dang / 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid/ lcags mkhar mtshon cha 'bar ba'i 'phrul 'khor gyi khrid/ lcags mkhar drug cu pa'i khrid/sngon 'gro'i khrid chen bzhi zhes skyabs 'gro/ rdor sems/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/maṇ+ḍal rnams kyi khrid/ rtsa tshig la yongs 'dzin gyi yig cha sbyar ba'i steng nas phyag chen gyi khrid/ ba so ba'i lta khrid rgyas pa'i bshad lung / bsdus pa'i khrid/blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid srol mi 'dra ba gnyis/ glang thang pa'i tshig rkang 129

brtse chen 'od snang lag sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()brgyad ma dang / khams lung pa'i thun brgyad pa'i khrid/ paṇa chen gyi rigasagasum spyi sgrub dang / bla ma'i rnal 'byor dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ de dang 'brelaba'i 'pho khrid bka' rgya ma/ 'pho ba dpa' bo g.yul 'jug ser ra ba'i lugasakyi 'ja' sug ma byams 'pho/ 'jigs byed 'pho lung rnams kyi khrid/ dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i ni gu chos drug gi khrid/ de'i 'pho khrid bka' rgya ma/ mgon po phyag drug pa snying zhugs ma'i 'pho khrid/ rdzogs rim mchog sgrub pa'i rlung khrid/gcod dbang nam mkha' sgo 'byed sngon du 'gro bas dben sa pa'i gcod gdan thog gcig ma dang / thar 'dod ded dpon gyi khrid/ gzhan yang 'jam dbyangasamagon po/ pu rje shrī rgya thang pa rnams nas brgyud pa'i gcod dbang / lung pod re re/ sbas pa grwa tshang 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyi gcod dbang dang / dga' ldan 'jug ngogs che chung gi khrid paṇa chen yig steng nas gtum mo zhag bdun ma/ zhag gsum ma/ dza bīr gyi rlung bcud len/ dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i me tog bcud len/ dben sa pa'i lugs kyi chu bcud len/ rde'u bcud len rnams kyi khrid/ lcang skya ngag dbang blo bzang chos ldan sogs kyi yig steng nas snying po don gsum dang / rol rdor yig steng nas tshom bu dmar khrid/ 'jigasabyed ser po'i tshe khrid/ ngag byin rlabs kyi khrid le tshan/ gsang 'dus tshe dkar khrid/ lcang skya rol rdor yig steng nas dril bu pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid/ dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i yig steng nas dril bu bskyed rim khrid/ 'jigs byed zhi khro sbrags sgrub kyi bshad lung dbang khrid le tshan3/ 'jigs byed dpal gcig gi khrid/ smyug la paṇa chen yig steng nas bka' gdams lha bzhi dang /— 130

brtse chen 'od snang lag saskya'i mosa'abyung gcespobasdus/ ()brgyad ma dang / khams lung pa'i thun brgyad pa'i khrid/ paṇa chen gyi rigasagasum spyi sgrub dang / bla ma'i rnal 'byor dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ de dang 'brelaba'i 'pho khrid bka' rgya ma/ 'pho ba dpa' bo g.yul 'jug ser ra ba'i lugasakyi 'ja' sug ma byams 'pho/ 'jigs byed 'pho lung rnamasakyi khrid/ dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i ni gu chos drug gi khrid/ de'i 'pho khrid bka' rgya ma/ mgon po phyag drug pa snying zhugs ma'i 'pho khrid/ rdzogs rim mchog sgrub pa'i rlung khrid/gcod dbang nam mkha' sgo 'byed sngon du 'gro bas dben sa pa'i gcod gdan thog gcig ma dang / thar 'dod ded dpon gyi khrid/ gzhan yang 'jam dbyangasamagon po/ pu h+ye shrī rgya thang pa rnams nas brgyud pa'i gcod dbang / lung pod re re/ sbas pa grwa tshang 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyi gcod dbang dang / dga' ldan 'jug ngogs che chung gi khrid paṇa chen yig steng nas gtum mo zhag bdun ma/ zhag gsum ma/ dza bīr gyi rlung bcud len/ dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i me tog bcud len/ dben sa pa'i lugs kyi chu bcud len/ rde'u bcud len rnams kyi khrid/ lcang skya ngag dbang blo bzang chos ldan sogs kyi yig steng nas snying po don gsum dang / rol rdor yig steng nas tshom bu dmar khrid/ 'jigasabyed ser po'i tshe khrid/ ngag byin rlabs kyi khrid le tshan/ gsang 'dus tshe dkar khrid/ lcang skya rol rdor yig steng nas dril bu pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid/ dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i yig steng nas dril bu bskyed rim khrid/ 'jigs byed zhi khro sbrags sgrub kyi bshad lung dbang khrid le tshan3/ 'jigs byed dpal gcig gi khrid/ smyug la paṇa chen yig steng nas bka' gdams lha bzhi dang /— 130

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/yongs 'dzin yig steng nasathig le bcu drug gi khrid/ sgrol dkar/ rig byed ma'i bdag byin rlabs/ grub rgyal lugasakyi tshe khrid/ dpal ldan rgyud smad pa'i lugs kyi rdzogs rim khrid chen brgyad ces/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs rim lnga / 'jam rdor gyi thig le bzhi/ lū hi pa'i rnal 'byor chen mo/ dril bu rim lnga/'jigs byed rnal 'byor bzhi/ 'khor chen byin rlabs bzhi ldan/ dus 'khor sbyor drug na ro chos drug rnams kyi khrid/ gzhan yang rab gnas/ gtor ma brgya rtsa sogs nyer mkho'i phyag len dang dmigasakhrid/ skyes rabs so bzhi pa/'dul ba mdo rtsa/ mngon pa mdzod/ mngon rtogasargyan/ dbu ma 'jug pa rnamasakyi bshad lung khungs btsun nges 'drongs/ brgyad stong gi bshad lung / 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i grub mtha' chen mo'i bshad lung sogs mtha' klas pa dang /dben sa bka' brgyud kyi skor la/ ba so chosargyan gyi lta khrid che chung / blo bzang don grub dang / sangasargyas ye shesakyi gsung tshang ma'i lung / 'jam dbyangs chos skor la/ 'jam dbyangs/ rnal 'byor ma/ bde mchog dkar po/ sgrol dkar rnams kyi rjes gnang / chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum thun mong dang /thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang / de dag gi yig cha mi 'dra ba gnyis kyi lung /lho brag phyag rdor snyan brgyud/ skor la/ don dam semasabaskyed kyi byin rlabs/ tshe dpag med lha dang / rnam 'jomasalha dbang / phyag rdor sku lnga/ rdo rje gcesaphreng / bdud rtsi thigs pa/ gtum po me 'bar/ drag po sum sgril rnams kyi rjes gnang / lung pod1/ 'jigs byed rwa pod dang / dpal pos kyi lung / chos skyong skor la/ phyag drug pa bka' chen bcu gsum dang / snying zhugs chog brgyud ma 131

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/yongs 'dzin yig steng nas thig le bcu drug gi khrid/ sgrol dkar/ rig byed ma'i bdag byin rlabs/ grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe khrid/ dpal ldan rgyud smad pa'i lugs kyi rdzogs rim khrid chen brgyad ces/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs rim lnga / 'jam rdor gyi thig le bzhi/ lha hi pa'i rnal 'byor chen mo/ dril bu rim lnga/'jigs byed rnal 'byor bzhi/ 'khor chen byin rlabs bzhi ldan/ dus 'khor sbyor drug na ro chos drug rnams kyi khrid/ gzhan yang rab gnas/ gtor ma brgya rtsa sogs nyer mkho'i phyag len dang dmigs khrid/ skyes rabs so bzhi pa/'dul ba mdo rtsa/ mngon pa mdzod/ mngon rtogs rgyan/ dbu ma 'jug pa rnamasakyi bshad lung khungs btsun nges 'drongs/ brgyad stong gi bshad lung / 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i grub mtha' chen mo'i bshad lung sogs mtha' klas pa dang /dben sa bka' brgyud kyi skor la/ ba so chos rgyan gyi lta khrid che chung / blo bzang don grub dang / sangs rgyas ye shes kyi gsung tshang ma'i lung / 'jam dbyangs chos skor la/ 'jam dbyangs/ rnal 'byor ma/ bde mchog dkar po/ sgrol dkar rnams kyi rjes gnang / chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum thun mong dang /thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang / de dag gi yig cha mi 'dra ba gnyis kyi lung /lho brag phyag rdor snyan bas/ skor la/ don dam sems bskyed kyi byin rlabs/ tshe dpag med lha dang / rnam 'joms lha dbang / phyag rdor sku lnga/ rdo rje gcesaphreng / bdud rtsi thigs pa/ gtum po me 'bar/ drag po sum sgril rnams kyi rjes gnang / lung pod1/ 'jigs byed rwa pod dang / dpal pos kyi lung / chos skyong skor la/ phyag drug pa bka' chen bcu gsum dang / snying zhugs chog brgyud ma 131

brtse chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ lta'i/bcas rjes gnang / lung pod1/ rnam sras bka' chen/ lung pod15/ las gshin yang gsang ha la nag po'i rjes gnang / lung skor pod chung / dmag zor ma'i rjes gnang / lung pod chung / be lce'i rjes lung / gzhan yang chab mde'i mi tra'i spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang / lha drug gi rjes gnang / de'i khrid drug sogs lung pod1/ ku cor rtogs ldan gyi khrid brgya/ stag phu ba blo bzang chos kyi dbang phyug gi dag snang mi tra dang / sgrol ma'i skor sogs kyi dbang lung mang tsam dang /lung srol gzhan yang / ma ṇi bka' 'bum/ mar mi'i rnam mgur/ bla ma zhang gi bka' 'bum/ dbang lung / stag phu ba'i yig steng na gser chos bcu gsum skor/ stag phu gong ma dang / thu'u bkwan sogs kyi yig steng nas rnal 'byor ma'i nyams khrid/ jo nang khrid brgya/ lcang lung paṇ+ḍita rdo rje grags pa'i yig steng nas zhal rnam 'gyur bcu bdun gyi rjes gnang sogs kyi rgyun yang dar bar mchis so / / dpal mnyam med ri bo dge ldan pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi rtogs pa brjod pa rgyas par mkhyen 'dod na/ rje rin po che'i rnam thar phyi nang gi yig cha du ma/ tsong kha brgyad cu pa rtsa 'grel/ byams pas mdzad pa'i rtogs brjod mdun legs ma'i 'grel pa/ paṇa chen bsod nams grags pas mdzad pa'i dga' ldan chos 'byung / 'ol kha mkhar nag lo tsā ba'i dga' ldan chos 'byung /sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i dga' ldan chos 'byung be+e ḍūr ser po/dkon mchog 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po'i chos 'byung / yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i lam rim bla brgyud nor bu'i phreng ba pod chen gnyis/ phur bu lcog byams pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i grwa sa chen po bzhi dang //32

brtse chen 'od snang las/ saskya'i chos 'byung gcesabasdus/ ()bcas rjes gnang / lung pod1/ rnam sras bka' chen/ lung pod15/ las gshin yang gsang ha la nag po'i rjes gnang / lung skor pod chung / dmag zor ma'i rjes gnang / lung pod chung / belce'i rjes lung / gzhan yang chab mdo'i mi tra'i spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang / lha drug gi rjes gnang / de'i khrid drug sogs lung pod1/ ku cor rtogs ldan gyi khrid brgya/ stag phu ba blo bzang chosakyi dbang phyug gi dag snang mi tra dang / sgrol ma'i skor sogs kyi dbang lung mang tsam dang /lung srol gzhan yang / ma ṇi bka' 'bum/ mar mi'i rnam mgur/ bla ma zhang gi bka' 'bum/ dbang lung / stag phu ba'i yig steng na gser chos bcu gsum skor/ stag phu gong ma dang / thu'u bkwan sogs kyi yig steng nas rnal 'byor ma'i nyams khrid/ jo nang khrid brgya/ lcang lung paṇ+ḍita rdo rje gragasapa'i yig steng nas zhal rnam 'gyur bcu bdun gyi rjes gnang sogs kyi rgyun yang dar bar mchis so / / dpal mnyam med ri bo dge ldan pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi rtogasapa brjod pa rgyas par mkhyen 'dod na/ rje rin po che'i rnam thar phyi nang gi yig cha du ma/ tsong kha brgyad cu pa rtsa 'grel/ byams pas mdzad pa'i rtogs brjod mdun legs ma'i 'grel pa/ paṇa chen bsod nams grags pas mdzad pa'i dga' ldan chos 'byung / 'ol kha mkhar nag lo tsā ba'i dga' ldan chos 'byung /sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i dga' ldan chos 'byung be+e ḍūr ser po/dkon mchog 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po'i chos 'byung / yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i lam rim bla brgyud nor bu'i phreng ba pod chen gnyis/ phur bu lcog byams pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i grwa sa chen po bzhi dang //32

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/rgyud stod smad kyi chags tshul pad dkar phreng ba/ thu'u bkwan rin po che'i grub mtha' thams cad kyi khungs dang 'dod tshul ston pa shel dkar me long gi dge lugs pa'i skabs sogs dang / gzhan yang rgyal ba/ paṇa chen/ lcang skya rin po che / 'jam dbyangs bayid pa sogs bstan 'dzin chen po rnams kyi sku phreng so so'i rnam thar shin tu rgyas pa pod du ma dang / dga' ldan pa'i khri rabs phal chero so so'i rnam thar/ de dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa sogs las shes par bya'/ /dga' ldan zhes pa'i sgra don ni gnas kyi ming gang zag la chags pa yin te shes sla zhing / dge lugs pa zhes pa'i don bzhed tshul mi 'dra ba mang yang /don la chos rje ri bo dga' ldan pa'i lugs zhes pa bsdus pas dga' lugs par 'gyur/ de brjod bde ba'i dbang du byas nas/ dge lugs par bsgyur bar mkhas pa dag bzhed/ gzhan yang 'di la bka' gdams gsar ma zhes kyang bya ste/ rje rin po che dpal ldan a ti sha'i sprul par yongs su grags shing /mdo phyogs kyi nyams len la de nyid nas brgyud pa'i gdams pa byang chub lam gyi rim pa gtso bor bzung nas bstan pa'i me ro gsar du gsos pa lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ bka' gdamasaglegs bam las kyang / tha ma bstan pa'i me ro ni/ /grags pa'i mtshan gyis gso bar byed/ /ces pa'i lung gis kyang grub pa yin no / / yang / bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyis klu mes shes rab tshul khrims la dbu zhwa ser po gnang bar brten/ sngon gyi 'dul 'dzin chen po rnams kyis zhwa ser mnabs pas/ rje rin po ches kyang 'dul bstan nyams pa gso ba'i rten 133

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/rgyud stod smad kyi chags tshul pad dkar phreng ba/ thu'u bkwan rin po che'i grub mtha' thams cad kyi khungs dang 'dod tshul ston pa shel dkar me long gi dge lugs pa'i skabs sogs dang / gzhan yang rgyal ba/ paṇa chen/ lcang skya rin po che / 'jam dbyangs ba'ad pa sogs bstan 'dzin chen po rnams kyi sku phreng so so'i rnam thar shin tu rgyas pa pod du ma dang / dga' ldan pa'i khri rabs phal chero so so'i rnam thar/ de dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa sogs las shes par bya'/ /dga' ldan zhes pa'i sgra don ni gnas kyi ming gang zag la chags pa yin te shes sla zhing / dge lugs pa zhes pa'i don bzhed tshul mi 'dra ba mang yang /don la chos rje ri bo dga' ldan pa'i lugs zhes pa bsdus pas dga' lugs par 'gyur/ de brjod bde ba'i dbang du byas nas/ dge lugs par bsgyur bar mkhas pa dag bzhed/ gzhan yang 'di la bka' gdams gsar ma zhes kyang bya ste/ rje rin po che dpal ldan a ti sha'i sprul par yongs su grags shing /mdo phyogs kyi nyams len la de nyid nas brgyud pa'i gdams pa byang chub lam gyi rim pa gtso bor bzung nas bstan pa'i me ro gsar du gsos pa lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ bka' gdamasaglegs bam las kyang / tha ma bstan pa'i me ro ni/ /grags pa'i mtshan gyis gso bar byed/ /ces pa'i lung gis kyang grub pa yin no / / yang / bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyis klu mes shes rab tshul khrims la dbu zhwa ser po gnang bar brten/ sngon gyi 'dul 'dzin chen po rnams kyis zhwa ser mnabs pas/ rje rin po ches kyang 'dul bstan nyams pa gso ba'i rten 133

brtse chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chosang gces bsdus/ ()'brel du zhwa ser bzhes shing 'khor rnams la'ang de ltar gnang bas zhwa ser 'chang ba'i ring lugs zhes kyang grags so/ // gzhan yang de dag tu ma 'dus pa ni/ grub mtha' zur pa/ jo zhal/bo shangs/ zhi gcod sogs mang du mchis pa las/ jo nang rgyal ba'i ri khrod ni/kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer gyi slob ma kun spangs thugs rje brtson sa zhes grub pa'i khyu mchog chen po des btab/ de rjes kun mkhyen dol bu pa shes rab rgyal mtshan ni/ skyi ston grags pa rgyal mtshan sogs bla ma sum cu lhag pa lasamado sngags kyi chos tshul rgya mtsho lta bu gsan/ dbus gtsang du grwa skor mdzad pas thams cad mkhyen pa'i grags pas khyab/ so gcig par jo nang du phebasanas mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho las rdo rje'i rnal 'byor zab mo gsan zhing srog rtsol mthar phyin/ de nas gdan sar bzhugs te sku 'bum chen mo bzhengs/dbu ma gzhan stong pa'i lta ba la thugs nges 'drongs te/ de rtsal du bton pa'i yig cha nges don rgya mtsho dang / bka' bsdu bzhi pa sogs mang du brtsams/ de'i rgyun jo nang phyogs las rnam rgyal dang / nya dbon kun dga' dpal sogs kyis bskyangs/ phyis 'jam dbyangs kun dga' grol mchog kyang phebs/ de'i rnam 'phrul rje btsun tā ra nā thas 'phags bod kyi mkhas grub du mar bsten nas mdo sngags rgya mtsho lta bur gsan bsam sgom gsum mdzad pas mkhas shing nyams myong dang ldan par gyur/ gsang sngags gtso bor gyur pa'i bstan bcos kyang pod bco brgyad tham pa mdzad/ rtag brtan phun tshogs gling btab cing dar rgyas che bar byung na'ang / bar skabs su dus 'gyur gyi dbang gis/ deng sang jo 134

brtse chen 'od snang las/ saskya'i mosa'abyung gtsesabasdus/ ()'brel du zhwa ser bzhes shing 'khor rnams la'ang de ltar gnang bas zhwa ser 'chang ba'i ring lugs zhes kyang grags so/ // gzhan yang de dag tu ma 'dusapa ni/ grub mtha' zur pa/ jo zhal/bo shangs/ zhi gcod sogs mang du mchisapa las/ jo nang rgyal ba'i ri khrod ni/kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer gyi slob ma kun spangs thugs rje brtson 'grusazhes grub pa'i khyu mchog chen po des btab/ de rjesakun mkhyen dol bu pa shesarab rgyal mtshan ni/ skyi ston grags pa rgyal mtshan sogs bla ma sum cu lhag pa lasamado sngags kyi chos tshul rgya mtsho lta bu gsan/ dbus gtsang du grwa skor mdzad pas thams cad mkhyen pa'i grags pas khyab/ so gzhag par jo nang du phebasanas mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho las rdo rje'i rnal 'byor zab mo gsan zhing srog rtsol mthar phyin/ de nas gdan sar bzhugasate sku 'bum chen mo bzhengs/dbu ma gzhan stong pa'i lta ba la thugs nges 'drongs te/ de rtsal du bton pa'i yig cha ngesadon rgya mtsho dang / bka' bsdu bzhi pa sogasamang du brtsams/ de'i rgyun jo nang phyogs las rnam rgyal dang / nya dbon kun dga' dpal sogs kyis bskyangs/ phyis 'jam dbyangs kun dga' grol mchog kyang phebs/ de'i rnam 'phrul rje btsun tā ra nā thas 'phags bod kyi mkhas grub du mar bsten nas mdo sngags rgya mtsho lta bur gsan bsam sgom gsum mdzad pas mkhas shing nyams myong dang ldan par gyur/ gsang sngags gtso bor gyur pa'i bstan bcos kyang pod bco brgyad tham pa mdzad/ rtag brtan phun tshogs gling btab cing dar rgyas che bar byung na'ang / bar skabs su dus 'gyur gyi dbang gis/ deng sang jo 134

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/nang du rten gsum sogs ma nyams tsam las brgyud 'dzin cher med la/ phun tshogs gling ni lnga pa rin po ches dge lugs par bsgyur nas dga' ldan phun tshogs gling zhes grags/ chos brgyud 'ga' zhig sngar smos pa ltar bka' 'brug dang / jo nang kun mkhyen gyi yang slob drung ka bzhi pa rin chen dpal gyis btab pa'i khams dzo thang dgon 'dir sbyor drug gi nyams len gyi rgyun sogs ma nyams par yod/sogs su yod do/ // dpal zha lu gser khang khra mo ni/ chos rgyal khri srong gi dus su lo tsā ba chen po lce khyi 'brug sogs mang du byon pa'i gdung brgyud rnam par dag pa las/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi thog mar dbus gtsang gi mi bcur grags pa'i nang tshan gtsang pa lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug gi slob ma lce btsun shes rab 'byung gnas kyis btab ste/ de yang rang gi bla ma lo ston la dgon gnas gar 'debs kyi lung bstan zhus pas/ bla mas phyag mda'i ltongs kha gser gyis bkang ba zhig gnang bas/ da lta'i chos sde chags sa 'dir mdel rtse zha lu gsar pa zhig la khel 'dug pas der dgon gnas btab pas 'brel ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas zha lu gser khang dang / phyis tshon rtsi khra bo gsol bas zha lu gser khang khra mo zhes grags/ lce btsun nyid rgya gar du byon nas a bha ya las sdom rgyun gsar du zhus te spel/ lnga brgya pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu dpal ldan a ti shas rab tu gnas pa'i me tog 'thor zhing / ri sbugs su gzimasaspyil phubs te phyag tsha btab pa'i sa 'bum da lta yang bzhugs/ de rjes mgo ye shes g.yung drung gis 'dul ba dang / paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa dang / rngog lo 135

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasogasar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/nang du rten gsum sogasam nyams tsam las brgyud 'dzin cher med la/ phun tshogs gling ni lnga pa rin po ches dge lugs par bsgyur nas dga' ldan phun tshogs gling zhes grags/ chos brgyud 'ga' zhig sngar smos pa ltar bka' 'brug dang / jo nang kun mkhyen gyi yang slob drung ka bzhi pa rin chen dpal gyis btab po'i khams j-i thang dgon 'dir sbyor drug gi nyams len gyi rgyun sogasam nyamasapar yod/sags ba/ yad da/ // dpal zha lu gser khang khra mo ni/ chos rgyal khri srong gi dus su lo tsā ba chen po lce khyi 'brug sogs mang du byon pa'i gdung brgyud rnam par dag pa las/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi thog mar dbus gtsang gi mi bcur grags pa'i nang tshan gtsang pa lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug gi slob ma lce btsun shes rab 'byung gnas kyis btab ste/ de yang rang gi bla ma lo ston la dgon gnas gar 'debs kyi lung bstan zhus pas/ bla mas phyag mda'i ltongs kha gser gyis bkang ba zhig gnang bas/ da lta'i chos sde chags sa 'dir mdel rtse zha lu gsar pa zhig la khel 'dug pas der dgon gnas btab pas 'brel ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas zha lu gser khang dang / phyis tshon rtsi khra bo gsol bas zha lu gser khang khra mo zhes grags/ lce btsun nyid rgya gar du byon nas a bha ya las sdom rgyun gsar du zhus te spel/ lnga brgya pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu dpal ldan a ti shas rab tu gnasapa'i me tog 'thor zhing / ri sbugs su gzimasaspyil phubs te phyag tsha btab pa'i sa 'bum da lta yang bzhugs/ de rjes mgo ye shes g.yung drung gis 'dul ba dang / paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa dang / rngog lo 135

brtse chen 'od snang las/ saskya'i motho'abyung gcetshobasdus/ ()chen pos phar phyin gyi bshad grwa btsugs/ kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che yan chad mkhan thog bcu gcig tsam gyis 'dul ba a bha ya'i sdom rgyun dang / phar phyin rngog lugs gtso bor bton/ phyis su rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyi sprul pa sku zhang grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis lcags sprel la rtsod pa'i dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa khro phu bu ston rin po che gdan sar spyan drangs/ de nas bzung /sdom rgyun kha che paṇa chen lugs dang / mdo sngags gnyis ga'i sgo nas grub mtha' bu lugs zhes gangs can mkhas pa rnams kyi rna ba'i rgyan du gyur/ de yang ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas rab gsal gyi rnam 'phrul kun mkhyen 'di nyid ni/'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ yi ge ra ra lung dang ba bu ston/ dang por/ /blo ldan gang zhig rab 'byung gsungs/ /ston pa'i bstan pa gsal byed pa/ /'byung bar 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /ces rten brten par bcas pa lung gis gsal bar bstan pa bzhin/ gtsang shab smad sgom gnas zhes bya bar brag ston rgyal mtshan dpal bzang gi sras su lcags pho rta'i lor 'khrungs/ chung ngu nas 'jam dpal dpa' bos rjes su bzung / khro phu sems dpa' chen po/ rang gi mes po tshul khrims bzang po/ mkhan chen bzang po dpal grags pa gzhon nu/ thar lo nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan seṅge/ bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ 'phagasapa yon tan rgya mtsho sogs las/ bzo gso sgra tshad/ nang rig la sde snod rgyud sde dang bcas pa/ zhar byung rig gnas chung ba lnga ste/ mdor na gangs can gyi ljongs su rgyun bzhugs so cog gi gcug lag rab 'byams la mang du thos pa'i mthar son pas slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi spun slar 'dzegs/ de dag gi don la 136

brtse chen 'od snang las/ 4 ༷ chos 'byung gtses bsdus/ ()skor/ su kha'i chos skor/ rdo rje gdan pa'i chos skor/ me tri pa'i chos skor/ ra hu la'i chos skor te lnga dang / der ma 'thus pa'i man ngag thor bu dang bcas bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig mchis na'ang / deng sang chos rje mus pa dang / bka' brgyud sogs su ni gu'i skor gtso bor gyur pa la/ rtsa ba ni ni gu chos drug sdong po phyag rgya chen po ga'u ma/ yal ga lam khyer rnam gsum/ me tog mkha' spyod dkar dmar/ 'bras bu lus sems 'chi med/ bka' srung ye shes mgon po'i skor rnams kyi smin grol rgyab rten dang bcas pa las/ dang po la/ chos drug gi smin byed khog phub gsum/ sgos bka' drug phyag chen bka' lnga/ mkha' spyod bka' gsum/ gsang sgrub bka' lnga/ mgon po bka' gnyis las/ dang po ni/ chosadrug spyi yi khog phub rgyud sde lnga gtso bor gyur pa'i 'jug sgo sgyu lus dbang mo che/bde mchog dbang bzhi lus bsgrigs/ lha bzhi dril sgrub bcas/ gnyas pa ni/gtum mo sogs chos drug so so'i dbang / gsum pa ni/ phyag chen ga'u ma/ bla ma / yi dam/ sgyu lus lam khyer/ lus sems 'chi med kyi dbang / bzhi pa ni/mkha' spyod dkar mo/ dmar mo/ sum kyi phrugs dbang / lnga pa ni/ bde mchogaspyan ras gzigs/ phyag rdor/ rta mgrin/ drug pa ni/ phyag drug pa dang / mgon dkar zhar byung su kha sirnyi'i byin rlabs bcas so/ /gnyis pa grol byed khrid la/thang rgyal dang / mus pa sogs/ jo nang bka' brgyud sogs/tā ra nā tha sogs kyi yig cha'i steng nas chos drug phyag chen/ lam sems 'chi med/ bla mgon dbyer me da rnams kyi nyams khrid/ gsum pa lung la/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang sogs glegasabam gcig lhag rnams bzhugs shing / gzhan yang sngar smos pa ltar dge 146

brtse wo 'od snang las/ saskya'i chosayang gtsesabasdus/ ()skor/ su kha'i chosaskor/ rdo rje gdan pa'i chosaskor/ me tri pa'i mosaskor/ ra hu la'i chos skor te lnga dang / der ma 'thus pa'i man ngag thor bu dang bcas bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig mchis na'ang / deng sang chosarje mus pa dang / bka' brgyud sogs su ni gu'i skor gtso bor gyur pa la/ rtsa ba ni ni gu chosadrug sdong po phyag rgya chen po ga'u ma/ yal ga lam khyer rnam gsum/ me tog mkha' spyod dkar dmar/ 'bras bu lus semasa'achi med/ bka' srung ye shes mgon po'i skor rnams kyi smin grol rgyab rten dang bcasapa las/ dang po la/ mosadrug gi smin byed khog phub gsum/ sgos bka' drug phyag chen bka' lnga/ mkha' spyod bka' gsum/ gsang sgrub bka' lnga/ mgon po bka' gnyisalas/ dang po ni/ chosadrug spyi yi khog phub rgyud sde lnga gtso bor gyur pa'i 'jug sgo sgyu lus dbang mo che/bde mchog dbang bzhi lusabasgrigs/ lha bzhi dril sgrub bcas/ gnyisapa ni/gtum mo sogs chos drug soso'i dbang / gsum pa ni/ phyag chen ga'u ma/ bla ma / yi dam/ sgyu lus lam khyer/ lus semasa'achi med kyi dbang / bzhi pa ni/mkha' spyod dkar mo/ dmar mo/ sum phrugasakyi dbang / lnga pa ni/ bde mchogaspyan ras gzigs/ phyag rdor/ rta mgrin/ drug pa ni/ phyag drug pa dang / mgon dkar zhar byung su kha sidhi'i byin rlabs bcas so/ /gnyis pa grol byed khrid la/thang rgyal dang / musapa sogs/ jo nang bka'abargyud sogs/tā ra nā tha sogasakyi yig cha'i steng nas chos drug phyag chen/ lam sems 'chi med/ bla mgon dbyer me da rnamasakyi nyams khrid/ gsum pa lung la/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang sogs glegasabam gcig lhag rnams bzhugs shing / gzhan yang sngar smos pa ltar dge 146

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/lugs pa'i phyogasala'ang chos drug gi khrid rgyun tsam dang / khyad par mgon po phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang / khrid lung bcas rgya cher dar ro/ // la stod ding ri glang 'khor ni/ 'gro mgon dam pa sangs rgyas dang /de'i thugs sras byang chub sems dpa' kun dga' sogs kyis byin gyis brlabasapa'i gnas khyad par can te/ de la grub chen 'di nyid ni/ 'phags yul be+e tā yul gyi tsa ra sidhar 'khrungs/ grub thob pho mo lnga bcu rtsa drug las gdams ngag gi sgro 'dogs bcad/ thugs dam bde gshegasabacu gnyis dang /ngo mtshar mkha' spyod kyi bla ma sum cu rtsa drug gi ye shes kyi skus rjes su bzung /thun mong gi dngos grub rgya chen po brgyad dang / mchog gi dngos grub mthong lam chen po mngon du gyur/ bod du lan lnga byon pa'i dus/ gsum pa la kha che dz+nyā na gu h+ya la zhi byed sgron ma'i skor gsum sogs gsungs/ de dang dam pa gnyis mas rje btsun long po lo tsā dang / kha che pu hrang lo chung la gsungs pa sogs brgyud pa snga ma dang / bzhi par/ rma chosakyi shes rab la phyag chen/ so chung dge 'dun 'bar la rig pa gcer mthong / dam tshul khrims rgyal mtshan la rtogs pa lam khyer gyi gdams ngag gnang bsamachen rma solam gsum grangasadang / lte dang / ljagasalugasagasum/ phran dang bcasapa la brgyud par bar ma/ lnga par dam pa phyar chen/phyar chung badz+ra kro bhā/ kun dga' bzhi la gdamasapa so sor gnang / gzhan yang ma jo nyi shu rtsa bzhi sogs grub pa'i skyes bu nam mkha'i skar tshogs tsam byon pa brgyud pa phyi ma ste/ de lasakyang skye ba lngar dam pasarjes su bzung zhing / nga dang dgongs pa mnyam pa kun dga' yin/ /cesabasngags pa chig brgyud sbas pa'i 147

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/lugs pa'i phyogs la'ang chos drug gi khrid rgyun tsam dang / khyad par mgon po phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang / khrid lung bcas rgya cher dar ro/ // la stod ding ri glang 'khor ni/ 'gro mgon dam pa sangs rgyas dang /de'i thugs sras byang chub sems dpa' kun dga' sogs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas khyad par can te/ de la grub chen 'di nyid ni/ 'phags yul be+e tā yul gyi tsa ra sidha ra 'khrungs/ grub thob pho mo lnga bcu rtsa drug las gdams ngag gi sgro 'dogs bcad/ thugs dam bde gshegs bcu gnyis dang /ngo mtshar mkha' spyod kyi bla ma sum cu rtsa drug gi ye shes kyi skus rjes su bzung /thun mong gi dngos grub rgya chen po brgyad dang / mchog gi dngos grub mthong lam chen po mngon du gyur/ bod du lan lnga byon pa'i dus/ gsum pa la kha che dz+nyā na gu spo la zhi byed sgron ma'i skor gsum sogs gsungs/ de dang dam pa gnyis mas rje btsun long po lo tsā dang / kha che pu hrang lo chung la gsungs pa sogs brgyud pa snga ma dang / bzhi par/ rma chos kyi shes rab la phyag chen/ so chung dge 'dun 'bar la rig pa gcer mthong / dam tshul khrims rgyal mtshan la rtogs pa lam khyer gyi gdams ngag gnang bab(mtshon rma so kam gsum grangs dang / lce dang / ljagasalugs gsum/ phran dang bcas pa la brgyud par bar ma/ lnga par dam pa phyar chen/phyar chung badz+ra kro bhā/ kun dga' bzhi la gdams pa so sor gnang / gzhan yang ma jo nyi shu rtsa bzhi sogs grub pa'i skyes bu nam mkha'i skar tshogs tsam byon pa brgyud pa phyi ma ste/ de las kyang skye ba lngar dam pas rjes su bzung zhing / nga dang dgongs pa mnyam pa kun dga' yin/ /ces bsngags pa chig brgyud sbas pa'i 147

brtse chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()gter mdzod dam pa kun dga' nas rim par pa tshab sgom pa rgyal ba te ba/rog shes rab seng ge sku mched sogs brgyud shin tu dar ba byung yang / deng sang ni brgyud pa phyi ma'i skor las/ tshogs lam blo sbyong / sbyor lam dka' thub/mthong lam blo bral/ sgom lam ro snyoms/ mthar lam bdag bstod dang bcas pa'i lam lnga'i dbang rgyas pa/ 'bring po lam gsum gzhud ma/ bsdus pa dbang rnon ku sa la'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang / rten 'brel sngon du bdag po bstod pa zhes bya ba dam pa phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bla sgrub byin rlabs/ thugs dam bde gshegs bcu gnyis kyi dbang / bde mchog bcu gsum ma/ phag mo phyi sgrub lha dgu/ nang sgrub zhal gnyis kham/ gsang sgrub khros nag bdud rtsi bum pa rnams kyi dbang / chos skyong ye shes mgon po a gho ra/ skrag med/ gsang sgrub dmar nag gi dbang bka' rgya ma/ phyi sgrub thun mong ba/ zhing skyong kun tu ri ka dang /a pa ra tsit+ta sogs kyi rjes gnang dang / mkhyud dpyad dkar nag khra gsum gyi lung sogs thor bu tsam las/ grub mtha'i rkang 'dzin pa dang chos brgyud sogs rgya cher mi snang ngo / /ngom shod zangs ri mkhar dmar gyi phug par ma gcig lab kyi sgron ma sku tshe'i smad yun ring bzhugs shing / gdul bya dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad pa dang sras snying po grub pas g.yer chung glang lung dgon pa bzung ba sogs phyogs der gcod yul gyi bstan pa dar ba byung mod/ deng sang ni gdan sa dngos su chos brgyud 'dzin pa dmigs bsal med kyang / gdams ngag gi rgyun ni grub mtha' thams cad la khyab par gyur te/ spyir dam pas yar lung sma ra ser po 148

brtse chen 'od snang las/ saskya'i chosa'abyung gces bsdus/ ()gter mdzod dam pa kun dga' nas rim par pa tshab sgom pa rgyal ba te ne+e/rog shes rab seng ge sku mched sogs brgyud shin tu dar ba byung yang / deng sango ni brgyud pa phyi ma'i+o skor laso/ tshogs lam blo sbyong / sbyor lam dka' thub/mthang lam bla bral/ sgam lam ra snyams/ mthar lam bdag bstad dang bcas pa'i lam lnga'i dbang rgyas pa/ 'bring po lam gsum gzhud ma/ bsdusapa dbang rnon ku sa la'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang / rten 'brel sngon du bdag po bstod pa zhes bya ba dam pa phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bla sgrub byin rlabs/ thugs dam bde gshegs bcu gnyis kyi dbang / bde mchog bcu gsum ma/ phag mo phyi sgrub lha dgu/ nang sgrub zhal gnyisam/ gsang sgrub khros nag bdud rtsi bum pa rnams kyi dbang / chos skyong ye shes mgon po a gho ra/ skrag med/ gsang sgrub dmar nag gi dbang bka' rgya ma/ phyi sgrub thun mong ba/ zhing skyong kun tu ri ka dang /a pa ra tsit+ta sogs kyi rjes gnang dang / mkhyud dpyad dkar nag khra gsum gyi lung sogs thor bu tsam las/ grub mtha'i rkang 'dzin pa dang chosabargyud sogs rgya cher mi snang ngo / /ngom shod zangs ri mkhar dmar gyi phug par ma gcig lab kyi sgron ma sku tshe'i smad yun ring bzhugs shing / gdul bya dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad pa dang sras snying po grub pas g.yer chung glang lung dgon pa bzung ba sogs phyogs der gcod yul gyi bstan pa dar ba byung mod/ deng sang ni gdan sa dngos su chos brgyud 'dzin pa dmigs bsal med kyang / gdams ngag gi rgyun ni grub mtha' thams cad la khyab par gyur te/ spyir dam pas yar lung sma ra ser po 148

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/dang / skyo ston bsod namasabla ma la bshad par pho gcod dang / ma gcig gisadam pa dang / skyo ston gnyis ka las gsan pa mo gakho+od ces grags pa las/yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang dbyer med pa'i ye shes ḍā ki 'di nyid ni yul g.yel ba/ grong 'dab grong ma tsher mor mor rus khe'u gad kyi rigs su 'brungs/ slar yang rab tu byung nas dgu cu lnga'i bar du gdul bya bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i don mdzad cing / sher phyin gyi gdams ngag zab mo gocod yul gyi grub mtho' gangs can thams cad la khyab par mdzad/ tshogos slab kyang sras rgyal ba dan grub nas brgyud pa la sras brgyud dang / khu sgam chas seng nas slob brgyud rnamasabyung / phyisakun mkhyen rang byung rdo rje dang / rgod phrug ras pa rgyal thang pa sogs lam 'di'i bka' babs mang du byung ste/ deng sang yang bka' brgyud gtso bor gyur pa'i sa rnying dge lugs sogs kyi grub mtha' thams cad la khros nag lha lnga'i dbang / nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi byin rlabs/ zhag bdun ma dang stan thog gcig ma sogs kyi nyams khrid phyag bzhes dang bcas pa/ ma gakhog gi bka' chems sogs rtsa ba'i gzhung dang / grub mtha' so so'i gcod gzhung glegs bam mang po'i lung sogs ci rigs par mchis so/ /de la sdug bsngal zhi byed ces pa'i don ni/ bod du byon pa'i gdams pa phal mo che slob ma mi dge ba las bzlog tu bcug nas da gzod de'i sems rgyud kyi nyon mongasapa sbyangs par byed pa gtso che la/ 'dis ni tshe rabs snga ma'i las kyi dbang gisalus dman pa dang / nad gdon gyis gtses pa sogs sdug bsngal rnams lam du bslangs pas 'phral du zhi bar byas nas rnal 'byor la

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/dang / skyo ston bsod nams bla ma la bshad par pho gcod dang / ma gcig gisadam pa dang / skyo ston gnyis ka las gsan pa mo gcod ces grags pa las/yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang dbyer med pa'i ye shes ḍa ki 'di nyid ni yul g.yel ba/ grong 'dab grong ma tsher mor mor rus khe'u gad kyi rigs su 'khrungs/ slar yang rab tu byung nas dgu cu lnga'i bar du gdul bya bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i don mdzad cing / sher phyin gyi gdams ngag zab mo gcod yul gyi grub mtha' gangs can thams cad la khyab par mdzad/ tshogs slob kyang sras rgyal ba don grub nas brgyud pa la sras brgyud dang / khu sgom chos seng nas slob brgyud rnams byung / phyis kun mkhyen rang byung rdo rje dang / rgod phrug ras pa rgyal thang pa sogs lam 'di'i bka' babs mang du byung ste/ deng sang yang bka' brgyud gtso bor gyur pa'i sa rnying dge lugs sogs kyi grub mtha' thams cad la khros nag lha lnga'i dbang / nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi byin rlabs/ zhag bdun ma dang stan thog gcig ma sogs kyi nyams khrid phyag bzhes dang bcas pa/ ma ga ṇi ga gi bka' chems sogs rtsa ba'i gzhud dang / grub mtha' so so'i gcod gzhung glegs bam mang po'i lung sogs ci rigs par mchis so/ /de la sdug bsngal zhi byed ces pa'i don ni/ bod du byon pa'i gdams pa phal mo che slob ma mi dge ba las bzlog tu bcug nas da gzod de'i sems rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa sbyangs par byed pa gtso che la/ 'dis ni tshe rabs snga ma'i las kyi dbang gis lus dman pa dang / nad gdon gyis gtses pa sogs sdug bsngal rnams lam du bslangs pas 'phral du zhi bar byas nas rnal 'byor la

yo chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()sbyor bzod pa'i phyir de skad ces bya ste/ sher snying las/ sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i sngags/ ces pa la brten nas btags par bzhed de/gcod yul ces pa ni/ gcod bya ni/ thogs bcas/ thogs med/ dga' brod/snyems byed de bdud bzhi'i rgyu 'bras su gyur pa'i nyon mongs pa thams cad spang gnyen res 'jog ma yin par yul de nyid kyi rang thog tu gcod par byed pas de skad ces bya zhing / ngo bo pha rol tu phyin pa la sngags dang rjes su mthun pa'i spyod pas khyad par du byas pa'o/ /༈ yang dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i thog mar bstan pa la snga 'gyur smad 'dul gyi brgyud pa ni/ lha btsan po khri srong dus/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po zhi ba 'tshos/ sba rat+na ye shes dbang po srung ba sogs sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung bas mtshon bstan pa'i sgron me dang por sbar/ dar mas bstan pa bsnubs pa'i skabs/ sba rat+na'i mkhan bu 'dul ba 'dzin pa dmar g.yo gtsang gsum khams su byon/ de rnams kyi spyan sngar bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyis rab tu byung zhing 'dul ba'i sde snod la sbyangs/ de las klu mes sogs dbus gtsang gi mi bcus bka' drin zhus te so sos gnas gzhi yang brtsigs te chos grwa shin tu mang ba byung / bka' gdams pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rnams kyang snga 'gyur gyi sdom rgyun las bsnyen par rdzogs/ bar du lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta dharma pā la spyan drangs te/ mkhan bu pā la rnam gsum bsnyen par rdzogs te stod mnga' ris phyogs su dar ba stod 'dul zhes grags pa byung / gzhan yang lte btsun gyis zha lur a bha ya'i sdom rgyun spel 150

'tshechen 'od snang las/ saskya'i choga'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()sbyor bzod pa'i phyir de skad ces bya ste/ sher snying las/ sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i sngags/ ces pa la brten nas btags par bzhed de/gcod yul ces pa ni/ gcod bya ni/ thogasabacas/ thogasamed/ dga' brod/snyems byed de bdud bzhi'i rgyu 'bras su gyur pa'i nyon mongs pa thams cad spang gnyen res 'jog ma yin par yul de nyid kyi rang thog tu gcod par byed pas de skad ces bya zhing / ngo bo pha rol tu phyin pa la sngags dang rjes su mthun pa'i spyod pas khyad par du byas pa'o/ /༈ yang dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i thog mar bstan pa la snga 'gyur smad 'dul gyi brgyud pa ni/ lha btsan po khri srong dus/ byang chub semasadapa' chen po zhi ba 'tshos/ sba rat+na ye shes dbang po srung ba sogs sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung bas mtshon bstan pa'i sgron me dang por sbar/ dar mas bstan pa bsnubs pa'i skabs/ sba rat+na'i mkhan bu 'dul ba 'dzin pa dmar g.yo gtsang gsum khams su byon/ de rnams kyi spyan sngar bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyis rab tu byung zhing 'dul ba'i sde snod la sbyangs/ de las klu mes sogs dbus gtsang gi mi bcus bka' drin zhus te so sos gnas gzhi yang brtsigs te chos grwa shin tu mang ba byung / bka' gdams pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rnams kyang snga 'gyur gyi sdom rgyun las bsnyen par rdzogs/ bar du lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta dharma pā la spyan drangs te/ mkhan bu pā la rnam gsum bsnyen par rdzogs te stod mnga' ris phyogs su dar ba stod 'dul zhes grags pa byung / gzhan yang lte btsun gyis zha lur a bha ya'i sdom rgyun spel 150

gangs can bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs mdor bsdus/na'ang / snga 'gyur gyi bshad rgyun ni kha che lugs kyi brgyud pa dang 'dres shing sdom rgyun kyang deng sang gi bar du gnas la/ rnying ma dang dge lugs phyogs 'ga' zhig phyi ma gnyis kyi srol ni yun ma byung ngo / /phyis ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas gsum pa kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī bod du phebs nas 'dul ba'i sdom rgyun gsar du btsugs pa las/ gas ( sde grangs med pa zhig 'phel ba'i rtsa ba lta bu ni / dge 'dun sgang pa/ chos lang ba/ tshal mig pa/ bye rdzing pa ste tsho gos sde bzhir grags pa 'di yin la/ 'di rnams su sngar 'dul ba'i bshad pa dang lag len gnyis ka khyad par can byung na'ang / deng sang ni spyi 'gre tsam las dmigasabasal gyi khyad chos yod pa ma mngon mod/ 'on kyang dge 'dun sgang pa las gar lugs/ sna'i/lung pa las 'brug lugs/ tshal mig pa las ngor lugs dang / sa lugs snga ma rnams kyis mtshon sdom rgyun mang du 'phel bas phyogs thams cad du 'dul ba'i bstan pa shin tu dar zhing rgyas par gyur to/ /de ltar na gangs kyi ri bo'i sul na ston pa bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa 'ba' zhig gi dbang du byas te/ 'gro ba rnams kyi phan bde'i gzhir gyur pa'i dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde dang / gdan rabs kyi skor ji ltar byon pa'i tshul sogs yongs su grags pa 'ga' zhig gi mtshan tsam brjod zin te/ spyir yang ji skad du/ shes rab mchog yin de'i gzhi ni/ /thos pa yin phyir thos pa gces/ /ces gsungs pa ltar rang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' yi gang zag dang chos kyi tshul mang du thos par bya ba ni shin tu gal che ste/ gzhan du rang rang gi lugs srol tsam khong du chud par rlom pa kha cig kyang / rang gi bla ma brgyud pa 151

gangasacan bod yul du byon pa'i gsang sngagasagasar rnying gi gdan rabasamador bsdus/na'ang / snga 'gyur gyi bshad rgyun ni kha che lugs kyi brgyud pa dang 'dres shing sdom rgyun kyang deng sang gi bar du gnas la/ rnying ma dang dge lugs phyogs 'ga' zhig phyi ma gnyis kyi srol ni yun ma byung ngo / /phyisam byon pa'i sangs rgyas gsum pa kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī bod du phebs nas 'dul ba'i sdom rgyun gsar du btsugs pa las/ tshogasasde grangs med pa zhig 'phel ba'i rtsa ba lta bu ni / dge 'dun sgang pa/ chosalang ba/ tshal mig pa/ bye rdzing pa ste tshogasasde bzhir grags pa 'di yin la/ 'di rnams su sngar 'dul ba'i bshad pa dang lag len gnyis ka khyad par can byung na'ang / deng sang ni spyi 'gre tsam lasadamigasabasal gyi khyad chos yod pa ma mngon mod/ 'on kyang dge 'dun sgang pa las gar lugs/ rngoṭha/lung pa las 'brug lugs/ tshal mig pa las ngor lugs dang / sa lugs snga ma rnams kyis mtshon sdom rgyun mang du 'phel bas phyogs thams cad du 'dul ba'i bstan pa shin tu dar zhing rgyas par gyur to/ /de ltar na gangs kyi ri bo'i sul na ston pa bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa 'ba' zhig gi dbang du byas te/ 'gro ba rnams kyi phan bde'i gzhir gyur pa'i dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde dang / gdan rabs kyi skor ji ltar byon pa'i tshul sogs yongs su grags pa 'ga' zhig gi mtshan tsam brjod zin te/ spyir yang ji skad du/ shes rab mchog yin de'i gzhi ni/ /thosapa yin phyir thos pa gces/ /cesagasungs pa ltar rang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' yi gang zag dang chos kyi tshul mang du thos par bya ba ni shin tu gal che ste/ gzhan du rang rang gi lugs srol tsam khong du chud par rlom pa kha cig kyang / rang gi bla ma brgyud pa 151

brtse chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gcesabasdus/ ()dang / chos lugs tsam ma gtogs gzhan mkhas pa dang grub pa dang lung rigs kyis dben no snyam du sems shing gzhan la'ang gdams pas chos spong ba'i las mi zad pa gsog pa dag snang ba'i phyir ro/ /de bsan bdag legs su 'dod pa rnams kyis ston pa thugs rje can gyi rnam thar mdo sde rin po che rnams dang / de dag gi don bsdus pa brgya nyer lnga pa dang / byamasapa mosarjegasalabazang rgya mtsho/ skyes rabs so bzhi pa kha skong rang byung zhabasasogasa'agrel chen ye shesargyalami' sogasadang bcas pa/ rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing mchan/ spang losaston sogasadang don bsdu ba'i rigs dang / 'phagasapa'i gnasabartan bcu drug dang /ye shes rgyal mtshan sogs/grub chen brgyad cu'i rtogs pa brjod pa sogasalegs par blta zhing dad pa bskyed/ grub mtha' spyi'i chosa'abyung skor la/ thamasacad mkhyen pa tā ra nā thas mdzad pa'i rgya gar chos 'byung dang / bka' babs bdun gyi gtam sogs rgya gar ba'i gtam tshad ma mang po dang / gung mgon po skyabs kyis byas pa'i rgya nag gi chos 'byung / bu ston rin po che'i mosa'abyung / tshal pa'i deb dmar/ 'gos lo'i deb sngon/ dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba'i chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston/ pad dkar gyi bstan pa'i pad+mo rgyas pa'i nyin byed/ thu'u bkwan pa'i grub mtha' shel gyi me long / rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long dang / rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston sogs/ bye brag sngar smos pa'i so so'i rnam thar dang lo rgyus rnams la blo gros kyi mig bsgrubs te rang gi lugs sre la ma nyams par bzung ba'i steng / grub mtha' gzhan la'ang sdang zhen gyis smod pa sogs spangs te/ dad pa'i pad+mo mchog tu rgyasapar bya'o/ /thosapa'i yid 152

brtse chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()dang / chos lugs tsam ma gtogs gzhan mkhas pa dang grub pa dang lung rigs kyis dben no snyam du sems shing gzhan la'ang gdams pas chos spong ba'i las mi zad pa gsog pa dag snang ba'i phyir ro/ /de bsan bdag legs su 'dod pa rnams kyis ston pa thugs rje can gyi rnam thar mdo sde rin po che rnams dang / de dag gi don bsdus pa brgya nyer lnga pa dang / byams pa chos rjes la bzang rgya mtsho/ skyes rabs so bzhi pa kha skong rang byung zhabs so gos 'grel chen ye shes rgyal ma' sogs dang bcas pa/ rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing mchan/ spang los ston sogs dang don bsdu ba'i rigs dang / 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug dang /ye shes rgyal mtshan sogs/grub chen brgyad cu'i rtogs pa brjod pa sogs legs par blta zhing dad pa bskyed/ grub mtha' spyi'i chosang skor la/ thams cad mkhyen pa tā ra nā thas mdzad pa'i rgya gar chos 'byung dang / bka' babs bdun gyi gtam sogs rgya gar ba'i gtam tshad ma mang po dang / gung mgon po skyabs kyis byas pa'i rgya nag gi chos 'byung / bu ston rin po che'i chosang / tshal pa'i deb dmar/ 'gos lo'i deb sngon/ dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba'i chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston/ pad dkar gyi bstan pa'i pad+mo rgyas pa'i nyin byed/ thu'u bkwan pa'i grub mtha' shel gyi me long / rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long dang / rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston sogs/ bye brag sngar smos pa'i so so'i rnam thar dang lo rgyus rnams la blo gros kyi mig bsgrubs te rang gi lugs sre la ma nyams par bzung ba'i steng / grub mtha' gzhan la'ang sdang chen gyis smod pa sogs spangs te/ dad pa'i pad+mo mchog tu rgyas par bya'o/ /thos pa'i yid 152

kyi gdung sel zhing / /phan bde'i chu gter 'phel byed pa/ /dam pa'i rnam thar zla shel gyis/ /'jig rten gsum po snang gyur cig /gangs can gyi ljongs su byon pa'i gdan rabs sogs cung zad bshad pa'i brjed byang gi le tshan no/ khu bhamastu sarba dzā ga tī// //

kyi gdung sel zhing / /phan bde'i chu gter 'phel byed pa/ /dam pa'i rnam thar zla shel gyis/ /'jig rten gsum po snang gyur cig /gangs can gyi ljongs su byon pa'i gdan rabs sogs cung zad bshad pa'i brjed byang gi le tshan no/ khu bhamastu sarba dzā ga tī// //

༄༅/ /mdo sngags bstan pa rin po che'i chos kyi byung tshul las brtsams pa'i lo rgyus dang rnam thar shin tu mang po ngo mtshar lha'i pad tshol zhes bya ba bsdokyigs sa/ /༄༅/ /oṃ swa sti siji/ thob pa tsam nas srid dang zhi'i/ /rgud pa mtha' dag drung 'byin pa/ /dam chos yid bzhin nor bu'i dpal/ /byung ba'i lo rgyus mdo tsam glengs/ /'di la gsum ste/ bdag po'i rkyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byon nas des chos kyi 'khor lo ji ltar bskor ba'i tshul dang / de nyid bka' bsdu ba ji ltar byas pa'i tshul dang / de nyid bstan skyong chen po rnams kyis ji ltar bkral zhing bskyang ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po bdag po'i rkyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byon nas des chos kyi 'khor lo ji ltar bskor ba'i tshul/ dang po ni/lha dang bcas pa'i ston pa gcig pu ba zas gtsang sras kyi rigs su 'khrungs pa'i skyob pa shākya'i tog de nyid kyis/ dang por smon pa dang 'jug pa'i tshul can gyi byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ bar du grangs med pa'i bskal pa gsum gyi srid du tshogs bsags/ tha ma dbus 'gyur 'chang rdo rje'i rdul brtsegs pa'i spor byang chub ljon pa'i bsil grib tu mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan nas rigs can gsum gyi 'gro ba rnams rjes su bzung ba'i slad/ theg pa che 154

༄༅/ /mdo sngags bstan pa rin po che'i chos kyi byung tshul las brtsams pa'i lo rgyus dang rnam thar shin tu mang po ngo mtshar lha'i pad tshol zhes bya ba bsdokyigs sa/ /༄tsho/ /oṃ swa sti siji/ thob pa tsam nas srid dang zhi'i/ /rgud pa mtha' dag drung 'byin pa/ /dam chos yid bzhin nor bu'i dpal/ /byung ba'i lo rgyus mdo tsam glengs/ /'di la gsum ste/ bdag po'i rkyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byon nas des chos kyi 'khor lo ji ltar bskor ba'i tshul dang / de nyid bka' bsdu ba ji ltar byas pa'i tshul dang / de nyid bstan skyong chen po rnams kyis ji ltar bkral zhing bskyang ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po bdag po'i rkyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byon nas des chos kyi 'khor lo ji ltar bskor ba'i tshul/ dang po ni/lha dang bcas pa'i ston pa gcig pu ba zas gtsang sras kyi rigs su 'khrungs pa'i skyob pa shākya'i tog de nyid kyis/ dang por smon pa dang 'jug pa'i tshul can gyi byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ bar du grangs med pa'i bskal pa gsum gyi srid du tshogs bsags/ tha ma dbus 'gyur 'chang rdo rje'i rdul brtsegs pa'i spor byang chub ljon pa'i bsil grib tu mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan nas rigs can gsum gyi 'gro ba rnams rjes su bzung ba'i slad/ theg pa che 154

mdo sngagasabastan pa rin po che'i mosakyi byung tshul lasabartsamasapa'i lo rgyusadang rnam thar/chung gi chos kyi bdud rtsi bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan par mdzad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ theg dman gyi lugs la bka' bsdu rim pa gsum gyis dang po nye bar 'khor/ 'od srungs/ kun dga' bo gsum gyis 'dul mdo mngon pa'i sde snod gsum bsdus/ gnyis pa yangs pa can gyi dge slong rnams kyis rung ba ma yin pa'i gzhi bcu spel ba grags pa la sogs pa'i dgra bcom pa bdun brgyas sun dbyung zhing sde snod gsum rdzogs par bton/ gsum pa ni/kha che'i yul rna rgyan gyi gtsug lag khang ngam/ gzhan dag dza lan+dha ra'i dgon pa ku sa ra zhes kyang bod pa der dgra bcom pa rtsib log sogs kyis sde pa bco brgyad po thams cad sangs rgyas kyi bkar sgrub cing 'dul ba yi ger bkod/mdo mngon gnyis kyang rgya cher spel lo/ /theg chen pa dag ni rtsa ba'i sdud po kun bzang dang / byamasapa dang / 'jam dpal dang / phyag rdor sogs kyis bsdus par 'dod la/ rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde rnamasani gtso bor dpal gsang ba 'dzin pa'i bdag po dang / gzhan du zhu ba po so sos bsdus pa ltar yang snang ngo / /gsum pa ni rgya gar du ji ltar bskyang tshul dang / bod du ji ltar bskyang tshul gnyis/ dang po theg dman dang / theg chen gnyis/ dang po ni/ ston pasa'od srungs dang / des kun dga' bo/ sha na'i gosacan/ nyer sbas/ dhi ti kanag po pa/ legasamathong / legasamathong chen po ste bstan pa'i gdan rabs bdun dang / dgra bcom pa chos skyobs/ dbyangs sgrogs/ dbyig bshes/sangs rgyas lha ste chen po bzhir grags pa bzhi so sor slob ma 'bum phrag gi grangs longs pa rnams byon nasabastan pa la bya ba rgya cher mdzad/155

mdo sngags bstan pa rin po che'i chos kyi byung tshul las brtsams pa'i lo rgyus dang rnam thar/chung gi chos kyi bdud rtsi bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan par mdzad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ theg dman gyi lugs la bka' bsdu rim pa gsum gyis dang po nye bar 'khor/ 'od srungs/ kun dga' bo gsum gyis 'dul mdo mngon pa'i sde snod gsum bsdus/ gnyis pa yangs pa can gyi dge slong rnams kyis rung ba ma yin pa'i gzhi bcu spel ba grags pa la sogs pa'i dgra bcom pa bdun brgyas sun dbyung zhing sde sdod gsum rdzogs par bton/ gsum pa ni/kha che'i yul rna rgyan gyi gtsug lag khang ngam/ gzhan dag dza lan+ta ra'i dgon pa ku sa ra zhes kyang bod pa der dgra bcom pa rtsib log sogs kyis sde pa bco brgyad po thams cad sangs rgyas kyi bkar sgrub cing 'dul ba yi ger bkod/mdo mngon gnyis kyang rgya cher spel lo/ /theg chen pa dag ni rtsa ba'i sdud po kun bzang dang / byams pa dang / 'jam dpal dang / phyag rdor sogs kyis bsdus par 'dod la/ rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde rnams ni gtso bor dpal gsang ba 'dzin pa'i bdag po dang / gzhan du zhu ba po so sos bsdus pa ltar yang snang ngo / /gsum pa ni rgya gar du ji ltar bskyang tshul dang / bod du ji ltar bskyang tshul gnyis/ dang po theg dman dang / theg chen gnyis/ dang po ni/ ston pasa'od srungs dang / des kun dga' bo/ sha na'i gos can/ nyer sbas/ dhi ti kanag po pa/ legs mthong / legs mthong chen po ste bstan pa'i gdan rabs bdun dang / dgra bcom pa chos skyobs/ dbyangs sgrogs/ dbyig bshes/sangs rgyas lha ste chen po bzhir grags pa bzhi so sor slob ma 'bum phrag gi grangs longs pa rnams byon nas bstan pa la bya ba rgya cher mdzad/155

ba chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chogaḥng sa bsdus/ ()gnyisapa la ma nyid dang / sngagasaganyisalas/ dang po ni/ yul o ṭi bi shar rgyal po zla srung gi khyim du 'jam dpal dge slong gi tshul gyis byon nas chos bstan cing theg pa chen po thog mar snang bar byas/ de nas btsun pa a bi tan sogs rnam rig smra ba'i slob dpon lnga brgya tsam byon cing / shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod rnams kyang mi yul du byung / de nasabram ze sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po byon/ de'i slob ma sangs rgyas gnyis pa klu sgrub kyisasher phyin dngos bstan dbu ma'i lam srol rgya cher phye/ de'i slob ma nā ga hā ste klus pos dang /arla de ba ste 'phagasapa lha dang / nā ga bo dhi dang / klu'i byang chub sogs byon/ ār+ya de ba'i slob ma dmangs rigasapa sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po dang / slob dpon dpa' bo zhabs so/ /ston pa 'das nas lo dgu brgya na slob dpon thogs med sku mched byon/ gcen gyis dga' ldan du phebs te byamasamagon las chos kyi bdud rtsi gsol/ slar mi yul du phebs te theg pa chen po'i seng ge'i sgra bsgrags/ de'i slob ma'i mchog gcung bā su brgyus theg pa che chung gi mngon pa sogs gsal bar mdzad/ slob ma phyogasaglang / yon tan 'od/ blo grosabastan pa/ 'phags pa rnam grol sde bzhi ni tshad ma 'dul mngon phar phyin bzhir rang las mkhas pa bzhi zhes grags/ klu sgrub kyi slob ma dge srung las legs ldan 'byed dang sangs rgyas bskyangs gnyis byon te rang thal gyi srol gsar du dbye/ sangs rgyas bskyangs kyi slob ma ka ma la budhi'i slob ma zla ba grags pas thal 'gyur gyi sgra phyogs bcur bsgrags shing / 'di'i tshe dge bsnyen tsan+d+ra'i zhabs kyang byon te slob dpon blo grosabartan pa'i slob ma yin/ zla grags dang nā len+d+rar lo bdun 156

ba chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang / sngags gnyis las/ dang po ni/ yul o ṭi bi shar rgyal po zla srung gi khyim du 'jam dpal dge slong gi tshul gyis byon nas chos bstan cing theg pa chen po thog mar snang bar byas/ de nas btsun pa a bi tan sogs rnam rig smra ba'i slob dpon lnga brgya tsam byon cing / shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod rnams kyang mi yul du byung / de nas bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po byon/ de'i slob ma sangs rgyas gnyis pa klu sgrub kyis sher phyin dngos bstan dbu ma'i lam srol rgya cher phye/ de'i slob ma nā ga hā ste klus pos dang /a rla de ba ste 'phags pa lha dang / nā ga bo dhi dang / klu'i byang chub sogs byon/ ārla de ba'i slob ma dmangs rigs pa sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po dang / slob dpon dpa' bo zhabs so/ /ston pa 'das nas lo dgu brgya na slob dpon thogs med sku mched byon/ gcen gyis dga' ldan du phebs te byams mgon las chos kyi bdud rtsi gsol/ slar mi yul du phebs te theg pa chen po'i seng ge'i sgra bsgrags/ de'i slob ma'i mchog gcung bā su brgyus theg pa che chung gi mngon pa sogs gsal bar mdzad/ slob ma phyogs glang / yon tan 'od/ blo gros bstan pa/ 'phags pa rnam grol sde bzhi ni tshad ma 'dul mngon phar phyin bzhir rang las mkhas pa bzhi zhes grags/ lnga/ sgrub kyi 〉stob ma dge srung las legs ldan 'byed dang sangs rgyas bskyangs gnyis byon te rang thal gyi srol gsar du dbye/ sangs rgyas bskyangs kyi slob ma ka ma la bzhi'i slob ma zla ba grags pas thal 'gyur gyi sgra phyogs bcur bsgrags shing / 'di'i tshe dge bsnyen tsan+t+ra'i zhabs kyang byon te slob dpon blo gros brtan pa'i slob ma yin/ zla grags dang nā len+t+ra ra lo bdun 156

mdo sngags bstan pa rin po che'i chos kyi byung tshul las brtsams pa'i lo rgyus dang rnam thar/du chos kyi brgal brtag mdzad cing slob dpon so sos klu thogs kyi gzhung bzung / phyis po ta lar gshegs par grags/ slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po sogs kyi slob ma nā le rgyu'i mkhan po chos skyong zhes bya ba byon/ dbu ma bzhi brgya pa rnam rig tu bkral ba sogs bstan bcos mang du mdzad/ de'i slob ma bhu su ku'i spyod pa can slob dpon chen po zhi ba lha dang / dpal ldan chos skyong ste phyisabi hūṃ par grags pa gnyis yin/ phyogs kyi glang po'i slob ma rgol ba dbang phyug sde las tshad ma dang / slob dpon chos skyong las sde snod gsum gyi zil dngar bzhes pa dpal chos kyi grags ka pa ni phyogs kyi glang po gnyis par gyur/ dpal he ru ka las phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi dngos grub thob/ de ltar na/ klu sgrub/thogs med/ phyogs glang gsum gzhung byed pa po dang / ārla de ba/ dbyig gnyen/ chos grags gsum ni 'grel pa byed pa po ste 'dzam gling mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan drug tu grags kyi/ mchog gnyis la sogs pa'i tha snyad ni 'phags yul du mi snang / de nas rnam snang bzang po las sher phyin gsan cing ma pham pas dbugs dbyung ba slob dpon seng ge bzang po dang / de'i slob ma sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs sogs kyis phar phyin dang / yon tan 'od kyi slob ma shākya 'od dang / dharma mi tra dang / dgra bcom sa ga'i lha sogs kyis 'dul bstan spel/ spyir 'dul ba la bshes gnyen drug dang / phar phyin la bka' bab drug ces kyang grags/ phyi zhig na bi kra ma shī lar nyi zla lta bu'i mkhas pa sgo drug ces/shan+ta pa shar sher 'byung sbas pa/ ngag dbang grags pa/ nā ro pa byang bram ze rin snyo rdo rje/ dbus dz+nyā na shrī mi tra rnams byon/ de rjes jo bo rje di paṃ kā ra dang / de 157

mdo sngagasabastan pa rin po che'i chos kyi byung tshul lasabartsams pa'i lo rgyusadang rnam thar/du chos kyi brgal brtag mdzad cing slob dpon so sos klu thogs kyi gzhung bzung / phyiba'ipo ta lar btanags par grags/ slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po sogs kyi slob ma nā len+d+ra'i mkhan po chos skyong zhes bya ba byon/ dbu ma bzhi brgya pa rnam rig tu bkral ba sogs bstan bcos mang du mdzad/ de'i slob ma bhu su ku'i spyod pa can slob dpon chen po zhi ba lha dang / dpal ldan chos skyong ste phyisabi hūṃ par grags pa gnyis yin/ phyogs kyi glang po'i slob ma rgol ba dbang phyug sde las tshad ma dang / slob dpon chos skyong las sde snod gsum gyi zil dngar bzhes pa dpal chos kyi gragabashapa ni phyogs kyi glang po gnyis par gyur/ dpal he ru ka lasaphyogasalas rnam rgyal gyi dngos grub thob/ de ltar na/ klu sgrub/thogs med/ phyogs glang gsum gzhung byed pa po dang / ār+ya de ba/ dbyig gnyen/ chos grags gsum ni 'grel pa byed pa po ste 'dzam gling mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan drug tu grags kyi/ mchog gnyis la sogs pa'i tha snyad ni 'phags yul du mi snang / de nas rnam snang bzang po las sher phyin gsan cing ma pham pas dbugs dbyung ba slob dpon seng ge bzang po dang / de'i slob ma sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs sogs kyis phar phyin dang / yon tan 'od kyi slob ma shākya 'od dang / dharma mi tra dang / dgra bcom sa ga'i lha sogs kyis 'dul bstan spel/ spyir 'dul ba la bshes gnyen drug dang / phar phyin la bka' bab drug ces kyang grags/ phyi zhig na bi kra ma shī lar nyi zla lta bu'i mkhas pa sgo drug ces/shan+ti pa shar sher 'byung sbas pa/ ngag dbang grags pa/ nā ro pa byang bram ze rin snyo rdo rje/ dbusadz+nyā na shrī mi tra rnams byon/ de rjes jo bo rje dī paṃ kā ra dang / de 157

ba tshe chen 'od sna pa las/ sa skya'i chog5nga tso4bsdus/ rtonanas rdo rje gdan du a bhā ya ka ra/ ma hā paṇ+ḍita shākya shrī sogs kyis bstan pa bzung / de'i skabs su tu dra tshe'i rgyal po zla bas dmag gi sbyor ba tshan che ba lhags te yul dbus kyi gtsug lag khang phal cher bzhig mkhas shing sdo/ba pa'i dbang po rnams kyang phyogs gzhan du 'khyal nas bstan pa'i dngos gzhi nub kyang / rgyal phran 'dras chos gzhi cung zad btsugs te paṇ+ḍi ta tā ru la shrī bha dra dang / shā ri su tra dang / sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po sogs kyis rang stobs gang yod kyis bstan pa la bya ba mdzad na'ang / deng sang ni yul dbus su nang pa'i bstan pa 'ga' yang med par mngon no/ /gzhan rgya gar gyi yul phran so sor ji ltar dar ba'i tshul rgyas par yi ges 'jigs kyang / 'phags yul shar phyogs dang / byang shar shar khar kham dang / 'ab kyi na ga ra sogs su sngar nas yod pa dang / ma ha dh+wa sogs su bstan pa nub pas rkyen byas/ gsar du bcos pa'i rgyun deng sang yang yod par grags shing gtso bor theg chen pa'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'o/ /siṅga la'i gling dang / dha na shrī'i gling sogs su ni nyan thos pa dar che bar mngon/ /gnyis pa la/ bya spyod kyi rgyud gnyis ni ston pas mi'i 'gro ba la gsungs pa sogs dang / gnod sbyin sogs la bstan pa'i rgyun dus de nyid nas bzung 'phags yul du skal ba can mang pos sngags grub pa'i rgyun ma nyams par yod pa la/ phyis theg chen dar ba'i mgo brtsam pa dang shin tu rgyas par gyur la/ de tsam na rnal 'byor phyi nang gnyis kyang thod rgal tsam las rgyun chags su med par mngon cing / phyis bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin gyi sku ring nas 158

'tshechen 'od snangalas/ saskya'i chogayang sa bsdus/ ()nas rdo rje gdan du a bhā ya ka ra/ ma hā paṇ+ḍita shākya shrī sogs kyis bstan pa bzung / de'i skabasasu tu ruṣ+ka'i rgyal po zla bsadamag gi sbyor ba tshan che ba lhags te yul dbus kyi gtsug lag khang phal cher bshig mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang po rnams kyang phyogs gzhan du 'khyal nas bstan pa'i dngos gzhi nub kyang / rgyal phran 'dras chos gzhi cung zad btsugs te paṇ+ḍi ta tā ru la shrī bha dra dang / shā ri su tra dang / sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po sogasakyis rang stobasagang yod kyis bstan pa la bya ba mdzad na'ang / deng sang ni yul dbus su nang pa'i bstan pa 'ga' yang med par mngon no/ /gzhan rgya gar gyi yul phran so sor ji ltar dar ba'i tshul rgyasapar yi ges 'jigs kyang / 'phags yul shar phyogs dang / byang shar shar khar kham dang / bit+ya na ga ra sogs su sngar nasayod pa dang / ma ha dh+wa sogs su bstan pa nub pas rkyen byas/ gsar du bcos pa'i rgyun deng sang yang yod par grags shing gtso bor theg chen pa'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'o+o/ /siṅga la'i gling dang / dha na shrī'i gling sogs su ni nyan thosapa dar che bar mngan/ /gnyis pa la/ bya spyod kyi rgyud gnyis ni ston pas mi'i 'gro ba la gsungs pa sogs dang / gnod sbyin sogs la bstan pa'i rgyun dus de nyid nas bzung 'phags yul du skal ba can mang pos sngags grub pa'i rgyun ma nyams par yod pa la/ phyis theg chen dar ba'i mgo brtsam pa dang shin tu rgyasapar gyur la/ de tsam na rnal 'byor phyi nang gnyis kyang thod rgal tsam las rgyun chags su med par mngon cing / phyis bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin gyi sku ring nas 158

mdo sngagasabastan pa rin po che'i mosakyi byung tshul lasabartsamasapa'i lo rgyusadang rnam thar/bzung dar zhing rgyas/ de yang ston pa dngos kyis o rgyan gyi rgyal po in+d+ra bhā ti la gsang 'dus dang / sham+bha lar gsang bdag zla bzang la dusa'akhor gyis/gtsos pa'i rgyud thams cad bstan par bzhed pa dang / rgya gar shar phyogs kyi rgyal po rab gsal zla bar dpal gsang ba 'dzin pas lha gnas gsum du grags pa'i rgyud de nyid 'dus pa sogs rnal 'byor gyi rgyud thams cad bstan/ ston pa 'das nas lo sum brgya tsam na dpal sa ra ha byon nas gsang bdag las lung blangs shing / mi'i bla ma'ang slob dpon rnam par mi rtog pa dang / o rgyan du klu las gyur pa'i rnal 'byor mas rjes su bzung ba bi su galpa sogs bsten/ o rgyan nas sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud spyan drangs/ des slob dpon klu sgrub rjesasu bzung / dang po theg chen dar ba nas 'di'i bar du bya spyod gtso bor gyur pa'i sngags kyi grub thob stong phrag brgya byung bar grags/ klu sgrub slob ma 'phags pa lha dang / klu byang sogasadang / de dang dus mtshungasadapal shwa ba ri dbang phyug sogs kyang byon/ 'di skabs kyi sngags ni gtso bor gsang sdom gdan thod rnams yin par grags/ gzhan yang slob dpon rta mchog dpal dang / grub pa'i dbang phyug lū hi pa sogs byon/lū hi pa nas dwa ri ka pa/ ḍik+ki sogs rjes su bzung / de 'og zla ba grags pas kyang gsang ba 'dus ba'i bstan pa lhag par spel ba'i rjes/'jigs bral rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bi rū pas klu byang las gshed skor nos te grub/ rdo rje bdag med mas rjes su bzung zhing sadrug pa mngon du gyur/ o rgyan nas gshed dmar rgyud spyan drangs/ bshad pa dang man ngag gi gtad pa 159

mdo sngags bstan pa rin po che'i chos kyi byung tshul las brtsams pa'i lo rgyus dang rnam thar/bzung dar zhing rgyas/ de yang ston pa dngos kyis o rgyan gyi rgyal po in+d+ra rna ti la gsang 'dus dang / sham+bha lar gsang bdag zla bzang la dus 'khor gyis/gtsos pa'i rgyud thams cad bstan par bzhed pa dang / rgya gar shar phyogs kyi rgyal po rab gsal zla bar dpal gsang ba 'dzin pas lha gnas gsum du grags pa'i rgyud de nyid 'dus pa sogs rnal 'byor gyi rgyud thams cad bstan/ ston pa 'das nas lo sum brgya tsam na dpal sa ra ha byon nas gsang bdag las lung blangs shing / mi'i bla ma'ang slob dpon rnam par mi rtog pa dang / o rgyan du klu las gyur pa'i rnal 'byor mas rjes su bzung ba bi su ga lpa sogs bsten/ o rgyan nas sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud spyan drangs/ des slob dpon klu sgrub rjes su bzung / dang po theg chen dar ba nas 'di'i bar du bya spyod gtso bor gyur pa'i sngags kyi grub thob stong phrag brgya byung bar grags/ klu sgrub slob ma 'phags pa lha dang / klu byang sogs dang / de dang dus mtshungs dpal shwa ba ri dbang phyug sogs kyang byon/ 'di skabs kyi sngags ni gtso bor gsang sdom gdan thod rnams yin par grags/ g.yin yang slob dpon rta mchog dpal dang / grub pa'i dbang phyug lha hi pa sogs byon/lū hi pa nas dwa ri ka pa/ ḍi lha sogs rjes su bzung / de 'og zla ba grags pas kyang gsang ba 'dus ba'i bstan pa lhag par spel ba'i rjes/'jigs bral rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bi rū pas klu byang las gshed skor nos te grub/ rdo rje bdag med mas rjes su bzung zhing sa drug pa mngon du gyur/ o rgyan nas gshed dmar rgyud spyan drangs/ bshad pa dang man ngag gi gtad pa 159

ba chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i rmasang gces bsdus/ ()grub chen g.yung po khrag 'thung dang / nag po pa sogs la gtad/ 'di tsam la slob dpon sa ho ru ha dang / la li ta badz+ra yang byon te snga mas o rgyan nas dgyes rdor dang / phyi mas gshed skor spyan drangs/ ḍo sbos re gi ā ra li'i rgyud spyan drangs te lwa ba pa sogs rjes su bzung / grub chen dwa ka pa'i slob ma rdo rje dril bu pas kyang bde mchog gi skor mchog tu gsal bar mdzad/ des rus sbal zhabs dang / des dza lān+ta ri pa dang / des nag po pa rjes su bzung / de'i 'og tu sngar smos pa'i rgyal po rab gsal zla bas yo ga'i skor rgya cher spel/ de nas birnya pa chung ba dang / nag po pa chung ba sogs gzhal gyis mi lang ba'i sidha pa byon/ khyad par yo ga pa shākya bshes gnyen gyis rnal 'byor rgyud kyi srol rgya cher phyes/ de nas slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjes nā len+t+ra ra sngags bstan rgya cher spel/ de'i 'og tu grub chen ku ku rī pas ma hā mā ya'i skor rnams o rgyan nas spyan drangs/ seng ge bzang po'i zhabs kyi slob ma slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes kyis 'jam dpal las dngos su lung mnos te sngags kyi shing rta pa chen por gyur cing bi kra mar sngags kyi slob dpon chen po mdzad/ kṛ yog sde gsum dang / nang rgyud sde lang 'dus sgyu zla gsang 'jam dpal khros pa sogs rgya cher spel/ tshe 'dir zung 'jug gi sku grub pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas gsang ba dang / sangs rgyas zhi ba sogs byon cing / 'di gnyis kyis bya spyod rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsal bar byas/ de'i 'og tu mā ga dha'i slob dpon kun snying byung / r+bha ga la ba rab gsal zla ba'i dngos slob bzhi la gtugs/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lung byin nas rgyud sde brgya rtsa'i 'grel pa mdzad/ lhag par rnal 'byor gyi rgyud 160

'tshechen 'od snangalas/ saskya'i chosayang sa bsdus/ ()grub chen g.yung po khrag 'thung dang / nag po pa sogasal gtad/ 'di tsam la slob dpon sa ho ru ha dang / la li ta badz+ra yang byon te snga mas o rgyan nas dgyes rdor dang / phyi mas gshed skor spyan drangs/ ḍozhisare gi ā ra li'i rgyud spyan drangs te lwa ba pa sogs rjes su bzung / grub chen dwa ka pa'i slob ma rdo rje dril bu pas kyang bde mchog gi skor mchog tu gsal bar mdzad/ des rus sbal zhabs dang / desadza lān+ta ri pa dang / desanag po pa rjesasu bzung / de'i 'og tu sngar smos pa'i rgyal po rab gsal zla bas yo ga'i skor rgya cher spel/ de nas birnya pa chung ba dang / nag po pa chung ba sogs gzhal gyis mi lang ba'i sid+dha pa byon/ khyad par yo ga pa shākya bshes gnyen gyis rnal 'byor rgyud kyi srol rgya cher phyes/ de nas slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjes nā len+d+rar sngags bstan rgya cher spel/ de'i 'og tu grub chen ku ku rī pas ma hā mā ya'i skor rnams o rgyan nas spyan drangs/ seng ge bzang po'i zhabs kyi slob ma slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes kyis 'jam dpal las dngos su lung mnos te sngags kyi shing rta pa chen por gyur cing bi kra mar sngags kyi slob dpon chen po mdzad/ kṛ yog sde gsum dang / nang rgyud sde lang 'dus sgyu zla gsang 'jam dpal khrosapa sogasargya cher spel/ tshe 'dir zung 'jug gi sku grub pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas gsang ba dang / sangs rgyas zhi ba sogs byon cing / 'di gnyis kyis bya spyod rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsal bar byas/ de'i 'og tu mā ga dha'i slob dpon kun snying byung / r+bha ga la ba rab gsal zla ba'i dngos slob bzhi la gtugs/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lung byin nas rgyud sde brgya rtsa'i 'grel pa mdzad/ lhag par rnal 'byor gyi rgyud 160

mdo sngagasabastan pa rin po che'i chosakyi byung tshul lasabartsams pa'i lo rgyusadang rnam thar/gsal bar byed pa'i nyi ma gcig pur gyur/ 'di tsam na slob dpon ye shes byin/ ye shes gragasapa/ laṅka rgyal bzang sogs dang / khyad par shar phyogs dza go'i yul du ti l+li pa byon/ tsār+ya pa sogabatabaka' babs bzhizhi bla ma bsten/ he ru ka nyid las rdo rje theg pa'i bdud rtsi gsol cing grub pa'i spyod pa chen po mdzad/ yang sngon tshe zhig na paṇ+ḍi ta zab pa'i rdo rjes o rgyan dhu mā tha la nas ye shes kyi mkha' 'gros bdud rtsi bzhi yi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba nas rim par brgyud de/ phyisakun snying gi dus tsam na slob dpon bdud rtsi gsang bas de'i srol phye/ rgyal po dharma pā la'i ring la slob dpon shrī dh+wa ras ye shes zhabs kyi slob brgyud 'ga' zhig la bsten nas gsang 'dus dang gshed skor la grub pa brnyes/ de nadra'ibha ba bha dra dang / skal ldan grags pa/ lī la badz+ra/mi thub zla ba/ ta thā ga ta sogs byon cing rgyud sde rgya mtshor mkhyen pa rgyas/ bi kra mar bstan pa skyong / rgyal po hi ma pā la'i sku tshe'i smad tsam na shar ekhri bar tsi lu paṇ+ḍita byon nas rigasaldan gyi sprul par dus 'khor gsan/ nā len+d+rar piṇ+ḍob chung ba dang / dusazhabs pa chen po rjes su bzung / phyi ma slar yang sham+bha lar byon nas rigs ldan nyid las gsan cing yul dbus su ches dar bar mdzad/'di skabs slob dpon ka ma la rak+ṣi ta dang / pad+ma lcags kyu/ 'jam dbyangs grub pa'i dpa' bo dze tā ri rnams byon cing bi kra mar bzhugs/ de nas rgyal po rbo na ga'i ring la bi kra mar mkhas pa sgo drug byon te thams cad kyang sngags kyi grub brnyes chen po yin mod kyi/ khyad par til+li pa dang / dus zhabs pa chen po'i slob ma nā ro pa ni rdo rje theg pa'i gsang 'dzin mchog tu 'khums so/ /de 161
