mdo sngags bstan pa rin po che'i chos kyi byung tshul las brtsams pa'i lo rgyus dang rnam thar/gsal bar byed pa'i nyi ma gcig pur gyur/ 'di tsam na slob dpon ye shes byin/ ye shes grags pa/ laṅka rgyal bzang sogs dang / khyad par shar phyogs dza go'i yul du ti spya pa byon/ tsārla pa sogs ( bka' babs bzhi'i bla ma bsten/ he ru ka nyid las rdo rje theg pa'i bdud rtsi gsol cing grub pa'i spyod pa chen po mdzad/ yang sngon tshe zhig na paṇ+ḍi ta zab pa'i rdo rjes o rgyan dhu mā tha la nas ye shes kyi mkha' 'gros bdud rtsi bzhi yi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba nas rim par brgyud de/ sa kun snying gi dus tsam na slob dpon bdud rtsi gsang bas de'i srol phye/ rgyal po dharma pā la'i ring la slob dpon shrī dh+wa ras ye shes zhabs kyi slob brgyud 'ga' zhig la bsten nas gsang 'dus dang gshed skor la grub pa brnyes/ de nabs bha ba bha dra dang / skal ldan grags pa/ lī la badz+ra/mi thub zla ba/ ta thā ga ta sogs byon cing rgyud sde rgya mtshor mkhyen pa rgyas/ bi kra mar bstan pa skyong / rgyal po hi ma pā la'i sku tshe'i smad tsam na shar e rbi bar tsi lu paṇ+ḍita byon nas rigs ldan gyi sprul par dus 'khor gsan/ nā len+t+ra ra piṇ+ḍib chung ba dang / dus zhabs pa chen po rjes su bzung / phyi ma slar yang sham+bha lar byon nas rigs ldan nyid las gsan cing yul dbus su ches dar bar mdzad/'di skabs slob dpon ka ma la rak+ṣi ta dang / pad+ma lcags kyu/ 'jam dbyangs grub pa'i dpa' bo dze tā ri rnams byon cing bi kra mar bzhugs/ de nas rgyal po rbo na ga'i ring la bi kra mar mkhas pa sgo drug byon te thams cad kyang sngags kyi grub brnyes chen po yin mod kyi/ khyad par ti lci pa dang / dus zhabs pa chen po'i slob ma nā ro pa ni rdo rje theg pa'i gsang 'dzin mchog tu 'khums so/ /de 161

'tshechen 'od snangal / saskya'i tshom༅nga ge bsdus/ ()rjes jo bo rjes nā ro pa sogs sngags kyi bla ma mang du bsten/ rdo rje theg pa gzigs pa'i spyan bye/ nā ro dang shā ba ri'i slob ma mi tri pas kyang grub snying a ma na si gtso bor gyur pa'i sngags bstan bskyangs/ gzhan yang nā ro pa sogs kyi slob ma rdo rje gdan pa che chung / de pā ka ra tsan+d+ra/ pradz+nyā rak+ṣi ta sogs kyi phrin las rgyas/ slob dpon a nu sa ma rak+ṣi ta dang nā ro'i lcam ming pos sngags lam du smin zin pa zhig badz+ra dh+wa ras rjes su bzung ba ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu ma'ang byin/ bi rū pa dang / nā ro lcam sring gnyis kyis srol btad pa'i lam 'bras dang / chos drug ni bla med spyi'i rdzogs rim du bzhag go /de'i 'og tu rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bstan bcos brtsams pa'i mchog byin pas rgyud sde'i dgongs pa rang dbang du 'grel nus pa a bhā ya byon cing dgung lo brgya dang nyer gcig tu bstan pa bskyangs/ bar dor mchog grub/ de dang mtshungs pa dus 'khor zhabs chung ba'ang nā len+d+rar grags par byon cing / dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi seng ge'i sgra bsgrags pas a bhā ya sogs paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgya tsam gyis bakhud/ de nas sngags kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa ma hān+ta nyi shu rtsa bzhin grags pa sogs byon/ phyis rgya gar shar phyogs song nā ga rar dpal nags kyi rin chen byon cing / grub chen shā ba ris rjes su bzung / dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag tu gyur/ bod yul du yang bka' drin chen pos khyab par mdzad/ de rjes 'phags yul lho phyogs su kha gen+d+rar rdo rje slob dpon zhi ba sbas pa byon cing / yul de dang ko zhi'i yul sogs su sngags bstan shin tu dar bar mdzad kyang deng sang ji ltar gyur thos par ma gyur la/ khyad par 'gro lding gi yul du ni/ sngar slob dpon pad+ma dang / phyis mar 162

ba chen 'od sna pa la / sa skya'i rma yan gung gces bsdus/ ()rjes jo bo rjes nā ro pa sogs sngags kyi bla ma mang du bsten/ rdo rje theg pa gzigs pa'i spyan bye/ nā ro dang shā ba ri'i slob ma mi tri pas kyang grub snying a ma na si gtso bor gyur pa'i sngags bstan bskyangs/ g.yin yang nā ro pa sogs kyi slob ma rdo rje gdan pa che chung / de pā ka ra tsan+d+ra/ pradz+nyā rak+ṣi ta sogs kyi phrin las rgyas/ slob dpon a nu sa ma rak+ṣi ta dang nā ro'i lcam ming pos sngags lam du smin zin pa zhig badz+ra dh+wa ras rjes su bzung ba ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu ma'ang byin/ bi rū pa dang / nā ro lcam sring gnyis kyis srol btad pa'i lam 'bras dang / chos drug ni bla med spyi'i rdzogs rim du bzhag go /de'i 'og tu rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bstan bcos brtsams pa'i mchog byin pas rgyud sde'i dgongs pa rang dbang du 'grel nus pa a bhā ya byon cing dgung lo brgya dang nyer gcig tu bstan pa bskyangs/ bar dor mchog grub/ de dang mtshungs pa dus 'khor zhabs chung ba'ang nā le rgyur grags par byon cing / dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi seng ge'i sgra bsgrags pas a bhā ya sogs paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgya tsam gyis bsdud/ de nas sngags kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa ma hān+ta nyi shu rtsa bzhin grags pa sogs byon/ phyis rgya gar shar phyogs song nā ga rar dpal nags kyi rin chen byon cing / grub chen shā ba ris rjes su bzung / dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag tu gyur/ bod yul du yang bka' drin chen pos khyab par mdzad/ de rjes 'phags yul lho phyogs su kha ge spror rdo rje slob dpon zhi ba sbas pa byon cing / yul de dang ko zhi'i yul sogs su sngags bstan shin tu dar bar mdzad kyang deng sang ji ltar gyur thos par ma gyur la/ khyad par 'gro lding gi yul du ni/ sngar slob dpon pad+ma dang / phyis mar 162

mdo sngags bstan pa rin po tshe'i chos kyi byung tshul las brtsams pa'i lo rgyus dang rnam thar/me mdzad bzang pos kyang byon pas sngags bstan shin tu dar bar grags so/ // gnyis pa bod yul du ji ltar byon tshul la/ mdo sngags gnyis las/dang po la'ang 'dul mdo mngon pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ 'jam dpal dbyangs khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku ring la/ mtshan brjod par dka' ba slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos sdom rgyun dang / kha che'i slob dpon dzī na/ dwa na gnyis kyis bshad rgyun gtso bor spel/ snga ma'i slob ma sad mi mi bdun sogs dang / phyi ma la ska cog gnyis sogs mang du byon/ mkhan po'i slob ma sba rat+na dang lar tshuramang yang rang lugs cog ro gnyis las dmar g.yo gtsang gsum gyis 'dul ba gsan/ bar skabs su glang dar mas rgyal bstan la me 'byin pa'i tshe khams su bros nas bzhugs pas bstan pa phyi dar gyi thog mar bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyis gtugs pas smad 'dul dang / stod mnga' ris su lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis paṇ+ḍi ta dharma pā la spyan drangs nas pā la gsum sogs bsnyen par rdzogs pas stod 'dul du grags/ 'di'i bshad rgyun dzī na dwa na gnyis las/shākya se na/ dharma pā la/ klu ba lo tsā/ skyogs 'dul 'dzin dang / yang bla chen nas/ grum ye shes rgyal mtshan/ klu mes tshulu khrims dbang phyug ste/ skyogs klu gnyis gar gzus rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis gsan pas bshad rgyun gyi chu bo gcig tu 'dres shing / 'dzim pa shes rab 'od/ sne so grags rgyal te gtsang dang / spo thung shes rab tshul khrims dang / bla ma glen byang tshul te dbu kyi bu gnyis te bzhir grags pa'i rgyun las kun mkhyen mtsho sna ba shes rab bzang po dang / bya 'dul ba 'dzin pa tshul khrims 'bar sogs byung zhing / 'dul bstan nyin mo 163

mdo sngagasabastan pa rin po che'i chosakyi byung tshul lasabartsamasapa'i lo rgyusadang rnam thar/me mdzad bzang pos kyang byon pas sngags bstan shin tu dar bar grags so/ // gnyis pa bod yul du ji ltar byon tshul la/ mdo sngagasaganyis las/dang po la'ang 'dul mdo mngon pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ 'jam dpal dbyangs khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku ring la/ mtshan brjod par dka' ba slob dpon zhi ba 'tshogasdom rgyun dang / kha che'i slob dpon dzī na/ dwa na gnyis kyis bshad rgyun gtso bor spel/ snga ma'i slob ma sad mi mi bdun sogasadang / phyi ma la ska cog gnyis sogs mang du byon/ mkhan po'i slob ma sba rat+na dang lar tshuramang yang rang lugasacog ro gnyis las dmar g.yo gtsang gsum gyis 'dul ba gsan/ bar skabs su glang dar mas rgyal bstan la me 'byin pa'i tshe khams su bros nas bzhugs pas bstan pa phyi dar gyi thog mar bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyis gtugasapas smad 'dul dang / stod mnga' ris su lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis paṇ+ḍi ta dharma pā la spyan drangs nas pā la gsum sogs bsnyen par rdzogs pasastod 'dul du grags/ 'di'i bshad rgyun dzī na dwa na gnyis las/shākya se na/ dharma pā la/ klu ba lo tsā/ skyogasa'adul 'dzin dang / yang bla chen nas/ grum ye shesargyal mtshan/ klu mesatshul khrimasadabang phyug ste/ skyogasaklu gnyis gar gzus rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis gsan pas bshad rgyun gyi chu bo gcig tu 'dres shing / 'dzim pa shesarab 'od/ sne so gragasargyal te gtsang dang / spo thung shes rab tshul khrims dang / bla ma glen byang tshul te dbus kyi bu gnyis te bzhir grags pa'i rgyun las kun mkhyen mtsho sna ba shes rab bzang po dang / bya 'dul ba 'dzin pa tshul khrims 'bar sogs byung zhing / 'dul bstan nyin mo 163

brtse chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'grang stsosabasdus/ ()ltar mdzad/ khyad par ma byon sangs rgyas rab gsal gyi rnam 'phrul kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī khro lo byams pa'i dpal gyi bsod nams zla med pa'i mgron du khugs/ des kher gang byang chub dpal/ gtsang pa rdo rje dpal/ sa skya paṇ+ḍita kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po sogs bsnyen par rdzogs/ snga ma gnyis las tshogs chen sde bzhir grags pa byung / 'dis snasalhasaklasamo cher dbyar gnas skabs me tog phreng rgyud gsungs pa/ seng ge zil gnon las tshad ma'i skyes bu dang / de las bu ston rin po ches gsan cing ṭīka chen yang brtsams/spyir bu ston rin po che la 'dul ba'i bshad srol gsum ka gcig tu 'dres shing / de nas bka' gdams gsar ma'i shing rta'i srol 'byed kun mkhyen tsong kha pa sogs kyis bstan pa la byi dor mdzad pas gcig tu bka' drin che'o/ /gnyis pa theg pa che chung gi mngon pa ni/ snga dar gyi tshe dzī na dwa na gnyis las ska cog sogs kyis theg chen gyi mngon pa kun btus dang theg dman gyi mdzod rang 'grel 'grel bshad rgyal sras ma sogs gsan cing bsgyur/ de dag gi slob ma sba ye shes rgyal ba las/ grum rgyal ba ye shes kyis gsan nas rgyun dar ba dang / yang nā ro'i slob ma smṛ nyis khams glang thang du mdzod kyi bshad pa mdzad pas mkhas btsun mang du 'dus nas mngon pa 'og ma'i bstan pa gzhir bzhengs su btang / phyis pu to ba'i slob ma rog dmar zhur dol pa shes rab rgya mtsho dang / 'ban gung rgyal ba chul khrims rgyal ba sogs kyis bzung ste snar thang pa'i dge bshes rnams la bka' babs pa sogs dang / mngon pa gong ma rong ngur smrig tu brang ti dar ma snying pos rgya cher spel/ phyis su paṇa chen shākya 164

brtse chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gtsesabasdus/ rtonaltar mdzad/ khyad par ma byon sangs rgyas rab gsal gyi rnam 'phrul kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī khro lo byams pa'i dpal gyi bsod nams zla med pa'i mgron du khugs/ des kher gang byang chub dpal/ gtsang pa rdo rje dpal/ sa skya paṇ+ḍita kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po sogs bsnyen par rdzogs/ snga ma gnyis las tshogs chen sde bzhir grags pa byung / 'dis snasalhasaklasamo cher dbyar gnas skabs me tog phreng rgyud gsungs pa/ seng ge zil gnon las tshad ma'i skyes bu dang / de las bu ston rin po ches gsan cing ṭīka chen yang brtsams/spyir bu ston rin po che la 'dul ba'i bshad srol gsum ka gcig tu 'dres shing / de nas bka' gdams gsar ma'i shing rta'i srol 'byed kun mkhyen tsong kha pa sogs kyis bstan pa la byi dor mdzad pas gcig tu bka' drin che'o/ /gnyis pa theg pa che chung gi mngon pa ni/ snga dar gyi tshe dzī na dwa na gnyis las ska cog sogs kyis theg chen gyi mngon pa kun btus dang theg dman gyi mdzod rang 'grel 'grel bshad rgyal sras ma sogs gsan cing bsgyur/ de dag gi slob ma sba ye shes rgyal ba las/ grum rgyal ba ye shes kyis gsan nas rgyun dar ba dang / yang nā ro'i slob ma smṛ nyis khams glang thang du mdzod kyi bshad pa mdzad pas mkhas btsun mang du 'dus nas mngon pa 'og ma'i bstan pa gzhir bzhengs su btang / phyis pu to ba'i slob ma rog dmar zhur dol pa shes rab rgya mtsho dang / 'ban gung rgyal ba chul khrims rgyal ba sogs kyis bzung ste snar thang pa'i dge bshes rnams la bka' babs pa sogs dang / mngon pa gong ma rong ngur smrig tu brang ti dar ma snying pos rgya cher spel/ phyis su paṇa chen shākya 164

mdo sngags bstan pa rin po che'i chos kyi byung tshul las brtsams pa'i lo rgyus dang rnam thar/shrīs kyang sa paṇa la mdzod kyi bshad pa gnang ba dang / mnal lam du a phyi 'bum pa'i drung dbyig gnyen las zla ba gcig tu gsan pa'i thugs nyams byung bas bshad srol khyad par 'phags so/ /gsum pa mdo sde'i bstan pa byon tshul la/ nyan thos kyi mdo sde'i bka' bsnga dang po'i tshe bsdus pa rnams rim gyis nyams nas btsun pa dbyig bshes kyi )bas kyang cher mi bzhugs par gsal ba bzhin/ bod du de las kyang cung zad cig las ma 'gyur te mdo sde las brgya pa sogs so/ /'khor lo bar pa sher phyin gyi mdo ni rgya gar du bzhugs so cog ljongs 'dir byon cing / bstan pa snga dar gyi tshe glang khams pa go cha dang / pa gor be+e ro tsa na sogs kyis yum gsum gyis mtshon pa'i bka' dang / de'i dgongs 'grel kyang de ni se na'i 'bum ṭīka sogs mang du bsgyur/ bshad pa dang nyams len gnyis ga'i rgyun rgya cher 'phel/ dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i srol 'byed zhi 'tsho/ pad+ma'i ngang tshul sogs kyi ring lugs 'dzin par bkas bcad kyang bar skabs su nyams pa las phyi dar gyi thog mar lo chen rin bzang gis paṇ+ḍi ta gu ṇa mi tra las rgyan 'grel pa dang bcas pa gsan/ des shar phyogs pa zla ba bzang po/ des slob dpon brtan skyong / des rngog lo chen por brgyud/ yang jo bos 'brom ston la phar phyin bshad pa dang / des 'bro stong btsan la bshad pa'i srol che ba gcig dang / jo bos phya dar ston pa la bshad pa'i phar phyin khams lugs su grags pa sogs dar/ khyad par rngog lo chen po'i slob ma 'bre shes rab 'bar gyis/ snga dar gyi rgyun khams su 'phos pa las byung ba dang / jo bo dang / rin bzang gi srol 165

mdo sngags bstan pa rin po che'i chogakyi byung tshul lasabartsamasapa'i lo rgyusadang rnam thar/shrīs kyang sa paṇa la mdzod kyi bshad pa gnang ba dang / mnal lam du a phyi 'bum pa'i dru+ong dbyig gnyen las zla ba gcig tu gsan pa'i thugs nyams byung bas bshad sral khyad par 'phags sa/ /gsum pa mdo sde'i bstan pa byon tshul la/ nyan thos kyi mdo sde'i bka' bsdu dang po'i tshe bsdus pa rnams rim gyis nyams nas btsun pa dbyig bshes kyi skabs kyang cher mi bzhugs par gsal ba bzhin/ bod du de las kyang cung zad cig las ma 'gyur te mdo sde las brgya pa sogs so/ /'khor lo bar pa sher phyin gyi mdo ni rgya gar du bzhugs so cog ljongs 'dir byon cing / bstan pa snga dar gyi tshe glang khams pa go cha dang / pa gor be+e ro tsa na sogs kyis yum gsum gyis mtshon pa'i bka' dang / de'i dgongs 'grel kyang rdani se na'i 'bum ṭīka sogs mang du bsgyur/ bshad pa dang nyams len gnyis ga'i rgyun rgya cher 'phel/ dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i srol 'byed zhi 'tsho/ pad+ma'i ngang tshul sogs kyi ring lugs 'dzin par bkas bcad kyang bar skabs su nyams pa las phyi dar gyi thog mar lo chen rin bzang gis paṇ+ḍi ta gu ṇa mi tra las rgyan 'grel pa dang bcas pa gsan/ des shar phyogs pa zla ba bzang po/ des slob dpon brtan skyong / des rngog lo chen por brgyud/ yang jo bos 'brom ston la phar phyin bshad pa dang / des 'bro stong btsan la bshad pa'i srol che ba gcig dang / jo bos phya dar ston pa la bshad pa'i phar phyin khams lugs su grags pa sogs dar/ khyad par rngog lo chen po'i slob ma 'bre shes rab 'bar gyis/ snga dar gyi rgyun khams su 'phos pa las byung ba dang / jo bo dang / rin bzang gi srol 165

ba 'odasnang las/ saskya'i chogayang tso bsdus/ ()gsum rnamasagacig tu dril ba'i legs bshad kyi sgron me ar byang chub ye shes kyis bzung ste bstan pa 'di la bya ba che thang du mdzad cing / rngog lo'i slob ma gro lung pa blo gros 'byung gnas kyi bshad srol la bsten dpal ldan phywa pas kyang spel/ dbu ma ni bstan pa snga dar la ye shes snying po dang / cog ro'i rtsa she'i bsgyur bar sems la dpag na dar bar byung ba 'dra/ phyi dar rngog lo chen pos shes rab sgron me gtso bor gyur pa'i gzhung la 'chad nyan mdzad/ de lasabargyud de phywa pa chos seng gis rang rgyud kyi dril bsgrogs/ khyad par pa tshab lo tsā ba kha che sadz+dza na'i srasaganyisasogs bsten nas lo nyer gsum bzhugs/ bod du rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum sogs kyi 'grel pa zla bas mdzad pa ci rigasabasgyur/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen sha ra bas kyang grogs mdzad nas thal 'gyur gyi ba dan bsgrengs pas pa tshab bu bzhir grags pa sogs byon/ 'khor lo tha ma'i mdo sde ni shin tu rgya che/ nā len+d+ra bi ha rar me'i gnod pa lan gsum byung bas phyis 'phags yul du'ang cher mi bzhugagashing / de las phal cher zhig dang dgongs 'grel bcas bstan pa snga dar gyi tshe bsgyur/ phyi 'gyur kyang 'ga' zhig yod/ de dag gi bshad srol yang mang du byung ba las gtso bor rngog btsan gnyis te/ snga mas kha che sadz+dza na las mdo sde rgyan/ rgyud bla/ 'byed gnyis rnams kyi gzhung 'grel dang bcas pa rgya cher gsan nas bstan pa'i rgyun phyis su gtsang nag pa/rang byung pa/ dol bu pa sogs kyis rtsal du bton pasa'akhor lo tha ma'i nges don rgya cher gsal/ grwa pa mngon shes kyi mkhan bu btsan kha bo ches sadz+dza na las rgyud bla sogs zhus/ lcang ra ba sogs slob ma rnams la bshad/ phyi mo'i bar 166

ba chen 'od snang las/ ri cho ༅nga tso0bsdus/ ()gsum rnams gcig tu dril ba'i legs bshad kyi sgron me ar byang chub ye shes kyis bzung ste bstan pa 'di la bya ba che thang du mdzad cing / rngog lo'i slob ma gro lung pa blo gros 'byung gnas kyi bshad srol la bsten dpal ldan phywa pas kyang spel/ dbu ma ni bstan pa snga dar la ye shes snying po dang / cog ro'i rtsa she'i bsgyur bar sems la dpag na dar bar byung ba 'dra/ phyi dar rngog lo chen pos shes rab sgron me gtso bor gyur pa'i gzhung la 'chad nyan mdzad/ de las brgyud de phywa pa chos seng gis rang rgyud kyi dril bsgrogs/ khyad par pa tshab lo tsā ba kha che sa rdzo na'i sras gnyis sogs bsten nas lo nyer gsum bzhugs/ bod du rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum sogs kyi 'grel pa zla bas mdzad pa ci rigs bsgyur/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen sha ra bas kyang grogs mdzad nas thal 'gyur gyi ba dan bsgrengs pas pa tshab bu bzhir grags pa sogs byon/ 'khor lo tha ma'i mdo sde ni shin tu rgya che/ nā len+d+ra bi ha rar me'i gnod pa lan gsum byung bas phyis 'phags yul du'ang cher mi bzhugs nga / de las phal cher zhig dang dgongs 'grel bcas bstan pa snga dar gyi tshe bsgyur/ phyi 'gyur kyang 'ga' zhig yod/ de dag gi bshad srol yang mang du byung ba las gtso bor rngog btsan gnyis te/ snga mas kha che sadz+dza na las mdo sde rgyan/ rgyud bla/ 'byed gnyis rnams kyi gzhung 'grel dang bcas pa rgya cher gsan nas bstan pa'i rgyun phyis su gtsang nag pa/rang byung pa/ dol bu pa sogs kyis rtsal du bton pas 'khor lo tha ma'i nges don rgya cher gsal/ grwa pa mngon shes kyi mkhan bu btsan kha bo ches sa tho na las rgyud bla sogs zhus/ lcang ra ba sogs slob ma rnams la bshad/ phyi mo'i bar 166

mdo sngags bstan pa rin po che'i chos kyi byung tshul lasabartsams pa'i lo rgyusadang rnam thar/bshad sgrub kyi rgyun khyad par can byung yang rnam rig smra bar grags so/ /gnyis pa rdo rje theg pa ni/ snga dar gyi tshe thogo maro chos rgyal tho ri snyan shal dus su dpang skang phyag brgya dang / mad za ma tag sags babs nas dbu brnyes/ lha gcig srong btsan gyi dus slob dpon ku swa ra dang bram ze shang ka ra sogs byon nas thon mi sogs kyis lo tsā mdzad de spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo rgyud nyer gcig tu grags pa bsgyur/ sprul pa'i rgyal pos kyang skal ldan 'ga' la lkog chos su bstan pas grub thob mang du byung bar grags/ khyad par khri srong gi dus su slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba'i mdun du dbas mañju shrī sogs btang yang ma byon nas kṛ yog sde gsum gyi bshad pa nyan nas dar bar byas/yo ga ba sngags 'chang dharma kirti sogs kyis kyang rnal 'byor gyi rgyud spel/brtul zhugs grub pa pad+ma saṃ bha was bla med nang rgyud sde gsum gyi smin grol phog bye brag tu ma hā yo ga'i skor rnams las/ rgyud sde sgyu 'phrul gyi skor slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba la gnyags kyis gsan pa sogs dang / sgrub sde bka' brgyad kyi skor/ slob dpon shīn+ti gar+bha/ hūṃ ka ra/ bi ma la sogs kyis dngos dang brgyud nas dar bar mdzad/ lung a nu yo ga'i skor rnams bru sha'i slob dpon che btsan skyes las gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyis zhus/man ngag rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga la sems klong gnyis shrī sedha las be+e ros gsan pa dang / man ngag sde ni bi ma la las mnga' bdag dang nyang gis gsan pa sogs kyi rgyun las byung / spyir brgyud pa'i bka' babs drug ces gtam du grags shing / de'ang bsdu na/ dang po gnyags/ bar du gnubs/ tha ma zur la 167

mdo sngags bstan pa rin po che'i chos kyi byung tshul lasabartsams pa'i lo rgyusadang rnam thar/bshad sgrub kyi rgyun khyad par can byung yang rnam rig smra bar grags so/ /gnyis pa rdo rje theg pa ni/ snga dar gyi tshe thogo maro chos rgyal tho ri snyan shal dus su dpang skang phyag brgya dang / mad za ma tag sags babs nas dbu brnyes/ lha gcig srong btsan gyi dus slob dpon ku swa ra dang bram ze shang ka ra sogs byon nas thon mi sogs kyis lo tsā mdzad de spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo rgyud nyer gcig tu grags pa bsgyur/ sprul pa'i rgyal pos kyang skal ldan 'ga' la lkog chos su bstan pas grub thob mang du byung bar grags/ khyad par khri srong gi dus su slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba'i mdun du dbas mañju shrī sogs btang yang ma byon nas kṛ yog sde gsum gyi bshad pa nyan nas dar bar byas/yo ga ba sngags 'chang dharma kirti sogs kyis kyang rnal 'byor gyi rgyud spel/brtul zhugs grub pa pad+ma saṃ bha was bla med nang rgyud sde gsum gyi smin grol phog bye brag tu ma hā yo ga'i skor rnams las/ rgyud sde sgyu 'phrul gyi skor slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba la gnyags kyis gsan pa sogs dang / sgrub sde bka' brgyad kyi skor/ slob dpon shīn+ti gar+bha/ hūṃ ka ra/ bi ma la sogs kyis dngos dang brgyud nas dar bar mdzad/ lung a nu yo ga'i skor rnams bru sha'i slob dpon che btsan skyes las gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyis zhus/man ngag rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga la sems klong gnyis shrī sedha las be+e ros gsan pa dang / man ngag sde ni bi ma la las mnga' bdag dang nyang gis gsan pa sogs kyi rgyun las byung / spyir brgyud pa'i bka' babs drug ces gtam du grags shing / de'ang bsdu na/ dang po gnyags/ bar du gnubs/ tha ma zur la 167

ba 'od palas/ saskya'i choga'abyung gtsespobasdus/ ()babs pas bod khams thams cad rig sngags 'chang ba'i dbang rīpos khengs/de'i tshe slob dpon rin po che dang / gnubs chen sogs kyis phyi ma'i dus na dgos pa khyad par can gzigs te zab mo gter gyis ri brag gangs gsum thams cad bkang ba/ phyis smon lam gyis sprul pa'i gter ston mang pos spyan drangs te/ de'ang bka' brgyad rnam pa gsum dang / bla ma zhi drag dang / rdzogasapa chen po man ngag snying gi thig le'i skor dang / thugs rje chen po zhi drag dang /'jam dpal tshe bdag la sogs pa rnams te/ sngar mnga' bdag nyang yab sras dang / phyis lho byang gnyis kho na grags che zhing / gzhan ni grangs kyi mthas gtugs pa mi mnga' na'ang phal cher la som nyi'i yul du gyur pa'ang snang zhing /'ga' zhig tshad ldan du khasalen dgos par sems/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus bya spyod gnyis kyi dbang dang rjes gnang rigs lung bklag pa tsam las bshad srol khungs ma ni ma byung bar mngon/ rnam 'byor gyi rgyud ni/ thog mar lo chen rin bzang gis rgya gar kha che'i paṇ+ḍita mang po la gtugs/ rgyud dang 'grel pa sngar ma bsgyur ba bsgyur/ bsgyur bar zhu chen mdzad/ 'chad nyan sgom sgrub kyi srol chen po btod nas rngog legs sher sogs thugs sras kyi gtso bo bzhis dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ bar du zangs dkar lo tsā ba 'phags pa shes rab kyis kyang yo ga'i skor la gsan pa rgya cher mdzad/ rgyud 'grel yang bsgyur/zangs dkar gyi bu bzhir grags pa sogs dang / rtsa skya shākya 'bum/ snur nyi ma 'od zer 'dzim pa blo chen sogs rang gi brgyud 'dzin dang bcas pas spel/phyis bu ston rin po ches dbang rgyud 'grel yongs su rdzogs pa gsan cing //68

ba chen 'od pal/ sa skya'i chog༅nga sa bsdus/ ()babs pas bod khams thams cad rig sngags 'chang ba'i dbang ri khengs/de'i tshe slob dpon rin po che dang / gnubs chen sogs kyis phyi ma'i dus na dgos pa khyad par can gzigs te zab mo gter gyis ri brag gangs gsum thams cad bkang ba/ phyis smon lam gyis sprul pa'i gter ston mang pos spyan drangs te/ de'ang bka' brgyad rnam pa gsum dang / bla ma zhi drag dang / rdzogasapa chen po man ngag snying gi thig le'i skor dang / thugs rje chen po zhi drag dang /'jam dpal tshe bdag la sogs pa rnams te/ sngar mnga' bdag nyang yab sras dang / phyis lho byang gnyis kho na grags che zhing / gzhan ni grangs kyi mthas gtugs pa mi mnga' na'ang phal cher la som nyi'i yul du gyur pa'ang snang zhing /'ga' zhig tshad ldan du khas len dgos par sems/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus bya spyod gnyis kyi dbang dang rjes gnang rigs lung bklag pa tsam las bshad srol khungs ma ni ma byung bar mngon/ rnam 'byor gyi rgyud ni/ thog mar lo chen rin bzang gis rgya gar kha che'i paṇ+ḍita mang po la gtugs/ rgyud dang 'grel pa sngar ma bsgyur ba bsgyur/ bsgyur bar zhu chen mdzad/ 'chad nyan sgom sgrub kyi srol chen po btod nas rngog legs sher sogs thugs sras kyi gtso bo bzhis dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ bar du zangs dkar lo tsā ba 'phags pa shes rab kyis kyang yo ga'i skor la gsan pa rgya cher mdzad/ rgyud 'grel yang bsgyur/zangs dkar gyi bu bzhir grags pa sogs dang / rtsa skya shākya 'bum/ snur nyi ma 'od zer 'dzim pa blo chen sogs rang gi brgyud 'dzin dang bcas pas spel/phyis bu ston rin po ches dbang rgyud 'grel yongs su rdzogs pa gsan cing //68

mdo sngagasabastan pa rin po che'i mosakyi byung tshul lasabartsamasapa'i lo rgyusadang rnam thang/'chad rtsom rgya cher mdzad na'ang deng sang ni rgyud kyi bklags lung dang / dpal rtse dbyings gsum sogs dbang bskur 'ga' zhig gnas pa tsam mo/ /bla med kyi rgyud la/ pha rgyud gsang 'dusalas/ 'phagasalugs ni/ thog mar lo chen rin bzang gis 'dus pa'i rgyud 'grel chen sgron gsal sogs bsgyur cing dbang bshad sogs rdzogs par gsan/ phyis 'dus pa gsan pa'i lo tsā mang yang gtso bor mar 'gos gnyis su grags pa'i 'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyis di paṃ ka ra dang / de bā ka tsan+d+ra sogs paṇ+ḍita bdun cu/ mkha' 'gro'i bla ma gnyis rnams las gsang 'dus kyi dbang rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa gsan/slob ma mang ra ba seng ge rgyal mtshan sogs mchog drug byung nas rim par dar/lho brag mar los nā ro dang ye shes snying po sogs las gsang 'dus dbang rdzogs par gsan/ bod du ka chen bzhi las mtshur ston dbang nge la gnang /des khams pa ro mnyam rdo rje sogs la brgyud pa dang / gzhan yang jo bos rong pa phyag sor ba la bshad pa rong lugs/ chag chos rje dpal gyis paṇ+ḍi ta pa ren+d+rar gsan nas 'u yug kung ra ba bla ma dpal sogs la bshad pa chag lugs/ kha che paṇ+ḍitags paṇa dang / dpyal lo la gnang ba dpyal lugs sogs byung na'ang gtso bor 'gos lugs nyid bzung ngo / /ye shes zhabs lugs ni/ dang por lo chen rin bzang dang / smṛ ṭaṃ dz+nyā nas dar bar mdzad pas lo chen lugs dang / khams lugs su grags pa byung / phyis paṇ+ḍita pur+bhe shrī nas gnyan lor brgyud pa sa lugs/ paṇ+ḍita purkye shrī sogs nas rwa los gsan pa rwa lugs/ gnyos 'byung pos ba li ār+ya la bsten pas gnyos lugs sogs byung /169

mdo sngags bstan pa rin po che'i chos kyi byung tshul las brtsams pa' lo rgyus dang rnam thang/'chad rtsom rgya cher mdzad na'ang deng sang ni rgyud kyi bklags lung dang / dpal rtse dbyings gsum sogs dbang bskur 'ga' zhig gnas pa tsam mo/ /bla med kyi rgyud la/ pha rgyud gsang 'dus las/ 'phags lugs ni/ thog mar lo chen rin bzang gis 'dus pa'i rgyud 'grel chen sgron gsal sogs bsgyur cing dbang bshad sogs rdzogs par gsan/ phyis 'dus pa gsan pa'i lo tsā mang yang gtso bor mar 'gos gnyis su grags pa'i 'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyis dī paṃ ka ra dang / de bā ka tsan+d+ra sogs paṇ+ḍita bdun cu/ mkha' 'gro'i bla ma gnyis rnams las gsang 'dus kyi dbang rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa gsan/slob ma mang ra ba seng ge rgyal mtshan sogs mchog drug byung nas rim par dar/lho brag mar los nā ro dang ye shes snying po sogs las gsang 'dus dbang rdzogs par gsan/ bod du ka chen bzhi las mtshur ston dbang nge la gnang /des khams pa ro mnyam rdo rje sogs la brgyud pa dang / gzhan yang jo bos rong pa phyag sor ba la bshad pa rong lugs/ chag chos rje dpal gyis paṇ+ḍi ta pa re rgyur gsan nas 'u yug kung ra ba bla ma dpal sogs la bshad pa chag lugs/ kha che paṇ+ḍitags paṇa dang / dpyal lo la gnang ba dpyal lugs sogs byung na'ang gtso bor 'gos lugs nyid bzung ngo / /ye shes zhabs lugs ni/ dang por lo chen rin bzang dang / spyo ṭaṃ dz+nyā nas dar bar mdzad pas lo chen lugs dang / khams lugs su grags pa byung / phyis paṇ+ḍita pu rje shrī nas gnyan lor brgyud pa sa lugs/ paṇ+ḍita pu rje shrī sogs nas rwa los gsan pa rwa lugs/ gnyos 'byung pos ba li ārla la bsten pas gnyos lugs sogs byung /169

'tshechen 'odasnang la / saskya'i chosayangagacetshobasdus/ ()pha rgyud gshed skor ni/ phyi dar la dang po cog lo tsā ba zhang shes rab bla mas dgra gdong 'jigs gsum gyi dbang bshad dar bar mdzad/ u pa shrī mi tra las rong zom chos bzang gis zhus te nag 'jigs kyi rgyud sogs bsgyur/ niṣ+ka lāṅga las dpyal chos bzang gis gshed dmar skor zhus te dar bar mdzad/ de bzhin du dwa na shrī las sa paṇa dang / chags lo tsā ba darbaṇa lasaglo bo lo tsā bas kyang gsan te de bzhi las gshed dmar gyi skor byung / rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyis bal po bha ro phyag rdum dang / me tsa ling pa gnyis la bsten nas 'jigs byed kyi skor dang / khyad par bal po thugs rje chen por dgra gdong 'jigs gsum gsan nas dar ba rwa lugs/ bla ma skyo 'od 'byung gis don yod rdo rje las 'jigs byed kyi skor gsan nas dar ba skyo lugs/ zhang cog gru lo tsās de bā ka ra tsan+d+rar nag 'jigs gnyis gsan nas dar ba shad lugs/ gnyos los ba lo a tsar+ya sogs las nag po skor gsum gsan te dar ba gnyos lugs te/mdor na dpyal lo sogs bzhi lasagashed dmar dang / rwa skyo zhang gnyos lo bzhi las nag po skor gsum gtso bor dar te de ltar na bka' babs brgyad do / / ma rgyud kyi phyogs la/ gdan bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag dang bcasapa ni lo chen dus cung zad byung ba/ ga ya dha ra yab sras kyis srol btod cing / mar 'gos gnyis kyis rgya cher spel/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo'ang de dang mtshungs/ sangs rgyas thod pa gyi jo zla 'od kyis rgyud 'grel bsgyur bshad mdzad pa dang mar 'gos sogs las kyang dar/ bde mchog ni/ phyi dar gyi thog mar jo bo rjes lo chen dang / rong pa 'bar dge sogs la gnang / lo chen dang 'gos kyis paṇ+ḍi ta 170

gye chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chosaḥng gce bsdus/ ()pha rgyud gshed skor ni/ phyi dar la dang po cog lo tsā ba zhang shes rab bla mas dgra gdong 'jigs gsum gyi dbang bshad dar bar mdzad/ u pa shrī mi tra las rong zom chos bzang gis zhus te nag 'jigs kyi rgyud sogs bsgyur/ ni ska lu sko las dpyal chos bzang gis gshed dmar skor zhus te dar bar mdzad/ de bzhin du dwa na shrī las sa paṇa dang / chags lo tsā ba dbo ṇa las glo bo lo tsā bas kyang gsan te de bzhi las gshed dmar gyi skor byung / rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyis bal po bha ro phyag rdum dang / me tsa ling pa gnyis la bsten nas 'jigs byed kyi skor dang / khyad par bal po thugs rje chen por dgra gdong 'jigs gsum gsan nas dar ba rwa lugs/ bla ma skyo 'od 'byung gis don yod rdo rje las 'jigs byed kyi skor gsan nas dar ba skyo lugs/ zhang cog gru lo tsās de bā ka ra tsan+t+ra ra nag 'jigs gnyis gsan nas dar ba shad lugs/ gnyes los ba bla a tsarla sogs las nag po skor gsum gsan te dar ba gnyos lugs te/mdor na dpyal lo sogs bzhi las gshed dmar dang / rwa skyo zhab gnyos lo bzhi las nag po skor gsum gtso bor dar te de ltar na bka' babs brgyad do / / ma rgyud kyi phyogs la/ gdan bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag dang bcas pa ni lo chen dus cung zad byung ba/ ga ya dha ra yab sras kyis srol btod cing / mar 'gos gnyis kyis rgya cher spel/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo'ang de dang mtshungs/ sangs rgyas thod pa gyi jo zla 'od kyis rgyud 'grel bsgyur bshad mdzad pa dang mar 'gos sogs las kyang dar/ bde mchog ni/ phyi dar gyi thog mar jo bo rjes lo chen dang / rong pa 'bar dge sogs la gnang / lo chen dang 'gos kyis paṇ+ḍi ta 170

mdo sngags bstan pa rin po che'i chos kyi byung tshul las brtsams pa'i lo rgyus dang rnam thar/mang po las dbang rgyud man ngag sogs gsan cing bsgyur/ phyis jo bos nag tsho la'ang gnang / klog skya shes rab brtsegs kyis bal por pham mthing pa las gsan pa dang / de dang pham mthing pa gnyis kar mal lo blo gros grags kyisagasan pa sa skya par bka' babs pa dang / mar los nā ro las bde mchog gi man ngag mang du gsan pa dang / mar pa do pas nā ro'i slob ma na ka shrī sogasamang po bsnyen nas slob ma gze pa blo ldan sogs kyis rgya cher spel ba'i srol rnams las/ tshogs pa dang slob mar bshad pa'i bdud rtsi gnyis gas myos pa ni mal lo tsā ba ste/ lugs 'di la rnal 'byor gsang mtha' zhes pa'i gtam gyis mdzes pa yin no/ /gzhan yang pham mthing pa sku mched las pu hrang lo chung zhes mkha' spyod du gshegs pa de las gnyos lo sogs kyis gsan pa'i srol ci rigs pa yod do/ /bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mche'i skor paṇ+ḍi ta dza se na la sro bha lo tsā dpal mchog dang po'i rdo rjes dbang bshad rdzogs par gsan te dpal sa skya par bka' babs pa sogs dang / des yum bka' phag mo lha so bdun mar grags pa'i dbang bskur dang / bsnyen sgrub kyi rgyun tsam dang / khyad par phag mo gzhung drug tu grags pa'i skor rnams rngog lo dang / rwa lo dang / khu ni tso dang / snub ston sogs las dar ro/ /de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i mkha' spyod skor gsum zhes dpal sa skya pa la bka' babs pa dang / gzhan yang mar pa nas brgyud pa sogs mang tsam snang ngo / /dpal dgyes pa rdo rje yab yum gyi skor ni/ rgya gar du srol chen drug gam bdun ces grags shing / spyir srol 'byed bcu gnyis tsam yod pa las/171

mdo sngagasabastan pa rin po che'i mosakyi byung tshul lasabartsamasapa'i lo rgyusadang rnam thar/mang po lasadabang rgyud man ngag sogs gsan cing bsgyur/ phyis jo bos nag tsho la'ang gnang / klog skya shes rab brtsegs kyis bal por pham mthing pa las gsan pa dang / de dang pham mthing pa gnyisagar mal lo blo gros grags kyisagasan pa sa skya par bka' babs pa dang / mar los nā ro las bde mchog gi man ngag mang du gsan pa dang / mar pa do pas nā ro'i slob ma na ka shrī sogasamang po bsnyen nas slob ma gze pa blo ldan sogs kyis rgya cher spel ba'i srol rnams las/ tshogs pa dang slob mar bshad pa'i bdud rtsi gnyis gas myos pa ni mal lo tsā ba ste/ lugs 'di la rnal 'byor gsang mtha' zhes pa'i gtam gyis mdzesapa yin no/ /gzhan yang pham mthing pa sku mched las pu hrang lo chung zhes mkha' spyod du gshegs pa de las gnyos lo sogs kyis gsan pa'i srol ci rigs pa yod do/ /bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mcho'i skor paṇ+ḍi ta dza se na la sum̐ bha lo tsā dpal mchog dang po'i rdo rjes dbang bshad dzo+ogs par gsan te dpal sa skya par bka' babs pa sogs dang / des yum bka' phag mo lha so bdun mar grags pa'i dbang bskur dang / bsnyen sgrub kyi rgyun tsam dang / khyad par phag mo gzhung drug tu gragasapa'i skor rnams rngog lo dang / rwa lo dang / khu ni tso dang / snub ston sogs las dar ro/ /de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i mkha' spyod skor gsum zhes dpal sa skya pa la bka' babs pa dang / g.yin yang mar pa nas brgyud pa sogs mang tsam snang ngo / /dpal dgyes pa rdo rje yab yum gyi skor ni/ rgya gar du srol chen drug gam bdun ces grags shing / spyir srol 'byed bcu gnyis tsam yod pa las/171

ba chen 'od snang las/ saskya'i tshoraḥng gcesabasdus/ ()'brog mis ga ya dha ra dang / 'gosalosanag po pa/ mar pas nā ro pa/ se tsa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis pham mthing pa las nā ro'i lugs gsan pa sogs las dar mod/ gtso bo ni mar pas mes rngog gnyis la bstan pa gtad pas rgya cher dar ba dang / khyad par 'brog mi lo tsā ba las brgyud pa'i bshad pa dang man ngag gi rgyun dpal sa skya pa yab sras kyi thugs mtshor bskyil ba las bshad sgrub kyi rba rlabs phyogs brgyar g.yo bar gyur to/ /gnyis su med pa dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud ni/ thog mar paṇ+ḍita shrī bha dra bo dhi dang / gyi jo lo tsā bsabasgyur cing / khrom lo tsā pad+ma sogs bu chen bzhi las brgyud pa gyi jo lugs dang / 'bro lo tsā bas kha che zla mgon las gsan nas dar ba 'bro lugs/ tsa mi sangs rgyas grags kyis dusazhabs pa la gsan nas rgya lo sogs la bshad pa tsa mi lugs/ bal po'i paṇ+ḍita sa man+ta shrī las rwa chosarab kyis gsan pa rwa lugs/ gzhan yang paṇa chen lugs/ chag lugs/sha ba ri pa'i man ngag gi lugs sogs mang po byung / de dag gi gdams ngag gtso bor sbyor ba yan lag drug la'ang lugs srol mi 'dra ba bcu bdun tsam bzhugs pa sogs mtha' klas shing / phyis bu dol gnyis bstan pa'i bdag por gyur pa las kyang chul 'dir bshad sgrub gnyis ga'i sgo nas bka' drin che ba ni kun mkhyen jo nang pa nyid yin no/ /de dang rjes mthun grub chen o rgyan pas sprul pa'i yul dh+ra ma tha lar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma las mngon sum du gsan pa'i o rgyan bsnyen bsgrub ces grags pa'ang / yi dam kyis lung bstan pa'i rtogs ldan mkhar chu ba dang / kun mkhyen rang byung / rtogs ldan zla ba seng ge172

ba 'a 'od snangalas/ saskya'i marabang tsosabasdus/ ()mkha' dang mnyam par song / gzhan yang zla ba lta bu ras chung rdo rje grags pa las ras chung snyan brgyud dang / ngan rdzong ston pa bo dhi rā dza las ngan rdzong snyan brgyud du grags pa sogs byung / shangs pa bka' brgyud du grags pa ni/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ni gu mas rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor thams cad pa'i ngo bo mkhas grub khyung po brtson 'grus mgon rjes su bzung / des rmogs lcog pa rin brtson/ skyer sgang pa chos seng / 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa'i bar du chig brgyud kyi rgyas btab pa brgyud pa rin po che sna bdun/ de nas bka' srol rnam lnga sogs rgya cher spel bas dbus su 'jag bsam gnyisadang / shangs dang / nyang sogs su rgya cher 'phel lo/ /zhi byed du gragasapa ni/ ngo mtshar brgyud pa'i bla ma so drug dang / bde gshegs bcu gnyis sogs kyis rjes su bzung ba grub pa'i dbang phyug dam pa sangs rgyas kyis bod 'dir brtse bas dgongs te lan mang du byon pa las/ dang por ang pho lo tsā ba sogs dang /bar du rma/ so/ kai dge 'dun 'bar gsum dang / tha ma dam pa kun dga'/phyar chen/ phyar chung sogs bu chen bdun la spel nas rgya cher dar/ de nas brgyud pa'i gdams ngag la brten nas rang stobs kyis phye ba gcod yul ces grags pa ni yum chen mo mi mo'i sha tshugs la brten pa ma gcig lab kyi sgrol mas rgya cher spel ba las grub mtha' phal cher la khyab par gyur to/ /de rnams ni mdo sngags so sor phye ba'i man ngag ma yin te/ dper na lam 'bras las kyang / sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab mdo sde dang rgyud sde thams cad kyi don gyi bcud phyung ba zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sngon 'gro snang gsum gyis mdo dang /174

ba 'a 'od snangalas/ saskya'i sa bang tsosabasdus/ ()mkha' dang mnyam par song / gzhan yang zla ba lta bu ras chung rdo rje grags pa las ras chung snyan brgyud dang / ngan rdzong ston pa bo dhi rā dza las ngan rdzong snyan brgyud du grags pa sogs byung / shangs pa bka' brgyud du grags pa ni/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ni gu mas rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'bor thams cad pa'i ngo bo mkhas grub khyung po brtson 'grus mgon rjes su bzung / des rmogs lcog pa rin brtson/ skyer sgang pa chos seng / 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa'i bar du chig brgyud kyi rgyas btab pa brgyud pa rin po che sna bdun/ de nas bka' srol rnam lnga sogs rgya cher spel bas dbus su 'jag bsam gnyisadang / shangs dang / nyang sogs su rgya cher 'phel lo/ /zhi byed du gragasapa ni/ ngo mtshar brgyud pa'i bla ma so drug dang / bde gshegs bcu gnyis sogs kyis rjes su bzung ba grub pa'i dbang phyug dam pa sangs rgyas kyis bod 'dir brtse bas dgongs te lan mang du byon pa las/ dang por ang pho lo tsā ba sogs dang /bar du rma/ so/ kai dge 'dun 'bar gsum dang / tha ma dam pa kun dga'/phyar chen/ phyar chung sogs bu chen bdun la spel nas rgya cher dar/ de nas brgyud pa'i gdams ngag la brten nas rang stobs kyis phye ba gcod yul ces grags pa ni yum chen mo mi mo'i sha tshugs la brten pa ma gcig lab kyi sgrol mas rgya cher spel ba las grub mtha' phal cher la khyab par gyur to/ /de rnams ni mdo sngags so sor phye ba'i man ngag ma yin te/ dper na lam 'bras las kyang / sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab mdo sde dang rgyud sde thams cad kyi don gyi bcud phyung ba zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sngon 'gro snang gsum gyis mdo dang /174

mdo sngagasabastan pa rin po che'i chosakyi byung tshul lasabartsams pa'i lo rgyusadang rnam thar/dngos gzhi rgyud gsum gyis sngags bla med mtha' dag gi dbang bzhi'i lam ston pa'i phyir dang / de bzhin phyag rgya chen po'ang spyir sngags lugs yin mod kyi / gdul bya dbang rtul la sher phyin gyi lta ba ngo sprad par phyag chen gyi ming gis btags nas 'chad pa sogs so/ /mdo lugs rang rkang gi nyams len gyi gnad thams cad bsdus pa skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim ni lnga brgya pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu lha gcig dī paṃ kā ra lasabyung ste/ de'ang lha btsun byang chub 'od kyis nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba pho nyar mngags te gangs can pa'i bsod namasakyi zhing dam pa jo bo rje byon par bskul ba bzhin phebs nas sngar bstan pa rnal ma zhig byung na'ang bar skabs su rnyogs pa'i dri ma cung zad kyis bslad pa rnams bsal te bsil ljongs thamasacad nyin mo lta bur mdzad/ de la slob ma bsam gyisami khyab kyang khu rngog 'brom gsum ni gtso bo yin la/ de las kyang 'brom ston pa skye ba du mar yab sras kyi tshul bzung bas thugs sras gcig pur gyur pa/ de'i slob ma sku mched gsum zhes pa'i 'jam dbyangs rnam 'phrul po to ba rin chen gsal gyis bka' gdamasagazhung drug la nyan bshad mdzad pas gzhung pa dang / phyag rdor rnam 'phrul phu chung ba gzhon nu rgyal mtshan sgrub pa gtso bor mdzad nas bden bzhi'i man ngag gsungs pas man ngag pa dang / spyan ras gzigs spyan snga tshul khrimasa'abar gyis skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim ches cher spel bas gdams ngag pa dang / nag tsho sogs jo bo'i slob ma brgyad dang / nying slob gnyis te bcu la gtugs pa rong pa phyag sor ba las nag tsho bka' brgyud dam/175

ba chen 'od snang las/ saskya'i chos nga casabasdus/ ()bka' gdams 'og ma zhes grags pa nas bzung ste phrin las kyi klong chen po brdol te bar skabs shin tu kha ba can gyi nor 'dzin thams cad khyab par gyur na'ang / phyis su bstan pa thams cad la thims te gnas pa las zur du 'byed rgyu ma byung zhing / 'on kyang 'jam dpal gzhon nu byis pa'i gzugs kyis rgyu ba shar tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pas thun mong mdo phyogs kyi gdams ngag las rgya chen spyod pa'i srol jo bo yab sras dang / zab mo stong pa'i srol dang / rdo rje theg pa bla med kyi rgyud sder 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras tshad mar mdzad nas lam rim gnyis sogs 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang / thos bsam sgom pa'i bgyi bas rgyal bstan slar yang nyin mor byed pa la bka' gdams gsar ma zhes mtshan du gsol ba'ang yod de don la gnas pa nyid do/ /de ltar dzasbu'i ljon pas ma pa'i ljongs 'dir bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che dar ba'i gnas kyi mchog ni 'phags bod gnyis kho nar nges pa'i phyir cung zad bshad pa yin la/ gzhan du dpal dus kyi 'khor lo las lho gling dbus ma 'di'i phyed byang ma la dum bu drug tu byas pa'i byang nas rim par gangs can/sham+bha la/ rgya nag bod/ li/ rgya gar zhes yul gyi dum bu drug tu gsungasapa ni las kyi sa nyid yin phyir bstan pa rin po che 'degs par bzod pa'i nor 'dzin gyi gzhi'o/ /de slad dang po gangs can du shrī ma ka ṭa dh+yā na'i mchod rten du nag pa'i nya la bdag cag gi ston pas dang por dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud gsungs/gnyis pa sham+bha lar chos rgyal zla ba bzang po nas lha dbang ldan gyi bar sprul 176

ba chen 'od snangs ga sa skya'i chosang sa bsdus/ ()po tha'i dus chos rje khams pa dbu se gdan drangs kyang ma phebs par gtsang po pa gtong bar chos nyan pa dang / hor yul du hor gyi rgyal po jing gi slu na gyi tshe tshal pa'i slob ma gtsang pa dung khur pa byon nas gnam mchod pa la dad pa tsam mdzad/ rjes nas mi nyag kyang hor gyis dbang du bsdus/ phyis rgyal po go dan gyis sa paṇ+ḍi ta spyan drangs/ de'i dus su chos rje rin po che 'phags pa'ang phebs shing / go dan la dbang bskur ba sogs bstan pa gsal bar mdzad/ mo gor gan gyis ga me pa zhi spyan drangs pa sogs bod yul gyi bstan pa dang der 'dzin ci rigs par mchod pa byung / rgya nag phyi ma dzin gyi brgyud tha'i dzu rgyal pos bi rū pa dang / gnas brtan bcu drug spyan drangs/ tā min g.yung lo rgyal pos chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa spyan drangs/ da lta chin gyi brgyud pa 'dir yang shu rgyu'i rgyal pos ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho spyan drangs pa sogs zhwa ser can gyi ring lugs gtso bor gyur pa'i bstan pa la bsnyen bkur zhing phyis nas chos sde chen po'ang mang du btab par snang la/ 'on te sngar nas bzung ste sngags kyi bstan pa ni skal ba can re gnyis tsam gyis nyams su len pa las khyab gdal du ma byung la / mdo phyogs las kyang deng sang gi theg chen dang / de las kyang 'khor lo tha ma'i mdo sde gtso bor spyod pa zhig snang / /bzhi pa bod yul gyi lo rgyus ni sngar bris pa ltar dang / lnga pa li yul du chos rgyal mya ngan med kyi sras su nur grags pas bzung ste ring zhig na rgyal po bi dza ya saṃ bha ba'i ring la/ dge slong be+e ro tsa na sogs kyis bstan pa spel te/gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten mang du bzhengs/ de rjes rgyal po bi dza ya birla'i 178

ba chen 'od snangathug saskya'i rma thing sa bsdus/ ()po tha'i dus chos rje khams pa dbu se gdan drangs kyang ma phebs par gtsang po pa gtong bar choganyan pa dang / hor yul du hor gyi rgyal po jing gi slu na gyi tshe tshal pa'i slob ma gtsang pa dung khur pa byon nas gnam mchod pa la dad pa tsam mdzad/ rjes nas mi nyag kyang hor gyisadabang du bsdus/ phyisargyal po go dan gyis sa paṇ+ḍi ta spyan drangs/ de'i dus su chosarje rin po che 'phags pa'ang phebs shing / go dan la dbang bskur ba sogasabastan pa gsal bar mdzad/ mo gor gan gyis dzime pak+shi spyan drangs pa sogs bod yul gyi bstan pa dang der 'dzin ci rigs par mchod pa byung / rgya nag phyi ma chin gyi brgyud tha'i dzu rgyal pos bi rū pa dang / gnas brtan bcu drug spyan drangs/ tā min g.yung lo rgyal posachosarje de bzhin gshegs pa spyan drangs/ da lta tshin gyi brgyud pa 'dir yang shuñca'i rgyal pos ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho spyan drangs pa sogs zhwa ser can gyi ring lugs gtso bor gyur pa'i bstan pa la bsnyen bkur zhing phyis nasachos sde chen po'ang mang du btab par snang la/ 'on te sngar nas bzung ste sngags kyi bstan pa ni skal ba can re gnyis tsam gyis nyams su len pa las khyab gdal du ma byung la / mdo phyogs lasakyang deng sang gi theg chen dang / de lasakyang 'khor lo tha ma'i mdo sde gtso bor spyod pa zhig snang / /bzhi pa bod yul gyi lo rgyus ni sngar bris pa ltar dang / lnga pa li yul du chos rgyal mya ngan med kyi sras su nur grags pas bzung ste ring zhig na rgyal po bi dza ya saṃ bha ba'i ring la/ dge slong be+e ro tsa na sogs kyis bstan pa spel te/gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten mang du bzhengs/ de rjesargyal po bi dza ya bir+ya'i 178

mdo sngagasabastan pa rin po che'i chosakyi byung tshul lasabartsams pa'i lo rgyus dang rnam thar/tshe 'phags yul nas dgra bcom bzhi phebs/ sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi mchod rten ngo sprad cing / ste'u do shan gyi gtsug lag khang brtsigs/ de bzhin du dgra bcom pa dang byang chub sems dpa' grangs med pa zhig byon te theg pa che chung gnyis rka'i bstan pa gsal bar mdzad cing / gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun gyi sdes khyab par gyur na'ang / deng sang ni bstan pa gzugs brnyan tsam du snang ngo zhes gtam du thos so/ /drug pa 'phags yul du dar tshul ni sngar smos pas khyab la/ rgyas par ni thams cad mkhyen pa tā ra nā thasamadzad pa'i rgya gar chos 'byung / kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che/ gsung rab rin po che'i mdzod/ 'gos lo thams cad mkhyen pa/ deb sngon/ dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba mkhasapa'i dga' ston sogs kyi bod yul gyi chos gtso bor gyur pa'i chos 'byung / kun mkhyen lnga pa rin po che'i bod kyi rgyal rabarme gtso bor bshad pa rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dang / kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che'i bde gsang dus gsum yo ga dang bcas pa'i chos 'byung dang / grub mtha' so so'i chos kyi byung ba brjod pa dang / bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar sogs dang / gung mgon po skyabs kyis byas pa'i rgya nag gi chos 'byung du blo gros kyi mig bsgrub par byos shig rnam mang ngo mtshar gtam gyi mchog /bdud rtsi'i chu gter bsrubs pa las/ /legs 'ong nyin mo'i dpal 'di yang //blo ldan ut+pal tshogs kyis gsos/ /zhes pa'ang ched du brjod pa'o/ /sarba dā maṅga lam̐/ /179

༄༅/ /rnal 'byor gyi rgyud sde byung tshul/ /༄7/ /na mo badz+ra satā ya/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud sde byung tshul la/ bdag cag gi ston pa grangs med kun snying bzhed pa'i bskal pa rgya mtsho'i thog ma nas rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon du brnyes kyang / drang don du rgyal bu don grub kyi rten la gsar du sangs rgyas pa'i tshul ston pa'i tshe/ btags pa'i lus chu bo ni rañja na'i 'gram du bzhag nas dbang bskur te/ ye shes kyi lus 'og min du mngon byang lnga'i rol pas sku bzhi'i sar gshegs par mdzad nas/ slar yang 'og min dang / dga' ldan dang / lcang lo can te lha gnas gsum du grags par yo ga'i rgyud sde rnams gsungs/ de nyid sdud pa phyag na rdo rjes bsdus te gnas pa la/ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgya dang bcu gnyis na/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ nga ni 'di nas mi snang nas/ /zhes sogasalung bstan pa ltar rgya gar shar lho'i 'gram/ grong khyer pa ti kirti zhes bya bar rgyal po rab gsal zla ba byung ste/ de la phyag na rdo rjes rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor sprul nas dbang bskur te/ lha gnas gsum du grags par de nyid bsdus pa la sogs pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud mtha' dag gnang / de la slob ma rgyal bu sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po dang / ye shesardo rje dang / pra dz+nyā sirnyi dang / rab 'byor bskyangs te bzhi'am/ kha cig rab 'byor bskyangasami 'dren par/ su sti pha la dang / phal 180
