rnala'abyor gyi rgyud sde byung tshul/cher nyi ma'i snying po dang bzhi yin zhesazer/gang ltar de bzhi char la 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/yi ge ā ming bdag nyid ches//ston pa'i bstan pa gcesa'adzan byed//blo ldan yon tan kun gyisabaskur//zhesalung bstan pa'i grub chen kun dga' snyingaposagasan/de nas pradz+nyā ba li ta/pradz+nyā bo dhi/muk+kika ko lgadharma pā la rnamasal brgyud de/de'i slob ma ni jo bo di paṃ kā ra dang /lo tsā ba rim/ chen bzang po'o//yang kha cigaslob dpon bud+dha gurgya zhesabya ba dngosagrub bornyesapa zhig gi+osa'aphagosapa 'jom dopal las/de nyid bsdusapa/rdo rje rtsem / dpal mchag dang pa/ngan sang sbyang rgyud/rtag pa thamasacad bsdusapa rnamasakyi dbang gdams gsan nas/yan lag med pa'i rdo rje sogasalas rim par brgyud de/slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen zhesabya bsade nyid bsdus pa'i 'grelapa mdzad de/de ltar na don la mkhasapa sangasargyasagasang ba/tshig la mkhasapa shākya bshesaganyen/tshig don gnyisaka la mkhas pa kun dga' snying po ste/rnala'abyor rgyud la mkhasapa mi gsum du gragasaso//zhesabazhed do//yang kun dga' snying po'i mched grogasa'ajam dpal grags pa zhesabya ba 'jam dpal gyi grub pa thob cing sku che ba'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa desadapal sbas bzang po la bzhad/desabram ze ye shesardo rje la bshad/desan len+t+ra'i nub sgo ba sher 'byung blo grosal bshad/desabram ze bzhad pa'i rdo rje dang /pad+ma /ra/shud+dhā snar gsum la bshad/phyi ma gnyisakyisalo chen la bshad/yang slob dpon 'jam dpal bshesaganyen zhesabya bas/sangasargyasaye shesazhabasadang sgeg pa'i rdo rje'am nor bu gling pa dang spya tshogs gzugasacan sogasamatshan gyi

rnal ra gyi rgyud sde byung tso/cher nyi ma'i snying po dang bzhi yin zhes zer/gang ltar de bzhi char la 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/yi ge ā ming bdag nyid ches//ston pa'i bstan pa gcesa'adzan byed//blo ldan yon to kun gyis bskur//zhes lung bstan pa'i grub bye/mi //sti lnga tsho 1re/ /2) sto te/bye/ ///dzog tshon kun dga' nga pas gsan/ nas pradz+nyā ba ta/pradz+nyā ba /mu / rka ka lgasto pā la rnams la brgyud de/de'i slob ma ni jo bo di paṃ kā ra dang /lo tsā ba rim/ 0 bzang po'o//yang kha cig slob dpon kyā gu phya zhes bya ba dngos grub brnyes pa zhig gis 'phags pa 'jam dpal las/de nyid bsdus pa/rdo rje rtsemo / dpal ma tso dang po/ga song sbyong rgyud/rtog pa thams cad bsdus pa rnams kyi dbang gdams gsan nas/yan lag med pa'i rdo rje sogs las rim par brgyud de/slob dpon shākya bshes gawo zhes bya bas de nyid bsdus pa'i 'grel pa mdzad de/de ltar na don la mkhas pa sangs rgyas gsang ba/tshig la mkhas pa shākya bshes gnyen/tshig don gnyis ka la mkhas pa kun dga' snying po ste/rnal ra rgyud la mkhas pa mi gsum du grags so//zhes bzhed do//yang kun dga' snying po'i mched grogs 'jam dpal grags pa zhes bya ba 'jam dpal gyi grub pa thob cing sku che ba'i yon to lnga dang ldan pa des dpal sbas bzang po la skad/des bram ze ye shes rdo rje la spyod/des nā le rdzo nub sgo ba sher khrung blo gros la gad/des bram ze bas pa'i rdo rje dang /pad+ma /ra/shrīdz+nyā snar gsum la bshad/phyi ma gnyis kyis lo chen la bshad/yang slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen zhes bya bas/sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs dang sgeg pa'i rdo rje'am nor bu gling pa dang spya tshogs gzugs can sogs ma gyi

ba chen 'od ngas la gas 'a cho /(2)rnam grangs du mdang ldan pa de la bshad/des su rla gim des dharma badz+ra/desade be shwa ra/des shīn+ti gar+bha dang : ti dz+nyā na la bshad do//de dag las bod du ji ltar byung tshul la/lo r+ṣa rin bzang /smi rar lan gsum du byon pa'i dang po la/kha che'i mkhan po byu ha ri la 'jig rten snang byed kyi dkyil 'khor du bzhugs/phyi bye las yo pa 'jam rdor dang /mi bskyod pa gnyis/rdor dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba zhus nas bshad bka' yang gsan/lan gnyis par paṇ+ḍita pad+mā snar — dang pradz+nyā kar warma gnyis la gtugs te yo ga'i gzhung 'grel 'ga' zhig bsgyur ba sogs mdzad/de yan ho lo r+sā gyi slob ma rnam bye nas brgyud pa'i yo ga'i skor 'dzin pas/phyag len kun snying dang /bshad pa de nyid snang ba ma tsā ra bas bshad pa ko swā ga'i ༅ gyi steng nas mdzad cing skar dang dbyangs sogs spros pa'ang che bar grags so//gsum par paṇ+ḍita sangs rgyas zhi ba zhes nor bu glang pa'i slob ma'am/la las de nyid du 'dod pa de la kun snying lugs kyi bshad pa dang lag len gnyis ka zhug pas/de nyid la thugs rtsis shin tu che bar mdzad/lo r+ṣa gyi sku tshe'i mjug tu rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍita sto pā la mnga' ris su byon par sto 'byor rgyud kyi skor gas/kun snying gi brgyud pa bzhi par bog cing de'i gdams pa ma nor pa byung bas shin tu mnyes skad/lo r+ṣa de la spyir slob ma mang yang thugs sras mchoge bzhi ste/lo chung legs pa'i shesarab/mang gong gi gur shing brtson sa rgyal ma'/grwab ga smo nu shes rab/sgyi nor dz+nyā na dang bzhi las/dang pos dha/ pā la'i lugs ma gsan/gnyis pas

ba zuga'odasnangalags 'a mo /(2)rnam grangasadu ma/nga ldan pa de sagad/desapho cigadesasto badz+ra/desade be shwa ra/desan+ti gar+bha dazlo smra ta dz+nyā na la bshad do//chi smide dag lasaboṭ+wāṃ du ltar byung tshus la/lo r+ṣa na /zang kā rar lan gsu/durngo+on padang po la/kha /'a mkhan po tsan+d+ra ha la 'ag rten /nga bye+od dastalatso+o+or du zlosasdu/zlosashad+dhā+olasaḥsapa 'jam rdor dang / bskyad pa gnyas/rdaradangs/ dal ༷/ra du dbang bskur ba zhuganas shad shāka' yang gas/telan snasapar /ta pad+mā karno nawarma dang pradz+nyākar warma gnyasal gtugs ṭī ga gzhung 'ala'aga' bsdor ba zlogs ma/da/de yan ho lo r+sā lja slob ma rnam shrad+dhā nasabargyud pa' yo ga skor 'anapas/phyagaXnakun+d+ra steng dang /bsha/bdeyisnangab mo'agyur bas spyod pa kosuka' ༅ gya nga nasamaspyi nga skar dang /byangasasogasaspru+os paXng che bar gragasaso//gsamapar bta sangasargyasnru ba zhesaspyi+or gaglang pa' slob mawo/sal lasade nyad du 'dā+od pa de lashi/ r+sha lugs shad pa dang lags len 〉khoka 0pas/deyi la thu/sakhrisan tu che bar masdod/lo r+ṣo gya sku mjug tu rgya saX shar phyogs pa'ita/ chu pā la mang/ ras subyanaciparatristir rgyud byaskar gas/sna snyang brgyud pa ba pa/ 'a// nga de' gdamasapa ma nor pabyungabasazhin tu mnyesaskad/lo ༷na da la raslobamasnangaya/thugasasrasam ོga ba ste/lo wo legasapa' shes/ba/mngagong snar nga tsho+on khrusargyal/'a/grwab gash+ko nu ༷sarab/ nar dz+nyā na dang ba las/dang bsardo pā la lugasatshigasan/gnyasapas

sasti+or gyi rma ca tso/dhipā swā lu/sasnyo boramadzad/gsum pasag7sna g.yi bsrangs/ba pasas gcwawa bsrang ngo //yang gas du sbyangasang der thug pa/pu comanak+ṣi+oṃgra/swādha/rgyaye tso/gung pa dge ges/masdu dhibadaso maspyo bugasape /bye/busakong na sprar da/ tso/ldo+ogyi drung du 'gro ba ya//nga ro da dom/ rberkyangapo /labla snga/ nasashanagisumaston ye 'bar/ nasato stad khi/ nasadapang kha 'dar wo pha gas nu rgya ྾/la stod kyi bragasteng ba/saphyi ru'i dmar ston mro+okyi sams /sde// snye/// //de/ //)/1nge/na / / mdag stan/b.lashākyado/thar+shasbyinagang ba /mas/ dag phalacheralosgi lathug pa ྾ byasanas bor lo sa drung du sbyangasate/snaswāgayo smad phyogasasu dar bsayozlo smad lugasasu grags/yang lo gya slobamabragar+sā payon totshul sa/desakho gyo/me+e saskyab laXrgyud de k+ṣi+oṃ lugasasngagato/yang sto gal/sa/jo bo/zegosgoms/skya nar dz+nyā na/gnyalabanyamasarab/sanuranyamaspyu+orashosanasabargyud pa laṅgi+o+o lugs4/'khyartsasgrur nyi yo'oca na pa grogogatsonas brgyud pa gragasaso/khu //8

zos ra gyi rma ca tso/sto pā la'i lugs gtso bor mdzad/gsum pas gnyis ka'i gzhung bsrangs/bzhi pas phyis kyi gzhung bsrang ngo //yang g.yin du sbyangasang der thug pa/pu co an ston grags rin/rgya ye tshul/gung pa dge bzhes/mar yul bdakon mkho gas te bsto//dbusang na mar dar tso/thos drung du 'gro ba yi/rgyang ro dpe dmar gyi rkyang po chos blo snga/de nas shan gyi sum ston ye 'bar/de nas to stod kyi ce zhar/de nas dpang kha 'dar wo gi pha gzhon nu rgya mtsho/la stod kyi brag steng ba/sgul ru'i dmar ston chos kyi rgyal mtshan no / / mdog gle r+sā/bgo shākya rdo rje/thang r+sā gong ge ba rnams te/de dag phal cher lo r+sā la thug pa ྾ byas nas gtso bor lo sa gi drung du sbyangs te/dbus gtsang gi smad phyogs su dar bas yo ga smad lugs su grags/yang lor+pā gyi slob ma brag steng g.yon to tshul khrims/des ma la gyo/des sa skya pa la brgyud de r+sā lugs su grags/yang sto gal nas/jo bo/go mi sgom 'a/skya nor dz+nyā na/gsha ba nyi ma shes rab/sa nur nyi ma'od zer tsos nasabargyud pa la jo bo lugs/rma rtsa snar nyi yo'og son pa sgo gogasumanas brgyud pa zhes grags so/khu //8

༄//dzi/ ༵ṭ+wā+oṃ snroshā dṛ ṭ+wāṃ k+ṣiṃ r+sha ོ༵kā gh+ri sngu rlo /nga zad zhes bya ba bzhugs so//'i༄7//oṃ susti sidhi/ngag gi rang bzhi ming rdzo brjod pa'i sgo//smra ba kun gya masho sar 'jam mgon sdong //dbyer med dpa/ ldan / mar sdos btud nas//gas par sbyar dba' /byetshul cung zad da//'a 'aXgaXs/thog maralhayuswā du dar tshul//sgonas yuladu dar sdolalo//dngapo spyi/sngan sarba dz+nyo zhesapa' sgra mkhasapa sdong bsna/desalha' dbang po brgya ri/ dang /drangasraX ḍir bul bslobs//krinyasapa /'dul ba lung na/shā buso dbang pa(2spradalabacuga~Xsasubaslabasapar 'gasungasaXng /rgyal pa tsan+dan skyong 'i skabasasu bram ze n+d+ra gh+ri ba phyugapasalha' dbang pa bsgru/sna sdus masdo+ong ༵ sgra' nges gnas gsungasata/tī dbang ༷sadīstan pa ba bras pa'/ n+d+ra byā ka ra ṇa zhesapa brtsamasashang /bodakya snyi dbazlo posabartsam par zlogadapayang//thugago/gzhanayang /// rkang gas drang srong ma lhag nya masamadzad pa gzhung bcu pa zheX/bya ba yod pa sgra /grelarnams/ lunga'adren pagri mngayodal/drang srong tañja sa mdzadapa/btañja byā r+sha ṭ+wāṃ ṇa thal mo lhung brda sprod pa zhes pa'ang /snyil ba sogasalasachur lhung ga pa

༄7//legs par sbyar ba'i bstan bcos kyi byung tshul cung zad bshad pa ngo mtshar zla zhun gsar pa'i 'dzum phreng zhes bya ba bzhugs so//༄tsho//oṃ su sti sid+dhi/ngag gi rang bzhin ming tshig brjod pa'i sgo//smra ba kun gyi mchog gyur 'jam mgon dang //dbyer med dpal ldan bla mar gus gas nas//legs par sbyar ba'i byung tshul cung zad dbye//'di laganyis/thog mar lha yul du dar tshul/de nas mi yul du dar tshul lo//dang po ni/sngon sarba dz+nya zhes pa'i sgra mkhas pa zhig byung bas/des lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang /drang srong phur bu la bslabs//gnyis pa ni/'dul ba lung nas shā ri'i bus dbang po'i brda sprod lo bcu gnyis su bslabs par gsungs shing /rgyal po tsan+dan skyong gi skabs su bram ze in+d+ra gh+ri ba zhes pas lha'i dbang po bsgrubs pas mthong ste sgra'i nges gnas gsungs ta/lha'i dbang pos bstan pa bzhin bris pa'i/in+d+ra byā ka ra ṇa zhes pa brtsams shang /bod kyi lha'i dbang pos brtsam par bshad pa yang der thug go/gzhan yang stag rkang rigs kyi drang srong ma lhag nyi mas mdzad pa'i gzhung bcu pa zhes bya ba zhig yod pa sgra 'grel rnams su lung 'dren pa yang yod la/drang srong tañja yis mdzad pa/ba tañja li byā ka ra ṇa ste thal mo lhung gi brda sprod pa zhes pa'ang ༷stel ba sogs las chur lhung gi rig pa

legasapar sbyar ba'i bstan bcosakyi byungatshulachungazad bshad ba ngo mtshar zla zhun gsar pa'i 'grum phreng /zhesabashad pa'ang de yin te/'di gnyisani snga mo zhig nasayod par mngon no/ /'jam dpal rtsa rgyud nas lung bstan pa'i bram ze pā ṇi nisamadzad pa'i pā ṇi byā ka ra ṇa'i mdo brgyad pa zhesash+lau ka stong yod pa dang / bye brag 'byed pa'i mdo sh+lau ka stong yod pa mdzad cing / de la dag 'byed zla ba'i 'grel pa zla zer zhesapa yod la/ 'dar losabasgyur bar grags pa'i dpe 'di yang rgya dpe 'di la brten khul yin kyang zla zer zhesapa'i ming yang ma shesa'adug go /rgyal po bde byed kyis sgra slob pa'i phyir bram ze mchog seng gisarig sngags kyi nusapasaklu'i rgyal po lhag ma can bkug ste/ pā ni'i 'grel pa shā+o ka 'bum yod pa 'chad nyan byasapa'i skabasaslob dpon dang klu'i bar yol bsabacad de gnasapa las/skabs shig yol ba bteg nas bltas pas klu'i lusal sprul chen po 'khyil ba mthong ste skyengasanadrangabros/ 'grel pa shā+o ka stong phrag lnga labakam zin/ lhag ma stong phrag bcu gnyisakyi tshad du longs pa brtsamasapa ma hā bhā ṣa zer/ gzhung 'grel pa dang bcasapa'i sder nyan da lta'i bar yod cing / si tu rin po che'i zhal nasakyang glegasabam rnamasagazigasatshul gsungasashing / 'grel pa de la 'chad nyan byed pa ma byung yang / 'grel pa ko mu di'i steng nas/ ti ta bhu k+ta'i bram ze pra byulha ste rab stobasalasalegasapar gsan cing / snga song dgung lo nyer lnga'i steng du bal yul lho phyogasakyi paṇ+ḍita yis pa ti khyab 'jug bdag po la 'grel pa bdud rtsi dang tshig zla'i steng nasa.a mā ra ko khri'i dka' gnasathamasacad legasapar bslab pa yin cesagasungs/ de'i don 'grel du slorgadapon tsān+d+ra go misatsān+d+ra byu /ra ṇa skabasadrug pa 'di mdzad cing / slob dpon 185

legs par sbyar ba'i bstan bcog kyi byung tshul chung zad bshad ba ngo mtshar zla zhun gsar pa'i 'dzum phreng /zhas bshad pa'ang de yin te/'di gnyis ni snga mo zhig nas yod par mngon no/ /'jam dpal rtsa rgyud nas lung bstan pa'i bram ze pā ṇi ni sa mdzad pa'i pā ṇi byā ka ra ṇa'i mdo brgyad pa zhes blo ka stong yod pa dang / bye brag 'byed pa'i mdo glo ka stong yod pa mdzad cing / de la dag 'byed zla ba'i 'grel pa zla zer zhes pa yod la/ 'dar los bsgyur bar grags pa'i dpe 'di yang rgya dpe 'di la brten khul yin kyang zla zer zhes pa'i ming yang ma shes 'dug go /rgyal po bde byed kyis sgra slob pa'i phyir bram ze mchog seng gis rig sngags kyi nus pas klu' rgyal po lhag ma can bkug ste/ pā ni'i 'grel pa sgro ka 'bum yod pa 'chad nyan byas pa' skabs slob dpon dang klu'i bar yol bas bcad de gnas pa las/skabs shig yol ba bteg nas bltas pas klu'i lus la sprul chen po 'khyil ba mthong ste skyengs nas bros/ 'grel pa sh+lau ka stong phrag lnga las ma zin/ lhag ma stong phrag bcu gnyis kyi tshad du longs pa brtsams pa ma hā bhā ṣa zer/ gzhung 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i lar nyan da lta'i bar yod cing / si tu rin po che'i zhal nas kyang glegs bam rnams gzigs kha tshul gsung ba(shing / 'grel pa de la 'chad nyan byed pa ma byung yang / 'grel pa ko mu di'i steng nas/ ti ta bhu k+ta'i bram ze pra sna ste rab stobs las legs par gsan cing / snga song dgung lo nyer lnga'i steng du bal yul lho phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍita yis pa ti khyab 'jug bdag po la 'grel pa bdud rtsi dang tshig zla'i steng nas a mā ra ko khri'i dka' gnasathams cad legs par bslab pa yin ces gsungs/ de'i don 'grel du slobadapon ston go mis tsā spro byu /ra ṇa skabs drug pa 'di mdzad cing / slob dpon 185

brtse rna'odamingalags 'a r+sha ()zla ba gragaXparārā bha dra kho+opa'i 5yi bstan 4ོsamahā pa gzi+ogs bas/rangaspyu gsabam༅par bsgyur rnyir gragasapayi sgra sho tso bzong ste/ da/ralogasasu/su man+tabhar zhesasanoṭ+wāṃ bde na k+to//slob dpan mas sgruzlo dbyangs༅ masadangasasu bskobagyi gar sba byā snar ṇanyamaldan /desprodapazhes/jo nang rje btsun disamado gzhungabod skad du skur nasa'al pagasar tshokāswāmadzad pa'acelasabakābhan+t+ras lgi ltad 0ba dang tsor nar brnying ga(bogaXspri man tu po rder+shagasungs/gas yang bta gdu samadzad woX dpal dbyangarā 3 sprod pa hāsalo wo chosaskyong bzang pos ra ba 'ad/zlo+od rnamasar+sha/salko+or da/ngasagaswā laXrten nasa'ajam dpalagyas snadzadapa /da zer rgyu de 'khrul/de yan /masnyam/skyesagaljoX sa /dzadapa'amatābhāṣama'agrelagalhagayod/ rtsagazha lusag pas k+ṣi+oṃ na rgyur mdzad /sabod ska/ du bsdurnyi'al//ralosagasabs nga bta/sabyasapa na bo/ rolarmo ta sto zhesapasabyas/'a sdugasaye khru1 padzigapoche /g.yi kyang sigapa de gnyasas rgya das ṭ+wāṃ tunapa phya)kharabazhugasapar snang /drangagrang lta/ ṭasamadzad ༵ shākagagan zhesapa brda sprod ga dang/drang grong ka busabyasapa banaspyad pa rnamasa'aphagasayumadu yangasasugragasakyaX lhanarni+osarnamasasu sgrihā rnyisapa snelhasabod 'ar mthir ro//spyuga~Xcu rdzogamadzad pa sadabang pa sdude sprod pa dang /drang srong sha sa

brtse sgo'og snang 'a gas zhi cho (6)zla ba grags pas sam na bha dra zhes pa'i 5yi bstan bcos mdzad pa gzigs bas/rang ṣ+ka kyi glegs bam par bsgyur bar grags pa'i sgra mdo tso bzang ste/be+e dkar gos su/su man+ta bha ra zhes bris nor bde yin no//slob dpon a nu ༷ la dbyangs༅ mas dngos su bstsal ba'i gar sba tī byā snar ṇa gle mtsho ldan 'a brda sprod pa spyo/jo nang rje bas gyis mdo ga bod skad du bsgyur nas 'grel pa gsar brtsams mdzad pa 'di la'ang ba 0bha dras rdzun bshad zhus pa dang 'gyur nor ba'ang ci rigs na ces tso mkhyen si tu si po ches gsungs/gas yang paṇ+ḍita gdu kirtis mdzad pa'i 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi 3 sprod pa kho lo wo si skyong bzang pos ra ba 'di/bod rnams kyis dus 'khor gyi dbyangs gsal la brten nas 'jam dpa gyis mdzad pa smo bod zer rgyu de'i zhi 'khrus ga de yin nam snyam/skyes gam gis mdzad pa'i ma hā bhā ṣa rtsa 'grel gnyis yod pa'i rtsa gzha lu ga ṇi pa'i mdo yin rgyur mdzad nas bod skad du bsgyur ba 'di la 'dar los ba ba'i ming btags byas pa yin 'dug phyi rol gyi ba rnyita dharma girti zhes pas byas pa'i gzugs kyi 'jug pa zhes pa'i sgragazhung zhig kyang bo lta pa de gnyis ka zhi rgya dpe tso mkhyen tu rin po che'i phyag khar bzhugs par snang /drang srong ga ṭas mdzad pa'i shākas gan zhes pa'i 3 sprod gzhes dang/drang grong /sto bus byas pa'i brda spyod pa rnams 'phags yul du bongs su grags kyang bstan sa rnams su lung drangs pa las bod 'dir mthir ro//rgyal po mnu dzemadzad pa'i mi skyes dbang tsho 8 6 sprod pa dang /drang thong pi sha lis

legar sbyas thab rtogayos kyi byungs zad dab ro la'i gras sha0ba'i ma phreng /mdzad pa'i pi sha li'i brda sprod pa zhes pa dag yod par bod rnams 'dod pa ni gang yin ma shes shing /rgya gzhung rnams las ming tsam yang mi 'byung la/tsā spro byā ka ra ṇa ni lha'i bu zla bas mdzad zer ba yang ji bzhin ma yin te 'phags yul r+sā ri :ri/sgros ma/rje/ zu ce na sa tsho rtse tshu nad zla /|/du ya ma grags pa ra ra//ra yang grags sgra mad pa brgyad grangs 'dren pa ni bod rnams kyi gsar spros las 'phags yul du de lta bu'i grangs nges byed pa kun tu ma grags so//spyir legs sbyar gyi gzhung dang bstan sabs ma gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir/de ltar yang bod yul 'dir rna ba'i lam du ma grags pa'i dpal sgra yi rgya mtsho zer ba'i rnam dbye'i mtha' dpyod kyi bstan bcos po zhig dang /shabha mi ma spa zer ba'i sgra spyi yi mtha' dpyad kyi bstan bcos shin tu rgyas pa zhig kyang yod ces bla ma mchog gis tu si bo byu/gsungs shing /yang spel byed kyis byas pa'i bya byed las gsum so gos byed rkyen drug gi rnam bshad 'grel pa la mkhas pa zhes dang /mchog sred kyisamadzad pa'i rtags kyi bstan bcos gnyis mkhyen gi tu rin po ches bsgyur pa dang /de zhabs kyi phyag tu rgyadape yod rigs kyang /ba ma ha ste mi'u thung gi mngon brjod/ma' brjod kyi blta sa rtse di ni snar dang /sna r+sāsagasal ba dang /ha tā gzhi dang /drag po 'bangs kyis sbyar ba'i mdzo brjod dang /sor 'phel gyis byas pa'i tshig sdud kyi snying po dang /waṃ med mdzod kyi 'grel pa byā khyu su zhe ste/rnam bshad bdud rtsi dang /gad byung kā rte gi zla ba rnams bzhugs shing /gzhan yang /ko mu di zer ba'i sgra mdo zhig byang phyogs gu dzi ra tha sogs su sid ra dir bod ces jo nang sgrol mgon gyis

legayor sbyabashāgs4ོsakyi byungasasazad shadar+ṣa la'i grasag0ba'i ldogaphreng /mdzad pa'i pi sha li'i brda sprod pa zhesapa dag yod par bod rnamasa'adod pa ni 45 mi /khro/spro ///skugang yin ma shesashang /rgya gzhung rnamasalasang tsam yang 'byung la/r+yā byā ka ra ṇa ni lha'i bu zla bsamadzad zer ba yang ji bzhi ma yin te 'phagasayul du ye ma gragasapa'i phyir ro//spyir yang gragasar+sā sgra mdo r+ṣa po bas kyi grangasa'adren pa ni bod rnamasakyi gsar sprosalasa'aphagasayul du de lta bu'i grangasangesabyed pa tso tu mgragasaso//spyir legasasbyar gyi g.yi dang bska yo+osab4 gyisami khyab pa'i phyir/de ltar yang bod yul 'dir rna ba'i lam du ma gragasapa'i dpal sgra yi rgya mtsho zer ba'i rnamadabye'i mtha' dpyod kyi bstan 4ོsa po zhig dang /shabha mi maspa zer ba'i sgra spyi yi mtha' dpyad kyi bstan d+ku+osashin tu rgyasapa zhig kyang yod cesabla ma maso gis tusibo r+ṣa/gsungasashing /yang spelabyed kyisabyasapa'i bya byed lasagasum sogasabyed rkyen drug gi rnam bshad 'grelapa la mkhasapa zhesadang /mchog sred kyisamadzad pa'i rtagasakyi bstan 4ོsaganyisas mkhyen gitu rin po chesabasgyur pa dang /de khasakyi phyagatu rgyadape yod rigasakyang /ba maha ste mi'u thung gi mngon brjod/mgo brjod kyi blta d+ku+osar+shadi ni snar dang /sna r+sāsagasalab dang /ha tā gzhi dang /drag po 'bangasakyisasbyar ba'i mgo brjod dang /sti+or 'phel gyisabyasapa'i tshigasdud kyi snying po dang /waṃ med mdzod kyi 'grel pa byā khyu su dhā ste/rnamanyad bod rtsidang /gad r+yā kān+ta gizla ba rnamasabazhugasashing /gas yang /ko mu di zer ba'i sgra mdo zhinabyang phyogasagu dzi ra tha sogasasu mothodar dir yod cesajo nang sgrolamagon gyis

'tshechena'od palas/saskya' 65 sa bsdus/()gsungasabog pa de+odarte /paṇ+ḍita /nasamadzad pa'i ma dh+ya ko mo ༷ zeje ṭ+wāṃ ༷go /nga /dbang phyu/ pa ḍa ma ru sgra lasabyung bar gragasapa'/ṇ+ḍi ka ma ste//ga pa sbyar te zla zer rnam pa gsum yodu cesabal rno bta kun bzlornyi sazer na 'dug gokhyadaparaka'alapa'abyungatshul zhi/'a|gsaX klu na bdag rgyal po bde spyod bzang po' btsu/mothachungag sasgra' gnasacung zad shesapa la/lhas/ོsnatshal du rtse ba tshe bas kā+odhi/gto+o bas/btsun mos/mo modwakri/ ñca sa/bdag la chu (5 dgator 'i sasmrasapas/rgya/mi pasalhaci phyagasna yulaskad du lusbyil nas/bal sraX / khur ba tal mar du sapa na ga zer bar go ste na pas/btsun ma bsam par/bdag gi khyo ga 'di ci yang mi shesapa'i skye bo ba lang lta bu zhig go bsam ste/lceb pazlo brtsamasapasargyalapos bzung ste sgra slob par dam 4sate'i/bramaze mamo/ da lasale/sapar bslab bo//'on kya/gong du bshad pa ma/ga sred 'grel pa la da ma chesate/rgyal po rang zhang po sharma ste 'tshe ba go cha'am/sarba washāstethamasacad go cha ste/jonang rjebarten la pa la bha drasas/warma/bdunapagocha yan tshul zhusayod 'dug kyang ngas mde'i 'grel pa' rgyad ṭ+wā+oṃgar+shasu rgya dpe gsum i lhazis parnyi sharma warma po/yod brdzubod bluno kha ga sadabang phyug ga cha ra ba nar bo'// la gzhan nu gdang dru+og sgrub bzhi+o pasasha/ wamesakyang gas nu /dang drug bsgru/sanasazhalamathang bas/dazlosagrub 'dad gsungasapas/ n+d+ra k+to snar ṇa zlok+tar 'tshal zhusapas/ d+dho war+ṇa pa māṃ nā di/8zhesagasungasapa mod la lha na

ba chen 'od pa las/lo skya' chos lnga sa bsdus/()gsungs 'dug pa de dang /paṇ+ḍita bhanas mdzad pa'i ma khyo ko mo di zer ba zhig dang /dbang phyug chen po'i ḍa ma ru'i sgra las byung bar grags pa'i/sirnyi ko mo dī ste/rtag pa'i zer te zla zer rnam pa gsum yod ces ba la po paṇ+ḍita kun bzang gis zer gyin 'dug go khyad par kā la pa'i byung tshul ni/'phags pa klu'i sbyin bdag rgyal po bde spyod bzang po'i btsun mo tha chung zhig gis sgra'i gnas cung zad shes pa la/skyed mos tshal du rtse ba'i tshe btsun mo la chu gtor bas/btsun mos/ma mo dwa ka ñca zhes/bdag la chu 'a dgator zhig ces smrasapas/rgyal pos lho phyogs kyi yul skad du 'grul nas/bal sran gyi khur ba til mar du btsos pa byin cig zer bar go ste byin pas/btsun mo'i bsam par/bdag gi khyo ga 'di ci yang mi shes pa'i skye bo ba lang lta bu zhig go bsam ste/lceb par brtsams pas rgyal pos bzung ste sgra slob par dam bcas te/bram ze mchog srid las legs par bslab bo//'on kyang gong du bshad pa'i mchog sred kyi 'grel pa la yid ma ches te/rgyal po rang gi shad po sha me ste 'tshe ba'i go cha'am/sarba warma ste thams cad go cha ste/jo nang rje btsun la pa la bha dras sartowarma ste bdun pa'i go cha yin tshul zhus yod 'dug kyang byings mdo'i 'grel pa'i rgya dpe sogs su rgya dpe gsum tsam mtshungs par sha me warma zhes yod pas bod blun kha cig gis dbang phyug go cha zhes zer ba ni nor ba'o//de la gzhon nu gdong drug sgrub bcug pas sha me warmas kyang gzhen nu gdong drug bsgrubs nasazhal mthong bas/dngos grub ci 'dod gsungs pas/in+d+ra byā snar ṇa shes par 'tshal zhug pas/sirnyo war+ṇa pa māṃ nā di/8zhes gsungs pa'i mod la lha'i byin

legasapar sbyar ba'i bstan bcosakyi byung tshul stongakhrod bzhad ba ngo mtshar zla zhun gsar pa'i 'dzum phreng /rlabasakyisasgra rig thams cad de ma thag tu shesapar byung ngo / /de nas sharma warmas sgra yi gzhung rnamasakyi legs pa'i cha shas thams cad bsdus nas bstan bcos 'di mdzad pasakā lā pa snyu tra cha shasabasagasapa'i mdo zhes gsungs so / / de ltar yang slob phan las/ slob dpon sarba warma dag gi 'dod pa 'jo ba dag skyong bsamadzad pa'o/ /zhes gsal bar bstan to/ /de ni in+d+ra byā ka ra ṇa'i lugs yin par bzhed do/ /des rang gi tsha bo rgyal po bde spyod la bslabs pasalegasasbyar la mkhasapar gyur/ ces 'phagasayul ba rnamasakyi ngag sgros rnam par dag pa lasa'abyung zhing / bod rnamasakyis kun bshad rkang pa bzhi pa ni lhas gsungasapas/ lha chog par 'tshal zhusapasame bya'i kha gyen du phyogasapa dang / bstan bcosade'i ming gang lagasazer rgyur/ shāsta nā ma ki ho/ zhesadrisapas/ rma bya'i mjug sgro khra tshubs kyis song bas ming kā la pa btags zer gyin 'dug la/ kā la pa zhesapa me bya sgro mdongs can la 'jug pa yin pas de skad du sgrogs so/ /rang lugs ni snga ma de ltar 'dod pa yin cing / ka tan+t+ra ste rgyud nyung ngu'ang rab tu grags so/ /de yang ji skad du/ bgrod dka' si has/ sharma wamosarnam bshad pa'i/ khyud nyung bdag gis bshad par bya/ /zhesagasungasaso / / 'di'i lugasal kun bshad rkang pa drug pa phyin chad ni 'tshe ba'i go chas brtsam par 'dod kyang ji bzhin ma yin no/ /mdo de la slob dpon durga sku rtagabartsams pa'i 'grel pa dur sing dang / slob dpon grags 'byor gyis mdzad pa 'i slob ma la phan pa dang / spyan gsum 'bangs kyis dur sing gi yang 'grel bod du 'gyur bar gsungs kyang ma mthong la/ kha cher ts+tsha tra ste gsal ba'i 189

legs par sbyar ba'i bstan bcos kyi byung tshul stong zlad bshad ba ngo mtshar zla zhun gsar pa'i 'grum phreng /rlabs kyis sgra rig thams cad de ma thag tu shes par byung ngo / /de nas sha me warmas sgra yi gzhung rnams kyi legs pa'i cha shas thams cad bsdus nas bstan bcos 'di mdzad pas kā lā pa snyu tra cha shas bsags pa'i mdo zhes gsungs so / / de ltar yang slob phan las/ slob dpon sarba warma dag gi 'dod pa 'jo ba dag skyong bas mdzad pa'o/ /zhes gsal bar bstan to/ /de ni in+d+ra byā ka ra ṇa'i lugs yin par bzhed do/ /des rang gi tsha bo rgyal po bde spyod la bslabs pasalegs sbyar la mkhas par gyur/ ces 'phags yul ba rnams kyi ngag sgros rnam par dag pa las 'byung zhing / bod rnams kyis kun bshad rkang pa bzhi pa ni lhas gsungs pas/ lha chog par 'tshal zhug pas me bya'i kha gyen du phyogs pa dang / bstan bcos de'i ming gang lags zer rgyur/ shāsta nā ma ki ho/ zhes drisapas/ rma bya'i mjug sgro khra tshubs kyis song bas ming kā la pa btags zer gyin 'dug la/ kā la pa zhes pa me bya sgro mdongs can la 'jug pa yin pas de skad du sgrogs so/ /rang lugs ni snga ma de ltar 'dod pa yin cing / ka tan+t+ra ste rgyud nyung ngu'ang rab tu grags so/ /de yang ji skad du/ bgrod dka' si has/ sha me wa mos rnam bshad pa'i/ khyud nyung bdag gis bshad par bya/ /zhes gsungasaso / / 'di'i lugs la kun bshad rkang pa drug pa phyin chad ni 'tshe ba'i go mas brtsam par 'dod kyang ji bzhin ma yin no/ /mdo de la slob dpon du rga si hasabartsams pa'i 'grel pa dur sing dang / slob dpon grags 'byor gyis mdzad pa 'i slob ma la phan pa dang / spyan gsum 'bangs kyis dur sing gi yang 'grel bod du 'gyur bar gsungs kyang ma mthong la/ kha cher ts+tsha tra ste gsal ba'i 189

ba 'a 'og kha gas tso r+sha mi go gas/()gdugs sam/rgyal po'i gdugs kyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa'ang bod du tsā ra bar grags kyang deng sang mi 'dug cing /de la rin chen gdugs su bsgyur gni blun gtam mo//ri so gos kyi bya ba sarba she ras mdzad gdang /ma dhi /ni dang /'jam dpal grags pas mdzad pa'i gi so gos kyi mtha' dpyad gnyisabod du 'gyur kyang 'gyur skyon shin tu che bar snang /dur sing gis mdzad pa'i rgyud nyung gi byings mdo 'di'ang gur ston gyis bsgyur kyang 'gyur skyon che bas/slar gi tu rin po ches byings mdo'i 'grel pa 'gyur skabs 'gyur bcosalegs par mdzad do//bod yul 'dir yang kā la pa'i per nyan shin cad ra bar byung bas bu dang /bla mdam pa dang /lo r+sā byang rtsedang /sa bzang 'phags pa dang /thugs rje dpal dang /blo brtan bzhi pa dang /stag tshang lotsāb dang /zha lu lo chen dang /na pa mi bskyod rdo rje rnams kyi 'grel pa rnamasayod cing /dam dum tsam ni smos kyis mi longs la/khyad par/ming gi mtshamasasbyor gtsor ston mtshams sbyor rkang pa lnga slob phan las drug tu bshad/ming las tshig tu bsgrub pa ming gi rkang pa bzhi ste ming bzhi zhes sogasungs/ming las ming du bsgrub pa tshig sdud dang de phan la mdo rkang pa re re dang /slob phan las bud med mdo rkang pa gcig bcas dang /byings las tshig tu bsgrub pa kun bshad rkang pa brgyad dang /byings las ming du bsgrub pa spo ta rkang pa drug rnams su bkral ba'i 'grel pa/kā pa pa'i mdo yi rnam par bshad pa zla ba'i 'od zer zhes/rgya 'grel gnyis pa sus ting gi mtha' dang /mdzod 'grel sogs la brten cing gi tu rin po che'i spyal lung ltar bkod pa'i legs bshad

char tso'angalagags r+shasnoskalags/9)cigs4/hrū tsho /dugs:samadzad pasbya 'grelapa'ang bod du ra snar gragasakyang deng risang snyug nga /de lan r+pā gdugasasu ༷sa ṅgi blun gtam mo// sogs bya ba sarnyi snro rasamadza/ gdang /ma kri dang /'jamadapal gragasapasnamadzad pa sogs //ṅgi dpyad gnyardzubod du 'a/ṭ+wāṃ kyang 'gyur /ོna na tuche rnyi/ snang /dur samadzad pa rgyud dzī ringasamado 'anga'ang gur ston sabasgyur kyang 'gyur skyon che bas/slar tunapochesabyangasamadot+t+waṃ 'grel pa 'grir skabasa'/rabacosalegasapar mdzadado//bodayula'ar yangakā lo sdu/ 'amawa yinacadar bar byung bsagastan dang rje/bla mdamapadang /la zhi byang dang /sabazang 'phagasapa dang /thugs dpalada~X /blo brtan ba pa dbye /stagatshangaldo+otsāb dbye /zhalulo'ad/ /kārnyi pa mibaskyod rdo rje rnams rāgre pa rnamasayod dū /dam dum tsam smosas longasal/khyad par/ nga mtsha/sasbyor garastonama.irdzulho/rkang bzhislobamiphanasnasadrug tubashad/ming lasazhug tu bsgrub pa nga rkang pa ba ste nga ba zhesasogasungs/ nga lasamang snre bsgrub pa rdzo sdu/ byeng de phan lamadobyi rkang pa re //nga /slobaphan lasabud da mad rkang pa spya bcasadabye / ngasalasakritubasgrub pa kun bshad rkang pa /rgyad dang /byangasalardzung sdo bsgrub pa ta rkang pa dru/ rnamasasu bkral ba 'grel ṭī/kā pa pa k+taso k+ta rnam par bshad pa zla ba 'odazerazhes//'byel/lhaga~Xsus mtha'adanga'i/mdzoda'agrel sogasal brten nga tu na po shāka lung ltar bkod pa legasabashad

leg par ra7 bsaspangakyi byungasacag skadar+ṣarma'iskyasag0ye ldogaphreng/rma du byung batshesnang wo /de'i brgyud 7yang /lha thamasato ༷dzi pa/drang sroX phur bu/gawā+o nugadong drugaslobadani+osha/ r+sā/apo spyod bzang pa/jobo rngosasti+or/slob /sno' ༵ /slobadapon sto nā dwa/mkhasaparat+na ma/slobadapon gang zla ba/ med so gede yan go ni bod rnamasakyi ngag sgrosadag sbyor ba yin cing /de nasapaṇa r+ṣa lak+ṣi ka ra/snye/rdo la te/)rtsen 'pho shegashozlo ldo+ordo rgyalamatshan/tshong lo blo grosabartan pa/la ma/ོga yā sapa' blo gros/dpang loblagrosabartanapa/lo'abya/ chus mo/sgra bsgyuṭ+wāṃ nam mkha' bzang po/lo thugasarje dpal/dpal nga ni+o tsā ba gragasapa mas gshe/zha lubyesaskyong bza/ po/da༅ོ po bdu dkar mroskyong /skyogasastoṭ+wāṃ lto la tsā ba na r+ṣa bkra sa/dpalakhang la tsā ba snangs༅ snyemasapa sde/sgang ra lo tsā ba 'od zer mtshan tso/smon 'gro btashā dbang don grubo/womadabyangasadabang rgyalardo rje+o/rgyaladabazlo blo /'ong gyo /rnamapaṇa shākan mas 7grags/thamad byamasapa ༵ mkhaswār+sha kun dga' smrasasbya/zur mang che tsha spruldo+osku gsung rirargorgya /bla ma ṭ+wā+oṃ che/byesaXta hūṃ bang kun khyab la ga dan sdong ri ma lan gsum bas / tu ranapokyi 5na nasakyang tsān+d+ra pa' sasago don dngasasapazhi/maḍā+o brjod k+tastan d+ku+osarnyi ma rakoṣa 'grel pa casalan /sum bar par ting /kā lapago son das gadhikyang lan /nyasasu le/sapar zhu/sna she/de ltar kā lngo gnyasar+pā chu bo ga 'dres brgyud pa /zha lu lo mroskyong bzang po/dbon pad spyakar mro+oskyong /thig pa lo tsā ba spyang

leg par ra ba'i ba btsos kyi byung tshul chu bshad ba ngo mtshas glags ra la phreng/rma du byung bzhig snang zhing /de'i brgyud rim yang /lha thams cad mkhyen pa/drang srong phur bu/gas nu gdong drug slob da sha me — /rgyal po ge spyod bzang po/jo bo khas wor/slob dgo 'a go mi/slong dpon sto nā dwa/mkhas parat+na ma ti/slob dpon gang ba'i zla ba/'chi med seng ge de yan chad ni bod rnams kyi ngag sgros dag sbyor ba yin cing /de nas paṇa chen la k+ṣi ka ra/shong lo rdo rje rgyal ma'/shong lo blo gros brtan pa/lo wo ma tso sa gosapa'i blo gros/dpang lo blo gros brtan pa/lo r+ṣa byang sa rtse mo/sgra skur nam mkha' bzang po/lo chen thugs rje dpal/dpal lding lo tsā ba grags pa'i mas tso/zha lu chos skyong bzang po/das po pad dkar chos skyong /skyogasaston na me lo tsā ba rin chen bkra shis/dpal khang lo tsā ba dbyangs can snyemasapa'i sde/sgang ra lo tsā ba 'od zer mtshan tso/smon 'gro paṇ+ḍita tshe dbang don grub/'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje/rgyal dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/rnam paṇa dkon mchog chos grags/chab mdo byams pa gling gi mkhas pa kun dga' legs pa/zur mang che tshang sprul sku gsung ra brgya mtsho/bla ma si po che/desapaṇ+ḍita tshe dbang kun khyab la go don dang ri mo lan gsum bstsal zhing /si tu rin po che'i mdun nas kyang tsā spro pa'i sa ris go don dang yos pa/mdzo brjod kyi bstan bcos a ma ra ko ṣa 'grel pa bcas lan gsum bzhir zhib par zhus shing /kā la pa'i go don dka' gnas kyang lan gnyis su legs par zhus pa ste/de ltar kā tsan gnyis char chu bo gcig 'dres kyi brgyud pa ni/zha lu lo r+pā chos skyong bzang po/dbon pad dkar chos skyong /thig pa lo tsā ba spyang 9

ba chena'odasnangalas/ saskya'i dzi+oskung sa bsdus/ ()mo ngag dbang gragasapa/ lo chen dbang phyug zhabs/ lo chen sangasargyasadapal bzang / 'brug pa sangs rgyas rdo rje/ kye re lo chen bstan 'dzin bzang po/ kye re lo chung bkra shisarnam rgyal/ gaḥthog rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu/ kun mkhyen dharmā ka ra/ desarkarma tshe dbang kun khyab la stsal ba'o/ /dam pa 'di nyid kyi 'grel pa bod snga ma dag gis ji bzhin ma mkhyen pa dang / rtsa 'grel gyi 'gyur nor ba sogs kyang dpyad gsum dag pasabacosasnang bsashin tu tshad ma'i yul lo/ /de ltar legs sbyar ut+pa la/ /rol pa'i bstan bcosachu gter che'i/ /rlabs phreng srid 'dir 'phel ba'i tshul/ tshong ngu'i ngag gis 'domasapar byas//zhes pa'ang ngesapa don gyi paṇ+ḍita tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung ji lta bar gud du bkol te bris pas sarba sa man+ta maṅga la bha ban+tu/ saṃ skṛ ta su shasta da gi kā la sarbe khu pra ban+dha kurban+tu/ /dge'o/ /192

pa tshe chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i ma yong sa bsdus/ ()mo ngag dbang grags pa/ lo chen dbang phyug zhabs/ lo chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang / 'brug pa sangs rgyas rdo rje/ kye re lo chen bstan 'dzin bzang po/ kye re lo chung bkra shis rnam rgyal/ gaḥthog rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu/ kun mkhyen dharmā ka ra/ des karma tshe dbang kun khyab la stsal ba'o/ /dam pa 'di nyid kyi 'grel pa bod snga ma dag gis ji bzhin ma mkhyen pa dang / rtsa 'grel gyi 'gyur nor ba sogs kyang dpyad gsum dag pas bcos snang bas shin tu tshad ma'i yul lo/ /de ltar legs sbyar ut+pa la/ /rol pa'i bstan bcos chu gter che'i/ /rlabs phreng srid 'dir 'phel ba'i tshul/ tshong ngu'i ngag gis 'doms par byas//zhes pa'ang nges pa don gyi paṇ+ḍita tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung ji lta bar gud du bkol te bris pas sarba sa man+ta maṅga la bha ban+tu/ saṃ sla ta su shasta da gi kā la sa ze khu pra brgyu kurba skyo/ /dge'o/ /192

༄༅/ /dbus gtsang gi gnas rten rags rim gyi mtshan byang mdor bsdus dad pa'i sa bon zhes bya ba bzhug ba'i so/ /༄༅/ /cha su sti sid+dhi/ grags pa'i dpal ni srid zhi'i bla na mtho/ /thugs rje'i grib mas lus can gdung ba sel/ /yid bzhin 'dod pa 'jo ba'i gdugs dkar po/ /dkon mchog gsum gyis shis pa'i me tog stsol/ /de la 'phags mchog phyag na pa blos sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyong bar mdzad pa'i yul/ gangs ri dpal dang ldan pas bskor ba'i ljongs/ bod chol kha gsum zhes grags pa'i ya rgyal/ dbus gtsang dam pa cho ji/kyi chol kha zhes gangs can 'dzin ma'i rgyan gcig pur gdod nas grub pa'i gnas rten rags rim gyi mtshan byang tsam bkod pa 'di lta ste/ thog mar nga bus la dbu ru dang / g.yo ru gnyis zhes grags pa'i dbu ru byang rgyud du byang rwa sgreng rgyal ba'i dben gnas zhes 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi gdan sa chen po lha shing ljon pa'i dga' tshal du mchod khang khag shin tu mang bar bzhugs pa'i rten gyi gtso bo rdo rje 'chang yab yum gyi ye shes chen po'i thig le las bskrun pa jo bo 'jam pa'i rdo rje 'di phyi'i gsol ba btab tshad 'grub pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ bla ma gser gling pa/ jo bo/ 'brom ston rnams kyi gdung rten sogs sus kyang mjal 193

༄༅/ /dbus gtsang gi gnas rten rags rim gyi mtshan byang mdor bsdus dad pa'i+o sa bon zhes bya ba bsdokyigabashas/ /༄༅/ /chasu sti sid+dhi/ gragasapa'i dpal ni srid zhi'i bla na mtho/ /thugs rje'i grib masalusacan gdung ba sel/ /yid bzhin 'dod pa 'jo ba'i gdugasadakar po/ /dkon mchog gsum gyisashisapa'i me tog stsol/ /de la 'phagasamachog phyag na pad+mos sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongasasu sbyong bar mdzad pa'i yul/ gangasari dpal dang ldan pasabaskor ba'i ljongs/ bod chol kha gsum zhes gragasapa'i ya rgyal/ dbusagatsang dam pa chosakyi chol kha zhes gangasacan 'dzin ma'i rgyan gcig pur gdod nas grub pa'i gnasarten rags rim gyi mtshan byang tsam bkod pa 'di lta ste/ thog mar dbusal dbu ru dang / g.yo ru gnyis zhes grags pa'i dbu ru byang rgyud du byang rwa sgreng rgyal ba'i dben gnas zhes 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi gdan sa chen po lha shing ljon pa'i dga' tshal du mchod khang khag shin tu mang bar bzhugs pa'i rten gyi gtso bo rdo rje 'chang yab yum gyi ye shes chen po'i thig le las bskrun pa jo bo 'jam pa'i rdo rje 'di phyi'i gsol ba btab tshad 'grub pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ bla ma gser gling pa/ jo bo/ 'brom ston rna sdu 3kyi gdung rten sogasasusakyang mjal

'tshe' 'ogasalagags 4ོ2khasagatsos/9)du yod cing /jo bo'i sku 'dra dbu yon ma so+ogs/nga rten rtsaX zlo rna/sa/ brango lozhusanas japa ṣa 'ango /gas 'bram stan bla shango bdu/ /'a chugaseng sna sags gan pa nya skarala'angamajal rgyu snang du yad/ 'ari ltag brag ngas 'dra/'a zhol du yang dgon zhesapar rje spra po chesalam ma brtsamasapa' chog sogs ngo mtshaX ba mang/dgon pam/ོ/phabongathangadu mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes kya phos brang la bde /chog sngagasabazla ba dang bcasagayon bskor du bskor na phyama.o༅rgyayul/ skye ba snogasalung bstaspyi pa yod/bcom lha khang gdong zer ba dedapornyipo dbangasasagand me btsar bgo+os ra grags/de nasagaser nga rgodo ṣ+pe du stag lung pa sangasargyasayar byan gya btsosaganas/ba yang sagasaya//sbyil lta lung thang du snron gsuX rarnyi 'disabasam rgyas khyab pa rten ga bo /ga lung thang pa na po/'a gam ༵ du'adraskugasung byon ma/gtsug lag steng du 'bromaston pa/ sku dbu skra 'al ba sogasango mtshar ba mang du ༵zhugs// 'i'i nasachag la ba:sna nasadabu ru 'phan yul sabaka' gdamasakya ba/nasaXr+shabyungaXnas ṭā+o der sne'u zur pa/potobo/phu chung ba so/r+shapy-i ba' sa gnyan rnams kya gdan samathasdu raklasapa yad na'ang 'ga' sbugatu song snas// sdud dka'/phal 'i shul tsamam gakho+osamed/yangs snagasad bang saganyanasharaba'agadan sprashara'abumapar mchod na byan canamangapodangarte/gla/ thang pa rdo rje seng ge gdan saglang thang du sgrolam gsung byon ma sogasan / slobasacan yod/kun mkhyen rong ston

'tshe' 'od snang lags tshe cho 2khas sa skul/()du yod cing /jo ba'i sku 'dra dbu yon ma sogs nang rten rtsa che ba rnams bla brang la zhugan mjal kha 'ong /gas 'brom ston bla shing bdud rtsi'i chu mig ring mo sogs dgon pa'i nye skor la'ang mjal rgyu mang du yod/de'i ltag brag seng ge 'dra ba'i zhol du yang dgon zhes par rje rin po ches phro rim brtsams pa' chos khri sogs ngo mtshar ba mang /dgon pa'i mdor pha bong thang du mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes kyi pho brang la bde mchog gi sngags bzla ba dang bcasagayon bskor du bskor na phyi ma o rgyan gyi yul du skye ba sogs lung bstan pa yod/bcom lha khang gdong zer ba de dpon po mi dbang sa sa gnad kyi me btsar bzhengs par grags/de nas gser gling rgod tshang du stag lung pa sangasargyas yar byon gyi bzhugs gnas sgrub khang so gos yod/dpal stag lung thang du rten gsum rab stims ba 4 gyis mi khyab pa rten gyi gtso bo stag lung thang pa rin po che'i gzim skyil du 'dra sku gsung byon ma/gtsug lag gi steng du 'brosaston pa'i sku dbu skra 'phel ba sogs ngo mtshar ba mang du bzhugs//de nas chag la brgal nas dbu ru 'phan yul ces bka' gdams kyi bstan pa'i 'byung gnas po der sne'u zur pa/po to ba/phu chung ba sogasadage ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi gdan sa mtha' klas pa yod na'ang 'ga' zhig ri sbug tu song bas rtsad chod dka'/phal cher shul tsam ma gtogos med/yongs grags dge ba'i bshes gnyen sha ra ba'i gdan sa sha ra 'bum par mchod rten byin can mang po dang /glang thang pa rdo rje seng ge'i gdan sa glang thang du sgrol ma gsung byon ma sogs rten byi/ /khas can yod/kun mkhyen rong ston

tso 'khong gi nas rten rag rim gyi mas byang bskung dag ba'i sa 'a zhe byab brtsa so/r+pā pho gdan sa dpal nā len+t+ra ra rong ston gyi sku yang nor bu dbyig tu gyur pas mtshone tshogs/bco bas bla brang /gzimakhang sogs rten gsumabyin tso 4 po dang /rong ston r+ṣa phi chos khri gsabs sa/de nas sgo la brgyud lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang du jo bo yid bzhin nor bu/thugasarje 〉po rang byon lnga ldan/byams pa chos ra/sgrol ma dar po ma/'od zer 'phros pa'i lha bzhi so ges steng shod bar gsum/khor yug dang sa par rten gsum rab 'byams snyed cig bzhugs pa dkar chag rgyal dbang lnga pa rin po mdzad ga ltar/ma rtsa byor mo tsho jo bo mi stso rdo rje/spyan rasagazigs kyi pho brang po ta lar rgyal dbang lnga pa rin po tsho gser gdung 'dzamagling sa r+sāg steng 'og bar gsum nas mjal rgyu yod/a par du bum sto thad ston pa glang tsho skye ba bzhes pa'i sa sogs ngo ma' tso dang /bskalabazang gyo mtsho/ma dpal gyo mtsho/lung rtogs gyo mtsho/tshul khrims rgya mtsho/mkhas grubargya mtsho'i bar gyi gser gdung /jo po lo te ra bzhugs pa'i khang du rje btsun grags pa'i sku 'du mdze thod ma/kha che paṇa chen dzo sku/thang rgyal sku 'ja' r+pā ma/o tso rin po che'i gung thang la kha'i zhabs rjes sogs nang rten khyad par ༅ mang po/shod du chos rgyal srong bsko gzim phug ga yang dus ra dang /gsang kyi 'dus blos slong khang sogs lha khang rab 'byamasamatha' yas pa bzhugs/phal cher rgyun du zhalami byed/phyag na rdo rje'i bla ri lcags po rir grub r+ṣa thang stong tso pos bas pa'i bye ru'i tshe dpag med/dung gi thugs rje r+ṣa po/g.yu yi sgrol ma sogs rten byin ༅ mang du yod/9

tsogayogisaponar07gyisabyangaroXgasaga'agato+osngonigasaso/r+pā pho gdan sadapalan len+d+rar rong ston gya sku sang nor bu dag tu gyur pasaḥbi r+sāsar+sā/d+ku+o bas bla brang //mkhang sogasarten gsumabyin tso 4 podang/ོ༵stona'aphomro+o misarnyisnos/de nasasgo la brgyud lha ldan sprulapa gtsug lag rdzo du jo bo da ba nor bu/sasarje r+pāporajebyon/ldan/byamasapa mosatso+or/sgrolam dar wī ma/'od zer lto+osapalha k+ṣi+oṃsasbyishodabaragasam/khor yug dang casapar skren gsum rab stims snyed ga bas〉pa dpyo dzo hrū das lnga pa ra/pobyimadzad galtar/m+mustorar yo+o ṭ+wā+oṃ be+espyod rdo rje/spyan rasakrigasak+ṣi+oṃbrangapotalar yodabang lnga pa na po d+ku gser gdung 'tshiglang sa ga steng 'og bar gsuswā nasamajal rgyu yod/a par du bum sga' thad ston pa glang tsho skye ba bar+sāpa chasasogasango ma' tso ༵༵ /bskalabazang gyo7/womodapazlo67/lungartogasagyo4/tshul 〈〈/mkhasagrubargya mtsho'i sprar gser gdung /jo bolo te ra btsosapa khang du rje r+ṣa gragasapa / 'du:thodam/khardopaṇas dzosku/thang asku 'ja' r+pā ma/o tso na po gung thang la kha kharnyi rjesasogasanang rten khyad paro ༅ mang po/shod du /ོsargyalasrongabatsun gam phugags yang dusatshor dang /ga4 bos blasaslang khang sagasalha khang rab stimasamatha' yasapa bsas/phal ྾ m+mu du khomi byed/phyag na rdo rje'i bla ri ༷༷/rdo 2bye ri 45 mi/re/rdolcagar+shapo ra grub r+ṣa thang stong rdza posabawosapa' sdo rung dpag med/dung thugasarje r+ṣa po/khi ya sgro~X ma sogasarten byan ༅ mang du yod/

bgechen 'od snangal / saskya'i so thing r+sā bsdus/ ()brag lha klu phug cesachos rgyal srang btsan sgam po'i gzim phug nyisa'aphags pa lce sgom gyi thugs rje chen po'i grub pa thob pa'i gnas der yang rten gsum ci rigs pa yod/ po ta la'i rgyab phyogs 'jam dbyangasakyi bla ri bong ba ri zhes grags pa de yin kyang / rtser lha khang zhig yod pa ni ge sar lha khang yin/ gzhan kun bde gling / rta sa/ bstan rgyasagling / de mo/ tshe smon gling / no mir/ gzhi sde / rwa sgreng / dmar ru rgyud smad/ gsar rnying sogasasu rten gsum rab 'byamasadang / phyogasabazhir chos rgyal dus su bzhengs par grags pa'i rigasagasum mgon po'i rdo lha/ lha sa'i pha rir ka ye shes rgya mtsho'i gdan sagrib tshe mchog gling yod/ /lha sadang nye bar chos sde po 'bras spungs grwa tshang khag bzhi/ tshogs chen dang bcas par rten gsum shin tu mang / gtso bor ngo mtshar che ba rwa lo chen po'i sku gdung bzhugs par grags pa'i 'jigasabyed sku/ dga' ldan pho brang du jo bo rje'i thugs dam sgrol ma gsung 'byon ma sogs nang rten khyad 'phags/ 'bras spungs 'jam dbyangs chosarje'i gzim chung / spar khang du rje rin po che dang / rgyal ba gong 'og gi gsum 'bum sogs spar mang du bzhugs/lha sa'i byang du se ra grwa tshang khag gnyis/ tshogs chen bcas kyi rten gsum mtha' yas pa'i gtso bo/ byes pa grwa tshang gi rten gtso grub thob 'dar 'phyar gyi phur pa/ rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i sku gsung byon ma sogasabazhugs/ spyir se 'bras dga' gsum/ bkra shis lhun po bcas grwa sa chen po bzhi/ rgyud stod smad bcas kyi dkar chag rgyas pa phur bu lcog byams pas mdzad par shin tu 196

brtse chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i sa thing r+sā bsdus/ ()brag lha klu phug ces chos rgyal srang btsan sgam po'i gzim phug phyis 'phags pa lce sgom gyi thugs rje chen po'i grub pa thob pa'i gnas der yang rten gsum ci rigs pa yod/ po ta la'i rgyab phyogs 'jam dbyangs kyi bla ri bong ba ri zhes grags pa de yin kyang / rtser lha khang zhig yod pa ni ge sar lha khang yin/ gzhan kun bde gling / rta gas/ bstan rgyas gling / de mo/ tshe smon gling / no mir/ gzhi sde / rwa sgreng / dmar ru rgyud smad/ gsar rnying sogs su rten gsum rab 'byamasadang / phyogs bzhir chos rgyal dus su bzhengs par grags pa'i rigs gsum mgon po'i rdo lha/ lha sa'i pha rir ka chen ye shes rgya mtsho'i gdan sa grib tshe mchog gling yod/ /lha sa dang nye bar chos sde chen po 'bras spungs grwa tshang khag bzhi/ tshogs chen dang bcas par rten gsum shin tu mang / gtso bor ngo mtshar che ba rwa lo chen po'i sku gdung bzhugs par grags pa'i 'jigs byed sku/ dga' ldan pho brang du jo bo rje'i thugs dam sgrol ma gsung 'byon ma sogs nang rten khyad 'phags/ 'bras spungs 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i gzim chung / spar khang du rje rin po che dang / rgyal ba gong 'og gi gsum 'bum sogs spar mang du bzhugs/lha sa'i byang du se ra grwa tshang khag gnyis/ tshogs chen bcas kyi rten gsum mtha' yas pa'i gtso bo/ byes pa grwa tshang gi rten gtso grub thob 'dar 'phyar gyi phur pa/ rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i sku gsung byon ma sogs bzhugs/ spyir se 'bras dga' gsum/ bkra shis lhun po bcas grwa sa chen po bzhi/ rgyud stod smad bcas kyi dkar chag rgyas pa phur bu lcog byams pas mdzad par shin tu 196

dbusagatsang gi gnasarten ragasarim gyi mtshan byang mdor bsdusadad pa'i sabon zhesabya ba bzhugasaso/gsal/ se ra dang nye ba'i lung pa'i gsham chosargyal srong btsan sgam po'i sgrub gnasapha bong khar sgrub phug dang rten gsum byin can mang du bzhugs/ 'di yul nyer bzhi'i nang tshan de wī ko ṭa gnyis pa yin par grags/ g.yin yang 'brasaspungasadage 'phel ri khrod/ se ra sgrub khang rtse/ phur bu lcog mkhar rdo ri khrod/ chu bzang ri khrod/ brag ri gsar rnying sogasari khrod shin tu mang bar yod/ /lha sa nas gtsang po byang du gyen brgyud/ brag yer zla phug tu o rgyan rin po che'i sku tshab dang / rang byon mang po/ rdo rje phug dril bu phug yer ba'i grub thob brgyad cu'i phug pa/ gtsug lag khang du jo bo'i gsol sder la jo bo rje'i shangs mtshal gyis sku bris pa/ gnas brtan bcu drug gi lha khang zhesabyin can sogs/ 'brom stod du gnyan lo tsā ba'i gzim phug tu mgon po zhal gyi sku khyad par can yod/ gtsang po lho rgyud tshal gung thang thebazhagrags pa bla ma zhad gi gdan sa yin/ mchod rten po dang / mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i mgon khang sogs rten gsum mang / de nas yar phyin pa na 'brog dge ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du rje rin po che'i sku gdung hril pos gtsos rten gsum mtha' yas pa dang / phyi yi skor lam du'ang rang byon mang du ngo bstan rgyu yod/ 'di nas yar phyin pa na la mo chos skyong tshangs pa dung thod can/ rgya ma khri khang / mal gro ska tshal/ dbu ru zhu'i lha khang / 'bri gung rdzong sar/ yang ri dgon/ 'bri gung thil/gzho stod ti sgrom gyi bar gnasarten mang du yod/ bskor na zhag lnga drug dgos/doga' ldan gyi phar phyogs gtsang po byang khar lo sems dpa' chen po'i gdan sa sags yad/ /197

dbus gtsang gi gnas rten rags rim gyi mtshan byang mdor bsdus dad pa'i sa bon zhes bya ba bzhugs so/gsal/ se ra dang nye ba'i lung pa'i gsham chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i sgrub gnas pha bong khar sgrub phug dang rten gsum byin can mang du bzhugs/ 'di yul nyer bzhi'i nang tshan de ri ko ṭa gnyis pa yin par grags/ gzhan yang 'bras spungs dge 'phel ri khrod/ se ra sgrub khang rtse/ phur bu lcog mkhar rdo ri khrod/ chu bzang ri khrod/ brag ri gsar rnying sogs ri khrod shin tu mang bar yod/ /lha sa nas gtsang po byang du gyen brgyud/ brag yer zla phug tu o rgyan rin po che'i sku tshab dang / rang byon mang po/ rdo rje phug dril bu phug yer ba'i grub thob brgyad cu'i phug pa/ gtsug lag khang du jo bo'i gsol sder la jo bo rje'i shangs mtshal gyis sku bris pa/ gnas brtan bcu drug gi lha khang the ltas byin can sogs/ 'brom stod du gnyan lo tsā ba'i gzim phug tu mgon po zhal gyi sku khyad par can yod/ gtsang po lho rgyud tshal gung thang zhes grags pa bla ma zhang gi gdan sa yin/ mchod rten chen po dang / mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i mgon khang sogs rten gsum mang / de nas yar phyin pa na 'brog dge ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du rje rin po che'i sku gdung hril pos gtsos rten gsum mtha' yas pa dang / phyi yi skor lam du'ang rang byon mang du ngo bstan rgyu yod/ 'di nas yar phyin pa na la mo chos skyong tshangs pa dung thod can/ rgya ma khri khang / mal gro ska tshal/ dbu ru zhwa'i lha khang / 'bri gung rdzong sar/ yang ri dgon/ 'bri gung thil/gzho stod ti sgrom gyi bar gnas rten mang du yod/ bskor na zhag lnga drug dgos/dga' ldan gyi phar phyogs gtsang po byang khar lo sems dpa' chen po'i gdan sa sogs yod/ /197

brtse rna'ogasnangalags 'i 4ོ ga()dga' ldananasal/rgyabaldanasaphyin nalo'abe+ero'i/bganasab4/sagaya' malungadub/phyir sgrub phug dang o /sku chos chu sogasnayod/ nasasngasamago brgyud ma/ na pa na bsam yas ltag tu mosargyal srong sku lusasasabrag dmar man bzang du lha khang dang rten gsabye bcasazlongosastung btsos/bskeyasamro+ophyo+or r+ṣa por da/ rtsemagasum gling ba nga phran/a'iltagarnyi+ogadapotralcogamamowa rten ba/rgyab tu jo mo nga gsum sogasarnyilacher dkarā go ragasam pad+ma bka' thacho du gsal ba ltar rten gtsobodabu:khangajobornyingachubachenapo/de kagadong g.yas/yon ñcā mosahrū mesarnyig ༅ thugasadam rten thub pa/mkha/ r+ṣa dī+o 'i sa dbu thod bumal/ba4 yasardzong du ma~X' bdag tonapokyi gter byon gu ru mtsho skyesardo rje zhes/bdapon sku tshab thamasago matso tu gyuje pa de dang/gungathang la khasarwazloṭ+wāṃngo/'a ༅sogasayod/grigarnyipo rdoralhabasarnying /bsamayas nga sang nasagatso+o bo rto mono nga de na/der rte/ gtso ṭ+wā+o 'phagar+shapa bye'isanyad ngalabs//ja masgralamo/sgyu 'phruladru ba lugs rta man sku gsung mang du 95byan pa sag/snyiX/da// kyi zebasam zlosam samuzloganas lte bar zlog dasdu/ ke'u tsha du ro dz+nyo na dang /tha maṭ+wā+oṃn brtson phyag bzo.o rgyan na po byi sku bye mas krong /sror+sha lde+o'u bawo thugs/ma snam so+ogasorten gsumo ṭ+wāṃ ༅ dang /sgrub phug thad du bka' brgyad dal ༵༵ra sagasarang byan rnam pa/mdun

brtse chen 'od pa gas 'a chos ga(0/dga' ldan nas la brgyabs nas phyin na lo chen be+e ro'i sgrub gnasabasam yas g.ya' ma lung du sleb/der sgrub phug dang o gyo5 tshang tshe chu sogasayod/de nas sngas mgo brgyud mar phyin pa na bsam yas kyi ltag tu chos rgyal khri srong sku ngas sa brag dmar mgrin bzang du lha khang dang rten gsar bzhengasadangos gtsang bzhugs/bsam yas chos 'khor r+ṣa por dbu rtse rim gsum gling bzhi gling phran/ak+ṣa ltag 'og dpe hra lcog mcho ne rten bzhi/rgyab tu jo mo gling gsum sogs phal cher gyi dkar chag rags rim pad+ma bka' thang du gsal ba ltar rten gyi gtso bo dbu rtse'i khang jo bo byang tso r+ṣa po/de'i kagadong g.yas g.yon du chos rgyal mes a ga tshomi can gyi thugs dam rten thub pa/mkhan r+ṣa bo dhī gtso dbu thod bum ril/bsam yas rdzong du mnga' bdag to rin po tsho ga kho byon gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje zhes slob dpon gyi sku dzo thams cad kyi mchog tu gyur pa de dang /gung thang la kha'i zhabs rjes ngo mtshar can sogs yod/has po ri rtser lha bsang khang /bsam yas kyi gling gi nang nas gtso bo rta mgrin gling de yin/der rten gyi gtso bo 'phags pa sems nyid ngal bso//jo mo sgrol ma/sgyu snyul dru ba'i lugs kyi rta mgrin gyi sku gsung mang du 'byon pa sogs yod//bsam yas mchims phur gnas kyi lte bar brag dmar ke'u tshang du be+e ro tsa na dang /tha mi mgon brtson gyi phyag bzo.o rgyan rin po che'i sku bye mas krong /khri srong lde'u btsan gyi thugs dam 'bum sogs rten gsum byin can dang /sgrub phug gi thod du bka' brgyad kyi dkyil ༵༵ra sogs rang byon gyi rnam pa/mdun

bu g.yogisabarten rags77gas ༅phodos0dgayothobo khobyab gsasaso/du lha lcam pad+ma gsalagyi sku gdung bas pa'i rjes/steng du be+e sne sgrub phug1detsho mi /|/ r+sār /reshān /rtse/ 8)rdobacasazlod/ 'a dzinas dbu rtsar blan 'i gur dkar phug rdzu / spya na po bye 'aXsanyar lnga dang bamasapa' sgrub phu/ sdud kyang sdu gshel tshor satsamayan/brag dmar ke'u tsha gzhamadu rgyalagam rdi/mas0gā sgrub phusdu/nga zlog ganga'ag tu /gsapa/klusal khyung phu/kun lhan klang pa godung 'bum/dan rtsar rgyalab mas dbyangs rta marnyi sgrub phug sagasayad//dir /4 yasaphyogasa'arjo g.yo ru byaX rma cesagrags/g.yo bo gyen ded du snron pa na zur ma~X mgo+o rten ragasalnga ོ༵ ma' che zlo/de nasasgrags/mdarayeshesa'i rgyalasku gasdongs bla ma/sgrags nang gnas kya ga bo yongasardzong yi/ rjeci rol pa' pho brang du sgrub phug po ste/ shod/gnasasgo gsar pa rnamasarin nga /'gas yang grub me long rdo rje sgrub gnasangaraphuga.o ༅ na rnyi+o d+ku phug dzo+ong kham phugamakhar r+ṣa gragasasdu+o/samangaduyodushe/sgrags mdas sgragasagrong mo che zhesapa de skrubs snangs rgyasaya saḥngs yan/sgragasamasnrunas/zlopo rgyan brgyud du maparathubaba'irdorjesdig/ṭ+wāṃ dang nye bar nga ༷sa sgrub gnas ṅgi solung rdo rje k+ṣiṃ zhusayar phyan pa yor stod brag lo' 'og dzi lu+ong pa ṣ+ṭha ga sang snge /ra gya gdan sani dgas ṅgi/yarastad/gala' stad du panāta ba bhū tso gad/ gas/ngasranganapar 'i gragasapa nga sang grong nag yan kyang /lha khang phu/ tu bde mchog ga sku sngar bar snang du

bu tshing gi gnas rten rags rim gyi ya ༅༄dor bsdu dag wa lon zhes bya ba bas so/du lha lcam pad+ma gsal gyi sku gdung bzhag pa'i rjes/steng du be+e ro'i sgrub phugatsobod/de'i gnas kyi dbu rtser blon wo gur dkar phug ces o ༅ rin po che rje 'bangs nyer lnga dang bcas pa' sgrub phug yod kyang nyin gcig la lubor tsam yin/brag dmar ke'u tshang gzham du mtsho rgyal gzim phug chosargyal gyi sgrub phug cang phug gong 'og tu grags pa/klu 'dul khyung chen phugakun mkhyen klong chen pa'i gdung 'bum/dben rtsar rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyi rta mgrin sgrub phug sogs yod//spyir bsam yas phyogs 'dir g.yo ru byang rgyud ces grags/gtsang bo gyen ded du phyin pa na zur mkhar rdo'i mar rten rigs lnga ngo ma' che bde nas sgrags kyi mdar ye shes mtsho rgyal sku 'khrungs bla mtsho/sgrags kyi nang gnas kyi gtso bo yongs rdzong skyon rje rol pa'i pho brang du sgrub phug ོ po steng shod/gnas sgo gsar pa rnams yin cing /gas yang grub ོ me long rdo rje'i sgrub gnasang ra phug o ༅ rin po che'i phug rdzong kham phug mkhar r+ṣa grags sogs mang du yod/sgrags kyi mda' sgrags grong mo che zhes pa de gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes 'khrungs yin/sgrags mda' nas gtsang po gyen brgyud du rim par thub bstan rdo rje brag/de dang nye bar gling ras kyi sgrub gnas sna phu chos lung rdo rje brag nas yar phyin pa'i yar stod brag la'i 'og tsam lung pa zhig gi nang du rmor r+ṣa gyi gdan sa rmor dgon pa/yar stod brag la'i stod du paṇ+ḍita bi bhū khi gdan sa drang srong srin po ri spyo grags pa deng sang grong nag yin kyang /lha khang zhig gi phug tu bde mchog gi sku sngar bar snang du 99

'tshe 'od pal / samu mo yang tso bsdus/ ()bzhugs pa gsung yang yang 'byon pa shin tu byin rlabs che ba bzhugs/ /bsam yasamachimasaphu'i rgyab kyi lung pa glo bo don steng gi phur mchod rten bkra shisa'od 'bar du grags pa'i byin rlabasacan de yod/ de nasamar phyin pa na rdo lung pa dang 'on lung pa sogs su rje rin che'i bzhugs gnas bkra shisardo kha dang / 'on kyi lha khang ke ru zhesakhri srong gi dus su bzhengasapa/ mchod rten dkar chung / 'on rgyal srasarin po che'i gdan sachos ldings/ 'on phu stag tshang sogs yod kyang bskor na zhag gnyisagasum dgos/ de nas mar phyin pa na lam bar du mnga' risadwagasapo grwa tshang dang / yongasagragasakyi gnas chen 'gro mgon phag mo gru pa'i gdan samathil zhes grags pa de yod cing / spyir rten gsum gyisami khyab pa dang / khyad par rten gyi gtso bo phag gru'i 'jags spyil du sku 'dra byis drod ma zhes gsung 'byon byin rlabasacan de yod/ de'i 'og tu zangs ri mkhar dmar zhes ma gcig lab sgron gyi gdan sa gcig yum sras kyi sku gsung byon ma sogasabazhugagashing / 'di nas shar du zhag gnyisagasum gyi sar 'ol kha stag rtse'i phyogasasu rdzing phyi'i byams pa/ o rgyan rin po che'i sgrub gnasa'agal phug rje rin po che'i sgrub gnasashin tu mang ba/ de nasadwags po'i phyogs su dwagasal sgam po dang / khra mo brag sogasaganasakhyad par can mang / 'ol dwags gnyisakyi mtshamasasu rgyal me tog thang zhes rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i gdan sa dang / rtser dmag zor ma'i bla mtsho mthong snang sna tshogasayod tshul sogasamang du yod/ dwagasapo'i sa cha zad mtshams nyang long kong gsum/ de nas spo bo bcasarim par yod cing / spo bo zad mtshams glo 200

chen 'od pal / sa tsho ma yang tso bsdus/ ()bzhugs pa gsung yang yang 'byon pa shin tu byin rlabs che ba bzhugs/ /bsam yas mchims phu'i rgyab kyi lung pa glo bo don steng gi phur mchod rten bkra shis 'od 'bar du grags pa'i byin rlabs can de yod/ de nas mar phyin pa na rdo lung pa dang 'on lung pa sogs su rje rin che'i bzhugs gnas bkra shis rdo kha dang / 'on kyi lha khang ke ru zhes khri srong gi dus su bzhengs pa/ mchod rten dkar chung / 'on rgyal sras ran po che'i gdan sa chas ldings/ 'on phu stag tshang sogs yod kyang bskor na zhag gnyis gsum dgos/ de nas mar phyin pa na lam bar du mnga' ris dwags po grwa tshang dang / yongs grags kyi gnas chen 'gro mgon phag mo gru pa'i gdan sa mthil zhes grags pa de yod cing / spyir rten gsum gyis mi khyab pa dang / khyad par rten gyi gtso bo phag gru'i 'jags spyil du sku 'dra byis drod ma zhes gsung 'byon byin rlabs can de yod/ de'i 'og tu zangs ri mkhar dmar zhes ma gcig lab sgron gyi gdan sa gcig yum sras kyi sku gsung byon ma sogs bzhugs shing / 'di nas shar du zhag gnyis gsum gyi sar 'ol kha stag rtse'i phyogs su rdzing phyi'i byams pa/ o rgyan rin po che'i sgrub gnas 'gal phug rje rin po che'i sgrub gnas shin tu mang ba/ de nasadwags po'i phyogs su dwags la sgam po dang / khra mo brag sogs gnas khyad par can mang / 'ol dwags gnyis kyi mtshams su rgyal me tog thang zhes rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i gdan sa dang / rtser dmag zor ma'i bla mtsho mthong snang sna tshogs yod tshul sogs mang du yod/ dwags po'i sa cha zad mtshams nyang long kong gsum/ de nas spo bo bcas ma par yod cing / spo bo zad mtshams glo 200

dbusagatsung gi gnasarten ragasarim gyi mtshan byang mdor bsdu dad pa'i sabon zhesabya ba bzhugasaso/dang thug skad/ spu kong gi shar du khyung po dang / de nasarim par ri bo che dang /nang chen sogs yin/zangasari mkhar dmar nas phar ko ba las don nasartse thang du thon/'dir dgon pa 'ga' re yod kyang lnga mchod pa'i 'du khang phug thub pa gser gling ma sogasarten khyad par can mjal rgyu dang / rtse thang gi ri sgang zhig tu bsam gtan gling zhesagrags pa sngon bla ma dam pa bsod namasargyal ma /yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod namasargyal mchog sogs sa skya'i snyan brgyud 'dzin pa rnams kyi sgrub gnasader mgon po byin rlabs can sogasabazhugs/ rtse thang gi rgyab ri de zo dang gangasapo ri zhesaspyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa sprel sgom byang chub sems dpa' sgrub gnas de yin par gragasashing bskor ba byed mkhan yang mang / rtse thang gi ltag tsam du sne gdung kun bzang rtse zhes pa de sngar bod khri skor phal cher gyi bdag po sde srid phag mo gru pa'i dzo+ong shul yin cing / 'di'i zhol sne gdong rtse tshogasapar/ba che paṇa r+ṣa gyi rdza sku gsung byon ma/ sgrol dkar bris sku me rdug ma/ 'bum gyi rgya dpe sogs nang rten khyad par can mang po yod/ spyir kha che paṇa chen gyi tshogs sde bzhi zhesapa ni sne'u gdong rtse tshogs pa/ grwa phyi tshong 'dusatshogasapa/ grwa nang rgyal gling tshogasapa/ gtsang cho lung tshogs pa rnamasayin pasade thamasacad kyi nang rten du paṇa chen gyi rdza sku dang / lhung bzed sogasarten khyad par can yod skad/ /yang klung rten gsum gnas gsum du gragasapa'i gsan gsum ni khra 'brug shel brag 'ga' zhig gisarasachung phug yin zer na'ang yum bu gla 201

dbus gtsang gi gnas rten rags rim gyi mtshan byang mdor bsdu dad pa'i sa bon zhes bya ba bzhugs so/dang thug skad/ spu kong gi shar du khyung po dang / de nas rim par ri bo che dang /nang chen sogs yin/zangs ri mkhar dmar nas phar ko ba las don nas rtse thang du thon/'dir dgon pa 'ga' re yod kyang lnga mchod pa'i 'du khang phug thub pa gser gling ma sogs rten khyad par can mjal rgyu dang / rtse thang gi ri sgang zhig tu bsam gtan gling zhes grags pa sngon bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mchog sogs sa skya'i snyan brgyud 'dzin pa rnams kyi sgrub gnas der mgon po byin rlabs can sogs bzhugs/ rtse thang gi rgyab ri de zo dang gangs po ri zhes spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa sprel sgom byang chub sems dpa' sgrub gnas de yin par grags shing bskor ba byed mkhan yang mang / rtse thang gi ltag tsam du sne gdung kun bzang rtse zhes pa de sngar bod khri skor phal cher gyi bdag po sde srid phag mo gru pa'i rdzong shul yin cing / 'di'i zhol sne gdong rtse tshogs par/ba che paṇa kho gyi rdza sku gsung byon ma/ sgrol dkar bris sku me rdug ma/ 'bum gyi rgya dpe sogs nang rten khyad par can mang po yod/ spyir kha che paṇa chen gyi tshogs sde bzhi zhesapa ni sne'u gdong rtse tshogs pa/ grwa phyi tshong sa tshogos pa/ grwa nang rgyal gling tshogs pa/ gtsang cho lung tshogs pa rnams yin pas de thams cad kyi nang rten du paṇa chen gyi rdza sku dang / lhung bzed sogs rten khyad par can yod skad/ /yang klung rten gsum gnas gsum du grags pa'i gsan gsum ni khra 'brug shel brag 'ga' zhig gis ras chung phug yin zer na'ang yum bu gla 201

brtse ga 'od khas 'a gas 'a cho mor/sgang la ngos bzung ba yid pa sa dang /rten gsum ni rtag spyan 'bum pa/dgon thang 'bum pa/tshe chu 'bum pa bcas su grags pa las/rtsed thang nasayar klung khor gyen ded du phyin pa na dpal g.yu ru khra 'brug ba po shis byamasasnyoms kyi gas lag khang du rten gyi gtso bo chos rgyal srong bsko sgam pos zo dang gangs po ri nas spyan drangs pa'i rgyal ba rigs lnga'i rdo sku/sgrol ma zhal zas ma/ma ṇi drug sogs kyis mtsho ni/lha khang khag mang gdang/phyi roladu sdig sbyong mar rten dbu lnga ma sogs byin rlabs can yod/khra 'brug lha khang dang nye bar rnam rgyal lha khang zhes pa rje rin po tsho bsnyen rdzogs bsgrub sa de yin/khra 'brug nas gyen du phyin pa na sa skya paṇ+ḍita'i gtam snyan bzhugs khri zhes pa dang /chos rgyal tho tho ri gto bsko gyi pho brang yum bu bla mkhar du jo bo nor bu bsam 'phel/thugs dam gnyan po gsang ba sogs bzhugs/de nas lha khang gnyan rur sman pa'i rgyal po'i sku gter byon khyad 'phags/bga' gdams pa'i dge bshes skor chen pos bzhengs pa/byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu'i spyan g.yon pa bzhugs par grags pa'i rtag spyan 'bum pa/'di'i phur yar lha sham po gangs kyis ra ba zhes 'brog mi dpal gyi ye shes kyis ma mo sgrub pa'i gnas sogs yod/spyir yang klung gi sto phyogs lho kha stod smad du e yul rig pa'i 'byung gnas/gnyal/lo ro/gro shul/byar/de nas rim par tsā ri sogs kong por 'brel/gong gi rta spyan 'bum pa nas mar 'ong sar mas stobs kyi dbang phyug gas nu blo gros kyi gdan sa bkra shis chos sde/rasachung pa'i rnam 'phrul gtsang spyon he ru po/ gdan sa ras chung phug sogs su rten

ba tshega'ogasnangalags 'a cho mor/sgango langosabang bzlod pa yosadang /rten gsum ni rtag sprun tsomapa/dganathangala~Xpade/ rnyitshomapasasasugragasapalas/rtsa/ thanganasayaraklu kharanadadunapa//rtolagakuru khra 'brug baposabyamasasnyoms gaX lag khang du rten 'i bo swā+or+shargyalaṭ+wā+oṃng bsko sgom posazo dang gangasarnyi nasasbyanodrangasnrupasdurnob gsalnga rgasku/sgral/khi+o zaXm/yol/drugasags byi/lha khang khag mang gdang/ raladu sdag sbyang mgo na dbu lnga /sdu gar+sharin tso+osgroca/ yad/lngaḥgalha kha/ dung nya bar rnamargyalalhakhang byib na pa ṇ+ḍita /na dzogasabasgrub sakhri yan/khra 'bruganasagyen du rin pa nasaskya ༵ gtam snyan bzhugs zhe+osapa dang /mosashālatho tho gto btsan pho brang yumo bubla mkhar du sdo ba nar bu ba4'al/thugaspradam /sdu pa k+ta4ོ ba sagasabatsos/ nasalhakhang 'gadhi sna sman pa ༵lapa / /ra byan khyad 'pha/sa/btso gdamasa~X'ad saskar pasab dīpa/byang chub masad// rtag tu ngu spyan g.yan pa ba/gsapar gragasapami rtag smyarnyi tsomapa/kyi' phu+orayaraX shamapogangasasarnyi ba zhesa'abro/ dpol yeshesasam ༵ sgrub rnyi' ga)sasagasayad/ ra yang klu+ong hrū+o phyagasalha kha/da sma/ du yul rig pa'a'abyungaganaswā/gaXg/gilar/spashul/byar/ nasam par tsā sopasakongapora'al/gang/ spyan 'bum pa /samar 'ong sar mthustozlosakya dbang phyug gtī+o sna blo trī+os gdan sabakrasamosasde//sachung pa' rnam 'phrul gtsang smyon ru 0 gdan sa rasachung phug sogasasu na

bu gang gyisatson ragasarimagyi ma' byangaro+osasdud 'irabon bya ngabatsosaso/gsum rabastims/dgunathangatsomamotshesaXrir+sādatshomapa4ne ṭ+wāṃ tsom pa zhesagragasaX rnamasadang /byang phyogs rgyud du yar klung shezlo brag phug tu gragasapa' rdza spyinasar+sā por sgrub :ga lte bar o tso sku ṣ+ṭha gsung byonas/4byan rnamarnomangaṭ+wā+oṃ/de 'ogatums /glo lha khang /gnasamal bla brang du o /ji gan po sku tshab/chosagos1zer ma/phyag tshor sogasanang rten 'ga' yod/phyag 'tshalalakhar dur sbyi+o khyad paracanamaho+orten dang zlo sapabatsos/gswānyeṭ+wā+oṃgasasumargyal gsang phug dang /g.yon rgyab phyogasasu rdzu+o rgyan nga pa gter gnasapad+ma shesaphug tu grag pa sogazloyod /nga thag nga /shelabrag nasamar bab sar btsan thang g.yu lha khang srong yum ngang tshul byang chub rgyal mosabazhengasapa dang /de dang nye bar cog ro tshe chu tsom pa zhesatshesad+ku+o lnga'i skabasatshe chu dngosasu wob pa yod/'di'i rgyab ri bzhi thang lha ri sgo bzhi khopa'i rtse mor bod mosasto gtso khribazhi pobyeng po brnyi sade yin/gong gi gung thang wī+om pa nasa'aphyongasargyosaphyogasasunapan rotsa nabazhugasakāsba gor dgan dang /sgrub phugaragapa rtsashasaXḍikha~X yad kyang susargyusa'id pasamadul mkhanadakona'adugadenasaya/napalamakhar dge ba bshesaganya/ khu ston brtson yasarnying drung gdan sasol na/ thabye po cher tsom nag la pa ༅ sogasarten nga mang yam̐ dang /jo bo rje gam phug tu 'dra sku byin tso/mkhasagrub dge legasadapalabazang gi slob ma nyi khri 'dzin pa blo //// /lnga// 11// //ṭī/grosadapal bzang sabato pa sngu+ongasargyas bo bde r+pā mosagrwar

bu g.yo gis rten rags rig gyi mas byang mdor bsdus da 'i sgo bon zhes bya ngabs so/gsum rab mas/dgun thang 'bum mo che'am sri gcod 'bum pa'am ne tso 'bum pa zhes grags pa rnams dang /byang phyogs kyi ri rgyud du yar klung shel gyi brag phug tu grags pa'i sgrub gnas chen por sgrub phug lte bar o rgyan gyi sku ra gsung byon ma/sa byon gyi rnam pa mang po/de'i 'og tu mas bas lha khang /gnas mthil bla brang du o ༅ rin po tsho sku tha/chos gos nyi zer ma/phyag 'khar sogs nang rten 'ga' zhig yod/phyag 'tshal la khar dur khrod khyad par can mar rten dang yos pa bzhugs/gas nye phyogs su mtsho rgyal gsang phug dang /g.yon gyi rgyab phyogs su o rgyan gling pa'i gter gnas pad+ma shes phug tu grags pa sogs yod kyang thag ring /shel brag nas mar bab sar btsan thang g.yu yi lha khang khri srong gi yum ngang tshul byang chub rgyal mos bzhengasapa dang /de dang nye bar cog ro tshe chu tsom pa zhes tshes bco lnga'i skabs tshe chu dngos su wob pa yod/'di'i rgyab ri bsko thang lha ri sgo bzhi zhes pa'i rtse mor bod chos sto gtso khri bsko po dang po bab sa de yin/gong gi gung thang stim pa nasangs rgyas phyogs su phyin pa na be+e ro tsa na bzhugs sa spa gor dgon dang /sgrub phug rog pa rtsa so gos la mkhar bod kyang sus rgyus med pasamajal mkhan dkon 'dug de nas yar phyin pa'i lam khar dge ba'i bshesaganyen khu ston brtson sa g.yung drung gi gdan sa sol nag thang po cher 'bum nag zil pa ༅ sogs rten rnying mang yam̐ dang /jo bo rje'i gzim phug tu 'dra sku byin can/mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang gi slob ma nyi khri 'dzin pa blo da sna 8) :/sa tsho rnga nge shā tsho thesno bye nge rwa ska/)sa mgras dpal bzang sa btab pa 2 0 3 ba ba chas grwar

ba chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chos༅nga gces bsdus/ ()rten gsum byin can mang du bzhugs/ 'di dang nye ba'i 'phying bar stag rtse zhesapa'i rdzong de sngon za hor gyi gdung rigs rim byon 'phyongs rgyas sde par gragasapa'i pho brang / phyis rgyal dbang lnga pa rin po che sku 'khrungs sa yan/ 'di'i ltag tsam du chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i sku spur gyi 'dra brnyan bzhugs pa bang so dmar por grags pa de yod/ bang so dngos ni sa 'bur gyi rnam pa de yin/ de'i steng du nyang sman lung pas bzhengs pa'i mchod khang dang rten gsum byin chen yod/ de dang nye ba'i don mkhar lung pa'i phur kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa'i gdan sa tshe ring ljongs su kun mkhyen gyi sku gdung ril por bzhugs pa'i mchod rten dang rten gsum khyad par can yod/ 'phyongs rgyas srong btsan bang so'i ltag tsam du be+e ro'i rnam 'phrul 'phreng po gter chen shes rab 'od zer gyi gdan sangs rgyas dpal ri zhes pa de yod/ sngar rdor smin dpal ri zhes rnying ma'i grwa sa che shos yin kyang deng sang dpal ri dgon ming ma stong tsam las med/ gu ru rin po che'i sku tshab sogs rten gsum byin rlabs che ba yod/ spyir 'di phyogs su 'gos lo gzhen nu dpal grwa sar zhugs pa spyan g.yas lha khang yod pa'i lung pa spyan g.yas dang / gzhan yang 'phyos dang phu lung sogs lung lag mang du yod/ gong gsal bsam yas/ rta mgrin gling / sku tshab mtsho skyesardo rje zhabs rjes dang bcas pa/ mchims phu/ mchod rten bkra shis 'od 'bar/'phyongs rgyas srong btsan bang so/ dpal ri/ tshe ring ljongs rnams kyi gnas bshad zhib cha mkhyen brtse rin po che'i gtam tshogs su yod/ gzhan nga gtam tshogs su gzho dze stod ti sgro/ dbu ru'i zhu'i lha khang / lho mon dkar po zangs 204

'tshe' 'odasnangal / saskya'i som༅pañca bsdus/ ()rten gsum byin can mang du bzhugs/ 'di dang nye ba'i 'phying bar stag rtse zhesapa'i rdzong de sngon za hor gyi gdung rigs rim byon 'phyongs rgyas sde par gragasapa'i pho brang / phyisargyal dbang lnga pa rin po che sku 'khrungasasayin/ 'di'i ltag tsam du chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i sku spur gyi 'dra brnyan bzhugasapa bang so dmar por grags pa de yod/ bang so dngos ni sa 'bur gyi rnam pa de yin/ de'i steng du nyang sman lung pas bzhengs pa'i mchod khang dang rten gsum byin chen yod/ de dang nye ba'i don mkhar lung pa'i phur kun mkhyen 'jigasamed gling pa'i gdan sa tshe ring ljongasasu kun mkhyen gyi sku gdung ril por bzhugs pa'i mchod rten dang rten gsum khyad par can yod/ 'phyongs rgyasasrong btsan bang so'i ltag tsam du be+e ro'i rnam 'phrul 'phreng po gter chen shes rab 'od zer gyi gdan sa'aphyongasargyas dpal ri zhesapa de yod/ sngar rdor smin dpal ri zhes rnying ma'i grwa sa che shas yin kyang deng sang dpal ri dgon ming ma stong tsam las med/ gu ru rin po che'i sku tshab sogs rten gsum byin rlabasache ba yod/ spyir 'di phyogs su 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal grwa sar zhugs pa spyan g.yas lha khang yod pa'i lung pa spyan g.yas dang / gzhan yang 'phyos dang phu lung sogs lung lag mang du yod/ gong gsal bsam yas/ rta mgrin gling / sku tshab mtsho skyesardo rje zhabasarjes dang bcasapa/ mchims phu/ mchod rten bkra shisa'od 'bar/'phyongs rgyas srong btsan bang so/ dpal ri/ tshe ring ljongasarnams kyi gnas bshad zhib cha mkhyen brtse rin po che'i gtam tshogs su yod/ gzhan nga gtam tshogs su gzho —stod ti sgro/ dbu ru'i zhwa'i lha khang / lho mon dkar po zangs 204

busagatsang gaganasarten ragasarim gyi mtshan byang mdor bsdusadad pa' sabon zhesabya ba bzhugagaso/sogasakyi gnasabashad kyang snang /rtsed thang nasagatsang po lho rgyud skor la spyir dbu ru lho rgyud cesagrags/de'ang gtsang po gyen ded du phyin pa na bya salha khang zhes gragasapa chosargyal dpal 'khor btsan gyisabazhengasapa'i rnam snang sku chen po / de nas rim par bying gi phur o rgyan rin po che'i sgrub gnasabying mda' o dkar brag/grwa phyi'i mdor tshong dusatshogasapa zhesadagon zhig tu paṇa chen gyi rdza sku dang /mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor gyi thugasaring bsrel gyi phungapo sogasanang rten khyad par can yod/de'i phur o rgyan smin grol gling grwa tshang dang bla brang gnyisasu lha khang dang rten gsum dngosagatsang byin can mang po dang /ga/tso bor gter chen rin po che'i sku gdung sogasabazhugs/tshong dus sapa nasagatsang po'i rgyud gyen ded du phyin pa'i sar grwa nang lung pa'i mda' gter ston grwa pa mngon shesakyi gdan sagrwa dang /de nasarim par paṇa chen byamasapa gling pa'i gdan sa sku 'bum mthong grol chen mo'i nang lha khang shin tu dngosagatsang can/'di dang nye bar kun mkhyen klong chen pa zhabrungasasadang /u rgyan gling pa'i gdan sayar rje lha khang /grwa nang brgyad gling tshogasapa/grwa g.yu sgang bragasmin gling gdan sarnying pa dar rgyasachosagling /'brug pa'i chosalugs/grwa sdingasapo che sogasayod/de nasagatsang po gyen ded du phyin pa na rnam rab kyi phur salugasadwagasapo grwa tshang /de dang nye bar rngog mosasku rdo rje'i gdan sagazhung spre zhing du mar pa lo tswa'i sku gdung bzhugasapa'i mchod rten/lha mo dud sol ma gsung byon/mi ladang rngog ston mjalas/rngogaston mkha' spyod du gshegasasasogasayod/de nasarim sdur gtsangapo gyen brgyud na thub bstan ra

bus gtsang gi gnas rten rags rim gyi mtshan byang mdor bsdus dad pa' sa bon zhes bya ba bzhugs so/sogs kyi gnas bshad kyang snang /rtsed thang nas gtsang po lho rgyud skor la spyir dbu ru lho rgyud ces grags/de'ang gtsang po gyen ded du phyin pa na bya sa lha khang zhes grags pa chos rgyal dpal 'khor btsan gyis bzhengs pa'i rnam snang sku chen po / de nas rim par bying gi phur o rgyan rin po che'i sgrub gnas bying mda' o dkar brag/grwa phyi'i mdor tshong dus tshogs pa zhes dgon zhig tu paṇa chen gyi rdza sku dang /mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor gyi thugs ring bsrel gyi phung po sogs nang rten khyad par can yod/de'i phur o rgyan smin grol gling grwa tshang dang bla brang gnyis su lha khang dang rten gsum dngos gtsang byin can mang po dang /ga/tso bor gter chen rin po che'i sku gdung sogs bzhugs/tshong dus tshogis pa nas gtsang po'i rgyud gyen ded du phyin pa'i sar grwa nang lung pa'i mda' gter ston grwa pa mngon shes kyi gdan sa grwa dang /de nas rim par paṇa chen byams pa gling pa'i gdan sa sku 'bum mthong grol chen mo'i nang lha khang shin tu dngosagatsang can/'di dang nye bar kun mkhyen klong chen pa 'khrungs sa dang /u rgyan gling pa'i gdan sa yar rje lha khang /grwa nang brgyad gling tsho gos pa/grwa g.yu sgang brag smin gling gdan sa rnying pa dar rgyas chos gling /'brug pa'i chos lugs/grwa sdings po che sogs yod/de nas gtsang po gyen ded du phyin pa na rnam rab kyi phur sa lugs dwags po grwa tshang /de dang nye bar rngog chos sku rdo rje'i gdan sagazhung spre zhing du mar pa lo tswa'i sku gdung bzhugs pa mchod rten/lha mo dud sol ma gsung byon/mi la dang rngog ston mjalas/rngog ston mkha' spyod du gshegs sa sogs yod/de nas rim par gtsang po gyen brgyud na thub bstan ra 20

dbus gtsang gi gnas rten rags rim gyi mtshan byang mdor bsdus dad pa'i ga bon zhes bya ba bzhugs so/rnam 'phrul grub chen kun dga' blo gros sogs kyi bzhugs gnas de yod/rgyal rtse khog 'di la nyang gser gzhung ring mo zhes grags/ nyang chu lho phyogs su mtha' 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang gi gras sdo/ grags pa rtsis gnas gsar lha khang du yum chen mo'i sku bzhugs pa/ byang khar dge ldan pa'i dgon pa tshogs sde bzhi'i gras su rtsi ba'i nyang stod spos khang / 'di la kha che paṇa chen dus kya nang rten mang du yod skad/ pa rnam nas chu phar phyogs brgyud na bu ston rin po che'i gdan sa zha lur sleb/ zha lu mthil du rang byon thugs rje chen po sogs rten gsum mang / ri sbug tu bu ston rin po che nga 'dra ba dang / yum gyi dgongasasna rdzags la bzhengs pa'i mchad rten mthong grol chen mo sogs dang / khyad par birnya pa'i dbang bum bum chu bcas/ bu ston rin po che'i sku'i nyer spyod sogs nang rten 'ga' yod na'ang gzhis ka rtse'i dam 'byar yin/ zha lu mthil gyi 'og tu nyang smad rgyan gong du lha mo rab brtan ma'i mgon khang byin can yod/ 'dir chos rje sa paṇa bsnyen rdzogs sgrub sa yin pas/ dbu skra 'khru snod rdo ga 'ad byin can yod pa'i khrus chu 'thungs na shes rab chen po 'ong skad/ zha lu dang nye ba'i la rgyab tu thar pa lo tsā ba'i gdan sa thar pa dgon yod/ kha che paṇa chen rin po che'i gsol lhung sogs sngar nang rten mang du yod skad/pa rnam nas gzhung lam brgyud phyin na nyin gcig tsam gyis gzhis ka rtser sleb/ 'di'i bar du zur gsang sngags gling zhes grong pa zhig yod/ sngar rnying ma bka' ma'i dgon pa che shos yin/ deng sang zur gyi gdung brgyud bzhugs pa'i bla brang 'dra ba der zur pa'i bla ma grub chen gong ma rnams kyi 209
