brtse na 'od snang gas ji cho /()nye) rwa ni /) bye rdo sa ma :sgo ga/):/ra tsho :/thugs dam sgyu dha na phur pa na tu na rlabs ba yad/ga ka grang pa 'dabs der 'u yug pa rig pa'i seng ge'i sku gdung sa 'bum ོ po zhig bod/de la bskor ba byas gso lob bto nas rtsod pa lags 'ong zer bkrashis lhun por rten gyi snyo bo bya mis/paṇa ོ blo phyong chas/blo bzang ye shes/dpal ldan ye shes/bstan pa'i nyi ma rnams kyi sku gdung /khyad par dga' gdong byams pa dang /ngur smig sgrol ma sogs rten ṣi byin tsos che ba mang du bzhugs/nang rten rje gzha mi la'i phyag shan/bka ༷ gdams gong ma mang tsho na bza' sa rten ci rigs/rdo ma tsho grod pa zhes grags pa nor g.yin zer ba sogs yod kyang mjal la zhu na ba gyordzo dang gto sgo sogs dgos ba po shis lhun po nas gyen du phyin pa na na ston blo gros grags pas ba/mchims ston rim byon so gos kyi gdan sa bka' gdams bstan pa'i 'byung gnas snar thang zhes grags pa der spyir rten gsum byin tso mang po dang /khyad par chu mig sgrol mar grags sku byin tso/dpon po pho lha tha'i ja'i dus su brkos pa'i bka' bstan tsā ra gyi spar/thub pa'i skyes rabs dang /gnas brtan bas drug gi thang tso spar sogs yod/nang rten 'brom ston pa'i shel gyi phyag ra btso gdams pa'i bla mgong ma mang po dang /bye brag snar thang pa'i bla ma 'phags pa'i gnas brtan gyi sprul pa rnams kyi sku'i nyer spyad so gos rtsa mang po btsos/mjal kha zhun bkushis lhun po nas yi ge zhudagos/'di'i lta gtu byang r+ṣa ri khrod ces snar thang sangs rgyas sgom pa sogs bka' gad/sa pa'i sgrub gnas khyad 'phags de

brtse na'ogasalagabs r+sha /9)thugasadamarten phur pa shin tu byin tsosache ba yod/galto/rtse'i grong pa'i 1de 1)rdo shāX/(rtse /re//༷/ /je/ga'adabasar 'u yug pa gapa nga sku gdung sa'abum ba bad/shā labaskor ba byas/k+ṣi+oṃb bto nasartsod pa lagasapa 'ong zerabakrasalhun por rten bo byams /paṇa 'i'i+o blo bzapaphyu+ogargyan/blo bzang ye shes/dpalaldanayeshes/gzhipanyamarnamasarte/ /sbying/khyad par dga' gdong byamasapa dang /ngur ga sgrochom zlogasan na tsosachebamangaduXgis/nangarte+onarje/lharil phyogaya/btso /tremasagangamamanga~Xbaza'asagasan gas/rda ma ma grad pa shisapa nar gan rasnasagasayod kyajemajarākhazhunabagyomago+o dong gto sga sagasadags/sdumasalhu+on smra nasono du gh+ri pa na gsastan bla grasagragasapazlobato/ sastan ma byan sags /dan sabaka' /dmasabastan pa yang khasasnar zlong r+sā+ogragasapa derā ra rte/ gsum notso+omongapa byenga'i/khyadaparachu+ogasalamar grags spyo na tso/dbyin pa pha lha tha ja dusasu brkasapa brjogazhasko sar spar/thub pa' zlosarabasadang /'asnas/rtan sodrug zang spar+sha sogasayod/nang na 'bra~X stan pa' lagyadzogatsor btso /dmasapa bla zlogang ma mang pa/nga /'idabrag snar thang pa blo ma 'phagasapa gnasabartan sprulapa /mas sku lharā /da shasamadi'i mang pa btsos//jalakha zhun bkusalhun po nos zhudagos/'a ltagasdi byang r+ṣa khrod cesasnar tha/ yosargyasasgam pa sagasabs gdasdusapa' sgrub gnasakhyad 'phags

bu 2nag/ṭāmasayomagerabazhuragaXlo3ོkhogagagasasaso/btsos/dpazlomasmron lto khasakhyad par༅yanakyi/snarathangadang nye bar gtsang/gangamozhesapa/sngar bas gasdoms rtogasde che grasa'aphagasapa ṭ+wāṃ po ྾mro+otso+or r+ṣa mo bskor ba' gnasade yan na'ang deng sang grong nag na/lha khang dang rten gsusbya shasam/la rgyu yod//snarathanganasazlorjotsamadungor /chas/gakhag lnga/khang wo 4ོ snad sdugasasu ra na gsum mang pa dang /khyad par bla brang gci ṣ+ṭṛ dur gams /༷mazagaphugatu lam lasabla brgyud dang /phyagad rags/snang rgyam/demadoradabang khang/snyel/lha khang ñcā ngor r+ṣa 'dra sku salam 'brasabla brgyud dang /gdan rabasam byon 'dra khi dang sku gdung sogs/snyu khophugatu thub gyisama' rten byin tso mang /ner /ji tsho ri/ce yo ne thos sna'i ///thar rtsa'i brang du rwa pa' ba thad du grag/sna dang /mgan pa' thug n+d+ra gnam lcagasardorje zlogasanangarte/ 'ga' mjalargyu yod/dgon pa' skyam du ngor r+ṣa sabagosapa bde tshogasamaho+o rten brgyad sogasaspyar /na gsum mngadubasdusaso//ngoranasags/la brgyud dpalasaskyar sh+ka tsā gsum rma zlogatsang laru gnyasayod pa ru lag tu ṭ+wāṃkhosapa dpalasaskyar sleb/der ra lha ༷nga dang rten gsumamatha' yasapa dkar sa mkhan r+sā ku/ sna' zla'odakyasamadzaX payodangar gragasapa sogasalasagatso/rten bo ngo mtshar sprula~X' rten ba gragasapa dbu rtse' 'jam dbyangasagazi 'od 'barab/sgo0 bse'abaganagaposwār ༷rnyi/g.yu mkhar r+yā sgrolamasemasadatsho sumabugs/sgribash+ko ltakhya ba'

bu brten sha rim gyi mtshan byang mdor bsdu0dba'i bon zhes ga ba bzhugs so/btsos/dpal mgon zhal gyi sa khyad par ༅ yin/snar thang dang nye bar gtsang chu mig ring mo zhes pa/sngar bka' gdams kyi cho ge sde che grasa'aphags pa rin po 77lor 0 mo bskor ba'i gnas de yin na'ang deng sang grong nag yin/lha khang dang rten gsum cha shas mjal rgyu yod//snar thang nas mo tsam du ngor e / chos sde/gla khag lnga/khang wo lo brgyad sogs su spyir rten gsum mang po dang /khyad par bla brang gci du ngor r+pā gzims /lam zag phug tu lam las bla brgyud dang /phyag dpe rigs ba rgya ma/de'i mdor dbang khang /lams lha khang du ngor r+ṣa 'dra sku gtsos lam 'bras bla brgyud dang /gdan rabs rim byon gyi 'dra khi dang sku gdung sogs/snyu khang phug tu thub ོ gyis ma rten byin tso mang /thar rtse'i brang du birwa pa'i bzhes thod du grags pa dang /mgon pho thug rten ra sna/jir rmo /shā lha de/ka 'a sna sa rmo 95gnam lcags do sags nang na 'ga' mjal rgyu yad/dgan pa' ltam du ngor r+ṣa gyis bas pa'i bde tshogs mar rten brgyad sogasaspyir rten gsum mang du bas so//ngor nas chag la brgyud dpalasaskyar wo zhag gsum tsam gyis gtsang la ru gnyis yod pa'i ru lag tu gtogasapa dpa las skyar sleb/der spyir lha khang dang rten gsum mtha' yas pa'i dkar sa mkhan r+sā kun dga' zla 'od kyis mdzad pa yod par grags pa sogasalas ga/rten gyi gtso bo ngo rma'i sprul pa'i rten bakhi grags pa dbu rtse'i 'jam dbyangs gzi 'od 'bar ba/sgo wo gyi bse 'bag nag po tsor shes/g.yu mkhar mo'i sgrol ma sems da sum gas/zi kha' lta ltos ri ba'i phyi

'tshe chen 'od snang lag sa 'i ma ༄ sa sdus/ ()rten rnam rgyal ma chad rten rnams yin/ gzhan yang nyin dgon bla brang shar dusachen gyis 'jam dbyangs zhal gzigs pa'i sgrub phug nyin dgon gyi ltag tu slob dpon bsod nam rtse mo mkha' spyod du gshegs sa/ nyin dgon zhabs brtan lha khang du rje btsun grags pa'i sku rtsas ma/ sgo rum gyi steng du rje sa paṇa gyis rig gter brtsam sa'i bzhugs byin rlabs can/ dbu rtser sa paṇa gyi phyag bris 'jam dbyangs gar gzigs ma/ gzhi thog bla brang du khyad 'phagasalho byang sogs rten gsum rab 'byams/ gzham du 'phags pa rin po che'i chosakhri khams gsum zil gnon/ srib dgon sprul pa'i lha khang du thub chen 'dzam gling g.yas bzhag dang / chos brtsigs brag ri brtsegs pa lta bu sogs rten gsum blo'i ra ba las 'das pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos dung dkar mo rgyang grags/ kha'u'i chu gyen ded du phyin pa'i lam bar phru ma zhes pa der sa chen sku 'khrungs sa yan/ sku 'khrungs pa 'a dus kyi mngal gyi phru ma sogs bzhugs pa'i mchod rten yod/ de nas rim par dpal mgon zhal gyi bzhugs gnas kha'u brag rdzong nag po'i ri khrod/ rje btsun grags pa dang sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje sogs kyi sgrub gnas bya 'gyar pad+ma 'od/ sa skya dang nye bar bsam gling zhesadamag zor ma'i mgon khang byin chen sogs yod/sa skya nas nub phyogs su zhag gcig tsam gyi sar mang mkhar lung pa yod/ de'i phur rje btsun grags pa dang / tshar chen sogs kyi sgrub gnas lung rdo rje'i brag rdzong yod/ de nas rim par tshar chen gyi gdan sa mang mkhar thub bstan dge 'phel/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba'i gdan sa mang mkhar mu gu lung / 'di 212

'tsher+ṣa 'odasnang lag sa 'i so lngabakhengaswās/ ()rten rnam rgyalamachod rten rnamasayin/ gzhan yang nyin dgon bla brang shar dusachen gyisa'ajam dbyangasazhal gzigasapa'i sgrub phug nyin dgon gyi ltag tu slob dpon bsod nam rtse mo mkha' spyod du gshegasas/ nyin dgon zhabs brtan lha khang du rje btsun gragasapa'i sku rtsarisam/ sgo rum gyi steng du rje sa paṇa gyis rig gter brtsam sa'i bzhugasakhri byin rlabasacan/ dbu rtser sapaṇa gyi phyag brisa'ajam dbyangasagar gzigasam/ gzhi thog bla brang du khyad 'phagasalho byang sogasarten gsum rab 'byams/ gzham du 'phagasapa rin po che'i chosakhri khamasagasum zil gnon/ srib dgon sprul pa'i lha khang du thub chen 'dzam gling g.yasabazhag dang / chosabartsigasabrag ri brtsegs pa lta bu sogasarten gsum blo'i ra ba lasa'adasapa dang / sangasargyasakyi chos dung dkar mo rgyang grags/ kha'u'i chu gyen ded du phyin pa'i lam bar phru ma zhesapa der sachen sku 'khrungasasayin/ sku 'khrungasapa'i dusakyi mngal gyi phru ma sogasabazhugasapa'i mchod rten yod/ de nasarim par dpal mgon zhal gyi bzhugasaganasakha'u brag rdzong nag po'i ri khrod/ rje btsun gragasapa dang sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje sogasakyi sgrub gnasabya 'gyar pad+ma 'od/ saskya dang nye bar bsam gling zhesadamag zor ma'i mgon khang byin chen sogasayod/sa skya nasanub phyogs su zhag gcig tsam gyi sar mang mkhar lung pa yod/ de'i phur rje btsun gragasapa dang / tshar chen sogasakyi sgrub gnas lung rdo rje'i brag rdzong yod/ de nasarim par tshar chen gyi gdan samang mkhar thub bstan dge 'phel/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba'i gdan samang mkhar mu gu lung / 'di 212

dbusagatsang gi gnasarten rags rim gyi mtshan byang mdor bsdus dad pa'i gabon zhesabya ba bzhugasaso/deng sang gnasa'adzin tsam ma gtogs ci'ang med rung / 'brog mi'i gzim phug 'od gsal zla ba phug rgya dpe bsgyur sa sgra bsgyur lo tsā phug lam 'bras gnang sa gsung ngag lam 'bras phug sogs phug chen bcu gsum du grags pa rnams mjal rgyu yod/ de thams cad sa phug kho na yin/ de nas rim par sngag bsod nams chos 'phel sos kyi gdan sa'i shul dang / mang mkhar gyi gzhung du lo tsā ba rma rin chen mchog gi 'khrungs yul yin skad grong pa/ mang mkhar gyi mdor tshar chen rin po che'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i 'dar grong mo che/ 'dir tshar chen rin po che'i gdung 'bum byin rlabs can bzhugs/ 'di dang nye bar se mkhar chung yang yod/ gram pa lha rtse zhes pa'i zhol du 'brog mi lo tsā dang ga ya dha ra thog mar mjal ba'i sgrub phug yod/ 'di nas yar stod phyogasal grub chen thang stong rgyal po'i gdan sa gcung ri bo che/ gtsang po pha ri'i byang brgyud du byang ngam ring / rig 'dzin rgod ldem gyi gter gnas zang zang lha brag ri bo bkra bzang / ri kun tu gzigs/ sa chen zhing gshegs sa'i gnasabyang phyogs skya po kha gdong sogs mang du yod kyang thag ring la stod phyogs nas rim par yar phyin na pha dam pa'i bzhugasaganasading ri/ gangs dkar/ bka' brgyud spyi dang / khyad par rgod tshang pa'i sgrub gnasartsibasari rgod tshang / rje btsun mi la'i zhabrungasayul mang yul gung thang / yol mo gangasakyi ra ba/ mang yul skyid grong nas bal yul sogs dang / la stod byang gi phyogs nas gangs ri ti se'i bar gnasachen mtha' yas pa yod/gong gi lha rtse dang nye bar mtha' 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang du gter ston 213

dbus gtsang gi gnas rten rags rim gyi mtshan byang mdor bsdus dad pa'i sa bon zhes bya ba bzhugs so/deng sang gnas 'dzin tsam ma gtogs ci'ang med rung / 'brog mi'i gzim phug 'od gsal zla ba phug rgya dpe bsgyur sa sgra bsgyur lo tsā phug lam 'bras gnang sa gsung ngag lam 'bras phug sogs phug chen bcu gsum du grags pa rnams mjal rgyu yod/ de thams cad sa phug kho na yin/ de nas rim par sngag bsod nams chos 'phel sos kyi gdan sa'i shul dang / mang mkhar gyi gzhung du lo tsā ba rma rin chen mchog gi 'khrungs yul yin skad grong pa/ mang mkhar gyi mdor tshar chen rin po che'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i 'dar grong mo che/ 'dir tshar chen rin po che'i gdung 'bum byin rlabs can bzhugs/ 'di dang nye bar se mkhar chung yang yod/ gram pa lha rtse zhes pa'i zhol du 'brog mi lo tsā dang ga ya dha ra thog mar mjal ba'i sgrub phug yod/ 'di nas yar stod phyogs la grub chen thang stong rgyal po'i gdan sa gcung ri bo che/ gtsang po pha ri'i byang brgyud du byang ngam ring / rig 'dzin rgod ldem gyi gter gnas zang zang lha brag ri bo bkra bzang / ri kun tu gzigs/ sa chen zhing gshegs sa'i gnas byang phyogs skya po kha gdong sogs mang du yod kyang thag ring la stod phyogs nas rim par yar phyin na pha dam pa'i bzhugs gnas ding ri/ gangs dkar/ bka' brgyud spyi dang / khyad par rgod tshang pa'i sgrub gnas rtsibs ri rgod tshang / rje btsun mi la'i 'khrungs yul mang yul gung thang / yol mo gangs kyi ra ba/ mang yul skyid grong nas bal yul sogs dang / la stod byang gi phyogs nas gangs ri ti se'i bar gnas chen mtha' yas pa yod/gong gi lha rtse dang nye bar mtha' 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang du gter ston 213

ba tshe chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i mas 'gung sa bsdus/ ()bzang po grags pas le'u bdun ma sogs kyi gter gnas ru lag gram pa ljongs kyi lha khang / rgyangs 'bum mo che/ rgyangs yon po lung du slob dpon sgrub phug yod/ de nas rim par zhang ston chos 'bar gyi gdan sa zhang pags thang ding zhes pa de yod kyang shul tsam ma gtogs ci'ang med/ de nas rje btsun tā ra na thas gsar btab dga' ldan phun tshogs gling zhes deng sang chos lugs dge lugs pa yin/ ri mthul gnyis mar gtsug lag khang dang / dgon gnas rten gsum sogs kyi bkod pa shin tu dngos gtsang zhing ngo mtshar ba bzhugs/'di'i phur kun mkhyen dol bu pa'i gdan sa ri khrod jo mo nang zhes grags par sku 'bum mthong grol chen mos mtshon rten gsum byin can mang du bzhugs shing / spyir sgrub phug skor mjal rgyu mang zhib cha rje btsun tā ra nā thas mjad pa'i gnas bshad du gsal/ phun gling nas nye bar brag ram mgon khang zhes beg tse'i mgon khang grags che ba de yod/ phun tshogs gling nas nyin lam cam du dge ba'i bshes gnyen mu dra chen pos btab cing / dpang lo chen po khu dpon dang / bo dong paṇa chen sogs kyi gdan sa bo dong e'u gtsug lag khang zhes nga/ de yod kyang deng sang ser khyim yin/ bo dong paṇa chen gyi ring bsrel las grub pa'i sku sogs rten byin can 'ga' zhig mjal rgyu yod/ de dang nye bar mnyan yod bya rgod zhes pa de yod/ chos rgyal dus kyi mtha' 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang yin/ rnam sras mdung dmar can gyi sku byin can bzhugs/ mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho sogs kyi dus sa skya'i mtshan nyid grwa tshang chen po yin na'ang deng sang ming ma bor tsam las med/ grub thob 'dar 'phyar gyi gdung brgyud bla ma snying ri ba 214

'tshechen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i mos yang tsosabasdus/ ()bzang po grags pas le'u bdun ma sogs kyi gter gnas ru lag gram pa ljongs kyi lha khang / rgyangasa'abum mo che/ rgyangasayon po lung du slob dpon sgrub phug yod/ de nas rim par zhang ston chos 'bar gyi gdan sa zhang pags thang ding zhes pa de yod kyang shul tsam ma gtogs ci'ang med/ de nas rje btsun tā ra na thas gsar btab dga' ldan phun tshogs gling zhes deng sang chos lugs dge lugs pa yin/ ri mthul gnyis mar gtsug lag khang dang / dgon gnasarten gsum sogs kyi bkod pa shin tu dngos gtsang zhing ngo mtshar ba bzhugs/'di'i phur kun mkhyen dol bu pa'i gdan sa ri khrod jo mo nang zhesagrags par sku 'bum mthong grol chen mos mtshon rten gsum byin can mang du bzhugs shing / spyir sgrub phug skor mjal rgyu mang zhib cha rje btsun tā ra nā thas mjad pa'i gnas bshad du gsal/ phun gling nasanye bar brag ram mgon khang zhes beg tse'i mgon khang grags che ba de yod/ phun tshogs gling nas nyin lam cam du dge ba'i bshes gnyen mu dra chen pos btab cing / dpang lo chen po khu dpon dang / bo dong paṇa chen sogs kyi gdan sa bo dong e'u gtsug lag khang zhes nga/ de yod kyang deng sang ser khyim yin/ bo dong paṇa chen gyi ring bsrel las grub pa'i sku sogs rten byin can 'ga' zhig mjal rgyu yod/ de dang nye bar mnyan yod bya rgod zhes pa de yod/ chos rgyal dus kyi mtha' 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang yin/ rnam sras mdung dmar can gyi sku byin can bzhugs/ mang thosaklu sgrub rgya mtsho sogs kyi dus sa skya'i mtshan nyid grwa tshang chen po yin na'ang deng sang ming ma bor tsam las med/ grub thob 'dar 'phyar gyi gdung brgyud bla ma snying ri ba 214

dbus gtsang gi gnas rten rags rim gyi mtshan byang mdor bsdus dad pa'i sa bon zhes bya ba bzhugs so/zhes pa de'ang 'di phyogs bzhugs sa yin/ bo dong nas nyin lam tsam na sngon mo chos rdzong dang / sa skya pa'i bla ma gong ma'i gdan sa sha ba dge sdings rdo rje'i pho brang zhes pa de yod/ 'di dang nye bar khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyi gdan sa khro phu byams chen chos sde zhes pa de yod/ der byams pa dgung lo brgyad pa'i sku tshad khru brgyad cu pa'i lha chen bod kyi gser sku zhig la ngo mtshar che ba de dang //byed 'phags bcu gsum sogs mjal rgyu yod/ mang mkhar sogs stod kyi gnas rigs bskor ma grub kyang sa skya nas mar lan shab dge sdings brgyud 'ongs na 'dir slebs pa yin/ khro phu nas gangs can chos 'phel zhes paṇa chen bzang po bkra shis kyi gdan sa der dmag zor ma'i sku byin can de nas stag la nub brgyud snar thang du sleb/ gzhis ka rtse nas gtsang po pha ri'i phyogs su phyin na rta nag phyogs su kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge'i gdan sa thub bstan rnam rgyal/ 'gos lo tsā ba khug pa lhas btsas kyi sgrub phug byin can/ sgrol chen rim byon gyi gdan sa sgrol ma phug de nas gtsang po rgyud yang phyogs rim par 'jad thub bstan/ rgyal sras thogs med kyi gdan sa bzhad dngul chu cho me rdzong / mus lung ba'i stod smad du mus chen sems dpa' chen po'i gdan sa/ dben gnas bsam gtan phug /gle lung / stag mo gling kha sogs yod/ gtsang po byang brgyud thur du phyin na shangs lung pa'i stod smad dbar gsum du spyir gnas rten mang po dang / khyad par shangs mdar zur che chung gi sgrub gnas shangs mda' dpal chen/ shangs gzhung du grub chen khyung po rnal 'byor gyi gdan sa shangs zhang zhang rdo rje gdan/ grub chen rmog lcog pa'i gdan sa rmog lcog grub chen 'ba' ra 2/5

dbusagatsang gi gnasarten ragasarim gyi mtshan byang mdor bsdusadad pa'i sabon zhes bya ba bzhugasaso/zhes pa de'ang 'di phyogs bzhugs sa yin/ bo dong nas nyin lam tsam na sngon mo chos rdzong dang / sa skya pa'i bla ma gong ma'i gdan sashab dge sdings rdo rje'i pho brang zhes pa de yod/ 'di dang nye bar khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyi gdan sa khro phu byams chen chos sde zhesapa de yod/ der byams pa dgung lo brgyad pa'i sku tshad khru brgyad cu pa'i lha chen bod kyi gser sku zhig la ngo mtshar che ba de dang //khyad 'phags bcu gsum sogs mjal rgyu yod/ mang mkhar sogs stod kyi gnas rigs bskor ma grub kyang sa skya nas mar lan shab dge sdings brgyud 'ongs na 'dir slebs pa yin/ khro phu nas gangs can chos 'phel zhes paṇa chen bzang po bkra shis kyi gdan sa der dmag zor ma'i sku byin can de nas stag la nub brgyud snar thang du sleb/ gzhis ka rtse nas gtsang po pha ri'i phyogs su phyin na rta nag phyogs su kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge'i gdan sa thub bstan rnam rgyal/ 'gos lo tsā ba khug pa lhasabatsas kyi sgrub phug byin can/ sgrol chen rim byon gyi gdan sa sgrol ma phug de nas gtsang po rgyud yang phyogs rim par 'jad thub bstan/ rgyal sras thogasamed kyi gdan sa bzhad dngul chu chosardzong / mus lung ba'i stod smad du mus chen sems dpa' chen po'i gdan sa/ dben gnas bsam gtan phug /gle lung / stag mo gling kha sogs yod/ gtsang po byang brgyud thur du phyin na shangs lung pa'i stod smad dbar gsum du spyir gnas rten mang po dang / khyad par shangs mdar zur che chung gi sgrub gnas shangs mda' dpal chen/ shangs gzhung du grub chen khyung po rnal 'byor gyi gdan sa shangs zhang zhang rgo rje gdan/ grub chen rmog lcog pa'i gdan sa me+og lcog grub chen 'ba' ra 2/5

brtse chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (skye/ba'i gdan sa 'ba' ra brag dkar/ shangs kyi phur gtsang gi sgrub gnas kun gyi gtso bo shangs zam bu lung bde gshegs 'dus pa'i pho brang / de dang mgo 'brel du gnas chen sog po 'dzul khung sogs khyad par can yod/ shangs nas phar la brgal nas phyin na 'u yug tu sleb/ 'di'i stod smad du bka' gdams pa ram lding ma ba bde gshegs 'byung gnas kyi gdan sa 'u yug lding ma dgon du rten gsum byin can dang / khyad par chu myong grol sogs yod/ mdar lug gdong du slob dpon rin po che'i sgrub phug 'u yug mdar dam can gyi sku mkhar dang / gos sngon lha khang sogs yod/ 'u yug stod nas la brgal 'a nas phyan na rim par ga me zhwa dmar pa'i gdan sa thub bstan yangs pa can dang / byang gnam mtsho sogs dang 'brel ba yin/ 'u yug smad nas rim par gzhu snye mor sleb/ snye mor be+e ro tsa na'i 'khrungs yul dang / dgung lo brgyad pa'i zhabs rjes sogs yod skad/ 'u yug nas mtshur phu la rgan brgyud stod lung mtshur phur sleb pa yin/gong gi gzhis ka rtse nas gtsang po lho rgyud nas mar phyin pas rim par paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan gyi gdan sa thub bstan gser mdog can/ 'di sngar mtshan nyid kyi grwa tshang chen po yin yang deng sang ming ma stong tsam las med/ 'on kyang rten gsum byin can yod/ 'di'i span thag ma'i phur snga 'gyur rnying ma'i gdan sa chen po zur lug pa lung zhes grags pa de yod/ deng sang grong pa yin kyang lha khang dang rten byin can 'ga' zhig yod/ phung po ri bo cher o rgyan gyi sgrub gnas dang / rgya zhang khrom gyi gter 6 / lnga pa rin po che'i dus btab

༄7/ /gangs ri'i khrod kyi klog pa nyan bshad pa rnams kyi snyan du springs pa thos bsam 'chi med bdud rtsi zhes bya ba bsdokyigs so/ /༄tsho/ /stobs bcu'i dbang phyug shākya seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis byang chub spyod pa'i dus nas spong blang khrims kyis rgyud bsdams te/ /mkhyen gsum la brten sbyor bzhi'i lam gyis chos sku'i go 'phang mngon gyur nas/ /gzhan phyir bden gnyis zung 'jug las brtsams skyob pa nyid gzigs lam gsungs pas/ bral smin sku dang ye shes mchog sbyin shākya'i gtso bos dge legs mdzod/ /sde snod rgyud sde yan lag dang bcas pa'i/ /lung gi dam chos nyan dang 'chad 'dod rnams/ /bshes gnyen dam pa spyi bo'i thod bzhin bsten//rgyal ba'i bka' dang tshad ldan mkhas pa'i gzhung / /rnam dpyod brtson pas thos dang bsam par bya/ /log pa'i srol la nyin mtshan khor yug tu/ /nan gyisabaslab kyang ngal ba don med pas/ /de phyir mkhas pa'i bshad srol 'di yin ces/ /phyogs kyi bshes gnyen rnams la 'di bsrings so/ /gangs can 'gro mang gtsug gi khrir 'khod pa/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang sa skyong sprul pa'i sku/ /sngon gyi chos rgyal lha gcig btsan po de/ srong ba' sna'i/ po gangs ri'i khrod kyi ston pa dang po yin/ /gangs can smra ba'i srol 'byed sam+bho ṭa/ /dgra bgegs log 'dren zlordo gcod badz+ra shrī/ /mdo sngags bstan

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya' chos yang gces bsdus/()pa'i gzhin gyur pa gor zhabs/mtshungs bral bod kyi sgra bsgyur ska cog zhang /snga 'gyur lo paṇa skyes mchog gi skor phal mo che zur du gsal/rgyal bas lung bstan sprul pa'i lo chen gnyis/gi r+ṣa bzang po dang /rngog blo ldan shes rab/gnas lnga rig pa'i mthar son sa skya pa//yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rin chen grub//byang phyogs bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu//drang srong chen po thams cad gzigs pa yis//'gro kun byang chen dkri ba'i them skas su//'khor lo rnam gsum 'dul mdo mngan rgyud sde bzhi bya spyod rnal 'byor bla med la sogs//mdo sngags chos kyi dril chen 'dzam gling bsgrags//legs gsung 'dul ba'i pho brang nang zhug ba(nas//nyi ba'i brgya lnga bcu pham pa bzhi/lhag ma bstogasum/spang lhung sum cu/lhung byed 'ba' zhig dgu bcu/sor bshag sde bzhi/nyes byas brgya dang bcu gnyis rnams so//spang ba'i tshul khrims dang //bcu bdun blang bya lung las/rab byung gso sbyong gzhi dang ni//dgag dbye dbyar dang ko lpags gzhi//sman dang gos dang sra brkyang dang //ko ra dang las kyi gzhi//dmar ser can dang gang zag dang //spo dang gso sbyong bzhag pa dang //gnas mal dang ni rtsod pa dang //dge 'dun dbyen rnams bsdus pa yin/mas/'jug pa'i tshul khrims te//'khor lo dang po'i lam gyi rim pa'o//'phags pa'i yul du bsdu ba gnyis pa'i rjes//mdo lung dgongs 'grel gyes pa bco brgyad byung /sde pa tha dad rim par bsdus pa las/shar nub ri dang gangs rir gnas//'jig rten 'das par smra ba dang //rtag par smra ba'i sde snod ni//lnga tshan dge 'dun pha chen pa/bzhi pa dang ni 'od srungs sde//sa ston sde dang chos srung ste//mang thos gos dmar slob pa dang //rnam par phye ste smra ba ni//thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde//rgyal byed tshal gnas 'jigs med ri//gtsug lag khang chen gnas brtan pa'o//sa sgrogs rigs dang srung ba pa//gnas ma bu yi sde rnams ni//kun 222

bgechen 'od snang las/saskya' chos yang r+sāsabasdus/()pa'i gzhin gyur pa gor zhabs/mtshungs bral bod kyi sgra bsgyur ska cog zhang /snga 'gyur lo paṇa skyesamachog gi skor phal mo che zur du gsal/rgyal bsalung bstan sprul pa'i lo chen gnyis/gi r+ṣa bzang po dang /rngog blo ldan shesarab/gnas lnga rig pa'i mthar son sa skya pa//yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rin chen grub//byang phyogs bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu//drang srong chen po thams cad gzigs pa yis//'gro kun byang chen dkri ba'i them skas su//'khor lo rnam gsum 'dul mdo mngon rgyud sde bzhi bya spyod rnal 'byor bla med la sogs//mdo sngags chos kyi dril chen 'dzam gling bsgrags//legs gsung 'dul ba'i pho brang nang zhugasanas//nyisabargya lnga bcu pham pa bzhi/lhag ma bstogasum/spang lhung sum cu/lhung byed 'ba' zhig dgu bcu/sor bshag sde bzhi/nyesabyasabargya dang bcu gnyisarnamasaso//spang ba'i tshul khrims dang //bcu bdun blang bya lung las/rab byung gso sbyong gzhi dang ni//dgag dbye dbyar dang ko lpagasagazhi//sman dang gosadang sra brkyang dang //ko sham+bhi dang lasakyi gzhi//dmar ser can dang gang zag dang //spo dang gso sbyong bzhag pa dang //gnasamal dang ni rtsod pa dang //dge 'dun dbyen rnamasabasdusapa yin/mas/'jug pa'i tshul khrimasate//'khor lo dang po'i lam gyi rim pa'o//'phags pa'i yul du bsdu ba gnyis pa'i rjes//mdo lung dgongs 'grel gyes pa bco brgyad byung /sde pa tha dad rim par bsdusapa las/shar nub ri dang gangs rir gnas//'jig rten 'das par smra ba dang //rtag par smra ba'i sde snod ni//lnga tshan dge 'dun pha chen pa/bzhi pa dang ni 'od srungs sde//sa ston sde dang chos srung ste//mang thos gos dmar slob pa dang //rnam par phye ste smra ba ni//thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde//rgyal byed tshal gnas 'jigasamed ri//gtsug lag khang chen gnasabartan pa'o//5sgrogasariga~Xng srung ba pa//gnas ma bu yi sde rnamasani//kun

gangasari'i khrod kyi klog pa nyan bshad pa rnamasakyi snyan du springasapa thosabasam 'chi med bdud rtsi/gyesabakur ba rnam pa gsum/ /yul don slob dpon bye brag gis/ /tha dad rnamapa bco brgyad gyur/ /zhes pa ste/ de las ston sde pa'am dpe ston sde pa dang / 'jig rten 'dasapar smra ba gnyisani mdo sde pa dang / lhag ma bstodrug po bye smra ba'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa kho na'o/ /yod smra'i dgongasa'agrel yon shāka rnam gnyis dang / /bshes gnyen drug dri med bshesagar+sā/ khyad par bshesaganyen/ dge legasapa shesaganyen/ dge ba'i bsheloganyen/ tshul khrimasabashesaganyen/ chosakyi bdesaga' rnamasaso/ /sogs 'phags yul mkhas rnamasaso/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir bshad srol rnam gsum smad 'dul/ stod 'dul/ khache lugs/ byung / /kun gyi bka' babs bu ston rin chen grub/ /'di la/ sgra tshad pa/ lung mang po/ gong gsumapa/ khrung lhasapa sogasabu r+pā byung / kha ba can 'dir 'phagasamachog gnyis par gyur/ /thar 'dod rnams kyang srol de'i rjes su zhugs/ /mkhyen gsum maphortogasargyan las/ shesarab pha rol phyin pa ni/ /dngosapo brgyad kyisayang dag bshad/ /rnam kun mkhyen nyid ( 1 ) lam shesanyid/ ( 2 ) /de nasathamasacad shesapa nyid/ ( 3 ) /rnam kun ma༅ོ rdzogasartogasapa dang /( 1 ) /rtse mor phyin dang ( 2 ) mthar gyis pa/ ( 3 ) /skad cig gcig ma༅ོ rdzogs byang chub/ ( 4 ) /mosakyi sku dang ( 5 ) de rnamasabargyad/ /zhesaskabasabargyad ma༅ོ rtogasakyi don gnyis kyisalar do/ /thos bsam skya ba 'dzin mkhas shing / /nyams len sbyor bzhi'i gzings la brten nas ni/ /chos sku lhun po'i mdzes pa blta ba yi/ /'khor lo bar pa'i sbas don lam rim de/ /dga' ldan gnas su mi pham chos rjes bkral/ /'phags pa'i yul du bka' babs rnam pa drug bde ba'i 'byung gnasadaga' ldan lha yul/ longasaspyod kyi 'byung gnasa'og klu yul/ rig pa'i 'byung gnasashar phyogasabhaṅga la/yon tan gyi 'byung gnasalho phyogasabe+e tā'i yul/ byin rlabasakyi 'byung gnasanub phyogasa.o rgyan yul/ ngo 223

gangs ri'i khrod kyi klog pa nyan bshad pa rnams kyi snyan du springs pa thos bsam 'chi med bdud rtsi/gyes bkur ba rnam pa gsum/ /yul don slob dpon bye brag gis/ /tha dad rnam pa bco brgyad gyur/ /zhes pa ste/ de las ston sde pa'am dpe ston sde pa dang / 'jig rten 'das par smra ba gnyis ni mdo sde pa dang / lhag ma bas drug po bye smra ba'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa kho na'o/ /yod smra'i dgongs 'grel yon shāka rnam gnyis dang / /bshes gnyen drug dri med bshes ga/ khyad par bzhesaganyen/ dge legs pa shes gnyen/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ tshul khrims bshes gnyen/ chos kyi bshesag 'a rnams so/ /sogs 'phags yul mkhas rnams so/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir bshad srol rnam gsum smad 'dul/ stod 'dul/ kha che lugs/ byung / /kun gyi bka' babs bu ston rin chen grub/ /'di la/ sgra tshad pa/ lung mang po/ gong gsum pa/ khrung lhas pa sogs bu r+pā byung / kha ba can 'dir 'phags ma chag gnyis par gyur/ /thar 'dod rnams kyang srol de'i rjes su zhugs/ /mkhyen gsum mngon rtogs rgyan las/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni/ /dngos po brgyad kyis yang dag bshad/ /rnam kun mkhyen nyid ( 1 ) lam shesanyid/ ( 2 ) /de nas thams cad shes pa nyid/ ( 3 ) /rnam kun mngan rdzogs rtogs pa dang /( 1 ) /rtse mor phyin dang ( 2 ) mthar gyis pa/ ( 3 ) /skad cig gcig mngon rdzogs byang chub/ ( 4 ) /chos kyi sku dang ( 5 ) de rnams brgyad/ /zhes skabs brgyad mngon rtogs kyi don gnyis kyis lar do/ /thos bsam skya ba 'dzin mkhas shing / /nyams len sbyor bzhi'i gzings la brten nas ni/ /chos sku lhun po'i mdzes pa blta ba yi/ /'khor lo bar pa'i sbas don lam rim de/ /dga' ldan gnas su mi pham chos rjes bkral/ /'phags pa'i yul du bka' babs rnam pa drug bde ba'i 'byung gnasadaga' ldan lha yul/ longs spyod kyi 'byung gnas 'og klu yul/ rig pa'i 'byung gnas shar phyogs bha la/yon tan gyi 'byung gnas lho phyogs be+e tā'i yul/ byin rlabs kyi 'byung gnas nub phyogs o rgyan yul/ ngo 223

ba tshe chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i marang sa bsdus/ () mtshar gyi 'byung gnas byang phyogs bi shwa ka tsas gyi gling nas brgyud pa ste drug go rgyan gyi dgongs 'grel thogs med sku mched sogs bshad srol rnam mang yang / /gang de 'grel la 'phags seng 'phags pa grol sde dang / slob dpon seṅge bzang po khyad par 'phags/ /de dag bzhed gzhung rngog lo'i thugs mtshor babs/ /sher phyin rgyas mdzad 'bre ar rnam gnyis kyi/ rngog lo'i slob ma 'bre shes rab 'bar dang / de'i slob ma ar byang chub ye shes/ 'chad rtsom nyi zla'i 'od zer 'bum phrag gis/ /gangs can mun pa'i nags khrod gsal bar mdzad/ /pas na de'i rjes su zhugs/ rtag chad mthar lta'i g.yangs su ma lhung zhing /bden gnyis/ zung 'jug lta ba'i them skas la 'dzegs nas/ /nges don chos sku'i khang bzang bgrod pa yi/ /'khor lo bar pa'i dngos bstan lam rim de/ /rgya gar yul du 'phags mchog klu yis bkral/ /legs ldan 'byed dang sangs rgyas bskyangs gnyis kyis/ /klu sgrub zhabs kyi dgongs pa 'grel tshul las/ /'phags pa'i yul du thal rang srol gnyis gyes/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir thams cad mkhyen pa rngog lo'i slob ma dpal ldan phywa pa chos kyi seng ge 'di la slob ma seng chen brgyad/ jo sras gsum/ shes rab can gsum/ grub thob gsum sogs byung / rang rgyud pa rnams de'i rjes su zhugs sa/ /rang rgyud mkhas pa'i srol chen dar bar mdzad/ / bsnyengs bral zla ba'i legs bshad ma nyams pa/ /gang babs bshad srol phul phyin pa tshab sdo/gas/ /lo tsā ba nyi ma grags pa la slob ma/ tshig la mkhas pa gang pa shes don la mkhas pa/ gtsang pa 'bre skur/ gnyis ka la mkhas pa rma bya zhang brtson/ gnyis ka la mi mkhas pa zhang thag sag pa sde pa tshab bu bzhir grags pa byung / thal 'gyur ba'i srol 'dzin pa rnams de'i rjes su zhugs/ klu sgrub dgongs pa sa gsum 'phags pa yi/ /rig pas bkral ba'i legs bshad 224

'tshechen 'od snang las/ saskya'i mosalung sa bsdus/ () mtshar gyi 'byung gnasabyang phyogasabi shwa ka tsan+dan gyi gling nasabargyud pa ste drug go rgyan gyi dgongs 'grel thogasamed sku mched sogasabashad srol rnam mang yang / /gang de 'grel la 'phags seng 'phagasapa grol sde dang / slob dpon seṅge bzang po khyad par 'phags/ /de dag bzhed gzhung rngog lo'i thugs mtshor babs/ /sher phyin rgyas mdzad 'bre ar rnam gnyis kyi/ rngog lo'i slob ma 'bre shesarab 'bar dang / de'i slob ma ar byang chub ye shes/ 'chad rtsom nyi zla'i 'od zer 'bum phrag gis/ /gangs can mun pa'i nags khrod gsal bar mdzad/ /pasan de'i rjesasu zhugs/ rtag chad mthar lta'i g.yangs su ma lhung zhing /bden gnyis/ zung 'jug lta ba'i them skas la 'dzegs nas/ /nges don chos sku'i khang bzang bgrod pa yi/ /'khor lo bar pa'i dngos bstan lam rim de/ /rgya gar yul du 'phags mchog klu yis bkral/ /legs ldan 'byed dang sangs rgyas bskyangs gnyis kyis/ /klu sgrub zhabs kyi dgongs pa 'grel tshul las/ /'phags pa'i yul du thal rang srol gnyis gyes/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir thamasacad mkhyen pa rngog lo'i slob ma dpal ldan phywa pa chosakyi seng ge 'di la slob ma seng chen brgyad/ jo srasagasum/ shesarab can gsum/ grub thob gsum sogasabyung / rang rgyud pa rnamasade'i rjesasu zhugasayis/ /rang rgyud mkhas pa'i srol chen dar bar mdzad/ / bsnyengs bral zla ba'i legs bshad ma nyams pa/ /gang babs bshad srol phul phyin pa tshab sdo/gas/ /lo tsā ba nyi ma gragasapa la slob ma/ tshig la mkhasapa gang pa shes don la mkhasang/ gtsang pa 'bre skur/ gnyisakal mkhasapa rma bya zhang brtson/ gnyis ka la mi mkhasapa zhang thag sag pa ste pa tshab bu bzhir gragasapa byung / thal 'gyur ba'i srol 'dzin pa rnamasade'i rjesasu zhugs/ klu sgrub dgongs pa sa gsum 'phags pa yi/ /rig pas bkral ba'i legs bshad 224

gangasari'i khrod kyi klog pa nyan bshad pa rnamasakyi snyan du springs pa thos bsam 'chi med bdud rtsi/bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug dpal ldan chos skyong dang / /'jam dbyags rnam 'phrul sa chen thugs mtshor babs/ /gzung ba'i chos kun nam yang yod min cing / /'dzin byed shes pa'ang 'khrul par gdon mi za/ /gnyis med ye shes sbyang gzhir bzhag pa ste/ /'khor lo tha ma'i lam gyi rim pa'o mi pham mgon dang klu sgrub snying po yis/ /byamasapa'i chos bzhi mdo sde rgyan/ rgyud bla ma/mosanyid rnam 'byed/ dbusamatha' rnam 'byed/ bstod tshogs gzhud gis bkral/ /thogaba'imed mched kyi gsung rab nyi 'od kyis/ /'khor lo tha ma'i nges don ches cher gsal/ /gangasari'i khrod 'dir mi pham rgyal ba dang / / thogs med mched kyi gzhung bzang ngo mtshar can/ /dbu sems so sor 'grel byed rnam mang yang / /gang de dbu ma'i gzhung du gdon mi za/ /chos mngon pa 'og ma rgya mtsho lta bu'i bka' babs 'ban dkon mchog rdo rje rog chos kyi brtson 'grus/tho gar gnam sdems kun dga' rdo rje / / byams chosagazhung gi nges don 'grel pa la/ /bshad dang sgrub pa'i bka' babs rnam pa gnyis/ /de dag rim bzhin rngog blo ldan shesarab dang btsan kha bo che gnyisal babs/ /thoba'ibasam sgom pas so sor khyad par 'phags/ /chos kun rig pa'i lam nas legs drangs te/ /gnas skabs gsung rab kun la lta ba'i mig /mthar thug kun mkhyen sgrub pa'i lam gyi srol/ /slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po dang de'i slob ma rgol ba dbang phyug sde'i slob ma mos kyi grags pa'i ring lugs bla na med/ /'phags pa'i yul du sde bdun rnam 'grel/ rnam nges/ rigs thig ste gtso bo gsum dang /gtan tshigasathigasapa/ 'brel ba brtag pa/ rgyud gzhan grub rī / rtsod pa/'i rig pa ste yan lag rgo bstan barbo+os bzhi'o/ /dgongs 'grel la/ /lha shāka bram ze rgyan dang chos mchog sogs/ /225

gangs ri'i khrod kyi klog pa nyan bshad pa rnams kyi snyan du springs pa thos bsam 'chi med bdud rtsi/bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug dpal ldan chos skyong dang / /'jam dbyags rnam 'phrul sa chen thugs mtshor babs/ /gzung ba'i chos kun nam yang yod min cing / /'dzin byed shes pa'ang 'khrul par gdon mi za/ /gnyis med ye shes sbyang gzhir bzhag pa ste/ /'khor lo tha ma'i lam gyi rim pa'o mi pham mgon dang klu sgrub snying po yis/ /byams pa' chos bzhi mdo sde rgyan/ rgyud bla ma/chos nyid rnam 'byed/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed/ bstod tshogs gzhud gis bkral/ /thog bshamed mched kyi gsung rab nyi 'od kyis/ /'khor lo tha ma'i nges don ches cher gsal/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir mi pham rgyal ba dang / / thogs med mched kyi gzhung bzang ngo mtshar can/ /dbu sems so sor 'grel byed rnam mang yang / /gang de dbu ma'i gzhung du gdon mi za/ /chos mngon pa 'og ma rgya mtsho lta bu'i bka' babs 'ban dkon mchog rdo rje rog chos kyi brtson 'grus/tho gar gnam sdems kun dga' rdo rje / / byams chos gzhud gi nges don 'grel pa la/ /bshad dang sgrub pa'i bka' babs rnam pa gnyis/ /de dag rim bzhin rngog blo ldan shes rab dang btsan kha bo che gnyis la babs/ /thos bsam sgom pas so sor khyad par 'phags/ /chos kun rig pa'i lam nas legs drangs te/ /gnas skabs gsung rab kun la lta ba'i mig /mthar thug kun mkhyen sgrub pa'i lam gyi srol/ /slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po dang de'i slob ma rgol ba dbang phyug sde'i slob ma chos kyi grags pa'i ring lugs bla na med/ /'phags pa'i yul du sde bdun rnam 'grel/ rnam nges/ rigs thig ste gtso bo gsum dang /gtan tshags thigs pa/ 'brel ba brtag pa/ rgyud gzhan grub rī / rtsod pa/'i rig pa ste yan lag rgo bstan bcos bzhi'o/ /dgongs 'grel la/ /lha shāka bram ze rgyan dang chos mchog sogs/ /225

'tshe chen 'od sna pa la / sa skya'i tsham 'gung gces bsdus/ ()chos grags slob ma kun mkhyen lha dbang blo/ de'i slob ma shākya blo gros/ gzhan yang bram ze bde byed dga' ba/ rgyan mkhan po sher 'byung sbas pa/ slob dpon chos mchog gam paṇa chen rgyal rnga bdun pa sos sa so/ /la la tshig nyung tshig gi phreng ba dang / /'ga' zhig dpyod ldan mkhas pas byas pa'ang yod/ /ngo bo nyid med khrog lo rnal 'byor spyod pa sa paṇa dang / /'jig rten grags sde'i phyis byon dbu mar 'grel pa yi/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'di'i bshad srol rnam pa gsum/ /kun las khyad 'phags bas skya pa yi lugs/ sa skya paṇa chen la slob ma shar nub gung gsum/ lho dmar gnyis/ grub tshogs gnyis sogs byung / tshad ma'i srol de'i rjes su zhugs/ sde snod mang thos grags ldan mkhas rnams kyang / /legs sbyar mi shes 'phags yul mkhas pa'i gzhung / /rang bzhin rkyen dang rnam dbye'i 'jug tshul sogs/ /gang 'chad de la su zhig yid rton byed/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang dgongs 'grel bstan bcos la/ /rnam dpyod brtson pas thos pa'i pha mthar son/ /tha snyad gtsug lag smra mkhas blo ldan de/ /gzur gnas mkhas mang tshogs pa'i mdun sar mdzes/ /sgra snyan bzo gso sgra 3 nang rig pa rnams la rig gnas che ba lnga dang / skar rtsis snyan ngag sdeb sbyor mngon brjod zlos gar rnams la rig gnas chung ba lnga zhes grags so/ /sdeb sbyor zlos gar mngon brjod sogs/ /tha snyad gtsug lag nyan dang 'chad 'dod na/ /skad gnyis smra ba'i gtsug rgyan shangs ston rdo rje rgyal mas dang / /dpang lo tsā blo gros brtan pa gsum pa'i bshad srol med du byung / /rgyu gzhi rgyud lam thabs rgyud 'bras bu mi 'phrog rgyud gsum gtan dbabs nas/ /sbyor dang dkyil 'khor 1dang las rgyal mchog rnam gnyis rdzogs rim 'phags pa'i lugs la rim pa lnga / / ste/ klu sgrub zhabs kyas/rdor bzlas/ sems la dmags pa/ sgyu lus/'od gsal/ zung 'jug 226

bgechen 'od snangalas/ sa skya'i 4ོ yang tsosabasdus/ ()chosagragasaslob ma kun mkhyen lha dbang blo/ de'i slob ma shākya blo gros/ gzhan yang bram ze bde byed dga' ba/ rgyan mkhan po sher 'byung sbas pa/ slob dpon mothomachog gam paṇa chen rgyal rnga bdun pa sosas so/ /la la tshig nyung tshig gi phreng ba dang / /'ga' zhig dpyod ldan mkhas pas byas pa'ang yod/ /ngo bo nyid med rngeg lo rnal 'byor spyod pa sapaṇa dang / /'jig rten grags sde'i phyis byon dbu mar 'grel pa yi/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'di'i bshad srol rnam pa gsum/ /kun las khyad 'phags bkaskya pa yi lugs/ saskya paṇa chen la slob ma shar nub gung gsum/ lho dmar gnyis/ grub tshogasaganyisasogasabyung / tshad ma'i srol de'i rjes su zhugs/ sde snod mang thos grags ldan mkhas rnams kyang / /legs sbyar mi shes 'phags yul mkhas pa'i gzhung / /rang bzhin rkyen dang rnam dbye'i 'jug tshul sogs/ /gang 'chad de la su zhig yid rton byed/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang dgongs 'grel bstan bcos la/ /rnam dpyod brtson pas thos pa'i pha mthar son/ /tha snyad gtsug lag smra mkhas blo ldan de/ /gzur gnasamakhas mang tshogs pa'i mdun sar mdzes/ /sgra snyan bzo gso sgra 3 nang rig pa rnamasal rig gnas che ba lnga dang / skar rtsis snyan ngag sdeb sbyor mngon brjod zlosagar rnamasal rig gnas chung ba lnga zhes grags so/ /sdeb sbyor zlos gar mngon brjod sogs/ /tha snyad gtsug lag nyan dang 'chad 'dod na/ /skad gnyis smra ba'i gtsug rgyan shangs ston rdo rje rgyal mas dang / /dpang lo tsā blo grosabartan pa gsum pa'i bshad srol med du byung / /rgyu gzhi rgyud lam thabs rgyud 'brasabu mi 'phrog rgyud gsum gtan dbabs nas/ /sbyor dang dkyil 'bor 1dang las rgyal mchog rnam gnyis rdzogasarim 'phagasapa'i lugasal rim pa lnga / / ste/ klu sgrub zhabasakyis/rdor bzlas/ semasaladamigasapa/ sgyu lus/'od gsal/ zung 'jug 226

gangs ri'i khrod kyi klog pa nyan bshad pa rnams kyi snyan du springs pa thos bsam 'chi med bdud rtsi/྅ dang / zla grags kyis/ rten bskyed rim/ gzhi dben gsum/ sgyu lus dngos/ 'od gsal/ zung 'jug lnga la bzhed/ /ye shes zhabs lugs la thig le bzhi ste/ dga' ba'i ye shes kyi dbang du byas nasasdeng gi thig le/ mchog dga'i ye shes kyi dbang du byas nas nor bur gsang ba'i thig le/ dga' bral ye shes kyi dbang du byas na gnas gzhin sprul pa'i thig le/ lhan cig skyes dga'i ye shes kyi dbang du byasanas snying gar mi shigs pa'i thig le bsgom tshul/ sogs bskyed rdzogs lam bsgom pa/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa lam gyi rim pa'o/ /'dus pa'i rgyud la klu sgrub yab sras dang / /ye shes / zhabs kha kyis rim par bkral ba la/ /'phags pa'i yul du 'dus pa 'phags lugs dang / /ye shes 6khas lugs rgya bod mkhas rnams bzhed/ /bod 'dir 'phags lugs la lo r+sā 'gos dang mar pa lotsā ba chog kyi blo gros rong par 'gar dge chag chos rje dpal dpyal chos bzang dang / /ye shes zhabs lugs la lo chen rin bzang gnyos rdo rje bla ma dang rwa rdo rje grags lugs sogs/ /gangs can 'dir yang 'dus pa'i srol rnams byung / /'gos lo'i tswas khug pa lhas btsas lugs bzang brgyud 'dzin gyi slob ma rgyud kyi ka ba tshugs pa bzhi/ man ngag gi gdung ma theg pa brgyad/ las tshogs dang phrin las la mkhas pa dral phyam gshibs pa ltar dpag tu med pa yod do/ 'od stong can/ /phyi nang rang lus dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs/ /rtsa yig bdud rtsi dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma/ /rim pa lnga dang bde mchog lha lha pa'i rdzogs ram la/ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdu ba / ye ge bsdu ba/ thig le bsdu bste bsdu ba gsum sogs dang / dril bu par/ bdag byin gyis brlabasapa 'i/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i/ nor bu 'gengs pa'i/ dzol rgyu ra'i/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rim pa ste lnga'o/ /rim bzhi'i rnal 'byor ni nag po pa'i lugs te/ shes bya rgyud kye rim pa/ nyams len sngags kyi rim pa/ ye shes skye ba'i rim pa / 'bras bu gsang ba'i rim pa'o/ sogs/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i 227

gangasari'i khrod kyi klogapa nyan bshad pa rnamasakyi snyan du springasapa thos bsam 'chi med bdud rtsi/྅ dang / zla gragasakyis/ rten bskyed rim/ gzhi dben gsum/ sgyu lusadangos/ 'od gsal/ zung 'jug lnga la bzhed/ /ye shesazhabasalugasal thig le bzhi ste/ dga' ba'i ye shesakyi dbang du byasanasasdeng gi thig le/ mchog dga'i ye shesakyi dbang du byasanaganor bur gsang ba'i thigale/ dga' bral ye shesakyi dbang du byasan gnasagazhir sprul pa'i thig le/ lhan cig skyesadaga'i ye shesakyi dbang du byasanas snying gar mi shigasapa'i thig le bsgom tshul/ sogs bskyed rdzogs lam bsgom pa/ /dpal ldan 'dusapa'i lam gyi rim pa'o/ /'dus pa'i rgyud la klu sgrub yab sras dang / /ye shesazhabasakyis rim par bkral ba la/ /'phags pa'i yul du 'dus pa 'phags lugs dang / /ye shes thebs lugs rgya bod mkhas rnams bzhed/ /bod 'dir 'phagasalugasalalo r+sā 'gos dang mar pa lotsā ba mosakyi blo grosarong par 'gar dge chag chosarje dpal dpyal chosabazang dang / /ye shesazhabasalugasal lo chen rin bzang gnyosardo rje bla ma dang rwa rdo rje gragasalugs sogs/ /gangasacan 'dir yang 'dus pa'i srol rnamasabyung / /'gosalo'i tswabakhug pa lhasabatsasalugasabazang brgyud 'dzin gyi slob ma rgyud kyi ka ba tshugs pa bzhi/ man ngag gi gdung ma theg pa brgyad/ lasatshogs dang phrin las la mkhasapa dralaphyam gshibs pa ltar dpag tu med pa yod do/ 'od stong can/ /phyi nang rang lus dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs/ /rtsa yig bdud rtsi dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma/ /rim pa lnga dang bde mchog lū lha pa'i rdzogasarim la/ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdu ba / ye ge bsdu ba/ thig le bsdu bste bsdu ba gsumasogasadang / dril bu par/ bdag byin gyisabarlabasapa 'i/ sna tshogasardo rje'i/ nor bu 'gengasapa'i/ dzo'adze ra'i/ bsamagyisami khyab pa'i rim pa ste lnga'o/ /rim bzhi'i rnal 'byor ni nag po pa'i lugasate/ shesabya rgyud kye rim pa/ nyamasalen sngagasakyi rim pa/ ye shesaskye ba'i rim pa / 'brasabu gsang ba'i rim pa'o/ sogs/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i 227

bzuchen 'od snang las/ saskya'i chos sing sa bsdus/ ()lam gyi rim pa'o/ /rnal 'byor gsang mtha' 'khor lo bde mchog rgyud/ /lū hi pa dang grub chen dril bu pa/ /nag po'i zhabasakyis rim par bkral ba las/ /'phags pa'i yul du lū dril nag gsum lugs/ /grub mal dang mar pa do pa chos kyi dbang po pu hrang pa/ /lo chung grags mchog shesarab/ rong pa 'gar dge g.yag sde lo tsā ba bsod nams bzang po rnam gnyibasasbal sna spang sna'i lugab/la sogs/ /bde mchog srol rnams bod yul ljongs su babs/ /rje btsun mal gyo lo tswab blo grosagragasapa gyis gzhung bsgyur gtan la phab/ /rgyu rigasasbang bya rkyen la ltosapa rgyur gnas spyod dang skyabs semasagaso sbyong gtan khrimasalta ba grub mtha' bzhi'i rgyud sde bzhir/ /rim zhugs smin byed lta ba bskyed rdzogs spyod pa dang nye rgyu mchog thun bzlasapa dang gtor ma sbyin sreg rab gnas lasatshogs rab 'byams mngon rtogs dang / /grogab(dmatshig dang sdom pa bcas gnasaskabs dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu rnam gnyis la sbyor ba/ /dgyesapa rdo rje'i lam gyi rim pa'o/ /dgyes rdor rgyud la mtsho skyes nag po pa/ /mi thub zla ba rin chen 'byung gnas dang / /nā ro pa dang mi tri'i lugs rnamasate/ /'phags pa'i yul du dgyes rdor srol chen drug /dang / kha che snyan gragasabazang po'i lugasate lugasasrol yongs su rdzogs pa bdun du'ang bzhed la/ spyir 'grel byed ni rdo rje snying po sogasabastoganyisabyung bar grags so/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba shākya ye shes 'gos kyi gyo zla ba'i 'od zer mar pa chos kyi blo gros dpyal kun dga' rdo rje rams lding ma ba sangs rgyas 'byung gnasasdo/gas sogs/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir bshad srol rnam mang yang / /snga ma gsum ga ya bhā ra dang / phyi ma nā ro pa'i brgyud 'ardzan no/ /'brog mi'i lugs bzang dpal ldan sa skya pas/ /bshad dang sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan rtse la bkod/ /228

snab tshe chen 'od snang las/ sa skya' chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ltas/lam gyi rim pa'o/ /rnal 'byor gsang mtha' 'khor lo bde mchog rgyud/ /lha hi pa dang grub chen dril bu pa/ /nag po'i zhabs kyis rim par bkral ba las/ /'phags pa'i yul du lū dril nag gsum lugs/ /grub chen mal dang mar pa do pa chos kyi dbang po pu hrang pa/ /lo chung grags mchog shes rab/ rong pa 'gar dge g.yag sde lo tsā ba bsod nams bzang po rnam gnyis ( sbal sna spang sna'i lugs la sogs/ /bde mchog srol rnams bod yul ljongs su babs/ /rje btsun mal gyo lo tswab blo gros grags pa gyis gzhung bsgyur gtan la phab/ /rgyu rigs sbang bya rkyen la ltos pa rgyur gnas spyod dang skyabs sems gso sbyong gtan khrims lta ba grub mtha' bzhi'i rgyud sde bzhir/ /rim zhugs smin byed lta ba bskyed rdzogs spyod pa dang nye rgyu mchog thun bzlas pa dang gtor ma sbyin sreg rab gnas las tshogs rab 'byams mngon rtogs dang / /gsang dam tshig dang sdom pa bcas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu rnam gnyis la sbyor ba/ /dgyes pa rdo rje'i lam gyi rim pa'o/ /dgyes rdor rgyud la mtsho skyes nag po pa/ /mi thub zla ba rin chen 'byung gnas dang / /nā ro pa dang mi tri'i lugs rnams te/ /'phags pa'i yul du dgyes rdor srol chen drug /dang / kha che snyan grags bzang po'i lugs te lugasasrol yongs su rdzogs pa bdun du'ang bzhed la/ spyir 'grel byed ni rdo rje snying po sogs bgraganyis byung bar grags so/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba shākya ye shes 'gos kyi gyo zla ba'i 'od zer mar pa chos kyi blo gros dpyal kun dga' rdo rje rams lding ma ba sangs rgyas 'byung gnas sdo/gas tre(gas/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir bshad srol rnam mang yang / /snga ma gsum ga ya bhā ra dang / phyi ma nā ro pa'i brgyud 'dzin no/ /'brog mi'i lugs bzang dpal ldan sa skya pas/ /bshad dang sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan rtse la bkod/ /228

gangs ri'i khrod kyi klog pa nyan bshad pa rnams kyi snyan du springs pa thos bsam 'chi med bdud rtsi/phyi 'jig rten khams 1dang nang lus 2rnam dag dang / /gzhan byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun/ gong ma bzhi bcas bcu gcig dbang bskur3bskyed rim gyis thun mong 4dngos grub dang / /rdzogs rim gyis lam mchog 5dngos grub tshe 'dir sgrub byed pa / / dpal ldan she dus 'khar lam gyi rim pa'o/ /gong gi don wo lnga po dus lha bar bsdusargyud le'u lngas rim par ston/ thabs shes gnyis med dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud/ /zla bzang la sogs sprul pa'i chas rgyal bdun/ /ni/ cho las/ zla bzang lha dbang gzi brjid can/ /zla bas byin dang lha'i dbang phyug /sna tshogs gzugs dang lha dbang ldan/ ces so/ /'jam dpal grags sku tegs rigs ldan nga me gcig las/ zla bzang la sogs sprul pa'i chos rgyal drug/pad+ma dkar sogs rigs ldan nyer lnga dang zhes pa'ang snang /nyer lnga ni/ snga mar/ grags pa rigs ldan rigs kyang ste/ /de nas rigs ldan pad+ma dkar/ /bzang po rags ldan gsum pa ste/ /de bzhin bzhi pa rnam rgyal lo/ /bshes gnyen bzang po rin chen phyag /bdun pa khyab 'jug sbas pa'o/ /nyi ma grags dang shin tu bzang //rgya mtsho rnam rgyal rgyal dka' dang //rigs ldan nyi ma bcu gnyis pa//sna tsho gos gzugs dang zla ba'i 'od/ /mtha' yas dang ni sa skyong dang / /dpal skyong seng ge rnam par gnon/ /stobs po che dang ma 'gags pa/ /mi yi seng ge dbang phyug che/ /mtha' yas rnam rgyal rigs ldan dang / /grags pa rigs ldan de nas slar/ /de sras 'khor lo chen po can/ /rigs ldan drag po 'byung 'gyur te/ /smra mkhas rta mchog ting ridzin gyis/ /kla klo'i chos ni mthar byed pa'o/ /zhes so/ dang / /dus zhabs pa dang tsi lu paṇa chen gyis/ /snga ma rnams kyis sham+bha la dang phyi ma gnyis kyis 'phags pa'i yul du spel/ /gyi gyo lo tsā ba zla ba'i 'od zer/ rtsa mi bsod snyoms pa sangs rgyas grags dang rwa chos rab 'bro shas rab grags rnam par gnyis/ /chag chos rje dpal dpyal kun dga' rdo rje rong pa rgya lo rnam rgyal rdo rje jo nang pa zhal zha lu bu ston rin po che'i lugs sogs kyis/ lugs srol 229

gangasari'i khrod kyi klog pa nyan bshad pa rnamasakyi snyan du springasapa tho4bsam 'chi med bdud rtsi/phyi 'jig rten khams 1dang nang lus 2rnam dag dang / /gzhan byisapa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun/ gong ma bzhi bcas bcu gcig dbang bskur3bskyed rim gyis thun mong 4dngos grub dang / /rdzogasarim gyisalam mchog 5dngos grub tshe 'dir sgrub byed pa / / dpal ldan dusa'akhor lam gyi rim pa'o/ /gongagi don tshan lnga po dusa'abor bsdusargyud le'u lngasarim par ston/ thabs shes gnyis med dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud/ /zla bzang la sogasasprul pa'i chosargyal bdun/ /ni/ rtsargyud las/ zla bzang lha dbang gzi brjid can/ /zla bsabyin dang lha'i dbang phyug /sna tshogs gzugs dang lha dbang ldan/ ces so/ /'jam dpal grags sogs rigs ldan ngame gcig las/ zla bzang la sogs sprul pa'i chos rgyal drug/pad+ma dkar sogasarigasaldan nyer lnga dang zhes pa'ang snang /nyer lnga ni/ snga mar/ gragasapa rigs ldan rigasakyang ste/ /de nas rigasaldan pad+ma dkar/ /bzang po rigasaldan gsum pa ste/ /de bzhin bzhi pa rnam rgyal lo/ /bshesaganyen bzang po rin chen phyag /bdun pa khyab 'jug sbasapa'o/ /nyi ma gragasadang shin tu bzang //rgya mtsho rnam rgyal rgyal dka' dang //rigs ldan nyi ma bcu gnyisapa//sna tshogasagazugs dang zla ba'i 'od/ /mtha' yasadang ni saskyong dang / /dpal skyong seng ge rnam par gnon/ /stobasapo che dang ma 'gags pa/ /mi yi seng ge dbang phyug che/ /mtha' yas rnam rgyal rigs ldan dang / /grags pa rigs ldan de nasaslar/ /de srasa'akhor lo chen po can/ /rigasaldan drag po 'byung 'gyur te/ /smra mkhasarta mchog ting ridzin gyis/ /kla klo'i chagani mthar byed pa'o/ /zhesaso/ dang / /dus zhabs pa dang tsi lu paṇa chen gyis/ /snga ma rnamasakyis sham+bha la dang phyi ma gnyisakyisa'aphags pa'i yul du spel/ /gyi gyo lo tsā ba zla ba'i 'od zer/ rtsa mi bsod snyomasapa sangasargyasagragasadang rwa chosarab 'bro shesarab gragasarnam par gnyis/ /chag chosarje dpal dpyal kun dga' rdo rje rong pa rgya lo rnam rgyal rdo rje jo nang pa zhal zha lu bu ston rin po che'i lugs sogs kyis/ lugs srol 229

bzur+ṣa 'od snangal /saskya' yo+ogaskang sa bsdus/()mtha' yasapa ste/bsdusargyud rtsa 'grel kho na la'ang 'gyur mgo nyer lnga tsam byung bsamatshon no//gangs can bstan pa'i pad tshal gsal bar mdzad//rwa 'bro'i bshad srol nyi zla'i 'od risacan//spyir bod yula'adir/gsang 'dusamar 'gosagalhosagasum/'jigasabyed rwa skyo zhang gsum/bde mchog mal mar lo gsum/kye rdor 'brog 'gosamar gsum/dusa'akhor rwa 'bro rtsa gsum lasagatso bor byung zhesagazur gnasakyi mkhasapa kun la gtam du gragasaso//slob ma'i dbang lnga sngon du 'gro bsaslob dpon dbang bskur phyir mi ldog pa'i dam tshig gsum bzung ba/gsang dkyil du gsang ba'i 'jug pasazhugasashing mthong ba/lha dang dkyila'abor gyi de nyid/slob dpon gyi lasarim rnamasashesapar bya ba/a mong ma yin pa'i mosalas rjesaganang /lung bstan dbugasadabyung gzengasabastod de drug rang rgyud smin byas nas//bdag mdun gnyis ka dag pa'i sku ru bskyed//ye shes spyan drangs de nyid nga rgyal bzung //rnal 'byor rgyud kyi lam gyi rim pa'o//rnal 'byor rgyud kye dgongs pa 'grel ba la / / rgya gar du don la mkhasapa sangs rgyasagasang ba tshigalamakhasapa shākya bshesaganyen dang //tshig don gnyisasal mkhasapa yongasardzogasapaṇa kun dga' snying po ste//bshes gnyen rnam gsum bstan pa'i rgyan du shar//bod yula'adir dang po'i srol 'byed lo chen brgyud par bcas//rin wo bzang po rgyagar du lan gsum byon/sku tshe'i stod du lag len kun snying dang /bshad pa shākya bshesaganyen gyi lugasaltar mdzad pas/phyisayo ga smad lugasadang /sku tshe'i mjug tu bshad pa dang lag len gnya kakun snying gi lugasakho na mdzad pa lasayo ga stod lugasasu gragasapa byung /slob ma mang yang /thugasasrasakyi mchog bzhi ste/lo chung legasapa'i shesarab/mang nang gi gur shing brtson 'grusargyalama'/grwa pa gzhon nu shesarab/skyi nor sgo na rnams so / / bar du dar mdzad saskya ba snur hūm̐ sna'od zer 'dzim pa blo r+ṣa gsum sogs//

ba tshe chen 'od snang la /sa skya' chogang sa bsdus/()mtha' yas pa ste/bsdus rgyud rtsa 'grel kho na la'ang 'gyur mgo nyer lnga tsam byung bas mtshon no//gangs can bstan pa'i pad tshal gsal bar mdzad//rwa 'bro'i bshad srol nyi zla'i 'od ris can//spyir bod yul 'dir/gsang 'dus mar 'gos gnyos gsum/'jigs byed rwa skyo zhad gsum/bde mchog mal mar lo gsum/kye rdor 'brog 'gos mar gsum/dus 'khor rwa 'bro rtsa gsum las gtso bor byung zhes gzur gnas kyi mkhas pa kun la gtam du grags so//slob ma'i dbang lnga sngon du 'gro bas slob dpon dbang bskur phyir mi ldog pa'i dam ṣ+ka gsum bzung ba/gsang dkyil du gsang ba'i 'jug pas zhugs shing mthong ba/lha dang dkyil 'khor gyi de nyid/slob dpon gyi las rim rnams shes par bya ba/a mong ma yin pa'i chos la ra rjes gnang /lung bstan dbugs dbyung ga phrengs bstod de drug rang rgyud smin byas nas//bdag mdun gnyis ka dag pa'i sku ru bskyed//ye shes spyan drangs de nyid nga rgyal bzung //rnal 'byor rgyud kyi lam gyi rim pa'o//rnal 'byor rgyud kye dgongs pa 'grel ba la / / rgya gar du don la mkhas pa sangs rgyas gsang ba tshig la mkhas pa shākya bsheb(gnyen dang //tshig don ga spyig kal mabs pa yongs rdzogs paṇa chen kun dga' snying po ste//bshes gnyen rnam gsum bstan pa'i rgyan du shar//bod yul 'dir dang po'i srol 'byed lo chen brgyud par bcas//rin wo bzang po rgya gar du lan gsum byon/sku tshe'i stod du lag len kun snying dang /bshad pa shākya bshes gnyen gyi lugs ltar mdzad pas/phyis bo ga smad lugs dang /sku tshe'i mjug tu bshad pa dang lag len gnya na kun snying gi lugs kho na mdzad pa las yo ga stod lugs su grags pa byung /slob ma mang yang /thugs sras kyi mchog bzhi ste/lo chung legs pa'i shes rab/mang nang gi gur shing brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan/grwa pa gzhon nu shes rab/skyi nor sgo na rnams so / / bar du dar mdzad byu ba snur nyi mo'od zer 'dzim pa blo r+ṣa gsum sogs//230

gangasari'i khrod kyi klog pa nyan bshad pa rnamasakyi snyan du springasapa thosabasam 'chi med bdud rtsi/dang / jo bo dang rin bzang gi brgyud 'dzin rnams/ tha mar spel mdzad kun mkhyen bu ston rin chen grub/ /gang 'di snyigasadusargyal ba gnyisapa'o/ /chu cod pan/ mtha' rten dang bosapa'i dbang sogs kyis rang rgyud smin byas nas/ /mdun bskyed thugs gar yig 'bru'i sa bon bkod/ /rje dpon lta bur dngosagrub len byed pa/ /bya ba'i rgyud kyi lam gyi rim pa'o/ /bya rgyud kyi dbang rnamasakyi steng rdo rje dril bu'i dbang gis smin byas nas/ /bdag mdun gnyis ga'i thugs dar yig 'bru bkod/ /grogs po lta bu'i dngos grub len byed pa/ /spyod pa'i rgyud kyi lam gyi rim pa'o//de lta bu'i bya spyod shing rta'i srol 'byed pa bya rgyud la slob dpon byang chub mchog /dang /spyod rgyud la slob dpon sangs rgyasagasang ba'i bshad srol phun sum tshogs/ /gangs can 'dir yang bya spyod rgyud sde la/ /ngo mtshar bshad pa'i brgyud 'dzin bla ma ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen gragasapa sogasabagrang yas byon/ /yang rgya gar du phyis jo bo dz+nya na shrī dang / purkyeshrī gnyis lung mang bar gragasal/ bod 'dir steng ba lo tsā ba tshul khrimasa'abyung gnas/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags sogasadang / phyi su shabs bag ston gzhen nu tshul khrims kyi thugs bskyed dang brtson 2grus kyi mthu phun sum tshogasapa la brten nas sde snod rgyud sde dang bcas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog yongasasu rdzogasapa phal mo che'i lung tshang bar bzhugs so/ /'phagaba'ipa'i yul dang gangs ri'i khrod 'dir yang / /mdo sngags gnyis kyi 'grosachen ma 'khrul pa/ /sngon rabs mkhas pas bkral ba'i bshad srol te/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi bzhed gzhung yin/ /'on kyang byang phyogs gangs ri'i khrod 'di sa /log pa'i gzhung lugs rnam dag rgyud sde rtswa /mngon chen dam pos 'bad nas nyan pa dang / /gzhan la 'chad pa'i mkhas rlom mang zhig byung / /'ga' zhig grags 'dod chang 231

gangs ri'i khrod kyi klog pa nyan bshad pa rnams kyi snyan du springs pa thos bsam 'chi med bdud rtsi/dang / jo bo dang rin bzang gi brgyud 'dzin rnams/ tha mar spel mdzad kun mkhyen bu ston rin chen grub/ /gang 'di snyigs dus rgyal ba gnyis pa'o/ /chu cod pan/ mtha' rten dang sa pa'i dbang sogs kyis rang rgyud smin byas nas/ /mdun bskyed thugs gar yig 'bru'i sa bon bkod/ /rje dpon lta bur dngos grub len byed pa/ /bya ba'i rgyud kyi lam gyi rim pa'o/ /bya rgyud kyi dbang rnams kyi steng rdo rje dril bu'i dbang gis smin byas nas/ /bdag mdun gnyis ga'i thugs dar yig 'bru bkod/ /grogs po lta bu'i dngos grub len byed pa/ /spyod pa'i rgyud kyi lam gyi rim pa'o//de lta bu'i bya spyod shing rta'i srol 'byed pa bya rgyud la slob dpon byang chub mchog /dang /spyod rgyud la slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba'i bshad srol phun sum tshogs/ /gangs can 'dir yang bya spyod rgyud sde la/ /ngo mtshar bshad pa'i brgyud 'dzin bla ma ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags pa sogs bgrang yas byon/ /yang rgya gar du phyis jo bo dz+nya na shrī dang / pubyeshrī gnyis lung mang bar grags la/ bod 'dir steng ba lo tsā ba tshul khrams 'byung gnas/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags sogs dang / phyi su shabs bag ston gzhan nu tshul khrims kyi thugs bskyed dang brtson 4grus kyi mthu phun sum tsho gos pa la brten nas sde snod rgyud sde dang bcas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog yongs su rdzogs pa phal mo che'i lung tshang bar bzhugs so/ /'phags pa'i yul dang gangs ri'i khrod 'dir yang / /mdo sngags gnyis kyi 'gros chen ma 'khrul pa/ /sngon rabs mkhas pas bkral ba'i bshad srol te/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi bzhed gzhung yin/ /'on kyang byang phyogs gangs ri'i khrod 'di sa /log pa'i gzhung lugs rnam dag rgyud sde rtswa /mngon chen dam pos 'bad nas nyan pa dang / /gzhan la 'chad pa'i mkhas rlom mang zhig byung / /'ga' zhig grags 'dod chang 231

ba tshe chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'grang gces bsdus/ ()gis rab myos nas/ /rgyal ba'i bka' sa 'gyur gyi rgyud lung man ngag dang tshad ldan gzhung rnams dang / /de dag sgyur byed lo paṇa pad 'grang bi ma be+e ro sogs mkhas rnams la/ /brtsad cing rgol ba'i lo rtog mang zhig mthong / kha cig 'di na rang bzo'i sbyor ba yis/ /sngon rabs mkhas pas bkral ba'i bshad srol rnams/ /mi mngon nam mkha'i dbyings su rab bcings nas/ /rang 'dod grub mtha'i rgyu skar bgrang yas 'char/ /gsang chen rgyud dang dbu sems shing rta'i srol/ /klu sgrub dgongs pa thal rang srol gnyis kyis/ /legs par bkral ba'i bshad srol zla med pa/ /de dag phal cher 'byog po'i lam du bkral/ /tshad ldan gzhung bzhin 'chad pa'i mkhas rnams kyis/ /sngon rabs mkhas pa'i bshad srol gzhung bsrangs nas/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pas thub bstan bzung ba na/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa gnyis shig byung / /nyan bshad thub bstan 'dzin par rlom rnams kyang / /gzhan gzhung 'jig dang rang gzhung bsgrub pa'i phyir/ khungs med tshig phreng lbu ba'i zol gyis ni/ /rang phyogs 'phyar ba'i rtsod pas thub bstan dkrugs/ /la la rgyal ba'i bka' dang dgongs 'grel gyi/ /tshad ldan gzhung gi nyan bshad kun dor nas/ /rang rang 'dod pas sbyar ba'i gzhung lugs la/ /nyan bshad bgyid pas tshe lo 'da' ba mtshar/ /tshe 'di che thabs rnyed bkur lhur blangs nas/ /pha rol brnyas dang phrag dog 'gran sems kyis/ /rang nyid bsgom dang gzhan la 'dom/sa kyang rung / /sgo gsum bya ba phal cher don med yin/ /de phyir blo gsal klog pa lhur len rnams/ /rang gzhan grub mtha'i rnam dbye legs rtogs nas/ /sngar bshad mkhas pas bkral ba'i bshad 232

brtsechen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'grang gtses bsdus/ ()gis rab myos nas/ /rgyal ba'i bka' sa'agyur gyi rgyud lung man ngag dang tshad ldan gzhung rnams dang / /de dag sgyur byed lo paṇa pad 'byung bi ma be+e ro sogasamakhas rnams la/ /brtsad cing rgol ba'i lo rtog mang zhig mthong / kha cig 'di na rang bzo'i sbyor ba yis/ /sngon rabs mkhas pas bkral ba'i bshad srol rnams/ /mi mngon nam mkha'i dbyings su rab bcings nas/ /rang 'dod grub mtha'i rgyu skar bgrang yas 'char/ /gsang chen rgyud dang dbu sems shing rta'i srol/ /klu sgrub dgongs pa thal rang srol gnyis kyis/ /legs par bkral ba'i bshad srol zla med pa/ /de dag phal cher 'khyog po'i lam du bkral/ /tshad ldan gzhung bzhin 'chad pa'i mkhas rnamaso kyiso/ /sngon rabs mkhas pa'i bshad srol gzhung bsrangs nas/ /'chad rtsad rtsam pas thub bstan bzung ba na/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa gnyis shig byung / /nyan bshad thub bstan 'dzin par rlom rnams kyang / /gzhan gzhung 'jig dang rang gzhung bsgrub pa'i phyir/ khungs med tshig phreng lbu ba'i zol gyis ni/ /rang phyogs 'phyar ba'i rtsod pas thub bstan dkrugs/ /la la rgyal ba'i bka' dang dgongs 'grel gyi/ /tshad ldan gzhung gi nyan bshad kun dor nas/ /rang rang 'dod pasasbyar ba'i gzhung lugs la/ /nyan bshad bgyid pas tshe lo 'da' ba mtshar/ /tshe 'di che thabs rnyed bkur lhur blangs nas/ /pha rol brnyas dang phrag dog 'gran sems kyis/ /rang nyid bsgom dang gzhan la 'dom/sa kyang rung / /sgo gsum bya ba phal cher don med yin/ /de phyir blo gsal klog pa lhur len rnams/ /rang g.yin grub mtha'i rnam dbye legs rtogs nas/ /sngar bshad mkhas pas bkral ba'i bshad 232

gangasari'i khrod kyi klog pa nyan bshad pa rnamasakyi snyan du springs pa thos bsam 3cho med bdud rtsi/srol la/ /rnam dpyod brtson pas thos pa'i pha mthar skyol/ /rig pa'i gnas la thos bsam mthar phyin nas/ /thos pa'i don rnams don yod bya ba'i phyir/ /ting 'dzin sgom pa'i bya ba lhur blangs nas/ /dben pa'i gnas su rang rgyud smin par mdzod/ /rang rgyud smin nas 'khor mang dbus su ni/ /dri med gzhung la rig grol spobs pa yis/ /rtsod rtsom mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam gsum gyis/ /gcig tu bstan pa 'ba' zhig lhag par dgongs/ /'chad pa rna ba'i bdud rtsi lha yi dbyangs/ /'jigasamed spobs pa mi zad chu bo'i rgyun/ /rtsom phreng thub bstan mdzes pa'i khang bzang rgyan/ /de dag gsum gyis g.yin la 'doms par mdzod//dgos bsdus tshig don mtshams sbyor brgal lan bcas/ /bsgrub dang sun 'byin tsher ma dbyung la mkhas/ /sgra gnabasnabargyad ni ji skad du/ sgra skad ming dang mtshan ma dang / /brda dang tha snyad tshig don brgyad/ /cesapas/ sgra ni/ zin pa'i sgra semasacan du ston pa'o/ /skad ni/legasasbyar sogasabazhi'o/ /ming ni/ mngon pa'i lugasakyi yi ge 'dusapa dang / brda sprod pasabyings la rkyen sbyar zhing rnam dbye ma sbyar ba'o/ /mtshan ma ni/ ming desamatshon par byed pa'o/ /brda rne/ trī snya da sngar med pa la glo bur du 'dod pasasbyar ba ste/ yal ga dang lo ma ldan pa'i ming la shing zhes btags pa sa/ming ming can du 'brel ba go ba lta bu'o/ /tha snyad ni/ de nyid la 'jug ldog byed pa'i phyir brjod pa ste/gdung 'digasanusapa'i shing la ka ba zhesabatagasapa lta bu'o/ /tshig ni/ mngon pa'i lugasakyi ming 'dusapa dang / brda sprod pa byingasadang ming la ting sub kyi rkyen sbyar ba la 'dod do/ /don ni/ chosagang zhig rang rang gi gnasalugasaji ltar gnas pa ste/ me'i ngo bo tsha ba lta bu'o kyi tshig sbyor kun chang ba'i /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'ang de ltar tshims par mdzod/ /ne+e sdu'i 'don nga sa mkhas par rlom pa dang / /tshul 'chos spyod pas btsun par 'chos pa dang / /stong pa'i 233

gangs ri'i khrod kyi klog pa nyan bshad pa rnams kyi snyan du springs pa thos bsam ri chi med bdud rtsi/srol la/ /rnam dpyod brtson pas thos pa'i pha mthar skyol/ /rig pa'i gnas la thos bsam mthar phyin nas/ /thos pa'i don rnams don yod bya ba'i phyir/ /ting 'dzin sgom pa'i bya ba lhur blangs nas/ /dben pa'i gnas su rang rgyud smin par mdzod/ /rang rgyud smin nas 'khor mang dbus su ni/ /dri med gzhung la rig grol spobs pa yis/ /rtsod rtsom mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam gsum gyis/ /gcig tu bstan pa 'ba' zhig lhag par dgongs/ /'chad pa rna ba'i bdud rtsi lha yi dbyangs/ /'jigs med spobs pa mi zad chu bo'i rgyun/ /rtsom phreng thub bstan mdzes pa'i khang bzang rgyan/ /de dag gsum gyis gzhan la 'doms par mdzod//dgos bsdus tshig don mtshams sbyor brgal lan bcas/ /bsgrub dang sun 'byin tsher ma dbyung la mkhas/ /sgra gnabs brgyad ni ji skad du/ sgra skad ming dang mtshan ma dang / /brda dang tha snyad tshig don brgyad/ /ces pas/ sgra ni/ zin pa'i sgra sems can du ston pa'o/ /skad ni/legs sbyar sogs bzhi'o/ /ming ni/ mngon pa'i lugs kyi yi ge 'dus pa dang / brda sprod pas byangs la rkyen sbyar zhing rnam dbye ma sbyar ba'o/ /mtshan ma ni/ ming des mtsho ni par byed pa'o/ /brda rne/ ri snya da sngar med pa la glo bur du 'dod pas sbyar ba ste/ yal ga dang lo ma ldan pa'i ming la shing zhes btags pa sa/ming ming can du 'brel ba go ba lta bu'o/ /tha snyad ni/ de nyid la 'jug ldog byed pa'i phyir brjod pa ste/gdung 'digs nus pa'i shing la ka ba zhes btags pa lta bu'o/ /tshig ni/ mngon pa'i lugs kyi ming 'dusapa dang / brda sprod pa byangs dang ming la ting sub kyi rkyen sbyar ba la 'dod do/ /don ni/ chos gang zhig rang rang gi gnas lugs ji ltar gnas pa ste/ me'i ngo bo tsha ba lta bu'o kyi tshig sbyor kun chang ba'i /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'ang de ltar tshims par mdzod/ /ba sdu'i 'don nga sa mkhas par rlom pa dang / /tshul 'chos spyod pas btsun par 'chos pa dang / /stong pa'i 233

ba chen 'od sna pa las/ sa skya'i cho skung byu bsdus/ ()'ud sa bzang por brdzub yi/ /klog pa ba de 'jig rten sgyu ma mkhan/ /'gro kun srid pa'i mtsho las bsgral ba'i phyir/ /gcig tu bstan pa 'ba' zhig nyer dgongs nas/ /rnam dag gzhung lugs nyan dang 'chad pa yi/ /klog pa ba de lha mi'i mchad gnas yin/ /mdor na sngon rabs mkhas pa'i bshad srol la/ /nyan bshad mdzod dang phyogs kyi bshes gnyen rnams/ /lus kyis thal sbyar ngag gis bstod pa dang / /yid kyis rjes su yi rangs lan brgyar bsgom/ /la lar mdo dang 'ga' zhig sngags gzhung tsam/ /gzhan dag sgra tshad tsam zhig phyogs re'i mig /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba rat+na'i zhabs/ /rig gnas kun la spobs pa dge ba can/ /sa gsum 'gran zla bral ba chos kyi rje/ khyod gsung lan brgyar myong ba'i bsod snyoms pas/ /kun nas mdangs sdug nags kyi sman ljongs na/ /bla ma dam pa'i yon tan rjes su dran/ /'ga' zhig log pa'i gzhung lugs dag par 'chad/ kha cig rnam dag gzhud lugs log par blta/ /de phyir de dag kun la snyan bskul du/ /cung zad zhus mod thugs kyis bzod par gsol/ /'di bsrings dge bas bdag kyang phyi ma'i dus/ / dam pas rjes bzung rnam dag gzhung lugs la//nyan dang bshad dang klog pa lhur blangs nas//thos dang bsam pas bshad rgyun 'dzin par shog /gang 'di rgya bod mkhas pa'i bshad srol rnams/ /mang du thos pa nags kyi klog pa bas/ pra dz+nya ra smi/ ran+ta kū ṭa'i sa 'dzin pho brang nas/ phreng bar stag rtse/ nyan bshad 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen kun la springs/ /sarba dwa ka phywa ṇi bha ba tu// //234

'tsher+ṣa 'od snangalas/ saskya'i cho skung r+sā bsdus/ ()'ud kyisabazang por brdzub yi/ /klog pa ba de 'jig rten sgyu ma mkhan/ /'gro kun srid pa'i mtsho las bsgral ba'i phyir/ /gcig tu bstan pa 'ba' zhig nyer dgongasanas/ /rnam dag gzhung lugasanyan dang 'chad pa yi/ /klog pa ba de lha mi'i mchod gnas yin/ /mdor na sngon rabasamakhas pa'i bshad srol la/ /nyan bshad mdzod dang phyogs kyi bshes gnyen rnams/ /lusakyis thal sbyar ngag gis bstod pa dang / /yid kyis rjes su yi rangs lan brgyar bsgom/ /la lar mdo dang 'ga' zhig sngags gzhung tsam/ /gzhan dag sgra tshad tsam zhig phyogs re'i mig /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba rat+na'i zhabs/ /rig gnas kun la spobs pa dge ba can/ /sagasum 'gran zla bral ba chos kyi rje/ khyod gsung lan brgyar myong ba'i bsod snyomasapas/ /kun nas mdangs sdug nags kyi sman ljongs na/ /bla ma dam pa'i yon tan rjes su dran/ /'ga' zhig log pa'i gzhung lugs dag par 'chad/ kha cig rnam dag gzhung lugs log par blta/ /de phyir de dag kun la snyan bskul du/ /cung zad zhus mod thugs kyis bzod par gsol/ /'di bsrings dge bas bdag kyang phyi ma'i dus/ / dam pas rjes bzung rnam dag gzhung lugs la//nyan dang bshad dang klag pa lhur blangs nas//thos dang bsam pas bshad rgyun 'dzin par shog /gang 'di rgya bod mkhas pa'i bshad srol rnams/ /mang du thosapa nagasakyi klog pa bas/ pra dz+nya rasmi/ ran+ta kū ṭa'i sa 'dzin pho brang nas/ phreng bar stag rtse/ nyan bshad 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen kun la springs/ /sarba dwa ka phywa ṇi bha ba tu// //234

༄༅/ /gangs ri'i khrod kyi spong ba bsam gtan pa rnams kyi snyan du springs pa bsgom pa 'chi med bdud rtsi zhes bya ba bsdo/gas so/ /༄7/ /sku bzhi'i dbang phyug dpal rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyis rgyud sbyangs ka dag lhun grub dbyer med dang / /bde stong zung 'jug dbang bzhi'i lam bsgom phyag rgya chen por mnyam bzhag pas/ /gzung 'dzin 'brul pa rang sar zhi ba mchog tu mi 'gyur ye shes kyis/ /rdo rje gsum gyi go 'phang sbyin mkhas khyab bdag bla mas dge legs mdzod/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab kun gyi snying po'i phul/ /rtogs pa'i dam chos nyams su len 'dod na/ /sum ldan bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su bsgom/ /grub thob gong ma'i snyan brgyud gdams pa la/ /dran 'dun drag posartse gcig nyams su longs/ /log pa'i gdams pa nyin ma khor yug tu/ /nyams su blangs kyang ngal ba don med pas/ /de phyir grub chen gdams pa 'di yin zhes/ /phyogs kyi sgom chen rnams la 'di bsrings so/ /rgyal bas lung bstan gangs can 'gro ba'i mgon/ /gcig tu bstan pa 'ba' zhig nyer dgongs pa'i/ /sngon gyi chos rgyal ye shes 'od kyang ngo lhag cig btsan po de/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir ston pa gnyis pa yin/ /zhu chen lo tsā ba gor be+e ro dang / /rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob 'brom ston u pa sī/ /mkhas grub chen po khyus 3ོ༵ rnal 'byor pa/ /skad gnyis smra ba bla

༄7/ /gangs ri'i khrod kyi spong ba bsam gtan pa rnams kyi snyan du springs pa bsgom pa 'chi med bdud rtsi zhes bya ba bsdokyigs so/ /༄༅/ /sku bzhi'i dbang phyug dpal rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyis rgyud sbyangs ka dag lhun grub dbyer med dang / /bde stong zung 'jug dbang bzhi'i lam bsgom phyag rgya chen por mnyam bzhag pas/ /gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa rang sar zhi ba mchog tu mi 'gyur ye shes kyis/ /rdo rje gsum gyi go 'phang sbyin mkhas khyab bdag bla mas dge legs mdzod/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab kun gyi snying po'i phul/ /rtogs pa'i dam chos nyams su len 'dod na/ /sum ldan bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su bsgom/ /grub thob gong ma'i snyan brgyud gdams pa la/ /dran 'dun drag posartse gcig nyams su longs/ /log pa'i gdams pa nyin ma khor yug tu/ /nyams su blangs kyang ngal ba don med pas/ /de phyir grub chen gdams pa 'di yin zhes/ /phyogs kyi sgom chen rnams la 'di bsrings so/ /rgyal bas lung bstan gangs can 'gro ba'i mgon/ /gcig tu bstan pa 'ba' zhig nyer dgongs pa'i/ /sngon gyi chos rgyal ye shes 'od kyang ngo lhag cig btsan po de/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir ston pa gnyis pa yin/ /zhu chen lo tsā ba gor be+e ro dang / /rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob 'brom ston u pa sī/ /mkhas grub chen po khyus 3ོ༵ rnal 'byor pa/ /skad gnyis smra ba bla

ཿpa/rtse//rdon///du de/shān da snang la /saskya' chosa'abyung gcatshobasdus/ )chen 'brog mi dang / /rnal 'byor dbang phyug rje btsun mar pa'i zhabs/ /grub pa'i sar bzhugs dam pa rgya gar dang //gyi gyo lo tsā mkhasagrub o rgyan pa//byang phyogs sgrub brgyud 'degs pa'i ka chen brgyad//dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang nas legs 'ongs pa'i//gangs ri'i khrod 'dir sgrub brgyud srol r+ṣa brgyad//de dag grub chen gong ma'i gshegs shul yin//thar 'dod rnams kyang lam de'i rjes su zhugs//semasasde tshogs drug yul du snang ba gang shar yang //gdod nas grub pa'i gnyug ma'i ye shes te//rang zhal blta zhing klong sde bsgom med ma yengs par//man ngag sde snang bzhi'i mosaṣ+ka mgo sum/yisasnang gong 'phel/rig pa tshwa phebs/o+oṃṣ+ka zad pa/don la mnyam par 'jog pa nyid//rdzogs chen zhesapa'idon ni / ma hā sarnyi'i sgra las drangasan yang dag pa'i bsam gto wo po zhes par 'gyur te/theg brgyad blo yi grub mtha' las 'das pa'i gnas lugs gcig pu'i klong du 'khor 'dasakyi chos thams cad rang shar ba'i ye shes bla na med pa'i don no//dbye na/mos thams cad sems nyid snyag bu'i rol par rgyu rkyen rtsol sgrub las 'das par rtogs pasaspang bya'i mtha' lasagrol ba phyi sems sde/de la'ang nang gsesasu 'bras bu sems kyi byung sar 'dod pa sogs bdun no//chos thams cad choganyid kun tu bzang mo'i klong las 'gro 'ong med pa'i phyir sku gsum rang chas kyi dbyings las mi 'gyur bar rtogs pas gnyen po' mtha' yas gral ba nang bya bral klong gi sde/de la'ang dkar nag khra gsum rab 'byamasakyi klong sde bzhi'o//gzhi lam 'bras gsum chos thams cad ka dag dang lhun grub dbyer med pa'i don rang gi mas nyid yin lugs ltar rtogs pas spang gnyen gnyis da'i mtha' lasagrol ba gsang ba zab pa man ngag gi sde/de la'ang /kha gto/kha 'thor/rgyud rang gci du bstan pa dang gsum mo//de skad du'ang bkod pa 'a po las/yid can rnams la semasakyi sde//nam maXdī /na la klong gi sde//rim rtsol bra pa la man ngag go/

ba tshe chen 'od snang las/sa skya' chos 'gung gcas bsdus/(0/chen 'brog mi dang / /rnal 'byor dbang phyug rje btsun mar pa'i zhabs/ /grub pa'i sar bzhugs dam pa rgya gar dang //gyi gyo lo tsā mkhas grub o rgyan pa//byang phyogs sgrub brgyud 'degs pa'i ka chen brgyad//dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang nas legs 'ongs pa'i//gangs ri'i khrod 'dir sgrub brgyud srol chen brgyad//de dag grub chen gong ma'i gshegs shul yin//thar 'dod rnams kyang lam de'i rjes su zhugs//sems sde tshogs drug yul du snang ba gang shar yang //gdod nas grub pa'i gnyug ma'i ye shes te//rang zhal blta zhing klong sde bsgom med ma yengs par//man ngag sde snang bzhi'i chos nyid mngon sum/nyams snang gong 'phel/rig pa tshad phebs/choganyid zad pa/don la mnyam par 'jog pa nyid//rdzogs chen zhes pa'i don ni / ma hā sa rnyi'i sgra las drangs na yang dag pa'i bsam gtan chen po zhes par 'gyur te/theg brgyad blo yi grub mtha' las 'das pa'i gnas lugs gcig pu'i klong du 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang shar ba'i ye shes bla na med pa'i don no//dbye na/chos thams cad sems nyid gcig bu'i rol par rgyu rkyen rtsol sgrub las 'das par rtogs pas spang bya'i mtha' las grol ba phyi sems sde/de la'ang nang gses su 'bras bu sems kyi byung sar 'dod pa sogs bdun no//chos thams cad chos nyid kun tu bzang mo'i klong las 'gro 'ong med pa'i phyir sku gsum rang chas kyi dbyings las mi 'gyur bar rtogs pas gnyen po' mtha' yas gral ba nang bya bral klong gi sde/de la'ang dkar nag khra gsum rab 'byams kyi klong sde bzhi'o//gzhi lam 'bras gsum chos thams cad ka dag dang lhun grub dbyer med pa'i don rang gi mtshan nyid yin lugs ltar rtogs pas spang gnyen gnyis da'i mtha' las grol ba gsang ba zab pa man ngag gi sde/de la'ang /kha gtam/kha 'thor/rgyud rang gzhung du bstan pa dang gsum mo//de skad du'ang bkod pa chen po las/yid can rnams la sems kyi sde//nam mkha' can la klong gi sde//rim rtsol bra pa la man ngag go/236

gangasari' khrod kyi spong ba bsam gtan pa rnamasakyi snyan du springasapa bsgom pa 'chi med bdud rtsi/zhesaso//chosakyi nyamasalen gtso bor yin//rten gzhi'i gtso bo rgyud ma hā lung anu man ngag ati yog gsum//shrī seng ha dpal gyi seng ge'i khyad par gdamasapa mchog/dang por bka' babs sngagasa'achang be+e ro yis//thugasanyamaspobazhesanas gangs ri'i khrod 'dir spel//ba yin te/de yang semasaphyogasarnamasamanga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan/rgyalamogayu sgra snying po/gsang ston ye shesabla ma/spang sangasargyasamagon po/li za shesarab sgron ma rnamasal gsungasapa ste rim pa lngar gragasashing /be+e ro dang g.yu sgra gnyisaka las/gnyagalodz+nyā na kum rasagasan pa sogasalasadang /klong sde ni/be+e rosaspang mi phamamagon po lagasungasanasadar ba sogasamatha' yas/man ngag gi dzisnying thig gi skor ni/shrī seng ha nas/mkhasapa ye shesamado/paṇa chen bi tshilami tra/desamanga' bdag dang nyang ban sogasal gsungasapa dang /slob dpon chen po pad+masashi seng ha lugasagasan nas/mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal la gdamasapa sogasaphyisakun mkhyen chosakyi rgyal po dri med 'od zer gyi bka' drin lasargya r+sā dar ro/khyus nyung rma dang 'khon zur gnubasamyosadang //srid rong dpyal dang skyo ston g.yung la sogs//snga 'gyur rnying ma'i bka' brgyud bgrang yas byon//dpal ldan zur po che shākya lung gnasakyis/myang ye 'byung /lce shāka mchog rog shāka 'byung sogasabla ma mang du bsten/mdo sgyu semasagasum la mkhasapa'i phul du phyin/rtsargyud dang bshad rgyud 'grel pa dang sgrub thabasalung man ngag sosor phye ste bshad pa la/slob ma rtsemo bzhi/rtse skog brgyad/sgotshichen brgya rtsabargyad sogasabyung ba'i gtso bo ni zung chung shesarab gragasapa dang /de'i rigasakyi srasasgro phug pa shākya seng ge ste zur mesadabon gsum du grags/'di rnamasakyi ring la gsang sngagasasnga 'gyur gyi phrin lasanam mkha' dang mnyam par song bsabod khamasa.o ḍi wā na'i yuladang yisasaparasnengasaso//pa rdzogasachen bstan pa'i rgyan//dal 'byor rnyed dka' mi rtag 'chi ba dang //༵༵ 'bras bslu med 'bor ba'i nyes

gangs ri'i khrod kyi sbong ba bsam gtan pa rnams kyi snyan du springs pa bsgom pa 'chi med bdud rtsi/zhes so//chos kyi nyams len gtso bor yin//rten gzhi'i gtso bo rgyud ma hā lung anu man ngag a lta yog gsum//shrī seng ha dpal gyi seng ge'i khyad par gdam bas pa mchog/dang por bka' babs sngagasang be+e ro yis//thugs nyams bzhesanas gangs ri'i khrod 'dir spel//ba yin te/de yang sems phyogs rnams mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan/rgyal mo g.yu sgra snying po/gsang ston ye shes bla ma/spang sangs rgyas mgon po/li za shes rab sgron ma rnams la gsungs pa ste rim pa lngar grags shing /be+e ro dang g.yu sgra gnyis ka las/gnyags dz+nyā na kum ras ga pa sogs las dang /klong sde ni/be+e ros spang mi pham mgon po lagasungasanas dar ba sogs mtha' yas/man ngag gi dzi snying thig gi skor ni/shrī seng ha nas/mkhas pa ye shesamado/paṇa chen bi tshil mi tra/des mnga' bdag dang nyang ban sogs la gsungs pa dang /slob dpon chen po pad+mas shrī seng ha lugs gsan nas/mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal la gdams pa sogs phyis kun mkhyen chosakyi rgyal po dri med 'od zer gyi bka' drin las rgya r+sā dar ro/khyus nyung rma dang 'khon zur gnubs myos dang //srid rong dpyal dang skyo ston g.yung la sogs//snga 'gyur rnying ma'i bka' brgyud bgrang yas byon//dpal ldan zur po che shākya 'byung gnas kyis/myang ye 'byung /lce shāka mchog rog shāka 'byung sogs bla ma mang du bsten/mdo sgyu sems gsum la mkhasapa'i phul du phyin/rtsa rgyud dang bshad rgyud 'grel pa dang sgrub thabs lung man ngag so sor phye ste bshad pa la/slob ma rtse mo bzhi/rtse lkog brgyad/sgom chen brgya rtsa brgyad sogs byung ba'i gtso bo ni zung sa shesarab grags pa dang /de'i rigs kyi sras sgro phug pa shākya seng ge ste zur mes dbon gsum du grags/'di rnams kyi ring la gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam par song bas pod khams o ḍi wā na'i yul dang mas sa par glengs so//pa rdzogs chen bstan pa'i rgyan//dal 'byor rnyed dka' mi rtag 'chi ba dang //las 'bras bslu med 'khor ba'i nyes237
