gye 'od snang r+sā/sa skya' m+mu+o lung r+sāsabasdus/'damigs dang //byang chub sems gnyis nan gyis sgom byed pa//bka' gdams zhes hrū ba'i bka' thamasacad gang zag gcig long rgya ba'i gdams ngag tu shar ba'i chos kyi khos len gtso bo yin/g.yi gdamasaman ngag gsum du gragasapa'i/gas gdamasaganyisal lta spyod gtso bor ston pa'i g.yi so sor yod la/gnyis/zung 'brel du ston pa ni byang tso snyo gyi sgron ma dang /man ngag ni jo bo yab srasakyi g.yo mro+oglegasabam rin po d+ku+o//de lasalam sgron gyi brjod/ bya ni/gci las/wo ngu 'bring dang malo+o gyur pa'i//skyesabu gsum du shes par bya//wopa ltar skyes bu gsum gyi lam rimaste/de yang skyesabu'i skad dod pu ru ṣa r+sāpa nusaldan la lajug pas/tshe phyi ma phan ho kyi don sgrub nusapa wo la skabasa'adir bstan gyi skyesabu r+sābya/de la'ang tshe 'di'i r+ṣa pa log nasaphyi ma rang wo kho na tsor bde'i ṣ+ka du lasa'abrasakyi blang dor sgrub nasapaniskyesabusanguste'adiyi4gyidangosagastonartagapagasongagikhodamigasaskyabs༄ d+ku /'gro/lasa'abrasacasadamigasaskor bsnyo+o//swo+or ba mtha' dag la wo pa log nasade lasathar ba'i ched du lam bslab pa gsum la tshi bzhi du bsgrub nusapa ni skyesabu 'bring ste/'di latheg pa'i sgo nasato rang gnyis/bsgom bya'i sgo nasabaden bzhi dang rten 'brel gnyis/gang zag gi bdag med phra ragasaganyis sogs so//srid snya mtha' gardzikaskyon du mthong nasa'agro kun sangs rgyasakyi sal 'god pa'i khur char nusapa ni skyesabu r+ṣa po ste/'di la'ang lta ba'i sgo nasadabu sosadang /theg pa'i sgo nasamado sngagasaganyis su dbye la/phro gyi khyad par semasabaskyed pa sngon du 'gro bsas sras kyi spyod spyo dang bye brag labaslab tshi'abrasabu dang casapa'o//tshosaga' bsten tshi dang /dal sti+or gyi chosaskor ni gsum spu'i lam gyi gzhi rten du bca do//g.yo 7glegasabam rin po tsho brjod bya ni / g.yi las/skyabasaganasabla ma dran par mdzod//lusani lha yi rang bzhi te//ngag ni bzlasabarjod rgyun par mdzod//'gro ba ma lusapha mar sdu+o~X//smosakyi gan lugasastong par dbyod//lnga po

gye chen 'od snang las/sa skya' chas lung gces bsdus/()dmigs dang //byang chub sems gnyis nan gyis sgom byed pa//bka' gdams zhes rgyal ba'i bka' thams cad gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i gdams ngag tu shar ba'i chos kyi nyams len gtso bo yin/gzhung gdams man ngag gsum du grags pa'i/gzhung gdams gnyis la lta spyod gtso bor ston pa'i gzhung so sor yod la/gnyis/zung 'brel du ston pa ni byang chub lam gyi sgron ma dang /man ngag ni jo bo yab sras kyi gsang chos glegs bam rin po che'o//de las lam sgron gyi brjod/ bya ni/gzhung las/chung ngu 'bring dang mchog gyur pa'i//skyes bu gsum du shes par bya//zhes pa ltar skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim ste/de yang skyes bu'i skad dod pu ru ṣa zhes pa nus ldan la la jug pas/tshe phyi ma phan chad kyi don sgrub nus pa zhig la skabs 'dir bstan gyi ri skyas bu zhes bya/de la'ang tshe 'di'i zhen pa log nas phyi ma rang nyid kho na 'khor bde'i ched du las 'bras kyi blang dor sgrub nus pa ni skyes bu chung ngu ste/'di yi lam gyi dngos gzhin mi rtag pa/ngan song gi nyes dmigs/skyabasa'agro/las 'bras bcas dmigs skor bzhi'o//'khor ba mtha' dag la zhen pa log nas de las thar ba'i ched du lam bslab pa gsum la tshul bzhin du bsgrub nus pa ni skyes bu 'bring ste/'di la theg pa'i sgo nas nyan rang gnyis/bsgom bya'i sgo nas bden bzhi dang rten 'brel gnyis/gang zag gi bdag med phra rags gnyis sogs so//srid zhi'i mtha' gnyis/skyon du mthong nas 'gro kun sangs rgyas kyi sal 'god pa'i khur 'khyer nus pa ni skyes bu chen po ste/'di la'ang lta ba'i sgo nas dbu sems dang /theg pa'i sgo nas mdo sngags gnyis su dbye la/lam gyi khyad par sems bskyed pa sngon du 'gro bas rgyal sras kyi spyod spyo dang bye brag la bslab tshul 'bras bu dang bcas pa'o//bzhes gnyen bsten tshul dang /dal 'byor gyi chos skor ni gsum spu'i lam gyi gzhi rten du bzhed do//gsang chos glegs bam rin po che'i brjod bya ni / gzhung las/skyabs gnas bla ma dran par mdzod//lus ni lha yi rang bzhin te//ngag ni bzlasabarjod rgyun par mdzod//'gro ba ma lus pha mar sems//sems kyi gan lug stong par dpyod//lnga po 238

gangs ri'i khrod kyi spong ba bsam gtan pa rnams kyi snyan du springs pa bsgom pa 'cha med bdud rtsi/'ad yi skye ba nas//dge rtsa thams cad dag par mdzod//ces rjes dran lnga'o//rten gzhi'i gtso bo mngon rtogs༅ sogs rgya chen spyod pa'i gzhung //lha gcig jo bo'i khyad par gdams pa mchog/dang por bka' babs rgyal sras 'brom ston rgyal ba'i yang kyi gnas sa//thugs nyams bzhes nas gangs ri'i khrod 'dir spel/ ba yin te/de'ang jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha'i dus su bstan pa'i dbu brnyes/ston pa rin po ches srol 'byed/sku mched gsum gyi ring la dar zhing rgyas/glang shar bya yul rga so ges kyi dus shin tu dar ba las bu to ba nas brgyud pa la gzhung pa/spyan snga ba nas brgyud pa la ga dmasang ga pa/phu chung ba nas brgyud pa la man ngag pa/gung thang nag tsho lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba'i slob ma rong pa phyag sor ba nas brgyud pa la nag tsho'i bka' brgyud du grags pa'i tshu po la/bka' gdams gzhud drug skyes cho mes dad pa'i/bslab spyod spyod pa'i/sa rgyan ting nge 'dzin gyi gzhung /nyan bshad gzhung pa dang //nyams len bden bzhi'i sdug bsngal kun 'byung /'gog pa/lam/khrid bsdus ( gdam bsang ga pa//gung thang nag tsho bka' brgyud gdams pa 'og/bshad sgrub chu bo gnyis ldan gzhung pa mchog/sdong po lta bu thabs lam bde drod rab 'bar/sku lus chags sdang rang grol/rmi lam nyid 'bru tharang dag/'od gsal gti mug rang sangs/'pho ba ma bsgom sangs rgyas/bar do rgyalab shel ngas sku ste chas drug yal ga phyag gyo chen po ga'u ma//lo ma snang ba la brten nas bla ma/yi dam/sgyu ma lam du khyer ba ste gas med lam khyer rnam gsum me tog mkha' spyod dkar dmar gnyis//'bras bu lus sems 'chi med sgom rim de/gser chos lnga'am/khrid wo lngar grags pa'i ni gu'i chos skor rnams ni/bka' brgyud shangs pa'i nyams len gtso bo yin la/gas yang su kha'i chos skor/rdo rje gdan pa'i chos skor/mi tri pa'i chos skor/rwa hu la'i chos skor/der ma 'dus pa'i man ngag thor bu dang bcas shangs chos kyi skor bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 239

gangasari'i khrod kyi spong ba bsam gtan pa rnamasakyi snyan du springasapa bsgom pa 'cha med bdud rtsi/'ad yi skye banas//dge rtsathamasato dgapar mdzod//cesarjesadran lnga'o//rten gzhi'i gtso bo mngon rtogs༅ sogasargya chen spyod pa'i gzhung //lha gcig jo bo'i khyad par gdamasapa mchog/dang por bka' babs rgyal srasa'abrom ston rgyal ba'i yang gnasakyis//thugs nyamasabazhes nas gangasari'i khrod 'dir spel/ ba yin te/de'ang jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha'i dusasu bstan pa'i dbu brnyes/ston pa rin po chesasrola'abyed/sku mched gsum gyi ring la dar zhing rgyas/glang shar bya yul rgasogasakyi dusashin tu dar ba lasabu to ba nasabargyud pa la gzhung pa/spyan snga ba nasabargyud pa la gdamasangag pa/phu chung ba nasabargyud pa la man ngag pa/gung thang nag tsho lo tsā ba tshul khrimasargyal ba'i slob ma rong pa phyag sor ba nasabargyud pa la nag tsho'i bka' brgyud du gragasapa'i tshulal/bka' gdams gzhung drug skyesachomasadad pa'i/bslab spyod spyod pa'i/sargyan ting nge 'dzin gyi gzhung /nyan bshad gzhung pa dang //nyams len bden bzhi'i sdug bsngal kun 'byung /'gogapa/lam/khrid bsdusagadamasangag pa//gung thang nag tsho bka' brgyud gdams pa 'og/bshad sgrub chu bo gnyis ldan gzhung pa mchog/sdong po lta bu thabasalam bde drod rab 'bar/sku lusachagasasdang rang grol/rmi lam nyid 'khrularang dag/'od gsalagati mug rang sangs/'pho ba ma bsgom sangasargyas/bar do rgyalab longasasku ste chozla/drug yal ga phyagagyochen po ga'u ma//lo ma snang ba labarten nasabla ma/yi dam/sgyu ma lam du khyer ba ste 'phyugasamed lam khyer rnam gsum me tog mkha' spyod dkar dmar gnyis//'brasabu lusasems 'chi med sgom rim de/gser chosalngawo/khrid wo lngar gragasapa'inigu'i mosaskorarnamasani/bka' brgyud shangasapa'i nyamasalen gtso bo yin la/gas yang sukha'i chosaskor/rdo rje gdan pa'i mothoskor/mi tri pa'i mosaskor/rwahu la'i chogaskor/der ma 'dusapa'i man ngag thor bu da/ sdusashangasamosakyi skor bsam gyisami khyab pa zhig

'tshechen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i r+yā skang khes bsdus/ ()yod do/ /de yang bde bsathabs byas pa'i stong nyid phyag rgya chen po'i ye shesamangon du gyur pa ni bsgrub bya'i snying po ste/ rtsab rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ lam gyi mchog gyur 'di nyid nyamasalen rnams/ /gzhan gyi dusamin 'di'am bar ma dor/ /bde stong dbyer med sku gsum rang shar nas/ r+sām par dag pa'i mkha' spyod nyid du 'gro/ /zhesaso/ /rten gzhi'i gtso bo 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud dang / ga yang /dgyesardor/ gsang 'dus/ ma hā ma ya/ rdo rje 'jigasabyed rnamasakyang ngo / /nā ro pa'i lcagaye shes mkha' 'gro nigu ma'i khyad par gdams pa mchog /dang por bka' babs skugasang ba 'dusapa/ gsung ma hā ma ya/ thugasadagyesamadzad rdo rje/ yon tan 'khor lo sdom pa/ phrin lasardo rje 'jigs mdzad de ye shes dkyil 'khor lnga'i ngo bo dang gnyisasu med par bzhugs pa'i mkhas sdo/ba khyung po rnal 'byor brtson 'grus mgon de yis/ /thugs nyams bzhes nasagangaba'iri'i khrod 'dir spel/ /rdo rje 'chang / ni gu ma/ khyung po/ smo gcog pa/ skyer sung pa/ sangasargyasaganyan ston/ yos rgyasaston pa ste/ brgyud rim bdun du chog brgyud bka' rgyasabatab//sangs rgyas ston pas skal ldan yongs la spel/ /dbus shangs 'jag pa tshulakhrimasamagon dang nyang bsam sdings pa mkhas btsun gzhon nu grub sogs bka' brgyud rnam mang gyes/ /nyams len rgyun gyi 'dzugs legs khyad par 'phags/ /gsung ngag rin po che la tshad ma bzhi dang snyan brgyud bzhi'i sgo nas slob ma bkri ba'i tshul rnam pa bzhi las/ gzhung shing rgyas pa gzhung ji lta ba bzhin bkri ba'i dbang du byasan/ rje sa skya pa chen pos/snang ba gsum gyis lam gyi gzhi bcasate/ /nyams blangs ma lusargyud gsum dag gis shes/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lasakyi gzhi bca/sna phar phyin dang thun mong ba snang ba gsum gyisargyud sbyangasapa sngon du 'gro bas/ sngags lam thun mong ma yin pa'i thog mar rgyu dusakyi dbang bskur nas gzhi dam tshig la gnasapar bya ba dang / lam dngosalargyud gsum las/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la'abor 'ad dbyer med 240

ba tshe chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chos 'byung khes bsdus/ ()yod do/ /de yang bde bas thabs byas pa'i stong nyid phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes mngon du gyur pa ni bsgrub bya'i snying po ste/ rtsab rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ lam gyi mchog gyur 'di nyid nyams len rnams/ /gzhan gyi dus min 'di'am bar ma dor/ /bde stong dbyer med sku gsum rang shar nas/ r+sām par dag pa'i mkha' spyod ṣ+ka du 'gro/ /tshes so/ /rten gzhi'i gtso bo 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud dang / ga yang /dgyes rdor/ gsang 'dus/ ma hā ma ya/ rdo rje 'jigs byed rnams kyang ngo / /nā ro pa'i lta mo ye shes mkha' 'gro na gu ma'i khyad par gdams pa mchog /dang por bka' babs sku gsang ba 'dus pa/ gsung ma hā ma ya/ thugs dgyes mdzad rdo rje/ yon tan 'khor lo sdom pa/ phrin las rdo rje 'jigs mdzad de ye shes dkyil 'khor lnga'i ngo bo dang gnyis su med par bzhugs pa'i mkhas sdo/ba khyung po rnal 'byor brtson 'grus mgon de yis/ /thugs nyams bzhes nas gangs ri'i khrod 'dir spel/ /rdo rje 44 / ni gu ma/ khyung po/ smo gcog pa/ skyer sung pa/ sangs rgyas gnyan ston/ sangs rgyas ston pa ste/ brgyud rim bdun du chog brgyud bka' rgyas btab//sangs rgyas ston pas skal ldan yongs la spel/ /dbus shangs 'jag pa tshul khrimasamagon dang nyang bsam sdings pa mkhas btsun gzhen nu grub sogs bka' brgyud rnam mang gyes/ /nyams len rgyun gyi 'a rna gas legs khyad par 'phags/ /gsung ngag rin po che la tshad ma bzhi dang snyan brgyud bzhi'i sgo nas slob ma bkri ba'i tshul rnam pa bzhi las/ gzhung shing rgyas pa gzhung ji lta ba bzhin bkri ba'i dbang du byas na/ rje sa skya pa chen pos/snang ba gsum gyis lam gyi gzhi bcas te/ /nyams blangs ma lus rgyud gsum dag gis shes/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ las kyi gzhi bca/sna phar phyin dang thun mong ba snang ba gsum gyis rgyud sbyangs pa sngon du 'gro bas/ sngags lam thun mong ma yin pa'i thog mar rgyu dus kyi dbang bskur nas gzhi dam tshig la gnas par bya ba dang / lam dngos la rgyud gsum las/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la 'khor 'ad dbyer med 240

gangs ri'i khrod kyi spong ba bsam gtan pa rnamasakyi snya na du springasapa bsgom pa 'chi med bdud rtsi/kye lta ba gsal stong zung 'jug tu ngo sprad cing bsgom pa/ lus thabasargyud la dbang bzhi dang rjes su 'brel ba'i lam bzhi las/ bum dbangagi lam phyi nang bskyed rim dang / /lam dusakyi dbang bskur nas de'i don zab mo nyin zhug re la thun bzhir bsgom pa dang / /gsang dbang gi lam rlung dang gtum mo/ sher dbang gi lam pho nya'i lam/ dbang bzhi pa'i lam rdo rje'i rba rlabasate rdzogasarim gyi lam gsum bsgom pab(dpe dang don gyi ye shedra'i'adren par byed pa dang / 'brasabu sku lnga mngon du 'gyur ba'i tshul sogasamador na lam gyi dusanasa'abras bu thob rung du gnasapasagazhi lam 'bras gsum dbyer med pa'idon ston pa/ lam 'bras chos kyi nyams len gtso bo yin/ /rten gzhi'i gtso bo dgyes pa rdo rje'i rtsa bshad kyi rgyud gsum la brten nas drug gi bdag nyid grub chen bir wa pasashar phyogasanag po pa'i don du rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang mdzad/ 'di la 'brog mi/ gyi gyo / 'brom gsum gyisargya dpe dang bstun nas bsgyur/ cha gan dang jo nang kun spangasapasargya dpe la ma gatshogs par go rim dkrugasapa'i 'gyur bcosamadzad pa dang / gzungasakyi dpal ba'i yig char paṇ+ḍita rā hu la'i 'gyur yang yod par gsungasabs/ de ltar na 'gyur mgo drug go /sprin 'dzin/ ga ya dh+wa ra'i khyad par gdams pa mchog /dang po bka' babs bla 'brog mi yis//thu+ogs nyams bzhes nosagangs ri'i khrod 'dir spel/ /gyi gyo 'brom dang zhang stan zhwa ma lugs/ /ka brag mar lam cha gan ja nang lugs/ /dbang rgyal sa lugs lce sgom mtha' rtsa sdo/gas ste/ gtso che ba'i lugasasrol bstoganyisadang / de lasa'aphrosapa'i rnam grangasami gcig pa bco brgyad du gragasate/ de yang 'brog mi dang gyi gyo lasabargyud pa gnyisakyi/snga ma la 'brog mi'i srasa.in+d+ra dang rdo rje lasabargyud pa'i lam 'bras/ thugasakyi srasa'abrom ston de ba las brgyud pa'i lam 'bras/ sgomakhar chung ba nasa'aphel ba la rab 'bring tha gsum las/ 'bring du thob pa zhwa ma nasa'aphelagal/ pho rgyud mo rgyud bsresargyud dang gsum/ pho rgyud la'ang / rje kham bu ba nasa'aphel 241

gangs ri'i khrod kyi spong ba bsam gtan pa rnams kyi snya na du springs pa bsgom pa 'chi med bdud rtsi/kye lta ba gsal stong zung 'jug tu ngo sprad cing bsgom pa/ lus thabs rgyud la dbang bzhi dang rjes su 'brel ba'i lam bzhi las/ bum dbang gi lam phyi nang bskyed rim dang / /lam kyi dus dbang bskur nas de'i don zab mo nyin zhag re la thun bzhir bsgom pa dang / /gsang dbang gi lam rlung dang ga65 mo/ sher dbang gi lam pho nya'i lam/ dbang bzhi pa'i lam rdo rje'i rba rlabs te rdzogs rim gyi lam gsum bsgom pas(dpe dang don gyi ye shes 'dren par byed pa dang / 'bras bu sku lnga mngon du 'gyur ba'i tshul sogs mdor na lam gyi dus nas 'bras bu thob rung du gnas pas gzha lam 'bras gsum dbyer med pa'i don ston pa/ lam 'bras chos kyi nyams len gtso bo yin/ /rten gzhi'i gtso bo dgyes pa rdo rje'i rtsa bshad kyi rgyud gsum la brten nas drug gi bdag nyid grub chen bir wa pas shar phyogs nag po pa'i don du rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang mdzad/ 'di la 'brog mi/ gyi gyo / 'brom gsum gyis rgya dpe dang bstun nas bsgyur/ cha gan dang jo nang kun spangs pas rgya dpe la ma gtugs par go rim na dkrugs pa' 'gyur bcos mdzad pa dang / gzungs kyi dpal ba'i yig char paṇ+ḍita rā hu la'i 'gyur yang yod par gsungs bas/ de ltar na 'gyur mgo drug go /sprin 'dzin/ ga ya dh+wa ra'i khyad par gdams pa mchog /dang po bka' babs bla chen 'brog mi yis//thugs nyams bzhes nas gangs ri'i khrod 'dir spel/ /gyi gyo 'brom dang zhang ston zhwa ma lugs/ /ko brag mar lam cha gan jo nang lugs/ /dbang rgyal sa lugs lce lha/ma mtha' rtsa sdo/gas ste/ gtso che ba'i lugs srol bstoganyis dang / de las losapa'i rnam grangs mi gcig pa bco brgyad du grags te/ de yang 'brog mi dang gyi gyo las brgyud pa gnyis kyi/snga ma la 'brog mi'i sras i dru dang rdo rje las brgyud pa'i lam 'bras/ thugs kyi sras 'brom ston de ba las brgyud pa'i lam 'bras/ the/mkhar chung ba nas 'phel ba la rab 'bring tha gsum las/ 'bring du thob pa zhwa ma nas 'phel bol/ pho rgyud mo rgyud bsres rgyud dang gsum/ pho rgyud la'ang / rje kham bu ba nas 'phel 241

ba 'a 'odasnangal /saskya'i 75nga tso bsdus/()ba'i slob brgyud dang /srasazhwa ma tsani na 'phel ba'i srasabargyud de gnyis/mo rgyud layang /zhwa ma'i slob ma nyang bsgom/ston g.yung ba/dpon mo shesarab/tshulakhrimasala'aphelaba'i lugasate gsum/bsresargyud las/zhwa ma pho mo bsresapa dumabu kobrag pa'i lugs/zhwa ma pho mo gnyisasalugasadang gsum bsresapas gan gyi lugs/'brog mi lugasadang gyi gyo lugasabasresapa jo nang kun spangasapa'i lugs/lam 'brasasbyor drug rdzogasachen gsum bsresapa lastod dbang rgyalagyi lugs/rabatu thob pa zhang ga brgyud par/salugasal snga gaphag gru lugs/lce sgom lugasaganyis/phyi bul nye brgyud dang /ring brgyud gnyis/'brog mi'i jo srasaganyisadang zhang ston mched gnyisasde bzhi'i gsung gcesapa bsdus pa mang lam zhig po'i lugs/se ston lasatha mar thob pa byang chub ye shesakyisazhing phyag par gdamasapa'i lugasate bco brgyad po thamasacad 'brog mi dang /gyi rgya'i brgyud 'dzin kho na las byung ba yin la/de rnamasakyi nang nasaphyis su salugasadang /zhwa lugs gnyis dar rgyasache ba lasakyang /chos sdo/gas rgya mtsho'i mthar son saskya pa//gang de sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i gtsag gi rgyan//stophyag rgya chen po zhesapa'i ngo bo ni/'bor 'dasathamasacad lakhyab pa zab gsal gnyisasu med pa'i ye shes khyad par bdun ldan no//ngesatshig ni/ma hā mu dra'i sgra lasadrangasan/'khor 'dasalamagasum gyi chos thamasacad 'di las mi 'da' bas phyag rgya dang /de lasagong du chosagazhan med pasan chen po zhes bya ste gzhi mthun pa'i bsdu ba'o//dbye na/gzhi lam 'brasagasum las/dang po ni/gnas lugasakyi don de nyid rtogasapas rtogs lasagrol 'khrulaganyisasu byung bsan/'khor 'dasakyi mothokun de las mi 'da' bas phyag rgya/de nyid lasagazhan pa'i mothokyi sku zhesabatsosamed pasachen po/gnyisapa ni/bla ma'i man ngag gisango sprad nasanyamasasu blangasapa'i tshe na'ang /shesadang shesabya thamasacad de'i gdangasalasami 'da' bsaphyag rgya/de lasagazhan pa'i sangasargyasakyi ye shesabatsal du med pasachen po//gsum pa ni/lam gyisaslo bur ba'i dri ma sbyangasa~Xzhi'i bzhugasatshul macan du gyur pa'i skabs/sku

ba chen 'od snang la /saskya'i chosang tso bsdus/()ba'i slob brgyud dang /sras zhwa ma tsan+de na 'phel ba'i sras brgyud de gnyis/mo rgyud la yang /zhwa ma'i slob ma nyang bsgom/ston g.yung ba/dpon mo shes rab/tshul khrims la 'phel ba'i lugs te gsum/bsres rgyud las/zhwa ma pho mo bsres pa du mo bu ko brag pa'i lugs/zhwa ma pho mo gnyis sa lugs dang gsum bsres pas gan gyi lugs/'brog mi lugs dang gyi gyo lugs bsres pa jo nang kun spangs pa'i lugs/lam 'bras sbyor drug rdzogs chen gsum bsres pa la stod dbang rgyal gyi lugs/rang tu thob pa zhang ga brgyud par/sa lugs la snga ga phag gru lugs/lce sgom lugs gnyis/phyi bul nye brgyud dang /ring brgyud gnyis/'brog mi'i jo sras gnyis dang zhung ston mched gnyis sde bzhi'i gsung gces pa bsdus pa mang lam zhig po'i lugs/se ston las tha mar thob pa byang chub ye shes kyis zhing phyag par gdamasapa'i lugs te bco brgyad po thams cad 'brog mi dang /gyi rgya'i brgyud 'dzin kho na las byung ba yin la/de rnams kyi nang nas phyis su sa lugs dang /zhwa lugs gnyis dar rgyas che ba las kyang /be+e byes sdo/gas rgya mtsho'i mthar son sa skya pa//gang de sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i gtsug gi rgyan//phyag rgya chen po zhes pa'i ngo bo ni/'khor 'das thams cad la khyab pa zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i ye shes khyad par bdun ldan no//nges tshig ni/ma hā mu dra'i sgra las drangs na/'khor 'das lam gsum gyi chos thams cad 'di las mi 'da' bas phyag rgya dang /de las gong du cho sogazhan med pas na chen po zhes bya ste gzhi mthun pa'i bsdu ba'o//dbye na/gzhi lam 'bras gsum las/dang po ni/gnas lugs kya don de nyid rtogs pas rtogs las grol 'khrul gnyis su byung bsan/'khor 'das kyi chos kun de las mi 'da' bas phyag rgya/de nyid las gzhan pa'i chos kyi sku zhes btsal med pas chen po/gnyis pa ni/bla ma'i man ngag gis ngo sprad nas nyams su blangs pa'i tshe na'ang /shes dang shes bya thams cad de'i gdangasalas mi 'da' bas phyag rgya/de las ga' na pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes btsal du med pas chen po//gsum pa ni/lam gyis slo bur ba'i dri ma sbyangs pas gzha'i bzhugs tshul mngon du gyur pa'i skabs/sku 242

gangs ri'i khrod kyi spong ba bsam gtan pa rnams kyi snyan du springs pa bsgom pa 'chi med bdud rtsi/dang ye shes kyi rnam rol thams cad de las mi 'da' bas phyag rgya/mthar thug pa'i go 'phang yin pasachan po'o//mdor na snang sems dbyer med lhan cig skyes pa yid la mi byed pa phyag rgya chen po'i 'bras bu pa sbyor ba'i mdo sngags kyi gseng lam khyad par can te/rje btsun sgam po pas/sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku//snang ba lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i 'od//de phyir snang sems dbyer med lhan cig skyas//zhes dang /sems dang rnam rtog chos sku gsum//dang po lhan cig skyes pa ste//gdams pasagacig tu sbyor ba'i phyir//lhan cig skyes sbyor mi zer ram//zhes so//de lta bu'i don nyams su blangs pa'i dus su dwangs ma'i shes pa ste tha mal gyi shes pa ma bcos pa nyid//te lo pas/kye ho 'di ni rang rag ye shes te//ngag tshig las 'das yid kyi spyod yul min//te long yis ci yang bstan du med//rang gas rang la mtshon te shes par byos//zhes gsungs pa ltar gzhi lta ba'i gnas lugs rang ngo ro/sa nas mi mno mi bsam mi dpyad cing //mi bsgom mi sems rang babs bzhag zhes pa'i tshul gyis ma yengs dran 'dun dang //bcas lam bsgom pas nyams su blang ba ni lam gyi dngos gzhi dang //de'i yan lag rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i thabs lam zang mo bsgom pas lta spyod zung du sbre05 ba ste/de yang rgyud dang 'brel ba'i thabs lam la bka' yang dag pa'i tshad mar/gtum mo las kyi phyag rgya dang //sgyu ma rmi lam 'od gsal dang /bar do lam gyi blo chod/'pho ba lam gyi sun ma/grong 'jug lam gyi chad mthud de chos brgyad dang /byin rlabs dang 'brel ba snyan brgyud la/las rgya dang /grong 'jug ma gtogs chos drug dang /gzhan yang 'pho ba bar de'i khongs su bsdus pa'i chos lnga dang /'khor lo bzhi sogs kyi dbang du byas pa'i gtum mo/sgyu lus/'od gsal/rmi lam stobazhi dang /rtsab dang yan lag gi chos gnyis su bsdu gsogs/bka' brgyud dwagangs po'i nyams len gtso bo yin//rten gzhi'i gtso bo byin chas༅ ma rgyud bde mchog ste//bku' bas chu bo bzhi 'dus grub chen tai lo shes rab bzang po'i slob ma/byang sgo srung ba'i paṇ+ḍita nā ro tā pa'i ste mi mchag 243

gangs ri'i khrod kyi spong ba bsam gtan pa rnams kyi snyan du springasapa bsgom pa 'chi med bdud rtsi/dang ye shesakyi rnam rol thamasacad de lasami 'da' bsaphyag rgya/mthar thug pa'i go 'phang yin pasachan po'o//mdor na snang semasadabyer med lhan cig skyesapa yid lami byed pa phyag rgya chen po'i 'brasabu pa sbyor ba'i mdo sngagasakyi gseng lam khyad par can te/rje btsun sgam po pas/semasanyid lhan cig skyesapa chosakyi sku//snang ba lhan cig skyesapa chosasku'i 'od//de phyir snang semasadabyer med lhan cig skyas//zhesadang /semasadang rnamartog chosasku gsum//dang po lhan cig skyesapa ste//gdamasapasagacig tu sbyor ba'i phyir//lhan cig skyesasbyor mi zer ram//zhes so//de lta bu'i don nyams su blangasapa'i dus su dwangs ma'i shes pa ste tha mal gyi shesapa ma bcosapa nyid//te lo pas/kye ho 'di ni rang rag ye shesate//ngag tshig lasa'adasayid kyi spyod yul min//te long yisaci yang bstan du med//rang gas rang la mtshon te shes par byos//zhes gsungasapa ltar gzhi lta ba'i gnas lugs rang ngo shes nas mi mno mi bsam mi dpyad cing //mi bsgom mi semasarang babasabazhagakhresapa'i tshul gyisam yengasadran 'dun dang //bcasalam bsgom pasanyamagasu blang ba ni lam gyi dngosagazhi dang //de'i yan lag rdo rje'i lusal gnad dubasnun pa'i thabs lam zabamo bsgom pas lta spyod zung du sbrel ba ste/de yang rgyud dang 'brel ba'i thabs lam la bka' yang dag pa'i tshad mar/gtum mo las kyi phyag rgya dang //sgyu marmi lam 'od gsal dang /bar do lam gyi blo chod/'pho ba lam gyi sun ma/grong 'jug lam gyi chad mthud de chogabargyad dang /byin rlabasadang 'brelab snyan brgyud la/lasargya dang /grong 'jug ma gtogasachosadrug dang /gzhan yang 'pho ba bar de'i khongasasu bsdusapa'i chosalnga dang /'bor lo bzhi sogasakyi dbang du byasapa'i gtum mo/sgyu lus/'od gsal/rmi lam stobazhi dang /rtsab dang yan lag gi chosaganyisasu bsdu 0sogs/bka' brgyud dwagabashapo'i nyams len gtso bo yin//rten gzhizhi gtso bo byin rlabs༅ ma rgyud bde mchog ste//baspu' bsachu bo bzhi 'dusagrub chen tai lo shesarab bzang po'i slo~X 4//byang sgo srung ba'i paṇ+ḍita nā ro tā pa'i ste mi mchog

ba chen 'od sna pa la / sa skya'i cho yong sa bsdus/ ()zhabs sam rtsod med zhabs zhes grags pa khyad par gdams pa mchog /dang por bka' babs dgyes mdzad rdo rje mi yi dngos snang rje btsun mar pa lo tsā ba chos kyi blo gros yis /thugs nyams bzhes nas gangs ri'i khrod 'dir spel ba las/ slob ma'i gtso bo mtshi rngog mes gsum gyis bshad pa dang / mi las sgrub pa'i srol bzung / de'i slob ma nyi zla lta bu dwags po rin po che dang / ras chung ba gnyis/ snga ma slob ma phag gru'i thugs sras rgyal tsha rin po che dang / kun ldan rasachung mched gnyis las 'phel ba'i khro phu pa dang gling ra slob ma gtsang pa rgya ra ye shes rdo rje las dpal ldan 'brug pa dang / /dwags po'i slob ma sgom tshul gyi thugs sras zhang 'gro ba'i mgon po las tshal pa bka' brgyud dwags po'i slob ma spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul sku ga me pa/ /dusagasum mkhyen pa las ka ma tshang bka' brgyud/ phag gru'i slob ma 'bri gung pa rin chen dpal las 'bri gung bka' brgyud/ stag lung thang pa bkra shis dpal las stag lung bka' brgyud de 'bri stag rnam gnyis skal lad thar pa ye shes seng ge'i slob ma rgyal ba g.ya' bzang pa las g.ya' bzang bka' brgyud/ bka' brgyud de rnams phal cher gyi 'byung gnas/ 'gro mgon phag mo gru pa rdo rje rgyal po'i gdan sa pa spyan snga rin po che las phag gru bka' brgyud de/ /mdor na phyag rgya chen po la bshad pa dang /nyams len gyi srol gnyis las/ dang po/ jo bo/ mar pa/ dngul chi be+e ro/ kong ni ru pa/ rgya gar phyag na/bal po a su/ ras chung pa/ mnga' ris nag po ste brgyad tsam byung ba las/ sngon dar rgyas che na'ang / deng sang cher mi snang la/ phyi ma nyams len sgrub rgyud kyi srol med du byung ba ni sa gsum mnyam med dwags po'i bka' brgyud de'i bshad sgrub nyams len gyis/ /gangs can ri sul phal cher mdzes par byas/ /ga las kyang / dpal ldan 'brug pa bka' brgyud ni/ rje rgod tshang pa las stod 'brug gnam gyi skar ma lta bu dang / rgyal ba lo ra pa las smad 'brug sa yi dreg pa lta bu byung bas mtsho ni/ mi byed 'brug pa/ 'brug byed sprang po/ sprang phyed grub thob ces kun la rlung ltar 244

ba r+ṣa 'od snangalas/ saskya'i cho yang sa bsdus/ ()zhabasasam rtsod med zhabasazhesagragasapa khyad par gdams pa mchog /dang por bka' babs dgyesamadzad rdo rje mi yi dngos snang rje btsun mar pa lo tsā ba mosakyi blo grosayis /thugasanyamasabazhesanas gangs ri'i khrod 'dir spel ba las/ slobama'igatso bo mtshi rngog mesagasum gyisabashad pa dang / mi lasasgrub pa'i srol bzung / de'i slob ma nyi zla lta bu dwagasapo rin po che dang / rasachung ba gnyis/ snga ma slob ma phag gru'i thugasasrasargyalatsha rin po che dang / kun ldan rasachung mched gnyisalasa'aphel ba'i khro phu pa dang gling ra slob ma gtsang pa rgya ra ye shesardo rje las dpal ldan 'brug pa dang / /dwagasapo'i slob ma sgom tshul gyi thugasasrasazhang 'gro ba'i mgon po las tshal pa bka' brgyud dwagasapo'i slob ma spyan rasagazigasakyi sprul sku rkarma pa/ /dusagasum mkhyen pa lasakam tshang bka' brgyud/ phag gru'i slob ma 'bri gung pa rin chen dpal lasa'abri gung bka' brgyud/ stag lung thang pa bkra shisadapal lasastag lung bka' brgyud de 'bri stag rnam gnyis skal lad thar pa ye shesaseng ge'i slob ma rgyal ba g.ya' bzang pa lasagaya' bzang bka' brgyud/ bka' brgyud de rnamasaphal cher gyi 'byung gnas/ 'gro mgon phag mo gru pa rdo rje rgyalapo'i gdan sapa spyan snga rin po che lasaphag gru bka' brgyud de/ /mdor na phyag rgya chen po la bshad pa dang /nyamasalen gyi srolaganyisalas/ dang po/ jo bo/ mar pa/ dngulachi be+e ro/ kong ni ru pa/ rgyagar phyag na/bal po a su/ rasachung pa/ mnga' risanag po ste brgyad tsam byung ba las/ sngon dar rgyasache na'ang / deng sang cher mi snang la/ phyi ma nyamasalen sgrub rgyud kyi srol med du byung ba ni tshogasum mnyam med dwagasapo'i bka' brgyud de'i bshad sgrub nyams len gyis/ /gangasacan ri sul phal cher mdzesapar byas/ /galasakyang / dpal ldan 'brug pa baspu'abargyud ni/ rje rgod tshang pa lasastod 'brug gnam gyi skar ma lta bu dang / rgyal ba lo ra pa lasasmad 'brug sayi dreg pa lta bu byung bsamatshon/ mi byed 'brug pa/ 'brug byed sprang po/ sprang phyed grubathobacesakun ldorlung ltar 244

gangs ri'i khrod kyi sbong ba bsam gtan pa rnams kyi snyan du springs pa bsgom pa 'chi med bdud rtsi/grags pas brgyud 'dzin chu bo'i gter/ /lta bi ste/ de rnams kyi nyams bzhes ni/ lta ba gtso bor ston pa gdams ngag phyag rgya chen po/ sgom pa gtso bor ston pa ga dmasang ga nā ro chos drug spyod pa gtso bor ston pa gdams ngag 'byung ba ro snyoms/ 'bras bu gtso bor ston pa ga dmasang ga rten 'brel/kun la gces pa'i gdam bsang ga lam zab bla sgrub lnga ni gzhud chos lta bu dang / gzhan gdams ngag bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni zur 'debs lta bu mdzad do/ /spyir bka' brgyud ces pa'i sgra don ni/ rje dwagasango/ rin po che bsod nams rin chen gyis dang por bka' gdams pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi gsol nas/ phyis phyag rgya chen po'i brgyud pa rin po che la zhugs nas rtogs pa brnyes pas bka' phyag chu bo gnyis 'dres kyi gzhung bzung ba'i phyir de skad ces brjod do/ /gzung ba'i chos kun rang rang ngo bos stong / /'dzin pa'i sems kyang spros bral stong pa nyid/ /spros med ngang nas gsal stong mi g.yo ba/ /zhi byed chos kyi nyams len gtso bo yin/ /te/ de yang spyir lam 'di la dbang po'i rim pas 'khrid tshul bsam gyis mi khyab kyang re zhig bdun rdzogs bdun gyi man ngag ltar na/ zab mo brda yi dbang bzhis smin par bya ba sngon du song nas/ dbang po rab gzung 'dzin las 'das pa'i gnyug ma'i sems ma bcos pa'i gnas lugs mngon sum du mthong bas gcig car du 'tshang rgya bar byed pa dkar khrid rig pa gcer mthong gi gnad/ 'bring sgo gsum cha mnyam gyi thig le sbyong ba bla ma sku bzhi'i lam rdzogs pas thod rgal du sku bzhir grub pa dmar khrid mos gus chig chod kyi gnad/ tha ma rim 'jug gi lam lnga thob las nag khrid gdams ngag phra chod pa'i gnad dang gsum las/ phyi ma la'ang phyi mtshan nyid kyi gdams pa skabs brgyad rtsa ba gcig tu bsdus na bang la ma lnga gdan ga ṇi ga tu nyams su blangs pa la brten nas tshogs lam blo spyong gi snyel ma bgrod/ pha rgyud g.yo ba'i rlung sbar 'dzin gyi lam rim lnga gdan gcig tu rdzogs pa la brten nas sbyor lam dka' thub kyi srang du bcug ma rgyud bde ba nyams kyi ga dmasang ga phyag rgya bzhi gdan rdzogs su 245

gangasari'i khrod kyi spong ba bsamagatan pa rnamasakyi snyan du springasapa bsgom pa 'chi med bdud rtsi/grags pasabargyud 'dzin chu bo'i gter/ /lta bi ste/ de rnamasakyi nyams bzhes ni/ lta ba gtso kror ston pa gdams ngag phyag rgya chen po/ sgom pa gtso bor ston pa gdamasangag nā ro chos drug spyod pa gtso bor ston pa gdams ngag 'byung ba ro snyoms/ 'brasabu gtso bor ston pa gdamasangag rten 'brel/kun la gces pa'i gdamasangag lam zab bla sgrub lnga ni gzhud chos lta bu dang / g.yin gdams ngag bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni zur 'debasalta bu mdzad do/ /spyir bka' brgyud cesapa'i sgra don ni/ rje dwagasapo/ rin po che bsod namasarin chen gyisadang por bka' gdamasapa'i mosakyi bdud rtsi gsol nas/ phyis phyag rgya chen po'i brgyud pa rin po che la zhugs nas rtogs pa brnyesapas bka' phyag chu bo gnyis 'dres kyi gzhung bzung ba'i phyir de skad ces brjod do/ /gzung ba'i chos kun rang rang ngo bos stong / /'dzin pa'i sems kyang spros bral stong pa nyid/ /spros med ngang nas gsal stong mi g.yo ba/ /zhi byed chos kyi nyams len gtso bo yin/ /te/ de yang spyir lam 'di la dbang po'i rim pasa'akhrid tshul bsam gyis mi khyab kyang re zhig bdun rdzogasabadun gyi man ngag ltar na/ zab mo brda yi dbang bzhis smin par bya ba sngon du song nas/ dbang po rab gzung 'dzin lasa'adas pa'i gnyug ma'i sems ma bcos pa'i gnas lugs mngon sum du mthong bsagacig car du 'tshang rgya bar byed pa dkar khrid rig pa gcer mthong gi gnad/ 'bring sgo gsum cha mnyam gyi thig le sbyong ba bla ma sku bzhi'i lam rdzogs pas thod rgal du sku bzhir grub pa dmar khrid mosagusachig chod kyi gnad/ tha ma rim 'jug gi lam lnga thob lasanag khrid gdams ngag phra chod pa'i gnad dang gsum las/ phyi ma la'ang phyi mtshan nyid kyi gdams pa skabs brgyad rtsa ba gcig tu bsdus nasalam lnga gdan gcig tu nyams su blangs pa la brten nas tshogs lam blo sbyong gi snyelam bgrod/ pha rgyud g.yo ba'i rlung sbar 'dzin gyi lam rim lnga gdan gcig tu dzo+ogasapa la brten nas sbyor lam dka' thub kyi srang du bcug ma rgyud bde ba nyamasakyi gdamasangag phyag rgya bzhi gdan rdzogasasu 245

'tshe chen 'od sna pa la / sa skya'i mtho5nga sa bsdus/ ()bsgom pa la brten nas mthong lam gyis rjes bcad/ snying po don gyi gdams pa rnal 'byor bzhi lam ting nge 'dzin bzhi gdan rdzogs su bsgom pa la brten nas sgom lam ro snyoms kyi bogs dbyung / rig pa rang grol gyi gdams pa sbyor ba yan lag drug gdan rdzogs su bsgom pa la brten nas mthar phyin bya bral gyi lam thob par bya ba'o/ /zhi byed ces pa'i sgra don ni/ bod du byon pa'i 'khrid tshul phal mo ches slob ma shā dge ba las bzlog tu bcig nas gzod de'i sems rgyud kyi nyon mongs sbyong bar byed pa gtso che la/ 'dir ni sngon gyi las kyi dbang gis lus dman pa dang / nad bu can du gyur pa sogs sdug bsngal rnams 'phral 'phral du zhi bar byas nas rnal 'byor la sbyor bzod par byed pas na dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed ces bya ste / yum las/ sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i sngags/ zhes dang / 'jam dpal sgyu dra las/ sdug bsnga'i/gsum gyi bsdug bsngal zhi/ /srid gsum mtha' yang ( gro 'ang gsum thob/ /sgrib pa kumalas rnam par grol/ /mkha' ltar mnyam pa nyid la gnas/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa la brten nas btags par mdzad cing / ngo bo pha rol tu phyin pa sngags dang rjes su mthun pa zhes mdo rgyud thams cad kyi zab gnad gcig tu dril ba'i gdams pa khyad par can no/ /rten gzhi'i gtso bo spyi mdo sher phyin rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum sogs dang / sgos mdo chu klung rol pa'i mdo/ /rgya gar be+e tā'i yul gyi tsa ra seng ngar zhabrungs pa'i mkhas pa chen po ka ma la shi la'am dam pa sangs rgyas zhesabya ba grub thob jo mo lnga bcu rtsa bzhi las gdams pa zab mo mtha' dag gsan nas rtse gcig tu bsgrub pa la gzhol bas/thugs dam bde gshegs bcu gnyis dang / ngo mtshar mkha' spyod kyi bla ma sum sto rtsa drug sogs kyi zhal gzigs/ thun mong gi dngos grub grub pa chen po brgyad dang / mchog gi dngos grub mthong lam chen po'i ye shes brnyes pa de nyid kyi khyad par gdams pa mchog bod yul 'dir brda dang gsung gis gzhan la gdul bya so so'i dbang po dang 'tshams par snga phyi bar gsum du bstan pa las//gangs ri'i khrod 'dir brgyud pa rim pa gsum/ /brgyud pa dang po dam pas kha che dz+nyā 246

'tshechen 'od snangal / saskya'i motho5nga sa bsdus/ ()bsgom pa la brten nasamathong lam gyisarjesabacad/ snying po don gyi gdamasapa rnal 'byor bzhi lam ting nge 'dzin bzhi gdan rdzogs su bsgom pa la brten nasasgom lam ro snyomasakyi bogasadabyung / rig pa rang grol gyi gdams pa sbyor ba yan lag drug gdan rdzogasasu bsgom pa la brten nasamathar phyin bya bral gyi lam thob par bya ba'o/ /zhi byed cesapa'i sgra don ni/ bod du byon pa'i 'khrid tshul phal mo chesaslob ma mi dge ba las bzlog tu bcug nasagazod de'i semasargyud kyi nyon mongasasbyong bar byed pa gtso che la/ 'dir ni sngon gyi lasakyi dbang gisalusadaman pa dang / nad bu can du gyur pa sogasasdug bsngal rnamasa'aphra' 'phral du zhi bar byas nas rnal 'byor la sbyor bzod par byed pas na dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed ces bya ste / yum las/ sdug bsngal thamasacad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i sngags/ zhesadang / 'angam dpal sgyu dra las/ sdug bsnga'/gsumagyiba'isdugabasngal zhi/ /srid gsum mtha' yabrasagro'/gsum thob/ /sgrib pa kumalas rnam par grol/ /mkha' ltar mnyam pa nyid la gnas/ /zhesasogasagasungasapa la brten nas btagasapar mdzad cing / ngo bo pha rol tu phyin pa sngagasadang rjes su mthun pa zhesamado rgyud thamasacad kyi zab gnad gcig tu dril ba'i gdamasapa khyad par can no/ /rten gzhizhi gtso bo spyi mdo sher phyin rgyasa'abring bsdusagasum sogasadang / sgosamado chu klung rol pa'i mdo/ /rgya gar be+e tā'i yul gyi tsa ra seng ngar 'khrungasapa'i mkhasapa chen po ka ma loshi la'am dam pa sangs rgyas zhesabya ba grub thob jo mo lnga bcu rtsabazhi lasagadamasapa zab mo mtha' dag gsan nasartse gcig tu bsgrub pa la gzhol bas/thugasadam bde gshegs bcu gnyisadang / ngo mtshar mkha' spyod kyi bla ma sum rtsartsa drug sogasakyi zhal gzigs/ thun mong gi dngosagrub grub pa chen po brgyad dang / mchog gi dngosagrub mthong lam chen po'i ye shes brnyesapa de nyid kyi khyad par gdams pa mchog bod yul 'dir brda dang gsung gis gzhan la gdul bya soso'i dbang po dang 'tshamasapar snga phyi bar gsum du bstan pa las//gangs ri'i khrod 'dir brgyud pa rim pa gsum/ /brgyud pa dang po dam pasakha che dz+nyā 246

gangs ri'i khrod kyi spong ba bsam gtan pa rnams kyi snyan du springs pa bsgom pa 'chi med bdud rtsi/na gu tho la zhi byed sgron me'i sgor gsum sogs gnang zhing / de dang dam pa gnyis kas rje btsun tse(nga po lo tsā ba la gnang ba dang / dz+nyā na gu r+shas pu shing lo chung la bshad pa sogs dang / brgyud pa bar ma rma chos kyi shes rab la phyag chen skor so chung dge 'dun 'bar la rig pa cer mthong gi man ngag /ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan la rtog pa lam khyer gdams ngag gnang ba sogs me so dam ga sdo/ma phran dang bcas pa dang / brgyud pa tha ma dam pa phyar chen la sher phyin bsgom yod bsgom medaganyis su ngo sprad nas cho lu dang / mdo sbyor dang / don sde pa gsum gyi spros pa bcad/ dam pa phyar chung la sngags dang bar phyin gnyis med kyi gdams pas ngo sprad de/ bsnyen sgrub bzhi'i srang du bcug badz+ra kro dha byin rlabs kyi snyel ma pa yin gsungs nas rtag tu gsol ba 'debs su bcug byang chub sems dpa' kun dga' ni gang zag rim gyis pa yin gsungs nas/ blo sbyong gnang nas dka' thub kyi srang rkyang khug lam lngas bsdus pa la bas pa ste/ sgo ba'i rnal 'byor pa bzhi yis mtshon bu chen bdun gyi lugs dang / ma jo nyi shu rtsa bzhi sogs grub pa'i skyes bu bgrang las 'das pa byon pa so so'i sdo/gas srol bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / skye ba lngar dam pas rjes su bzung zhing / nga dang dgongs pa mnyam pa kun dga' yin ces bsngagasapa chog brgyud kyi mnga' bdag dam pa kun dga' zhes thugs sras mchog tu gyur pa gang gis pa tshab bsgom pa dang / des rgyal ba te ba/ des rog shes rab seng ge sku mched la gnang ba sogasashin tu dar rgyas che bar byung ba ni lugs srol khyad par du 'phags pa zhig yin la/ spyir brgyud pa bar ma bka' tha ma dang / brgyud pa tha ma sngags dang gtso bor mthun no/ /sor sdud bsam gtan stong gzugs 'char ba dang / /srog rtsol 'dzin pas srog gnas 'gog par byed/ /rjes dran ting 'dzin bde chen bskyed pa de/ /sbyor drug chos kyi nyams len gtso bo yin te/ /de yang dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ so sor sdud dang bsam gtan dang / /srog rtsol de bzhin ridzin pa dang / /rjes su dran dang ting nge 'dzin/ /sbyor ba yan lag drug tu 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/247

gangasari'i khrod kyi spong ba bsam gtan pa rnamasakyi snyan du springs pa bsgom pa 'chi med bdud rtsi/na gu h+ya la zhi byed sgron me'i skor gsum sogasaganang zhing / de dang dam pa gnyisakasarje btsun ong po lo tsā ba la gnang ba dang / dz+nyā na gu byasapu tso lo chung la bshad pa sogasadang / brgyud pa bar ma rma chos kyi shesarab la phyag chen skor so chung dge 'dun 'bar la rig pa cer mthong gi man ngag /ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan la rtog pa lam khyer gdams ngag gnang ba sogs me so dam gadza/ma phran dang bcasapa dang / brgyud pa tha ma dam pa phyar chen la sher phyin bsgom yod bsgom medaganyisasungo sprad nas cho lu dang / mdo sbyor dang / don sde pa gsum gyisasprosapa bcad/ dam pa phyar chung lasngags dang bar phyin gnyisamed kyi gdamasapasango sprad de/ bsnyen sgrub bzhi'i srang du bcug badz+ra kro dha byin rlabasakyi snyelam pa yin gsungasanas rtag tu gsol ba 'debasasu bcug byang chub semasadapa' kun dga' ni gang zag rim gyis pa yin gsungasanas/ blo sbyong gnang nasadaka' thub kyi srang rkyang khug lam lngas bsdus pa la gas pa ste/ sgo ba'i rnal 'byor pa bzhi yisamatshon bu chen bdun gyi lugasadang / ma jo nyi shu rtsa bzhi sogs grub pa'i skyes bu bgrang las 'das pa byon pa so so'i sdo/gas srol bsam gyisami khyab kyang / skye ba lngar dam pasarjesasu bzung zhing / nga dang dgongs pa mnyam pa kun dga' yin cesabasngagasapa chog brgyud kyi mnga' bdag dam pa kun dga' zhesathugs sras mchog tu gyur pa gang nas pa tshab bsgom pa dang / des rgyal ba te ne+e/ des rog shesarab seng ge sku mched la gnang ba sogasashin tu dar rgyasache bar byung ba ni lugasasrol khyad par du 'phagasapa zhig yin la/ spyir brgyud pa bar ma bka' tha ma dang / brgyud pa tha ma sngagasadang gtso bor mthun no/ /sor sdud bsam gtan stong gzugs 'char ba dang / /srog rtsol 'dzin pas srog gnas 'gog par byed/ /rjes dran ting 'dzin bde chen bskyed pa de/ /sbyor drug chos kyi nyams len gtso bo yin te/ /de yang dusa'akhor rtsargyud las/ so sor sdud dang bsam gtan dang / /srog rtsol de bzhin ridzen pa dang / /rjes su dran dang ting nge 'dzin/ /sbyor ba yan lag drug tu 'dod/ /cesagasungasapa ltar/247

brtsechen 'od snang las/ saskya'i chosayang rnyasabasdus/ ()bsgrub bya ni de bzhin gshegasapa'i gsang ba gsum dang / sgrub byed sbyor ba yan lag drug yin la/ ji ltar bsgrub tshul ni/ sor mnyam gnyis kyisadabu ma sbyangasashing rdo rje'i sku rnam pa thamasacad pa bsgrub/srog rtsol gyis der ro rkyang gi rlung 'dzud cing / 'dzin pasade brtan par byasapasardo rje'i gsung rnam pa thamasacad pa bsgrub/ rjes dran gyisaphyag rgya la brten nasabyang semasabazhu ba de zag bral gyi ngang du bzung ba'i 'gyur med kyi bde ba dang / ting nge 'dzin gyisade nyid kha sbyor te gzugasakyi sku dang dbyer med du byas pas bde stong zung 'jug rdo rje'i thugs rnam pa thamasacad pa bsgrub pa'o/ /gzhan yang sor bsam gnyis sku rdo rje'i bsnyen pa'i yan lag srog 'dzin gnyisagasung rdo rje'i rnal 'byor nyer sgrub kyi yan lag rjes dran thugs rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i yan lag ting nge 'dzin ye shesardo rje'i rnal 'byor sgrub chen gyi yan lag gam/ sor bsam gnyisagazugs sgrub kyi yan lag srog 'dzin gnyisasrog sgrub kyi yan lagarjesadran bde ba sgrub pa'i yan lag ting nge 'dzin bde ba sgrub pa'i yan lag cesakyang bya'o/ /de yang dusazhabasasnyan brgyud las/ kun la drug drug cesabya ste/ zhesagasungasapa ltar/ yan lag drug po re re la'ang / ngo bo ngesatshig dbye ba dang / /rigasabadag bskyed thabs 'brasabu'o/ /zhes don tshan drug drug gi sgo nas gtan la 'bebs tshul sogasargyas par bsnyen bsgrub yan lag bzhi'i rnam gzhag tu bshad pa ltar dang / bla ma gong ma rnamasakyis/ sngon 'gro ltosamed drug ldan/ dngotshogazhi rnal 'byor drug ldan/ rjesasrung sdom drug ldan zhes pa'i chingasakyang mdzad do/ /rten gzhi'i gtso bo dpaladusakyi 'bor lo rtsa ba yi rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis pa dang / de lasa'ajam dpalagyi spru'adapa rigasaldan gragasapasanye bar bsdus pa'i rgyud/ /le'u lnga pa'i bdag nyid 'grel chen dang bcasapa ste/ thogamar sprulapa'i rigasad rnamasakyis sham+bha lar dar rgyasasu mdzad/ de nasa'aphagasayuladu tsi lu paṇ+ḍitasaspelazhing / de'i slob ma paṇ+ḍi.ā tsarla ste slob dpon bsod snyomasapar gragasapa dang / de'i slob ma dus thebs paṇa chen te/ dusazhabasapa chen po'am/ tsi lu pa chung bar yang gragasapa des/ sprulapa'i rigasaldan las248

ba tshe chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()bsgrub bya ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba gsum dang / sgrub byed sbyor ba yan lag drug yin la/ ji ltar bsgrub tshul ni/ sor mnyam gnyis kyis dbu ma sbyangs shing rdo rje'i sku rnam pa thams cad pa bsgrub/srog rtsol gyis der ro rkyang gi rlung 'dzud cing / 'dzin pas de brtan par byas pas rdo rje'i gsung rnam pa thams cad pa bsgrub/ rjes dran gyis phyag rgya la brten nas byang sems bzhu ba de zag bral gyi ngang du bzung ba'i 'gyur med kyi bde ba dang / ting nge 'dzin gyis de nyid kha sbyor te gzugs kyi sku dang dbyer med du byas pas bde stong zung 'jug rdo rje'i thugs rnam pa thams cad pa bsgrub pa'o/ /gzhan yang sor bsam gnyis sku rdo rje'i bsnyen pa'i yan lag srog 'dzin gnyis gsung rdo rje'i rnal 'byor nyer sgrub kyi yan lag rjes dran thugs rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i yan lag ting nge 'dzin ye shes rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sgrub chen gyi yan lag gam/ sor bsam gnyis gzugs sgrub kyi yan lag srog 'dzin gnyis srog sgrub kyi yan lagarjes dran bde ba sgrub pa'i yan lag ting nge 'dzin bde ba sgrub pa'i yan lag ces kyang bya'o/ /de yang dusazhabs snyan brgyud las/ kun la drug drug ces bya ste/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ yan lag drug po re re la'ang / ngo bo nges tshig dbye ba dang / /rigs bdag bskyed thabs 'bras bu'o/ /zhes don tshan drug drug gi sgo nas gtan la 'bebs tshul sogs rgyas par bsnyen bsgrub yan lag bzhi'i rnam gzhag tu bshad pa ltar dang / bla ma gong ma rnams kyis/ sngon 'gro stos med drug ldan/ dngos gzhi rnal 'byor drug ldan/ rjesasrung sdom drug ldan zhes pa'i chings kyang mdzad do/ /rten gzhi'i gtso bo dpal dus kyi 'khor lo rtsa ba yi rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis pa dang / de las 'jam dpal gyi spru'ang pa rigs ldan grags pas nye bar bsdus pa'i rgyud/ /le'u lnga pa'i bdag nyid 'grel chen dang bcas pa ste/ thog mar sprul pa'i rigasad rnams kyis sham+bha lar dar rgyas su mdzad/ de nas 'phags yul du tsi lu paṇ+ḍita sa spel zhing / de'i slob ma paṇ+ḍi ā tsarla ste slob dpon bsod snyoms par grags pa dang / de'i slob ma dus 'khas paṇa chen te/ dus zhabs pa chen po'am/ tsi lu pa chung bar yang grags pa des/ sprul pa'i rigs ldan las248

gangasari'i khrod kyi spong ba bsam gtan pa rnams kyi snyan du springasapa bsgom pa 'chi med bdud rtsi/kyang dngos su dbang bshad man ngag mtha' dag gsan nas khyad par gyi gdams pa mchog /'di rtsal du bton nasa'achad par mdzad pa las/ slob ma'i mchog a wa dhu ti pa/ ngag gi dbang phyug shrī bha dra bo dhi/ nā len+d+ra pa ste 'di gsum ka la dusazhabasapa chung bar sosor gragasapa sogasamakhasashing dngos grub brnyesapa bsam gyisami khyab pa zhig byon/ bod yul 'dir dang por bka' babs gyi gyo lo tsā zla ba'i 'odazer yis/ dusazhabasapa chung ba shrī bha dra bo dhi spyan drangasanas rgyud 'grel rdzogs par bsgyur cing / rang gisathugs nyams bzhes nas gangs ri'i khrod 'dir spel ba lasaslob ma khrom lo tsā ba pad+mo 'od zer sogasabu chen bzhir gragasapa byung / khrom losabla ma'i gsung zin brisasu mdzad pa lasabargyud pa'i gyi gyo lugasadang / nā len+d+ra pa'i slob ma mañju kirti/ de'i slob ma bal po saman shrī/ de lasar lo tsā ba mosarab kyisagasan pa'i rwa lugasadang / de bzhin du/ nā len+d+ra pa/ kha che zla gzhon 'bro shesarab grags/ sgom pa dkon mchog srung sogasalasabargyud pa'i 'bro lugs/ nā len+d+ra r+sā /'i slob ma rtsa mi bsod snyomasapa sangasargyasagragasanasabargyud pa'i rtsami lugs/ de'i slob ma selo tsā ba gzhon nu tshul khrimasadang / de lasaganyos dar ma 'od kyisagasan pa sogasaganyosalugs/ nā len+d+ra pa / a bhā wā kwa ra/ nisko li zha b.lapo paṇ+ḍita re ben+d+ra/ chag lo chosarje dpal sogasalasabargyud pa chag lo lugs/ a bhā ya/ bizlu tā da be/ kha tshepaṇa chen shākya shrī/ dpyal mothokyi bzang po sogasalasabargyud r+sā / paṇa chen lugasasam dpyalalo lugs/ rwa chosarab nas/ ye shesaseng ge 'bum seng / rong pa rga lo rnam rgyal rdo rje sogasalasabargyud pa'i rong lugs/ tsā mi nasakhamasapa rgya lo gzhon nu dpal labargyud pa dang / de nyid kyisazhang tshal pa la gnang ba'i tshal lugs/ grub chen shābari dbang phyug gisapaṇa chen sgru ti tsan+d+ra la dngos su bstsal zhing / desako brag pa bsod namasargyal mtshan laganang ba ko brag lugs/mañju kirti dang / a bhā yasaganyan lo dang / rga lo gnyis la gsungs shing / de gnyis ka lasabla ma 'gos kyisagasan pa sogasa'agosalugs/ chagachosarje dpal/ go lung pa mdo sde dpal/ mkhasagrub o rgyan 249

gangs ri'i khrod kyi sbong ba bsam gtan pa rnams kyi snyan du springs pa bsgom pa 'chi med bdud rtsi/kyang dngos su dbang bshad man ngag mtha' dag gsan nas khyad par gyi gdams pa mchog /'di rtsal du bton nas 'am da par mdzad pa las/ slob ma'i mchog a wa dhu ti pa/ ngag gi dbang phyug shrī bha dra bo dhi/ nā len+d+ra pa ste 'di gsum ka la dus zhabs pa chung bar so sor grags pa sogs mkhas shing dngos grub brnyes pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig byon/ bod yul 'dir dang por bka' babs gyi gyo lo tsā zla ba'i 'od zer yis/ dus zhabs pa chung ba shrī bha dra bo dhi spyan drangs nas rgyud 'grel rdzogs par bsgyur cing / rang gis thugs nyams bzhes nas gangs ri'i khrod 'dir spel ba lasaslob ma khrom lo tsā ba pad+mo 'od zer sogs bu chen bzhir grags pa byung / khrom los bla ma'i gsung zin brisasu mdzad pa las brgyud pa'i gyi (1 lugs dang / nā len+d+ra pa'i slob ma mañju kirti/ de'i slob ma bal po saman shrī/ de las rwa lo tsā ba chos rab kyis gsan pa'i rwa lugs dang / de bzhin du/ nā len+d+ra pa/ kha che zla gzhon 'bro shes rab grags/ sgom pa dkon mchog srung sogs las brgyud pa'i 'bro lugs/ nā len+d+ra da /'i slob ma rtsa mi bsod snyoms pa sangs rgyas grags nas brgyud pa'i rtsa mi lugs/ de'i slob ma se lo tsā ba gzhen nu tshul khrims dang / de las gaḍinyos dar ma 'od kyis gsan pa sogs gnyos lugs/ nā len+d+ra pa / a bhā wā kwa ra/ ni li zha bal po paṇ+ḍita re be spro/ chag lo chos rje dpal sogs las brgyud pa chag lo lugs/ a bhā ya/ bizlu tā da be/ kha tshe paṇa chen shākya shrī/ dpyal chos kyi bzang po sogs las brgyud ri / paṇa chen lugs sam dpyal lo lugs/ rwa chos rab nas/ ye shes seng ge 'bum seng / rong pa rga lo rnam rgyal rdo rje sogs las brgyud pa'i rong lugs/ tsā mi nas khams pa rgya lo gzhen nu dpal la brgyud pa dang / de nyid kyis zhang 36pa pa la gnang ba'i tshal lugs/ grub chen shā ba ri dbang phyug gis paṇa chen sgru ti tsan+d+ra la dngos su bstsal zhing / des ska| brag pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan laganang ba ko brag lugs/mañju girti dang / a bhā yas gnyan lo dang / rga lo gnyis la gsungs shing / de gnyis ka las bla ma 'a lha/sa kyas gas na pa sogs 'gos lugs/ chag chos rje dpal/ go lung pa mdo sde dpal/ mkhas grub o rgyan 249

ba chen 'od snangal /saskya'i chosayang tso bsdus/()pa /snye mdo kun dga' don grub/rje rang byung pyosogasalasabargyud pa kur lugs/grub thob rtsemo che ba nas/pho dong pa rin chen rtsemo/stag sdob seng gorgyalamatshan/de dang go lung pa'i slobam shong ston lo cwa ba rdo rje rgyal ma dang /dpang blo grosabartan pa sogasal brgyud pa dang /khamatshogargya lo nas za la gnang ba'i salugasarnamasadang /khyad par dusakyi 'bor lo gangasacan khrod 'dir shin tu dar bar mdzad pa ni jo zhalwa gnyis te/de yang sgom pa dkon mchogasrung nas/sgron ston gnamolabartsegs/grub thob yumo ba/srasadharme rwar/namamakha' 'od/grungathobartsemoche ba/'jayogasang ba/kun mkhyen chosa'od/kun spangasathugasarje brtson 'grus/byang semasargyala.e/yon tan rgya mtsho/kun mkhyen dol bu pa shesarangargyalamatshan sogasalasabargyud pa jo nang lugasadang /motho'od nas/'phagasa'od/bu ston rin grub la brgyud pa sogasabu lugasate/lug 'di gnyisakasadang po rwa pa'i brgyud pa las gsan cing /phyisa'abro lugasal yang dag par zhugasapasagatso bor rwa 'bro'i brgyud pa 'dzin mo/gzhan du sbyor drug mi 'dra ba phal cher gyi bka' babasapa dang /der ma zad lugabashasrol phran tshegs na lkog phran ba'i lugs dang kun spangasapa'i slob tshilastod dbang rgyal lugs/sogasamang da byon pa ste/mdor na gyogar 'phagasapa'i yuladu dusazhabasapa che chung /shwa ngari/dpe med mtsho/nya rma/ dpal/ye shes/nā ro pa/kha paṇa chen gyi lugasalogasadang /bod 'dir dar sal/gyi gyo/'bro/rwading ri chosagragasate sngon byon bzhi/man lung gung sathar lo/o rgyan pa/bi bhu ti tsan+d+ra ste bar byon bzhi/shwa ba ri thog mtha' bar gsum/phyisabyon rgya gar shar phyogasabasnu ga ri'i paṇ+ḍita chen po nagasakya rin 'a lasabyung bsamar+sā de sogasazab lam med du byung ba 'di gangs can gyi 'dzin mar khyab par shar ba lasakyang/rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ba mo'i nyamasalen chu bo'i rgyun ltar bar ma lo pa dang ldan pa ni kun mkhyen jo nang pa yin te/kun spangasarin po che byang semasargyal ye sogasakun spangasabu bzhin gragasapa dang/kun mkhyen dol ༵ bye/ra kun mkhyen chosagrags/phyogasalasarnamargyal/

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/()pa /snye mdo kun dga' don grub/rje rang byung gso gos las brgyud pa kur lugs/grub thob rtse mo che ba nas/pho dong pa rin chen rtse mo/stag sdob seng go rgyal4zha/de dang go lung pa'i sgro ba ma shong ston lo cwa ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang /dpang blo gros brtan pa sogs la brgyud pa dang /khams po rgya lo nas 'a la gnang ba'i sa lugs rnams dang /khyad par dus kyi 'khor lo gangs can khrod 'dir shin tu dar bar mdzad pa ni jo zhal gnyis te/de yang sgom pa dkon mchog srung nas/sgron ston gan mo la brtsegs/grub thob ga mo ba/sras dharme rwar/na mo mkha' 'od/grung thobartse mo che ba/'jam gsar ba/kun mkhyen chos 'od/kun spangs thugs rje brtson 'grus/byang sems rgyal ye/yon tan rgya mtsho/kun mkhyen dol bu pa shes rang rgyal mtshan sogs las brgyud pa jo nang lugs dang /chos 'od nas/'phags 'od/bu ston rin chen grub la brgyud pa sogs bu lugs te/lug 'di gnyis kas dang po rwa pa'i brgyud pa las gsan cing /phyis 'bro lugs la yang dag par zhugs pas gtso bor rwa 'bro'i brgyud pa 'dzin mo/g.yin du sbyor drug mi 'dra ba phal cher gyi bka' babs pa dang /der ma zad sdo// gas kha srol phran tshegs na lkog phran ba'i lugs dang kun spangs pa'i slob ma la stod dbang rgyal lugs/sogs mang da byon pa ste/mdor na gyogar 'phags pa'i yul du dus zhabs pa che chung /shwa nga ri/dpe med mtsho/nya rma/ dpal/ye shes/nā ro pa/kha chen paṇa chen gyi lugs so gos dang /bod 'dir dar sal/gyi gyo/'bro/rwa | di nga ri chos grags te sngon byon bzhi/man lung gung sa thar lo/o rgyan pa/bi bhu ti tsan+d+ra ste bar byon bzhi/shwa ba ri thog mtha' bar gsum/phyis byon rgya gar shar phyogs pa snu ga ri'i paṇ+ḍita chen po nags kya rin 'a las byung bas mtshon de sogs zab lam med du byung ba 'di gangs can gyi 'dzin mar khyab par shar ba las kyang/rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ba mo'i nyams len chu bo'i rgyun ltar bar ma lo pa dang ldan pa ni kun mkhyen jo nang pa yin te/kun spangs rin po che byang sems rgyal ye sogs kun spangs bu bzhin grags pa dang/kun mkhyen dol bu par kun mkhyen chos grags/phyogs las rnam rgyal/250

gangs ri'i khrod kyi spong ba bsam gtan pa rnams kyi snyan du springs pa bsgom pa 'chi med bdud rtsi/na dbon kun dga' dpal/ ma ti rnam gnyis sogs bstan 'dzin chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig byon nas/ slob brgyud mkhas shing sbyor ba yan lag drug gi rnal 'byor lhur len pa mang pos stod mnga' risanas bzung dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi ri sul phal cher gang bas nges don gyi bstan pa nyin mo ltar mdzad do/ /lus rtsa dag par byed pa sku yi rdo rje bsnyen pa yi yan lag la lus gnad byed pa bcings pa'i rnal 'byor rgyu sor sdud de'i byed las 'bras bu bsam gtan sde gsum sgo nas gtan la da bab pa dang / /ngag rlung dag par byed pa gsung gi rdo rje sgrub pa yi yan lag la rdor bzlas zhes 'jug ldang gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyi sngags su sbyar ba'i rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro bas rgyu 11ga rtsol dang / /de'i 'bras bu 'dzin pa de gnyis kyi byed las/ byed las kyis bsgrub pa'i 'bras bu dang /bzhi'i sgo nas gtan la dbab pa dang / yid kyi thig le dag par byed pa thugs kyi rdo rje sgrub pa chen pa'i yan lag la/ 'jig rten pa'i lam rdzogs par bstan pa rjes dran dbang po rab gtum mo/ 'bring rang lus/ tha mo gzhan lus la brten ba gsum/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam rdzogs par bstan pa ta ri nge 'dzin dmigs bcas dang dmigs med kyi bde ba chen po gnyis su med pa rang rig pa'i bde ba la sems rtse gcig tu gnas pas dwangs ma thig le phyi rol du 'pho rgyu thams cad rdo rje nor bu nas phyir 'dzag pa med par 'ching / ba rnams ni grub pa'i slob dpon au ḍi ā na pa las byung ba'i rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub ces grags pa'i ba chos kyi nyams su len bya'i gtso bo yin pa'i tshul/ dpal gsang ba 'dub(ba las/ khyod kyi lus semasang lta bu dang / sems tshig tu brjod pa lta bur bskyed cig ces gzhi dus su rdo rje gsum mi byed pa'i 'brel bkod nas/ la mo dus su rdo rje gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom pas/ 'bras dus su gsang ba gsum gyi bdag nyid mngon du byed pa'i ga dmasang ga khyad par can te/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ rtsa sbyangs pas ni lus kyi dri ma dag /rlung sbyangasapas ni ngag gi dri ma dag /'dzag med thob pas yid kyi bag chags bcom/ /'khor lo'i mdud pa dga' 251

gangasari'i khrod kyi spong ba bsam gtan pa rnamasakyi snyan du springasapa bsgom pa 'chi med bdud rtsi/na dbon kun dga' dpal/ ma ti rnam gnyisasogasabastan 'dzin chen po bsam gyisami khyab pa zhig byon nas/ slob brgyud mkhasashing sbyor ba yan lag drug gi rnala'abyor lhur len pa mang posastod mnga' risanas bzung dbusagatsang khamasagasum gyi ri sul phal cher gang bsangesadon gyi bstan pa nyin mo ltar mdzad do/ /lusartsa dag par byed pa sku yi rdo rje bsnyen pa yi yan lag la sdo/sa gnad byed pa bcings pa'i rnal 'byor rgyu sor sdud de'i byed lasa'abrasabu bsam gtan sde gsum sgo nasagatan la da bab pa dang / /ngag rlungadag par byed pa gsung gi rdo rje sgrub pa yi yan lag la rdor bzlas zhes 'jug ldang gnasagasum 'bru gsum gyi sngagasasu sbyar ba'i rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro bsargyu srog rtsol dang / /de'i 'brasabu 'dzin pa de gnyisakyi byed las/ byed lasakyisabasgrub pa'i 'brasabu dang /bzhi'i sgo nasagatan ladabab pa dang / yid kyi thig le dag par byed pa thugs kyi rdo rje sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag la/ 'jig rten pa'i lam rdzogasapar bstan pa rjesadran dbang po rab gtum mo/ 'bring rang lus/ tha tshigazhan lusalabarten ba gsum/ 'jig rten lasa'adasapa'i lam rdzogasapar bstan pa tiri nge 'dzin dmigasabacasadang dmigasamed kyi bde ba chen po gnyisasu med pa rang rig pa'i bde ba la semasartse gcig tu gnasapasadwangs ma thig le phyi rol du 'pho rgyu thamasacad rdo rje nor bu nasaphyir 'dzag pa med par 'ching / ba rnamasani grub pa'i slob dpon o ḍi ā na pa lasabyung ba'i rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub cesagragasapa'i ba chos kyi nyams su len bya'i gtso bo yin pa'i tshul/ dpal gsang ba 'duspob las/ khyod kyi lusasemasalta bu dang / semasatshig tu brjod pa lta bur bskyed cig cesagazhi dusasu rdo rje gsum mi byed pa'i 'brel bkod nas/ lamadus su rdo rje gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom pas/ 'brasadusasu gsang ba gsum gyi bdag nyid mngon du byed pa'i gdamasangag khyad par can te/ rdo rje'i tshigarkang las/ nasbyangasapasani lusakyi dri ma dag /rlung sbyangasapasani ngag gi dri ma dag /'dzag med thob pasayid kyi bag chagasabacom/ /'khor lo'i mdud pa dga' 251

'tshechen 'od snang las/saskya'i chosaring sa bsdus/()bzhi'i 'grosakyisabashig/ma rig gnyid ni brgyal ba log pas dwangs//chagasabral nyamasapa zha snang da pa'i sems//chagasagadag pasabade ba chen por grol/zhesagasungasapa ltar ro//de lta bu' lama'adi'i rten gzhi'i gtso bo ni morgyud bde mchog 'khor lo dngaganyisasu med pa dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud gnyisalabarten nas/sangasargyasathamasacad kyi shesarab stong pa nyid rnam kun mchog ldan ye shesasgyu ma'i gzugasasu shar ba'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor masalegs par bkral ba'i khyad par gyi gdams pa mchog tu gyur pa/ /gang zhig dang por bka' babs mkhas grub o rgyan dang //thugs nyams bzhes nas gangs ri'i khrod 'dir spel ba yin te/de yang grub chen rin chen dpal zhesargyal ba rgod tshang pa'i slob ma brtul zhugs rab dang mnyam par bsngagasapa de nyid mthong lam gyi bden pa mngon sum du gzigasapa spyod pasamathar phyin par bya ba'i phyir dza la ra sogasaganasachen mang por byon/lhag par au ḍi yā na zhesagragasapar rdo jo thigapa'i gan mdzod chen mor bzhugasapa/sprul pa'i zhing ye shesakyi mkha' 'gro ma rnamasakyi dga' b.ri tshalachen po der dpal ye shesapa'i zhabasa'abring dang bcasabyon pas/yulade'i dbusalha ma tha lar rigasabazhi'i mkha' 'grosabyin gyisabarlabs/khyad par ka bo ga'i gnasasu mkha' spyod rdo rje btsun mo' zhal nasagadamasangag 'di stsal te skal ldan rnamasal rdo rje semasadapa'i gser lam ston pa 'i samakhan chen por gyur/gzhan dag lasalam bsngas pa sogasartsa ba dang yan lagagi gdamasapa rdzogs par gsan pasamachog dang thun mong gi dngosagrub brnyes/bod du byon nasashar gangagasu yi dam rdo rja btsun mosasnod ldan gyi slob mar sdo/nga bstan thob pa/g.ya' bzang pa'i slob ma gnubasa'adul ba 'dzin pa'i dbon mkhar chu rin po che//zhesagragasapa desagasol ba btab nasamakha' 'gro ma' bgazhi rgya grol te/gzhung thog mar yi ge bkod/de nasabazung skal ldan yongasalargya cher spelab las/khriganyer ba rtogasaldan zla ba seng ge dang ༵༵༵ ldan sbu tra ba/mkhasabatsobasod nams

ba tshe chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chosang sa bsdus/()bzhi'i 'gros kyis bshig/ma rig gnyid ni brgyal ba log pas dwangs//chags bral nyams pa zha snang da pa'i sems//chags pa dag pas bde ba chen por grol/zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//de lta bu' lam 'di'i rten gzhi'i gtso bo ni mo rgyud bde mchog 'khor lo dang gnyis su med pa dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud gnyis la brten nas/sangs rgyas thams cad kyi shes rab stong pa nyid rnam kun mchog ldan ye dī ma'i gzugs su shar ba'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas legs par bkral ba'i khyad par gyi gdams pa mchog tu gyur pa/ /gang zhig dang por bka' babs mkhas grub o rgyan dang //thugs nyams bzhes nas gangs ri'i khrod 'dir spel ba yin te/de yang grub chen rin chen dpal zhes rgyal ba rgod tshang pa'i slob ma brtul zhugs rab dang mnyam par bsngags pa de nyid mthong lam gyi bden pa mngon sum du gzigs pa spyod pas mthar phyin par bya ba'i phyir dza la ra sogs gnas chen mang por byon/lhag par au ḍi yā na zhes grags par rdo jo thig pa'i gan mdzod chen mor bzhugs pa/sprul pa'i zhing ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi dga' ba ri tshal chen po der dpal ye shes pa'i zhabs 'bring dang bcas byon pas/yul de'i dbus lha ma tha lar rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gros byin gyis brlabs/khyad par ka bo ga'i gnas su mkha' spyod rdo rje btsun mo' zhal nas gdams ngag 'di stsal te skal ldan rnams la rdo rje sems dpa'i gser lam ston pa 'i sa mkhan chen por gyur/gzhan dag las lam bsngas pa sogs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi gdams pa rdzogs par gsan pas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub brnyes/bod du byon nas shar gangs su yi dam rdo jo btsun mos stod ldan gyi slob mar lung bstan thob pa/g.ya' bzang pa'i slob ma gnubs 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i dbon mkhar chu rin po che//zhes grags pa des gsol ba btab nas mkha' 'gro ma' bka' rgya grol te/gzhung thog mar yi ge bkod/de nas bzung skal ldan yongs la rgya cher spel ba las/khriganyer ba rtog bas ldan zla ba seng ge dang dpal ldan sbu tra ba/mkhas bas bsod nams252

gangs ri'i khrod kyi spong ba bsam gtan pa rnams kyi snyan du springs pa bsgom pa 'chi med bdud rtsi/shed zer/rnam dpyod mtshungs med rje btsun zur phug pa/mkhas bsod nams 'od zar/gzhan yang rgyal ba rang byung ba snye mdo thams cad mkhyen pa sku mched//chag lo dbon sogs mkhas grub mang du byon cing /phyis su nges par thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che dang /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan sogs//tshad ma'i skyes bus mang pos kyang 'chad nyan bsgom sgrub kyis gtan la phab pa'i lam dri ma mad pa yin la/slob tshogs rnams kyi nang nas brgyud 'dzin lung bstan thob phyir dang po 'khar chu rin po che las brgyud pa nyid mchog tu gyur pa'o//de ltar sgrub brgyud kyi lam srol rnamasabaka' babs brgyad du bsdus pa de yang gtso che ba dang /lam srol yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang du byas pa yan gyi/gzhan lam srol phan tshegs ni mtha' ma byung /lam 'bras/ni gu/bsnyen sgrub rnams la rdo rje'i tshag rkang rtsod med snang /nā ro'i rdo rje'i tshig rkang ni mar pa do pas mdzad par mkhas grub chen po rnams bzhed pas dpyad bya'i gnas so//gter byon du grags kyang rgyud sde dang ma 'brel ba dang yi dam lung bstan du/khas len yang rdzun gyi phreng ba bsdebs nas smra ba'i bcos ma'i snyan brgyud du grags pa rnams kyis mtshon/ mdor na mkhas grub gong ma'i srol dang mi mthun pa/ /de dag rdo rje 'chang gi bka' brgyud min/ gleng gzhi'i rim pa phye ba ste dang pa 'o//thos bsam sgom pa 'chi med bdud rtsis bzung ba'i gtam gyi ut+pal dpyod ston yongs kyi rna ba'i rgyan du 'os pa 'di nyid kyi thog mar bstan bcos so so' lus rnam par bzhag pa dang mthun pa'i mchod brjod dang /gleng gzhi'i skabs kyi mchan chung rags pa sogs/mang du thos pa'i dpyid gtsug lag smra ba 'a nyi ma'i blo gros kyi snang bas cung zad gsal bar byas pa ste/rgyas par logs su 'chad par spro ba nyid do / / sarba dā ka l+ya ṇi bha ba tu////253

gangs ri'i khrod kyi spong ba bsam gtan pa rnams kyi snyan du springs pa bsgom pa 'chi med bdud rtsi/da zer/rnam dpyod mtshungs med rje btsun zur phug pa/mkhasabs bsod namasa'od zar/gzhan yang rgyal ba rang byung ba snye mdo thamasacad mkhyen pa sku mched//chag lo dbon sogs mkhas grub mang du byon cing /phyis su ngesapar thamasacad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che dang /dpalaldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan sogs//tshad ma'i skyes bus mang posakyang 'ar nyan bsgom sgrub kyisagatan la phab pa'i lam dri ma mad pa yin la/slob tshogasarnamasakyi nang nasabargyud 'dzin lung bstan thob phyir dang po 'khar chu rin po che lasabargyud pa nyid mchog tu gyur pa'o//de ltar sgrub brgyud kyi lam srol rnamasabaka' babs brgyad du bsdusapa de yang gtso che ba dang /lam srol yongasasu rdzogasapa'i dbang du byasapa yan gyi/gzhan lam srolaphan tshegasani mtha' ma byung /lam 'bras/ni gu/bsnyen sgrub rnamasal rdo rje'i tshag rkang rtsod med snang /nā ro'i rdo rje'i tshig rkang ni mar pa do pasamadzad par mkhasagrub chen po rnams bzhed pasadapyad bya'i gnasaso//gter byon du gragasakyang rgyud sde dang ma 'brel ba dang yi dam lung bstan du/khas len yang rdzun gyi phreng ba bsdebasanasasmra ba'i bcos ma'i snyan brgyud du grags pa rnams kyis mtshon/ mdor na mkhas grub gong ma'i srol dang mi mthun pa/ /de dag rdo rje 'chang gi bka' brgyud min/ gleng gzhi'i rim pa phye ba ste dang po 'o//thos bsam sgom pa 'chi med bdud rtsisabazung ba'i gtam gyi ut+pal dpyod ston yongs kyi rna ba'i rgyan du 'os pa 'di nyid kyi thog mar bstan bcos so so' lus rnam par bzhag pa dang mthun pa'i mchod brjod dang /gleng gzhi'i skabasakyi mchan chung rags pa sogs/mang du thos pa'i dpyid gtsug lag smra ba' nyi ma'i blo gros kyi snang bas cung zad gsal bar byas pa ste/rgyasapar logasasu 'chad par spro ba nyid do / / sarba dā ka l+ya ṇi bha ba tu//// 253

༄tsho/ /tshad ma'i mdo dang bstan bcos kyi shing rta'i srol rnams ji ltar byung ba'i tshul gtam du bya ba nyin mor byed pa'i snang bas dpyod ldan mtha' dag dga' bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos bzhugs so/ /paṇa chen shāka mchog gisabartsams/ra༅༅/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thub chen ston pa g.yin 'phrul dbang byed bdag po de ni ye shes mda' lnga kun gyi yid la ngang gis 'jug mdzad nyid do kun la grags pa'i me tog mda' can de yi dgra bo nyid gyur pas na mda' can de ni deng sang 'di na dzo+ogs pa'i dbyings su gzims/ /bde 'byung zhes byar kun la rab grags 'jam pa'i dpal gang gis ni mkhyen dang brtse bas grims par bzung ba'i rigs pa'i gnas dang bgrang yas 'gro ba'i don gang yin pa de ni 'dod pa'i dbang phyug mar gyur ji bzhin nam du yang ni yal bar 'dor min pa/ /phyogs dang phyogs bral kun nas chos kyi grwa chen yangs po dag tu klan pa'i phyir ni rings par gtibs nas 'ongs pa'i nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa'i tshogs kun 'joms mkhas glang po de ni sa srung bu ste rnam dpyod gnyis 'thung rigs pa'i 'khor lo can/ /tshad mar grags pa'i ngo mtshar gtam gyi phreng ba 254

༄tsho/ /tshad ma'i mdo dang bstan bcos kyi shing rta'i srol rnams ji ltar byung ba'i tshul gtam du bya ba nyin mor byed pa'i snang bas dpyod ldan mtha' dag dga' bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos bzhugs so/ /paṇa chen shāka mchog gisabartsams/༄༅/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thub chen ston pa gzhan 'phrul dbang byed bdag po de ni ye shes mda' lnga kun gyi yid la ngang gis 'jug mdzad nyid do kun la grags pa'i me tog mda' can de yi dgra bo nyid gyur pas na mda' can de ni deng sang 'di na dzo+ogs pa'i dbyings su gzims/ /bde 'byung zhes byar kun la rab grags 'jam pa'i dpal gang gis ni mkhyen dang brtse bas grims par bzung ba'i rigs pa'i gnas dang bgrang yas 'gro ba'i don gang yin pa de ni 'dod pa'i dbang phyug mar gyur ji bzhin nam du yang ni yal bar 'dor min pa/ /phyogs dang phyogs bral kun nas chos kyi grwa chen yangs po dag tu klan pa'i phyir ni rings par gtibs nas 'ongs pa'i nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa'i tshogs kun 'joms mkhas glang po de ni sa srung bu ste rnam dpyod gnyis 'thung rigs pa'i 'khor lo can/ /tshad mar grags pa'i ngo mtshar gtam gyi phreng ba 254

shākamachog tshad ma'i mosa'abyung /mtha' dag mi shes mtshor bying pa na sa steng 'dir 'degs byed po de ni chos kyi grags pas sa chen 'dir khyab 'jug pa rnam bcu'i gar byed mkhan yin dpyod ldan yongs kyi bsten byar 'osapa de yin no/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi mkhyen pas ma bzung ba'i/ /thub dbang bstan pa'i snyingapo gzhan ma mchis/ /gang des dge ba'i bshes su dam bcas pa/ /smra ngan pham mdzad phyogs kyi glang po'i zhabs/ /'jam dbyangs mkhyen pa'i ya mtshan ltad mo kun/ /rgyal sras kun bzang mkhyen pa'i rgya mtshor snang / /chos kyi nyi ma grags pa'i lang tsho can/ /kun bzang chu gter dbusanasagang 'dir bzhengs/ /zhes mchod par brjod pa sngon du btang nas/ 'dir tshad ma'i mdo dang bstan bcos kyi shing rta'i srol rnams ji ltar byung ba'i tshul gtam du bya ba nyin mor byed pa'i snang bsadapyod ldan mtha' dag dga' bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos 'di 'chad pa la gsum ste/ rjod byed ming gi tha snyad ji ltar btags pa dang / brjod bya don gyi rnam gzhag gang nas 'byung ba dang / de ltar shes pa'i phan yon bstan pas mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ brda sbyor mkhan po su zhig gis ming du btags pa dang / ming de gang la dngos ming du mjug pa'i don de ngos bzung ba dang / ming don gyi 'brel ba de gzhan dang thun mong ma yin par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ tshad ma zhesabya ba'i ming de/ 'jig rten dang gsung rab gzhan las skabs stobs kyis don mang po la 'jug par bshad mod/ 'dir yang dag pa'i shes pa kho na la tshad ma zhes bya ba'i ming sgra bshad 'jug gnyis ka yod pas dngos ming du btags pa yin la/ lugs 'dir ni don de las gzhan gang la 255

shāka mchog tshad ma'i chos 'byung /mtha' dag mi shes mtshor bying pa na sa steng 'dir 'degs byed po de ni chos kyi grags pas sa chen 'dir khyab 'jug pa rnam bcu'i gar byed mkhan yin dpyod ldan yongs kyi bsten byar 'os pa de yin no/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi mkhyen pas ma bzung ba'i/ /thub dbang bstan pa'i snying po gzhan ma mchis/ /gang des dge ba'i bshes su dam bcas pa/ /smra ngan pham mdzad phyogs kyi glang po'i zhabs/ /'jam dbyangs mkhyen pa'i ya mtshan ltad mo kun/ /rgyal sras kun bzang mkhyen pa'i rgya mtshor snang / /chos kyi nyi ma grags pa'i lang tsho can/ /kun bzang chu gter dbus nas gang 'dir bzhengs/ /zhes mchod par brjod pa sngon du btang nas/ 'dir tshad ma'i mdo dang bstan bcos kyi shing rta'i srol rnams ji ltar byung ba'i tshul gtam du bya ba nyin mor byed pa'i snang bas dpyod ldan mtha' dag dga' bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos 'di 'chad pa la gsum ste/ rjod byed ming gi tha snyad ji ltar btags pa dang / brjod bya don gyi rnam gzhag gang nas 'byung ba dang / de ltar shes pa'i phan yon bstan pas mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ brda sbyor mkhan po su zhig gis ming du btags pa dang / ming de gang la dngos ming du mjug pa'i don de ngos bzung ba dang / ming don gyi 'brel ba de gzhan dang thun mong ma yin par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ tshad ma zhes bya ba'i ming de/ 'jig rten dang gsung rab gzhan las skabs stobs kyis don mang po la 'jug par bshad mod/ 'dir yang dag pa'i shes pa kho na la tshad ma zhes bya ba'i ming sgra bshad 'jug gnyis ka yod pas dngos ming du btags pa yin la/ lugs 'dir ni don de las gzhan gang la 255

brtse 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ltas/yang ming de dngos ming du 'jug pa med do/ /de'i phyir don de nyid rtog ge'i lus sam yan lag brgyad po gang rung gi sgo nas gtan la 'bebs pa'i ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs la yang tshad ma'i gsung rab zhes btags pa ni dngos ming yin la/ tshad ma zhes bya ba ni btags pa'i ming ngo / /gnyis pa ni gsung rab snri las yang dag pa'i shes pa spyi dang bye brag gi ngos 'dzin rgya che bar gsungs kyang 'dir ni gsar du mi bslu ba'i rig pa zhes sam mi bslu ba dang ma shes don gsal gyi tshogs don zhig la der bshad pas na/ 'dir ni de'i ngos 'dzin gsung rab gzhan las rgya chung ba yin no/ /don de la bsams nas yang dag pa'i shes pa la log par rtog pa du ma mthong zhes gsungs pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/de ltar ming don gyi ngos 'dzin dang tha snyad de dag ni/ bdag nyid chen po phyogs kyi glang po kho nas mdzad pa yin la/ de yi gong gi gsung rab gzhan las tha snyad de gsal bar gsungs pa med do/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ rgyal ba'i bka' las ji ltar byung ba dang / rtsa ba'i bstan bcos las ji ltar byung ba dang /'grel byed mkhan po dag gis ji ltar bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ tshad ma dang tshad min gyi rnam gzhag gsung ba po ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te/ji skad du/ tshad ma'i de nyid sgrub don ste/ /zhes gsungs/ des de ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshul ni/ mngon sum la dogs pa'i gnas med mod/ rjes su dpag pa ji ltar gsung snyam pa la/ ji skad du/ rjes su dpag pa ma bzlog phyir zhes pa nas/ bstan phyir de yang gsal bar bshad ces so/ /de la mngon sum ni gnyis te/ so so'i skye bo'i dang / 'phags pa'i'o/ /dang po la dbang yid kyi 256

brtse 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ltas/yang ming de dngos ming du 'jug pa med do/ /de'i phyir don de nyid rtog ge'i lus sam yan lag brgyad po gang rung gi sgo nas gtan la 'bebs pa'i ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs la yang tshad ma'i gsung rab zhes btags pa ni dngos ming yin la/ tshad ma zhes bya ba ni btags pa'i ming ngo / /gnyis pa ni gsung rab snri las yang dag pa'i shes pa spyi dang bye brag gi ngos 'dzin rgya che bar gsungs kyang 'dir ni gsar du mi bslu ba'i rig pa zhes sam mi bslu ba dang ma shes don gsal gyi tshogs don zhig la der bshad pas na/ 'dir ni de'i ngos 'dzin gsung rab gzhan las rgya chung ba yin no/ /don de la bsams nas yang dag pa'i shes pa la log par rtog pa du ma mthong zhes gsungs pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/de ltar ming don gyi ngos 'dzin dang tha snyad de dag ni/ bdag nyid chen po phyogs kyi glang po kho nas mdzad pa yin la/ de yi gong gi gsung rab gzhan las tha snyad de gsal bar gsungs pa med do/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ rgyal ba'i bka' las ji ltar byung ba dang / rtsa ba'i bstan bcos las ji ltar byung ba dang /'grel byed mkhan po dag gis ji ltar bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ tshad ma dang tshad min gyi rnam gzhag gsung ba po ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te/ji skad du/ tshad ma'i de nyid sgrub don ste/ /zhes gsungs/ des de ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshul ni/ mngon sum la dogs pa'i gnas med mod/ rjes su dpag pa ji ltar gsung snyam pa la/ ji skad du/ rjes su dpag pa ma bzlog phyir zhes pa nas/ bstan phyir de yang gsal bar bshad ces so/ /de la mngon sum ni gnyis te/ so so'i skye bo'i dang / 'phags pa'i'o/ /dang po la dbang yid kyi 256

shāka mchog tshad ma'i chos 'byung /mngon sum gnyis ni/ mdo las/ dge slong dag gzugs shes pa ni rnam pa gnyis te/ mig dang yid la brten pa'o zhes sogs yin la/ rang rig pa ni 'khor lo gsum pa'i gsung rab na shin tu mang ba dang / rnal 'byor mngon sum ni / mkhyen pa gsum dang stobs sogs yon tan rnams so/ /rjes kyi rang ldog nas ngos 'dzin pa rgyal ba'i bka' na mi gsal yang / de'i rten gtan tshigs ni / rgyal ba'i yum lasaphyir mi ldog pa'i rtags rnams dang / rdo rje gzigs ma'i gtan tshigs gsungs pa dang / mdo gzhan las gcig du bral dang/ rten 'brel gyi gtan tshigs gsungs pa rnams so/ /de'i phyir tshad ma gsung pa po ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / bshad ma thag pa de lta bu ston pa'i gsung rab rnams la ni tshad ma'i bka' zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ phyogs glang yab sras kyi chad ma'i bstan bcos 'di/ theg pa dang grub mtha' gang du gtogs pa dang / rtsa ba'i bstan bcos gang dang gang zhig byung ba dang / grub mtha' gzhan la ma grags pa'i brda 'chad kyi choms ji ltar yod pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ gnas skabs grub mtha' gang nas 'jug pa dang / mthar thug grub mtha' gang du 'jog pa dang / theg pa chen po gzhan dang khyad par gang gis 'byed pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rnam 'grel mdzad pa'i gzhung gi dbang du bgyis na theg pa gsum pa'i lta ba dang / de la lajug pa'i chul gsum ka yang rim gyis ston pa yin te/ gang zag gi bdag med pa'i lta ba'i chul la ni theg pa gsum ka yang khyad par med la/ de nyid kyang tshad ma grub pa'i le'u nas ston no/ /bdag med de la 'jug pa'i chul yang de dang 'dra bas spyi cam nas bshad kyi 257

shāka mchog tshad ma'i chos 'byung /mngon sum gnyis ni/ mdo las/ dge slong dag gzugs shes pa ni rnam pa gnyis te/ mig dang yid la brten pa'o zhes sogs yin la/ rang rig pa ni 'bor lo gsum pa'i gsung rab na shin tu mang ba dang / rnal 'byor mngon sum ni / mkhyen pa gsum dang stobs sogs yon tan rnams so/ /rjes kyi rang ldog nas ngos 'dzin pa rgyal ba'i bka' na mi gsal yang / de'i rten gtan tshigs ni / rgyal ba'i yum lasaphyir mi ldog pa'i rtags rnams dang / rdo rje gzigs ma'i gtan tshigs gsungs pa dang / mdo gzhan las gcig du bral dang/ rten 'brel gyi gtan tshigs gsungs pa rnams so/ /de'i phyir tshad ma gsung pa po ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / bshad ma thag pa de lta bu ston pa'i gsung rab rnams la ni tshad ma'i bka' zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ phyogs glang yab sras kyi chad ma'i bstan bcos 'di/ theg pa dang grub mtha' gang du gtogs pa dang / rtsa ba'i bstan bcos gang dang gang zhig byung ba dang / grub mtha' gzhan la ma grags pa'i brda 'chad kyi choms ji ltar yod pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ gnas skabs grub mtha' gang nas 'jug pa dang / mthar thug grub mtha' gang du 'jog pa dang / theg pa chen po gzhan dang khyad par gang gis 'byed pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rnam 'grel mdzad pa'i gzhung gi dbang du bgyis na theg pa gsum pa'i lta ba dang / de la lajug pa'i chul gsum ka yang rim gyis ston pa yin te/ gang zag gi bdag med pa'i lta ba'i chul la ni theg pa gsum ka yang khyad par med la/ de nyid kyang tshad ma grub pa'i le'u nas ston no/ /bdag med de la 'jug pa'i chul yang de dang 'dra bas spyi cam nas bshad kyi 257

brtse chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()grub mtha' so so'i dbye bas ma gsungs so/ /chos kyi bdag med la 'jug pa'i rim pa ni bye brag tu smra ba la yang ji skad du/ gang la bcom dang blo yis gzhan zhes sogs ltar/ lugs de la yang rags rgyun bden par med pa sogs kyi rnam gzhag yod mod/ lugs de la gzhung btsugs nas mi 'chad par zhan byung gi tshul du ni don dam don byed nus pa gang zhes sogs kyis bshad/ de bas na thog mar mdo sde pa'i skabs nyid nas 'jug pa yin te/ lugs 'dir/ thog mar phyi rol don grub dang / don 'gog gi skabs gnyis las dang po'i tshe na/mdo sde pa'i gzhung ji lta ba bzhin du khas len te/ phyi rol gyi don khas blangs nas rnam med rjen char 'gog pa'i phyir dang / phyi rol gyi don yod par yang rtags las bsgrub dgos kyi mngon sum gyis mthong bar mi 'chad pa'i phyir/ldog pa gzhan sel gyi rnam gzhag dang de bden par med pa'i tshul ni byed smra la med pas na/ tshul 'di ni de las khyad par du 'phags so/ /de'i tshe ni nyan thos kyi grub mtha' dang / 'bras bu yang nyan thos kyi theg pa'o/ /gnyis pa don 'gog gi skabs su ni/ grub pa'i mtha' sems tsam pa dang / 'bras bu rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa ste/ chos kyi bdag med la 'jug tshul phyogs gcig mdo sde pa dang mthun la/ phyi rol gyi don bkag pas/ gzung ba chos kyi bdag med la 'jug cing / 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med la 'jug tshul ni sems tsam pa la med do/ /gnyis pa ni/ lugs 'di yi mthar thug gi grub mtha' ni dbu mar gnas pa nyid do zhes mdor bstan nas/ de yang bstan pa 'di la grub mtha' bzhi yi rtse mor gyur pa'i dbu ma ni rnam pa gnyis 'byung ste/ mdo sde dgongs 258

brtse chen 'od snang las/ saskya'i chosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()grub mtha' so so'i dbye bas ma gsungs so/ /chos kyi bdag med la 'jug pa'i rim pa ni bye brag tu smra ba la yang ji skad du/ gang la bcom dang blo yis gzhan zhes sogasaltar/ lugs de la yang rags rgyun bden par med pa sogs kyi rnam gzhag yod mod/ lugs de la gzhung btsugs nas mi 'chad par zhan byung gi tshul du ni don dam don byed nus pa gang zhesasogs kyis bshad/ de bas na thog mar mdo sde pa'i skabs nyid nas 'jug pa yin te/ lugs 'dir/ thog mar phyi rol don grub dang / don 'gog gi skabs gnyis las dang po'i tshe na/mdo sde pa'i gzhung ji lta ba bzhin du khas len te/ phyi rol gyi don khas blangs nas rnam med rjen char 'gog pa'i phyir dang / phyi rol gyi don yod par yang rtags las bsgrub dgos kyi mngon sum gyis mthong bar mi 'chad pa'i phyir/ldog pa gzhan sel gyi rnam gzhag dang de bden par med pa'i tshul ni byed smra la med pas na/ tshul 'di ni de las khyad par du 'phagasaso/ /de'i tshe ni nyan thos kyi grub mtha' dang / 'bras bu yang nyan thos kyi theg pa'o/ /gnyis pa don 'gog gi skabs su ni/ grub pa'i mtha' sems tsam pa dang / 'bras bu rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa ste/ chos kyi bdag med la 'jug tshul phyogs gcig mdo sde pa dang mthun la/ phyi rol gyi don bkag pas/ gzung ba chos kyi bdag med la 'jug cing / 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med la 'jug tshul ni sems tsam pa la med do/ /gnyis pa ni/ lugs 'di yi mthar thug gi grub mtha' ni dbu mar gnas pa nyid do zhes mdor bstan nas/ de yang bstan pa 'di la grub mtha' bzhi yi rtse mor gyur pa'i dbu ma ni rnam pa gnyis 'byung ste/ mdo sde dgongs 258
