chog lo tsā ba chen pos bstan pa ji ltar bskyangs ba'i tshul mdo tsam du bya ba ngo mtshar gtam gyi rol mo/rgyas kyi ye shes la/ kun rdzob kyi snang ba shar ba thams cad kyang / 'khrul pa'i snang bar 'chad cing / blo de spangs kyang / dgos dus su mngon du byas par bzhed/ de la sras kyi thu bo byung ba ni bzhi ste/ sku'i gdan sa 'dzin pa zhang tshe srong ba chos kyi bla ma/ gsung gi bstan pa rdzogs par 'dzin pa kro lung pa blo gros 'byung gnas/ yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i bshad srol 'dzin pa/'bre chen po shes rab 'bar/ dbu tshad kyi bshad srol 'dzin pa/ khyung rin chen grags rnams so/ /dang pos gsang phu ne'u thog gi gdan sa lo sum cu rtsa gnyis mdzad/ de rjes mnyal pa ri lus lo gnyis mdzad/ de rjes gnam 'phar bsalo brgyad/ de rjes phyu pa chos kyi seng shes gdan sa lo bco brgyad mdzad/ 'di lo chen gshegs pa'i lo/ sa mo glang la 'khrungs nas/ re gcig pa sa mo glang pa gshegs/ di 'as dang po khyung gi slob ma/ rgya dmar ba byang chub grags la dbu tshad gsan/ phyis gro lung pa la pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo dang / rgyan sogasagasung rab yongs su rdzogs par gsan/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa bya 'dul gyi drung du mdzad nas 'dul ba gsan/ dpe 'grems kyi grwa pa lnga stong tsam byung bar grags/ de'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa/ grub thob mi gsum/ jo sras mi bzhi/shes rab can mi gsum/ seng chen brgyad rnams so/ /dang po ni/ rje dus gsum rma/khyen pa/ phag mo gru pa/ gsal sto sho sgom rnams so/ /la la shad 'tshal pa yin zhes zer/ gnyis pa ni/ sa jo sras bsod nams rtse mo/ mnyes jo srasan pal le/ khu jo sras ba tso/ rngog jo sras ra mo rnams so/ /gsum pa ni/ kong po 'jag chung / lho pa sgog gzan/ par bu ba blo gros seng ge rnams so/ /sgog 443

rngog lo tsā ba chen posabastan pa ji ltar bskyangasaba'i tshul mdo tsam du bya ba ngo mtshar gtam gyi rol mo/rgyas kyi ye shesal/ kun rdzob kyi snang ba shar ba thamasacad kyang / 'khrul pa'i snang bar 'chad cing / blo de spangs kyang / dgos dus su mngon du byas par bzhed/ de la sras kyi thu bo byung ba ni bzhi ste/ sku'i gdan sa'adzin pa zhang tshe skrong ba chosakyi bla ma/ gsung gi bstan pa rdzogs par 'dzin pa gro lung pa blo gros 'byung gnas/ yum shesarab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i bshad srol 'dzin pa/'bre chen po shesarab 'bar/ dbu tshad kyi bshad srol 'dzin pa/ khyung rin chen grags rnams so/ /dang pos gsang phu ne'u thog gi gdan sa lo sum cu rtsa gnyis mdzad/ de rjesamanyal pa ri lusalo gnyis mdzad/ de rjesaganam 'phar bsalo brgyad/ de rjesaphyu pa chosakyi seng shes gdan salo bco brgyad mdzad/ 'di lo chen gshegasapa'i lo/ samo glang la 'khrungabakanas/ re gcig pa brasamo glang pa gshegs/ 'disadang po khyung gi slob ma/ rgya dmar ba byang chub grags la dbu tshad gsan/ phyis gro lung pa la pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo dang / rgyan sogasagasung rab yongasasu rdzogasapar gsan/ bsnyen par rdzogasapa bya 'dul gyi drung du mdzad nas 'dul ba gsan/ dpe 'grems kyi grwa pa lnga stong tsam byung bar grags/ de'i nang nasamachog tu gyur pa/ grub thob mi gsum/ jo srasami bzhi/shes rab can mi gsum/ seng chen brgyad rnams so/ /dang po ni/ rje dus gsum rma/khyen pa/ phag mo gru pa/ gsal sto sho sgom rnamasaso/ /la la shad 'tshal pa yin zhesazer/ gnyisapa ni/ sa jo srasabasod namasartsemo/ mnyos jo srasan pal le/ khu jo sras ne+e tso/ rngog jo sras ra mo rnams so/ /gsum pa ni/ kong po 'jag chung / lho pa sgog gzan/ par bu ba blo grosaseng ge rnamasaso/ /sgog 443

ba chen 'od snang las/ saskya'i choga'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()gzan ni lho pa thams cad mkhyen par grags pa ste/ lho pa dha ra seng ngo / /bzhi pa ni/ phywa pa'i rjes su gdan sa lo lnga mdzad pa'i rtsegs dbang phyug seng gegatsang nag pa brtson 'grus seng ge me bya rtsod pa'i seng zha bru sha bsod nams seng ge nyang bran pa chos kyi seng ge dan 'bag pa smra ba'i seng ge 'dam nga/ dkon mchog seng ge rgyang dur ba gzhon nu seng ge la la dag 'u yug pa bsod nams seng ge zhes zer yang dus mi 'grig 'dis gzhung lugs bzhi bcu cam gyi rnam bshad mdzad cing / tshad bsdus dang / dbu bsdus kyi srol thog mar phye/khyad par mtshon sbyor gyi rnam gzhag rgyas pa de nas byung / grub mtha'i byings lo chen dang mthun kyang / gnas skabs phran tshegs la dgag pa mang du mdzad/slob dpon zla ba grags pa'i lugs de dus su rgyas par dar bas/ lugs de 'a/ nyes chen brgyad la sogs pa'i dgag pa mang du mdzad/ stong nyid bden grub tu zhal gyis bzhes/ de la gtsang nag pa sogs bod gzhan dag stong pa la mtshan mar lta ba'i dbu ma pa zhes zer/ dus der pa tshab lo tsā ba bshad nyan byed pas/rma bya dang / gtsang nag pa gnyis de'i slob mar yang song / gro lung pa ni/ lo chen la dgag pa cung zad kyang mi mdzad cing / chos tshan mi 'dra ba brgya dang brgyad tsam mdzad par grags shing / sku tshe'i stod la phrin las ma byung / smad kyi slob ma'i mchog ni phywa pa'o/ /rtsegs dbang phyug seng ge'i rjes la/ mnyal pa dad pa bzang pos gdan sa lo bdun byas/ de la slob ma bzad ring la sogs pa phar tshad gnyis ga'i ṭī ka byed pa dgu byung ba la bu dgu zer/ jo bo nam mkha' dpal la sogs pa gang rung re re'i slob ma byed mkhan dgu byung ba labu 444

ba chen 'od snang la / saskya'i chosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()gzan ni lho pa thams cad mkhyen par grags pa ste/ lho pa dha ra seng ngo / /bzhi pa ni/ phywa pa'i rjes su gdan sa lo lnga mdzad pa'i rtsegs dbang phyug seng gegatsang nag pa brtson 'grus seng ge me bya rtsod pa'i seng zha bru sha bsod nams seng ge nyang bran pa chos kyi seng ge dan 'bag pa smra ba'i seng ge 'dam nga/ dkon mchog seng ge rgyang dur ba gzhon nu seng ge la la dag 'u yug pa bsod nams seng ge zhes zer yang dus mi 'grig 'dis gzhung lugs bzhi bcu cam gyi rnam bshad mdzad cing / tshad bsdus dang / dbu bsdus kyi srol thog mar phye/khyad par mtshon sbyor gyi rnam gzhag rgyas pa de nas byung / grub mtha'i byings lo chen dang mthun kyang / gnas skabs phran tshegs la dgag pa mang du mdzad/slob dpon zla ba grags pa'i lugs de dus su rgyas par dar bas/ lugs de 'a/ nyes chen brgyad la sogs pa'i dgag pa mang du mdzad/ stong nyid bden grub tu zhal gyis bzhes/ de la gtsang nag pa sogs bod gzhan dag stong pa la mtshan mar lta ba'i dbu ma pa zhes zer/ dus der pa tshab lo tsā ba bshad nyan byed pas/rma bya dang / gtsang nag pa gnyis de'i slob mar yang song / gro lung pa ni/ lo chen la dgag pa cung zad kyang mi mdzad cing / chos tshan mi 'dra ba brgya dang brgyad tsam mdzad par grags shing / sku tshe'i stod la phrin las ma byung / smad kyi slob ma'i mchog ni phywa pa'o/ /rtsegs dbang phyug seng ge'i rjes la/ mnyal pa dad pa bzang pos gdan sa lo bdun byas/ de la slob ma bzad ring la sogs pa phar tshad gnyis ga'i ṭī ka byed pa dgu byung ba la bu dgu zer/ jo bo nam mkha' dpal la sogs pa gang rung re re'i slob ma byed mkhan dgu byung ba labu 444

rngog lo tsā ba chen posabastan pa ji ltar bskyangasaba'i tshul mdo tsam du bya ba ngo mtshar gtam gyi rol mo/mo dgu zhesazer/ bzad ring gi mtshan ni dar ma tshul khrims te/ des khro phur phar tshad kyi bshad grwa gtsugs/ de las brgyud pa tshad ma'i skyes bu dang / bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa sogs so/ /mnyal zhig gi bu dgu'i slob ma rgya ston phying ru bas gling stod kyi gdan sa lo bco brgyad byas shing / snye thang bde ba can gyi chos grwa btab/ de'i gdan sa gnyag grags tshul gyis byas/ rin po che blo bzang pa'i grwa sa 'di dang / 'tshal chos 'bor gling yin cing / phyis sa skyar mdzad pa'o/ /mnyal zhig gi bu dgu'i nang gi jo nang la/ slob ma 'jam dbyangs ri+od zer mgon po byung / des gling smad kyi gdan sa lo sum cu so lnga byas/ de la slob ma 'jam dbyangs shākya gzhon nu dang / kha rag pa byang chub gzhon nu gnyisabyung / dang pos gling smad kyi gdan sa lo nyi shu rtsa bdun mdzad cing / 'tshal chos 'bor gling gi bshad grwa gtsugs/ jo nang pa phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi grwa sa 'di yin/ shāka gzhon la slob ma gsang phu ba blo gros mkhyungaba'imed/ g.yag sde paṇa chen/ ka bzhi rkang gcig rnams byung / dang pos rkarma pa rang byung rdo rje'i bla ma byas/ gnyis pas gling smad kyi bla zur byas nas e waṃ gi dgon pa btab/gsum pas rab sgang gi ka bzhi dgon btab/ mnyal zhig gi rjes la/ gtsang ri/ 'jam dpal seng ge dang / j-i dza ne+e gnyis kyi gdan sa so sor bzung bas/gling stod smad gyes/ dza nes gling smad kyi gdan sa lo bdun byas pa'i rjes la/gzhu pa khu dbon gyis lo sum cu/ mnyal zhig gi slob ma jo nang gis lo bco lnga/de'i slob ma 'od zer mgon pos lo so lnga/ de'i slob ma shāka gzhon gyis/ slob da pon gyi bgros la brten zhing / kha rag pas bgros gsar du brtsams pas/445

rngog lo tsā ba chen pos bstan pa ji ltar bskyangs ba'i tshul mdo tsam du bya ba ngo mtshar gtam gyi rol mo/slo dgu zhes zer/ bzad ring gi mtshan ni dar ma tshul khrims te/ des khro phur phar tshad kyi bshad grwa gtsugs/ de las brgyud pa tshad ma'i skyes bu dang / bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa sogs so/ /mnyal zhig gi bu dgu'i slob ma rgya ston phying ru bas gling stod kyi gdan sa lo bco brgyad byas shing / snye thang bde ba can gyi chos grwa btab/ de'i gdan sa gnyag grags tshul gyis byas/ rin po che blo bzang pa'i grwa sa 'di dang / 'tshal chos 'khor gling yin cing / phyis sa skyar mdzad pa'o/ /mnyal zhig gi bu dgu'i nang gi jo nang la/ slob ma 'jam dbyangs 'od zer mgon po byung / des gling smad kyi gdan sa lo sum cu so lnga byas/ de la slob ma 'jam dbyangs shākya gzhen nu dang / kha rag pa byang chub gzhen nu gnyisabyung / dang pos gling smad kyi gdan sa lo nyi shu rtsa bdun mdzad cing / 'tshal chos 'bor gling gi bshad grwa gtsugs/ jo nang pa phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi grwa sa 'di yin/ shāka gzhen la slob ma gsang phu ba blo gros mtshudas med/ g.yag sde paṇa chen/ ka bzhi rkang gcig rnams byung / dang pos ga me pa rang byung rdo rje'i bla ma byas/ gnyis pas gling smad kyi bla zur byas nas e waṃ gi dgon pa btab/gsum pas rab sgang gi ka bzhi dbe|na btab/ mnyal :ston gi rjes la/ gtsang ri/ 'jam dpal seng ge dang / rdza dza ba gnyis kyi gdan sa so sor bzung bas/gling stod smad gyes/ dza nes gling smad kyi gdan sa lo bdun byas pa'i rjes la/gzhu pa khu dbon gyis lo sum cu/ mnyal zhig gi slob ma jo nang gis lo bco lnga/de'i slob ma 'od zer mgon pos lo so lnga/ de'i slob ma shāka gzhon gyis/ slob da pon gyi bgros la brten zhing / kha rag pas bgros gsar du brtsams pas/445

brtse chen 'od snang lag sa skya'i chosang gces bsdus/ ()bgros gsar rnying so sor gyes/ gling stod kyi gdan sa 'jam seng gi rjes la 'a ston hral mo dang / blo gros 'bar gyis lo lnga lnga/ mnyal zhig gi slob ma rgya ston phying ru bas lo bco brgyad mdzad/ mnyal zhig gi nying slob rgyal sras chu mig pas/ gdan sa mdzad kyang / gling stod kyi zur chos pa ring du mdzad/ phar tshad gnyis kyi ṭī ka dang / bsdus pa brtsams/ phrin las rgya che bar byung / mnyal zhig gi dus su/ sa skya paṇ+ḍita jo sras gzhen nu mar gyur pas/ gsang phur byon nas rnam nges gsungs shing / bshad tshar mdzad/ bla mar 'os pa shig 'dug kyang bsten dka' ba zhig 'dug gsung / mnyal zhig la ma gsan/ shing stod du rtsegs dbang phyug seng ge dang / rkyang dur ba gzhen nu seng ge la/ dbu tshad dang /bsdus pa gsan/ chu mig pa'i dus su/ 'phags pas gsang phur byon/ thugs bskyed gsungs/ rnam gzhag rgya chen po mdzad/ rje btsun bsod nams rtse mos sum cu so drug bzhes pa/ sa mo glang gi lo la/ slob dpon phywa pa 'das/ chos khri'i steng du sku 'bum bzhengs pa la/ rje btsun rtse mos gser tog phul/ phyu pa'i sku tshad dang mnyam pa'i bris sku chen mo/ rje btsun nyid kyis phyag bris su mdzad pa/ de'i bsham na/ rdzas ldog ma 'dres so sor 'byed pa'i mig rtsa dmar po can/ /zhes sogs kyi tshig ring po mdzad pa'i sku 'dra ngo mtshar can phul/ phyu pa'i slob ma bru sha bsod nams seng ges/ snar thang du rnam par nges pa'o bshad srol gtsugs/ der phar phyin gyi bshad srol ni/ khro phu nas brgyud pa yin pas mnyal zhig gi bshad pa'i srol lo/ /zha lu'i phar phyin dang rnam nges kyi bshad pa'i srol yang khro phu nas brgyud pa yin pas/ mnyal zhig gi bshad pa'i 446

'tsher+ṣa 'od snang lag sa skya'i chogayang tso bsdus/ ()bgrosagasar rnying so sor gyes/ gling stod kyi gdan sa'ajam seng gi rjes la zhu ston hral mo dang / blo gros 'bar gyis lo lnga lnga/ mnyal zhig gi slob ma rgya ston phying ru bas lo bco brgyad mdzad/ mnyal zhig gi nying slob rgyal sras chu mig pas/ gdan samadzad kyang / gling stod kyi zur chos pa ring du mdzad/ phar tshad gnyis kyi ṭī ka dang / bsdusapa brtsams/ phrin lasargya che bar byung / mnyal zhig gi dus su/ sa skya paṇ+ḍita jo sras gzhon nu mar gyur pas/ gsang phur byon nas rnam nges gsungs shing / bshad tshar mdzad/ bla mar 'os pa shig 'dug kyang bsten dka' ba zhig 'dug gsung / mnyal zhig la ma gsan/ nyang stod du rtsegs dbang phyug seng ge dang / rkyang dur ba gzhon nu seng ge la/ dbu tshad dang /bsdus pa gsan/ chu mig pa'i dusasu/ 'phagasapas gsang phur byon/ thugs bskyed gsungs/ rnam gzhag rgya chen po mdzad/ rje btsun bsod nams rtse mos sum cu sodrug bzhesapa/ samo glang gi lo la/ slob dpon phywa pa 'das/ chos khri'i steng du sku 'bum bzhengs pa la/ rje btsun rtse mos gser tog phul/ phyu pa'i sku tshad dang mnyam pa'i bris sku chen mo/ rje btsun nyid kyis phyag bris su mdzad pa/ de'i bsham na/ rdzasaldog ma 'dresaso sor 'byed pa'i mig rtsa dmar po can/ /zhes sogs kyi tshig ring po mdzad pa'i sku 'dra ngo mtshar can phul/ phyu pa'i slob ma bru sha bsod nams seng ges/ snar thang du rnam par nges pa'i bshad srol gtsugs/ der phar phyin gyi bshad srol ni/ khro phu nas brgyud pa yin pas mnyal zhig gi bshad pa'i srol lo/ /zha lu'i phar phyin dang rnam nges kyi bshad pa'i srol yang khro phu nas brgyud pa yin pas/ mnyal zhig gi bshad pa'i 446

grog lo tsā ba chen po bstan pa ji ltar bskyangs ba'i tshul mdo tsam du bya ba ngo mtshar gtam gyi rol mo/srol lo/ /dus phyis/ gsang phu sogs su rnam 'grel gyi bshad srol byung ba de dag ni/ lo chen gyi bshad pa'i srol ma yin gyi/ sa skya nor bzang dang / nya dbon gyi bshad pa las 'phel lo/ /gsum pa 'bre chen po shes rab 'bar gyis bo dong du bshes gnyen chen po la chos mngon pa gsan zhing / lo chen la phar phyin gsan nas/ lo chen gyis zur chos pa mdzad pa'i slob ma'i gtso bo ni ar byang chub ye shes yin la/ phyis gnas rnying gi bshad grwa chen po gtsug bas pa shā/na no/ /'dis yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang / nyi khri snang ba dang / brgyad stong 'grel chen la sogs pa'i ṭī ka mdzad do/ /ar byang chub ye shes kyis sher phyogs kyi rnam bshad mang du mdzad cing / gnam rtse ldeng dang / gzhu kun dga' ra bar bshad pa mdzad/ phar phyin gyi dpe 'grems/ stong ra can tsam byung / mkhas mgo btsun gyi ston pa ar zhes zer/ de'i slob ma gzhen nu tshul /khrims yin/ de'i slob ma ni/ 'jam dpal gzhen nu byang chub yin la/ 'disabo dong du phar phyin gyi bshad pa phyis dar bar mdzad pa'ang ar gyi srol lo/ /de'i slob ma byang chub 'bum yin la/ de'i slob ma mnyal zhig go /bya 'dul ba re dzen pa ni/ 'bre chen po shes rab 'bar las rab tu byung zhing / mtshan brtson )spyos 'bar du btags so/ /bzhi pa khyung rin chen grags kyis ni/ lo chen gyi zur chos yun ring du mdzad cing / phyis nyang stod smon gro dang / stag tshal la so/gas par bshad nyan mdzad pa'i slob ma'i gtso bo ni/ gangs pa shes gong bu rwa can/ mes lhang tsher/ rdog skya'o la sogs pa yin la/ 'di dag gis gzhen nu 'i /'i dus su lo chen la thug ces kyang zer ro/ /rje sa skya pa chen pos kyang / khyung 447

rngog lo tsā ba chen posabastan pa ji ltar bskyangasaba'i tshul mdo tsam du bya ba ngo mtshar gtam gyi rol mo/skropa lo/ /dus phyis/ gsang phu sogs su rnam 'grel gyi bshad srol byung ba de dag ni/ lo chen gyi bshad pa'i srol ma yin gyi/ saskya nor bzang dang / nya dbon gyi bshad pa las 'phel lo/ /gsum pa 'bre po sheba'irab 'bar gyis bo dong du bshes gnyen chen po la chos mngon pa gsan zhing / lo chen la thar phyin gsan nas/ lo chen gyis zur chosapa mdzad pa'i slob ma'i gtso bo ni ar byang chub ye shes yin la/ phyis gnas rnying gi bshad grwa chen po gtsugasapa yi/na no/ /'dis yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang / nyi khri snang ba dang / brgyad sdong 'grel chen la sogs pa'i ṭī ka mdzad do/ /ar byang chub ye shes kyis sher phyogs kyi rnam bshad mang du mdzad cing / gnam rtse ldeng dang / gzhu kun dga' ra bar bshad pa mdzad/ phar phyin gyi dpe 'grems/ stong ra can tsam phyung / mkhas mgo btsun gyi ston pa ar zhes zer/ de'i slob ma g.yi+on nu tshul /khrims yin/ de'i slob ma ni/ 'jam dpal gzhon nu byang chub yin la/ 'disabo dong du phar phyin gyi bshad pa phyis dar bar mdzad pa'ang ar gyi srol lo/ /de'i slob ma byang chub 'bum yin la/ de'i slob ma mnyal zhig go /bya 'dul ba ridzin pa ni/ 'bre chen po shesarab 'bar las rab tu byung zhing / mtshan brtson khrus 'bar du btags so/ /bzhi pa khyung rin chen grags kyisani/ lo chen gyi zur chos yun ring du mdzad cing / phyis nyang stod smon gro dang / stag tshal la so/gas par bshad nyan mdzad pa'i slob ma'i gtso bo ni/ gangasapa shes gong bu rwa can/ mes lhang tsher/ rdog skya'o la sogs pa yin la/ 'di dag gis gzhon nu 'i /'i dus su lo chen la thug ces kyang zer ro/ /rje sa skya pa chen pos kyang / khyung 447

'tshe 'od snang las/ saskya'i chos 'byung gcis bsdus/ ()la phar phyin dang / dbu tshad gsan zhes bshad pa'ang snang ngo / /mdor na 'e/ chen gyi bshad srol la rag ma las pa'i byams chos lnga dang / rang rgyud shar pa'i bstan bcos gsum dang / tshad ma rnam par nges pa rnams kyi bshad srol gzhan nas brgyud pa med cing / lo chen ma byon pa'i gong na/ 'dul ba dang / chos mngon pa'i bshad nyan dar po yod kyang / rigs pa'i lam nas drangs nga/'i dgag sgrub kyi rnam par bzhag pa/ chos kyi grags pa'i gzhung dang mthun par 'chad shes pa ma byung ngo / /lo chen gyi rjes su 'jug pa'i bshad srol ni gsum/ ste / gro lung pa chen po nasabargyud pa dang / 'bre ar nas brgyud pa dang / khyung rin chen grags nas brgyud pa rnams so/ /deng sang gi bar du yod pa ni/ 'bre ar dang / khyung nas brgyud pa de yin la/ gro lung pa nas brgyud pa'i srol lam ma nyams par yod pa mi 'dra zhing / rin po che blo bzang pa phyogs de'i brgyud 'dzin du khas len kyang / gang nas brgyud ma shes so/ /de nas zhar las byung ba 'di brjod par bya ste/ slob dpon phywa pa 'das nas lo bcu bzhi song ba/ chu pho stag gi lo la/ sa skya paṇ+ḍita 'khrungs/ de mya ngan las 'das nas lo bzhi bcu pa lcags pho stag la/ bu ston rin po che 'khrungs/ des lo drug cu re gcig bzhes pa lcags pho stag la/ rin po che g.yag pa 'khrungs/ des lo bco brgyad bzhes pa me mo lug gi lo la/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa rong ston chos rje 'brungs/ des lo bco lnga bzhes pa lcags mo bya la/ rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po 'khrungs/ don drug pa me pho byi ba'i lo la gshegs/ de nas deng sang sa mo phag gi bar la nyi shu rtsa bzhi song ngo / /yang rngog lo nas deng sang gi bar du lo grangs 448

rngog lo tsā ba chen posabastan pa ji ltar bskyangs ba'i tshul mdo tsam du bya ba ngo mtshar gtam gyi rol mo/brtsi tshul go bde ba 'di yang yod de/ lo chen lnga bcu nga gcig pa sa mo glang la gshegs/ de'i phyi lo lcags pho stag la 'gro mgon phag mo gru pa 'khrungs/ des re gcig lon pa'i lcags pho stag la/ ko brag pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gzungs/ des drug cu re gcig lon pa'i lcags pho stag la/ grub thob u rgyan pa 'khrungs/ des re gcig lon pa'i ñca gas stag la/ bu ston rin po che 2brungs/ des re gcig bzhes pa'i lcags stag la/ rin po che g.yag pa dzesangs/ des bzhi bcu zhe dgu bzhes pa sa pho stag la/ mkhas sdo/ba don yod dpal zhabrungs/ de deng sang brgyad cu gya gnyis pa'i steng na bzhugs pa yin no / / 'di tsam kho nas sngon byon pa'i/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu mang po yi/ /rnam thar ngang gis shes gyur nas/ /yid rab dang ba rim gyis 'dren/ /tshig nyung don mang brjod bde zhing / /dpyod ldan tshogs pa'i gral dag tu/ /mang po mgu zhing ya rabs su/ /mtshon byed gtsug lag 'di byas so/ /zhes rngog lo tsā ba chen pos bstan pa ji ltar bskyangs pa mdo tsam du bya ba/ ngo mtshar gtam gyi rol mo zhes bya ba 'di ni/ thub bstan dar rgyas gling gi gtsug lag khang chen po nas/chos kyi rje bsod nams lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung gnas kyi gsung gi rnga bo ches/ nye bar bskul ba'i ngor bgyis nas/ yul dbus kyi sde snod 'chang ba'i slob dpon dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blos/ gtsang g.yas ru'i sa'i thig le khyung tshang gser mdog can gyi dben gnas dam par grub pa'i yi ge pa ni chos kyi rgyal mtshan no/ /sarba maṅga lo// //449

༄7/ /bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel ba'i gtam skyes dpyod ldan mkhas pa'i lus rgyan rin chen mdzes pa'i phra tshom bokod pa bsdokyigs sa/ /mkhan chen ngag dbang chosagragasakyisabartsams/༄7/ /byang chub sems kyi rtsa ba rab brtan tshogs gnyis bye ba'i yal gas bres/ /zhi dul thugs rje'i 'dab ma 'bum ldan skye rgu'i nyon mongs cha gdung bcil/ /phrin las dam pa dkar ba'i me tog phan bde'i dri bsung phyogs brgyar 'thul/ /bstan pa'i gtso bo 'dod rgu'i dpag bsam thub dbang zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /thub gsung chos kyi sgo mo mtha' yas pa/ /dbang sgyur rgyan drug mchog dang sa skya pa/ /gong ma brgyud par bcas pa'i zhabasapad la/ /yan lag mchog gis lan brgyar 'degs shing sbyor/ khyad par chos srid dbu rmog btsan po yis/ /log smra'i g.yul ngo ma lus dmangs su phab/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i gdugs gcig gis/ /srid gsum kun skyob sa skya paṇa chen bsngags/ /rgyal kun 'dus pa'i mkhyen brtse'i sprin phung las/ /bstan pa 'chi med bdud rtsi'i dog pa can/ /legs bshad dpal gyi gru char 'bebs mkhas 450

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/sa/ / / byam ba'i pa rnam sprul g.yag mtshan can bsngags/ /rnam dpyod lha chen /bros pa'i mda' gcig gis/ /log lta'i lha min grong khyer gsum bsregs te/ / yang dag lha yi dpal de khyod kyis myang / /rong ston smra ba'i seng ge lha brgyas bsngags/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rtsa lag bstan pa'i rgyun/ /yun du 'phel ba'i byed po rgyal ba'i sras/ /bstan 'dzin phreng bas rgya mtsho'i gos can kun/khyab mdzad bstan pa'i mes po khyod gcig bsngags/ /e ma sngon byon phur bu'i lugs sa kyang / /ma phye blo gros zab pa'i mdzod phye ste/ /mdo sngags chos kyi rgand don dril chen po/ /phyogs bcur sgrogs mkhas kun mkhyen bla mar 3dud/ /thub dbang bstan pa'i legs byas rin chen khrir/ /'chad rtsod rtsom ga(ma dbyangs bdun rdzogs pa'i glu/ /phyogs kun ri dwags mig can rna ba'i bsdu da/ /byams dang thugs rje'i dpal mnga' bzang por 'dud/ /rnam gnon rig pa'i gom stabs gcig gis kyang / /pha rol rgol ba'i stobs ldan sa 'og bcings/ /chos grags spobs pa'i nga ro gzugs can bzhin/ /mkhyen pa'i da bang phyug dpal yon bzang por 'dud/ /ngo mtshar 'chi med gzhung brgya lasabartsams te/ /lung rig bka'abrel ba'i bka' mchid ya rab bas skyes/ /mkhaba'ikun dga' ba'i gtam 'di gleng bya ste/ /skal bzang yid can dpyod ldan kun dgar byos/ /de la 'dir 'o skol gyi ston pa thub pa'i dbang pos gdul bya lge mas kyi khams dang / bsam pa dang / dbang po'i rim pa mtha' yas pa dang mthun par chos kyi sgo mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa las/ kha che bye brag tu smra bas chos kyi phung po brgyad khrir nges par 'dod/ mdo sde pa dang theg 451

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dgagi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/r+sā/ / / byamasapa rnam sprul g.yag mtshan can bsngags/ /rnam dpyod lha chen /bros pa'i mda' gcig gis/ /log lta'i lha min grong khyer gsum bsregs te/ / yang dag lha yi dpal de khyod kyis myang / /rong ston smra ba'i seng ge lha brgyas bsngags/ /sangs rgyasabastan pa'i rtsa lag bstan pa'i rgyun/ /yun du 'phel ba'i byed po rgyal ba'i sras/ /bstan 'dzin phreng bas rgya mtsho'i gos can kun/khyab mdzad bstan pa'i mes po khyod gcig bsngags/ /e ma sngon byon phur bu'i lugs kyibatakyang / /ma phye blo grobashazab pa'i mdzod phye ste/ /mdo sngags chos kyi rgand don dril chen po/ /phyogasabacur sgrogs mkhas kun mkhyen bla mar 3dud/ /thub dbang bstan pa'i legs byas rin chen khrir/ /'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dbyangs bdun rdzogs pa'i glu/ /phyogs kun ri dwags mig can rna ba'i bsdu da/ /byams dang thugs rje'i dpal mnga' bzang por 'dud/ /rnam gnon rig pa'i gom stabs gzhig gis kyang / /pha rol rgol ba'i stobs ldan sa 'og bcings/ /chos grags spobs pa'i nga ro gzugs can bzhin/ /mkhyen pa'i da bang phyug dpal yon bzang por 'dud/ /ngo mtshar 'chi med gzhung brgya lasabartsams te/ /lung rigasa'abrel ba'i bka' mchid ya rababashaskyes/ /mkhasakun dga' ba'i gtam 'di gleng bya ste/ /skal bzang yid can dpyod ldan kun dgar byos/ /de la 'dir 'o skol gyi ston pa thub pa'i dbang pos gdul bya lge mas kyi khamasadang / bsam pa dang / dbang po'i rim pa mtha' yasapa dang mthun par chos kyi sgo mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa las/ kha che bye brag tu smra bsachos kyi phung po brgyad khrir nges par 'dod/ mdo sde pa dang theg 451

bgechen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()chen pa 'ga' zhag chos kyi phung po brgyad khra ba stong nges par 'dod/ theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i dgongs pa mthar thug pa ni chos kyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab par bzhed pa yin te/ rje btsun rtse mo'i dgongs pa bzhin bkod pa spyi rnam mdzes rgyan las/ chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong zhes bshad pa/ /nyan thos mos pa dman rnams drang phyir te/ /theg chen lugs la dbye ba bsam mi khyab/ /zhes gsungs pa de yin/ de ltar chos phung bsam gyis mi khyab par gsungs pa'i bka'i dgongs pa 'grel ba'i bstan bcos la rgya bod du ji snyed cig byung kyang /mkhas pa la yongs su grags pa tshad thub tu gyur pa ni rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyis mdzad pa rnams dang / bod du rje btsun sa skya pa/ gong ma rnams kyis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos dri ma med pa rnams yin zhing / thar pa don gnyer dag gis thos bsam sgom gsum bya ba'i yul yang rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos dri ma med pa 'di rnams la gtso bo bya bar rigs te/rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ des na sangs rgyas gsung rab dang / /mkhas pa rnams kyi bstan bcos kyi/ /tshig don la ni byin rlabs yod/ /'di 'dra nyan bshad byed pa la/ /thos pa zhes ni brjod pa yin/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa so so'i dgongs par mnga' ba de yin/ de ltar rgyan drug sogs mkhas pa so sos mdzad pa'i bstan bcos rnams kyi nang nas deng sang bod 'e 'chad nyan gyi rgyun ma nub cing dar bar yod pa ni phar tshad gnyis/ 'dul mngon gnyis/ dbu ma sdom gsum rab dbye ste pod drug po 'di yin par 'durgade'i dang po phar phyin gyi gzhung du gyur pa'i bstan bcos ni byams pa'i chos ྅/ 452

bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/yin 'di la mkhas pa 'ga' res gsung tsa na/ byams pa mgon po sangs rgyas yin pas des mdzad pa'i byams chos lnga'ang bka' ru khas len gsung ba yod 3dug kyang / bstan pa 'di shākya thub pa'i bstan pa yin zhing / byams mgon rang shākya thub pa'i 'khor na gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshul bzung bas des mdzad pa'i byams chos rnams shāka thub kyi bka'i dgongs 'grel du gyur pa/'i bstan bcos su bzhag na legs pa 'dra ste/ mngon rtogasargyan las/ ston pas 'di lasabashad pa gang / /zhes dang / de dang de ni mdo bzhin du/ /bsdusadang rgyas pa'i sgo nas brjod/ /ces dang / rgyud blar/ de ltar yid chesalung dang rigs pa la/ /brten nas bdag nyid 'ba' zhig dag phyir dang / /zhes gsungs pas byams pas mdzad pa rnams mdo'i lung dang sbyar shing lung la brten nas brtsams par bshad pas na mkhas pa dag gis gzu bor gnas pa/'i blos dpyod dgos rgyur snang / byams chos lnga'i nang nas mngon rtogs rgyan ni phar chad gnyis su grags pa'i phar phyin gyi gzhung gi gtso bo yin zhing / bod 'dir bka' chen bzhi'i kha skad byung ba'i phar phyin gyi bka' yang yin/ 'di la thog mar 'phags pa thogs med kyis de nyid rnam nges bya ba'i dgongs 'grel mjad/ de'i rjes su slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis yum gyi dgongs pa rnam rig tu bkral ba'i nyi khri'i gzhung 'grel mdzad/ de nas dbyig gnyen gyi slob ma ri ra phyin rang las mkhas pa 'phags pa rnam grol sdes yum don dbu mar 'grel ba'i nyi khri snang ba mdzad/ de'i rjes su btsun pa grol sdes kyang rang gi te+o gas pa dang rjes mthun tsam gyi rnam bshad mdzad/ de nas yum 'chad pa la blo 453

0 tshe na 'od pal/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ () nus phul du na pa slob dpon seng ge bzang pos mngon rtogs rgyan nyad nyi /khri dang sbyar ba la nyi khri le brgyad ma/ brgyad stong pa dang sbyar ba la brgyad stong 'grel chen/ yum gsum ka dang mdor bsdus te sbyar ba la 'grel pa don gsal mdzad/ shān+ti pas slob dpon gyi gzhung gsum po 'di la zur za bar bzhed nas nyi khri dang sbyar ba'i 'grel pa dag ldan dang / brgyad stong pa'i 'grel/ pa snying po mchog dang / sher phyin gyi man ngag rnams mdzad par grags/ 'gre pa pa don gsal ma rgya gar du phrin las shin tu che/ slob dpon dkon mchog 'bangs dang / gser gling pa la sogs pas mdzad pa'i rnam bshad kyang mtha' yas/ bod 'dir yang rngog lo bstan pa'i nyi ma blo ldan shes rab sogs kyis 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phab ste deng sang gi bar du dar rgyas su bzhugs/ khyad par kun mkhyen spyi skad la phar phyin g.yag la thug zer/ g.yag mi pham chos kyi bla mas yul phyogs kun tu phar phyin la 'chad nyan rtsal 'don gnang / ṭī ka'ang che ba rin chen phreng ba/ 'bring po rin chen bang mdzod/ chung ba rin chen bsam 'phel dang gsum mdzad/ brgyud pa ni rngog lo nas rim can du bzung / bu ston rin po che'i slob ma thugs sras lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal la gtso bor thugabu ston gyis phar phyin gyi ṭīk+ka lung gi snye ma brtsams/ 'di'i gseb tshags na sa lugs kyi sems bskyed sogs la dpyad pa thor bu gnang yod 'dugagayag pa'i slob ma rong ston thams cad mkhyen pas sku tshe hril po sa skya pa'i mdo phyogs kyi 'chad nyan gyi rkang bzung / phar phyin rong ṭīka chen mo la sogs nga/ rnam bshad bzhi bcu zhe gsum tsam mdzad/ g.yag rong gnyis kyi bzhed pas 454

bgechen 'od snangal / saskya'i chosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()su chud pa gang dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas yang dag par bsdamasapa' sku can rna si/ 'byor can gyi dbang phyug gi gtso bo rnams/ spyod pa'i gnyen por chos kyi 'khor lo ma lus pa rnam pa thams cad du bskor bar mdzad pa zhes gsungs pas shes nus/ de'ang sangs rgyas zhes pas khyad gzhi bstan/ yang dag par bsdams pa'i zhes sogasakyis khyad chos bstan pa yin no/ /'dir sangs rgyas mchog gi sprul sku rnams ni sgo gsum mi mthun pa'i phyogs las yang dag par bsdams nga ste / spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs mtha' dag spangs/ zhes pa'i don yin/ rnal 'byor can dang / dbang phyug dang / gtso bo rnams la zur dod kyi bshad pa re g.yag ṭīka lasagasungasate/ phyi rol pa'i rnal 'byor pa dang / nyan rang rnams rnal 'byor can dang / byang sems 'phags pa rnams rnal 'byor can gyi dbang phyug dang / shākya thub pa la sogs pa'i mchog gi sprul sku rnams rnal 'byor can gyi dbang phyug gi gtso bo yin par bshad/ skabs 'di'i chos 'khor ni lung gis chos 'khor yin pa gzhir gzhag spyir chos 'khor la lung rtogs kyi chos 'khor gnyis su yod pa ni slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ ston pa'i dam chos rnam/ gnyis te/ /lung dang rtogasapa'i bdag nyid do/ /zhes dang / rgyud bla ma las/chos rnams gnyis dang zhes gsungs pas bstan 'dug rtogs pa'i chos 'khor ni mkhas pa kun mthun par 'gog bden dang lam bden la bzhed kyin yod pa 'dra bas/ phyis su kha cig ngo bo nyid sku 'di spangs pa dang chos 'khor gyi gzha mthun yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis spangs pa'i chos 'khor du 'dod mkhan byung 'dug kyang / mkhas pa snga ma dag ni brda chad bzhag mtshams chos 'khor snye pre 456

bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/lung rtogs kyi chos 'khor gnyas su nges pas ngo bo nyad sku sogs 'gog bden rnams rtogs pa'i chos 'khor du sdud pa las 'os ci yod/ gzhan du chosa'akhor ༄/ lung rtogs gnyis su ma nges par spangs pa'i chos 'khor bsnan te gsum du grangs nges dgos par thal ba'i skyon 'byung / lung gi chos 'khor la kha cigabaka' yin pas khyab zer mkhan yang yod 'dug kyang / lha'i bu rab gnas kyis nus pa'i mdo las/ chos rnams thams cad bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis su /ladus/ /legs par gsungs dang de yi dgongs 'grel ba/ /de yi dbang gisashākya'i bstan pa 'di/ /'jig rten khams 'dir yun ring gnasapar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas na/ lung gi dam chos thams cad rgyal ba'i bka' dang de'i dgongs 'grel du gyur pa'i bsta bcos rnam dag gang rung du 'du dgos la/ de r+sha/ra 'dus pa dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos tshad ldan thams cad lung gi dam chos su grub pas lung gi chos 'khor du yang khas len dgos pa 'dra/ lung gi dam chos dang lung gi chos 'khor la khyad par che ba yod med mkhas pa dag gis rtog dpyod mdzad 'tshal/ spyir lung gi chos 'khor la mdo sde dgongs pa nges 'grel las gsungs tshul la/ ston pa sangs rgyas nas dang por yul wā rā ṇa sīr/ 'khor lnga sde bzang po la sogs pa gdul bya nyan thos kyi rigs can rnams la/ brjod bya 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi las brtsams te chos kyi 'khor spru+o bskor/ bar du bya rgod phung po'i ri bor byang chub sems dpa' bzang skyong dang byams pa la sogs pa gdul bya theg chen gyi rigs can rnams la brjod bya gzugs sogs ngo bo nyid med pa la sogs pa stong pa nyid las brtsams te chos 457

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/lung rtogs kyi chos 'khor gnyas su nges pas ngo bo nyad sku sogs 'gog bden rnams rtogs pa'i chos 'khor du sdud pa las 'os ci yod/ gzhan du chos 'khor wa/ lung rtogs gnyis su ma nges par spangs pa'i chos 'khor bsnan te gsum du grangs nges dgos par thal ba'i skyon 'byung / lung gi chos 'khor la kha cigabaka' yin pas khyab zer mkhan yang yod 'dug kyang / lha'i bu rab gnas kyis nas pa'i mdo las/ chos rnams thams cad bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis su //dus/ /legs par gsungs dang de yi dgongs 'grel ba/ /de yi dbang gisasha kya' bstan pa 'di/ /'jig rten khams 'dir yun ring gnas par 'gyur/ /snyes gsungs pas na/ lung gi dam chos thams cad rgyal ba'i bka' dang de'i dgongs 'grel du gyur pa'i bsta bcos rnam dag gang rung du 'du dgos la/ de / /ra 'dus pa dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos tshad ldan thams cad lung gi dam chos su grub pas lung gi chos 'khor du yang khas len dgos pa 'dra/ lung gi dam chos dang lung gi chos 'khor la khyad par che ba yod med mkhas pa dag gis rtog dpyod mdzad 'tshal/ spyir lung gi chos 'khor la mdo sde dgongs pa nges 'grel las gsungs tshul la/ ston pa sangs rgyas nas dang por yul wā rā ṇa sar/ 'khor lnga sde bzang po la sogs pa gdul bya nyan thos kyi rigs can rnams la/ brjod bya 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi las brtsams te chos kyi 'khor spo bskor/ bar du bya rgod phung po'i ri bor byang chub sems dpa' bzang skyong dang byams pa la sogs pa gdul bya theg chen gyi rigs can rnams la brjod bya gzugs sogs ngo bo nyid med pa la sogs pa stong pa nyid las brtsams te chos 457

ba chen 'od snang lag sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ () 'khor lo bskor/ mthar yul yangs pa can du gzungs dbang phyug rgyal po dang / li tsā byi'i gzhon nu dang / lha mo dpal phreng la sogs pa gdul bya theg pa sna tshogs pa'i rigs can rnams la brjod bya chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med pa gsum la dgongs te ma skyes pa dang / gzod ma nas zhi ba dang / rang bzhin gyis yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa las brtsams pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo sna tshogs pa zhig bskor bar gsung ba la/ de ltar gsum las/ dang po gnyis bla na mchis pa/ skabs mchis pa/ drang ba'i don/ rtsod pa'i gzhir gyur pa yin nga/ dang / gsum pa nyid bla na ma mchis pa/ skabs ma mchis pa/ nges pa'i don/rtsod pa dang bral bar gsungs kyang / dbu ma pa rnams dgongs 'grel las gsungs pa de dag sems tsam pa'i rgyab brten du sbyar nas/ rang lugs la bya rgod phung por gsungs pa'i chos 'khor bar pa sher phyin gyi mdo rnams nges don gyi mdor bzhed kyin yod pa 'dra/ sher phyin mdo nyid la'ang chos 'khor rim pa gsum du dbye rgyu yod pa 'dra ste/ rnam mkhyen gyi thad kyi sher mdo gsungs nga/'i rjes su lam shes kyi mdo gsungs pa na lha rnams kyis/ kye/ 'dzam bu'i gling du chos kyi 'khor lo gnyis pa bskor bar mthong ngo zhes ched du bsngags pa brjod pas na sngar gsungs pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi thad kyi mdo chos 'khor dang po dang /lam shes kyi mdo chos 'khor gnyis pa yin par bstan/ de'i shugs las ga/zhi shes kyi thad kyi mdo rnams chos 'khor gsum pa yin par bstan pa 'dra/ deng sang rang rang dang tha dad na/ ji ltar gsung gin yod/ yang gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal pos zhus pa'i mdo las/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i dri rma/ 458

ba chena'od snang lag saskya'i chosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ () 'khor lo bskor/ mthar yul yangs pa can du gzungs dbang phyug rgyal po dang / li tsā byi'i gzhon nu dang / lha mo dpal phreng la sogs pa gdul bya theg pa sna tshogs pa'i rigs can rnams la brjod bya chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med pa gsum la dgongasate ma skyes pa dang / gzod ma nasazhi ba dang / rang bzhin gyis yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa las brtsams pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo sna tshogs pa zhig bskor bar gsungabashal/ de ltar gsum las/ dang po gnyis bla na mchisapa/ skabasamachisapa/ drang ba'i don/ rtsod pa'i gzhin gyur pa yin nga/ dang / gsum pa nyid bla na ma mchis pa/ skabasam mchis pa/ ngesapa'i don/rtsod pa dang bral bar gsungs kyang / dbu ma pa rnams dgongs 'grel las gsungs pa de dag sems tsam pa'i rgyab brten du sbyar nas/ rang lugs la bya rgod phung por gsungs pa'i chos 'khor bar pa sher phyin gyi mdo rnams nges don gyi mdor bzhed kyin yod pa 'dra/ sher phyin mdo nyid la'ang chos 'bor rim pa gsum du dbye rgyu yod pa 'dra ste/ rnam mkhyen gyi thad kyi sher mdo gsungs nga/'i rjesasu lam shes kyi mdo gsungs pa na lha rnams kyis/ kye/ 'dzam bu'i gling du chos kyi 'khor lo gnyis pa bskor bar mthong ngo zhes ched du bsngags pa brjod pas na sngar gsungs pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi thad kyi mdo chos 'khor dang po dang /lam shes kyi mdo chos 'bor gnyis pa yin par bstan/ de'i shugs las ga/zhi shes kyi thad kyi mdo rnams chos 'khor gsum pa yin par bstan pa 'dra/ deng sang rang rang dang tha dad na/ ji ltar gsung gin yod/ yang gzungasakyi dbang phyug rgyal pos zhus pa'i mdo las/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i dri rma/ 458

bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/rags pa 'a nga / phra ba dang gsum sbyong ba tshul dpes mtshon pa chobro/kya 'bor lo gsum rim can du bskor tshul gsungs te/ thog mar gdul bya rnams skyo ba bskyed nas thar pa don gnyer la 'jug pa'i slad du 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa dang / zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal ba la sogs pa chosakyi sdom gzhi las brtsams pa'i chos 'khor bskor/ de nas thabs shegazung 'jug gi sgo nas theg pa chen po'i lam du zhugs te/ dam chos pad+ma dkar po la sogs pa rnam thar sgo gsum brjod byar byas pa'i chos 'khor bskor te/ sa brgyad pa la 'god par mdzad/ brgyad pa thob pa dang 'tshang rgya bar mngon sum lung ston pa'i phyir mi ldog pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba ni mdo nyid las gsal zhing /de'i don rgyud bla mar/ mi rtag sdug bsngal bdag med dang / /zhi ba'i sgra yisathabs mkhyen nas/ /zhes pa nas/ byang chub mchog tu lung ston pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis kyang gsal bar bstan/ de ltar gsungs pa'i chosa'akhor rim pa gsum dang / spyi bab dgongs 'grel sogs las gsungs pa'i chosa'akhor rim li / gsum la mi 'dra pa'i khyad par ji ltar yod mkhas pas dpyad dgos pas rang rang gi bla ma gong ma'i srol 'dzin pa'i grwa sa so so na kha skad ji ltar yod/yang kun mkhyen g.yag pa dang thog mtshungs rje re mda' ba gzhon nu blo gros kyis gdan sa chen por 'chad nyan dang las chen yun ring du mdzad/ de'i slob ma gzhung lugs rab 'byams shes pa'i bshes gnyen bdun gyi gtso bo rje tsong khe pa blo bzang grags pa byung / dpon slob de gnyis kyis kyang phar phyin la ṭīk+ka la sogs yig tshogasargya che ba mdzad/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyis dgongs pa dbu 459

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/rags pa 'a nga / phra ba dang gsum sbyong ba tshul dpes mtsho ni pa chobs kyi 'bor lo gsum rim can du bskor tshul gsungs te/ thog mar gdul bya rnams skyo ba bskyed nas thar pa don gnyer la 'jug pa'i slad du 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa dang / zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal ba la sogs pa chos kyi sdom gzhi las brtsams pa'i chos 'khor bskor/ de nas thabs shes zung 'jug gi sgo nas theg pa chen po'i lam du zhugs te/ dam chos pad+ma dkar po la sogs pa rnam thar sgo gsum brjod byar byas pa'i chos 'khor bskor te/ sa brgyad pa la 'god par mdzad/ brgyad pa thob pa dang 'tshang rgya bar mngon sum lung ston pa'i phyir mi ldog pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba ni mdo nyid las gsal zhing /de'i don rgyud bla mar/ mi rtag sdug bsngal bdag med dang / /zhi ba'i sgra yisathabs mkhyen nas/ /zhes pa nas/ byang chub mchog tu lung ston pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis kyang gsal bar bstan/ de ltar gsungs pa'i chos ra rim pa gsum dang / spyi bab dgongs 'grel sogs las gsungs pa'i chos 'khor rim li / gsum la mi 'dra pa'i khyad par ji ltar yod mkhas pas dpyad dgos pas rang rang gi bla ma gong ma'i srol 'dzin pa'i grwa sa so so na kha skad ji ltar yod/yang kun mkhyen g.yag pa dang thog mtshungs rje re mda' ba gzhen nu blo gros kyis gdan sa chen por 'chad nyan dang las chen yun ring du mdzad/ de'i slob ma gzhung lugs rab 'byams shes pa'i bshes gnyen bdun gyi gtso bo rje tsong khe pa blo bzang grags pa byung / dpon slob de gnyis kyis kyang phar phyin la ṭīk+ka la sogs yig tshogs rgya che ba mdzad/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyis dgongs pa dbu 459

ba chen 'od snang las/ saskya'i masa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()mar 'grel / sher na gyi mdo'i sbas don mngon rtogs kya rim pa 'chad byed du sbyor bas grub mtha'i gnad kyang phar phyin la mi mthun pa cher med nga/ 'dra/ rong ston gyi slob ma don yod dpal ba'i rjes skyong ba la paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan byung ste/ des phar phyin gyi spyi don chen mo dang / thal ngag dbang po'i rdo rje la sogs pa mdzad de g.yag rong gi lugs srol 'dzin par zhal gyis bzhes/ grub mtha'i gnad sher mdo dang / rgyan gyi dgongs pa mthar thug gzhan stong dbu mar bzhed pa la thugs rtse gtad/ 'bras bu'i skabs su rgya gar rdo rje gdan du sangs rgyas pa'i shākya thub pa la sogs pa'i gzugs sku sangs rgyas min zhing / sangs rgyas mtshan nyid pa ni chos sku kho na yin par bzhed de/de'i shes byed gser 'od dam pa las/ sku snga ma gnyis ni btags pa tsam mo/ /chos kyi sku ni yang dag pa ste zhes sogs dang / rdo rje gcod pa las/ gang dag nga la gzugs su mthong / /gang dag nga la sgrar shes pa/ /log pa'i lam du zhugs pa yi/ /skye bo de dag nga mi mthong / /zhes dang / rgyud bla ma las/ ji ltar tshon ni sna tshogs pas/ /nor bu nge dngos min par snang / /de bzhin 'gro rkyen sna tshogs pas/ khyab bdag de dngos min par snang / /zhes gsungs shing / de'i don yang /tshon ris kyis bris pa'i nor bu de nor bu dngos ma yin pa bzhin du rigs can gsum gyi 'gro ba nas/ sa bcu pa'i byang sems kyi bar la rang rang gi mos pa/ dang dge ba'i rkyen sna tshogs pas snang ba'i sprul sku mchog dang / 'bring dang / tha ma dang / longs skur snang ba de dag gdul bya gzhan snang gi sangs rgyas cam/ las/ sangs rgyas mtshan nyid pa min pa dpe don de ltar sbyar bas rtogs sdos 460

ba chen 'od snang las/ saskya'i masa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()mar 'grel / sher na gyi mdo'i sbas don mngon rtogs kya rim pa 'chad byed du sbyor bas grub mtha'i gnad kyang phar phyin la mi mthun pa cher med nga/ 'dra/ rong ston gyi slob ma don yod dpal ba'i rjes skyong ba la paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan byung ste/ des phar phyin gyi spyi don chen mo dang / thal ngag dbang po'i rdo rje la sogs pa mdzad de g.yag rong gi lugs srol 'dzin par zhal gyis bzhes/ grub mtha'i gnad sher mdo dang / rgyan gyi dgongs pa mthar thug gzhan stong dbu mar bzhed pa la thugs rtse gtad/ 'bras bu'i skabs su rgya gar rdo rje gdan du sangs rgyas pa'i shākya thub pa la sogs pa'i gzugs sku sangs rgyas min zhing / sangs rgyas mtshan nyid pa ni chos sku kho na yin par bzhed de/de'i shes byed gser 'od dam pa las/ sku snga ma gnyis ni btags pa tsam mo/ /chos kyi sku ni yang dag pa ste zhes sogs dang / rdo rje gcod pa las/ gang dag nga la gzugs su mthong / /gang dag nga la sgrar shes pa/ /log pa'i lam du zhugs pa yi/ /skye bo de dag nga mi mthong / /zhes dang / rgyud bla ma las/ ji ltar tshon ni sna tshogs pas/ /nor bu nge dngos min par snang / /de bzhin 'gro rkyen sna tshogs pas/ khyab bdag de dngos min par snang / /zhes gsungs shing / de'i don yang /tshon ris kyis bris pa'i nor bu de nor bu dngos ma yin pa bzhin du rigs can gsum gyi 'gro ba nas/ sa bcu pa'i byang sems kyi bar la rang rang gi mos pa/ dang dge ba'i rkyen sna tshogs pas snang ba'i sprul sku mchog dang / 'bring dang / tha ma dang / longs skur snang ba de dag gdul bya gzhan snang gi sangs rgyas cam/ las/ sangs rgyas mtshan nyid pa min pa dpe don de ltar sbyar bas rtogs sdos 460

bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/kra yin gsungs na yod 'dug pa/ deng sang phal cher ni gzugs sku sangasargyas yin pa gzhir bzhag snang bas na paṇa chen gyi grub mtha' ha cang thal che ba de la dgag sgrub kyi lung rigs ji ltar byed/ yang kun mkhyen g.yag rong gi rjes skyong byams chen rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas 'phel la slob ma kun mkhyen rin po che gtso bor gyur pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu grangs las brgal ba byung /kun mkhyen chen pos rong ston gyi grub mtha' dang mthun par spyi don yum don rab gsal dang / sbyor ṭīka dang / yan lag rgyas bshad sogs mdzad/ kun mkhyen rang gi dgongs pa thun mong ma yin pa ston pa la phar phyin dka' 'grel du grags pa mdzad de/ de'ang rgya gar gyi slob dpon seng ge bzang po la sogasapa dang / bod kyi rngog lo chen po dang / 'bre ar la sogs pa'i lugasarnamasakyang byams mgon gyi dgongs par song ma song rang gi rnam dpyod kyis gzigs nas ma song ba rnams bkag ste byams mgon rang gi dgongs pa dpyis phyin pa blangs nas mchod brjod kyi skabs su/ mchod brjod bstan bcos lus kyi nyams len la sbyar ba sogs sbyar tshul gyis bshad pa rgyas pa dang / de dag gi don bsdu ba la/ mchod brjod tshig gi mkhyen gsum rdzing bcasanas/ /dgongasa'agrel ngag gi yur ba nas drangs te/ /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad kyang mdzad de thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsal bton gnang ba la grub mtha' gzhan 'dzin pa rnams 'di la 'thad mi 'thad kyi dpyad pa gnang rgyu ji ltar yod/ sems bskyed kyi skabs su smon 'jug gnyis kyi khyad par la/ spyod 'jug las/ 'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba yi/ /bye brag ji ltar shes pa ltar/ /de bzhin mkhas pas 'di 461
