brtse 'a 'od snangal / saskya'i chosalung sa bsdus/ ()gnya'ayo / /bye brag ma bzhin shebashapar bya/ /shes/gsungs pa don la phal/ cher 'gro 'dod kyi dpes bstan pa smon pa sems bskyed dang / 'gro ba'i bya bas zin nasa'ajug pa sems bskyed yin pas/ smon pa sems bskyed theg ḍā lam du 'jug pa'i snga rol nasayod pa yin zer zhing / rong ṭīka las kyang de bzhin du gsungasapa la/ kun mkhyen rin po ches/ smon semasadang 'jugi sems tsam theg chen lam gyi snga rol du yod pa yin zhing / smon 'jug gi sems/ bskyed mtshan nyid pa nam skyesapa na theg chen lam du zhugasapa yin te/ sa paṇa gyis/ rgyal sras semasabaskyed ma thob pa/ /zhesatheg chen gyi semasabaskyed ma thob par rgyal sras su khas 'tshe ba bkag pa'i shugasalas/ theg chen sems bskyed thob nas rgyal sras sam/ byang chub sems dpa' yin par gsungasashing /byang chub semasadapa' rnamasani theg chen lam zhugasayin pa/ spyod 'jug las/byang chub sems bskyed gyur na skad cig gis/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad kyis bstan/ khyad par slob dpon gyi 'grel pa don gsal las smon pa dang 'jug pa'i ngo bo nyid rnam pa gnyisaso/ /zhesatheg chen slob pa'i sems bskyed thams cad smon 'jug gi sems bskyed gnyis su nges par gsungs shing / de ltar nges pa'i sems bskyed kyi ma mtha'i sa mtshams kyang theg chen gyi tshogs lam chung ngu nas 'jog pa gnang / ji ltar na/ don gsal las/ de la dang po gsum ni chung ngu dang / 'bring dang / chen po nyid kyisalasadang po pa'i sasabasdusaso/ /zhes gsungs pa'i sems bskyed la dpe'i sgo nas nyer gnyis su phye ba'i sa lta bu'i sems bskyed byang sems lasadang po pa ste/ theg chen tshogasalam chung ngu ba'i 462

brtse chen 'od sna pa la / sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()gnya'/ / /bye brag ma bzhin shes par bya/ /che blta gsungs pa don la phal/ cher 'gro 'dod kyi dpes bstan pa smon pa sems bskyed dang / 'gro ba'i bya bas zin nas 'dun pa sems bskyed yin pas/ smon pa sems bskyed theg chen lam du 'jug pa'i snga rol nas yod pa yin zer zhing / rong ṭīka las kyang de bzhin du gsungs pa la/ kun mkhyen rin po ches/ smon sems dang 'jag sems tsam theg chen lam gyi snga rol du yod pa yin zhing / smon 'jug gi sems/ bskyed mtshan nyid pa nam skyes pa na theg chen lam du zhugs pa yin te/ sa paṇa gyis/ rgyal sras sems bskyed ma thob pa/ /zhes theg chen gyi sems bskyed ma thob par rgyal sras su khas 'che ba bkag pa'i shugs las/ theg chen sems bskyed thob nas rgyal sras sam/ byang chub sems dpa' yin par gsungs shing /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni theg chen lam zhugs yin pa/ spyod 'jug las/byang chub sems bskyed gyur na skad cig gis/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad kyis bstan/ khyad par slob dpon gyi 'grel pa don gsal las smon pa dang 'jug pa'i ngo bo nyid rnam pa gnyis so/ /zhes theg chen slob pa'i sems bskyed thams cad smon 'jug gi sems bskyed gnyis su nges par gsungs shing / de ltar nges pa'i sems bskyed kyi ma mtha'i sa mtshams kyang theg chen gyi tshogs lam chung ngu nas 'jog pa gnang / ji ltar na/ don gsal las/ de la dang po gsum ni chung ngu dang / 'bring dang / chen po nyid kyis las dang po pa'i sa sa bsdus so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i sems bskyed la dpe'i sgo nas nyer gnyis su phye ba'i sa lta bu'i sems bskyed byang sems las dang po pa ste/ theg chen tsho gis lam chung ngu ba'i 462

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/rgyad la yod pa nas ma mtha' bzhag de ba du bse ru lta bu dang zla ba lta bu khroms bskyed kyang tshogs lam 'bring po la gnas pa dang / tshogs lam chen po la gnas pa nas ma mtha'i sa mtshams su bzhag cing / byang sems las dang po pa dang byang sems tshogs lam pa don gcig yin/ de ltar byas na sa skya pa'i rje bas gong ma rnams kyi gsung las/ smon pa la smon pa'i sems/ smon pa sems bskyed pa/ smon pa mi nyams par bsrung ba dang gsum/ 'jug pa la ra jug pa'i sems/ 'jug pa sems bskyed pa/ 'jug pa mi nyams par bsrung kra dang gsum gsungs pa'i dgongs par song bas sa lugs dang grub mtha'i gnad rnam pa kun tu mthun pa zhig yin shas che bar 'dug skyed tshal ba'i nyang stod phyogs kha cig nyan rang gi sems bskyed rnams sems bskyed mtshan nyid pa ma yin zer ba byung 'dug kyang / de ltar na nyan rang gi lam rnams kyang lam mchan nyid pa min par 'gyur ba dang / nyan rang gi thar pa thob pas kyang thar pa thob pa'i go mi chod pa'i ston byung ba 'dra/ yang rigs kyi skabs su rang bzhin gnas rigs la gnyis su phye nas sems gsal ba'i cha de 'dus byas rang bzhin gnas rigs dang / stong pa'i cha de 'dus ma byas rang bzhin gnas rigs yin zer zhing / rong ṭīka gi dngos bstan la'ang gdul bya drang ba'i don gyi phyir de ltar gsungs yod 'dug kyang / sdom gsum kha skong las/ rang bzhin gnas rigs 'dus byas su/ /'dod pa dngos smra'i lugs yin gyi/ /dbu ma pa yi lugs la med/ zhes rang bzhin gnas rigs la 'dus ma byas kyi khyab mtha' 'cha' bar mdzad/ de'i shes byed du rang bzhin gnas rigs zhes pa'i 463

bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/rgyud la yod pa nas ma mtha' bzhag de ba du bse ru lta bu dang zla ba lta bu sems bskyed kyang tshogasalam 'bring po la gnas pa dang / tshogs lam chen po la gnas pa nas ma mtha'i samatshamasasu bzhag cing / byang sems lasadang po pa dang byang sems tshogasalam pa don gcig yin/ de ltar byas na sa skya pa'i rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi gsung las/ smon pa la smon pa'i sems/ smon pa sems bskyed pa/ smon pa mi nyams par bsrung ba dang gsum/ 'jug pa la rajug pa'i sems/ 'jug pa semasabaskyed pa/ 'jug pa mi nyamasapar bsrung ba dang gsum gsungs pa'i dgongs par song bas sa lugs dang grub mtha'i gnad rnam pa kun tu mthun pa zhig yin shasache bar 'dug skyed tshal ba'i nyang stod phyogs kha cig nyan rang gi sems bskyed rnams sems bskyed mtshan nyid pa ma yin zer ba byung 'dug kyang / de ltar na nyan rang gi lam rnams kyang lam mchan nyid pa min par 'gyur ba dang / nyan rang gi thar pa thob pas kyang thar pa thob pa'i go mi chod pa'i skyon byung ba 'dra/ yang rigs kyi skabs su rang bzhin gnas rigs la gnyis su phye nas semasagasal ba'i cha de 'dus byasarang bzhin gnas rigs dang / stong pa'i cha de 'dus ma byasarang bzhin gnas rigs yin zer zhing / rong ṭīka gi dngosabastan la'ang gdul bya drang ba'i don gyi phyir de ltar gsungs yod 'dug kyang / sdom gsum kha skong las/ rang bzhin gnasarigs 'dusabyasasu/ /'dod pa dngosasmra'i lugasayin gyi/ /dbu ma pa yi lugs la med/ zhes rang bzhin gnas rigs la 'dusam byas kyi khyab mtha' 'cha' bar mdzad/ de'i shesabyed du rang bzhin gnas rigasazhesapa'i 463

brtse chen 'od snang la / saskya'i chosa'abyung gces bsdus/ ()rang bzhin dang chos nyid rnam grangs yan pa 'phags pa grol sdes nyar snang du gsungs pa'i lung 'dren par mdzad/ rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs la'ang paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa la sogs pa sa skya pa'i rjes 'brang mang dag cig gis sems can gyi rgyud kyi dge ba yin tshad rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs yin zer ba dang /kha cig slob lam thams cad rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs yin zer ba byung yang / sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin 'khrul med mkhas mchog smra ba'i seng ges ni/ thub pa dgongs gsal las/ rgyas pa'i rigs ni byang chub tu semasabaskyed nas yod kyi / ma bskyed pa la med do zhes gsungs pa la thugs rtse gtad nas rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs la theg chen gyi slob lam gyis khyab par mdzad/ rgyas 'gyur gyi don yang rigs sad pa'i stobs kyi theg chen gyi rigs kyi nus pa gong nas gong du rgyas par 'gyur ba la 'jog des na mngon rtogs rgyan gyi bstan bya'i don ni/shesarab pha rol phyin pa ni/ /dngos po brgyad kyis yang dag bshad/ /rnam kun mkhyen nyid lam shes nyid/ /de nasathams cad shes pa nyid/ /rnam kun mngon dzo+ogs rtogs pa dang / /rtse mor phyin dang mthar gyis pa/ /skad cig gcig mngon rdzogs byang chub/ /chos kyi sku dang de rnam brgyad/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/rnam mkhyen lam shes gzhi shes gsum thob bya'i yul du byas te skabs dang po gsum du rim bzhin bstan/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba/ rtse mo'i sbyor ba/ mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba dang bzhi ni sgom pa nyams len byas te/skabasabazhi pa/ lnga pa/ drug pa/ bdun pa rnamasasu bstan/ 'brasabu chasasku ni mkhyen gsum thob bya'i yul du byas pa'i don sbyor bzhis khobazhinanyams su blangs 464

brtse chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chosang gces bsdus/ ()rang bzhin dang chos nyid rnam grangs yan pa 'phags pa grol sdes nyar snang du gsungs pa'i lung 'dren par mdzad/ rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs la'ang paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa la sogs pa sa skya pa'i rjes 'brang mang dag cig gis sems can gyi rgyud kyi dge ba yin tshad rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs yin zer ba dang /kha cig slob lam thams cad rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs yin zer ba byung yang / sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin 'khrul med mkhas mchog smra ba'i seng ges ni/ thub pa dgongs gsal las/ rgyas pa'i rigs ni byang chub tu sems bskyed nas yod kyi / ma bskyed pa la med do zhes gsungs pa la thugs rtse gtad nas rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs la theg chen gyi slob lam gyis khyab par mdzad/ rgyas 'gyur gyi don yang rigs sad pa'i stobs kyi theg chen gyi rigs kyi nus pa gong nas gong du rgyas par 'gyur ba la 'jog des na mngon rtogs rgyan gyi bstan bya'i don ni/shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni/ /dngos po brgyad kyis yang dag bshad/ /rnam kun mkhyen nyid lam shes nyid/ /de nas thams cad shes pa nyid/ /rnam kun mngon rdzogs rtogs pa dang / /rtse mor phyin dang mthar gyis pa/ /skad cig gcig mngon rdzogs byang chub/ /chos kyi sku dang de rnam brgyad/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/rnam mkhyen lam shes gzhi shes gsum thob bya'i yul du byas te skabs dang po gsum du rim bzhin bstan/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba/ rtse mo'i sbyor ba/ mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba dang bzhi ni sgom pa nyams len byas te/skabase bzhi pa/ lnga pa/ drug pa/ bdun pa rnam ba'i su bstan/ 'bras bu cho tre/sku ni mkhyen gsum thob bya'i yul du byas pa'i don sbyor bzhis kho bzhin nyams su blangs 464

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa' 'bel gtam/ru las thob pa' 'bras bu yin pas skabs brgyad par bstan/ de ltar brjod bya'i gtso bo dngos po brgyad byung ba'i dang po rnam mkhyen rgyas par 'chad pa la theg chen sems bskyed la sogs pa'i chos bcu/ lam shes la bcu gcigagazhi shes la dgu/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba la bcu gcig rtse mo'i sbyor ba (la )brgyad/ mthar gyis pa la bcu gsum/ skad cig ma'i sbor ba la bzhi/ 'bras bu ri chas sku la sku gsum mdzad pa phrin las dang bcas pas bzhi ste/ 'di rnams la sher phyin gyi sbas don don 'dun cur grags pa yin/ de ltar na dngos brgyad den bdun cu'i sgo nas 'tshang rgya ba'i lam rim 'bras bu dang bcas pa tshang la ma nor bar ston pa ni/ phar phyin brgyud 'debs kyi lam rim las/ rnam pa kun mkhyen 'bras bu thob bya'i phyir/ /zhes pa nas/ sna tsho gos gdul bya'i re skong sprul pa'i sku/ /mngon du gyur nas phrin las dbang bsgyur shog /ces pa'i bar tshigs bcad gsum gyis gsal bar rtogs nus pa yin/ 'bras bu'i skabs su lung chos pa phal cher sangs rgyas kyi sku la bzhir grangs nges pa dang / ye shes la me long lta bu'i ye shes sogs bzhi'i steng du chos dbyings ye shes bsnan nas lngar 'dod kyang / kun mkhyen chen pos pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs la sku gsum dang ye shes bzhi/ rdo rje theg pa'i skabs su sku bzhi dang ye shes lngar bzhed dgos pa yin te/ rje btsun rtse mos rgyud sde spyi rnam las de ltar du gsung 'dug pas so zhes bshad/ de la brten nas mkhabang pa snga ma phal cher sku la bzhir grangs nges par bzhed kyin yod 'dug kyang / gzhung 'dir/ ngo bo nyid longs rdzogs bcas dang / /de bzhin gzhan pa sprul pa ni/ /chos sku zhes dgar 465

bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/ru las thob pa' 'bras bu yin pas skabs brgyad par bstan/ de ltar brjod bya'i gtso bo dngos po brgyad byung ba'i dang po rnam mkhyen rgyas par 'chad pa la theg chen sems bskyed la sogs pa'i chos bcu/ lam shes la bcu gcigagazhi shes la dgu/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba la bcu gcig rtse mo'i sbyor ba (la )brgyad/ mthar gyis pa la bcu gsum/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba la bzhi/ 'bras bu ches sku la sku gsum mdzad pa phrin las dang bcas pas bzhi ste/ 'di rnamasal sher phyin gyi sbas don don 'dun cur grags pa yin/ de ltar na dngos brgyad den bdun cu'i sgo nas 'tshang rgya ba'i lam rim 'bras bu dang bcas pa tshang la ma nor bar ston pa ni/ phar phyin brgyud 'debs kyi lam rim las/ rnam pa kun mkhyen 'bras bu thob bya'i phyir/ /zhes pa nas/ sna tshogasagadul bya'i re skong sprul pa'i sku/ /mngon du gyur nas phrin las dbang bsgyur shog /cesapa'i bar tshigs bcad gsum gyis gsal bar rtogs nus pa yin/ 'bras bu'i skabs su lung chos pa phal cher sangs rgyas kyi sku la bzhir grangs ngesapa dang / ye shes la me long lta bu'i ye shes sogs bzhi'i steng du chos dbyings ye shes bsnan nas lngar 'dod kyang / kun mkhyen chen pos pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs la sku gsum dang ye shes bzhi/ rdo rje theg pa'i skabs su sku bzhi dang ye shes lngar bzhed dgos pa yin te/ rje btsun rtse mos rgyud sde spyi rnam lasade ltar du gsung 'dug pas so zhes bshad/ de la brten nas mkhadra'ipa snga ma phal cher sku la bzhir grangs nges par bzhed kyin yod 'dug kyang / gzhung 'dir/ ngo bo nyid longs rdzogs bcas dang / /de bzhin gzhan pa sprul pa ni/ /chosasku zhes dgar 465

bas chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chosang gces bsdus/ ()tshigs dang bcas te gsungs pas gsum po de sku grangs nges dbye gzhir bstan pa 'dra/ rgyud bla ma las kyang / rigs 'di gnyis las sangs rgyas kyi/ /sku gsum thob par 'dod pa dang / /zhes dang / mdo sde rgyan las/ sku gsum/ dag gis sang ba'i rgyas kyi/ /sku bsdu bang par ni shes kha bya ste/ /che lta yo sku gsum gyis sangs rgyas kyi sku thams cad bsdus par gsungs pa dang / seng ge bzang po'i 'grel pa don gsal las/ sku la bzhi ru bshad pa gnyis 'gal spong dgos pa/ 'dug pas rang rang gi blos dpyad dang grub mtha'i kha skad la ji ltar yod/gzhan yang rje mus rab 'byams pas phar phyin gyi ṭīk+ka mi pham dgongs rgyan la sogs pa dang / paṇa chen kong ston gyis kyang phar phyin gyi spyi don mdzad/ de ltar na bka' chen bzhi'i nang tshan gyi phar phyin gyi gzhung de mngon rtogs rgyan rang yin par 'dug kyang / spyi babs byams cho me phyi ma bzhi dang / thogs med kyis mdzad pa'i theg bsdus rnams kyang phar phyin gyi gzhung du bsdu dgos pas/ de dag la go don dang mtha' dpyod cung zad bgyis na/ mdo sde rgyan ni theg pa ྾ po'i mdo sde mtha' yas pa'i dgongs 'grel du gyur pas mdo sde rgyan zhes bya/'di nyid theg chen bka' sgrub la sogs pa skabs nyi shu rtsa gcig gi sgo nas gtan la phab/ lam rim ni rigs dang sna chas la mos pa dang / /zhes sogs thub pa dgongs gsal du drangs pa ltar don tshan bcu'i sgo nas gtan la phab/ drang nges gang gtso che na/ gnyis ka ci rigs par yod de/ gzhi'i skabs su/ dkar po dman pa yod pa rgyu dang bral/ /zhes rigs chad kyi sems can yod par bshad pa dang / lam gyi skabs su/ rang dang rang gi bdag nyid du/ /med phyir 466

bgechen 'od snang la / saskya'i chosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()tshigs dang bcas te gsungs pas gsum po de sku grangs nges dbye gzhir bstan pa 'dra/ rgyud bla ma lasakyang / rigasa'adi gnyisalasasangasargyas kyi/ /sku gsum thob par 'dod pa dang / /zhesadang / mdo sde rgyan las/ sku gsum/ dag gis sangasargyas kyi/ /sku bsdusapar ni shesabya ste/ /zhesasku gsum gyis sangasargyas kyi sku thams cad bsdus par gsungasapa dang / seng ge bzang po'i 'grel pa don gsal las/ sku la bzhi ru bshad pa gnyis 'gal spong dgos pa/ 'dug pasarang rang gi blos dpyad dang grub mtha'i kha skad la ji ltar yod/gzhan yang rje mus rab 'byams pas phar phyin gyi ṭīk+ka mi pham dgongs rgyan la sogs pa dang / paṇa chen kong ston gyis kyang phar phyin gyi spyi don mdzad/ de ltar na bka' chen bzhi'i nang tshan gyi phar phyin gyi gzhung de mngon rtogs rgyan rang yin par 'dug kyang / spyi babs byams chosaphyi ma bzhi dang / thogs med kyis mdzad pa'i theg bsdus rnams kyang phar phyin gyi gzhung du bsdu dgosapas/ de dag la go don dang mtha' dpyod cung zad bgyis na/ mdo sde rgyan ni theg pa ḍā po'i mdo sde mtha' yas pa'i dgongs 'grel du gyur pas mdo sde rgyan zhes bya/'di nyid theg chen bka' sgrub la sogs pa skabs nyi shu rtsa gcig gi sgo nas gtan la phab/ lam rim ni rigs dang chogal mos pa dang / /zhesasogs thub pa dgongs gsal du drangs pa ltar don tshan bcu'i sgo nasagatan la phab/ drang ngesagang gtso che na/ gnyisaka ci rigasapar yod de/ gzhi'i skabasasu/ dkar po dman pa yod pa rgyu dang bral/ /zhesarigasachad kyi sems can yod par bshad pa dang / lam gyi skabasasu/ rang dang rang gi bdag nyid du/ /med phyir 466

bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam//zhes pa la sogs pas chos thams cad skye med du ston pa'i mdo drang don du richad ba dang / 'bras bu'i skabasasu/ kha cig dag ni drang phyir dang / /gzhan dag rjes su gzung ba'i phyir/ /rdzogasapa'i sangasargyasarnams kyisani/ /ma ngesarnams la theg gcig bstan/ /zhesamathar thug theg pa gcig tu nges pa drang do na du bstan nas/ mthar thug theg pa gsum du gtan la 'bebasapa'i skabasarnams ni drang don gyi kha skad yin/ yang gzhi'i skabasasu/ 'gro kun de yi snying kro can/ /zhes sems can thams cad bde gshegs snying po rgyud ldan du bstan r+sā dang / lam gyi skabasasu/ grangasadang de yi mtshan nyid go rim dang / /zhesasogs kyisaphar phyin drug dang / bsdu dngosabazhi'i spyod pa bstan pa dang /3bras bu'i skabs su/ sangasargyasarnamasakyi sku dbye ba/ /rang bzhin dang ni pre+ongs spyod rdzogs/ /g.yin ni sprul pa'i sku yin te/ /zhes sogasakyisasku gsum dang ye shes bzhir bstan pa rnamasani nges don 'chad pa'i skabs yin/3dir ye shesal bzhi las ma gsungasate/ rgyan las/ me long ye shes mi g.yo ste / / ye shesagasum ni de la brten/ /mnyam pa nyid dang sosor rtog /bya ba grub pa kho na'o/ /zhesagasungs pa me long lta bu'i ye shesarten dang / ye shesaphyi rme/ gsum po de la brten par bshad pa'i bzhi po de las/ chos dbyings ye shes3der mi bzhed pa kho na'o zhes pa'i rnam dpyad lasathon pa 'dra/ sabazang ma ti pa r+ṇa chen gyisabyams chos lnga char la 'grel pa tshad thub re mdzad/ 'on kyang 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi sa'i lung gis 'khrul gzhi byadra'inas chos dbyings ye shes dang lngar bzhed pa ni salugs dang ma mthun zhing / gzhan stong gi phyogs 467

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam//shes pa la sogs pas chos thams cad skye med du ston pa'i mdo drang don du ri chad ba dang / 'bras bu'i skabs su/ kha cig dag ni drang phyir dang / /gzhan dag rjes su gzung ba'i phyir/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis ni/ /ma ngesarnams la theg gcig bstan/ /zhes sa mthar thug theg pa gcig tu nges pa drang do na du bstan nas/ mthar thug theg pa gsum du gtan la 'bebs pa'i skabasarnams ni drang don gyi kha skad yin/ yang gzhi'i skabs su/ 'gro kun de yi snying kro can/ /zhes sems can thams cad bde gshegs snying po rgyud ldan du bstan tho dang / lam gyi skabs su/ grangs dang de yi mtshan nyid go rim dang / /zhesasogs kyas phar phyin drug dang / bsdu dngos bzhi'i spyod pa bstan pa dang /3bras bu'i skabs su/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku dbye ba/ /rang bzhin dang ni sdongs spyod rdzogs/ /g.yin ni sprul pa'i sku yin te/ /zhes sogs kyis sku gsum dang ye shes bzhir bstan pa rnams ni nges don 'chad pa'i skabs yin/ri dar ye shes la bzhi las ma gsungs te/ rgyan las/ me long ye shes mi g.yo ste / / ye shes gsum ni de la brten/ /mnyam pa nyid dang so sor rtog /bya ba grub pa kho na'o/ /zhes gsungs pa me long lta bu'i ye shes rten dang / ye shes phyi rme/ gsum po de la brten par bshad pa'i bzhi po de las/ chos dbyings ye shes3der mi bzhed pa kho na'o zhes pa'i rnam dpyad las thon pa 'dra/ sa bzang ma ti pa r+ṇa chen sa byams chos lnga char la 'grel pa tshad thub re mdzad/ 'on kyang 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi sa'i lung gis 'khrul gzhi bya ba'i nas chos dbyings ye shes dang lngar bzhed pa ni sa lugs dang ma mthun zhing / gzhan stong gi phyogs 467

brtsechen 'odasnang la / saskya'i choga'agrang gcesabasdus/ ()la spyan yangs pabakakho na'o zhes pa tshig 'di ma ga gas pa ltar snang / rgyal sras thogs med pas mdo sde rgyan dang / rgyud bla gnyis ka la 'grel pa re mdzad/rgyud blar/ de bzhin de nyid mthong ba yis/ /mthong spang rnams ni zlog par 'gyur/ /zhesapa'i gzhung la/ de bzhin mthong lam rim skyesapas/ /zhes pa'i gzhung du bsgyur nas mthong lam skad cig ma bcu drug gis mthong spang rim bzhin du spong ba'i bshad pa mdzad pas mthong lam kun bar chad med lam du bzhed pa 'dra/ spyir rgyud bla'i bstan bcos lus kyi brjod bya'i gtso bo ni/sangs rgyas chos tshogs khams dang byang chub dang / /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ skyabs yul gyi sangasargyasadakon mchog nas/ sangasargyas kyi phrin las kyi bar brjod bya rtogasapa'i rdo rje bdun po de yin/ deng sang mang po zhig brjod bya bdun po de ka rdo rje'i gnas bdun du 'dod pa yod pa shas che ba 'dra na'ang /rdo rje yi ni gnasabadun 'di dag go /zhes pa'i don ni/ sangs rgyasadakon mchog la sogs pa de dang de brjod byar ston pa'i mdo so so la rdo rje'i gnas zhes bya la/ de dag bdun po 'dir bshad gzhir byas te/ 'chad byed rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos kyi 'chad ces sbyar na legs pa 'ong ngam/ gang ltar rdo rje dang rdo rje'i gnasakyi khyad par 'byed dgos/ rgyud bla ma 'di dbu sems gang gi gzhung yin snyam na/ rje btsun rin po che'i mngon rtogs ljon shing gi rgyu rigs spang bya rkyen la ltosapa'i skabs su/ 'dir ni rigs chad pa mi srid de/ rgyud bla ma las kyang / dzo+ogasasangs sku ni 'phro phyir dang / /zhes sogasa'adren par mdzad pa dang / thub pa dgongs gsal du'ang sems tsam pa ni rigs chad par 468

yo chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chosang gces bsdus/ ()la spyan yangs pa bsha na'o zhes pa tshig 'di ma ga gas pa ltar snang / rgyal sras thogs med pas mdo sde rgyan dang / rgyud bla gnyis ka la 'grel pa re mdzad/rgyud blar/ de bzhin de nyid mthong ba yis/ /mthong spang rnams ni zlog par 'gyur/ /che'i/pa'i gzhung la/ de bzhin mthong lam rim skyes pas/ /zhes pa'i gzhung du bsgyur nas mthong lam skad cig ma bcu drug gis mthong spang rim bzhin du spong ba'i bshad pa mdzad pas mthong lam kun bar chad med lam du bzhed pa 'dra/ spyir rgyud bla'i bstan bcos lus kyi brjod bya'i gtso bo ni/sangs rgyas chos tshogs khams dang byang chub dang / /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ skyabs yul gyi sangs rgyas dkon mchog nas/ sangs rgyas kyi phrin las kyi bar brjod bya rtogs pa'i rdo rje bdun po de yin/ deng sang mang po zhig brjod bya bdun po de ka rdo rje'i gnas bdun du 'dod pa yod pa shas che ba 'dra na'ang /rdo rje yi ni gnas bdun 'di dag go /zhes pa'i don ni/ sangs rgyadakon mchog la sogs pa de dang de brjod byar ston pa'i mdo so so la rdo rje'i gnas zhes bya la/ de dag bdun po 'dir bshad gzhir byas te/ 'chad byed rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos kyi 'chad ces sbyar na legs pa 'ong ngam/ gang ltar rdo rje dang rdo rje'i gnas kyi khyad par 'byed dgos/ rgyud bla ma 'di dbu sems gang gi gzhung yin snyam na/ rje btsun rin po che'i mngon rtogs ljon shing gi rgyu rigs spang bya rkyen la ltos pa'i skabs su/ 'dir ni rigs chad pa mi srid de/ rgyud bla ma las kyang / rdzogs sangs sku ni 'phro phyir dang / /zhes sogs 'dren par mdzad pa dang / thub pa dgongs gsal du'ang sems tsam pa ni rigs chad par 468

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/ridod dbu ma pa ragasachad par mi 'dod ces gsungs shing / rgyud bla ma'i dngos bstan la/ rigs yod phyir na lus can kun/ /zhes pas sems can kun rigs rgyud ldan du bstan pa'i rigs chad pa'i sems can mi srid pa gzhir bzhag pas/ de ltar na 'ad dbu ma'i gzhung yin par khas len dgos pa 'dra/rgeng ma'i gsung dang mthun par kun mkhyen rin po che'ang 'di dbu ma'i gzhung rang du bzhed de/ rgyud bla mar/ sprin dang rmi lam sgyu bzhin de dang der/ zhas bya thams cad rnam kun stong pa zhes/ /gsungs nas yang 'dir rgyal rnams sems can la/ /sangs rgyas snying po yod ces ci ste gsungs/ /zhes bshad pa'i don bka' 'bor lo bar par sprin dang rmi lam sogs kyi dpes chos thams cad bden stong du gsungs pa dang / 'khor lo gsum par/ sems can gyi rgyud la sangs rgyas kyi snying po bden par grub pa yod par gsungs pa gnyis mi 'gal spru ma zhes dogs pa bkod pa yin la/ de'i lan ston pa la gzhung snga ma de'i de 'i / thag sems zhus sems can dman la brnyas pa dang/ /yang dag mi 'dzin yang dag chos la skur/ /bdag cag lhag pa'i skyon lnga gang dag la/ /yod pa de dag de spang don du gsungs/ /zhes pa 'di yin la/ de'i don ni/ bka' 'khor spru+o bar pa las chos thams cad bden med du bshad pa de nges pa'i don du khas len zhing / 'khor lo gsum pa las mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i snying po bden par grub pa sems can kun la yod par bshad pa de sems zhus pa dang / sems can dman pa la brnyas pa sogs kyi skyon lnga spang ba'i phyir du gsungs pa yin sa /sa drang don yin no zhes lan btab pas rtogs nus gsungs/ rab dbye las/469

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/ridod dbu ma pa ragasachad par mi 'dod ces gsungs shing / rgyud bla ma'i dngos bstan la/ rigs yod phyir na lus can kun/ /zhes pas sems can kun rigs rgyud ldan du bstan pa'i rigs chad pa'i sems can mi srid pa gzhir bzhag pas/ de ltar na 'ad dbu ma'i gzhung yin par khas len dgos pa 'dra/rgeng ma'i gsung dang mthun par kun mkhyen rin po che'ang 'di dbu ma'i gzhung rang du bzhed de/ rgyud bla mar/ sprin dang rmi lam sgyu bzhin de dang der/ zhas bya thams cad rnam kun stong pa zhes/ /gsungs nas yang 'dir rgyal rnams sems can la/ /sangs rgyas snying po yod ces ci ste gsungs/ /zhes bshad pa'i don bka' 'khor lo bar par sprin dang rmi lam sogs kyi dpes chos thams cad bden stong du gsungs pa dang / 'khor lo gsum par/ sems can gyi rgyud la sangs rgyas kyi snying po bden par grub pa yod par gsungs pa gnyis mi 'gal spru ma zhes dogs pa bkod pa yin la/ de'i lan ston pa la gzhung snga ma de'i de 'i / thag sems zhus sems can dman la brnyas pa dang/ /yang dag mi 'dzin yang dag chos la skur/ /bdag cag lhag pa'i skyon lnga gang dag la/ /yod pa de dag de spang don du gsungs/ /zhes pa 'di yin la/ de'i don ni/ bka' 'khor spru+o bar pa las chos thams cad bden med du bshad pa de nges pa'i don du khas len zhing / 'khor lo gsum pa las mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i snying po bden par grub pa sems can kun la yod par bshad pa de sems zhum pa dang / sems can dman pa la brnyas pa sogs kyi skyon lnga spang ba'i phyir du gsungs pa yin sa /sa drang don yin no zhes lan btab pas rtogs nus gsungs/ rab dbye las/469

brtsechen 'od snang la / saskya'i chosa'abyung gcespobasdus/ ()dgos pa skyon lnga spang ra gsungs / /ches pa dang 'grags par snang / yang sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin thams cad mkhyen pa klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i gsung las/ rgyud dwa ma'i dogs pa de'i lan ni de ltar ma yin te gsungs zhes pa'i 'phro de ma thag pa/ las/ yang dag mtha' ni 'dus byas kyis/ /rnam pa thamasacad bden pa sde/ /nyon mongs las dang rnam smin don/ /sprin la sogs pa bzhin du brjod/ /zhon mongs sprin 'dra bya ba yin/ /las ni rmi lam longs spyod bshin/ /nyon mongs las kyi rnam par smin/ /phung po sgyu ma sprul pa bzhin/ /sngar ni de ltar rna'i / bzhag nas/ /slar yang bla ma'i rgyud 'dir ni/ /nyes pa lnga dag spang ba'i ngh+ru ra/khams yod nyid cesabastan pa yin/ /zhesagasungasal/ de'i don yang / yang dag mtha' ste bde gshegs snying po ni sprin sogs kyi dpes bstan par mi nas/ shing bden grub yin la/ 'khor lo bar par sprin sogs kyi dpes chos tham/sa cad bden med du bstan pa ni nyon mongs pa'i nyon mongs pa la sogs pa/ gsum gyis mtshon pa'i 'dus byas kyi chos rnams la dgongs pa yin te/ sprin gyi dpes bstan pa nyon mongs pa'i nyon mongs pa dang / rmi lam gyi dpes bstan pa las kyi nyon mongs pa dang / sgyu ma sprul pa'i dpes bstan pa las kyi rnam smin du gyur pa'i skye ba'i nyon mongs pa rnams bden par med par yin zhes (pan btab pas na rgyud bla 'di snying po bden grub tu 'dod pa'i sems tsam gyi gzhung rang yin/ bu ston chos 'byung du'ang sems tsam pa'i gzhung du bshad/ rab dbye las kyang / 'on kyang mdo sde 'ga' zhig dang / /theg pa chen po rgyud bla mar/ /sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi/ /snyingapo yod par gsungs pa ni/ /470

brtse chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()dgos pa skyon lnga spang ra gsungs / /zhes pa dang 'grags par snang / yang sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin thams cad mkhyen pa klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i gsung las/ rgyud da ma'i dogs pa de'i lan ni de ltar ma yin te gsungs zhes pa'i 'phro de ma zlog skre/ las/ yang dag mtha' ni 'dus byas kyis/ /rnam pa thams cad bden pa sde/ /nyon mongs las dang rnam smin don/ /sprin la sogs pa bzhin du brjod/ /zhon mongs sprin 'dra bya ba yin/ /las ni rmi lam longs spyod bzhin/ /nyon mongs las kyi rnam par smin/ /phung po sgyu ma sprul pa bzhin/ /sngar ni de ltar rna'i / bzhag nas/ /slar yang bla ma'i rgyud 'dir ni/ /nyes pa lnga dag spang ba'i ngh+ru ra/khams yod nyid ces bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs la/ de'i don yang / yang dag mtha' ste bde gshegs snying po ni sprin sogs kyi dpes bstan par mi nas/ shing bden grub yin la/ 'khor lo bar par sprin sogs kyi dpes chos tha /sa cad bden med du bstan pa ni nyon mongs pa'i nyon mongs pa la sogs pa/ gsum gyis mtshon pa'i 'dus byas kyi chos rnams la dgongs pa yin te/ smin gyi dpes bstan pa nyon mongs pa'i nyon mongs pa dang / rmi lam gyi dpes bsnyen pa las kyi nyon mongs pa dang / sgyu ma sprul pa'i dpes bstan pa las kyi rnam smin du gyur pa'i skye ba'i nyon mongs pa rnams bden par med par yin zhes (pan btab pas na rgyud bla 'di snying po bden grub tu 'dod pa'i sems tsam gyi gzhung rang yin/ bu ston chos 'byung du'ang sems tsam pa'i gzhung du bshad/ rab dbye las kyang / 'on kyang mdo sde 'ga' zhig dang / /theg pa chen po rgyud bla mar/ /sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi/ /snying po yod par gsungs pa ni/ /470

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/dgongs pa na par shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun pa yan zhes bzhed kyin yod 'dug pa spyi babs kha skad la lung don dang 'jim ril 'dra /nyes pa ltar/ lung don 'di 'dra mkhas pa so so'i rnam dpyod kyis 'then khyer byas tsa na gang bshad bden bden 'dra ba 'ong gin 'dug rang rang gi grub pa'i rnga/tha' dang bstun na gang 'thad/ bab 'di la kun mkhyen g.yag pas kyang mu gu /nga du mdzad zer ba'i ṭīk+ka zhig dang / rong ston gyis mdzad pa'i ṭīk+ka dang /kun mkhyen rin po che'i yang ṭīk+ka yod 'dug pa yin/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed rno brjod bya mtshan nyid gsum gyi sgo nas sgro 'dogs dang skur 'debs kyi mtha' ga nyis su ma lhung ba'i dbus dang / der lhung ba'i mtha' rnam par phye nas sems tsam pa rang lugs kyi dbu ma'i lam 'chad par bzhed de/ gzhung nyid wa sa/ btags pa dang ni g.yin gyi dbang / /yongs su grub pa nyid kyang ngo / /zhes dang / yod pas med pas yod pas na/ /de ni dbu ma'i lam yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa yin/ de'ang yod pas sogs kyis gzhan dbang rang gi mtshan nyid kyi yod pas skur 'debs su ma lhung / kun btags rang gi mtshan nyid kyi med pa sa sgro 'dogs su ma lhung / yongs grub don dam par yod pas mtha' thamasadu da las grol te dbu ma'i lam yin no zhes bstan/ lugs 'di'i yongs grub si/ 'gyur med yongs grub dang / phyin ci ma log pa'i yongs grub gnyis su phye nas/ snga ma de don dam bden pa yin zhing rgyu rkyen las ma byung ba'i 'dus ma byas su 'jog phyi ma de dag pa gzhan dbang dang don gcig pas rgyu rkyen las byung zhing 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes la ngos 'dzin pa yin/ 'di don 471

bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/dgongs pa na par shesapar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun pa yan zhes bzhed kyin yod 'dug pa spyi babs kha skad la lung don dang 'jim ril 'dra /nyes pa ltar/ lung don 'di 'dra mkhas pa so so'i rnam dpyod kyis 'then khyer byas tsa na gang bshad bden bden 'dra ba 'ong gin 'dug rang rang gi grub pa'i rnga/tha' dang bstun na gang 'thad/ bab 'di la kun mkhyen g.yag pas kyang mu gu /nga du mdzad zer ba'i ṭīk+ka zhig dang / rong ston gyis mdzad pa'i ṭīk+ka dang /kun mkhyen rin po che'i yang ṭīk+ka yod 'dug pa yin/ dbusamatha' rnam 'byed ni brjod bya mtshan nyid gsum gyi sgo nas sgro 'dogs dang skur 'debs kyi mtha' ga nyis su ma lhung ba'i dbus dang / der lhung ba'i mtha' rnam par phye nas sems tsam pa rang lugasakyi dbu ma'i lam 'chad par bzhed de/ gzhung nyid wa sa/ btagasapa dang ni gzhan gyi dbang / /yongasasu grub pa nyid kyang ngo / /zhes dang / yod pas med pas yod pas na/ /de ni dbu ma'i lam yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa yin/ de'ang yod pas sogs kyis gzhan dbang rang gi mtshan nyid kyi yodo paso skur 'debs su ma lhung / kun btags rang gi mtshan nyid kyi med pa sa sgra 'dags su ma lhung / yangs grub don dam par yod pas mtha' thamasadu da las grol te dbu ma'i lam yin no zhes bstan/ lugs 'di'i yongs grub si/ 'gyur med yongs grub dang / phyin ci ma log pa'i yongs grub gnyis su phye nas/ snga ma de don dam bden pa yin zhing rgyu rkyen las ma byung ba'i 'dusam byas su 'jog phyi ma de dag pa gzhan dbang dang don gcig pas rgyu rkyen las byung zhing 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes la ngos 'dzin pa yin/ 'di don 471

bgechen 'od snang las/ saskya'i chosa'abyung gces bsdus/ rtonadam par yod kyang don dam bden pa ma yin te/ 'dus byas yin pa' phyar ro/ /de skad du mdo sde dgongs pa nges 'grel las/ rgyu las byung ba nyid yin na (ni )'dus byas yin par 'gyur ro/ /'dus byas yin na don dam par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa yin/ kha cig don dam du yod pa la don dam bden pa yin pas khyab pa gzhir bzhag mdzad nas/ don dam bden pa la 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas gnyis yod gsungs pa byung 'dug pa 'thad mi 'thad ji ltar yin/ rang gi blo tshod ni 'gyur med yongs grub dang don dam bden pa don gcig ste/ gzhung 'dir/ dam pa'i don ni gcig pu'o/ /zhes gsungs pas shes/ ma dag gzhan dbang ni gzung 'dzin gnyis snang can gyi shes pa mtha' dag la 'jog ste/ yang dag ma yin kun rtog ni/ /sems dang sems byung khams gsum pa/ /zhes gsungs pas shes/ 'dir semasatsam pa'i skabs yin pas bems po'i rnam gzhag ni med/ chos gzhan spyi mtshan gyis bsdus pa'i sgro btags rnams la kun btags su 'jog 'di dang mngon pa kun btus kyi skabs kyi sems tsam pa ni lung gi rjes 'brang gi sems tsam pa yin/ phyis kyi mtshan nyid pa kha cig gis tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi skabs su dbus mtha' nas gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid gsum gyi rnam gzhag rnams kyang bsres nas yig 'jog dang grub mtha' 'cha' ba ni rigs pa'i rjes 'brang la lung rgo rjes 'brang gis rgyas bkab par 'gro bas/ de 'dra'i chosakyisagrul mi thub/rigs pa'i rjes 'brang gi sems tsam pa rang gi lugs bzhin byed na tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi tshad 'bras gnyis pa sogs nas gsungs pa bzhin byed dgos/472

brtsechen 'od snang las/ saskya'i chosa'abyung gces bsdus/ ()dam par yod kyang don dam bden pa ma yin te/ 'dus byas yin pa' phyar ro/ /de skad du mdo sde dgongs pa nges 'grel las/ rgyu las byung ba nyid yin na (ni )'dus byas yin par 'gyur ro/ /'dus byas yin na don dam par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa yin/ kha cig don dam du yod pa la don dam bden pa yin pas khyab pa gzhir bzhag mdzad nas/ don dam bden pa la 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas gnyis yod gsungs pa byung 'dug pa 'thad mi 'thad ji ltar yin/ rang gi blo tshod ni 'gyur med yongs grub dang don dam bden pa don gcig ste/ gzhung 'dir/ dam pa'i don ni gcig pu'o/ /zhes gsungs pas shes/ ma dag gzhan dbang ni gzung 'dzin gnyis snang can gyi shes pa mtha' dag la 'jog ste/ yang dag ma yin kun rtog ni/ /sems dang sems byung khams gsum pa/ /zhes gsungs pas shes/ 'dir semasatsam pa'i skabs yin pas bems po'i rnam gzhag ni med/ chos gzhan spyi mtshan gyis bsdus pa'i sgro btags rnams la kun btags su 'jog 'di dang mngon pa kun btus kyi skabs kyi sems tsam pa ni lung gi rjes 'brang gi sems tsam pa yin/ phyis kyi mtshan nyid pa kha cig gis tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi skabs su dbus mtha' nas gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid gsum gyi rnam gzhag rnams kyang bsres nas yig 'jog dang grub mtha' 'cha' ba ni rigs pa'i rjes 'brang la lung rgo rjes 'brang gis rgyas bkab par 'gro bas/ de 'dra'i chosakyisagrul mi thub/rigs pa'i rjes 'brang gi sems tsam pa rang gi lugs bzhin byed na tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi tshad 'bras gnyis pa sogs nas gsungs pa bzhin byed dgos/472

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/de nas kyang mtshan nyad gsum gya rnam gzhag gsungs pa med/ chos dang chosanyid rnam 'byed ni/ chosathams cad chos can 'khor ba dang / chos nyid mya ngan smras 'das pa gnyis su phye nas ston pa'i gzhung yin te/ gzhung nyid las/ 'di thams cad ni gnyis te/ chos kyi rab tu phye ba dang / chosanyid kyi rab tu phye ba'o/ /chos kyi rab tu phye ba ni 'khor ba'o/ /chosanyid ni theg pa gsum gyi mya ngan las 'das pa'o zhes gsungs/ 'byed rnam pa gnyis sems tsam pa'i gzhung yin/ gnyis ka la dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa re yod/ chosasnyad rnam 'byed la tshigs bcad ma zhig kyang yod par grags mod/ mkhas pa gcig gis tshigs bcad du bsdebs pa yin nam/ byams pa rang gis mdzad pa rne tshigs lhug 'di las 'os med/ yang rngog lo chen po ni byams chos lnga ka dbu ma//'i gzhung du bzhed pa yin no zhes pa'i gsung 'phros kyang yod/ phar phyin gyi gzhung thogs med kyi theg bsdus ni theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i lam gyi rnam gzhag ston pa la shin tu rgya che/ byang chub sems dpa' lam sne zin pa'i sa mchams byams chos lngar gsal kha ma byung yang / gzhud 'dir gsal kha bstan pa yin te/ bzang dang smon pa'i stobs can dang / /semasabartan khyad par 'gro ba yis/ /byang chub sems dpa' grangs med gsum/ /kun tu rtsom par mdzad pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa de'i don yang / bzang ba ste dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen po byas pa dang / smon lam rgya chen po thebs pa dang / byang chub kyi sems mi ldog par brtan pa dang / sems de'ang khyad par te/ gong nas gong du 'phel 'gro ba ste khyad par bzhi dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpar gyur pa na lam sne zin pa 473

ba chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chosang gtses bsdus/ ()theb/kyang bya/ ra ldog pa che kha/kyang bya/ des na theg chen sems skyed rgyud 'a/ nam skyes pa na lam zhugs su 'jog kyang lam sne zin par mi 'jog lam sde zin pa'i snga rol du tshogs bsags pa rnams bskal pa grangs med gsum gyi bzla la mi bgrang ste/ mdo sde dkon mchog sprin las/ byang chub semadapa' chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du rtogs par gyur pa de'i tshe de nas bskal pa bgrang bar bya'i/ thog ma'i sems nas brtsams te ma yin no zhes gsungs nga/ yin/ lam sne zin pa'am phyir mi ldog pa'i ma mtha'i sa mtshams theg chen gyi tshogs lam na yod kyang / phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags thob pa ni theg chen gyi stor lam drod thob pa nas 'jog ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ gzugs la so/sa las ldog sogs rtags/ /zhes pa nas/ drod dang rtse mo bzod bcas dang / /chos mchog rnams la gnas pa ni/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub las mi ldog /ces gsungs so/ /de ltar na de dag gis ni phar phyin gyi gzhung gi skabs las brtsams te mkhas pa dag la 'bel gtam du bya ba rin chen mdzes pa'i phra tshom dang por bkod pa bstan zin to/ /de skad bshad 'di mi tri nā tha yis/ /rnam par phye ba'i phar phyin lam gyi gzhung / /'bel ba'i gtam gyi yid gcugs mdza' na mo/ /bla zhal 'dzum sgeg rgyan phreng dang por dge/ /// 'gro 'dir yang dag rig pa'i lam/ /drang por gsungs pa'i ston rnga/ rje / / bden bzhi'i lam ston bslu ba med/ /thub dbang zhabs kyi pa smor 'dud//ces mchod par brjod nas/ 'dir bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍita sa mkhag pa/ 'jug pa'i sgo las/ mkhas gang shes bya'i de kho na/ /ji bzhin rtogs pa/ yin 474

'tshechoga'odasnangalas/ saskya'i chosaḥng sa bsdus/ rtonachesko/kyang bya/ ra ldog pa che'i/kyang bya/ des na theg chen sems skyed rgyud 'a/ nam skyes pa na lam zhugs su 'jog kyang lam sne zin par mi 'jog lam ste zin pa'i snga rol du tshogs bsags pa rnamasabaskal pa grangs med gsum gyi bzla la mi bgrang ste/ mdo sde dkon mchog sprin las/ byang chub semasadapa' chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du rtogs par gyur pa de'i tshe de nasabaskal pa bgrang bar bya'i/ thog ma'i sems nasabartsamasate ma yin no zhes gsungs nga/ yin/ lam sne zin pa'am phyir mi ldog pa'i ma mtha'i samatshams theg chen gyi tshogs lam na yod kyang / phyir mi ldog pa'i rtagasathob pa ni theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod thob pa nasa'ajog ste/ mngon rtogasargyan las/ gzugs la sogs lasaldog sogs rtags/ /zhesapa nas/ drod dang rtse mo bzod bcas dang / /chosamachog rnamasal gnas pa ni/ /rdzogasapa'i byang chub lasami ldog /ces gsungs so/ /de ltar na de dag gis ni phar phyin gyi gzhung gi skabs las brtsams te mkhas pa dag la 'bel gtam du bya ba rin chen mdzes pa'i phra tshom dang por bkod pa bstan zin to/ /de skad bshad 'di mi tri nā tha yis/ /rnam par phye ba'i phar phyin lam gyi gzhung / /'bel ba'i gtam gyi yid gcugs mdza' na mo/ /bla zhal 'dzum sgeg rgyan phreng dang por dge/ /// 'gro 'dir yang dag rig pa'i lam/ /drang por gsungs pa'i ston rnga/ rje / / bden bzhi'i lam ston bslu ba med/ /thub dbang zhabasakyi pad+mor 'dud//ces mchod par brjod nas/ 'dir bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍitamamakhasang/ 'jug pa'i sgo las/ mkhasagang shesabya'i de kho na/ /ji bzhin rtogasang/ yin 474

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/kra ra 'dod/ /bye brag sbyangs ba 'a don shes pa/ /de dang de la mkhas pa yan/ /de yul brda sprod rtog ge dang / /gso ba phyi nang rig ces gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa snar/ gang la mkhas par bya ba'i yul ni shes bya rig pa'i gnas lnga yin la/de'i nang nas don gyi 'gal 'brel gcod pa la rtog ge'am/ tshad ma rig pa sprud mi dgos ka med yin te/ 'di'i sgrub pa dang sun 'byin pa'i rigs lam gyi sgo nas don yin pa dang ma yin pa'i dgag sgrub kyi mtha' dpyod pa yin/ de lta bu'i rtog ge pa la phyi pa dang nang pa gnyis byung / phyi pa la rtag lta ba bzhi dang /chad lta ba gcig ste rtog ge sde lnga byung / de'ang mkhas ka' ga las/ mu stegs byed la rtog ge lnga/ /rigs byed grangs can 'ug phrug pa/ /za byed tshu rol mdzes pa'o/ /zhes dang / sgra pa shes rin gyis grub mtha' kun shes las kyang /phyi rol grub mtha' smra pa mang gsungs kyang / /rtag smra bzhi dang chad smra gcig pur 'dus/ /zhes bshad/ rigs gter las kyang / thub pa ser skya rkang mig pre dang zhes sogs phyi rol pa'i rtog ge pa lnga rang du gsungs/ kha cig sa paṇa (gyes )mdzad zer ba'i gzhung lugs legs bshad na mu stegs byed la rtog ge sde bdun du bshad do/ /rtag lta ba lnga dang / chad lta ba gnyis su gsungs/ 'di sa paṇa gyi rigs gter rang 'grel du kho bos byas pa'i grub mtha' rnam 'byed twe blta bar bya'o zhes dang / mkhas 'jug las/ rgyas par grub mtha' rnam 3byed ltos/ /zhes gsungs pa'i grub mtha' rnam 'byed de yin par 'dod kyang /de ni min pa 'dra ste/ grub mtha' rnam 'byed ni mkhas 'jug dang rigs gter zi da 'grel gyi gong du brtsams tshar bas/ rgya nag la ma phebs gong 'di phyogs 475

brtse chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()su mdzad pa yan la/ ga shos ni ling chu rtse'i khab tu sbyar zer ba yod cing /rigs gter rang nas lung drangs pa'ang 'ga' re yod/ dbu ma'i grub mtha'i rjes su rgyud sde bzhi'i rnam gzhag kyang cha tsam bstan 'dug gang ltar yang / phyi rol pa'i rtog ge sde bdun du bshad pa de ni mkhas 'jug dang dngos su 'ag pa zhing / rigs gter dang yang 'gal te/ thub pa grangs can pa/ ser skya rkang mig ri/ rig byed pa dang / 'ug pa'i bu bye brag pa/ bu mkha' gos can sar bu pa dang / tshu rol/ mdzes pa'i gzhung 'dzin pa rgyang 'phen pa/ zhes phyi rol pa lnga smras nas/ thos/ sgrogs pa dang gangs ri'i khrod gnas smra rnams kyi/ /rtog ge ngan 'joms bstan bcos chen po 'di byas so/ /zhes pas phyi rol pa lnga po de'i steng du nyan thos pa/ dang bod rgan po rnams kyi lugs te/ de dag gi smra ba ngan pa 'joms byed du bstan bcos 'di byas so zhes bstan to/ /des na gzhung lugs legs bshad 'di rang lugs kyi slob brgyud zhig gis sa paṇa la kha 'phangs pa 'dra mo zhig 'dug pas 'di la'ang mkhas pa dag gis dpyad bdar dgos rgyur snang / nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i rtog ge pa la snga phyi bar gsum du bzhed mkhan byung zhes grags kyang /mkhas 'jug las/ rang sde sangs rgyas tshad mar 'dzin/ /de la snga phyi rnam pa gnyis/ /zhes gsung bas pas gnyis su nges kal/ snga phyi'i grub mtha'i khyad par ni/ snga ma dbyig gnyen legs ldan sogs/ /don la 'khrul pa me/do mod kyi/ /dbye bsdu'i khyad par 'ga' zhig dang / /brjod pa'i tshul la khyad par yod/ /phyi ma phyogs glang chos grags sogs/ /grangs dang dbye bsda'i bye brarga dang / /brjod pa'i tshul la nyung rgyas sogs/ /snga ma'i tshul la khyad par 476

brtse chen 'od snang las/ saskya'i chos 'byung gcesabasdus/ ()su mdzad pa yan la/ ga shos ni ling chu rtse'i khab tu sbyar zer ba yod cing /rigs gter rang nas lung drangs pa'ang 'ga' re yod/ dbu ma'i grub mtha'i rjes su rgyud sde bzhi'i rnam gzhag kyang cha tsam bstan 'dug gang ltar yang / phyi rol pa'i rtog ge sde bdun du bshad pa de ni mkhas 'jug dang dngos su 'gapa zhing / rigs gter dang yang 'gal te/ thub pa grangs can pa/ ser skya rkang mig ri/ rig byed pa dang / 'ug pa'i bu bye brag pa/ bu mkha' gosacan sar bu pa dang / tshu rol/ mdzes pa'i gzhud 'dzin pa rgyang 'phen pa/ zhes phyi rol pa lnga smras nas/ thosi/ sgrogs pa dang gangs ri'i khrod gnas smra rnams kyi/ /rtog ge ngan 'joms bstan bcos chen po 'di byas so/ /zhes pas phyi rol pa lnga po de'i steng du nyan thos pa/ dang bod rgan po rnams kyi lugs te/ de dag gi smra ba ngan pa 'joms byed du bstan bcos 'di byas so zhes bstan to/ /des na gzhung lugs legs bshad 'di rang lugs kyi slob brgyud zhig gis sa paṇa la kha 'phangs pa 'dra mo zhig 'dug pas 'di la'ang mkhas pa dag gis dpyad bdar dgos rgyur snang / nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i rtog ge pa la snga phyi bar gsum du bzhed mkhan byung zhes grags kyang /mkhasa'ajug las/ rang sde sangasargyasatshad mar 'dzin/ /de la snga phyi rnam pa gnyis/ /zhes gsungaba'ipas gnyis su ngebashal/ snga phyi'i grub mtha'i khyad par ni/ snga ma dbyig gnyen legasaldan sogs/ /don la 'khrul pa me/do mod kyi/ /dbye bsdu'i khyad par 'ga' zhig dang / /brjod pa'i tshul la khyad par yod/ /phyi ma phyogasaglang chosagrags sogs/ /grangs dang dbye bsdu'i bye brarga dang / /brjod pa'i tshul la nyung rgyas sogs/ /snga ma'i tshul las khyad par 476

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam//riphags/ /zhes gsungs pas snga ma rnams tshad ma la mngon rjes gnyas/ lung chad ma dang gsum/ 'brel pa la'ang bdag brteg de byung gnyis las lhag par grangs nges pa dang / ltag chod gsum du sdud pa dang / sgrub ngag brjod pa'i chu pa la yan lag lnga ldan gyi sgrub ngag 'god par mdzad/ rtog ge pa phyi ma rig pa'i dbang phyug gnyis nas bzung tshad ma la mngon rjes gnyis/ 'brel ba la bdag gcig dang / de byung gi 'brel ba gnyis su nges pa dang / ltag chod gsum du mi sdud par nyi shu rtsa bzhir 'byed pa dang / sgrub ngag brjod tshul la yan lag lnga ldan las tshig nyung la don rgyas pa'i yan lag gnyis ldan gyi sgrub ngag 'god par mdzad/ 'dir gsungs pa'i nyung rgyas dang / rigs gter du/blun po la ni nyung rgyas sbyar/ /zhes gsungs pa'i nyung rgyas go don gcig paṇa chen gyi rigs gter ṭīk+kar nyung zhes pa rtsa ba'i sgrub ngag yan lag gnyis ldan dang / rgyas pa de'i tshul gsum sgrub byed kyi rigs pa rnams la sbyor bar mdzad kyang / 'grel par de 'dra'i gsal kha mi 'dug pas ji ltar 'thad dam/ de ltar dbyig gnyen gyi slob ma tshad ma rang las mkhas pa phyogs kyi glang pos tshad ma rma/do pas/ mngon sum dang ni rjesasu dpag /ltar snang bcasapa bdag rig phyir/ /sgrub pa dang ni sun 3byen rig /ltar snang bcasapa gzhan don byed/ /cesartog ge pa'i tshig don brgyad gsungs pa'i rjes dad ga snar snang gang yin dri bar bya ste/ kha cig rtags 'dzin sems yin zer yang phyogasasu ma phyin/ rang /gas ni 'gal rtags la brten pa'i blo rnams de yin te/ rtagasayang dag la brten pa 'i blo thamasacad rjes dpag yang dag yin pa'i phyir/ mdo le'u drug gi bdag nyid can rang 'grel dang bcas pa brtsams/ de'i dgongs pa rnam par 'grel pa la chos grags kyi rnam 477

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam//ri phags/ /ces gsungs pas snga ma rnams tshad ma la mngon rjes gnyas/ lung chad ma dang ga sdo/ma/ 'brel pa la'ang bdag brteg de byung gnyis las lhag par grangs nges pa dang / ltag chod gsum du sdud pa dang / sgrub ngag brjod pa'i chu pa la yan lag lnga ldan gyi sgrub ngag 'god par mdzad/ rtog ge pa phyi ma rig pa'i dbang phyug gnyis nas bzung tshad ma la mngon rjes gnyis/ 'brel ba la bdag gcig dang / de byung gi 'brel ba gnyis su nges pa dang / ltag chod gsum du mi sdud par nyi shu rtsa bzhir 'byed pa dang / sgrub ngag brjod tshul la yan lag lnga ldan las tshig nyung la don rgyas pa'i yan lag gnyis ldan gyi sgrub ngag 'god par mdzad/ 'dir gsungs pa'i nyung rgyas dang / rigs gter du/glan po la ni nyung rgyas sbyar/ /zhes gsungs pa'i nyung rgyas go don gcig paṇa rngon gyi rigs gter ṭī mer nyung zhes pa rtsa ba'i sgrub ngag yan lag gnyis ldan dang / rgyas pa de'i tshul gsum sgrub byed kyi rigs pa rnams la sbyor bar mdzad kyang / 'grel par de 'dra'i gsal kha mi 'dug pas ji ltar 'thad dam/ de ltar dbyig gnyen gyi slob ma tshad ma rang las mkhas pa phyogs kyi glang pos tshad ma rnga/do pas/ mngon sum dang ni rjes su dpag /ltar snang bcas pa bdag rig phyir/ /sgrub pa dang ni sun 3byen ngag /ltar snang bcas pa gzhan don byed/ /ces rtog ge pa'i tshig don brgyad gsungs pa'i rjes dad ga snar snang gang yin dri bar bya ste/ kha cig rtags 'dzin sems yin zer yang phyogs su ma phyin/ rang /gas ni 'gal rtags la brten pa'i blo rnams de yin te/ rtags yang dag la brten pa 'i blo thams cad rjes dpag yang dag yin pa'i phyir/ mdo le'u drug gi bdag nyid can rang 'grel dang bcas pa brtsams/ de'i dgongs pa rnam par 'grel pa la chos grags kyi rnam 477

brtsechen 'od snang las/ saskya'i mtho'agrang gcesabasdus/ ()'grel la sogs pa tshad ma sde bdun/ rnam 'grel le'u dang po rang 'grel dang bcasapa brtsams nas/ le'u phyi ma gsum la 'grel pa lha dbang blo la brtsam du bcug pas slob dpon gyi dgongs pa ma longs te 'grel pa brtsams pa gzigs su phul bas chu la bkrus/ yang brtsams te gzigs su phul bas me la bsregs/yang brtsams te de'i mjug tu/ phal cher bskal pa med nyid dang //dus la'ang sdod pa med pa dang / /gomasapa'i phyir ni mdor bsdusanas/ /dka' 'grel 'di ni 'dir byas so/ /zhes de skad kyang bris nas gzigs su phul bas/ gzhung gi 'phrosadang tshig zur gyis bstan pa'i sbas don rnams ma mngon 'dug kyang / dngos bstan phal cher longs pa tsam du 'dug gsungs nas bzhag gang ltar lha'i 'grel pa 'di'i dgongs pa la tshad ma'i mtshan nyid la sogs pa'i blang bya phan pa'i don dang / grangs dang / mtshan nyid la log par rtog pa sogs dor bya gnod par gyur pa'i don ma yin pa rnam par 'byed nga/ dngos stobs rjes dpag la rag las pas rnam 'grel 'dir dgos pa'i dbang gis rang don rjes dpag gi le'u dang por bshad/ de nas mdo'i mchod brjod tshad mar gyur pa zhes sogs kyi tshigasabacad kyi don 'chad pa la/ de'ang brtsams par dam bcas pa'i tshig rkang gnyis kyi don rtogs sla bas bshad nga/ mdzad ma dgos shing / tshad mar gyur pa zhes sogs mchod brjod kyi tshig rkang gnyis po de'i don rgyas par 'chad pa la/ tshad mar grub pa'i le'u gnyis par gsungs/ de nas tshad ma'i mtshan nyid kyi bstan bcos tshad ma mdo nyid bshang gzhir byas nas 'chad pa skabs su babs pa las/ re zhig mdo'i mngon sum/ 478

ba chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i mas 'byung gces bsdus/ ()'grel la sogs pa tshad ma sde bdun/ rnam 'grel le'u dang po rang 'grel dang bcas pa brtsams nas/ le'u phyi ma gsum la 'grel pa lha dbang blo la brtsam du bcug pas slob dpon gyi dgongs pa ma longs te 'grel pa brtsams pa gzigs su phul bas chu la bkru/sa/ yang brtsams te gzigs su phul bas me la bsregs/yang brtsams te de'i mjug tu/ phal cher bskal pa med nyid dang //dus la'ang sdod pa med pa dang / /goms pa'i phyir ni mdor bsdus nas/ /dka' 'grel 'di ni 'dir byas so/ /zhes de skad kyang bris nas gzigs su phul bas/ gzhung gi 'phros dang tshig zur gyis bstan pa'i sbas don rnams ma mngon 'dug kyang / dngos bstan phal cher longs pa tsam du 'dug gsungs nas bzhag gang ltar lha'i 'grel pa 'di'i dgongs pa la tshad ma'i mtshan nyid la sogs pa'i blang bya phan pa'i don dang / grangs dang / mtshan nyid la log par rtog pa sogs dor bya gnod par gyur pa'i don ma yin pa rnam par 'byed pa/ dngos stobs rjes dpag la rag las pas rnam 'grel 'dir dgos pa'i dbang gis rang don rjes dpag gi le'u dang por bshad/ de nas mdo'i mchod brjod tshad mar gyur pa zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad kyi don 'chad pa la/ de'ang brtsams par dam bcas pa'i tshig rkang gnyis kyi don rtogs sla bas bshad nga/ mdzad ma dgos shing / tshad mar gyur pa zhes sogs mchod brjod kyi tshig rkang gnyis po de'i don rgyas par 'chad pa la/ tshad mar grub pa'i le'u gnyis par gsungs/ de nas tshad ma'i mtshan nyid kyi bstan bcos tshad ma mdo nyid bshang gzhir byas nas 'chad pa skabs su babs pa las/ re zhig mdo'i mngon sum/ 478

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/ be'u 'chad pa la/ gzhal bya gnyas ra la sogs pa' le'u 'ad gsum par gsungs/ de nas rjes dpag la gnyis las/ rang don rjes dpag gi le'u dang ngo/ra bshad zin pas/ lhag ma skabs su babs pa mdo'i gzhan don rjes dpag rgo le'u'i dgongs don 'chad pa la/ gzhan la bstan par bya nyid phyir/ /la sogs pa'i le'u 'di bzhi par gsungs par bzhed de/ lhas slob dpon gyi tshad ma'i mchan nyid kyi bstan bcos kyi rgyu rjes su dpag par sngar rnam par bzhag pa dang / zhes sogs gsungs shing / de'i rgyab rten yang le'u dang po'i rang 'grel las don dang don ma yin pa rnam par 'byed pa ni rjes su dpag pa la brten pa'i phyir yin la zhes gsungs pa la thugs rtse gtad/ lha'i slob ma shākya blo gros kyis le'u dang po'i rang 'grel dang / lha'i le'u phyi ma gsum gyi 'grel ri/ la 'grel bshad mdzad/ slob dpon rgyan mkhan po shes rab 'byung gnas srus pa sa/ glegs bam gnas pa'i go rim dang / brtsams pa'i go rim gnyis pas/ dang po ni da lta glegs bam gnas pa ltar yongs su grags pa yin la/rga nyis pa ni chos grags kyis tshad ma grub pa'i le'u dang por brtsams/ de nas mngon sum le'u gnyis pa/ rang don rjes dpag gi le'u gsum pa/ de'i rjes de rnga/ thag tu gzhan don rjes dpag 'chad de/ rgyan gyis gzhan don rjes dpag re chad pa'i mtshams sbyor du rang gi don gyi rjes su dpag pa'i de ma thag par /zhes gsungs yod 'dug bod 'dir yang rje re mda' ba dang / de'i slob ma tsong pre pre dang / bo dong paṇa chen sogs kyis brtsams pa'i go rim de ltar du bzhed/te ga pa'i drwa ba rnams gsal zhing / /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad kyang le'u dang 479

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/ be'u 'chad pa la/ gzhal bya gnyas ra la sogs pa' le'u 'ad gsum par gsungs/ de nas rjes dpag la gnyis las/ rang don rjesadapag gi le'u dang po/ra bshad zin pas/ lhag ma skabs su babs pa mdo'i gzhan don rjes dpag rgo le'u'i dgongs don 'chad pa la/ g.yin la bstan par bya nyid phyir/ /la sogs pa'i le'u 'di bzhi par gsungs par bzhed de/ lhas slob dpon gyi tshad ma'i mchan nyid kyi bstan bcos kyi rgyu rjes su dpag par sngar rnam par bzhag pa dang / zhes sogs gsungs shing / de'i rgyab rten yang le'u dang po'i rang 'grel las don dang don ma yin pa rnam par 'byed pa ni rjes su dpag pa la brten pa'i phyir yin la zhes gsungs pa la thugs rtse gtad/ lha'i slob ma shākya blo gros kyis le'u dang po'i rang 'grel dang / lha'i le'u phyi ma gsum gyi 'grel pa/ la 'grel bshad mdzad/ slob dpon rgyan mkhan po shes rab 'byung gnas srus pa sa/ glegasabam gnas pa'i go rim dang / brtsamasapa'i go rim gnyis pas/ dang po ni da lta glegs bam gnas pa ltar yongs su grags pa yin la/rga nyis pa ni chos grags kyis tshad ma grub pa'i le'u dang por brtsams/ de nas mngon sum le'u gnyis pa/ rang don rjes dpag gi le'u gsum pa/ de'i rjesade rma/ thag tu gzhan don rjes dpag 'chad de/ rgyan gyis gzhan don rjesadapag rechad pa'i mtshams sbyor du rang gi don gyi rjes su dpag pa'i de ma thag par /nyes gsungs yod 'dug bod 'dir yang rje re mda' ba dang / de'i slob ma tsong ba pre dang / bo dong paṇa chen sogs kyis brtsams pa'i go rim de ltar du bzhed/rte ga pa'i drwa ba rnams gsal zhing / /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad kyang le'u dang 479

ba chen 'od pal/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()pa' rang 'grel gyi mchod brjod yin gsungs/ nya dbon dang kun mkhyen g.yag pa'i rjes su 'brangs te sa skya pa byings glegs bam gnas pa'i go rim/ ltar du brtsams par bzhed/ rgyan gyi slob ma ya ma phyis tshad ma rgyan gyi 'grel ru / stong phrag sum cu rtsa drug yod pa mdzad/ ya ma dang ri'i bar du mtshams sbos gyis sgra sgrub pas gshin rje'i dgra zhes pa 'byung bar sgra pa dag 'chad pa la|sa/kun mkhyen gyis sde bdun rab gsal du ya ma rī zhes yang yang gsungs nga/si/ brgyud 'debs su yang / 'chi bdag bdud kyi dpung 'joms ya ma rī/ /zhes 'don dgos/ ya ma shrī zhes pa yi ge ma dag gsungs/ yang dzā len dha rar ska 'khrungs pa'i slob dpon chos mchog gis rnam nges kyi 'grel bshad 'thad lda rme chen mo mdzad/ 'dis mu stegs dang rtsod pas rtsod pa rgyal theng bdun byung sde rgyal rnga lan bdun du brdungs pas paṇa chen rgyal rnga bdun par grags/ 'on kyang 'dis rang rig mngon sum la gzung yul yod par bshad pa rigs gter du bkag gzhan yang slob dpon dul ba lhas kyang tshad ma sde bdun char 'a/ 'grel pa re mdzad/ kha che dz+nyā na shrī 'di'i rnam nges la dang / dge bsnyen paṇ+ḍita 'jigs sde bdun char la bram ze bde byed dga' bas kyang 'grel pa mdzad de tshad ma/'i bshad srol bskyangs/ 'di gnyis la'ang rigs gter du dpyad pa ci rigs par mdzad/ 'on kyang mngon sum gyi 'gros kyi skabs su bde byed dga' ba'i lugs zhal gyis bzhes te bsngags pa'ang mdzad/ bde byed dga' ba'i slob rma/ la paṇa chen me wa dru 'phags pa'i dngos slob ston gzhan gyi rjes su 'brangs te sa skya nor bzang gis wang gu kun mkhyen gyis wang gu/ paṇa chen gyis wang pu gsungs byung / sgra bsgrub pas ngag 480

'tshechen 'od palas/ saskya'i chosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()pa' rang 'grel gyi mchod brjod yin gsungs/ nya dbon dang kun mkhyen g.yag pa'i rjes su 'brangs te sa skya pa byings glegs bam gnas pa'i go rim/ ltar du brtsams par bzhed/ rgyan gyi slob ma ya ma phyis tshad ma rgyan gyi 'grel ru / stong phrag sum cu rtsa drug yod pa mdzad/ ya ma dang ri'i bar du mtshams sbyor gyis sgra sgrub pas gshin rje'i dgra zhes pa 'byung bar sgra pa dag 'chad pa lags/kun mkhyen gyis sde bdun rab gsal du ya ma rī zhes yang yang gsungs nga/si/ brgyud 'debs su yang / 'chi bdag bdud kyi dpung 'joms ya ma rī/ /zhes 'don dgos/ ya ma shrī zhes pa yi ge ma dag gsungs/ yang dzā len dha rar skra 'khrungs pa'i slob dpon chos mchog gis rnam nges kyi 'grel bshad 'thad lda be chen mo mdzad/ 'dis mu stegs dang rtsod pas rtsod pa rgyal theng bdun byung sde rgyal rnga lan bdun du brdungs pas paṇa chen rgyal rnga bdun par grags/ 'on kyang 'dis rang rig mngon sum la gzung yul yod par bshad pa rigs gter du bkag gzhan yang slob dpon dul ba lhas kyang tshad ma sde bdun char 'a/ 'grel pa re mdzad/ kha che dz+nyā na shrī 'di'i rnam ngesaladang / dge bsnyen paṇ+ḍita 'jigs sde bdun char la bram ze bde byed dga' bas kyang 'grel pa mdzad de tshad ma/'i bshad srol bskyangs/ 'di gnyis la'ang rigs gter du dpyad pa ci rigs par mdzad/ 'on kyang mngon sum gyi 'gros kyi skabs su bde byed dga' ba'i lugs zhal gyis bzhes te bsngags pa'ang mdzad/ bde byed dga' ba'i slob rma/ la paṇa chen me wadru 'phagasapa'i dngos slob ston gzhon gyi rjes su 'brangasate sa skya nor bzang gisawang gakun mkhyen gyisawang gu/ paṇa chen gyisawang pu gsungasabyung / sgra bsgrub pas ngag 480

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/dbang du 'gro zer/ de'i slob ma kha che paṇa chen yin zhing / paṇa chen de'i 'khor pa/ṇa chung gsum dang bcas pa bod du phebs pa la chos rje sa paṇa gyis rig pa'i gnas lnga char gyi chos mang po gsan/ khyad par paṇa chen nyid la phyogs glang gi kun las btus dang / chos grags kyi sde bdun dang / lha rgyan chos mchog la sogs pa'i 'grel pa rnams kyang gsan zhing thugs su chud par mdzad nas sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa'i snying po tshad ma rigs gter rtsa 'grel mdzad/ridi'i brjod bya la shes bya spyi ldog nas bstan la dbab pa dang / shes byed tshad rma/'i rang bzhin nges par bya ba gnyis las/ dang po la'ang shes bya'i yul thog mar bshad na/ shes byed kyi blo rtogs sla bar 'gyur bas yul brtag pa'i rab byed dang por bstan/ shes byed kyi blo la tshad ma dang tshad min gyi blo gnyis las/chad ma 'og tu 'byung bas/ re zhig tshad min gyi blo ston pa la blo brtag pa'i rab byed gnyis par bstan/ blo brtag par blo la yul gyi sgo nas rtog bcas dang te+o ga med gnyis su dbye ba las 'phros nas/ de gnyis kyi yul 'dzin tshul ston pa la/ rang mtshan 'dzin pa rtog med de/ /sbyi 'dzin pa ni rtog pa yin/ /zhes bshad nas spyi dngos po ba 'gog pa'i phyir spyi ma rgyas par 'chad par byed pre la spyi dang bye brag brtag pa'i rab byed gsum par bstan/ rang mtshan 'dzin pa'i blo rtog med dang / spyi mchan 'dzin pa'i blo rtog pa yin par bstan pa las riphros nas blo de gnyis yul la 'jug tshul gyi khyad par gang zhe na/ rtog med kyi blo ni rang yul la snang bas 'jug pa dang / rjod byed kyi sgra dang rtog pa thams 0 da sel bsa'ajug pa yin no zhes bshad nas/ slar sel 'jug las 'phros 481

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/dbang du 'gro zer/ de'i slob ma kha che paṇa chen yin zhing / paṇa chen de'i 'khor pa/ṇa chung gsum dang bcas pa bod du phebs pa la chos rje sa paṇa gyis rig pa'i gnas lnga char gyi chos mang po gsan/ khyad par paṇa chen nyid la phyogs glang gi kun las btus dang / chos grags kyi sde bdun dang / lha rgyan chos mchog la sogs pa'i 'grel pa rnams kyang gsan zhing thugs su chud par mdzad nas sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa'i snying po tshad ma rigs gter rtsa 'grel mdzad/ridi'i brjod bya la shes bya spyi ldog nas bstan la dbab pa dang / shes byed tshad rma/'i rang bzhin nges par bya ba gnyis las/ dang po la'ang shes bya'i yul thog mar bshad na/ shes byed kyi blo rtogs sla bar 'gyur bas yul brtag pa'i rab byed dang por bstan/ shes byed kyi blo la tshad ma dang tshad min gyi blo gnyis las/chad ma 'og tu 'byung bas/ re zhig tshad min gyi blo ston pa la blo brtag pa'i rab byed gnyis par bstan/ blo brtag par blo la yul gyi sgo nas rtog bcas dang te+o ga med gnyis su dbye ba las 'phros nas/ de gnyis kyi yul 'dzin tshul ston pa la/ rang mtshan 'dzin pa rtog med de/ /sbyi 'dzin pa ni rtog pa yin/ /zhes bshad nas spyi dngos po ba 'gog pa'i phyir spyi ma rgyas par 'chad par byed pre la spyi dang bye brag brtag pa'i rab byed gsum par bstan/ rang mtshan 'dzin pa'i blo rtog med dang / spyi mchan 'dzin pa'i blo rtog pa yin par bstan pa las riphros nas blo de gnyis yul la 'jug tshul gyi khyad par gang zhe na/ rtog med kyi blo ni rang yul la snang bas 'jug pa dang / rjod byed kyi sgra dang rtog pa thams 0 da sel babasha'ajug pa yin no zhes bshad nas/ slar sel 'jug las 'phros 481

bgechen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chos 'byung gcespobasdus/ ()nas gzhan sel gya rnam gzhag rgyas par 'chad pa la g.yin sel brtag pa'i rab byed 'di bzhi par gsungs/ g.yin sel brtag par rjod byed kyi sgra sel 'jug tu bstan pa la rjod byed kyi sgra de'i brjod bya rang mtshan nam/ spyi mchan gang yin zhe na/ de'i dngos kyi brjod bya ni sbya mtshan dang / zhen pa'i brjod bya ni rang mtshan yin no zhes brjod bya rjod byed kyi rnam gzhag ston pa la rab byed lnga pa 'di gsungs/ de ltar shes bya spyi ldog song nas/ de ma thag shes byed chad ma'i rang bzhin 'chad dam zhe na/ da dung de'i sngon du 'grel pa dang 'gal ba'i rtogs tshul bshad na legs pa yin te/ 'og tu tshad ma'i mtshan nyid gtan la phab pa'i sgo nas 'di tshad ma yin pa dang / 'di ma yin no zhes rnam par dpyod pa'i dgag sgrub thams cad 'gal 'grel la ltos pa'i phyir/ de skad du/ dgag dang sgrub pa ji snyed pa/ /'gal 'brel nyid la ltos pas na/ /tshad ma'i mchan nyid dpyod pa yi/ /sngon du 'gal 'brel dpyad par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dper na rnam 'grel le'u gnyis par/ tshad ma bslu med can shes pa/ /zhes sogs tshad ma'i mtshan nyid 'chad pa'i sngon du don tshad ma yin pa dang ma yin nga/ rnam par 'byed pa rjes dpag la ltos pas na rjes dpag gi le'u dang por bshad pa dang mtshungs so/ /de ltar na bdag nyid chen po'i dgongs pa ni tshad grub kyi le'u 'di skabs don tshad ma'i mtshan nyid ston byed yin cing / de las 'phros nas ston pa tshad ma'i skyes bu yin pa dang / de'i sgrub byed phun tshogs bzhi lugs 'byung lugs ldog gi sgo nas bshad de gang zag gcig 'chang rgya ba'i lam gyi rim pa 'bras bu don gnyis phun tshogs dang bcas pa ston bya 482

bgechen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gcespobasdus/ rtonanas g.yon sel gya rnam gzhag rgyas par 'chad pa la gzhan sel brtag pa'i rab byed 'di bzhi par gsungs/ g.yin sel brtag par rjod byed kyi sgra sel 'jug tu bstan pa la rjod byed kyi sgra de'i brjod bya rang mtshan nam/ spyi mchan gang yin zhe na/ de'i dngos kyi brjod bya ni sbya mtshan dang / zhen pa'i brjod bya ni rang mtshan yin no zhes brjod bya rjod byed kyi rnam gzhag ston pa la rab byed lnga pa 'di gsungs/ de ltar shes bya spyi ldog song nas/ de ma thag shes byed chad ma'i rang bzhin 'chad dam zhe na/ da dung de'i sngon du 'grel pa dang 'gal ba'i rtogs tshul bshad na legs pa yin te/ 'og tu tshad ma'i mtshan nyid gtan la phab pa'i sgo nas 'di tshad ma yin pa dang / 'di ma yin no zhes rnam par dpyod pa'i dgag sgrub thams cad 'gal 'grel la ltos pa'i phyir/ de skad du/ dgag dang sgrub pa ji snyed pa/ /'gal 'brel nyid la ltos pas na/ /tshad ma'i mchan nyid dpyod pa yi/ /sngon du 'gal 'brel dpyad par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dper na rnam 'grel le'u gnyis par/ tshad ma bslu med can shes pa/ /zhes sogs tshad ma'i mtshan nyid 'chad pa'i sngon du don tshad ma yin pa dang ma yin nga/ rnam par 'byed pa rjes dpag la ltos pas na rjes dpag gi le'u dang por bshad pa dang mtshungs so/ /de ltar na bdag nyid chen po'i dgongs pa ni tshad grub kyi le'u 'di skabs don tshad ma'i mtshan nyid ston byed yin cing / de las 'phros nas ston pa tshad ma'i skyes bu yin pa dang / de'i sgrub byed phun tshogs bzhi lugs 'byung lugs ldog gi sgo nas bshad de gang zag gcig 'chang rgya ba'i lam gyi rim pa 'bras bu don gnyis phun tshogs dang bcas pa ston bya 482

bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dgagi grubamatha'ishana'abyedamatha'odapyodadangabacasapa'i'obelagatam/gzhung bab nyad na gsal la/ mthar grub dan bsdu ba na bcam ldan 'das pre tshad mar gyur pa de lta bu'i sgo nas bstod pa'i dgos pa des bstan pa'am/gsung rab las tshad ma'i de nyid mngon sum dang rjes dpag gi rnam gzhag grub pa/'i don du yin par gsungasate/ de lta'i dngos don bstod pa ni/ /de yi bstan ru / nyid lasani/ /tshad ma'i de nyid grub don te/ /zhes sogs gsungs pasashesanus pa yin/ des na/ tshad ma'i de nyid grub don te/ /zhes pa dang / tshad ma grub pa/ zhes pa gnyis don gcig tu 'chad dgos pas na le'u gnyis pa'i skabs don dngos bstan gyi tshad ma ni shes pa tshad ma rang yin pas/ le'u gnyis pa 'di ma/do'i mchod brjod rang gi 'grel par byas nas 'chad par mi snang / de ltar na chad ma grub pa'i sabacad la/ skabs don tshad ma'i mtshan nyid bshad/ /'phros don tshad mar gyur sogs bshad/ /tshad mas bstod pa'i dgos don grub/ /ces kugad kyang 'gal ba med cing chos grags dang bdag nyid chen po'i dgongs ri/ra gnas so/ /'o na sa skya pa rnams lha'i 'grel pa la tshad mar byed do zhes ri/'i ngag rgyun zhig 'dug pa ci snyam na/ g.yag rong gis mdzad pa'i rnam 'grel gyi ṭīk+ka rnams lha'i 'grel pa dang mthun par byung bas de yin shas che/ sa paṇa ni sngon gyi mkhas pa klu mesakyisalha rgyan gnyis kyi 'grel pa la brten nas rnam 'grel kyi ṭīk+ka brtsams/hrong ston gzhan rnamasaphal cher lha shāka rgyan mchog gi 'grel pa'i legs bsdus nas 'chad rtsom byed chad ma mdo dang / chos gragasakyi sde bdun/ le'u dang po'i rang 'grel rnam ngesakyi rang 'grel rnams brjod bya gzhung gong 'og sna tshogs su sil bur yod pa rnam/sa rigs mthun phyogs gcig tu bsdebs nas tshad ma rigs pa'i gter 483

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/gzhung bab nyad na gsal la/ mthar grub don bsdu ba na bcom ldan 'das pre tshad mar gyur pa de lta bu'i sgo nas bstod pa'i dgos pa des bstan pa'am/gsung rab las tshad ma'i de nyid mngon sum dang rjes dpag gi rnam gzhag grub pa/'i don du yin par gsungs te/ de lta'i dngos don bstod pa ni/ /de yi bstan ru / nyid las ni/ /tshad ma'i de nyid grub don te/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas shesanas pa yin/ des na/ tshad ma'i de nyid grub don te/ /zhes pa dang / tshad ma grub skre/ zhes pa gnyis don gcig tu 'chad dgos pas na le'u gnyis pa'i skabs don dngos bstan gyi tshad ma ni shes pa tshad ma rang yin pas/ le'u gnyis pa 'di ma/do'i mchod brjod rang gi 'grel par byas nas 'chad par mi snang / de ltar na chad ma grub pa'i sa bcad la/ skabs don tshad ma'i mtshan nyid bshad/ /'phros don tshad mar gyur sogs bshad/ /tshad mas bstod pa'i dgos don grub/ /ces kug da kyang 'gal ba med cing chos grags dang bdag nyid chen po'i dgongs ri/ra gnas so/ /'o na sa skya pa rnams lha'i 'grel pa la tshad mar byed do zhes ri/'i ngag rgyun zhig 'dug pa ci snyam na/ g.yag rong gis mdzad pa'i rnam 'grel gyi ṭik+ka rnams lha'i 'grel pa dang mthun par byung bas de yin shas che/ sa paṇa ni snan gyi mkhas pa klu mes kyis lha rgyan gnyis kyi 'grel pa la brten nas rnam 'grel kyi ṭīk+ka brtsams/drang ston gzhan rnams phal cher lha shāka rgyan mchog gi 'grel pa'i legs bsdus nas 'chad rtsom byed chad ma mdo dang / chos grags kyi sde bdun/ le'u dang po'i rang 'grel rnam ngesakyi rang 'grel rnams brjod bya gzhung gong 'og sna tshogs su sil bur yod pa rnam/sa rigs mthun phyogs gcig tu bsdebs nas tshad ma rigs pa'i gter 483

'tshechen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gcesabasdus/ ()rab byed bcu gcig rang 'grel dang bcas pa'i sgo nas 'chad pa 'di gangs ri'i khrod 'dir 'chad tshul rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa yin/ rang 'grel du lung 'dren pa na'ang / mdo rnam 'grel rnam ngesale'u dang po'i rang 'grel sogs rig pa'i dbang phyug gnyis kyi gzhud drangs pa ma gtogs/ ྅/ rgyan chos mchog sogs kyi 'grel pa'i tshig khungs thub tu byas nas drangs pa ye med/ lha rgyan sogs la ltos dgos pa'i sa paṇa de min/ sa paṇa gyi blo gros nyi ma'i 'od kyi snang bas ma khyab pa de srid du chos grags kyi dgongs don ge sar snying po gsal mi nus pa de tshig zin la bod 'dir gsungs kyang / 'dir ma zad 'phags yul du'ang de ltar yin pa gor ma chag don gyi gnad de dag thugs la bzhag nas kun mkhyen chen pos/ rig pa'i gtsug rgyan gnyis kyi gzhud lugs las/ /sde bdun gong 'og bsdebs nas 'chad pa dang / /rgya 'grel legs cha btus nas 'chad pa dang / /rang rgyal tshab dang rin pa dang dge legs dpal ba la sogs pa gi rnam rtog nyid kyis 'chad pa ste/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir 'chad tshul rnam gsum las/ /skye ba du mar rig lam gomasabyas nas/ /skyon med brgyud pa'i man ngag dang ldan zhing / /'jam dbyangs thugs kyi mkhyen pa/ mnga' ba yi/ /sa skya pa ni 'chad tshul dang por bzhed/ /ces gsungs yod 'dug pa de legs pa'i tshad thub pa rang yin pa 'dra/ tshad ma'i mtshan nyid dpyod pa yis/ /zhes pa las 'phros nas/ tshad ma'i mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ de ston pa la rab byed brgyad pa mtshan nyid brtag pa 'di gsungs/ mtshan nyid de ldan gyi tshad ma la dbye na du zhe na/ de la mngon rjes gnyis las/ mngon sum/ 484
