bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/ston pa la rab byed dgu pa dang / rjes dpag la dngos btags gnyis las/rjes dpag dngos rang don rjes dpag 'chad pa la rab byed bcu pa dang / rjes dpag btags pa ba gzhan don rjes dpag 'chad pa la rab byed bcu gcig pa gsungs/ sa paṇa gyi dngos slob 'u yug pa rigs pa'i seng ges tshad ma'i bstan bcos rigs mdzod chen mo dang / lho pa kun mkhyen rin chen dpal gyis kyang yig cha ci rigs par mdzad/ 'u yug pa dang mdo sde dpal gyis sa skyar 'chad nyan yun ring bskyangs pa'i grub 'bras brgyud 'dzin grags che ba la 'jam dbyangs skya bo/ dpang lo chen po/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ nya dbon kun dga' dpal rnams thog mtshungs dang rim can ci rigs par byung / nya dbon pas rnam 'grel gyi ṭīk+ka brtsams/ tshad ma nya la thug zer/ nya'i slob ma kun mkhyen g.yag mi pham chos kyi bla mas rnam 'grel gyi ṭīk+ka yid gyi mun sel bya ba dang /rigs gter gyi ṭīk+ka rigs pa'i 'od stong 'phro ba brtsams/ gzhung don go bde snyel tshig tshogs ha cang che ba min pa bstan bcos dngos gtsang zhig snang / 'on kyang tshad ma'i mtshan nyid 'chad pa na rang gi 'jug yul la gsar du mi slu ba'i rig pa zhes gsungs pas/ dpyad shes mi bslu ba yin par bzhed/ sa skya nor bzang gis kyang gsar du bsnan/ chos rje sa paṇa gyis gsar du bsnon mi dgos par gsungs te/ mtshan nyid brtag pa'i rang 'grel las/ bden pa'i don rtogs chos sum ldan gyi yang / yul gyi khyad par sngar ma rtogs pa la rnam bcad med pas mi dgos te zhes gsungs yod 'dug g.yag pa dang thog mtshungs rje re mda' ba chen pos/ rnam 'grel gyi ṭīk+ka rigs pa'i 'dod 'jo bya 485

bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/ston pa la rab byed dgu pa dang / rjes dpag la dngos btags gnyis las/rjes dpag dngos rang don rjes dpag 'chad pa la rab byed bcu pa dang / rjes dpag btags pa ba gzhan don rjes dpag 'chad pa la rab byed bcu gcig pa gsungs/ sa paṇa gyi dngos slob 'u yug pa rigs pa'i seng ges tshad ma'i bstan bcos rigs mdzod chen mo dang / lho pa kun mkhyen rin chen dpal gyis kyang yig cha ci rigs par mdzad/ 'u yug pa dang mdo sde dpal gyis sa skyar 'chad nyan yun ring bskyangs pa'i grub 'bras brgyud 'dzin grags che ba la 'jam dbyangs skya bo/ dpang lo chen po/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ nya dbon kun dga' dpal rnams thog mtshungs dang rim can ci rigs par byung / nya dbon pas rnam 'grel gyi ṭīk+ka brtsams/ tshad ma nya la thug zer/ nya'i slob ma kun mkhyen g.yag mi pham chos kyi bla mas rnam 'grel gyi ṭīk+ka yid gyi mun sel bya ba dang /rigs gter gyi ṭīk+ka rigs pa'i 'od stong 'phro ba brtsams/ gzhung don go bde snyel tshig tshogs ha cang che ba min pa bstan bcos dngos gtsang zhig snang / 'on kyang tshad ma'i mtshan nyid 'chad pa na rang gi 'jug yul la gsar du mi slu ba'i rig pa zhes gsungs pas/ dpyad shes mi bslu ba yin par bzhed/ sa skya nor bzang gis kyang gsar du bsnan/ chos rje sa paṇa gyis gsar du bsnon mi dgos par gsungs te/ mtshan nyid brtag pa'i rang 'grel las/ bden pa'i don rtogs chos sum ldan gyi yang / yul gyi khyad par sngar ma rtogs pa la rnam bcad med pas mi dgos te zhes gsungs yod 'dug g.yag pa dang thog mtshungs rje re mda' ba chen pos/ rnam 'grel gyi ṭīk+ka rigs pa'i 'dod 'jo bya 485

ba 'a 'odasnang las/ saskya'i mosa'agrang gcesabasdus/ ()ba pu ga brtsams/ rgyan mkhan po'i rjes su 'brangs te khong rang ṭīk+ka'i mjug na/ chos kyi gragasapa chos min 'pham byed dpal ldan phan yon can de'i gzhung / /tshul bzhin rnam 'byed shes rab 'byung gnas rnam 'grel rgyan gyi ma/ dros las/ /legs par 'ongs pa'i legasabashad chu gtsang yan lag brgyad ldan gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /gang gis legs phab blo gros 'di ni skal ldan shing rta'i gdung 'tshob yin/ /zhesasogasabashad/ rnam 'grel gyi mchod brjod la bshad pa mdzad pa na/ zab cing zhesapa ji lta ba mkhyen pa dang / rgya che'i sku mnga' zhes pa ji snyed pa mkhyen pa la sbyor bsasku gsum la sbyar ba'i bshad pa mi mdzad/phyogs chos de chas khyab pa ni/ /zhes dgar tshig sbyar nas 'bru mnan pas tshul/ gsum rtags yang dag gi mtshan nyid du bzhed rgyu yin pa 'dra/ le'u gnyis par/tshad ma bslu med can shesapa/ /zhesapa don dam pa'i tshad ma dang / ma shes don gyi gsal byed kyang / /zhes pa tha snyad pa'i tshad ma'i ma nyid ston byed du 'chad pa sogs sa lugs dang mi mthun pa 'ga' snang / re mda' ba'i slob ma'i gtso bo rje tsong kha pas rnam 'grel gyi ṭīk+ka thar lam gsal byed bya ba brtsams/khong gi bzhed pas rnam 'grel 'dir mu stegs kyi lta ba ngan pa mtha' dag sun phyung nas bden bzhi'i rnam gzhag ma 'khrul pa ston pa'i sgo nas thar pa'i lam/ yongasasu rdzogs par ston pas na nang don rig pa'i bstan bcos rang yin gsung gin yod 'dug de la gzu bo'i blos dpyad na rnam 'grel le'u gnyis par kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam byang rgyu 'brasasu bstan zhing / phun tshogs bzhi'i sgo nas 'tshang rgya ba'i lam rim rdzogs par bstan pa dang / mngon 486

ba chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chosang gces bsdus/ ()ba pu ga brtsams/ rgyan mkhan po'i rjes su 'brangs te khong rang ṭī ka'i mjug na/ chos kyi grags pa chos min 'pham byed dpal ldan phan yon can de'i gzhung / /tshul bzhin rnam 'byed shes rab 'byung gnas rnam 'grel rgyan gyi ma/ dros las/ /legs par 'ongs pa'i legs bshad chu gtsang yan lag brgyad ldan gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /gang gis legs phab blo gros 'di ni skal ldan shing rta'i gdung 'tshob yin/ /zhes sogs bshad/ rnam 'grel gyi mchod brjod la bshad pa mdzad pa na/ zab cing zhes pa ji lta ba mkhyen pa dang / rgya che'i sku mnga' zhes pa ji snyed pa mkhyen pa la sbyor bas sku gsum la sbyar ba'i bshad pa mi mdzad/phyogs chos de chas khyab pa ni/ /zhes dgar tshig sbyar nas 'bru mnan pas tshul/ gsum rtags yang dag gi mtshan nyid du bzhed rgyu yin pa 'dra/ le'u gnyis par/tshad ma bslu med can shes pa/ /zhes pa don dam pa'i tshad ma dang / ma shes don gyi gsal byed kyang / /zhes pa tha snyad pa'i tshad ma'i mtshan nyid ston byed du 'chad pa sogs sa lugs dang mi mthun pa 'ga' snang / re mda' ba'i slob ma'i gtso bo rje tsong kha pas rnam 'grel gyi ṭīk+ka thar lam gsal byed bya ba brtsams/khong gi bzhed pas rnam 'grel 'dir mu stegs kyi lta ba ngan pa mtha' dag sun phyung nas bden bzhi'i rnam gzhag ma 'khrul pa ston pa'i sgo nas thar pa'i lam/ yongs su rdzogs par ston pas na nang don rig pa'i bstan bcos rang yin gsung gin yod 'dug de la gzu bo'i blos dpyad na rnam 'grel le'u gnyis par kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam byang rgyu 'bras su bstan zhing / phun tshogs bzhi'i sgo nas 'tshang rgya ba'i lam rim rdzogs par bstan pa dang / mngon 486

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha ri dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/sum le'u'i rnal 'byor mngon sum gyi skabs kyang tshad ma grub pa' le'u dang brjod don gcig pas rnam 'grel 'di nang don rig pa tshang ba'i bstan bcos yin zhes bya la/ bstan bcos rang gi ngo bo ni phyi rig par 'jog ste/ rig pa'i gnas lnga'i nang nas tshad ma rig pa'i bstan bcos yin pa'i phyir snyam du sems/ de bzhin du tshad ma rigs gter kyang rnal 'byor mngon sum gyi skabs rnam sa nang don rig pa'i chos su 'dug pas nang don rig pa tshang ba'i bstan bcos yin la/ bstan bcos spyi ldog ni rnam 'grel dang mtshungs/ tsong kha pa'i je sa skyong rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen dang / dge legs dpal ba la sogs pas kyang mdo dang rnam 'grel rnam nges sogs la ṭīk+ka ci rigs par mdzad/ dge re gas dpal ba'i de 'phral la 'bru rno zhing gsal drag pa la sogs pa su dang nga /nga mi mthun pa'i rtog bzo mang po yod zer/ dar ma bas sngon gsang phur kun mkhyen rong ston dang rtsod pas khong rtsod pa pham pa la brten phyis rong ston la rigan bdo bas/ rong ston gyis gzhung lugs bzhi bcu zhe grangs la ṭīk+ka mdzad ri/sa/ de las lhag par 'dod nas khong gis kyang gzhung drug cu skor la ṭīk+ka mjad/ dpang lo chen po dang / mosarje bla ma'i dngos slob lo chen byang rtse/ de'i snyeb ma lo chen grags pa 'dis gzhud chen du ma la ṭīk+ka mdzad par grags/ lo grags kyi slob ma la bo dong paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal byung / 'dis sangs gya sa kyi mchan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu dang grangs mthun pa'i pusti brgya dang bcu gnyis brtsams te de nyid 'dus chen du grags/ chos rje sa paṇa bod 'dir mkhas par byung bas de la dgag sgrub byas 487

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha ri dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/sum le'u'i rnal 'byor mngon sum gyi skabs kyang tshad ma grub pa' le'u dang brjod don gcig pas rnam 'grel 'di nang don rig pa tshang ba'i bstan bcos yin zhes bya la/ bstan bcos rang gi ngo bo ni phyi rig par 'jog ste/ rig pa'i gnas lnga'i nang nas tshad ma rig pa'i bstan bcos yin pa'i phyir snyam du sems/ de bzhin du tshad ma rigs gter kyang rnal 'byor mngon sum gyi skabs rnam sa nang don rig pa'i chos su 'dug pas nang don rig pa tshang ba'i bstan bcos yin la/ bstan bcos spyi ldog ni rnam 'grel dang mtshungs/ tsong kha pa'i je sa skyong rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen dang / dge legs dpal ba la sogs pas kyang mdo dang rnam 'grel rnam nges sogs la ṭīk+ka ci rigs par mdzad/ dge re gas dpal ba'i de 'phral la 'bru rno zhing gsal drag pa la sogs pa su dang nga /nga mi mthun pa'i rtog bzo mang po yod zer/ dar ma bas sngon gsang phur kun mkhyen rong ston dang rtsod pas khong rtsod pa pham pa la brten phyis rong ston la rigan bdo bas/ rong ston gyis gzhung lugs bzhi bcu zhe grangs la ṭīk+ka mdzad ri/sa/ de las lhag par 'dod nas khong gis kyang gzhud drug cu skor la ṭīk+ka mjad/ dpang lo chen po dang / mosarje bla ma'i dngos slob lo chen byang rtse/ de'i snyeb ma lo chen grags pa 'dis gzhung chen du ma la ṭīk+ka mdzad par grags/ lo grags kyi slob ma la bo dong paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal byung / 'dis sangs gya sa kyi mchan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu dang grangs mthun pa'i pusti brgya dang bcu gnyis brtsams te de nyid 'dus chen du grags/ chos rje sa paṇa bod 'dir mkhas par byung bas de la dgag sgrub byas 487

ba tshe chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chosang gces bsdus/ rtonan rang yang dpe med du 'gro bar re nas/ khong sa rigs snang bya ba'i bstan bcos las phyi rabs kyi rtog ge pa dag ni tshad ma'i bstan bcos kyi go rim/ tsam la'ang mkhas pa min na/ gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos zhes sogs bris/don ni rigs gter gyi dbur yul brtag pa sogs gsungs pa la/ de la ge rim rang nas ma byung ste/ go rim gyi dbang du byas na brjod bya'i gtso bo tshad ma'i mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba mngon sum la sogs pa nas 'chad rigs gsung ba snang / 'o na chos grags kyang bstan bcos rtsom pa'i go rim la mi mkhas par gyur te/ rnam 'grel gyi dbu na tshad ma'i mtshan nyid dang / de'i dbye ba mngon sum mi gsung bar rang don rjes dpag gi le'u gsungs pa'i phyir/ de la khong gi bzhed pas rjes dpag gi skabs le'u dang por bshad pa ni glegs ba'i / gnas pa'i go rim yin la/ bstan bcos brtsam pa'i go rim ni tshad grub kyi le'u thog mar brtsam/ de nas mdzan sum/ de nas rang don/ de nas gzhan don le'u yin no zhes gsung ba snang / de ni chos grags dang 'gal te/ rang don le'ur/ blang dang dor bya'i de nyid ni/ /thabs bcas rab tu nges pa yis/ /zhes/ sogs kyi rang 'grel du/ blang bar bya ba dang / dor bar bya ba dang / de'i thabs dngos bstan pa dag la phyi ci log med pa ni mi bsku ba yin te/ dper na 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po 'chad par 'gyur ba'i tshul lta bu'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i 'chad 'gyur tshad ma grub par byed dam mi byed/ byed na tshad grub dang por brtsams zer ba dang dngos su 'gal/ mi byed na gzhan don le'ur na bden bzhi'i rnam gzhag med/ mngon sum le'ur yang ni bden bzhi'i rnam/ 488

ba chen 'od snangal / saskya'i chosa'abyung gcespobasdus/ ()na rang yang dpe med du 'gro bar re nas/ khong sa rigs snang bya ba'i bstan bcos las phyi rabs kyi rtog ge pa dag ni tshad ma'i bstan bcos kyi go rim/ tsam la'ang mkhas pa min na/ gathen lta smos kyang ci dgos zhes sogs bris/don ni rigs gter gyi dbur yul brtag pa sogs gsungs pa la/ de la ge rim rang nas ma byung ste/ go rim gyi dbang du byas na brjod bya'i gtso bo tshad ma'i mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba mngon sum la sogs pa nas 'chad rigs gsung ba snang / 'o na chos grags kyang bstan bcos rtsom pa'i go rim la mi mkhas par gyur te/ rnam 'grel gyi dbu na tshad ma'i mtshan nyid dang / de'i dbye ba mngon sum mi gsung bar rang don rjes dpag gi le'u gsungs pa'i phyir/ de la khong gi bzhed pas rjes dpag gi skabs le'u dang por bshad pa ni glegs ba'i / gnas pa'i go rim yin la/ bstan bcos brtsam pa'i go rim ni tshad grub kyi le'u thog mar brtsam/ de nas mngon sum/ de nas rang don/ de nas g.yin don le'u yin no zhes gsung ba snang / de ni chos grags dang 'gal te/ rang don le'ur/ blang dang dor bya'i de nyid ni/ /thabs bcas rab tu nges pa yis/ /zhes/ sogs kyi rang 'grel du/ blang bar bya ba dang / dor bar bya ba dang / de'i thabs dngos bstan pa dag la phyi ci log med pa ni mi bslu ba yin te/ dper na 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po 'chad par 'gyur ba'i tshul lta bu'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i 'chad 'gyur tshad ma grub par byed dam mi byed/ byed na tshad grub dang por brtsams zer ba dang dngos su 'gal/ mi byed na g.yin don le'ur t+na bden bzhi'i rnam gzhag med/ mngon sum le'ur yang ni bden bzhi'i rnam/ 488

bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/gzhag med nga / khyed ltar na mngon sum le'u'i 'og tu rang don le'u brtsams pas/ 'chad 'gyur de gzhan don le'u nyid las 'os ma byung bas/ gzhan don du bden bzhi'i skabs 'tshol bar rigs so/ /spyi bab bstan bcos gang dang gang gi brjod bya'i gtso bo de de'i dbu nyid na 'byung ba'i nges pa med de/ mdo sde rgyan gyi brjod bya sems bskyed dang / phar phyin drug gi skabs rnams su gco che bar 'dug na'ang / rgyan gyi dbu nas mar theg chen bka' sgrub dang / rigs dang skyabs 'gro'i rnam gzhag 'dug pa sogs mtha' yas par dgongs 'tshal lo / / bo dong paṇa chen gyi lugs la chos de'i rnam par 'jog byed kyi mtshan nyid la khyab pa sgo bzhi'i khas mi len pa sogs sdo/ba mtha' ha las pa mang po yod pa 'dra/ bo dong pa dang sa paṇa gyi bar na khyad par chen po yod de/ bsil zer rab tu 'phro ba'i zla dbang khyod/ /rang gi 'od dkar snang ba ci yang gsal/ /'od zer brgya pa'i drung du nye ba na/ /'od dkar lta ci gzugs kyang rnge mi thogs/ /zhes bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad do/ /yang g.yag pa'i slob ma rong ston gyis chad ma rnam 'grel sogs gzhung bzhi bcu zhe gsum la ṭīk+ka mdzad/ rong ston gyi slob ma rje don yod dpal ba'i rjes skyong paṇa chen rin po che shākya mchog ldan gyi rnam 'grel gyi ṭīk+ka kun bzang rol mtsho dang / rigs gter gyi ṭīk+ka sde bdun ngag gi rol mtsho mdzad/ rnam 'grel ṭīk+ka de kun mkhyen g.yag pa dang mthun zer/ le'u dang po'i rgyu la rang bzhin ji snyed cig ces pa'i ji snyed kyi don rme/'i rdul rdzas rnams la 'chad/ rigs gter rab byed drug par/ rdo dang shing sogs me rgyu yin/ /me rgyu me yi rdul phran yin/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun 489

bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/gzhag med nga / khyed ltar na mngon sum le'u'i 'og tu rang don le'u brtsams pas/ 'chad 'gyur de gzhan don le'u nyid las 'os ma byung bas/ gzhan don du bden bzhi'i skabs 'tshol bar rigs so/ /spyi bab bstan bcos gang dang gang gi brjod bya'i gtso bo de de'i dbu nyid na 'byung ba'i nges pa med de/ mdo sde rgyan gyi brjod bya sems bskyed dang / phar phyin drug gi skabs rnams su gco che bar 'dug na'ang / rgyan gyi dbu nas mar theg chen bka' sgrub dang / rigs dang skyabs 'gro'i rnam gzhag 'dug pa sogs mtha' yas par dgongs 'tshal lo / / bo dong paṇa chen gyi lugs la chos de'i rnam par 'jog byed kyi mtshan nyid la khyab pa sgo bzhi'i khas mi len pa sogs sdo/ba mtha' ha las pa mang po yod pa 'dra/ bo dong pa dang sa paṇa gyi bar na khyad par chen po yod de/ bsil zer rab tu 'phro ba'i zla dbang khyod/ /rang gi 'od dkar snang ba ci yang gsal/ /'od zer brgya pa'i drung du nye ba na/ /'od dkar lta ci gzugs kyang rnge mi thogs/ /zhes bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad do/ /yang g.yag pa'i slob ma rong ston gyis chad ma rnam 'grel sogs gzhung bzhi bcu zhe gsum la ṭīk+ka mdzad/ rong ston gyi slob ma rje don yod dpal ba'i rjes skyong paṇa chen rin po che shākya mchog ldan gyi rnam 'grel gyi ṭīk+ka kun bzang rol mtsho dang / rigs gter gyi ṭīk+ka sde bdun ngag gi rol mtsho mdzad/ rnam 'grel ṭīk+ka de kun mkhyen g.yag pa dang mthun zer/ le'u dang po'i rgyu la rang bzhin ji snyed cig ces pa'i ji snyed kyi don rme/'i rdul rdzas rnams la 'chad/ rigs gter rab byed drug par/ rdo dang shing sogs me rgyu yin/ /me rgyu me yi rdul phran yin/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun 489

ba chen 'od snangalas/ saskya'i chosa'abyung gcegabasdus/ ()par 'dug zer ba byung kyang / de dang mthun te/ rgyu la rang ba snyed na/ /'bras bu'i gtan tshigasadu ba'i rgyu/ /ji snyed cig cesapa'i don yin la/ me rgyu me'i rdul phran ni me'i nyer len gyi rgyu me'i rdul phran snga ma zhig yin par bstan to / / le'u gnyis par rnam pa du mar thabasamang po/ /yun ring dusasu goms pa las/ /zhes pa'i thabs de paṇa chen gyis thabs dang shes rab gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i thabs rgya chen po la ngos 'dzin mdzad/ 'di sdom gsum rab dbyer/ 'tshang rgya ba la shes rab rkyang pas mi chog thabs rgya chen po'ang goms dgos pa'i shes byed du/ rnam 'grel las/ rnam pa du mar thabasamang po/ /zhesasogs gsungs pa 'dren par mdzad pa dang / rigs gter du'ang / thabasal goms pas dngos kun gsal/ /bag chags spangs phyir kun mkhyen yin/ /zhes gsungs pa dang dgongs pa mthun par snang / rigs gter du/ blun po la ni nyung rgyas sbyar/ /zhes pa'i don ngag nyung ngu ni gang byas na zhes sogs yan lag gnyis ldan gyi sgrub ngag yongs grags 'di yin/ ngag rgyas pa ni byasartags lta bu la mtshon na/ de'i tshul gsum sgrub byed kyi rigs pa rnams yin gsungs/gzhung bcos pa'ang mang du mdzad de/ gsum pa de yi skyes bu yi/ /bsdu ba yin phyir 'gal ba med/ /la/ gsum pasade yi skyes bu yi/ /bsdu bar 'chad phyir 'gal ba med/ /ces dang / 'dod pa brjod nas mi 'dod sgrub/ /la/ 'dod pa brjod nas mi 'dod 'phen/ /zhes dang / lhag ma yang dag gtan tshigs kun/ /la / lhag ma yang dag thal 'gyur kun/ /byasan legasagasung ba sogs gzhung kha yar la 'don pa bsgyur 'dug yang kun mkhyen rong ston la gtso bor brten 490

ba cha chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chosang gces bsdus/ ()par 'dug zer ba byung kyang / de dang mthun te/ rgyu la rang ba snyed na/ /'bras bu'i gtan tshigs du ba'i rgyu/ /ji snyed cig ces pa'i don yin la/ me rgyu me'i rdul phran ni me'i nyer len gyi rgyu me'i rdul phran snga ma zhig yin par bstan to / / le'u gnyis par rnam pa du mar thabs mang po/ /yun ring dus su goms pa las/ /zhes pa'i thabs de paṇa chen gyis thabs dang shes rab gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i thabs rgya chen po la ngos 'dzin mdzad/ 'di sdom gsum rab dbyer/ 'tshang rgya ba la shes rab rkyang pas mi chog thabs rgya chen po'ang goms dgos pa'i shes byed du/ rnam 'grel las/ rnam pa du mar thabs mang po/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa 'dren par mdzad pa dang / rigs gter du'ang / thabs la goms pas dngos kun gsal/ /bag chags spangs phyir kun mkhyen yin/ /zhes gsungs pa dang dgongs pa mthun par snang / rigs gter du/ blun po la ni nyung rgyas sbyar/ /zhes pa'i don ngag nyung ngu ni gang byas na zhes sogs yan lag gnyis ldan gyi sgrub ngag yongs grags 'di yin/ ngag rgyas pa ni byas rtags lta bu la mtshon na/ de'i tshul gsum sgrub byed kyi rigs pa rnams yin gsungs/gzhung bcos pa'ang mang du mdzad de/ gsum pa de yi skyes bu yi/ /bsdu ba yin phyir 'gal ba med/ /la/ gsum pas de yi skyes bu yi/ /bsdu bar 'chad phyir 'gal ba med/ /ces dang / 'dod pa brjod nas mi 'dod sgrub/ /la/ 'dod pa brjod nas mi 'dod 'phen/ /zhes dang / lhag ma yang dag gtan tshigs kun/ /la / lhag ma yang dag thal 'gyur kun/ /byas na legs gsung ba sogs gzhung kha yar la 'don pa bsgyur 'dug yang kun mkhyen rong ston la gtso bor brten 490

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/pa mkhyen rab dbang phyug grags bzang sa rnam 'grel sogs la ṭīk+ka mdzad/gzhi grub na rtags yang dag yin pas khyab/ gzhi grub na gzhan sel yin pabasha/khyab pa sogs kyi khyab chen bzhir grags pa byung / rong ston dang mkhyen rab dbang phyug gnyis ka la brten pa phyi rabs bstan pa'i mes po kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel bas yig cha rang cher ma mdzad kyang / 'chad nyan gyi sgo nasas skya pa'i bstan 'dzin mang po bskrun/ kun gyi gtso bo kun mkhyen mkhas pa'i dbang po bsod nams seng ges rnam 'grel gyi ṭīk+ka che ba kun bzang 'od zer/chung ba sbyor ṭīka rigs gter gyi dgongs pa thun mong ma yin pa 'grel pa'i spyi don che ba sde bdun rab gsal/ chung ba rigs gter gsal byed rnamasabartsams/ gzhan dag tshul gsum rtags yang dag gi mtshan nyid du bzhed pa la/kun mkhyen gyis tshulu gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshigs rtags yang dag gi mtshan nyid du bzhed/ rigs gter las/ dgag bya 'gog la tshul gsum tshang / /zhes dang / yin pa sgrub la tshul gsum tshang / /zhes dang / yod pa sgrub la tshul gsum tshang / /zhes pa dang shin tu mthun/ gzhan paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa sogs sgrub ngag yan lag gnyis ldan tsam las yan lag gcig ldan gyi ngag mi 'dod pa la lugs 'dir tshul gsum gang rung shes zin dran lam na yod pa khar snyan pa'i phyir rgol mkhas pa'i ngor phyogs chos rkyang pa tshig zin la brjod pa dang / khyad pa rkyang pa tshig zin la brjod pa'i yan lag gcig ldan gyi sgrub ngag yang dag bzhed/ tshul gsum gang rung shes zin dran lam na yod kyang khar mi 2byen pa'i rgol ba mkhas pa la khar mi 'byin pa'i klan ka de spang ba'i ched du 491

bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dgagi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/pa mkhyen rab dbang phyug grags bzang sa rnam 'grel sogs la ṭīk+ka mdzad/gzhi grub na rtags yang dag yin pas khyab/ gzhi grub na gzhan sel yin pabasha/khyab pa sogs kyi khyab chen bzhir grags pa byung / rong ston dang mkhyen rab dbang phyug gnyis ka la brten pa phyi rabs bstan pa'i mes po kun mkhyen sangasargyas 'phel bsayig cha rang cher ma mdzad kyang / 'chad nyan gyi sgo nasas skya pa'i bstan 'dzin mang po bskrun/ kun gyi gtso bo kun mkhyen mkhas pa'i dbang po bsod nams seng ges rnam 'grel gyi ṭīk+ka che ba kun bzang 'od zer/chung ba sbyor ṭīka rigs gter gyi dgongs pa thun mong ma yin pa 'grel pa'i spyi don che ba sde bdun rab gsal/ chung ba rigs gter gsal byed rnamasabartsams/ gzhan dag tshul gsum rtags yang dag gi mtshan nyid du bzhed pa la/kun mkhyen gyisatshul gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshigs rtags yang dag gi mtshan nyid du bzhed/ rigs gter las/ dgag bya 'gog la tshul gsum tshang / /zhes dang / yin pa sgrub la tshul gsum tshang / /zhes dang / yod pa sgrub la tshul gsum tshang / /zhes pa dang shin tu mthun/ g.yin paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa sogs sgrub ngag yan lag gnyis ldan tsam las yan lag gcig ldan gyi ngag mi 'dod pa la lugs 'dir tshul gsum gang rung shes zin dran lam na yod pa khar nabyen pa'i phyir rgol mkhas pa'i ngor phyogs chos rkyang pa tshig zin la brjod pa dang / khyad pa rkyang pa tshig zin la brjod pa'i yan lag gcig ldan gyi sgrub ngag yang dag bzhed/ tshul gsum gang rung shes zin dran lam na yod kyang khar mi 2byen pa'i rgol ba mkhas pa la khar mi 'byin pa'i klan ka de spang ba'i ched du 491

brtse ho 'od snangalas/ saskya'i chos nga gces bsdus/ ()rgol ba mkhas pa' ngor bkod pa' klan ka spong byed kyi sgrub ngag yan lag gnyis ldan yang bzhed de/ rang 'grel las/ gtan tshigs brjod pas khyab pa dran nus par shes pa de la gtan tshig tsam gyis 'grub ste zhes pa nas/ mkhas su zin kyang skabs der sgrub pa'i ngag rdzogs par sbyar dgos ste zhes sogs kyi dgongs pa dpyis phyin yin/ de la sogs pa mdo sngags kyi grub mtha' gang 'chad kyang / dpal ldan sa skya pa'i rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab rin po che rnams gces spras dang / grub pa'i mtha' kun la'ang rang bzo'i bsre slad kyi dri ma dang bral bar bskyangs pas kun mkhyen nyid kyi phrin las kyi rgyun mkha' khyab tu dar ba'i rten 'brel bzang po de nas 'grigs pa yin/ rigs gter rab byed bzhi pa'i thad kyi sde bdun rab gsal las/ bum pa dang snam bu la sogs pa rdzas su ma grub ste zhes sogs sgrub byed dang bcas pa gsungs yod 'dug pa/bum pa la sogs pa rang mtshan yin pas rdzas su ni los grub/ 'di'i don ji ltar yin zhe na/ bum pa la sogs pa rang gi gdags gzhi rdul rdzas brgyad la brten nas btags pa'i bta gas yod kyi dngos po yin pa'i phyir na/ rang gi gdags gzhi la ltos te rdzas yod min pas rdzas su ma grub ces gsungs par shes par bya ste/ sgrub byed bkod pa'i skabs kyi tshigs rnams dang snga phyi 'brel bsgrigs pas shes nus/ spyi ni rdzas yod btags yod mi 'gal te/ rdul phran phyogs kyi cha med ma gtogs bem po thams cad dang / shes pa skad cig cha med ma gtogs cha shas can gyi shes pa thams cad rdzas yod dang btags yod kyi dngos po gnyis ka yin pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang rang gi gdags gzhi la ltos te 492

brtse ho 'od snangalas/ saskya'i chos nga gces bsdus/ ()rgol ba mkhas pa' ngor bkod pa' klan ka spong byed kyi sgrub ngag yan lag gnyis ldan yang bzhed de/ rang 'grel las/ gtan tshigs brjod pas khyab pa dran nus par shes pa de la gtan tshig tsam gyis 'grub ste zhes pa nas/ mkhas su zin kyang skabs der sgrub pa'i ngag rdzogs par sbyar dgos ste zhes sogs kyi dgongs pa dpyis phyin yin/ de la sogs pa mdo sngags kyi grub mtha' gang 'chad kyang / dpal ldan sa skya pa'i rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab rin po che rnams gces spras dang / grub pa'i mtha' kun la'ang rang bzo'i bsre slad kyi dri ma dang bral bar bskyangs pas kun mkhyen nyid kyi phrin las kyi rgyun mkha' khyab tu dar ba'i rten 'brel bzang po de nas 'grigs pa yin/ rigs gter rab byed bzhi pa'i thad kyi sde bdun rab gsal las/ bum pa dang snam bu la sogs pa rdzas su ma grub ste zhes sogs sgrub byed dang bcas pa gsungs yod 'dug pa/bum pa la sogs pa rang mtshan yin pas rdzas su ni los grub/ 'di'i don ji ltar yin zhe na/ bum pa la sogs pa rang gi gdags gzhi rdul rdzas brgyad la brten nas btags pa'i bta gas yod kyi dngos po yin pa'i phyir na/ rang gi gdags gzhi la ltos te rdzas yod min pas rdzas su ma grub ces gsungs par shes par bya ste/ sgrub byed bkod pa'i skabs kyi tshigs rnams dang snga phyi 'brel bsgrigs pas shes nus/ spyi ni rdzas yod btags yod mi 'gal te/ rdul phran phyogs kyi cha med ma gtogs bem po thams cad dang / shes pa skad cig cha med ma gtogs cha shas can gyi shes pa thams cad rdzas yod dang btags yod kyi dngos po gnyis ka yin pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang rang gi gdags gzhi la ltos te 492

bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/btags yod tsam las rdzas yod ma yin pa'i rnam dbye shes par bya/ yang na bum pa'i gdags gzhi rdul rdzas brgyad la brten nas 'di ni bum pa'o zhes rags pa ling po gcig tu gzung ba'i tshe/ de ltar gzung ba'i rtog pa la dngos su snang ba'i bum pa de rdzas su ma grub ces pa'i don yin te/ rtog pa la dngos su snang ba'i bum pa de bum pa'i don spyi yin pa'i phyir/ mtshan nyid brtag par/mtshan mtshon grangs mnyam ngo bo gcig /rdzas yod btags yod nyid du nges/ /zhes gsungs pas/ dngos po'i mtshan nyid don byed nus pa lta bu rdzas yod dang /mtshon bya dngos po de mtshan nyid don byed nus pa la ltos te btags yod tsam yin te/ don byed nus pa la brten nas dngos por blos brtags te bzhag pa'i phyir/ mtshan nyid go byed don gyi chos/ /mtshon bya go bya blo yi chos/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don yang 'di yin/ tshul 'di ni dngos por gyur pa'i mtshan mtshon kun la rigs 'gre/ rdzas yod kyang rags pa'i dngos po ni sngar bshad pa ltar dang / rdul phran phyogs kyi cha med dang / shes pa skad cig cha med lta bu de gnyis la gdags gzhi'i cha shas can med pas nam yang btags yod ma yin pa'i phyir/ rigs gter gyi dgongs pa mtshan mtshon dang / 'gal 'brel dang / tshad 'bras dang / bsgrub bya sgrub byed kyi gtan tshigs kun la bkod tshod dang / song tshod gnyis su phye nas/ bkod tshod la sgra chos can/ mi rtag ste/ byasapa'i phyir ro / / zhes pa lta bu la dper mtshon na/ byas pa/ mi rtag pa/ sgra gsum po de rim pa bzhin du byas pa'i/ rtags kyi de skor gyi rtags su gzung bya dang / sgrub chos dang shes 'dod chos can yin zhing / de bzhin du sgra mi rtag par bkod tshod la 493

bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/btags yod tsam las rdzas yod ma yin pa'i rnam dbye shes par bya/ yang na bum pa'i gdags gzhi rdul rdzas brgyad la brten nas 'di ni bum pa'o zhes rags pa ling po gcig tu gzung ba'i tshe/ de ltar gzung ba'i rtog pa la dngos su snang ba'i bum pa de rdzas su ma grub ces pa'i don yin te/ rtog pa la dngos su snang ba'i bum pa de bum pa'i don spyi yin pa'i phyir/ mtshan nyid brtag par/mtshan mtshon grangs mnyam ngo bo gcig /rdzas yod btags yod nyid du nges/ /zhes gsungs pas/ dngos po'i mtshan nyid don byed nus pa lta bu rdzas yod dang /mtshon bya dngos po de mtshan nyid don byed nus pa la ltos te btags yod tsam yin te/ don byed nus pa la brten nas dngos por blos brtags te bzhag pa'i phyir/ mtshan nyid go byed don gyi chos/ /mtshon bya go bya blo yi chos/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don yang 'di yin/ tshul 'di ni dngos por gyur pa'i mtshan mtshon kun la rigs 'gre/ rdzas yod kyang rags pa'i dngos po ni sngar bshad pa ltar dang / rdul phran phyogs kyi cha med dang / shes pa skad cig cha med lta bu de gnyis la gdags gzhi'i cha shas can med pas nam yang btags yod ma yin pa'i phyir/ rigs gter gyi dgongs pa mtshan mtshon dang / 'gal 'brel dang / tshad 'bras dang / bsgrub bya sgrub byed kyi gtan tshigs kun la bkod tshod dang / song tshod gnyis su phye nas/ bkod tshod la sgra chos can/ mi rtag ste/ byasapa'i phyir ro / / zhes pa lta bu la dper mtshon na/ byas pa/ mi rtag pa/ sgra gsum po de rim pa bzhin du byas pa'i/ rtags kyi de skor gyi rtags su gzung bya dang / sgrub chos dang shes 'dod chos can yin zhing / de bzhin du sgra mi rtag par bkod tshod la 493

ba chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()de skor gyi bsgrub bya yang dag yan la/ song tshod la byas pa rtags de skor gyi rtags/ chos/ don gsum ka dang / bsgrub bya rnams gzhan sel 'ba' zhig yin pa ni rtog ge'i gsang tshigs yin/ rtags kyi mtshan nyid gzhan sel yin zhes pa'i shugs las song tshod kyi dbang du byas te bsgrub bya'i chos kyi mtshan nyid dang / shes 'dod chos can gyi mtshan gzhi yang gzhan sel yin par bstan cing / sgra yi don la rang mtshan du/ /'brul pa bsgrub bya'i mtshan gzhi yin/ /zhes pas song tshod kyi bsgrub bya gzhan sel yin pa dngos su bstan/ de ltar na byas pa sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i rtags yang dag tu 'dzin pa'i rtog ngor dngos su snang ba'i sgra mi rtag pa dang / sgra/ byas/ mi rtag pa gsum po de gzhan sel yin cing / de la dgag sgrub dngos su byas pas don rang mtshan sgra mi rtag pa rtogs par 'gyur zhing / don rang mtshan la dgag sgrub dngos su mi byed de/rnam 'grel las/ phyi rol brten min sgra don la/ /brten nas 'dir ni sgrub pa dang / /dgag pa thams cad 'dod pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don de nyid thugs la bzhag nas/ chos kyi rjes/ don la dgag sgrub byed na ni/ /tshad ma'i yul mi shes par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa yin/ des na rtog ngor dngos su snang ba'i sngo ma yin pa las ldog pa'i sngo tsam de sngon po'i gzhan sel yin pas dngos por med pa la bod rgan po dag gis de dngos por 'dod pas spyi dngos po bar song / spyi dngos po ni chos grags kyi dgongs pa ma yin te/ rnam 'grel las/ ldog pa ngo bo nyid med phyir/ /zhes dang / spyi ni dngos med ngo bo nyid/ /zhes sogs mang du gsungs/ rang 'grel du bod phal cher dngos med kyang yod 494

ba chen 'od snang las/ saskya'i mosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()de skor gyi bsgrub bya yang dag yan la/ song tshod la byas pa rtags de skor gyi rtags/ chos/ don gsum ka dang / bsgrub bya rnams gzhan sel 'ba' zhig yin pa ni rtog ge'i gsang tshigs yin/ rtags kyi mtshan nyid gzhan sel yin zhes pa'i shugs las song tshod kyi dbang du byas te bsgrub bya'i chos kyi mtshan nyid dang / shes 'dod chos can gyi mtshan gzhi yang gzhan sel yin par bstan cing / sgra yi don la rang ma du/ /'khrul pa bsgrub bya'i mtshan gzhi yin/ /zhes pas song tshod kyi bsgrub bya gzhan sel yin pa dngos su bstan/ de ltar na byas pa sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i rtags yang dag tu 'dzin pa'i rtog ngor dngos su snang ba'i sgra mi rtag pa dang / sgra/ byas/ mi rtag pa gsum po de g.yin sel yin cing / de la dgag sgrub dngos su byas pas don rang mtshan sgra mi rtag pa rtogs par 'gyur zhing / don rang mtshan la dgag sgrub dngos su mi byed de/rnam 'grel las/ phyi rol brten min sgra don la/ /brten nas 'dir ni sgrub pa dang / /dgag pa thams cad 'dod pa yin/ /zhes gsungasapa'i don de nyid thugasal bzhag nas/ chos kyi rjes/ don la dgag sgrub byed na ni/ /tshad ma'i yul mi shes par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa yin/ des na rtog ngor dngos su snang ba'i sngo ma yin pa las ldog pa'i sngo tsam de sngon po'i gzhan sel yin pas dngos por med pa la bod rgan po dag gis de dngos por 'dod pas spyi dngos po bar song / spyi dngosapo ni chosagrags kyi dgongs pa ma yin te/ rnam 'grel las/ ldog pa ngo bo nyid med phyir/ /zhesadang / spyi ni dngosamed ngo bo nyid/ /zhes sogasamang du gsungs/ rang 'grel du bod phal cher dngos med kyang yod 494

bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/par 'dod la/ zhes sogasagasungs pa don yang phywa gtsang sogasabod rgan po dag gis spyi dngos por 'dod pa la dgongs pa yin/ de skad gsungasapa'i yod pa de dngos po dang don gcig pa'i yod pa yin pa rnam nges dang rang 'grel sogs na gsal zhing / bod rgan po dag kyang dngos med tshig zin la dngos por gnasa'adod/ don gyisade ltar du 'dod par song ste/ spyi dngos por khas blangs pa'i phyir/ 'di ni sngon chosakyi rjes kha che paṇa chen la nged bod rnamasal sngo ma yin pa las ldog pa'i sngo tsam zhig ldog pa shwa mang gi sul bzhin du 'dod pa 'thad lagasasam zhusapas/ tsam tsam mang po ngas mi shes/ sngon po don la yod gsungs pas gzhan sel gyi gnad thams cad des go gsungs pa'i gnad don 'di dag yin/ sngon po la dper mtshon pa yin gyi/ gzhan sgra la sogasapa dngos po kun la don la yod pa'i rang mtshan mtshan nyid pa re dang / rang mtshan 'dzin pa'i rtog ngor dngos su snang ba'i sngo tsam dang sgra tsam sogs gzhan sel gyi cha sngon po dang sgra sogs btags pa re rnam par phye nas 'chad tshe dang 'jug tshe'i rnam gzhag ma 'brul ba re shesadagos/ 'di rtog ge'i gsang tshig yin/thal 'gyur gyi skabs su gzhung 'dir/ rang bzhin 'brasabu mtshan nyid de/ /mi dmigs gsum gyi sgrub mi 'phen/ /zhesagasungs pas/ rang bzhin ma dmigasapa dang / dngosa'abras ma dmigasapa'i thal 'gyur gnyis dang / de'i steng du khyab byed ma dmigs pa'i nang mtshan mtshan nyid mi dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur dang gsum ni sgrub byed mi 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur dang / lhag ma yang dag gtan tshigs kun/ /sgrub byed 'phen par shes par bya/ /zhes gsungasapas rang 495

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/par 'dod la/ zhes sogs gsungs pa don yang phywa gtsang sogs bod rgan po dag gis spyi dngos por 'dod pa la dgongs pa yin/ de skad gsungs pa'i yod pa de dngos po dang don gcig pa'i yod pa yin pa rnam nges dang rang 'grel sogs na gsal zhing / bod rgan po dag kyang dngos med tshig zin la dngos por gnas 'dod/ don gyis de ltar du 'dod par song ste/ spyi dngos por khas blangs pa'i phyir/ 'di ni sngon chos kyi rjes kha che paṇa chen la nged bod rnams la sngo ma yin pa las ldog pa'i sngo tsam zhig ldog pa shwa mang gi sul bzhin du 'dod pa 'thad lags sam zhus pas/ tsam tsam mang po ngas mi shes/ sngon po don la yod gsungs pas gzhan sel gyi gnad thams cad des go gsungs pa'i gnad don 'di dag yin/ sngon po la dper mtshon pa yin gyi/ gzhan sgra la sogs pa dngos po kun la don la yod pa'i rang mtshan mtshan nyid pa re dang / rang mtshan 'dzin pa'i rtog ngor dngos su snang ba'i sngo tsam dang sgra tsam sogs gzhan sel gyi cha sngon po dang sgra sogs btags pa re rnam par phye nas 'chad tshe dang 'jug tshe'i rnam gzhag ma 'khrul ba re shes dgos/ 'di rtog ge'i gsang tshig yin/thal 'gyur gyi skabs su gzhung 'dir/ rang bzhin 'bras bu mtshan nyid de/ /mi dmigs gsum gyi sgrub mi 'phen/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rang bzhin ma dmigasapa dang / dngos 'bras ma dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur gnyis dang / de'i steng du khyab byed ma dmigs pa'i nang mtshan mtshan nyid mi dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur dang gsum ni sgrub byed mi 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur dang / lhag ma yang dag gtan tshigs kun/ /sgrub byed 'phen par shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas rang 495

'tshechen 'od snangalas/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()bzhan ma dmigs pa sogs gsum gyi lhag ma rgyu ma da gas pa dang / mtshan nyid ma dmigs par bzhag pa'i khyab byed ma dmigs pa dang / 'gal ba'i rang bzhin dmigs pa skor bzhi sogs lhan cig mi gnas pa'i 'gal la brten pa bcu gnyis/ phan tshun spang 'gal la brten pa gnyis/ 'bras rang gnyis te bco0brgyad kyi thal 'gyur rnams sgrub byed 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur du gsungs pa ltar snang zhing / de ltar na sgrub byed mi 'phen pa la gsum dang / 'phen pa la bco brgyad de/ dngos bstan nyi shu rtsa gcig byung / sde bdun rab gsal las kyang dngos bstan nyer gcig ces pa dang / rtags yang dag nyi shu'i ming can gyi thal 'gyur nyi shu yod pa las zhes sogasabashad snang mod/ 'on kyang bco brgyad po de'i nang na rang bzhin dang 'gal ba'i rgyu dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur so+ogs rgyu dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur sogs bgrang 'dug pa/ gsum po 'di'i rtags yang dag yod dam/ yod na rgyu dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag rnam rig gnyis ka nas bkag pa dang 'gal/ med na de lta bu'i thal 'gyur gsum po de lhag ma yang dag gtan tshigs bco brgyad kyi nang tshan gyi thal 'gyur ma yin par 'gyur bas gsum po de'i tshab kha skang dgos so zhes gzhan dag gis dogs pa slong na rang re sa skya pa'i rjes 'brang rnams lan ji ltar gsungs/ deng song sa skya pa'i mtshan nyid kyi bshad grwa so so na 'chad nyan mdzad pa sogs kyi zhal ༄gran kha skad la ji ltar yod/ mkhas pa dag gi lung rigs kyi rtogs dpyod 'di blo bskyed la shin tu phan pa yin/ tshad ma rnam 'grel dang rigs gter gyi skabs 'di rnams grub mtha' smra ba bzhi'i nang nas mdo sde pa dang sems tsam 496

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcagapa'i 'bel gtam/pa'i skabs yan/ bye brag smra ba dang ngo bo nyad med par smra ba' skabs 'dir 3chad de/ de ltar grub mtha' bzhi las slob dpon ni/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas rtogs nus pa yin/ mdo sems gnyis kyi nang nas kyang gong 'og phal cher mdo sde pa'i skabs yin/ sems tsam pa'i lugs ni rigs gter rtsa 'grel gnyis la/ tshad 'bras kyi skabs su cung zad 'byung / rnam 'grel du'ang /don rig gang yin so sor rig /ces sogs tshad 'bras gnyis pa'i skabs rnams sems tsam rnam bden pa dang / tshad 'bras bzhi par gzugs rnam sgro btags pa gzhal byar byed pa'i tshad 'bras rnams rnam rdzun pa'i lugs yin/gzung ba 'dzin pa rig pa dag /yod pa min yang gzhal bya dang / /zhes sogs tshad 'bras bzhi pa'i skabs kyang / rnam bden pa'i lugs su sbyar ba rang 'grel nyid na dngos su gsal/ de lta bu'i mdo sems gnyis la rig pa'i rjes 'brang rge mdo sde pa dang sems tsam par 'jog mngon pa kun btus dang byams chos phyi ma nas bshad pa'i lung gi rjes 'brang rnams dang ma 'dres pa'i rnam dbye gal che / rig pa'i rjes 'brang gi sems tsam pa ni theg pa chen po pa yin par gzhir bzhag 'di'i mdo sde pa'ang theg pa chen po pa yin te/ rnam 'grel gyi mchod brjod kyi skabs su sku gsum bstan pas 'bras bu'i skabs su sku gsum khas len/ le'u gnyis par/ rnam pa du mar thabs mang po/ /yun ring dus su goms pa las/ /zhes gsungs pas bskal pa grangs med du mar thabs rgya chen por goms par bshad pa dang / 'dod chags bral ba'i gnas pa ni/ /brtse ba'am yang na las kyis yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i 'dod chags dang bral ba la gnyis 497

yo' 'od snang lag sa skya'i chosaḥng gces bsdus/ ()las/ theg dman dgra bcom pa re rnam na phung po ma dor ba las kyis 'phen pa ma rdzogs pas 'khor bar gnas pa yin/ theg chen 'phags pa 'khor bar gnas pa ni snying rje'i dbang gis gzhan don byed pa yin pas lam/ gyi skabs su sa bcu dang / byang 'phags rjes thob pa 'khor bar gzhan gyi don byed pa rnams khas len pas so/ /sgra pa sher rin pas/ gnyis gnyis theg dman pa dang theg chen phyir/ /gnyis pa theg chen par sdud gzhung lugs/ 'khrul/ /zhes bshad kyang mdo sde pa mtha' dag theg chen par sdud na 'brul pa los yin yang / mdo sde pa la gnyis su phye nas lung gi rjes 'brang gi mdo sde ri/ ni / nyan thos pa dang / rig pa'i rjes 'brang gi mdo sde pa ni sngar sgrub byed bkod pa ltar theg chen pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal phyogs gling grags pa'i gzhung / /mdo dang rnam 'grel de 'grel dang bcas rnams/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i de 'grel gyi ngos 'dzin la kun mkhyen g.yag pa dang / mkhas pa bsod nams skyabs sogs kyis lha shāka sogs kyi 'grel pa la ngos bzung / kun mkhyen chen pos rnam 'grel rtsa ba lta bu dang /rnam nges la sogs pa gzhan rnams de'i 'grel pa lta bur 'chad pa'i don du bzhed/ dgongs pa ni rigs gter rtsa 'grel 'di lha shāka sogs kyi 'grel pa/ la mi ltos pas na gzhung dag gi tshig zur gyis de 'grel yang rig pa'i dbang phyug gnyis po gang rung gis mdzad pa zhig dgos pa la thugs rtse gtad/phyogs las zhes sogs tshig dang po de dang snga phyi'i 'brel bsgrigs pas/ de 'grel yang rig pa'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa zhig dgos pa shas che zhing /498

'tsheho 'od snang ldog saskya'i chogayang sresabasdus/ ()las/ theg dman dgra bcom pa re rnam na phung po ma dor ba las kyis 'phen pa ma rdzogs pasa'akhor bar gnasapa yin/ theg chen 'phags pa 'khor bar gnas pa ni snying rje'i dbang gis gzhan don byed pa yin pas lam/ gyi skabs su sa bcu dang / byang 'phags rjesathob pa 'khor bar gzhan gyi don byed pa rnams khas len pas so/ /sgra pa sher rin pas/ gnyisaganyis theg dman pa dang theg chen phyir/ /gnyisapa theg chen par sdud gzhung lugs/ 'khrul/ /zhes bshad kyang mdo sde pa mtha' dag theg chen par sdud na 'khrul pa los yin yang / mdo sde pa la gnyis su phye nasalung gi rjesa'abrang gi mdo sde ri/ ni / nyan thos pa dang / rig pa'i rjesa'abrang gi mdo sde pa ni sngar sgrub byed bkod pa ltar theg chen pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /phyogs lasarnam rgyal phyogs gling grags pa'i gzhung / /mdo dang rnam 'grel de 'grel dang bcas rnams/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i de 'grel gyi ngosa'adzin la kun mkhyen g.yag pa dang / mkhas pa bsod namaba'iskyabs sogs kyis lha shāka sogs kyi 'grel pa la ngos bzung / kun mkhyen chen posarnam 'grel rtsa ba lta bu dang /rnam nges la sogs pa gzhan rnams de'i 'grel pa lta bur 'chad pa'i don du bzhed/ dgongs pa ni rigs gter rtsa 'grel 'di lha shāka sogs kyi 'grel pa/ la mi ltos pas na gzhung dag gi tshig zur gyis de 'grel yang rig pa'i dbang phyug gnyis po gang rung gis mdzad pa zhig dgos pa la thugs rtse gtad/phyogs las zhes sogs tshig dang po de dang snga phyi'i 'brel bsgrigs pas/ de 'grel yang rig pa'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa zhig dgos pa shas che zhing /498

brtse chen 'od snangalas/ saskya'i mosa'abyung gtses bsdus/ ()gnyis pa'i slob ma paṇa chen gzhung brgya pas gas gter la ṭik+ka mdzad/'dir song tshod kyi rnam gzhag yang yang gsal bar gsungs pas rigs gter la dpyad pa'i mdo sde pa dang / rnam 'grel du song tshod kyi skabs gsal bar ma byung dgongs nas rnam 'grel la ma dpyad pas mdo sde par bzhed/ da lta'ang rgyun skyong / spyi bab bkod tshod dang song tshod kyi rnam gzhag rnam 'grel gyi dgongs par gnas pa de sa paṇa gyis gsal bar mdzad pa yin pas rnam 'grel dang rigs gter gnyis dgongs pa gcig tu bskyang dgos/ gzhung 'di gnyis ma dpyad pa dang dpyad pa'i skabs la so sor sbyar bas grub mtha' tha dad du 'gro ba 'dra/ de 'dra ni ji ltar lags sam/ yang kun mkhyen gyi slob ma mus kong nyang stod bka' chen pa sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ba las sku dngos kyi gdan sa pa paṇa chen kong ston gyis/ tshad ma'i spyi don blo rtags su grags pa brtsams/ blo rigs skyes bu'i 'jug yul la rang mtshan gyis khyab pa dang / sgra rtogs pa'i rjes dpag med pa sogs kun mkhyen dang mi mthun pa mang / rtags rigs la mkhas grub bstan gsal gyi rjes su 'brangs te dgag rtags dang sgrub rtags mi 'gal ba sogs bshad tshul mi 'dra ba 'ga' re yod 'dug 'dis mdzad pa'i blo rigs kyi dbu phyogs na slob dpon dbyig gnyen la bka' bzhi rang la mkhas pa'i slob ma bzhi zhes pa'ang bshad yod 'dug pa/de ltar na dbyig gnyen gyi slob ma phyogs glang de tshad ma rang las mkhas kyi/gzhan la mi mkhasapar 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du 'phags pa grol sde sogs la'ang de 'dra'i skyon re byung bar gyur/ des na sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyi gsung 500

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/las byung ba ltar bka' bzhi rang las mkhas pa 'di 'thad de/ mkhas pa 'jug snor snga ma dbyig gnyen legs ldan sogs/ /zhes sogs dang / phyi ma phyogs gung chos grags sogs/ /zhes pa nas/ brjod pa'i tshul la nyung rgyas sogs/ /snga ma'i tshul las khyad par 'phags/ /zhes gsungs pas dbyig gnyen las phye+ogs glang gi bshad srol khyad par du 'phags pa dang / 'grel pa don gsal las/ 'phags pa'i khongs su gtogs pa yi/ /rnam par grol ba zhes byas kyang / /de byas byas pa min mthong nas/ /dbu mar gnas pa'i blo rab phye/ /zhes gsungs pas/ dbyig gnyen gyi yum gyi dgongs pa rnam rig tu bkral kyang / 'phags pa grol sdes de 'thad pa ma yin par gzigs nas yum don dbu mar bkral bas/ bshad srol khyad par du 'phags par grub pas na rang las mkhas pa zer ba yin/ de bzhin du 'dul ba rang las mkhas pa dang /mngon pa rang las mkhas pa la'ang rgyu mchan de 'dra re los yod 'dug chos kyi ji 'brug pa pad+ma dkar po'i chos 'byung du'ang bka' bzhi rang la mkhas pa zhes bris mod/ rang la mkhas pa logs su go rgyu mi 'tshol bar 'ol tshod mdzad/ma /bas pa dag rang rang gi blo la gang byung ba'i shes rab kyi 'char sgo de ka tshad mar byas nas tshig don gyi cha la bsgyur bkod byed pa mang po 'ong gin 'dugayang kun mkhyen gyi slob ma bu chen phyogs su byon nas grwa sa thebs pa rgyal ba spos rab 'byams pas rnam 'grel gyi ṭīk+ka sde bdun dgongs rgyan/ rigs gter gyi ṭīk+ka rig lam gsal ba'i nyi ma/ rnam rig gnyis ga'i spyi don rdo rje thog 'bebs su grags pa rnams brtsams/ grub mtha' kun mkhyen nyid dang 501

ba chen 'od sna pa la/ sa skya'i chosang tha rjes bsdus/ ()mthun/ 'on kyang 'das skyes bu rtag par bzhed pa yin no zer ba zhig byung zhing /deng sang gi bar du'ang de'i rgyun skyong ba 'dra yod mod/ gnas tshul ni stag lo'i skabs shig rten 'brel gyi gnad la dgongs nas dbyar chos gnang ba'i chos grwar skyes bu rtag pa'i sgrub byed gsungs/ khong 'ga' re ba'i zin bris byas/ da lta'ang yig rgyun yod/ de la dad pa'i stobs kyis gsung rgyun de ka bskyangs nga/sa/ de ltar grags pa byung / rje mus rab 'byams pa rang gi rtsom chos sngar smos rnga/ nge rnams su de 'dra'i gsal kha ye med pas na chos kyi rjes 'brang dag gis de re du bla ma'i zhe 'dod kyi dgongs pa yin min rtog dpyod dgos pa yod/ ming tshig la sogs pa'i rjod byed kyi sgra rnams ni rtag pa yin par rong ston shes bya kun rig dang / kun mkhyen gnyis gas dngos su gsungs shing / rnam 'grel gyi dgongs pa'ang yin/ tshad ma mdo'i rang 'grel las/ rgyu la 'bras bur btags pa'i phyir/ /zhes dang / rigs gter du/ 'bras bu'i rjes dang/rga bskyed pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don sgrub ngag gis rjes dpag mi skyed kyang /snga rgol gyi sgrub ngag yang dag bkod pa la brten nas phyi rgol gyi rgyud la rjes/ dpag skye ba'i don du 'chad dgos/ gang ltar skyes bu dam pa 'di ni bla rma/ gong ma'i sdi/ba mtha' la gces spras dang / yig cha la gtsigs 'jotre ga che/ rgyu mcha' de bas na/ de ltar sgrub dang sun 'byin gyi/ /rigs pa'i gzhung lugs gang gis shes/ /mkhabs pa de ni rdzogs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi bstan nga/ 'dzin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i bsngags brjod kyi yon tan rnams kyang 'di la lngan pa yin no/ /tshad ma'i bstan bcos nam mkha' lta bu la/ /bdag blo khab kyi bu 502

ba chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()sde bzhi mi 'dra ba re re yod/ bzhi po de las gyes pa' sde pa bco brgyad la'ang de bzhin du rtsa ba dang bshad pa'i lung tha dad pa re yod/ de dag so so'i so thar gyi mdo la'ang / dge slong pha'i so thar gyi mdo dang / ma'i so thar gyi mdo gnyis su byung / bshad pa'i lung la lung gzhi dang / rnam 'byed la sogasapa sde bzhir grags pa kun la mthun/ sde bzhi'i go rim ni gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i lugs la lung gzhi dang por gsungs te/ de ltar rab byung gi gzhi thog mar gsungs shing / der sdom pa ma thob pa 'thob par byed pa'i cho ga bstan pa'i phyir zhes rgyal ba mus rab 'byams pas mdzad pa'i mdo don gsal ba'i nyi ma las bshad/ skyed tshal ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' chos bzang gis mdzad pa'i 'dul ba'i spyi don lung rig gter mdzod las so thar gyi mdo'i rgya 'grel gyi lung zhig drangs nas lung gzhi thog mar gsungs/ de nas rnam 'byed la sogs pa yin gsungs/ yid ches pa'i lung las snga phyi bgrang tshul ltar go rim byed na 'di ltar yang sems te/ thog mar lung rnam 'byed/ de nasaphran tshegs/de nas lung gzhi/ de nas lung zhu ba 'byung rigs pa yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni deng sang bod 'dir 'dul ba'i phyogs la 'dul ba mdo rtsa dang / de'i rgya cher 'grel/ la tshad mar byed pa sha stag yin la/ de yin na ji skad bshad ma thag pa de khas len dgos te/ rgya cher 'grel gyi dbu nas mar/ 'dir 'dul ba zhesabya ba'ang rnam par 'byed pa la sogs pa dag yin par blta ste zhes pa dang / lnga phrug dgu pa'i thad kyi rgya cher 'grel lasakyang / 'dul ba zhes bya ba ni so sor thar pa'i bslab pa'i rnam par bshad par gyur pa rnam par 'byed pa dang / phran tshegs 504

bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dbyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/dang / gzha la sogabashapa'o zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de lta bu 'dul ba bstan pa de la bka' bsdu rim pa gsum du byung bar rab dbye las gsungs/ rtsa bshad de dag la 'phags yul du dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos mang du byung kra las/ lung rnam 'byed ni/ sothar gyi mdo'i tshig 'grel lta bur yin zhing / bam po brgyad stonagasum yod la/ lung phran tshegasani/ bslab bya phra mo rnamasargyasapar bstan pa'i sgo nasasothar gyi spyi don sna bu'i 'grel pa yin zhing / bam po lnga bstortsa dgu yod/ lung gzhi ni sothar gyi ma tshang ba kha bskang pa'i 'grel pa yin la/ bam po brgya dang bcu'o/ /gzhung dam pa ni so thar gyi daspung ba'i gnasarnamasagatan la ribebs par shin tu gces pa'i 'grel pa yin la/ bam po lnga bsartsalnga yod do/ /bshad pa'i lung sde bzhi'i brjod bya'i gnas tshul dang bam grangasa'adi rnamasapaṇa chen gser mdog can pa'i 'dul ba mdo'i dkari 'grel mdo'i snang byed nyi ma'i shing rta lasabashad pa/ mchan/ gtso bor gyur pa ni slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi slob ma 'dul ba rang las mkhas pa yon tan 'od kyis mdzad nga/'i 'dul ba mdo rtsa bam po dgu yod pa 'di yin/ 'di la yon tan 'od rang gis 'grel pa zhig kyang mdzad snang / yang 'dul ba las brgya rtsa gcig gi gzhung yang mdzad/ slob dpon chos kyi bshes gnyen gyisamado rtsa'i dgongs pa rgyas par 'grel pa la rgya cher 'grel du grags pa bam po bdun cu r+sha/ga tsam yod pa zhig mdzad/ yang kha cig yon tan 'od kyi slob ma'ang yin zer te/ gang ltar yang slob dpon shākya 'od du grags pas dge tshul gyi bslab pa las brtsams pa'i 'dul ba sum brgya pa dang / de'i 'grel pa 'od ldan mdzad/ yang gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i lugs la dgra bcom pa saga'i lhas 'dul ba tshig le'ur byas pa mdzad/ 'di la me tog phreng rgyud kyang zer/505

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/dang / gzha la sog ba'i pa'o zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de lta bu 'dul ba bstan pa de la bka' bsdu rim pa gsum du byung bar rab dbye las gsungs/ rtsa bshad de dag la 'phags yul du dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos mang du byung kra las/ lung rnam 'byed ni/ so thar gyi mdo'i tshig 'grel lta bur yin zhing / bam po brgyad stonagasum yod la/ lung phran tshegs ni/ bslab bya phra mo rnams rgyas par bstan pa'i sgo nas so thar gyi spyi don sna bu'i 'grel pa yin zhing / bam po lnga bsto rtsa dgu yod/ lung gzhi ni sgo thar gyi ma tshang ba kha bskang pa'i 'grel pa yin la/ bam po brgya dang bcu'o/ /gzhung dam pa ni so thar gyi dka' ba'i gnas rnams gtan la sna bebs par shin tu gces pa'i 'grel pa yin la/ bam po lnga bas rtsa lnga yod do/ /bshad pa'i lung sde bzhi'i brjod bya'i gnas tshul dang bam grangs 'di rnams paṇa chen gser mdog can pa'i 'dul ba mdo'i dkasnye ri 'grel mdo'i snang byed nyi ma'i shing rta las bshad pa/ mchan/ gtso bor gyur pa ni slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi slob ma 'dul ba rang las mkhas pa yon tan 'od kyis mdzad nga/'i 'dul ba mdo rtsa bam po dgu yod pa 'di yin/ 'di la yon tan 'od rang gis 'grel pa zhig kyang mdzad snang / yang 'dul ba las brgya rtsa gcig gi gzhung yang mdzad/ slob dpon chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis mdo rtsa'i dgongs pa rgyas par 'grel pa la rgya cher 'grel du grags pa bam po bdun cu r+sha/ga tsam yod pa zhig mdzad/ yang kha cig yon tan 'od kyi slob ma'ang yin zer te/ gang ltar yang slob dpon shākya 'od du grags pas dge tshul gyi bslab pa las brtsams pa'i 'dul ba sum brgya pa dang / de'i 'grel pa 'od ldan mdzad/ yang gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i lugs la dgra bcom pa sa ga'i lhas 'dul ba tshig le'ur byas pa mdzad/ 'di la me tog phreng rgyud kyang zer/505

'tshe' 'odasnangalas/ saskya'i mos lung gcesabasdus/ ()gang ltar yang dge slong pha 'dul ba 'chad byed yin/ de ltar smos pa' mdo rtsa rgya cher 'grel pa bcas dang / sum brgya pa rtsa 'grel dang / 'dul ba tshig le'ur byas pa dang gsum la 'chad tshul mi mthun pa 'ga' rer snang ba'ang blo gsal dag gis shes par bya dgos/ skyed tshal ba sogs de dgongs pa mthun pa gzhir bzhag byas nas/ so so'i lung 'dren gar bab gya tshoms su drangs/ pa'ang 'dug bod 'dir rtsa ba'i sde pa bzhi'i nang nas gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i lugs 'ba' zhig byung ba 'dra ste/ bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su mchan brjod par dka' ba'i mkhan chen bo dhi satwa bod la bka' drin shin tu che ba des/ lo tsā ba sad mi mi bdun la rang byung bsnyen rdzogs phogs pa nas bzung /de'i rgyun bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus su'ang g.yo gtsang dmar gsum gyi slob ma bru chen dgongs pa rab gsal las dbus gtsang gi mkhas pa mi bcus sdom pa/ blangs pa sogs dang / phyis su ma byon sangs rgyas gsum pa shākya shrī bod du phebs nas slob ma'i gtso bo sa skya paṇa chen la rab byung bsnyen rdzogs gnang ba dang / gzhan yang byang dpal/ rdor dpal sogasal bsnyen rdzogasaganang ba'i sdom rgyun dang bshad rgyun mtha' dag gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i lugs srol 'ba' zhig tu snang / phyi dar gyi dusabod kyi 'dul 'dzin la grags che ba bya 'dul 'dzin pa mtha' bzhi 'bar du grags pa byung / bslab pa phra mo tshun la'ang gces spras che ba'i tshad du thub/ des 'dul ba la ṭīk+ka mdzad de sdom rgyun dang bshad rgyun gnyis ka spel/ kha skad ngag rgyun la 'dul ba bya la thug zer ba de yin/ gzhan yang 'dul 'dzin klu mesadang / pa tshab nyi ma gragasadang / gzus 506

ba chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chos lung gces bsdus/ ()gang ltar yang dge slong pha 'dul ba 'chad byed yin/ de ltar smos pa' mdo rtsa rgya cher 'grel pa bcas dang / sum brgya pa rtsa 'grel dang / 'dul ba tshig le'ur byas pa dang gsum la 'chad tshul mi mthun pa 'ga' rer snang ba'ang blo gsal dag gis shes par bya dgos/ skyed tshal ba sogs de dgongs pa mthun pa gzhir bzhag byas nas/ so so'i lung 'dren gar bab gya tshoms su drangs/ pa'ang 'dug bod 'dir rtsa ba'i sde pa bzhi'i nang nas gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i lugs 'ba' zhig byung ba 'dra ste/ bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su mchan brjod par dka' ba'i mkhan chen bo dhi satwa bod la bka' drin shin tu che ba des/ lo tsā ba sad mi mi bdun la rang byung bsnyen rdzogs phogs pa nas bzung /de'i rgyun bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus su'ang g.yo gtsang dmar gsum gyi slob ma bru chen dgongs pa rab gsal las dbus gtsang gi mkhas pa mi bcus sdom pa/ blangs pa sogs dang / phyis su ma byon sangs rgyas gsum pa shākya shrī bod du phebs nas slob ma'i gtso bo sa skya paṇa chen la rab byung bsnyen rdzogs gnang ba dang / gzhan yang byang dpal/ rdor dpal sogs la bsnyen rdzogs gnang ba'i sdom rgyun dang bshad rgyun mtha' dag gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i lugs srol 'ba' zhig tu snang / phyi dar gyi dus bod kyi 'dul 'dzin la grags che ba bya 'dul 'dzin pa mtha' bzhi 'bar du grags pa byung / bslab pa phra mo tshun la'ang gces spras che ba'i tshad du thub/ des 'dul ba la ṭīk+ka mdzad de sdom rgyun dang bshad rgyun gnyis ka spel/ kha skad ngag rgyun la 'dul ba bya la thug zer ba de yin/ gzhan yang 'dul 'dzin klu mes dang / pa tshab nyi ma grags dang / gzus 506

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang / 'bring mtshams pa bla ma rin chen dpal la sogs pa du ma byung / de ltar na'ang de dag gi bshad srol ni rim pas byung mod/ sdom rgyun ni cher ma byung ba 'dra ste/ kha che paṇa chen ni bod du lo bcu bzhugs/ de'i ring pa rab byung bsnyen rdzogs mtha' yas pa gnang ba nas bzung de'i sdom rgyun sha stag dar ba las/ 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa las brgyud pa ni 'u yug pa rig pa'i seng ge dang / 'jam dbyangs mdo sde dpal sogs nas brgyud de da lta'i bar du de'i rgyun brtan par yod/ bla ma 'phags pas chos rje pa'i sdom rgyun bzhes par 'dod nas 'u yug pa la gsol btab bka' phebs kyang stabs ma 'grigs/de'i rjes su kha che paṇa chen gyi sdom rgyun bzhugs pa mkhan po grags pa seng ge las bsnyen rdzogs bzhes/ sdom rgyun yang 'dul 'dzin chos kyi mgon po sogs las brgyud de 'phel rgyas che/ 'phags pa nyid kyis 'dul ba'i las kyi cho ga don rgya che la tshig tshogs 'tshams pa/ mtha' chod la go bde ba'i yig cha phul du phyin pa dang / de'i bsdus don yang mdzad/ bod kyi 'dul ba'i las chog cig la 'di las dga' ba med/ phyis su chos kyi spyan ldan bu ston rin po ches bstan pa/'i khur chen po bsnams nas 'dul ba sogs gzhus lugs mtha' dag phral 'chad nyan rtsal du btan nas mdzad/ 'dul ba la yig cha/ 'dul ba'i lasachog chen mo dang / mdo rtsa'i ṭīk+ka 'bru mthar chags med pa la dka' 'grel lta bu tshog tshogs che se ba zhig dang / 'dul ba las brgya rtsa gcig gi ṭīk+ka sogs mdzad/ bu ston gyis bzhed pas/ sdom pa 'bogs pa'i tshe las gral na gsan pa'i dge slong rnam dag yin nges shes pa la/ sdom pa len mkhan gyi bsgrub bya 507

bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/do rje rgyal mtshan dang / 'bring mtshams pa bla ma rin chen dpal la sogs pa du ma byung / de ltar na'ang de dag gi bshad srol ni rim pas byung mod/ sdom rgyun ni cher ma byung ba 'dra ste/ kha che paṇa chen ni bod du lo bcu bzhugs/ de'i ring pa rab byung bsnyen rdzogs mtha' yas pa gnang ba nas bzung de'i sdom rgyun sha stag dar ba las/ 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa las brgyud pa ni 'u yug pa rig pa'i seng ge dang / 'jam dbyangs mdo sde dpal sogs nas brgyud de da lta'i bar du de'i rgyun brtan par yod/ bla ma 'phags pas chos rje pa'i sdom rgyun bzhesapar 'dod nas 'u yug pa la gsol btab bka' phebs kyang stabs ma 'grigs/de'i rjes su kha che paṇa chen gyi sdom rgyun bzhugs pa mkhan po grags pa seng ge las bsnyen rdzogs bzhes/ sdom rgyun yang 'dul 'dzin chosakyi mgon po sogs las brgyud de 'phel rgyasache/ 'phags pa nyid kyis 'dul ba'i las kyi cho ga don rgya che la tshig tshogs 'tshams pa/ mtha' chod la go bde ba'i yig cha phul du phyin pa dang / de'i bsdus don yang mdzad/ bod kyi 'dul ba'i las chog cig la 'di las dga' ba med/ phyis su chos kyi spyan ldan bu ston rin po ches bstan pa/'i khur chen po bsnams nas 'dul ba sogs gzhus lugs mtha' dag la 'chad nyan rtsal du bton nasamadzad/ 'dul ba la yig cha/ 'dul ba'i lasachog chen mo dang / mdo rtsa'i ṭīk+ka 'bru mthar chags med pa la dka' 'grel lta bu tshig tshogs che se ba zhig dang / 'dul ba las brgya rtsa gcig gi ṭīk+ka sogs mdzad/ bu ston gyis bzhed pas/ sdom pa 'bogasapa'i tshe las gral na gsan pa'i dge slong rnam dag yin nges shesapa la/ sdom pa len mkhan gyi bsgrub bya 507

bgechen 'od snangalas/ saskya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()des kyang de ltar du 'du shes ma 'khrul pa zhag byung na sdom pa chags/ las gral gyi dge slong 'ga' zhig rnam dag ma yin pa la/ bsgrub byas de rnam dag yin par 'du shes nas sdom pa blangs kyang 'du shes 'khrul pas sdom pa mi chags gsungs pa'i bca' khrims dam po gsungs 'dug rang gi bsam tshod ni las gral ba 'ga' zhig rnam dag ma yin yang bsgrub bya rang la de 'dra'i dogs pa ma byung bar rnam dag yin par 'du shes na sdom pa skye ste/ mdo rtsa las/ de dang ldan pa ltar mkhan po med pa nyid la 'ong ngo / /de bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa nyid yin na 'ong ngo / /de dge slong nyid ma yin par shes na mi skye'o/ /zhes gsungs pa de'i don mkhan po lta bu las gral der gnas pa'i dge slong gi chul 'chang gang yang rung ba don la dge slong ma yin na'ang bsgrub bya la de 'dra'i the tshom/ med cing rnam dag yin par 'du shes nas blangs na sdom pa skye ba dang / de dge slong min par 'du shes na mi skye ba dngos su bstan 'dug pas so/ /'on kyang bu ston rin po che'i gsung de bstan pa la gces spras kyi phyag len dogs phyogs nas mtha' bsdams pa yin/ drang ma thag pa'i mdo rtsa'i lung de la brten nas paṇa chen rin po che shākya mchog ldan yang tshul de ltar du bzhed de/ rab dbyer/dge slong sdom pa ma thob par/ /gzhan gyi mkhan slob byed pa ni/ /gsang sngags med par sbul gdug gi /zhes sogs gsungasapa la/ gser thur dri bar/ dge slong sdom pa ma thob bar/ /mkhan slob byas pas chog pa zhig /'dul ba'i mdo dang lung dag tu/ /gsal bar gsungasapa ma yin nam/ /zhesadrisanas/ dri ba po rang gisalan ni/ rab dbye'i de nyes med phun tshogs la dgongs pa yin/508

ba tshe chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()des kyang de ltar du 'du shes ma 'khrul pa zhag byung na sdom pa chags/ las gral gyi dge slong 'ga' zhig rnam dag ma yin pa la/ bsgrub byas de rnam dag yin par 'du shes nas sdom pa blangs kyang 'du shes 'khrul pas sdom pa mi chags gsungs pa'i bca' khrims dam po gsungs 'dug rang gi bsam tshod ni las gral ba 'ga' zhig rnam dag ma yin yang bsgrub bya rang la de 'dra'i dogs pa ma byung bar rnam dag yin par 'du shes na sdom pa skye ste/ mdo rtsa las/ de dang ldan pa ltar mkhan po med pa nyid la 'ong ngo / /de bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa nyid yin na 'ong ngo / /de dge slong nyid ma yin par shes na mi skye'o/ /zhes gsungs pa de'i don mkhan po lta bu las gral der gnas pa'i dge slong gi chul 'chang gang yang rung ba don la dge slong ma yin na'ang bsgrub bya la de 'dra'i the tshom/ med cing rnam dag yin par 'du shes nas blangs na sdom pa skye ba dang / de dge slong min par 'du shes na mi skye ba dngos su bstan 'dug pas so/ /'on kyang bu ston rin po che'i gsung de bstan pa la gces spras kyi phyag len dogs phyogs nas mtha' bsdams pa yin/ drang ma thag pa'i mdo rtsa'i lung de la brten nas paṇa chen rin po che shākya mchog ldan yang tshul de ltar du bzhed de/ rab dbyer/dge slong sdom pa ma thob par/ /g.yin gyi mkhan slob byed pa ni/ /gsang sngags med par sbul gdug gi /zhes sogs gsungs pa la/ gser thur dri bar/ dge slong sdom pa ma thob bar/ /mkhan slob byas pas chog pa zhig /'dul ba'i mdo dang lung dag tu/ /gsal bar gsungs pa ma yin nam/ /zhes dris nas/ dri ba po rang gis lan ni/ rab dbye'i de nyes med phun tshogs la dgongs pa yin/508

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/spyir mkhan po dang slob dpon sogs dge slong gtan naba'im yan pa'am/ tshul richal yin na'ang bsgrub bya des rnam dag yin par 'du shes shing mthong thos kyis dogs pa med par yid ches na sdom pa skye ba mdo rtsa'i dgongs par bzhed/paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa'i 'dul ba'i bslab bya chen mo'i las bzhi'i thad du'ang las gral gyi dge slong yul la lar don gyi skyon chags pa'am/ ma chags kyang rung / tshul khrims ma dag par grags nas yul de phyogs su las kyi kha skong du mi rung / de nas yul thag ring po 'ga' zhig tu gzhan la dogs pa med na der las kyi bskor du rung bar bshad 'dug pa yin/ rje btsun re mda' ba chen pos 'dul ba la ṭīk+ka mdzad/ de'ang de ltar gyi las kyi cho ga la spyir btang la mkhan po dgos kyang / dmigs bsal la las gral der mkhan po gtan nas med pa'am/ mkhan po sogs las gral ba de dang de dge slong ma yin na'ang bsgrub bya'i 'du shes kyi dbang gis sdom pa skye ba yod par bzhed/ de la dogs pa 'di byung ste/ mkhan po dge slong ma yin kyang 'du shes kyi dbang gis bsgrub bya la sdom pa (skyes pa )de'i sdom rgyun gang la 'ded/ mkhan po'i tshul 'chang ba de la ni sdom rgyun mi bzhugs pa de yin/ 'di la mdo rtsa'i tshig zin sgra ji bzhin pa'i rjes su 'grang ba dag lan ji ltar gsungs/ rje btsun re mda' bas 'dul ridzin snga ma dag gi phyag len la las slob 'os pa gzhan ma 'byor na slar las slob kyang mkhan po nyid kyis byas te bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i phyag len rim can sdi byung ba ni mi 'thad de/ mkhan slob gcig gis byed pa lung las mi gsal la/de bas mkhan po gtan med par cho ga byas na legs te/ de nyid 'dul ba'i 509

ba chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chosa'abyung gces bsdus/ () gzhud na gsal ba' phyir/ de bas na 'dul 'dzin rnams la mkhan slob gcig gisabyed pa ni mi mdzad par zhu zhes thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs se gsungs pa yod 'dug thams cad mkhyen pa klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i gsung las/'dul ba'i cho ga la/ sngon chog dang / da chog gnyisalas/ sngon chog la mkhan slob kyi rnam gzhag med cing deng sang byar yang mi rung / da ltar gyi cho ga la gsol bzhi'i las brjod pa'i tshe bsgrub bya'i ming dang mkhan po'i ming brjod pa chad na sdom pa mi skye ba nyid du gsungs pas mkhan po gtan med kyis da ltar gyi bsnyen rdzogs ston pas gsungs pa med pas de 'dra mi mdzad par zhu zhes slar rje re mda' ba nyid la thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs so zhes gsungs pa yin te/ mkhyen pa'i gter chen klu sgrub rjes mdzad pa'i dpal gyi 'khri shing gi 'dul ba'i skabs las/ mkhan slob gcig pa 'dul ba'i gzhung mi gsal//de bas mkhan po med par sgrub pa 'di/ /'dul bar gsal phyir 'di nyid rigs so zhes/ /re mda' ba sogs thal sbyar gsol ba 'debs/ /gsol bzhi'i las kyis bsnyen par rdzogs pa la/ /sngon dang da ltar byung ba gnyis su nges/ /da chog bsnyen rdzogs ming dge smurun zhes pa dang / bsgrub bya'i ming dang / mkhan porka ming / gsum tshad mi skye/ /sngon gyi cho ga deng sang byar mi rung / /mkhan po med par da ltar cho ga yis/ /bsnyen rdzogs sgrub pa'i cho ga zur pa zhig /ston pas ma gsungs khyed kyis brtsam mi rigs/ /slar yang khyed la thal sbyar gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs par mdzad/ yang bka' lugs pa dag sngon gyi 'dul ba 'dzin pa rdo rje gzhon nu'i phyag len yin zer nas bsnyen par rdzogs 'dod 510

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/kyi bsgrub bya bcu'am/ nya shu'am/ sum cu la sogadra'ipa tsam tshogs pa la mkhan po'i bya ba dus gcig car du mdzad nas/ las dngos gzhi la bsgrub bya du yod srad bus bskor bas mtshams tha dad du bcad nas bzhag mtshams de thams cad thag pa lta bus non par byas pa'i thag pa'i sne ring du brkyangs pa'i /ba na phar gdan bshams la/ der las gral gyi dge 'dun grangs tshang bzhugs nas las kyi cho ga brda sprod par byed cing / de'i tshe na bsgrub bya du yod la las kyi cho ga gcig las bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa cig car du skye bar 'dod/ de la bsnyen rdzogs thag rgya ma zer/ paṇa chen shāka mchog kyang khong chen po 'ga'i ngo bsrung ba'i phyir thag rgya ma 'di rung ba tsam yin gsung / don la paṇa chen rjes 3brang dang bcas pa de 'dra phyag len la ye mi mdzad/ tshul de la 'du khang lta bu'i gnas yangs pa zhig tu bsgrub bya bcu la sogs pa'i brgya phrag du longs pa dus gcig la bsnyen par rdzogs de mtshams nang gcig tu yin nam/ tha dad du shā /na/ dang po ltar na skud pa'am/ thag pas bcad nasamatshams tha dad du gnas par 'dod pa dang 'gal/ tha dad du yin na gtsug lag khang gcig gi nang du mtshams tha dad pa du ma ma bshad de/ gtsug lag khang de'i rtsig nang tshun mchams nang gcig tu bshad pa'i phyir/ ji skad du/ las la rtsig pa mtshams yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ dbyar gnas kyi gzhi'i thad kyi mdo rtsar/tham/sa cad non pa la gnas na non pa nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa ni dbyar rganas khas len pa'i tshe dmigs bsal gsungs pa yin gyi/ de las gzhan la sbyar bar mi bya ste/ phan tshun gcig gi dmigs bsal gcig la sbyar na thams 5//
