bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/rgyal po'i sras dang / gang ba spel dang / phyogabasnaglang la sogs pas 'grel bshad mdzad/ bod 'dir dar ma snying pos mngon pa kun btus la 'chad nyan rtsal du bton pas mngon pa gong ma dar bar mdzad/ rje btsun rin po ches mngon rtogs ljon shing du mngon pa gong 'og gnyis ga'i rnam gzhag cha tshang ba re gsungs/ khyad par mdzod kyi gnas brgyad car la don gyi snying po phul du phyin pa re yod/ de'i dbon bla ma 'phags pas mdzod kyi spyi don shes bya rab gsal bya ba brtsams/ phyis su'ang dpang lo chen pos kun btus la rnam bshad shes bya gsal byed bya ba brtsams/ 'chad nyan gyis kyang dar bar mdzad/ de'i rjes thog rgyang tsam nas mngon pa 'og ma mdzod la rnam bshad rtsom pa mang 'chad nyan kyang dar/ gong ma'i 'chad nyan bsgol bar gyur/ mchims brtson seng /mchims nam mkha' grags/ mchims blo bzang grags pa gsum gyis kyang mdzod la rnam bshad re yod/ de'i rjes su rje re mda' ba brgyud 'dzin dang bcas pas kyang rnam bshad re re mdzad/ bo dong paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis rnam bshad shes bya'i mdzod bya ba brtsams/ rang re'i kun mkhyen rong ston chen pos rnam bshad tshig don rab tu gsal bar brtsams/ paṇa chen rin po che shāka mchog gis mngon pa kun btus la bzhed tshul rgya mtsho'i rlabs kyi phreng ba bya ba dang / mdzod la spyi don chen mo bye brag bshad mtshor grags pa yod/ kun mkhyen rin po ches mdzod kyi 'grel pa ngo mtshar sum ldan/ phung khams skye mched kyi rnam gzhag ston pa ji snyed shes bya'i sgo 'byed mdzad/ kun mkhyen gyi slob ma rgyal ba mus rab 'byams pas mdzod la ṭīk+ka yongs su rdzogs pa yod/527

bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/rgyal po'i sras dang / gang ba spel dang / phyogabashaglang la sogs pas 'grel bshad mdzad/ bod 'dir dar ma snying pos mngon pa kun btus la 'chad nyan rtsal du bton pas mngon pa gong ma dar bar mdzad/ rje btsun rin po ches mngon rtogs ljon shing du mngon pa gong 'og gnyis ga'i rnam gzhag cha tshang ba re gsungs/ khyad par mdzod kyi gnas brgyad car la don gyi snying po phul du phyin pa re yod/ de'i dbon bla ma 'phags pas mdzod kyi spyi don shes bya rab gsal bya ba brtsams/ phyis su'ang dpang lo chen pos kun btus la rnam bshad shes bya gsal byed bya ba brtsams/ 'chad nyan gyis kyang dar bar mdzad/ de'i rjes thog rgyang tsam nas mngon pa 'og ma mdzod la rnam bshad rtsom pa mang 'chad nyan kyang dar/ gong ma'i 'chad nyan bskol bar gyur/ mchims brtson seng /mchims nam mkha' grags/ mchims blo bzang grags pa gsum gyis kyang mdzod la rnam bshad re yod/ de'i rjes su rje re mda' ba brgyud 'dzin dang bcas pas kyang rnam bshad re re mdzad/ bo dong paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis rnam bshad shes bya'i mdzod bya ba brtsams/ rang re'i kun mkhyen rong ston chen pos rnam bshad tshig don rab tu gsal bar brtsams/ paṇa chen rin po che shāka mchog gis mngon pa kun btus la bzhed tshul rgya mtsho'i rlabs kyi phreng ba bya ba dang / mdzod la spyi don chen mo bye brag bshad mtshor grags pa yod/ kun mkhyen rin po ches mdzod kyi 'grel pa ngo mtshar sum ldan/ phung khams skye mched kyi rnam gzhag ston pa ji snyed shes bya'i sgo 'byed mdzad/ kun mkhyen gyi slob ma rgyal ba mus rab 'byams pas mdzod la ṭīk+ka yongs su rdzogs pa yod/527

ba chen 'od snang las/ saskya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()skyed tshal ba kun mkhyen shes rab 'od zer gyis mdzod don legs par bshad pa rin po che'i 'byung gnas bya ba brtsams te/ paṇa chen gyi bye brag bshad mtsho phyogs sngar byas nas rig pa'i thal gyur 'phen lan mang po mdzad 'dug thams cad mkhyen pa klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas mdzod kyi spyi don chen mo dang / gzhung gi dka' ba'i gnas rnams la dogs gnas kyi phreng ba bkod pa dang / dbang po'i rnam gzhag dang / rgyu 'bras rkyen gsum sogs la zur bkol gyi rim pa ngo mtshar ba du ma yod/ paṇa chen gzhung brgya pas ṭīk+ka yongs rdzogasamadzad/ 'di'i mchod brjod du kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan bshad pa zhig yod 'dug sngags kyi skabs min pas mi 'thad gsungs mkhan mang /thub bstan nas 'jam dbyangs chos 'od zer gyis kyang spyi don yongs su rdzogs pa gnang yod 'dug de ltar yig cha'i rim pa mang yang mdzod rtsa 'grel gnyis brjod don zhal gsal ba dang / shes bya ji snyed pa'i rnam gzhag 'di mkhas pa rnams kyis rtogs sla bas bo dong paṇa chen dang / paṇa chen shāka mchog ma gtogs phal cher grub mtha' mi 'dra ba'i khyad par chen po med/ mkhas pa de gnyis ni mkhyen rab nam mkha' ltar yangs grags pa yin nam/ gzhung lugs kun tu grub mtha' zur dod byings dang mi mthun pa'i ha cang thal che ba re mdzad pa phyag srol la 'dug 'dir yang paṇa chen gyis sangs rgyas mtshan nyid pa ni theg chen mi slob pa'i lam bden kho na yin pas/ gang zhig kun la zhes pa nas/ don bzhin ston pa de la phyag 'tshal nas/ /zhes pa phyag 'tshal yul gyi sangs rgyas kyang spang rtogs phun sum tshogs pa'i chos sku nyid la ngos 'dzin 528

'tshechen 'od snang las/ saskya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()skyed tshal ba kun mkhyen shes rab 'od zer gyis mdzod don legs par bshad pa rin po che'i 'byung gnas bya ba brtsams te/ paṇa chen gyi bye brag bshad mtsho phyogs sngar byas nas rig pa'i thal gyur 'phen lan mang po mdzad 'dug thams cad mkhyen pa klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas mdzod kyi spyi don chen mo dang / gzhung gi dka' ba'i gnas rnams la dogs gnas kyi phreng ba bkod pa dang / dbang po'i rnam gzhag dang / rgyu 'bras rkyen gsum sogs la zur bkol gyi rim pa ngo mtshar ba du ma yod/ paṇa chen gzhung brgya pas ṭīk+ka yongs rdzogasamadzad/ 'di'i mchod brjod du kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan bshad pa zhig yod 'dug sngags kyi skabs min pas mi 'thad gsungs mkhan mang /thub bstan nas 'jam dbyangs chos 'od zer gyis kyang spyi don yongs su rdzogs pa gnang yod 'dug de ltar yig cha'i rim pa mang yang mdzod rtsa 'grel gnyis brjod don zhal gsal ba dang / shes bya ji snyed pa'i rnam gzhag 'di mkhas pa rnams kyis rtogs sla bas bo dong paṇa chen dang / paṇa chen shāka mchog ma gtogs phal cher grub mtha' mi 'dra ba'i khyad par chen po med/ mkhas pa de gnyis ni mkhyen rab nam mkha' ltar yangs grags pa yin nam/ gzhung lugs kun tu grub mtha' zur dod byings dang mi mthun pa'i ha cang thal che ba re mdzad pa phyag srol la 'dug 'dir yang paṇa chen gyis sangs rgyas mtshan nyid pa ni theg chen mi slob pa'i lam bden kho na yin pas/ gang zhig kun la zhes pa nas/ don bzhin ston pa de la phyag 'tshal nas/ /zhes pa phyag 'tshal yul gyi sangs rgyas kyang spang rtogs phun sum tshogs pa'i chos sku nyid la ngos 'dzin 528

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/dgos/ gzugs sku gzhung 'di'i mchod brjod kya yul du gyur pa sangs rgyas ma yin/ de sangs rgyas btags pa ba yin pa'i phyir gsung bar mdzad/ de ni gzhung 'di dang 'gal te/ gnas bdun pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad tshogs dang ni/ /chos sku 'gro ba'i don spyod pas/ /mnyam pa nyid de sku tshe dang / /rigs dang sku bong tshod kyis min/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas thams cad rgyu tshogs bsags pa/ 'bras bu chos sku brnyes pa/ 'gro don phrin las mdzad pa rnams mnyam zhing / sku tshe'i yun dang rigs gang yin la sogs pa tha dad du bshad cing / gal te chos sku kho na sangs rgyas yin na/ chos sku la sku tshe dang / rigs dang / sku bong la sogs pa'i rnam gzhag mi 'thad pasaso / / de ltar na/ gang zhig ces pa dang / 'og gi de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa gnyis sbrel nas/ sangs rgyas gang zhig de la phyag 'tshal zhes sbyar/ de la yon tan ji lta bu zhe na/ shes bya skye mched bcu gnyis po kun la mun pa dang 'dra ba'i mi shes pa gtan nas bcom pa spangs pa phun tshogs dang / des mtshon nas shes bya ji ltar ba dang ji snyed pa kun mkhyen pa rtogs pa phun tshogs dang /thugs rjes 'gro ba rnams 'khor ba'i 'dam las drangs te don ji lta ba bzhin chos bstan pas thar pa'i skam sar 'jog pa'i phrin las phun sum tshogs pa rnams ni skabs 'dir phyag 'tshal yul gyi sangs rgyas kyi yon tan yin no zhes pa ni/ kun la mun pa gtan bcom zhing / /'khor ba'i 'dam las 'gro ba drangs mdzad pa/ /don bzhin ston pa zhes pas bstan/ 'dir gtan gyi mun pa ni mun pa mtshan nyid pa ma yin te/ rang 'grel las/ mi shes pa ni yang dag 529

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/dgos/ gzugs sku gzhung 'di'i mchod brjod kya yul du gyur pa sangs rgyasam yin/ de sangs rgyas btags pa ba yin pa'i phyir gsung bar mdzad/ de ni gzhung 'di dang 'gal te/ gnas bdun pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad tshogs dang ni/ /chos sku 'gro ba'i don spyod pas/ /mnyam pa nyid de sku tshe dang / /rigs dang sku bong tshod kyis min/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas thams cad rgyu tshogs bsags pa/ 'brasabu chos sku brnyes pa/ 'gro don phrin las mdzad pa rnams mnyam zhing / sku tshe'i yun dang rigs gang yin la sogs pa tha dad du bshad cing / gal te chos sku kho na sangasargyas yin na/ chos sku la sku tshe dang / rigasadang / sku bong la sogasapa'i rnam gzhag mi 'thad pasaso / / de ltar na/ gang zhig cesapa dang / 'og gi de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa gnyis sbrel nas/ sangs rgyas gang zhig de la phyag 'tshal zhes sbyar/ de la yon tan ji lta bu zhe na/ shes bya skye mched bcu gnyis po kun la mun pa dang 'dra ba'i mi shes pa gtan nas bcom pa spangs pa phun tshogs dang / des mtshon nas shes bya ji ltar ba dang ji snyed pa kun mkhyen pa rtogs pa phun tshogs dang /thugs rjes 'gro ba rnams 'khor ba'i 'dam las drangs te don ji lta ba bzhin chos bstan pas thar pa'i skam sar 'jog pa'i phrin las phun sum tshogs pa rnams ni skabs 'dir phyag 'tshal yul gyi sangs rgyas kyi yon tan yin no zhes pa ni/ kun la mun pa gtan bcom zhing / /'khor ba'i 'dam las 'gro ba drangs mdzad pa/ /don bzhin ston pa zhes pas bstan/ 'dir gtan gyi mun pa ni mun pa mtshan nyid pa ma yin te/ rang 'grel las/ mi shesapa ni yang dag 529

ba tshe chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chog 'byung gces bsdus/ ()pa' don mthong ba la gegs su gyur pa' (phyir )mun pa ste zhes gsungs pas/mi shes pa'i ma rig pa ni mun pa dang chos mtshungs pas de'i ming gis bstan par byas pa yin/ mun pa mtshan nyid pa ni/ gzugs can yin te/ gzugs rnam gnyis dang rnam nyi shu/ /zhes gsungs pas shes/ mi shes pa la nyen mongs pa can dang / nyon mongs pa can ma yin pa'i mi shes pa gnyis las/ dang po ni nyon sgrib tu 'jog gnyis pa la yul gyi bskal bas mi shes pa sogs bzhir dbye ru yod pa ni ma sgrib lung ma bstan yin/ paṇa chen gyis bzhi po 'di shes sgrib yin gsungs kyang / mdzod kyi lugs 'dir spang bya la shes sgrib kyi tha snyad med/ lam la sa bcu dang / 'braba'i bu la sku gsum gyi rnam gzhag med de/ kha skong las/ bye smras rnam grol chos sku dang / /gzugs sku gnyis 'dod longs sprul gyi/ /don dang tha snyad gnyis ka med/ /ces gsungs pa 'di tshad thub pa'i legs bshad du snang / 'on kyang longs sku dang / longs sku sprul gzhin byas pa las byung ba'i sprul sku skabs 'dir med pa kun mkhyen gyi dgongs pa yin/spyir ni sprul sku med pa ma yin te/ gzugs kyi skur ston pa shākya thub pa lta bu gdul bya gang la gang 'dul gyi don du ri bong dang / stag dang / seng ge la sogs pa du mar sprul pa mdzad pa de rnams sprul sku yin pa las 'os med pa'i phyir/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i shes bya rab gsal du'ang / ston min sprul pa po dang bcas zhes pa'i mdzod gzhung drangs nas sprul sku yod par gsungs pa yin/ gong du smos pa de ltar mchod par brjod nas/ las su bya ba ston pa la/ chos mngon mdzod kyi bstan bcos rab bshad bya/ /zhes pa 'di 530

bgechen 'od snang las/ saskya'i choga'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()pa' don mthong ba la gegs su gyur pa' (phyir )mun pa ste zhes gsungs pas/mi shes pa'i ma rig pa ni mun pa dang chos mtshungs pas de'i ming gis bstan par byas pa yin/ mun pa mtshan nyid pa ni/ gzugs can yin te/ gzugs rnam gnyis dang rnam nyi shu/ /zhes gsungasapas shes/ mi shes pa la nyon mongs pa can dang / nyon mongs pa can ma yin pa'i mi sheba'ipa gnyis las/ dang po ni nyon sgrib tu 'jog gnyis pa la yul gyi bskal bas mi shes pa sogs bzhir dbye ru yod pa ni ma sgrib lung ma bstan yin/ paṇa chen gyis bzhi po 'di shes sgrib yin gsungs kyang / mdzod kyi lugs 'dir spang bya la shes sgrib kyi tha snyad med/ lam la sa bcu dang / 'brasabu la sku gsum gyi rnam gzhag med de/ kha skong las/ bye smras rnam grol chos sku dang / /gzugs sku gnyis 'dod longs sprul gyi/ /don dang tha snyad gnyis ka med/ /ces gsungs pa 'di tshad thub pa'i legs bshad du snang / 'on kyang longasasku dang / longs sku sprul gzhir byas pa las byung ba'i sprul sku skabs 'dir med pa kun mkhyen gyi dgongs pa yin/spyir ni sprul sku med pa ma yin te/ gzugs kyi skur ston pa shākya thub pa lta bu gdul bya gang la gang 'dul gyi don du ri bong dang / stag dang / seng ge la sogs pa du mar sprul pa mdzad pa de rnams sprul sku yin pa las 'os med pa'i phyir/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i shes bya rab gsal du'ang / ston min sprul pa po dang bcas zhes pa'i mdzod gzhung drangs nas sprul sku yod par gsungs pa yin/ gong du smos pa de ltar mchod par brjod nas/ las su bya ba ston pa la/ chos mngon mdzod kyi bstan bcosarab bshad bya/ /zhes pa 'di 530

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/byung / de lta bu' bshad bya'i chos mngon pa de la dbye na/ don dam pa'i chos ma/ngon pa dang / brdar btags pa'i chos mngon pa gnyis las/ dang po don dam ston pa la/ chos mngon shes rab dri med rjes 'brang bcas/ /zhes gsungs te/don ni zag med kyi shes rab dang / de'i rjes 'brang gang rung du gyur pa'i lam de don dam pa'i chos mngon pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na mthong sgom mi slob lam dang gsum du yod/ deng sang gi mtshan nyid pa phal cher don dam pa'i chos mngon pa dang / lam bden don gcig par 'dod kyang / dbyig gnyen gyi dgongs pa ma yin/ rgyu mtshan ni gzhung 'dir de ni chos mchog dang sa gcig /ces dang / sadagu'i lam ni phan tshun du/ /zhes gsungs pas/ mthong lam du gyur pa'i chos mngon pa bsam gtan sa drug gang rung la brten/ sgom lam dang mi slob lam du gyur pa'i chos mngon pa bsam gtan sa drug dang gzugs med dang po gsum gyi snyoms 'jug ste/ rgyu zag med sa dgu gang rung la brten dgos la/ de ltar brten pa'i tshe na rten gzhi'i sa de rnams don dam pa'i chos mngon pa ma yin te/ de rnams de'i rten du gyur pa yin pa'i phyir/ rten dang brten pa'i tshul la/ ngo mtshar sum ldan las/ grub bde rdzas gcig pa'i tshul gyis brten par gsungs/ yang 'dir paṇa chen gyis/ chos mngon pa mtshan nyid pa la brjod bya don dang / rjod byed ming gi mngon pa gnyis yod la/ dang po ni/lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa 'khor dang bcas pa dang / gnyis pa ni de ston pa'i gsung rab dag go /bod kyi slob dpon dag gis brdar btags pa'i chos mngon pa gnyis po chos mngon pa mtshan nyid pa ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa de 531

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/byung / de lta bu' bshad bya'i chos mngon pa de la dbye na/ don dam pa'i chos ma/ngon pa dang / brdar btags pa'i chos mngon pa gnyis las/ dang po don dam ston pa la/ chos mngon shes rab dri med rjes 'brang bcas/ /zhes gsungs te/don ni zag med kyi shes rab dang / de'i rjes 'brang gang rung du gyur pa'i lam de don dam pa'i chos mngon pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na mthong sgom mi slob lam dang gsum du yod/ deng sang gi mtshan nyid pa phal cher don dam pa'i chos mngon pa dang / lam bden don gcig par 'dod kyang / dbyig gnyen gyi dgongs pa ma yin/ rgyu mtshan ni gzhung 'dir de ni chos mchog dang sa gcig /ces dang / sadagu'i lam ni phan tshun du/ /zhes gsungs pas/ mthong lam du gyur pa'i chos mngon pa bsam gtan sa drug gang rung la brten/ sgom lam dang mi slob lam du gyur pa'i chos mngon pa bsam gtan sa drug dang gzugs med dang po gsum gyi snyoms 'jug ste/ rgyu zag med sa dgu gang rung la brten dgos la/ de ltar brten pa'i tshe na rten gzhi'i sa de rnams don dam pa'i chos mngon pa ma yin te/ de rnams de'i rten du gyur pa yin pa'i phyir/ rten dang brten pa'i tshul la/ ngo mtshar sum ldan las/ grub bde rdzas gcig pa'i tshul gyis brten par gsungs/ yang 'dir paṇa chen gyis/ chos mngon pa mtshan nyid pa la brjod bya don dang / rjod byed ming gi mngon pa gnyis yod la/ dang po ni/lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa 'khor dang bcas pa dang / gnyis pa ni de ston pa'i gsung rab dag go /bod kyi slob dpon dag gis brdar btags pa'i chos mngon pa gnyis po chos mngon pa mtshan nyid pa ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa de 531

ba chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()mi 'thad de/ zhes sogs bkod pa gnang bas/ grub mtha' ha cang thal che bar snang ngo / /mkhasapa byings ni/ de thob bya phyir gang dang bstan bcos gang / /zhes pas bstan pa'i lam mngon pa ni mthong lam gyi sngon du byung ba'i zag bcas kyi shes rab rjes 'brang dang bcas pa dang / gzhung mngon pa ni mngon pa sde bdun la sogs rjod byed tshig gi mngon pa la 'jog cing / de dag mngon nga/ btags pa ba yin te/ brdar btags kyi chos mngon pa yin pa'i phyir gsung bar snang / de nas bshad bya gzhung gi don dngos la lus rnam gzhag dang /gnas brgyad so sor bstan pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ zag bcas zag pa med chos rnams/ /zhes pa nas/ lta gnas srid pa'ang de dag yin/ /zhesapa'i bar gyis bstan/ gnyis pa gnas brgyad so sor bshad pa ni/ thar pa don gnyer gyis dang / shes par bya ba'i yul phung khams skye mched kyi rnam gzhag ston pa la/gzugs ni dbang po lnga dang don/ /lnga dang rnam rig byed min nyid/ /ces pa nas/ bcu gnyis nang gir bshad dbang po/ /zhes pa'i bar gnas dang po'i gzhung tshogs 'di dag gis bstan/ de'i rjes su shes par bya ba'i yul gzhan yang dbang po nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyi rnam gzhag dang / 'dus byas rgyu rkyen las skye tshul/ skyed byed rgyu rkyen 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i rnam gzhag 'chad pa ni/ lnga po rnams ni don bzhi la/ /zhes pa nas/ slob pa la bzhi lhag la de/ /zhesapa'i bar gnas gnyis pa'i gzhung tshogs rnams kyis bstan/ de'i rjes su shes par bya ba'i yul shes bya ji lta ba la bden pa bzhi las/ dang po sdug bsngal bden pa bcud kyi sems can dang / de skye ba'i gnas snod kyi 'jig rten la 'jog 532

'tshechen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()mi 'thad de/ zhes sogs bkod pa gnang bas/ grub mtha' ha cang thal che bar snang ngo / /mkhasapa byings ni/ de thob bya phyir gang dang bstan bcos gang / /zhes pas bstan pa'i lam mngon pa ni mthong lam gyi sngon du byung ba'i zag bcas kyi shes rab rjes 'brang dang bcas pa dang / gzhung mngon pa ni mngon pa sde bdun la sogs rjod byed tshig gi mngon pa la 'jog cing / de dag mngon nga/ btags pa ba yin te/ brdar btags kyi chos mngon pa yin pa'i phyir gsung bar snang / de nas bshad bya gzhung gi don dngos la lus rnam gzhag dang /gnas brgyad so sor bstan pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ zag bcas zag pa med chos rnams/ /zhes pa nas/ lta gnas srid pa'ang de dag yin/ /zhesapa'i bar gyis bstan/ gnyis pa gnas brgyad so sor bshad pa ni/ thar pa don gnyer gyis dang / shes par bya ba'i yul phung khams skye mched kyi rnam gzhag ston pa la/gzugs ni dbang po lnga dang don/ /lnga dang rnam rig byed min nyid/ /ces pa nas/ bcu gnyis nang gir bshad dbang po/ /zhes pa'i bar gnas dang po'i gzhung tshogs 'di dag gis bstan/ de'i rjes su shes par bya ba'i yul gzhan yang dbang po nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyi rnam gzhag dang / 'dus byas rgyu rkyen las skye tshul/ skyed byed rgyu rkyen 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i rnam gzhag 'chad pa ni/ lnga po rnams ni don bzhi la/ /zhes pa nas/ slob pa la bzhi lhag la de/ /zhesapa'i bar gnas gnyis pa'i gzhung tshogs rnams kyis bstan/ de'i rjes su shes par bya ba'i yul shes bya ji lta ba la bden pa bzhi las/ dang po sdug bsngal bden pa bcud kyi sems can dang / de skye ba'i gnas snod kyi 'jig rten la 'jog 532

bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/pas de dag gi rnam gzhag ni/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang / /zhes sogs gnas gsum pa'i gzhung tshogs rnams kyis bstan/ de dag gi rgyu kun 'byung bden pa la las dang / nyon mongs gnyis las/ nyon mongs pa'i rnam gzhag ni/ srid pa'i rtsa ba phra rgyas drug /ces sogs gnas lnga pas bstan/ de gnyis ni kun nas nyon mongs kyi phyogs yin la/ de nas rnam byang gi phyogs lam nyams su len pa'i chul ni/ bden pa mthong dang bsgoms pa las/ /zhes so/gas gnas drug pa'i gzhung tshogs rnams kyis bstan/ lam nyams su blangs pa las 'bras bu yongs shes thob tshul ni/ dri med bzod rnam shes pa min/ /zhes sogs gnas bdun pas bstan/ drug pa bstan pa'i gnyen por lam bden gyi rten du bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug sogs dgos pas/ de dag gi na ma gzhag ni/ bsam gtan dag ni rnam/ gnyis bzhi/ /zhes sogs gnas brgyad pa bstan pa zhes bya bas bstan/ de ltar gnas brgyad po de dag gis ni thar pa don gnyer gcig gis shes par bya ba'i yul thos bsam gyis gtan la dbab bya dang / lam sgom pas nyams su len chul/ nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu dang gsum gyi sgo nas thar pa'i lam rim yongs su rdzogs pa zhig bstan pa yin/ da ni de dag la dogs slong dang mtha' dpyod kyi rim pa cung zad re brjod na/ gnas dang por/ spungs dang skye sgo rigs kyi don/ /phung po skye mched khams rnams yin/ /zhes gsungs pas du ma spungs pa phung po'i mtshan nyid dang / sems dang sems byung skye ba'i sgor gyur pa skye mched kyi mtshan nyid dang / sems sems byung 'byung ba'i rigs te khams kyi mchan nyid yin par 533

bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/pas de dag gi rnam gzhag ni/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang / /zhes sogs gnas gsum pa'i gzhung tshogs rnams kyis bstan/ de dag gi rgyu kun 'byung bden pa la las dang / nyon mongs gnyis las/ nyon mongs pa'i rnam gzhag ni/ srid pa'i rtsa ba phra rgyas drug /ces sogs gnas lnga pas bstan/ de gnyis ni kun nas nyon mongs kyi phyogs yin la/ de nas rnam byang gi phyogs lam nyams su len pa'i chul ni/ bden pa mthong dang bsgoms pa las/ /zhes so/gas gnas drug pa'i gzhung tshogs rnams kyis bstan/ lam nyams su blangs pa las 'bras bu yongs shes thob tshul ni/ dri med bzod rnam shes pa min/ /zhes sogs gnas bdun pas bstan/ drug pa bstan pa'i gnyen por lam bden gyi rten du bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug sogs dgos pas/ de dag gi na ma gzhag ni/ bsam gtan dag ni rnam/ gnyis bzhi/ /zhes sogs gnas brgyad pa bstan pa zhes bya bas bstan/ de ltar gnas brgyad po de dag gis ni thar pa don gnyer gcig gis shes par bya ba'i yul thos bsam gyis gtan la dbab bya dang / lam sgom pas nyams su len chul/ nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu dang gsum gyi sgo nas thar pa'i lam rim yongs su rdzogs pa zhig bstan pa yin/ da ni de dag la dogs slong dang mtha' dpyod kyi rim pa cung zad re brjod na/ gnas dang por/ spungs dang skye sgo rigs kyi don/ /phung po skye mched khams rnams yin/ /zhes gsungs pas du ma spungs pa phung po'i mtshan nyid dang / sems dang sems byung skye ba'i sgor gyur pa skye mched kyi mtshan nyid dang / sems sems byung 'byung ba'i rigs te khams kyi mchan nyid yin par 533

brtse chen 'od snang las/ saskya'i chosa'abyung gces bsdus/ lta'i/khas len dgos la/ de blangs na dogs pa ram bzhin 'ong ste/ 'o na/ phyogs cha med kyi rdul phran yan gar ba de phung po yin nam/ ma yin/ yin na de la du ma/ spungs pa ma tshang bas phung por ji ltar 'thad/ de phung po ma yin na 'dus byas/ la phung po lngar grangs ma nges par thal ba dang / rdul phran yan gar ba de gzugs can ma yin par thal ba'i spyon yang 'byung / dogs pa gnyis nga/ ni/gzugs kyi skye mched ma 'ongs pa mi skye ba'i chos can la sogs pa rnams la skye mched kyi ma nyid de ma tshang ste/ de rnams skye ba'i sgor gyur pa ma yin nga/ 'i phyir te/ de rnams mi skye ba'i chos can yin pa'i phyir/ dogs pa gsum pa ni/ rma/ 'ongs mi skye ba'i don gyi khams sogs la sngar gyi ma nyid ma tshang bas de rnams khams ma yin par thal ba'i dogs pa 'byung / yang khams go rim 'chang pa na/ da lta'i don phyir dang po lnga/ /zhes gsungs pas mig la sogs pa rten dbang po'i khams drug gi nang nas dang po lnga yul da lta ba kho na la 'jug pas/ sngon la bsten/ yid kyi khams yul dus gsum dang / dus kyis ma bsdus pa/ la'ang 'jug pas rjes la bstan par mdzod rtsa 'grel las gsungs pa yin la/de ltar na mig khams nas lus khams kyi bar lnga po de la dus kyi sgo nas dus/ gsum du yod pa'i/ 'das ma 'ongs gnyis kyang yul da lta ba la 'jug dgos/de zhugs na mig dbang 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa sogs kyi yul de da lta ba gang yin dris na cung zad dka' ba snang / yang khams kyi rnam pa'i rab dbye 'chad pa/ na / bstan yod 'dir ni gzugs gcig pu/ /zhes gsungs pas/ khams bco brgyad tsu nang nas gzugs khams ni/ mig gi yul du bstan du yod pa dang /534

brtse chen 'od snang las/ saskya'i chosa'abyung gces bsdus/ (nakhas len dgos la/ de blangs na dogs pa ram bzhin 'ong ste/ 'o na/ phyogs cha med kyi rdul phran yan gar ba de phung po yin nam/ ma yin/ yin na de la du ma/ spungs pa ma tshang bas phung por ji ltar 'thad/ de phung po ma yin na 'dus byas/ la phung po lngar grangs ma nges par thal ba dang / rdul phran yan gar ba de gzugs can ma yin par thal ba'i spyon yang 'byung / dogs pa gnyis nga/ ni/gzugs kyi skye mched ma 'ongs pa mi skye ba'i chos can la sogs pa rnams la skye mched kyi ma nyid de ma tshang ste/ de rnams skye ba'i sgor gyur pa ma yin nga/ 'i phyir te/ de rnams mi skye ba'i chos can yin pa'i phyir/ dogs pa gsum pa ni/ rma/ 'ongs mi skye ba'i don gyi khams sogs la sngar gyi ma nyid ma tshang bas de rnams khams ma yin par thal ba'i dogs pa 'byung / yang khams go rim 'chang pa na/ da lta'i don phyir dang po lnga/ /zhes gsungs pas mig la sogs pa rten dbang po'i khams drug gi nang nas dang po lnga yul da lta ba kho na la 'jug pas/ sngon la bsten/ yid kyi khams yul dus gsum dang / dus kyis ma bsdus pa/ la'ang 'jug pas rjes la bstan par mdzod rtsa 'grel las gsungs pa yin la/de ltar na mig khams nas lus khams kyi bar lnga po de la dus kyi sgo nas dus/ gsum du yod pa'i/ 'das ma 'ongs gnyis kyang yul da lta ba la 'jug dgos/de zhugs na mig dbang 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa sogs kyi yul de da lta ba gang yin dris na cung zad dka' ba snang / yang khams kyi rnam pa'i rab dbye 'chad pa/ na / bstan yod 'dir ni gzugs gcig pu/ /zhes gsungs pas/ khams bco brgyad tsu nang nas gzugs khams ni/ mig gi yul du bstan du yod pa dang /534

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam//bams gzhan bcu bdun no mag yul du bstan du med pa' khams yin par gsungs la/ khams gzhan bcu bdun de bzhin yin kyang / gzugs kyi khams snyel bstan du yod pas ma khyab ste/ mig gi yul du ma gyur pa'i rdul phran yan gar ba gzugs can gyi chung mthar gyur pa rnams dang / ma 'ongs pa mi skye ba'i chos can gyi gzugs khams rnams kyang mig gi yul du mthong byar med pa'i phyir snyam pa'i dogs pa 'byung / yang khams bco brgyad la rten bcas dang / de mtshungs kyi dbye ba 'chad pa la/ gnas dang por/ rten pa dang bcas mtshungs pa dag kyang yin/ /gang zhig rang gi las mi byed/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don/ chos /bams ni rten bcas kho na yin te/ khams rang gi byed las byed pa'i phyir//bams lhag ma bcu bdun la rten bcas dang / de mtshungs gnyis su yod de//bams rang gi byed las byed mi byed gnyis gnyis su yod pa'i phyir zhes bzhed la / de lta na'ang gnas gnyas par/ rten dang dmigs dang rnam bcas dang / /mchungs par ldan pa'ang rnam pa lnga/ /zhes gsungs pas sems sems byung gang rung dang / rten bcas dang / dmigs bcas dang / mtshungs ldan rnams don gcig par bstan la/ de'i tshe na sems kyi khams bdun dang / chos khams kyi phyed dang / sems byung rnams rten bcas kyi khams 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur bas/gnas dang por sems kyi khams bdun sogs la rten bcas dang / de mtshungs gnyis gnyis yod par gsungs pa dang 'gal ba ltar snang / yang gnas gnyis par/ btang snyoms dang ni srog dang ni/ /yid dang ldan la nges sum ldan/ /zhes gsungs pas/ sems can gang la tshor ba btang snyoms kyi dbang po/ srog gi 535

bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam//bams gzhan bcu bdun no mag yul du bstan du med pa' khams yin par gsungs la/ khamasagazhan bcu bdun de bzhin yin kyang / gzugs kyi khams snyel bstan du yod pas ma khyab ste/ mig gi yul du ma gyur pa'i rdul phran yan gar ba gzugs can gyi chung mthar gyur pa rnams dang / ma 'ongs pa mi skye ba'i chos can gyi gzugs khams rnams kyang mig gi yul du mthong byar med pa'i phyir snyam pa'i dogs pa 'byung / yang khams bco brgyad la rten bcas dang / de mtshungs kyi dbye ba 'chad pa la/ gnas dang por/ rten pa dang bcas mtshungs pa dag kyang yin/ /gang zhig rang gi lasami byed/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don/ chos /bams ni rten bcas kho na yin te/ khams rang gi byed las byed pa'i phyir//bams lhag ma bcu bdun la rten bcas dang / de mtshungs gnyis su yod de//bams rang gi byed las byed mi byed gnyis gnyis su yod pa'i phyir zhes bzhed la / de lta na'ang gnasaganyis par/ rten dang dmigs dang rnam bcasadang / /mchungs par ldan pa'ang rnam pa lnga/ /zhes gsungs pas sems sems byung gang rung dang / rten bcas dang / dmigs bcas dang / mtshungs ldan rnams don gcig par bstan la/ de'i tshe na sems kyi khams bdun dang / chos khams kyi phyed dang / sems byung rnams rten bcas kyi khams 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur bas/gnas dang por sems kyi khams bdun sogs la rten bcas dang / de mtshungs gnyis gnyis yod par gsungs pa dang 'gal ba ltar snang / yang gnas gnyis par/ btang snyoms dang ni srog dang ni/ /yid dang ldan la nges sum ldan/ /zhes gsungs pas/ sems can gang la tshor ba btang snyoms kyi dbang po/ srog gi 535

brtse chen 'od snang las/ saskya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()dbang po/ yid kyi dbang po dang gsum gang rung ga ldan na/ de gsum ka nges par ldan pas khyab pa mdzod kyi dgongs pa yin la/ de ltar na gnas dang por/ g.yengs dang sems med pa yi yang / /zhes gsungasapa'i don 'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug dang / 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug la gnas pa'i gnas skabs de sems med kyi gnas skabs su bshad la/ de bas na snyoms 'jug de gnyis la gnas pa'i sems can la srog dbang yod pas yid dbang dang btang snyoms kyi dbang po'ang yod dgos pa nges ldan gyi don du snang / gal te snyoms 'jug de gnyis la gnas pa'i dus su yid dbang yod na gtso sems yod pas sems med kyi gnas skabs su bshad pa dang 'gal ba ltar snang ba'i dogs pa byung / lugs 'dir chos thams cad shes bya gzhi lnga'i sgo nas gtan 'a/ 'bebs pa mngon rtogs ljon shing las gsungs la/ de ltar gsungs pa'i gzugs kyi gzhi ni gzugs phung dang don gcig de la dbye na bcu gcig yod pa ni/ gzugs ni dbang po lnga dang zhes sogs kyis bstan/ gtso bo sems kyi gzhi dang / 'khor sems byung gi gzhi ni gnas gnyis par/ semasadang sems byung nges lhan cig/ces sogs kyi skabs su rgyas par gsungs/ gtso bo'i sems ni rnam shes kyi phung po dang don gcig dbye na mig gi rnam shes sogs tshogs drug tu yod/ sems byung gi gzhi la/ mdzod las/ thob pa'am sems byung rnam lnga ste/ /sa mang la sogs tha dad phyir/ /zhesagasungasapas/ semasakyi sa mang dang / dge ba'i sa mang la sogs pa lnga'i sgo nasadabye ste/ dngosabastan bzhi bcu zhe drug tu gsungs pa ni rdzas yod kyi dbang du byas pa yin la/ de'i 536

brtse chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()dbang po/ yid kyi dbang po dang gsum gang rung ga ldan na/ de gsum ka nges par ldan pas khyab pa mdzod kyi dgongs pa yin la/ de ltar na gnas dang por/ g.yengs dang sems med pa yi yang / /zhes gsungs pa'i don 'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug dang / 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug la gnas pa'i gnas skabs de sems med kyi gnas skabs su bshad la/ de bas na snyoms 'jug de gnyis la gnas pa'i sems can la srog dbang yod pas yid dbang dang btang snyoms kyi dbang po'ang yod dgos pa nges ldan gyi don du snang / gal te snyoms 'jug de gnyis la gnas pa'i dus su yid dbang yod na gtso sems yod pas sems med kyi gnas skabs su bshad pa dang 'gal ba ltar snang ba'i dogs pa byung / lugs 'dir chos thams cad shes bya gzhi lnga'i sgo nas gtan 'a/ 'bebs pa mngon rtogs ljon shing las gsungs la/ de ltar gsungs pa'i gzugs kyi gzhi ni gzugs phung dang don gcig de la dbye na bcu gcig yod pa ni/ gzugs ni dbang po lnga dang zhes sogs kyis bstan/ gtso bo sems kyi gzhi dang / 'khor sems byung gi gzhi ni gnas gnyis par/ sems dang sems byung nges lhan cig/ces sogs kyi skabs su rbas par gsungs/ gtso bo'i sems ni rnam shes kyi phung po dang don gcig dbye na mig gi rnam shes sogs tshogs drug tu yod/ sems byung gi gzhi la/ mdzod las/ thob pa'am sems byung rnam lnga ste/ /sa mang la sogs tha dad phyir/ /zhes gsungs pas/ sems kyi sa mang dang / dge ba'i sa mang la sogs pa lnga'i sgo nas dbye ste/ dngos bstan bzhi bcu zhe drug tu gsungs pa ni rdzas yod kyi dbang du byas pa yin la/ de'i 536

bod kyi ma/bas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/steng du brjed ngas dang / le lo la sogs pa'i sems byung lnga bsnan pas lnga bcu nga gcig tu 'gyur ba ni mngon pa gong 'og gnyis skar don gyi bzhed pa mthun dgos la/ rje btsun gyi ljon shing las kyang / sems las byung ba'i gzhi lnga bcu rtsa gcig go /zhes gsungs pa yin/ bzhi pa ldan pa ma yin pa'i 'du byed kyi gzhi ni/ sems dang mtshungs ldan ma yin pa'i 'du byed ces bya ste/ gzhung 'dir thob pa dang ma thob pa la sogs pa bcu bzhir dbye la/ mngon pa gong mar nyer gsum du dbye/ lnga pa 'dusam byas kyi gzhi ni/ nam mkha' dang / so sor brtags 'gog dang / brtags min gyi 'gog pa dang gsum du gsungs/gzhi lnga po de thams cad rdzas yod dang / dngos po yin te/ 'dus ma byasagasum ni rtag pa'i dngos po dang / gzugs nas ldan min 'du byed kyi bar ni mi/ rtag par gyur pa'i dngos po yin pa'i phyir/ sems byung btags yod rnamasakyang rdzas yod du 'dod dgos te/ rten gyi don byed nus pa'i rdzas yod yin pa'i phyi ra/ don dam bden pa dang / don dam par yod pa ngos 'dzin pa na/ ljon shing las/sngar bstan pa'i shes bya gzhi lnga po de tsam zhig yin par sems so/ /zhes dang / kun mkhyen gyi dbu ma stong thun las/ shes bya gzhi lngas bsdus pa'i do na dam bden pa bden par grub pas chad mtha' las grol/ phung po la brten nas btags pa'i gang zag dang / rags pa dang rgyun la bzhag pa'i chos kyis bsdus pa'i kun rdzob bden pa bden par med pas rtag mtha' las grol ba bye brag smra ba'i lugs kyi rtag chad spong tshul du gsungs pa lags/ de ltar na shes bya gzhi lnga bden gnyis kyi nang nas don dam bden pa 'ba' zhig yin par 537

bod kyi ma/bas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/steng du brjed ngas dang / le lo la sogs pa'i sems byung lnga bsnan pas lnga bcu nga gcig tu 'gyur ba ni mngon pa gong 'og gnyis skar don gyi bzhed pa mthun dgos la/ rje btsun gyi ljon shing las kyang / sems las byung ba'i gzhi lnga bcu rtsa gcig go /zhes gsungs pa yin/ bzhi pa ldan pa ma yin pa'i 'du byed kyi gzhi ni/ sems dang mtshungs ldan ma yin pa'i 'du byed ces bya ste/ gzhung 'dir thob pa dang ma thob pa la sogs pa bcu bzhir dbye la/ mngon pa gong mar nyer gsum du dbye/ lnga pa 'dusam byas kyi gzhi ni/ nam mkha' dang / so sor brtags 'gog dang / brtags min gyi 'gog pa dang gsum du gsungs/gzhi lnga po de thams cad rdzas yod dang / dngos po yin te/ 'dus ma byasagasum ni rtag pa'i dngos po dang / gzugs nas ldan min 'du byed kyi bar ni mi/ rtag par gyur pa'i dngos po yin pa'i phyir/ sems byung btags yod rnamasakyang rdzas yod du 'dod dgos te/ rten gyi don byed nus pa'i rdzas yod yin pa'i phyi ra/ don dam bden pa dang / don dam par yod pa ngos 'dzin pa na/ ljon shing las/sngar bstan pa'i shes bya gzhi lnga po de tsam zhig yin par sems so/ /zhes dang / kun mkhyen gyi dbu ma stong thun las/ shes bya gzhi lngas bsdus pa'i do na dam bden pa bden par grub pas chad mtha' las grol/ phung po la brten nas btags pa'i gang zag dang / rags pa dang rgyun la bayig pa'i chos kyis bsdus pa'i kun rdzob bden pa bden par med pas rtag mtha' las grol ba bye brag smra ba'i lugs kyi rtag chad spong tshul du gsungs pa lags/ de ltar na shes bya gzhi lnga bden gnyis kyi nang nas don dam bden pa 'ba' zhig yin par 537

bgechen 'odasnang las/ saskya'i mosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()bshad pa lta bur snang la/ de byasan/ bum chu ba du kun rdzob tu/ /yod de don dam yod gzhan no/ /zhesagasungasapa dang thug gi dogs pa byung ste/ rang gisam go ba yin pa 'dra/ gnas gsum par/ dbyar gyi zla ba gnyis pa yi/ /mtha' ma'i tshes dgu nas mtshan ring / /dgun rnamasakyi ni bzhi pa la/ /thur ngur 'gyur ro nyin mo ldog /ces gsungs pa'i don la/ bo dong paṇa chen gyi shes bya'i mdzod du/ dbyar dgun gyi nyi ma ldog mtshams bstan par bzhed cing/mkhas pa gzhan dag gi bzhed pa sun 'byin par mdzad pa'ang gnang / don ni/dgun rnams kyi ni bzhi pa la/ /zhesapa de dbo zla yin zhing / de la dpyid nyin mnyam ma mnyam pa 'byung ba dang / dbyar zla gnyis pa de khrums zla ba yin zhing / de la ston nyin mnyam mtshan mnyam pa 'byung bar ston pa yin/ ldan min 'du byed kyi dbye ba thob pa 'chad pa na/ gnas gnyisapar/ slob dang mi slob min gyi gsum/ /zhesasogs dang / de'i tshig rkang dang po'i 'grel par/ slob pa'i thob pa ni slob pa dang / mi slob pa'i thob pa ni mi slob pa dang / zhes sogasagasungasal/ de'i don ni/ mthong lam dang / zag med sgom lam slob par byas nas/ de dag gi thob pa slob pa'am/ zag med kyi slob lam yin/ de bzhin mi slob lam mi slob par byas nas/ de'i thob pa mi slob lam yin pa dang / slob lam zag med dang / mi slob lam gang yang ma yin pa'i chos rnams kyi thob pa la mu gsum du dbye ba sogs bstan pa 'di las 'phros nas paṇa chen gyi bye brag bshad mtsho las/ slob pa dang / mi slob pa dang / 'phagasapa sogs kyang zag med kyi lam nyid la 'chad pa yin gyi/ gang zag la mi 'jog la/ de 538

bam chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chosang gces bsdus/ ()bshad pa lta bur snang la/ de byas na/ bum chu ba du kun rdzob tu/ /yod de don dam yod gzhan no/ /zhes gsungs pa dang thug gi dogs pa byung ste/ rang gis ma go ba yin pa 'dra/ gnas gsum par/ dbyar gyi zla ba gnyis pa yi/ /mtha' ma'i tshes dgu nas mtshan ring / /dgun rnams kyi ni bzhi pa la/ /thur ngur 'gyur ro nyin mo ldog /ces gsungs pa'i don la/ bo dong paṇa wo gyi shes bya'i mdzod du/ dbyar dgun gyi nyi ma ldog mtshams bstan par bzhed cing/mkhas pa g.yin dag gi bzhed pa sun 'byin par mdzad pa'ang gnang / don ni/dgun rnams kyi ni bzhi pa la/ /zhes pa de dbo zla yin zhing / de la dpyid nyin mnyam mtshan mnyam pa 'byung ba dang / dbyar zla gnyis pa de khrums zla ba yin zhing / de la ston nyin mnyam mtshan mnyam pa 'byung bar ston pa yin/ ldan min 'du byed kyi dbye ba thob pa 'chad pa na/ gnas gnyis par/ slob dang mi slob min gyi gsum/ /zhes sogs dang / de'i tshig rkang dang po'i 'grel par/ slob pa'i thob pa ni slob pa dang / mi slob pa'i thob pa ni mi slob pa dang / zhes sogs gsungs la/ de'i don ni/ mthong lam dang / zag med sgom lam slob par byas nas/ de dag gi thob pa slob pa'am/ zag med kyi slob lam yin/ de bzhin mi slob lam mi slob par byas nas/ de'i thob pa mi slob lam yin pa dang / slob lam zag med dang / mi slob lam gang yang ma yin pa'i chos rnams kyi thob pa la mu gsum du dbye ba sogs bstan pa 'di las 'phros nas paṇa chen gyi bye brag bshad mtsho las/ slob pa dang / mi slob pa dang / 'phags pa sogs kyang zag med kyi lam nyid la 'chad pa yin gyi/ gang zag la mi 'jog la/ de 538

bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gartam/krazhin du dge slong dge tshul sogs kyang sdom pa kho na yin gya/ rten gyi gang zag la 'jog pa ma yin no zhes gsungs/ skyed tshal ba kun mkhyen shesarab 'od zer bas phar phyin sogs dang sgo mthun par slob pa dang / mi slob pa dang /'phags pa rnams gang zag kho nar 'jog de bzhin du dge slong dge chul sogs kyang rten gyi gang zag kho na la 'jog pas paṇa dang bzhed tshul tha dad du byung / yang kun mkhyen po'i ngo mtshar sum ldan las/ des na bye brag tu smra bsaso so skye bo nyid dang / de dang ldan pa'i gang zag tha dad du byed de/ snga ma ni phung po rdzas yod dang / phyi ma ni gang zag btags yod du 'dod pa'i phyir ro / / 'o na/ 'phagasapa dang / de dang ldan pa'i gang zag tha dad du byed par 'gyur ro zhe na/ de'ang byed de/ snga ma ni mthong sgom mi slob lam gyis bsdus pa'i lam zag med dang /phyi ma ni gang zag btags yod du 'dod pa'i phyir ro//zhes gsungs pas lam bden gyi ma thob pa so sor skye bo dang / lam bden kun 3phags pa yin par bzhed rgyu yin 'dug pa/ de ltar na so so skye bo dang 'phags pa la gang zag gis ma khyab pa paṇa chen dang mthun 'dug 'on kyang 'phags pa sogs zag med kyi lam kho nar ma nges pa ste/ gnas gsum par/'phags dang mtshams med byed pa dag /cesapa'i rang 'grel du/ 'phagasapa rnams gang zag gang chedan/ gang la 'phags pa'i lam skyes pa'o/ /ces/dang /drug par/ de tshe de mi slob dgra bcom/ /zhesapa'i 'grel par/ gang zag sngar bshad pa gzhan bdun slob pa dag yin no/ /zhes bya bar grub bo/ /zhes sogs 'thad pa dang bcas pa gsungs bas/ 'phags lam rgyud la skyeba'ipa'i gang zag 539

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel ga rtam/bzhan du dge slong dge tshul sogs kyang sdom pa kho na yin gya/ rten gyi gang zag la 'jog pa ma yin no zhes gsungs/ skyed tshal ba kun mkhyen shes rab 'od zer bas phar phyin sogs dang sgo mthun par slob pa dang / mi slob pa dang /'phags pa rnams gang zag kho nar 'jog de bzhin du dge slong dge chul sogs kyang rten gyi gang zag kho na la 'jog pas paṇa chen dang bzhed tshul tha dad du byung / yang kun mkhyen chen po'i ngo mtshar sum ldan las/ des na bye brag tu smra bas so so skye bo nyid dang / de dang ldan pa'i gang zag tha dad du byed de/ snga ma ni phung po rdzas yod dang / phyi ma ni gang zag btags yod du 'dod pa'i phyir ro / / 'o na/ 'phags pa dang / de dang ldan pa'i gang zag tha dad du byed par 'gyur ro zhe na/ de'ang byed de/ snga ma ni mthong sgom mi slob lam gyis bsdas pa'i lam zag med dang /phyi ma ni gang zag btags yod du 'dod pa'i phyir khro//zhes gsungs pas lam bden gyi ma thob pa so sor skye bo dang / lam bden kun 3phags pa yin par bzhed rgyu yin 'dug pa/ de ltar na so so skye bo dang 'phags pa la gang zag gis ma khyab pa paṇa chen dang mthun 'dug 'on kyang 'phags pa sogs zag med kyi lam kho nar ma nges pa ste/ gnas gsum par/'phags dang mtshams med byed pa dag /ces pa'i rang 'grel du/ 'phags kha pa rnams gang zag gang che(na/ gang la 'phags pa'i lam skyes pa'o/ /che'i/dang /drug par/ de tshe de mi slob dgra bcom/ /zhes pa'i 'grel par/ gang zag sngar bshad pa g.yin bdun slob pa dag yin no/ /zhes bya bar grub bo/ /zhes sogs 'thad pa dang bcas pa gsungs bas/ 'phags lam rgyud la skyebs pa'i gang zag 539

bgechen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()thams cad kyang 'phags par 'jog dgos/ zung bzhi ya brgyad kyi nang nas dgra bcom pa ni mi slob pa dang / rgyun zhugs zhugs gnas sogs gzhan bdun slob pa yin par mdzod rtsa 'grel las gsungs pas/ de dag gi rnam/ gzhag su yis 'gog nus/ des na gnas bzhi par/ zag med ni/ 'phags des/ zhes dang / gnas brgyad par/ srid rtse'i 'phags pa ci yang med/ /ces/ dang / gnas drug par/ 'phags brgyad kyis rang gong sa las rgyal/ zhes gsungs pa'i 'phags pa rnams ni/ zag med kyi lam la 'jog 'phags dang mtshams med byed pa dag /ces sogs kyis bstan pa'i 'phags pa rnams ni rten gyi gang zag la 'jog pa mdzod rang gi dgongs pa'i babs yin par 'dug pas de bzhin du bskyang bar bya/ lam bden gyi ma thob la so so skye bo yin pa ni/gzhung 'dir/ lam ma thob pa so so yi/ /skye bor 'dod do zhes dang / ma ngon pa/ sde bdun las kyang / so so skye bo nyid gang zhe na/ 'phags pa'i chos rnams kyis ma rnyed pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa yin/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir rang bzhin so so skye bo sogs la'ang gang zag dang gang zag ma yin pa gnyis su 'byed pa gzhung 'di rang gi dgongs pa yin pas theg pa gong ma'i lugs dang ma/ 'dres par byas na legs/ gnas gsum par/ bskal pa rnam pa mang bshad pa//zhes pa nas / de dag brgyad cu la bskal chen/ /de grangs med gsum la sangs rgyas/ /'byung ngo mar ni 'grib pa yi/ /brgya yi bar la de dag 'byung / /zhes gsungs pa'i don ni/ dang po bskal pa chags pa dang / de nas gnas pa dang /de'i rjes su 'jig pa dang / stong pa rnams la bar bskal nyi shu'iyun chad re 540

bgechen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()thams cad kyang 'phags par 'jog dgos/ zung bzhi ya brgyad kyi nang nas dgra bcom pa ni mi slob pa dang / rgyun zhugs zhugs gnas sogs gzhan bdun slob pa yin par mdzod rtsa 'grel las gsungs pas/ de dag gi rnam/ g.yig su yis 'gog nus/ des na gnas bzhi par/ zag med ni/ 'phags des/ zhes dang / gnas brgyad par/ srid rtse'i 'phags pa ci yang med/ /ces/ dang / gnas drug par/ 'phags brgyad kyis rang gong sa las rgyal/ zhes gsungs pa'i 'phags pa rnams ni/ zag med kyi lam la 'jog 'phags dang mtshams med byed pa dag /ces sogs kyis bstan pa'i 'phags pa rnams ni rten gyi gang zag la 'jog pa mdzod rang gi dgongs pa'i babs yin par 'dug pas de bzhin du bskyang bar bya/ lam bden gyi ma thob la so so skye bo yin pa ni/gzhung 'dir/ lam ma thob pa so so yi/ /skye bor 'dod do zhes dang / ma ngon pa/ sde bdun las kyang / so so skye bo nyid gang zhe na/ 'phags pa'i chos rnams kyis ma rnyed pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa yin/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir rang bzhin so so skye bo sogs la'ang gang zag dang gang zag ma yin pa gnyis su 'byed pa gzhung 'di rang gi dgongs pa yin pas theg pa gong ma'i lugs dang ma/ 'dres par byas na legs/ gnas gsum par/ bskal pa rnam pa mang bshad pa//zhes pa nas / de dag brgyad cu la bskal chen/ /de grangs med gsum la sangs rgyas/ /'byung ngo mar ni 'grib pa yi/ /brgya yi bar la de dag 'byung / /zhes gsungs pa'i don ni/ dang po bskal pa chags pa dang / de nas gnas pa dang /de'i rjes su 'jig pa dang / stong pa rnams la bar bskal nyi shu'iyun chad re 540

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam// dgrang ba'i bar bskal brgyad cu la bskal chen gcig tu 'jog sangs rgyas rnams kyis bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags pa'i bskal pa'ang bskal chen gyi steng nas brtsi dgos/ de la dang po chags pa'i bskal pa ni/gzhung 'dir/chagasapa dang po'i rlung nasani/ /dmyal ba'i srid pa'i bar du'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don/ dang po bskal pa chags pa'i snga ltas su gyur pa'i rlung 'jam po ldang ba nas chags bskal gyi mgo 'dzin/ de yun ring por song ba nas rlung gi dkyil 'khor rdo rje rgya gram gyi dbyibs can tshan po che'i rdo rjes kyang gzhig par mi nus pa'i sra zhing brtan pa chags/ de'i steng du chu'i dkyil 'khor chags te/ de'ang sems can spyi mthun gyi las kyis nam mkha' nas char gyi rgyun gnya' shing tsam pa lo grangs du mar babs pa las/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rgya mtsho chen po gcig tu gyur par byung / chu de lo grangs du mar rlung gis bsrubs pa las chu'i steng du dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi chags/ de lta bu'i rlung dang / chu/ gser gyi sa gzhi gsum la rten dkyil 'khor gsum zer/de'ang gzhung 'dir/ de la snod kyi 'jig rten gyi/ /gnas par 'dod pa'i 'og dag gi /rlung gi dkyil 'khor rngams su ni/ /zhes sogs kyis de gsum rim pa bzhin du bstan/ de ltar byung ba'i rlung dang chu gnyis chags pa'i dus su chu'i dkyil nas yar gser gyi pad+ma stong byung bar gyur te de la gnas gtsang ma'i lha zho ma/sa kyis brtags pas sangs rgyas stonga'abyung ba'i ltas su shes te/ e ma bskal pa 'di ni bzang po'o zhes brngod pas bskal pa bzang por grags/ de ne+e/ra na chu'i nang nas yar pad+ma stong byung ba'i chu de ni bskal pa 'jig dus kyi chu 54/

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam// dgrang ba'i bar bskal brgyad cu la bskal chen gcig tu 'jog sangs rgyas rnams kyis bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags pa'i bskal pa'ang bskal chen gyi steng nas brtsi dgos/ de la dang po chags pa'i bskal pa ni/gzhung 'dir/chagasapa dang po'i rlung nasani/ /dmyal ba'i srid pa'i bar du'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don/ dang po bskal pa chags pa'i snga ltas su gyur pa'i rlung 'jam po ldang ba nas chags bskal gyi mgo 'dzin/ de yun ring por song ba nas rlung gi dkyil 'khor rdo rje rgya gram gyi dbyibs can tshan po che'i rdo rjes kyang gzhig par mi nus pa'i sra zhing brtan pa chags/ de'i steng du chu'i dkyil 'khor chags te/ de'ang sems can spyi mthun gyi las kyis nam mkha' nas char gyi rgyun gnya' shing tsam pa lo grangs du mar babs pa las/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rgya mtsho chen po gcig tu gyur par byung / chu de lo grangs du mar rlung gis bsrubs pa las chu'i steng du dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi chags/ de lta bu'i rlung dang / chu/ gser gyi sa gzhi gsum la rten dkyil 'khor gsum zer/de'ang gzhung 'dir/ de la snod kyi 'jig rten gyi/ /gnas par 'dod pa'i 'og dag gi /rlung gi dkyil 'khor rngams su ni/ /zhes sogs kyis de gsum rim pa bzhin du bstan/ de ltar byung ba'i rlung dang chu gnyis chags pa'i dus su chu'i dkyil nas yar gser gyi pad+ma stong byung bar gyur te de la gnas gtsang ma'i lha zho ma/sa kyis brtags pas sangs rgyas stonga'abyung ba'i ltas su shes te/ e ma bskal pa 'di ni bzang po'o zhes brngod pas bskal pa bzang por grags/ de ne+e/ra na chu'i nang nas yar pad+ma stong byung ba'i chu de ni bskal pa 'jig dus kyi chu 54/

'tshe chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()ma yan par bskal pa chags dus chu na par shes cadagos/ mdzod kya ṭīk+ka tshad ldan rnams su'ang de bzhin du gsungs/ bu ston chos 'byung du/ 'jig rten 'di chus 'jig pa'i tshe mtsho nas gser gyi pad+ma stong byung zhes sogs bris pa snang mod/ 'jig pa'i tshe zhes pa'i yi ge de ni dpe ma dag pa zhig gis rgyun mched pa yin gyi/ bu ston gyi gsung ga nas yan/ rgyu mtshan ni/ gser gyi pad+ma stong byung ba la brten nas gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams kyis bskal pa 'di ni bzang po'o zhes bsgrags par bshad pas/ 'di ni zhes pa'i tshig de snga gong gi 'jig pa'i skabs la mi 'grigs shing / bskal pa chags 'ong ba'i skabs la 'grigs te/ da lam chags pa'i bskal pa 'di la sangs rgyas stong 'ong bas bskal pa bzang por brjod pa'i phyir/ bu ston gyi gsung ni 'jig rten 'di chus chags pa'i tshe mtsho nas zhes sogs dag ste/tshig snga phyi'i 'grel las shes so/ /de bzhin du snying rje pad dkar gyi lung drangs pa la lar yang / 'jig rten gyi khams 'di 'jig par gyur pa'i tshe sa chen po 'di rgya mtsho chen po gcig tu gyur pa na zhes bris pa'ang yi ge ma dag ste/ bka' bstan bcos gang la'ang rang gi shes rab kyis go ba myangs nas dag ma dag dpyod dgos pa yin/ des na 'jig rten gyi khams 'di chags par gyur pa'i tshe byas na yi ge dag ste/ mdo der yang / bskal pa bzang po 'di la zhes bshad pa dang / tshig snga phyi'i 'brel dang bcas babs thob bsgrigs pas shes nus pa yin no/ /mtsho nang nas yar pad+ma stong byung ba de bskal pa 'di'i gnas bskal pa sangs rgyas stong 'byung ba'i mtshan ma yin te/ gnas bskal 'di'i sngon du chags bskal byung ba'i chu'i 542

ba chen 'od snang las/ saskya'i chos 'byung gcesabasdus/ ()ma yan par bskal pa chags dus chu na par sheba'idagos/ mdzod kya ṭīk+ka tshad ldan rnamasasu'ang de bzhin du gsungs/ bu ston chos 'byung du/ 'jig rten 'di chus 'jig pa'i tshe mtsho nas gser gyi pad+ma stong byung zhes sogs bris pa snang mod/ 'jig pa'i tshe zhes pa'i yi ge de ni dpe ma dag pa zhig gis rgyun mched pa yin gyi/ bu ston gyi gsung ga nasayin/ rgyu mtshan ni/ gser gyi pad+ma stong byung ba la brten nas gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams kyis bskal pa 'di ni bzang po'o zhes bsgrags par bshad pas/ 'di ni zhes pa'i tshig de snga gong gi 'jig pa'i skabs la mi 'grigs shing / bskal pa chags 'ong ba'i skabs la 'grigs te/ da lam chags pa'i bskal pa 'di la sangs rgyas stong 'ong bas bskal pa bzang por brjod pa'i phyir/ bu ston gyi gsung ni 'jig rten 'di chus chags pa'i tshe mtsho nas zhes sogs dag ste/tshig snga phyi'i 'grel las shes so/ /de bzhin du snying rje pad dkar gyi lung drangs pa la lar yang / 'jig rten gyi khams 'di 'jig par gyur pa'i tshe sa chen po 'di rgya mtsho chen po gcig tu gyur pa na zhes bris pa'ang yi ge ma dag ste/ bka' bstan bcos gang la'ang rang gi shes rab kyis go ba myangasanasadag ma dag dpyod dgos pa yin/ des na 'jig rten gyi khams 'di chags par gyur pa'i tshe byas na yi ge dag ste/ mdo der yang / bskal pa bzang po 'di la zhes bshad pa dang / tshig snga phyi'i 'brel dang bcas babs thob bsgrigs pas shes nus pa yin no/ /mtsho nang nas yar pad+ma stong byung ba de bskal pa 'di'i gnas bskal pa sangs rgyas stong 'byung ba'i mtshan ma yin te/ gnas bskal 'di'i sngon du chags bskal byung ba'i chu'i 542

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/dkyil 'khor chags nas mtshan ma de ltar byung ba mngon sum du na tu 'thad/sangs rgyas stong byon tshar nas bskal pa 'di 'jig par 'gyur ba'i chu nang nas yar pad+ma stong byung bas sangs rgyas stong byung zer ba sogs ni mngon sum tshad ma'i rig pas gnod mi gnod dpyod ldan dag gis gzigs 'tshal/ bu ston rin po che dges par gyur cig chos mngon shes bya'i rgya mtsho chen po la/ /bdag blo'i gru skya tshugs pa lta ci smros/ kha dog dag kyang ring nas 'ol spyi las/ /ma mthong ming nyid rna bas thos pa tsam/ /'on kyang dkar ba'i bag chags gzhag snyam ste/ /'dir yang 'bad pa cung zad bgyis pa las/ tags rab snang ba srin bu me khyer gyi/ /'od tsam 'di na bgo skal thob par rlom/ /legs zag da spring sprin bawo gyi gto brgyud dang sbyar gyi bzhen pa rtse dga' dgod/ /thub gsung yangs par blta ba'i mig dkyus ring / /ji snyed shes bya'i rgyan phreng tshar du dngar/ /dpal mo ma la ya can bzhi par dge /de ltar na de dag gis ni chosakyi ma mo mngon pa'i gzhung gi skabs las brtsams te mkhas pa dag la 'bel gtam du bya ba rin chen mdzes pa'i phra tshom bzhi par bkod pa bstan zin to/// 'gro la thugs rje'i lhan gyis nyer gzags nas/ /rtag chad 'ching pa dam po kun bkrol te/ /dbu ma'i lta bas rgyal sar 'khrid mdzad pa'i/ /ston pa go tam lha la gus phyag bgyid/ /ces mchod par brjod nas/ 'dir gang bshad pa ra bya ba'i chos ni/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam dam pa'i chos dbu ma 'di yin la/ de 'chad par byed pa la 'phags yul du byung tshul dang / bod yul du byung tshul gnyis/ dang po la bka' dbu ma 543

bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dag gigrub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/dkyil 'khor chags nas mtshan ma de ltar byung ba mngon sum du na tu 'thad/sangs rgyas stong byon tshar nas bskal pa 'di 'jig par 'gyur ba'i chu nang nas yar pad+ma stong byung bas sangs rgyas stong byung zer ba sogs ni mngon sum tshad ma'i rig pas gnod mi gnod dpyod ldan dag gis gzigs 'tshal/ bu ston rin po che dges par gyur cig chos mngon shes bya'i rgya mtsho chen po la/ /bdag blo'i gru skya tshugs pa lta ci smros/ kha dog dag kyang ring nas 'ol spyi las/ /ma mthong ming nyid rna bas thos pa tsam/ /'on kyang dkar ba'i bag chags gzhag snyam ste/ /'dir yang 'bad pa cung zad bgyis pa las/ khres rab snang ba srin bu me khyer gyi/ /'od tsam 'di na bgo skal thob par rlom/ /legs kugad spring sprin bzhon gyi gto brgyud dang sbyar gyi bzhon pa rtse dga' dgod/ /thub gsung yangs par blta ba'i mig dkyus ring / /ji snyed shesabya'i rgyan phreng tshar du dngar/ /dpal mo ma la ya can bzhi par dge /de ltar na de dag gis ni chosakyi ma mo mngon pa'i gzhung gi skabs las brtsams te mkhas pa dag la 'bel gtam du bya ba rin chen mdzes pa'i phra tshom bzhi par bkod pa bstan zin to/// 'gro la thugasarje'i sgrun gyisanyer gzigasanas/ /rtag chad 'ching pa dam po kun bkrol te/ /dbu ma'i lta bas rgyal sar 'khrid mdzad pa'i/ /ston pa go tam lha la gus phyag bgyid/ /ces mchod par brjod nas/ 'dir gang bshad pa ra bya ba'i chos ni/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam dam pa'i chos dbu ma 'di yin la/ de 'chad par byed pa la 'phags yul du byung tshul dang / bod yul du byung tshul gnyis/ dang po la bka' dbu ma 543

ba chen 'odasnang las/ sa skya'i chosa'abyung gces bsdus/ ()dang / bstan bcos dbu ma gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sher phyin gyi mdo rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum la 'jog gnyis pa ni/ mdo las/ de ming klu zhes 'bod pa ste/ /zhes sogs sangs rgyas rang nyid kyis lung bstan pa'i slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis spyir sangs rgyas kyi bka' thams cad mthar thug de /le na nyid la 'bab cing gzhol bar gzigs pa dang / khyad par bka' bar pa sher mdo'i dngos bstan zab don dbu mar gnas pa de dag gi dgongs pa 'grel/ par byed pa la dbu ma gtam tshogs/ bstod tshogs/ rigs tshogs dang gsum mdzad/ dang po ni/ rgyal po la yul thag ring po nas 'phrin du bskur ba dbu ma/ bshes spring dang / rgyal po nyid dang mjal nas dngos su gtam du bya ba rin chen phreng ba dang gnyis po 'di yin/ bstod tshogs la gzhi'i skabs su chos can gsal ba la bstod pa dang / chos nyid dbyings la bstod pa gnyis/ lam gyi skabs su thabs snying rje chen po la bstod pa dang / shes rab 'phags bzhi 'i yum la bstod pa gnyis/ 'bras bu'i dus su sku gsum la so sor bstod pa dang/so sor ma phye bar lta ba rang gi ngo bo'i sgo nas bstod pa la/ don dam par bstod pa / dpe med par bstod pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab par bstod pa/ 'jig rten las 'das par bstod pa rnams su yod/ de dag ni tshi gsal las/ gtam bya rin chen phreng dang yang dag bstod pa dang / /zhes gsungs pa de yin/ gsum pa rigs tshogs las gtso bor gyur pa ni dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab yin/ gzhan yang dbu ma'i lus rnam par bzhag pa rigs pa drug cu pa dang / de dang rtsa sher gnyis las 'phros pa'i tshul du zhib mo rnam 'thag dang / stong nyid bdun cu pa 544

ba chen 'odasnang las/ sa skya'i chosa'abyung gces bsdus/ ()dang / bstan bcos dbu ma gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sher phyin gyi mdo rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum la 'jog gnyis pa ni/ mdo las/ de ming klu zhes 'bod pa ste/ /zhes sogs sangs rgyas rang nyid kyis lung bstan pa'i slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis spyir sangs rgyas kyi bka' thams cad mthar thug de /le na nyid la 'bab cing gzhol bar gzigs pa dang / khyad par bka' bar pa sher mdo'i dngos bstan zab don dbu mar gnas pa de dag gi dgongs pa 'grel/ par byed pa la dbu ma gtam tshogs/ bstod tshogs/ rigs tshogs dang gsum mdzad/ dang po ni/ rgyal po la yul thag ring po nas 'phrin du bskur ba dbu ma/ bshes spring dang / rgyal po nyid dang mjal nas dngos su gtam du bya ba rin chen phreng ba dang gnyis po 'di yin/ bstod tshogs la gzhi'i skabs su chos can gsal ba la bstod pa dang / chos nyid dbyings la bstod pa gnyis/ lam gyi skabs su thabs snying rje chen po la bstod pa dang / shes rab 'phags bzhi 'i yum la bstod pa gnyis/ 'bras bu'i dus su sku gsum la so sor bstod pa dang/so sor ma phye bar lta ba rang gi ngo bo'i sgo nas bstod pa la/ don dam par bstod pa / dpe med par bstod pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab par bstod pa/ 'jig rten las 'das par bstod pa rnams su yod/ de dag ni tshi gsal las/ gtam bya rin chen phreng dang yang dag bstod pa dang / /zhes gsungs pa de yin/ gsum pa rigs tshogs las gtso bor gyur pa ni dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab yin/ gzhan yang dbu ma'i lus rnam par bzhag pa rigs pa drug cu pa dang / de dang rtsa sher gnyis las 'phros pa'i tshul du zhib mo rnam 'thag dang / stong nyid bdun cu pa 544

bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i ribel gtam/dang / rtsod bzlog dang gsum ni gyes pa yan lag lta bu yin/ kun mkhyen rin po ches ni rtsa sher sogs lnga po 'di la dbu ma rigs pa'i tshogs lnga gsungs te/tshigs gsal dang mthun/ mkhas pa gzhan rnams ni de lnga'i steng du tha snyad sgrub pa bsnan nas rigs tshogs drug tu bzhed/ klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa de rnams dang / sher phyin gyi mdo rnams gzhung phyi mo'i dbu ma yin te/ dbu ma thal rang la sogs pa gyes pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i gzhung yin pas so/ /der ma zad 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa'i dbu ma bzhi brgya pa'ang gzhu phyi mo'i dbu ma yin/ de skad du/ tshig gsal gyi lung sngar drangs pa de'i 'phro nyid las/ 'bad pas shin tu yun ring 'phags pa'i bstan bcos las bstan tshig ler byas de dang / /rigs pa drug cu zhes bya rnam par 'thag bcas stong nyid bdun cu pa de dang / /gang yang rtsod pa rnam par bzlog pa bkod pa de dag kyang ni mthong gyur cing / /brgya pa la sogs de dag dang ni de bzhin mdo sde zab mo rnam mang dang / /zhes gsungs pa yin/ bzhi brgya pa 'di la tshigs gsal du brgya pa las zhes gsungs pa mang du yod de/ tshig zor yang mdzad pa yin/ dbu ma stong thun chen mo spar mar rgyal ba la sogs zhes drangs yod kyang yi ge pas ma dag brgya pa la sogs zer dgos rgyu yin/ sogs kyi sgras ni klu sgrub kyi dngos slob gzhan gyis mdzad pa'i gzhung grub mtha' phyogs 'dzin du ma lhung ba rnams bstan/ spyi bab rtsa she'i dgongs pa la 'grel pa ga las 'jigs med du grags pa dang /sangs rgyas bskyangs kyis mdzad pa'i bud+dha pā li ta dang / legs ldan gyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa shes rab sgron me la sogs pa nas/ zla ba grags pas mdzad 545

'tshechen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()pa' tshig gsal gyi bar te 'grel chen brgyad yod/ ga las 'a gas med kun mkhyen jo nang pa rtsa she'i rang 'grel du bzhed/ sangs rgyas bskyangs kyis mdzad pa de ni rtsa she'i dgongs pa thal 'gyur du 'grel zhing / legs ldan byed kyi de ni rtsa she'i dgongs pa rang rgyud du 'grel byed kyi gzhung na/ 'di gnyis dang zla grags kyi gzhus sogs la grub mtha' phyogs 'dzin gyi dbu ma zer/ zla grags kyis thal rang gi 'grel pa de gnyis ka la sbyangs pa mdzad cing 'grel pa tshig gsal brtsams pa'i rgyur bzhed de/ sngar drangs pa'i 'phro nyid las/ sangs rgyas bskyangs gis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa mthong nas legs ldan byed kyi legs bshad gang / /gcig nas gcig tu brgyud las 'ongs dang bdag gis rnam par phye las rnyed pa gang / /de dag bsnams te blo chen ldan rnams mgu bar bya phyir yang dag bstan pa yin/ /cheX5 gsungs pa yin/ zla bas gzhan yang bzhi brgya pa dang / rigs pa drug cu pa gnyis mar yang 'grel pa mdzad/ de gnyis tshig gsal dang gsum la zla ba'i 'grel chen gsum du 'jog par mdzad de/ theg mchog gnad kyi zla zer las/ 'di dag zla ba'i dgongs pa yin min zhes/ /rtsod 'dod rgol ba yod na zla ba yi/ /'grel chen gsum po dpang du byas nas ni / / rtsod pa bya yisamadun du lhags par gyis/ /zhes bka' stsal pa yin/ de ltar na dbu ma pa la thal 'gyur ba dang / rang rgyud pa gnyisasu phye ba ni don dam gyi lta ba rgyud la bskyed tshul gyi sgo nas phye ba yin la/ don dam rang gi ngo bo 'dod tshul la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par med de/ gnyis rka'ang dbu ma mtshan nyid pa yin pa'i phyir te/ 'on kyang tshig gsal las/ thal rang gi khyad par gyi skabs 546

bzuchen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()pa' tshig gsal gyi bar te 'grel chen brgyad yod/ ga las 'a gas med kun mkhyen jo nang pa rtsa she'i rang 'grel du bzhed/ sangs rgyas bskyangs kyis mdzad pa de ni rtsa she'i dgongs pa thal 'gyur du 'grel zhing / legs ldan byed kyi de ni rtsa she'i dgongs pa rang rgyud du 'grel byed kyi gzhung na/ 'di gnyis dang zla grags kyi gzhus sogs la grub mtha' phyogs 'dzin gyi dbu ma zer/ zla grags kyis thal rang gi 'grel pa de gnyis ka la sbyangs pa mdzad cing 'grel pa tshig gsal brtsams pa'i rgyur bzhed de/ sngar drangs pa'i 'phro nyid las/ sangs rgyas bskyangs gis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa mthong nas legs ldan byed kyi legs bshad gang / /gcig nas gcig tu brgyud las 'ongs dang bdag gis rnam par phye las rnyed pa gang / /de dag bsnams te blo chen ldan rnams mgu bar bya phyir yang dag bstan pa yin/ /zhesda gsungs pa yin/ zla bas gzhan yang bzhi brgya pa dang / rigs pa drug cu pa gnyis mar yang 'grel pa mdzad/ de gnyis tshig gsal dang gsum la zla ba'i 'grel chen gsum du 'jog par mdzad de/ theg mchog gnad kyi zla zer las/ 'di dag zla ba'i dgongs pa yin min zhes/ /rtsod 'dod rgol ba yod na zla ba yi/ /'grel chen gsum po dpang du byas nas ni / / rtsod pa bya yisamadun du lhags par gyis/ /zhes bka' stsal pa yin/ de ltar na dbu ma pa la thal 'gyur ba dang / rang rgyud pa gnyisasu phye ba ni don dam gyi lta ba rgyud la bskyed tshul gyi sgo nas phye ba yin la/ don dam rang gi ngo bo 'dod tshul la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par med de/ gnyis rka'ang dbu ma mtshan nyid pa yin pa'i phyir te/ 'on kyang tshig gsal las/ thal rang gi khyad par gyi skabs 546

bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/su rtog ge pa 'dis zhes legs ldan byed dbu ma pa min pa lta bur bshad pa'ang yod mod/ de ni legs ldan byed sngar mdo sde pa'i rtog ge la legs par sbyangs pa zhig phyis dbu ma pa'i grub mtha' la zhugs pa na don dam sgrub byed la rang rgyud kyi rigs pa bcug pas de la 'thing slad kyi tshul ston phyogs tsam yin gyi / don gyi ma yin/ de ltar na thal rang gi khyad par la gzhi'i khyad par/ lam gyi khyad par/ 'bras bu'i khyad par dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ kun rdzob bden pa dang mi bslu ba'i gzhi mthun 'dod pa rang rgyud pa'i lugs dang / de'i gzhi mthun mi 'dod pa thal 'gyur ba'i lugs yin te/ 'jug pa rang 'grel las/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa ni slu bar byed pa nyid kyi phyir zhes dang / rigs pa drug cu pa'i 'grel pa las kyang de bzhin du gsung pa rnams thugs la bzhag nas/ chosarje sapaṇa gyis/ tha snyad du ni mi bslu bar/ /'dod pa de ni tshad ma'i lugs/ /rang rgyud de dang cha mthun la/ /thal 'gyur ba dag tha snyad du/ /bden pa mi 'dod mdor bsdus pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa yin/ 'di ni gzhi'i skabs kyi khyad par gyi gtso bo yin/ khyad par gzhan yang mang po yod skad/ lam gyi skabs kyi khyad par ni tshad ma la mngon rjes gnyis su grangs nges pa dang / nyan rang gis chos kyi bdag med ma rtogs par 'dod pa sogs ni rang rgyud pa'i lugs dang / nyan rang gis de rtogs par 'dod pa dang / tshad ma la mngon sum/rjes dpag dpe nyer 'jal gyi tshad ma/ lung tshad ma dang bzhir grangs nges pa sogs ni thal 'gyur ba'i lugs yin/ 'jug par/ de ni ring du song bar blo yang lhag par 'gyur / /zhes pa'i rang 'grel du/ nyan rang gi chos kyi bdag 547

bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/su rtog ge pa 'dis zhes legs ldan byed dbu ma pa min pa lta bur bshad pa'ang yod mod/ de ni legs ldan byed sngar mdo sde pa'i rtog ge la legs par sbyangs pa zhig phyis dbu ma pa'i grub mtha' la zhugs pa na don dam sgrub byed la rang rgyud kyi rigs pa bcug pas de la 'thing slad kyi tshul ston phyogs tsam yin gyi / don gyi ma yin/ de ltar na thal rang gi khyad par la gzhi'i khyad par/ lam gyi khyad par/ 'bras bu'i khyad par dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ kun rdzob bden pa dang mi bslu ba'i gzhi mthun 'dod pa rang rgyud pa'i lugs dang / de'i gzhi mthun mi 'dod pa thal 'gyur ba'i lugs yin te/ 'jug pa rang 'grel las/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa ni slu bar byed pa nyid kyi phyir zhes dang / rigs pa drug cu pa'i 'grel pa las kyang de bzhin du gsung pa rnams thugs la bzhag nas/ chosarje sapaṇa gyis/ tha snyad du ni mi bslu bar/ /'dod pa de ni tshad ma'i lugs/ /rang rgyud de dang cha mthun la/ /thal 'gyur ba dag tha snyad du/ /bden pa mi 'dod mdor bsdus pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa yin/ 'di ni gzhi'i skabs kyi khyad par gyi gtso bo yin/ khyad par gzhan yang mang po yod skad/ lam gyi skabs kyi khyad par ni tshad ma la mngon rjes gnyis su grangs nges pa dang / nyan rang gis chos kyi bdag med ma rtogs par 'dod pa sogs ni rang rgyud pa'i lugs dang / nyan rang gis de rtogs par 'dod pa dang / tshad ma la mngon sum/rjes dpag dpe nyer 'jal gyi tshad ma/ lung tshad ma dang bzhir grangs nges pa sogs ni thal 'gyur ba'i lugs yin/ 'jug par/ de ni ring du song bar blo yang lhag par 'gyur / /zhes pa'i rang 'grel du/ nyan rang gi chos kyi bdag 547

brtse chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()med rtogs pa la lung rigs kyi sgrub byed mang du bkod pa rnams rang rgyud pa'i ngor yin zhing / tshig gsal las kyang / slob dpon legasaldan byed ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams la ji skad bshad pa'i stong pa nyid rtogs par yod pa khong du ma chud nas/ zhes sogs gsungs 'dug pa yin/ 'bras bu'i khyad par ni/ 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag snang bcas dang / sangs rgyasakyi sar mnyam rjes tha dad du 'dod pa ni rang rgyud pa'i lugs dang / de ltar bshad pa las bzlog pa ni thal 'gyur ba'i lugs yin/ 'o na thal rang zhes pa'i nges tshig ci zhe na/ legs ldan byed kyis myu gu bdag las mi skye bar sgrub pa sogs la'ang tshad ma'i rigs pa sbyar nas yan lag lnga ldan gyi sgrub ngag 'god pa sogs mdzad cing / de'i tshe na rtags chos rtsod gzhi gsum ka rgol phyir rgol gnyis ga'i ngor grub dgos pas dpyad gzhi'i chos can myu gu lta bu zhig gnas lugs la spyod pa'i rig ngo na chos can grub par bzhed/ sangs rgyas bskyangs dang / zla bas de mi 'thad par gzigs nas/ myu gu chosacan/ slar skye ba don med du thal/ rang dang bdag nyid gcig pa'i rgyu las skyes pa'i phyir zhes 'gal ba brjod pa'i thal 'gyur sogs kyi sgo nas myu gu bden med du sgrub par mjad/de'i tshe na dpyad gzhi'i myu gu tshad mas grub par khas mi len te/ myu gu rang gi gnas tshul la dpyod pa'i skabs yin pa'i phyir/ de skad du tshig gsal las/dbu ma pa yin na rang gi rgyud kyi rjes su dpa/ga par bya ba rigs pa ma yin te/phyogs gzhan khas blangs pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang / de'i rgyab brten du rtsod bzlog dang / bzhi brgya nga/'i lung rnam/sa 'dren par mdzad/ don 'di dang 548

brtse chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()med rtogs pa la lung rigs kyi sgrub byed mang du bkod pa rnams rang rgyud pa'i ngor yin zhing / tshig gsal las kyang / slob dpon legasaldan byed ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams la ji skad bshad pa'i stong pa nyid rtogs par yod pa khong du ma chud nas/ zhes sogs gsungs 'dug pa yin/ 'bras bu'i khyad par ni/ 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag snang bcas dang / sangs rgyasakyi sar mnyam rjes tha dad du 'dod pa ni rang rgyud pa'i lugs dang / de ltar bshad pa las bzlog pa ni thal 'gyur ba'i lugs yin/ 'o na thal rang zhes pa'i nges tshig ci zhe na/ legs ldan byed kyis myu gu bdag las mi skye bar sgrub pa sogs la'ang tshad ma'i rigs pa sbyar nas yan lag lnga ldan gyi sgrub ngag 'god pa sogs mdzad cing / de'i tshe na rtags chos rtsod gzhi gsum ka rgol phyir rgol gnyis ga'i ngor grub dgos pas dpyad gzhi'i chos can myu gu lta bu zhig gnas lugs la spyod pa'i rig ngo na chos can grub par bzhed/ sangs rgyas bskyangs dang / zla bas de mi 'thad par gzigs nas/ myu gu chosacan/ slar skye ba don med du thal/ rang dang bdag nyid gcig pa'i rgyu las skyes pa'i phyir zhes 'gal ba brjod pa'i thal 'gyur sogs kyi sgo nas myu gu bden med du sgrub par mjad/de'i tshe na dpyad gzhi'i myu gu tshad mas grub par khas mi len te/ myu gu rang gi gnas tshul la dpyod pa'i skabs yin pa'i phyir/ de skad du tshig gsal las/dbu ma pa yin na rang gi rgyud kyi rjes su dpa/ga par bya ba rigs pa ma yin te/phyogs gzhan khas blangs pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang / de'i rgyab brten du rtsod bzlog dang / bzhi brgya nga/'i lung rnam/sa 'dren par mdzad/ don 'di dang 548

bod kyi rme khas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/mthun par mkhas 'jug las/ gal te khas blangs gtan mi 'dod/ /de la brtags na gnyis su 'gyur/ /spros bral yin phyir mi 'dod na/ shinas na dbu ma'i grub mtha' 'gyur/ /zhes dang / theg mchog gnad kyi zla zer las/ gnas lugs dpyod tshe dpyad bya'i chos can ni/ /snang dang mi snang 'dod pa'i bye brag gis/ /thal rang gnyis kyi khyad par byung ba la/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa yin cing / des na rang rgyud pas dbu ma'i rtags chen lnga tshul gsum tshad mas grub pa'i rang rgyud kyi gtan tshigs dang / rtsa sher/ bdag las ma yin gzhan las min/ /gnyis las ma yin rgyu med min/ /dngos po gang dag gang na yang / /skye ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i mtha' bzhi skye 'gog gi dam bca' de'ang rang rgyud kyi dam bcar 'dod/ thal 'gyur bas de dag rim bzhin tha pa 'gyur gyi gtan tshigs dang / thal 'gyur gyi dam bcar 'dod pa ni khyad par gyi gtso bo yin/ legs ldan byed kyi rjes su slob dpon dpal sbas kyis de bo na nyid la 'jug pa mdzad/ de nas slob dpon ye shes snying pos dbu ma bden gnyis rtsa 'grel dang / mtshan brjod par dka' ba bod la shin tu bka' drin che ba mkhan chen zhi ba 'tshos dbu ma rgyan rtsa 'grel dang / slob dpon ka ma la shi las sgom rim thog mtha' bar gsum dang / dbu ma snang ba mdzad/ ye shes snying po sogs gsum po 'di la rang rgyud shar pa skor gsum du grags/dpal ldan zla ba'i srol 'dzin slob dpon rig pa'i khu byug che chung gnyis su byung / gzhung mdzad pa mi snang / khu byug gi slob ma sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi rnam sprul jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha rang cag bod rnams kyi mgon po 549

bod kyi rme khas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/mthun par mkhas 'jug las/ gal te khas blangs gtan mi 'dod/ /de la brtags na gnyis su 'gyur/ /spros bral yin phyir mi 'dod na/ khrigs na dbu ma'i grub mtha' 'gyur/ /zhes dang / theg mchog gnad kyi zla zer las/ gnas lugs dpyod tshe dpyad bya'i chos can ni/ /snang dang mi snang 'dod pa'i bye brag gis/ /thal rang gnyis kyi khyad par byung ba la/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa yin cing / des na rang rgyud pas dbu ma'i rtags chen lnga tshul gsum tshad mas grub pa'i rang rgyud kyi gtan tshigs dang / rtsa sher/ bdag las ma yin gzhan las min/ /gnyis las ma yin rgyu med min/ /dngos po gang dag gang na yang / /skye ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i mtha' bzhi skye 'gog gi dam bca' de'ang rang rgyud kyi dam bcar 'dod/ thal 'gyur bas de dag rim bzhin tha pa 'gyur gyi gtan tshigs dang / thal 'gyur gyi dam bcar 'dod pa ni khyad par gyi gtso bo yin/ legs ldan byed kyi rjes su slob dpon dpal sbas kyis de bo na nyid la 'jug pa mdzad/ de nas slob dpon ye shes snying pos dbu ma bden gnyis rtsa 'grel dang / mtshan brjod par dka' ba bod la shin tu bka' drin che ba mkhan chen zhi ba 'tshos dbu ma rgyan rtsa 'grel dang / slob dpon ka ma la shi las sgom rim thog mtha' bar gsum dang / dbu ma snang ba mdzad/ ye shes snying po sogs gsum po 'di la rang rgyud shar pa skor gsum du grags/dpal ldan zla ba'i srol 'dzin slob dpon rig pa'i khu byug che chung gnyis su byung / gzhung mdzad pa mi snang / khu byug gi slob ma sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi rnam sprul jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha rang cag bod rnams kyi mgon po 549

'tshe chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()ga ga pur gyur pa des dbu ma bden gnyas rtsa 'grel mdzad/ gzhan yang 'phags yul du dbu ma pa'i ming can slob dpon shān+ti pa sngags kyi'ang rdo rje slob dpon du gyur pa des dbu ma rgyan dang / rnam 'byor bzhi ston pa'i sher phyin gyi man ngag dang / yang sher phyin sgom pa'i man ngag gcig ste/ gzhung gsum mdzad/ 'di dbu ma pa'i ming can gzhan stong pa rnams kyis rtsa ba'i khungs 'ded sa yin/ 'dis mdzad pa'i dbu ma rgyan la bod du bstan 'gyur gyi dkar chag rnams su sems tsam rgyan du mtshan gsol/ /gnyis pa bod yul du byung tshul la/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus su gangs ri'i khrod kyi thub pa'i rgyal tshab chen po rngog lo bstan pa'i nyi ma blo ldan shes rab ni rang rgyud pa'i phyogs la thugs shin tu dges/ zhi ba lha dang zla grags kyang rang rgyud pa'i phyogs su 'then par mjad/ rngog los spring yig bdud rtsi'i thigs pa sogs mdzad/ thal 'gyur ba'i srol ni pa tshab nyi ma grags kyis 'jug pa rtsa 'grel la sogs pa bsgyur zhing 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phab/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen me bya la sogs pa'i pa tshab bu bzhi las brgyud de dpal ldan sa skya pa'i rje btsun gong ma rnams dang / bu ston rin po che la sogs pa bod kyi tshad ldan chen por gyur pa rnams kyang thal 'gyur ba'i phyogs la thugs phyogs par mdzad cing srol༄ 'dzin/ stag tshang lo tsā bas grub mtha' kun shes las kyang / klu sgrub lugs mchog dbu ma chen po ni/ /zla bas legs bkral nyi mas bsgyur ba'i srol/ /bu bzhi las 'ongs rtog gis ma bslad pa/ /gangs can mtha' bral rtser gshegs 'ga' yis gzigs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don yang de ltar yin/ phyis su ka ma la shī 550
