bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/blo tshad kyis gzhal na/ gzhung 'dir/ phyi ru yul rnams bgrod pa dang / /nang du rtsa mdud grol ba ni/ /sa bcu la sogs bgrod pa yi/ /rten 'brel nyid kyis 'byung ba yin/ /'di don rnal 'byor chen po yi/ /rgyud kyi sa lam skabasasu ltos/ /zhes gsungs byung bas na/ dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogaba'ipa dang / /zhes pa nas dbu bzung / sa rnams bgrad par bya ba dang / /yul rnams dbang du bsdu ba'i phyir/ /gnas dang nye ba'i gnas la sogs/ /yul chen sum cu so bdun du/ /rig pa brtul zhugs spyod phyir rgyu/ /zhes pa nas/ des na sa lam mi bgrod par/ /yul sogs bgrod pa bzhad gad gnas/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi gzhung 'di kun gong ma mdor bstan du gsungs pa'i phyi nang gi rten 'brel dang /bla med kyi sa lam gyi rnam gzhag gnyis ka cab gcig tu ston pa'i rgyas bshad yin te/ spyod pa dang sa lam gnyis po de zung 'brel gyi sgo nas ston pa las tha dad du byas nas ston rgyu mi 'dug pa'i phyir/ de ltar na drod 'bring gi rtogs pa thob pa gcig gis pu li ra ma la ya la sogs pa'i gnas kyi yul bzhir spyod pa rgyu ba las/ spyi bo la sogs pa nang gi yul bzhi'i rlung sems dbu mar thims te sa dang po'i rtogs pa skye ba ni skabs 'di'i phyi'i rten 'brel dang / nang gi yul bzhi'i rlung sems dbu mar 'dus pa las/ phyi'i yul bzhi'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams sgrub pa po'i dbang du gyur pa ni skabs 'di'i nang gi rten 'brel yin te/ rim bzhin phyi la brten nas byung ba'i rten 'brel la phyi'i rten 'brel dang / nang la brten nas byung ba'i rten 'brel la nang gi rten 'brel du tha snyad bzhag pa 'dra snyam du sems/ gang ltar blo gros dang ldan pa dag gis mngon 581

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/blo tshad kyis gzhal na/ gzhung 'dir/ phyi ru yul rnams bgrod pa dang / /nang du rtsa mdud grol ba ni/ /sa bcu la sogs bgrod pa yi/ /rten 'brel nyid kyis 'byung ba yin/ /'di don rnal 'byor chen po yi/ /rgyud kyi sa lam skabasasu ltos/ /zhes gsungs byung bas na/ dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogabatapa dang / /zhes pa nas dbu bzung / sa rnams bgrad par bya ba dang / /yul rnams dbang du bsdu ba'i phyir/ /gnas dang nye ba'i gnas la sogs/ /yul chen sum cu so bdun du/ /rig pa brtul zhugs spyod phyir rgyu/ /zhes pa nas/ des na sa lam mi bgrod par/ /yul sogs bgrod pa bzhad gad gnas/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi gzhung 'di kun gong ma mdor bstan du gsungs pa'i phyi nang gi rten 'brel dang /bla med kyi sa lam gyi rnam gzhag gnyis ka cab gcig tu ston pa'i rgyas bshad yin te/ spyod pa dang sa lam gnyis po de zung 'brel gyi sgo nas ston pa las tha dad du byas nas ston rgyu mi 'dug pa'i phyir/ de ltar na drod 'bring gi rtogs pa thob pa gcig gis pu li ra ma la ya la sogs pa'i gnas kyi yul bzhir spyod pa rgyu ba las/ spyi bo la sogs pa nang gi yul bzhi'i rlung sems dbu mar thims te sa dang po'i rtogs pa skye ba ni skabs 'di'i phyi'i rten 'brel dang / nang gi yul bzhi'i rlung sems dbu mar 'dus pa las/ phyi'i yul bzhi'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams sgrub pa po'i dbang du gyur pa ni skabs 'di'i nang gi rten 'brel yin te/ rim bzhin phyi la brten nas byung ba'i rten 'brel la phyi'i rten 'brel dang / nang la brten nas byung ba'i rten 'brel la nang gi rten 'brel du tha snyad bzhag pa 'dra snyam du sems/ gang ltar blo gros dang ldan pa dag gis mngon 581

brtse chen 'od snang las/ saskya'i chos 'byung gcesabasdus/ ()rtogs ljon shing sogs rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab dang / ngor chen gyi ljon shing mdzes rgyan la yang dang yang du blta zhing bsam byung gi shes rab kyis go ba myongs pas tshul bzhin du rtogs par 'gyur ba yin no/ /gzhung 'di'i bstan bcos lus kyi skabs su paṇa chen rin po ches dogs gnas brgya dang brgyad bkod pa'i dri ba mdzad pa kun mkhyen chen po'i gzigs lam du phebs pa na/gsung las/ dogs pa zhugs pa'i dri ba bzhi 'dug cing / rnam dpyod dang ldan pa dag gis dogs pa sel dgos pa'i dpyod ldan gyi dri ba yang 'ga' zhig 'dug mod kyi/ phal cher ni tshigs la 'khris pa cam dang zhes sogs gsungs 'dug pa yin/ de la dogs pa zhugs pa'i dri ba dang po ni/ gzhung du/ des na bsngo rgyu'i dge ba dang / /bshags par bya ba'i sdig pa yang / /byas pa'i dge sdig yin mod kyi/ /ma byas pa la dge sdig med/ /de yi rnam gzhag bshad kyis nyon/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /des bskyed las ni mi dge ba/ /ma chags zhe sdang gti mug med/ /des bskyed las ni dge ba zhes/ /gsungs pa'i dgongs pa shes nas ni/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis dpyad par bya/ /zhes rin chen phreng ba'i lung drangs pa de la/ paṇa chen gyis/ chags sdang rmongs gsum gyis bskyed pa'i/ /las kun mi dge ba yin na/ /zag bcas dge ba gti mug gis/ /kun slong dag las 'byung de ci/ /zhesadrisapa 'di yin la/ lan ni mi dge ba'i rtsa ba gsum gyi nang tshan du gyur pa'i gti mug gis kun nas bslangs te bskyed pa'i las yin na mi dge ba yin pas khyab pa gzhung gi don yin gyi/spyir gti mug gis kun nas bslangs pa'i las la mi dge bas ma khyab ste/ mdo 582

brtse chen 'od snang las/ saskya'i mos 'byung gcesabasdus/ ()rtogs ljon shing sogs rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab dang / ngor chen gyi ljon shing mdzes rgyan la yang dang yang du blta zhing bsam byung gi shes rab kyis go ba myongs pas tshul bzhin du rtogs par 'gyur ba yin no/ /gzhung 'di'i bstan bcos lus kyi skabs su paṇa chen rin po ches dogs gnas brgya dang brgyad bkod pa'i dri ba mdzad pa kun mkhyen chen po'i gzigs lam du phebs pa na/gsung las/ dogs pa zhugs pa'i dri ba bzhi 'dug cing / rnam dpyod dang ldan pa dag gis dogs pa sel dgos pa'i dpyod ldan gyi dri ba yang 'ga' zhig 'dug mod kyi/ phal cher ni tshigs la 'khris pa cam dang zhes sogs gsungs 'dug pa yin/ de la dogs pa zhugs pa'i dri ba dang po ni/ gzhung du/ des na bsngo rgyu'i dge ba dang / /bshags par bya ba'i sdig pa yang / /byas pa'i dge sdig yin mod kyi/ /ma byas pa la dge sdig med/ /de yi rnam gzhag bshad kyis nyon/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /des bskyed las ni mi dge ba/ /ma chags zhe sdang gti mug med/ /des bskyed las ni dge ba zhes/ /gsungs pa'i dgongs pa shes nas ni/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis dpyad par bya/ /zhes rin chen phreng ba'i lung drangs pa de la/ paṇa chen gyis/ chags sdang rmongs gsum gyis bskyed pa'i/ /las kun mi dge ba yin na/ /zag bcas dge ba gti mug gis/ /kun slong dag las 'byung de ci/ /zhesadrisapa 'di yin la/ lan ni mi dge ba'i rtsa ba gsum gyi nang tshan du gyur pa'i gti mug gis kun nas bslangs te bskyed pa'i las yin na mi dge ba yin pas khyab pa gzhung gi don yin gyi/spyir gti mug gis kun nas bslangs pa'i las la mi dge bas ma khyab ste/ mdo 582

bod kyi ma/bas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/las/ ma rig pa' rkyen gyis 'du byed ces sogs rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis snga ma snga ma las phyi ma phyi ma 'byung bar gsungs pa'i don myongs na/ nyer len gyi phung po la bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin de thog ma'i ma rig pa yin par klu sgrub kyis gsungs/ de'i rjes su gang zag nyid la nga'o snyam pa'i ngar 'dzin lhan skyes 'byung ba de rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi dang po ma rig pa'i rten 'brel gyi gtso bo yin zhing/ 'di la de kho na nyid la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa zer/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum gyi nang nas sgrib lung ma bstan yin/'dis kun nas bslangs te bskyed pa'i las la bsod nams dang / bsod nams ma yin pa dang / mi g.yo ba'i las gsum du dbyer yod pa las/ gnyis pa 'du byed kyi rten 'brel du 'jog des na zag bcas kyi dge ba thams cad de kho na nyid la rmongs pa'i ma rig pas kun nas bslangs te bskyed par khas len la / 'on kyang mi dge ba'i rtsa ba gsum gyi nang tshan du gyur pa'i gti mug gis kun bslangs pa ma yin te/ rtsa ba gsum gyi nang du gyur pa'i gti mug ni las 'bras la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa dang don gcig pa'i phyir ro/ /'di la klu sgrub yab sras kyi lung gi 'thad pa'ang mang du yod pa 'dir ma spros/ dogs pa gnyis pa ni/ skabs gnyis par/ so sor thar pa'i mdo bzhin du/ /bsngo ba nyan thos rnams kyang byed/ /ces dang / bdag gis bram zer 'dod pa la/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i thad du/ paṇa chen gyis/nyan thos rnams kyi rdzogs byang du//bsngo ba byed na 'phags pa yis/ /nyan thos theg pa de las ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang / /spyod pa yongs bsngo ma bshad de/ /zhes gsungs 583

bod kyi ma/bas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/las/ ma rig pa' rkyen gyis 'du byed ces sogs rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis snga ma snga ma las phyi ma phyi ma 'byung bar gsungs pa'i don myongs na/ nyer len gyi phung po la bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin de thog ma'i ma rig pa yin par klu sgrub kyis gsungs/ de'i rjes su gang zag nyid la nga'o snyam pa'i ngar 'dzin lhan skyes 'byung ba de rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi dang po ma rig pa'i rten 'brel gyi gtso bo yin zhing/ 'di la de kho na nyid la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa zer/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum gyi nang nas sgrib lung ma bstan yin/'dis kun nas bslangs te bskyed pa'i las la bsod nams dang / bsod nams ma yin pa dang / mi g.yo ba'i las gsum du dbyer yod pa las/ gnyis pa 'du byed kyi rten 'brel du 'jog des na zag bcas kyi dge ba thams cad de kho na nyid la rmongs pa'i ma rig pas kun nas bslangs te bskyed par khas len la / 'on kyang mi dge ba'i rtsa ba gsum gyi nang tshan du gyur pa'i gti mug gis kun bslangs pa ma yin te/ rtsa ba gsum gyi nang du gyur pa'i gti mug ni las 'bras la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa dang don gcig pa'i phyir ro/ /'di la klu sgrub yab sras kyi lung gi 'thad pa'ang mang du yod pa 'dir ma spros/ dogs pa gnyis pa ni/ skabs gnyis par/ so sor thar pa'i mdo bzhin du/ /bsngo ba nyan thos rnams kyang byed/ /ces dang / bdag gis bram zer 'dod pa la/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i thad du/ paṇa chen gyis/nyan thos rnams kyi rdzogs byang du//bsngo ba byed na 'phags pa yis/ /nyan thos theg pa de las ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang / /spyod pa yongs bsngo ma bshad de/ /zhes gsungs 583

brtse chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()pa de ci la dgongs/ thams cad sgrol gyi skyes rabs las/ /bsngo ba bshad de nyan thos kyi/ /bsngo ba yin par bzhed dam ci/ /zhes dris pa 'di yin la/ lan ni / klu sgrub kyi rin chen phreng ba las/ nyan thos theg pa de las na/ /byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang / /spyod pa yongs bsngo ma bshad pas/ /theg pa chen por ga la 'gyur/ /byang chub spyod la gnas pa'i don/ /mdo sde las ni bka' ma stsal/ /theg pa che las bka' stsal pa/ /de phyir mkhas pa rnams kyas gzung / /zhes gsungs pa'i don/ spyir nyan thos kyi theg pa'i gzhung las/ byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam sogs ma bshad ces pa'i don du mi 'chad la/ 'o na ci zhe na/ mi dmigs nga/'i rnam pa can gyis shes rab khyad pa can gyi rtsis zin pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang spyod pa sogs nyan thos kyi sde snod las ma bshad la/ rgyu mchan de'i phyir na nyan thos kyi sde snod las gsungs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang spyod pa sogs nyams su blangs pa las sangs rgyas 'thob mi nus te/ de dag gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi rtsis ma zin pa'i phyir zhes pa'i don du 'chad dgos so/ /'di'i skabs don snying po ni theg chen bkar sgrub kyi skabs yin te/ nyan thos sde pa dag gis 'dul ba lung la sogs pa nyan thos kyi gzhung rnams las theg pa gsum rka'i lam 'byung ba'i theg chen gyi lam ston pa'i skabs rnams la theg chen gyi sde snod ces bya zhing / de las logs su theg chen gyi bka' gzhan med par 'dod pa'i log rtog 'gog ci par bzhed nas/ nyan thos theg pa de las ni/ /zhes sogs gsungs rnga/ra shes par bya'o/ /dogs pa che ba'i dri ba gsum pa ni/ skabs gsum par/ dge slong 584

brtsechen 'od snang las/ saskya'i chosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()pa de ci la dgongs/ thams cad sgrol gyi skyes rabs las/ /bsngo ba bshad de nyan thos kyi/ /bsngo ba yin par bzhed dam ci/ /zhes dris pa 'di yin la/ lan ni / klu sgrub kyi rin chen phreng ba las/ nyan thos theg pa de lasani/ /byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang / /spyod pa yongs bsngo ma bshad pas/ /theg pa chen por ga la 'gyur/ /byang chub spyod la gnas pa'i don/ /mdo sde las ni bka' ma stsal/ /theg pa che las bka' stsal pa/ /de phyir mkhas pa rnamasakyisagazung / /zhes gsungs pa'i don/ spyir nyan thos kyi theg pa'i gzhung las/ byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam sogs ma bshad ces pa'i don du mi 'chad la/ 'o na ci zhe na/ mi dmigs nga/'i rnam pa can gyis shes rab khyad pa can gyi rtsis zin pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang spyod pa sogs nyan thos kyi sde snod las ma bshad la/ rgyu mchan de'i phyir na nyan thos kyi sde snod las gsungs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang spyod pa sogs nyams su blangs pa las sangs rgyas 'thob mi nus te/ de dag gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi rtsis ma zin pa'i phyir zhes pa'i don du 'chad dgos so/ /'di'i skabs don snying po ni theg chen bkar sgrub kyi skabs yin te/ nyan thos sde pa dag gis 'dul ba lung la sogs pa nyan thos kyi gzhung rnams las theg pa gsum rka'i lam 'byung ba'i theg chen gyi lam ston pa'i skabs rnams la theg chen gyi sde snod ces bya zhing / de las logs su theg chen gyi bka' gzhan med par 'dod pa'i log rtog 'gog ci par bzhed nas/ nyan thos theg pa de las ni/ /zhes sogs gsungs rnga/ra shes par bya'o/ /dogs pa che ba'i dri ba gsum pa ni/ skabasagasum par/ dge slong 584

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/sdom pa ma thob par/ /mkhan slob la sogs byed pa ni/ /gsang sngags med par sbrul gdug gi /mgo las rin chen len pa ltar/ /rang gzhan brlag pa'i rgyu ru ('gyur )bas/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis rgyang ring spang / /zhes gsungs pa'i thad du/ paṇa chen gyis/ dge slong sdom pa ma thob par/ /mkhan slob byas pas (pa'i)chog pa zhig /'dul ba'i mdo dang lung dag tu/ /gsal bar gsungs pa ma yin nam/ /zhes dris pa 'di yin la/ lan ni/ byed pa po mkhan slob kyis dge slong gi sdom pa ma thob par bsgrub bya la sdom pa 'bogs chog byas pa las sdom pa skye ba tsam zhig lung zhu ba dang / mdo rtsar tshig zin la gsungs pa de yin mod/ 'on kyang de dag dgongs pa gang yin rtogs dka' bas mkhas pa dag gis dpyod dgos rgyur 'dug cing / re zhig sgra zin ltar khas len na'ang /gzhung 'dir rang gzhan brlag pa'i rgyu ru gsungs pa sogs dang mi 'gal te/byed pa po sdom pa dang mi ldan pas g.yin la sdom pa 'bogs chog byas pa las sdom pa skye ba srid kyang / bstan pa dang rang g.yin kun la gnod pa'i nyes pa shin tu che bas mkhas pa rnams kyis rgyang ring du spang bar bya 'os pas so/ /dogs gnas che ba'i dri ba bzhi pa/ deng sang gang zag rab 'bring kun/ /zhes sogs gsungasapa'i thad du/ paṇa chen gyis/ rdul tshon min par smin byed kyi/ /dbang bskur deng sang mi rung na/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i ras bris kyi/ /dkyil 'khor dag tu dbang bskur nas/ /phag mo'i byin rlabs mdzad de ci/ /zhesadrisapa 'di yin la/ lan ni/ kun mkhyen gyi dgongs pa ni gzhung 'di'i lam gyi rim pa thams cad birnya pa'i dgongs pa gzhir bzhag nas/ de'i dbang du byas 585

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/sdom pa ma thob par/ /mkhan slob la sogs byed pa ni/ /gsang sngags med par sbrul gdug gi /mgo las rin chen len pa ltar/ /rang gzhan brlag pa'i rgyu ru ('gyur )bas/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis rgyang ring spang / /zhes gsungs pa'i thad du/ paṇa chen gyis/ dge slong sdom pa ma thob par/ /mkhan slob byas pas (pa'i)chog pa zhig /'dul ba'i mdo dang lung dag tu/ /gsal bar gsungs pa ma yin nam/ /zhes dris pa 'di yin la/ lan ni/ byed pa po mkhan slob kyis dge slong gi sdom pa ma thob par bsgrub bya la sdom pa 'bogs chog byas pa las sdom pa skye ba tsam zhig lung zhu ba dang / mdo rtsar tshig zin la gsungs pa de yin mod/ 'on kyang de dag dgongs pa gang yin rtogs dka' bas mkhas pa dag gis dpyod dgos rgyur 'dug cing / re zhig sgra zin ltar khas len na'ang /gzhung 'dir rang gzhan brlag pa'i rgyu ru gsungs pa sogs dang mi 'gal te/byed pa po sdom pa dang mi ldan pas gzhan la sdom pa 'bogs chog byas pa las sdom pa skye ba srid kyang / bstan pa dang rang g.yin kun la gnod pa'i nyes pa shin tu che bas mkhas pa rnams kyis rgyang ring du spang bar bya 'os pas so/ /dogs gnas che ba'i dri ba bzhi pa/ deng sang gang zag rab 'bring kun/ /zhes sogs gsungasapa'i thad du/ paṇa chen gyis/ rdul tshon min par smin byed kyi/ /dbang bskur deng sang mi rung na/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i ras bris kyi/ /dkyil 'khor dag tu dbang bskur nas/ /phag mo'i byin rlabs mdzad de ci/ /zhesadrisapa 'di yin la/ lan ni/ kun mkhyen gyi dgongs pa ni gzhung 'di'i lam gyi rim pa thams cad birnya pa'i dgongs pa gzhir bzhag nas/ de'i dbang du byas 585

brtsechen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chosa'abyung gcespobasdus/ ()te las dang po pa sngar ma smin pa gsar du na par byed pa la dbang gi mngon par rtogs pa bdun ldan dgos la/ de la rdul tshon dgos pa gzhir bzhag pas gzhung gi don de ltar yin/ spyir ni ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du'ang smin byed kyi dbang bskur du rung ste/ gang du dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor brgyad dang drug la sogs pa'i nang na ras bris 'dug pa dang / slob dpon sgra gcan 'dzin dpal bshes gnyen gyis gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ras bris la brten nas mdzad pa dang / rje sa chen gyis bde mchog nag po pa'i cho ga ras bris la brten nas gsungs pa yin la/ des na las dang po pa zhig la 'khor lo sdom pa'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur nas phag mo'i byin rlabs byas pa la gzhung 'di dang yang 'gal ba med cing 'thad par gsungs/ paṇa chen rang gi gser thur chen mor/ 'phags pa rnams kyi gang zag rab/ /sprul pa yi ni dkyil 'khor du/ /zhes sogs gzhung snga ma'i 'phros dang bstun nas/ deng sang sogs tshig rkang gsum gyi rjesasu/ sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor la sogs pa/ /gzhan gyi smin byed rgyud las bkag /ces bshad na 'thad pa yin gsungs/ rje btsun gyi rtsa lhung 'grul spong gi mjug na deng sang sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur mi nus pa'i phyir gsang sngags spyod pa'i dus min zer ba'i log rtog 'gog pa na rgyud sde rnams las so so skye bo'i rdo rje slob dpon gyis slob ma smin par byed pa'i dbang du byas nas sa brtag bslang sbyang ba dang / dkyil 'khor thig gis 'bri ba dang tshon gyis bri ba la sogs pa gsungs kyi/ sprul pa la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba bshad pa 586

brtsechen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chosa'abyung gcespobasdus/ ()te las dang po pa sngar ma smin pa gsar du na par byed pa la dbang gi mngon par rtogs pa bdun ldan dgos la/ de la rdul tshon dgos pa gzhir bzhag pas gzhung gi don de ltar yin/ spyir ni ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du'ang smin byed kyi dbang bskur du rung ste/ gang du dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'bor brgyad dang drug la sogs pa'i nang na ras bris 'dug pa dang / slob dpon sgra gcan 'dzin dpal bshes gnyen gyis gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ras bris la brten nas mdzad pa dang / rje sa chen gyis bde mchog nag po pa'i cho ga ras bris la brten nas gsungs pa yin la/ des na las dang po pa zhig la 'khor lo sdom pa'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur nas phag mo'i byin rlabs byas pa la gzhung 'di dang yang 'gal ba med cing 'thad par gsungs/ paṇa chen rang gi gser thur chen mor/ 'phags pa rnams kyi gang zag rab/ /sprul pa yi ni dkyil 'khor du/ /zhes sogs gzhung snga ma'i 'phros dang bstun nas/ deng sang sogs tshig rkang gsum gyi rjesasu/ sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor la sogs pa/ /gzhan gyi smin byed rgyud las bkag /ces bshad na 'thad pa yin gsungs/ rje btsun gyi rtsa lhung 'grul spong gi mjug na deng sang sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur mi nus pa'i phyir gsang sngags spyod pa'i dus min zer ba'i log rtog 'gog pa na rgyud sde rnams las so so skye bo'i rdo rje slob dpon gyis slob ma smin par byed pa'i dbang du byas nas sa brtag bslang sbyang ba dang / dkyil 'khor thig gis 'bri ba dang tshon gyis bri ba la sogs pa gsungs kyi/ sprul pa la sogs pa'i dkyil 'bor du dbang bskur ba bshad pa 586

bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/med pa'i ra zhes gsungs pa zhig yod/ de dang paṇa chen gya bzhed pa 'di re mthun pa yin/ 'on kyang / gzhan gyi smin byed rgyud lasabakag /ces pa'i rang mchan du/ rdo rje phag mo la sogasapa/ /zhes bshad snang / de'ang gong du/ kha cig gang zag dbang po rab/ /smin byed phag mo'i phyin rlabs yin/ /zhes sogs dang gzhung snga phyi'i 'phros don 'grigs/ don ni 'di yin te/ so so skye bo'i rdo rje slob dpon gyis sngar ma smin pa'i slob (ma'i )rgyud smin par byed pa la spyir btang gtso che ba'i dbang du byas te/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bya bar gsungs mod kyi/ rdul tshon du dbang bskur ba las gzhan phag mo'i byin rlabs tsam gyis smin byed dang / mchan bu'i sogs kyi sgras da lta sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur zer ba rnams rgyud las bkag ste/ de rnams rgyud las gsungs pa ye med pa'i phyir ro zhes pa 'di tshigs bcad 'di'i don du 'chad dgos par sems/ sbyir btang la rdul tshon gtso che bas gzhung 'dir yang de bzhin du gsungs pa yin gyi/ dmigs bsal deng sang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du'ang smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ spyod rgyud sogs rgyud sde 'ga' re las ras bris gsungs pa'i skabs kyang yod pa dang / grub chen dza ya se nas/ rdul tshon bri bar ma nusan/ /dkyil 'khor dang mnyam ras la ni/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa dang / rje btsun rtse mos/ ras bris la brten pa'i lugs 'di ni zhes pa nas/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyang skabs su phyag len 'di la mdzad pas lugs 'di ha cang mi legs pa'ang ma yin no/ /zhes gsungasapas so / / mdor na rasabris tsam la brten pa 'disago ni chod/ rgyud sde rnamasalas 587

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/med pa'i ra zhes gsungs pa zhig yod/ de dang paṇa chen gya bzhed pa 'di re mthun pa yin/ 'on kyang / gzhan gyi smin byed rgyud las bkag /ces pa'i rang mchan du/ rdo rje phag mo la sogs pa/ /zhes bshad snang / de'ang gong du/ kha cig gang zag dbang po rab/ /smin byed phag mo'i phyin rlabs yin/ /zhes sogs dang gzhung snga phyi'i 'phros don 'grigs/ don ni 'di yin te/ so so skye bo'i rdo rje slob dpon gyis sngar ma smin pa'i slob (ma'i ༄da smin par byed pa la spyir btang gtso che ba'i dbang du byas te/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bya bar gsungs mod kyi/ rdul tshon du dbang bskur ba las gzhan phag mo'i byin rlabs tsam gyis smin byed dang / mchan bu'i sogs kyi sgras da lta sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur zer ba rnams rgyud las bkag ste/ de rnams rgyud las gsungs pa ye med pa'i phyir ro zhes pa 'di tshigs bcad 'di'i don du 'chad dgos par sems/ sbyir btang la rdul tshon gtso che bas gzhung 'dir yang de bzhin du gsungs pa yin gyi/ dmigs bsal deng sang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du'ang smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ spyod rgyud sogs rgyud sde 'ga' re las ras bris gsungs pa'i skabs kyang yod pa dang / grub chen dza ya se nas/ rdul tshon bri bar ma nus na/ /dkyil 'khor dang mnyam ras la ni/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa dang / rje btsun rtse mos/ ras bris la brten pa'i lugs 'di ni zhes pa nas/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyang skabs su phyag len 'di la mdzad pas lugs 'di ha cang mi legs pa'ang ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas so / / mdor na ras bris tsam la brten pa 'dis go ni chod/ rgyud sde rnams las 587

'tshe tshen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ ()gtso bor gsungs pa ba gya sa sbyang ba sogs dang / da la 'khor ga dang tshon gyis 'bri ba la sogs pa'i cho ga rgyas pa ma byung bas cung zad mi legs pa'i cha yod par bstan/ rdul tshon bri bar ma nus na zhes pa'i tshig gis shugs las nus na rdul tshon bri dgos par bstan te/ ras bris tsam la brten pa 'di phyag len zor yangs su song bar dogs so/ /rab dbye'i gzhung khro spar ma zhig na / de yang gang zag rab 'bring kun/ /zhes pa yod/ las chen kumā ra bas de bzhin du bshad snang mod/ de ni gzhung snga phyi'i 'brel bsgrigs pa las/ deng sang gang zag ces pa'i gzhung yongs su grags pa 'di dag pa yin/ yang smin byed kyi skabs su dbang bskur mu bzhi dgag pa las 'phros nas/ 'brug pa sprul sku pad+ma dkar pos brtag gnyis 'chad pa po rnams la dri bar/ tshe 'dir dbang ma bskur kyang thob pa zhig /med na sngags sdom sems rjes 'di'i lha skrul gzhi skabs dang pho gser thur na yod/ 'brang bas gnod/ /ces brtsad cing dri ba snang /de'i lan ni/ sngags sdom spyi tsam pa sems kyi rjes 'brang yin pa rang yang sgrub dka' ste/ sngags sdom thams cad sems dang sems byung gang rung du nges pa las/ sems byung ni sems kyi rjes 'brang yin kyang / sngags sdom du gyur pa'i gtso sems rnams sems kyi rjes 'brang ma yin pa'i phyir te/ de rnams sems kyi 'khor ma yin pa'i phyir/ des na sems kyi rjes 'brang dang / sems kyi rjes 'jug dang / gtso sems kyi 'khor rnams don gcig yin zhing / de dag gi tha snyad kyang mngon pa nas bshad de/ mdzod las/ mtha' ma gnyis ni sems rjes 'brang / zhes dang / sems las byung dang sdom gnyis dang / /sems dang de dag 588

bzuchen 'od snang la / saskya'i motho'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()gtso bor gsungs pa ba gya sa sbyang ba sogs dang / da la 'khor ga dang tshon gyis 'bri ba la sogs pa'i cho ga rgyas pa ma byung bas cung zad mi legs pa'i cha yod par bstan/ rdul tshon bri bar ma nus na zhes pa'i tshig gis shugs las nus na rdul tshon bri dgos par bstan te/ ras bris tsam la brten pa 'di phyag len zor yangs su song bar dogs so/ /rab dbye'i gzhung khro spar ma zhig na / de yang gang zag rab 'bring kun/ /zhesapa yod/ lasachen kumā ra bsade bzhin du bshad snang mod/ de ni gzhung snga phyi'i 'brel bsgrigs pa las/ deng sang gang zag ces pa'i gzhung yongs su grags pa 'di dag pa yin/ yang smin byed kyi skabs su dbang bskur mu bzhi dgag pa las 'phros nas/ 'brug pa sprul sku pad+ma dkar pos brtag gnyis 'chad pa po rnams la dri bar/ tshe 'dir dbang ma bskur kyang thob pa zhig /med na sngags sdom sems rjes 'di'i 'byul gzhi skabasadang tsho gser thur na yod/ 'brang bas gnod/ /cesabartsad cing dri ba snang /de'i lan ni/ sngags sdom spyi tsam pa sems kyi rjes 'brang yin pa rang yang sgrub dka' ste/ sngags sdom thams cad sems dang sems byung gang rung du nges pa las/ sems byung ni sems kyi rjes 'brang yin kyang / sngags sdom du gyur pa'i gtso sems rnams sems kyi rjes 'brang ma yin pa'i phyir te/ de rnams sems kyi 'khor ma yin pa'i phyir/ des na sems kyi rjes 'brang dang / sems kyi rjes 'jug dang / gtso sems kyi 'khor rnams don gcig yin zhing / de dag gi tha snyad kyang mngon pa nas bshad de/ mdzod las/ mtha' ma gnyis ni sems rjes 'brang / zhesadang / semasalasabyung dang sdom gnyisadang / /sems dang de dag 588

bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/ mtshan nyad/ /sems rjes 'jug ces dang / sems dang semasabyung ngesalhan cig zhesagasungasapasaso/ /de ltar na sems kyi rjesa'abrang yin na/ shi 'phos nas kyang rjes su 'brang ba dang / de min na shi 'phos nas rjes su mi 'brang ba'i rnam gzhag byar mi rung ste/ sngags sdom rgyud ldan gyi rig pa 'dzin pa gcig la rtsa lhung byung ba'i tshe de shi ma 'phos kyang de'i rgyud kyi sngags sdom sems kyi rjes 'brang yin min thams cad stong ste/ de'i tshe sngags sdom gyi gtong rgyu byung ba'i phyir/ rig pa 'dzin pa de 'chi 'pho ba'i tshe sngags sdom gyi nyams len gyi rgyun brtan po yod cing rtsa ltung ma byung na/ shi 'phos nas kyang sngags sdom sems kyi rjes 'brang min pa rnams kyang rjes su 'brang ste/ shi 'phos nas kyang sngagasasdom gyi gtong rgyu ma byung bas sngags sdom du gyur pa'i sems sems byungaganyis ka de'i rgyud la yod pa'i phyir ro/ /rab dbye'i gzhung gi dgongs pa ni/ bka' brgyud pa 'ga' zhig gis dbang bskur mu bzhi bcos nas dbang bskur ma byas kyang thob pa sogs la dbang bskur mi dgos pas gsang sngags la dbang bskur ba mtha' gcig tu dgos pa de g.yo thabs kyis bkag nas don la khong tsho rang gi phyag len la dbang bskur dgos pa tsho yang dbang bskur mi byed par/dbang bskur nan gyis 'dor bar byed pa 'di 'gog par bzhed pa yin te/gzhud las/ gal te mu bzhi bden srid na/ /gzhan la dbang bskur mi byed kyang / /byas na thob pa'i gang zag la/ /dbang bskur ci yi phyir mi dgos/ /zhes gsungasapa'i phyir/ tshe 'dir dbang bskur ma thob kyang / skye ba snga ma nasathob zin pa'i sngags sdom gyi rgyun da lta gnas nas yod pa de 'dra lugs 'dir —589

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/ mtshan nyad/ /sems rjes 'jug ces dang / sems dang sems byung nges(lhan cig zhes gsungs pas so/ /de ltar na sems kyi rjes 'brang yin na/ shi 'phos nas kyang rjes su 'brang ba dang / de min na shi 'phos nas rjes su mi 'brang ba'i rnam gzhag byar mi rung ste/ sngags sdom rgyud ldan gyi rig pa 'dzin pa gcig la rtsa lhung byung ba'i tshe de shi ma 'phos kyang de'i rgyud kyi sngags sdom sems kyi rjes 'brang yin min thams cad stong ste/ de'i tshe sngags sdom gyi gtong rgyu byung ba'i phyir/ rig pa 'dzin pa de 'chi 'pho ba'i tshe sngags sdom gyi nyams len gyi rgyun brtan po yod cing rtsa ltung ma byung na/ shi 'phos nas kyang sngags sdom sems kyi rjes 'brang min pa rnams kyang rjes su 'brang ste/ shi 'phos nas kyang sngagasasdom gyi gtong rgyu ma byung bas sngags sdom du gyur pa'i sems sems byung gnyis ka de'i rgyud la yod pa'i phyir ro/ /rab dbye'i gzhung gi dgongs pa ni/ bka' brgyud pa 'ga' zhig gis dbang bskur mu bzhi bcos nas dbang bskur ma byas kyang thob pa sogs la dbang bskur mi dgos pas gsang sngags la dbang bskur ba mtha' gcig tu dgos pa de g.yo thabs kyis bkag nas don la khong tsho rang gi phyag len la dbang bskur dgos pa tsho yang dbang bskur mi byed par/dbang bskur nan gyis 'dor bar byed pa 'di 'gog par bzhed pa yin te/gzhud las/ gal te mu bzhi bden srid na/ /gzhan la dbang bskur mi byed kyang / /byas na thob pa'i gang zag la/ /dbang bskur ci yi phyir mi dgos/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ tshe 'dir dbang bskur ma thob kyang / skye ba snga ma nasathob zin pa'i sngags sdom gyi rgyun da lta gnas nas yod pa de 'dra lugs 'dir —589

ba chen 'od sna pa la/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()yang 'gog ste/ tshe 'a ra sems bskyed cho ga g.yin las ma nos kyang skye ba snga ma nas thob zin pa'i sems bskyed kyi rgyun da lta gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' mang dag yod pa'i phyir dang / gzhung 'dir yang / mu bzhi kun la yod bzhin du/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na sngon gyi grub chen go rak+ṣa dang /rol pa mo la sogs pas tshe 'dir dbang bskur ye ma zhus kyang / skye ba snga ma nas thob zin pa'i rgyun rtogs pa khyad par can thugs rgyud la yod cing / de ltar yod pa de skabs kyi bla ma mngon shes dang ldan pas kyang rtogs nus pas dbang bskur ma mdzad pa'ang srid la/ deng sang ni skye ba sngar nas thob zin rgyun gnas pa'i gdul bya'ang nyung / de 'dra yod srid kyang mngon shes dang mi ldan pa'i slob dpon gyis rtogs par yang dka'/ rtogs su zin kyang bstan pa'i mig rkyen 'chol bar 'gyur gyis dogs nas kun la dbang bskur skabs kyi phyag len ma 'khrul pa re re nas mdzad pa 'di ni khe che la nyen med pa rgyal ba dgyes pa'i phyag len rma med pa yin te/ bstan pa la gces spras su mdzad pa kun gyis 'di bzhin du gnang bar rigs so zhes yang dang yang du zhu ba 'bul te/ gdul bya rgyud mtho dman kun la phan che ba'i phyir ro/ /'dir smras pa/ sngon tshe rgyang 'phen 'dod pa'i gnyis bcas kyi/ /sbyor ba'i zol bzhin kha ba'i khrod 'dir yang / /dbang bskur mu bzhi'i zol sbyor 'di bkod nas/ /kun la dbang bskur 'dor ba'i g.yo thabs mkhan/ /rgyud sde kun las lam gyi rtsa ba mā /dbang bskur gsungs shing dbang de sngags lam gyi/ /dngos gzhi yin par sa skya'i 'jam mgon gsungs/ /rgyal kun dges pa'i lam 'di kun gyis long / /zhes kyang 590

ba chen 'od snapalas/ saskya'i choga'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()yang 'gog ste/ tshe 'a ra sems bskyed cho ga g.yin las ma nos kyang skye ba snga ma nas thob zin pa'i sems bskyed kyi rgyun da lta gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' mang dag yod pa'i phyir dang / gzhung 'dir yang / mu bzhi kun la yod bzhin du/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ desan sngon gyi grub chen go rak+ṣa dang /rol pa mo la sogs pas tshe 'dir dbang bskur ye ma zhus kyang / skye ba snga ma nas thob zin pa'i rgyun rtogs pa khyad par can thugs rgyud la yod cing / de ltar yod pa de skabs kyi bla ma mngon shes dang ldan pas kyang rtogs nus pas dbang bskur ma mdzad pa'ang srid la/ deng sang ni skye ba sngar nas thob zin rgyun gnas pa'i gdul bya'ang nyung / de 'dra yod srid kyang mngon shes dang mi ldan pa'i slob dpon gyis rtogs par yang dka'/ rtogs su zin kyang bstan pa'i mig rkyen 'chol bar 'gyur gyis dogs nas kun la dbang bskur skabs kyi phyag len ma 'khrul pa re re nas mdzad pa 'di ni khe che la nyen med pa rgyal ba dgyes pa'i phyag len rma med pa yin te/ bstan pa la gces spras su mdzad pa kun gyis 'di bzhin du gnang bar rigs so zhes yang dang yang du zhu ba 'bul te/ gdul bya rgyud mtho dman kun la phan che ba'i phyir ro/ /'dir smras pa/ sngon tshe rgyang 'phen 'dod pa'i gnyis bcas kyi/ /sbyor ba'i zol bzhin kha ba'i khrod 'dir yang / /dbang bskur mu bzhi'i zol sbyor 'di bkod nas/ /kun la dbang bskur 'dor ba'i g.yo thabasamakhan/ /rgyud sde kun lasalam gyi rtsa ba mā /dbang bskur gsungs shing dbang de sngags lam gyi/ /dngos gzhi yin par sa skya'i 'jam mgon gsungs/ /rgyal kun dgesapa'i lam 'di kun gyis long / /zhes kyang 590

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/gdams so/ /de ltar dbang bskur ba' slob ma la grangs nges dgos mi dgos kyi rnam dbye ston pa la/ gzhung 'dir/ sngags kyi dbang bskur byed pa na/ /grangs nges med par dbang bskur byed/ /cesapa nas/ rgyud rnams kun la 'jug pa yin/ /zhes pa'i bar 'di gsungs pa yin/ de ltar so so skye bo'i rdo rje slob dpon gyis slob ma brgya stong grangs med pa cig car dbang bskur ba 'di ni lag len 'chol bas mi 'thad de/ rdo rje 'chang gis rgyud las bkag pa'i phyir zhes khyab che ba'i spyir btang sngon la bshad nas/ rnam pa kun tu slob ma brgya la sogs par cig car dbang bskur du mi rung ba'ang ma yin te/ spyod pa'i rgyud kyi dbang bskur la grangs nges mi dgos pa rnam snang mngon byang nyid las gsungs pa'i phyir zhes khyab chung ba'i dmigs bsal rjes la gsungs te/dbang bskur ba'i slob ma la grangs nges dgos pa dang mi dgos pa'i rnam dbye phye ste ston pa la/ sngags kyi dbang bskur zhes nas/ slob ma grangs nges med par gsungs/ /zhes pa'i bar 'di byung / de dag gi grub don snying po bsdu ba ni/lhag ma dmigs bsal ma mdzad pa'i/ /slob ma la ni grangs nges yod/ /ces pa'i gzhung 'dis bstan pa yin te/ de ltar spyod rgyud logs su bzhag nas/ de ma yin par gyur pa'i rgyud sde lhag ma bya rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ bla med rnams kyi dbang bskur ba'i slob ma la grangs nges byed pa yin no zhes pa ni tshig rkang gnyis po de'i bstan don yin/ /sgrub byed kyi lung ni bya ba spyi'i rgyud chen bzhi'i nang tshan gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ mkhas pas slob ma gzhig gam gsum/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa 'di bya rgyud kyi dbang bskur rnams la lta ci smos/ rnal 'byor 591

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/gdams so/ /de ltar dbang bskur ba' slob ma la grangs nges dgos mi dgos kyi rnam dbye ston pa la/ gzhung 'dir/ sngags kyi dbang bskur byed pa na/ /grangs nges med par dbang bskur byed/ /cesapa nas/ rgyud rnams kun la 'jug pa yin/ /zhes pa'i bar 'di gsungs pa yin/ de ltar so so skye bo'i rdo rje slob dpon gyis slob ma brgya stong grangs med pa cig car dbang bskur ba 'di ni lag len 'chol bas mi 'thad de/ rdo rje 'chang gis rgyud las bkag pa'i phyir zhes khyab che ba'i spyir btang sngon la bshad nas/ rnam pa kun tu slob ma brgya la sogs par cig car dbang bskur du mi rung ba'ang ma yin te/ spyod pa'i rgyud kyi dbang bskur la grangs nges mi dgos pa rnam snang mngon byang nyid las gsungs pa'i phyir zhes khyab chung ba'i dmigs bsal rjes la gsungs te/dbang bskur ba'i slob ma la grangs nges dgos pa dang mi dgos pa'i rnam dbye phye ste ston pa la/ sngags kyi dbang bskur zhes nas/ slob ma grangs nges med par gsungs/ /zhes pa'i bar 'di byung / de dag gi grub don snying po bsdu ba ni/lhag ma dmigs bsal ma mdzad pa'i/ /slob ma la ni grangs nges yod/ /ces pa'i gzhung 'dis bstan pa yin te/ de ltar spyod rgyud logs su bzhag nas/ de ma yin par gyur pa'i rgyud sde lhag ma bya rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ bla med rnams kyi dbang bskur ba'i slob ma la grangs nges byed pa yin no zhes pa ni tshig rkang gnyis po de'i bstan don yin/ /sgrub byed kyi lung ni bya ba spyi'i rgyud chen bzhi'i nang tshan gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ mkhas pas slob ma gzhig gam gsum/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa 'di bya rgyud kyi dbang bskur rnams la lta ci smos/ rnal 'byor 591

bzuchen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()rgyud dang bla med kyi dbang bskur ba na'ang sbyar dgos pa yin te/ rgyud sde gong ma gnyis su dbang bskur gyi rnam gzhag mang du gsungs kyang / slob ma la grangs nges kyi rnam gzhag ma gsungs pa la grangs nges kyi phyag len spyi rgyud nas kha skong nas bya ba yin no/ /rab dbyer spyi rgyud nyid kyi lung drangs pa las/ gang du las ni yod gyur la/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ der ma zad so shing 'dor ba dang / dpung skud 'ching ba la sogs pa rnams kyang bya rgyud nas kha skong ste gong ma gnyis su sbyor dgos pa dang / yang nang 'jug gi dngos gzhi ye shes dbab pa 'di'ang bla med kyi rgyud rnams nas dngos su mi gsal bas de nyid rnal 'byor rgyud nas yar kha bskangs te bla med du sbyar ba yin zhing / de dag kyang rgyud rang gi dgongs pa 'khrul med yin te/ de nyid 'dusapa'i rgyud las/nga dang gsang ba spyi rgyud dang / /'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rtog pa dang / /cho ga 'dus dang chog bshad las/ /mkhasapas cho ga kun la sbyar/ /zhes gsungs pa dang /bla med kyi rgyud nyid las kyang tshul de bzhin du gsungs te/ brtag gnyis las/mang du rab tu brjod pas ci/ /ji ltar de nyid bsdus pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga de bzhin bya/ /zhes dang / slob dpon kong ka nas/ slob ma dbang bskur cho ga ni / / gang na'ang gcig gis rdzogs pa yi/ /de phyir mkhabashapas cho ga ni/ khrigrad kun las ni btu bar bya/ /zhes gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir na sa skya pa'i rje btsun gong ma rnams kyis spyod rgyud ma gtogs rgyud sde gzhan gsum gyi dbang bskur ba'i slob ma la grangs nges mdzad pa 'di rgyud sde'i dgongs pa zhabrul med yin no/ /der ma zad lam zab mo bla ma'i byin rlabs kyi bka' sogs dang /592

brtse chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()rgyud dang bla med kyi dbang bskur ba na'ang sbyar dgos pa yin te/ rgyud sde gong ma gnyis su dbang bskur gyi rnam gzhag mang du gsungs kyang / slob ma la grangs nges kyi rnam gzhag ma gsungs pa la grangs nges kyi phyag len spyi rgyud nas kha skong nas bya ba yin no/ /rab dbyer spyi rgyud nyid kyi lung drangs pa las/ gang du las ni yod gyur la/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ der ma zad so shing 'dor ba dang / dpung skud 'ching ba la sogs pa rnams kyang bya rgyud nas kha skong ste gong ma gnyis su sbyor dgos pa dang / yang nang 'jug gi dngos gzhi ye shes dbab pa 'di'ang bla med kyi rgyud rnams nas dngos su mi gsal bas de nyid rnal 'byor rgyud nas yar kha bskangs te bla med du sbyar ba yin zhing / de dag kyang rgyud rang gi dgongs pa zhabrul med yin te/ de nyid 'dus pa' rgyud las/nga dang gsang ba spyi rgyud dang / /'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rtog pa dang / /cho ga 'dus dang chog bshad las/ /mkhas pas cho ga kun la sbyar/ /zhes gsungs pa dang /bla med kyi rgyud nyid las kyang tshul de bzhin du gsungs te/ brtag gnyis las/mang du rab tu brjod pas ci/ /ji ltar de nyid bsdus pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga de bzhin bya/ /zhes dang / slob dpon kong ka nas/ slob ma dbang bskur cho ga ni / / gang na'ang gcig gis rdzogs pa yi/ /de phyir mkhas pas cho ga ni/ khu1da kun las ni btu bar bya/ /zhes gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir na sa skya pa'i rje btsun gong ma rnams kyis spyod rgyud ma gtogs rgyud sde gzhan gsum gyi dbang bskur ba'i slob ma la grangs nges mdzad pa 'di rgyud sde'i dgongs pa 'khrul med yin no/ /der ma zad lam zab mo bla ma'i byin rlabs kyi bka' sogs dang /592

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/rjes gnang khyad par can 'ga' zhig dang / rig gtad gnyan po rnams kyang grangs nges kyis bsdams na phyag len 'chol mi 'gro zhing chos la gces spras su 'gro ba yin te/ sa skya pa'i rjes 'jug rnams da lta'ang phyag len 'di bzhin du mdzad do/ /'o na deng sang dus 'khor gyi dbang la grangs nges mi mdzad pa dang /de bzhin du shangs pa bka' brgyud pa dang / rnying ma ba dang / slob dpon a bha yā ka ra'i lugs kyi dbang bskur gyi phyag len mdzad pa rnams kyang slob ma ji tsam byung ba la gnang bas grangs nges mi mdzad pa dang / grangs kha 'cham pa'ang dgag par mi mdzad pa rnams ji ltar 'thad ce na/ 'di dag kun la'ang spyi bab nyer lnga tshun gyi grangs nges byung na rgyud kyi dgongs pa yin pa dang / dbang de kun gyis nges shing yid ches pa zhig 'byung bas/ cis kyang legs mod/ da lta grangs nges mi mdzad pa sogs ni phyag len zor yangs la shor bas ha cang legs pa rang gi phyag len ni ma yin/ 'on kyang bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pas byang chub kyi sems kyis zin pa'i sgo nas brgya la sogs pa'i mang po la dbang bskur na'ang dbang bskur mtshan nyid par 'gro ste/ nyer lnga las lhag pa brgya la sogs par dbang bskur ba'i tshe na las mi 'chags pa ma yin pa'i phyir te/mang po la dbang bskur bas las mi 'chags pa rgyud las gsungs pa med la/'dul ba las/ bsgrub bya gsum las mang ba la mi rung ba'i shes byed du las mi 'chags pa bkod 'dug pa/de dang sngags kyi chul 'di mi 'dra bar 'chad do//'di dag ni rang gzhan gyi lugs srol kun la sgro skur gyi mtha' dang bral ba'i drang nges rnam par phye nas phyogs gcig la a ma 'thas par rgya 'bag gi mig 593

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/rjes gnang khyad par can 'ga' zhig dang / rig gtad gnyan po rnams kyang grangs nges kyis bsdams na phyag len 'chol mi 'gro zhing chos la gces spras su 'gro ba yin te/ sa skya pa'i rjes 'jug rnams da lta'ang phyag len 'di bzhin du mdzad do/ /'o na deng sang dus 'khor gyi dbang la grangs nges mi mdzad pa dang /de bzhin du shangs pa bka' brgyud pa dang / rnying ma ba dang / slob dpon a bha yā ka ra'i lugs kyi dbang bskur gyi phyag len mdzad pa rnams kyang slob ma ji tsam byung ba la gnang bas grangs nges mi mdzad pa dang / grangs kha 'cham pa'ang dgag par mi mdzad pa rnams ji ltar 'thad ce na/ 'di dag kun la'ang spyi bab nyer lnga tshun gyi grangs nges byung na rgyud kyi dgongs pa yin pa dang / dbang de kun gyis nges shing yid ches pa zhig 'byung bas/ cis kyang legs mod/ da lta grangs nges mi mdzad pa sogs ni phyag len zor yangs la shor bas ha cang legs pa rang gi phyag len ni ma yin/ 'on kyang bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pas byang chub kyi sems kyis zin pa'i sgo nas brgya la sogs pa'i mang po la dbang bskur na'ang dbang bskur mtshan nyid par 'gro ste/ nyer lnga las lhag pa brgya la sogs par dbang bskur ba'i tshe na las mi 'chags pa ma yin pa'i phyir te/mang po la dbang bskur bas las mi 'chags pa rgyud las gsungs pa med la/'dul ba las/ bsgrub bya gsum las mang ba la mi rung ba'i shes byed du las mi 'chags pa bkod 'dug pa/de dang sngags kyi chul 'di mi 'dra bar 'chad do//'di dag ni rang gzhan gyi lugs srol kun la sgro skur gyi mtha' dang bral ba'i drang nges rnam par phye nas phyogs gcig la a ma 'thas par rgya 'bag gi mig 593

ba 'odasnang la / saskya'i chosa'abyung gcesabasdus/ ()'phrul ltar chags pa rnam dbye mdo tsam bstan pa yin la/ da paṇa chen na po che'i bzhed pa bstan pa'i sgo nas gzhung tshig bcos pa sogs kyi rtsod pa bzlog par bya ste/ mkhas pas slob ma gcig gam gsum/ /ceXgasogs drangasapa 'di la gser thur du/ gsang ba spyi rgyud dag lasani/ /dkyil 'khor dag tu dbang bskur ba'i/ /slob ma gnyis dang bzhi la sogs/ /zung du bshad pa 'ga' zhig yod/ /ces tshur rtsod pa mdzad la/ de ni sa paṇa la ma song rdo rje 'chang la rtsod par song ste/ zung du bshad pa 'ga' zhig yod pa'i khungs ni gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ bla masaslob ma gcig pu ni/ /dkyil 'khor dag tu dbang bskur bya/ /mkhasapas cig car slob ma gnyis/ /dbang bskur ba ni yongs mi bya/ /gnyis sam gsum mam bzhi yang rung / /bla masadabang bskur bya ba ni/ /yo byad sar pa gzhan rnamasakyi/ /thamasacad so soso sor bya/ /zhesagasungs pa 'di yin cing / khyed rang gis kyang de ltar mdzad la/ mkhas pas slob ma gcig gam gsum/ /zhes sogasa'adi'ang sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa ni ma yin la/ spyi rgyud nyid kyi lung drangs pa yin cing / spyi rgyud kyi lung de gnyisal khyed kyis 'gal 'du'i rtsod pa btang 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /don ni 'di yin te/slob ma snod rung nyer lnga man gyi zung du ma gyur pa la rjes 'dzin dus gcig la byas nas dbang bskur ba la 'jug pa yin nam/ kun mkhyen gyi dgongs pa ltar na chu dang cod pan gyi dbang tshun sdebs gcig la byas nas/ slar rigs lnga sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba na gzhan rnams gtong nas slob ma gcig kho na la bya ba yin gyi/ gzhan rnams la mi bya/ gal te 'os su gyur pa'i 594

ba chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()'phrul ltar chags pa rnam dbye mdo tsam bstan pa yin la/ da paṇa chen na po che'i bzhed pa bstan pa'i sgo nas gzhung tshig bcos pa sogs kyi rtsod pa bzlog par bya ste/ mkhas pas slob ma gcig gam gsum/ /zhes sogs drangasapa 'di la gser thur du/ gsang ba spyi rgyud dag las ni/ /dkyil 'khor dag tu dbang bskur ba'i/ /slob ma gnyis dang bzhi la sogs/ /zung du bshad pa 'ga' zhig yod/ /ces tshur rtsod pa mdzad la/ de ni sa paṇa la ma song rdo rje 'chang la rtsod par song ste/ zung du bshad pa 'ga' zhig yod pa'i khungs ni gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ bla mas slob ma gcig pu ni/ /dkyil 'khor dag tu dbang bskur bya/ /mkhas pas cig car slob ma gnyis/ /dbang bskur ba ni yongs mi bya/ /gnyis sam gsum mam bzhi yang rung / /bla mas dbang bskur bya ba ni/ /yo byad sar pa gzhan rnams kyi/ /thams cad so so so sor bya/ /zhesagasungs pa 'di yin cing / khyed rang gis kyang de ltar mdzad la/ mkhas pas slob ma gcig gam gsum/ /zhes sogs 'di'ang sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa ni ma yin la/ spyi rgyud nyid kyi lung drangs pa yin cing / spyi rgyud kyi lung de gnyis la khyed kyis 'gal 'du'i rtsod pa btang 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /don ni 'di yin te/slob ma snod rung nyer lnga man gyi zung du ma gyur pa la rjes 'dzin dus gcig la byas nas dbang bskur ba la 'jug pa yin nam/ kun mkhyen gyi dgongs pa ltar na chu dang cod pan gyi dbang tshun sdebs gcig la byas nas/ slar rigs lnga sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba na gzhan rnams gtong nas slob ma gcig kho na la bya ba yin gyi/ gzhan rnams la mi bya/ gal te 'os su gyur pa'i 594

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dgagigrubamatha'ishana'abyedamotha'adapyodadang bcasapa'i 'bel gtom/slab ma gnyas sam/ gsum mam/ bzha la sags pa gang yang 〈cong ba yad na snga ma de la dbang bskur tshar ba dang / gzhan rnams rim pa bzhin du re re nas bos la dbang bskur bar bya ba yin te/ de'i tshul yang re re la'ang sngon du mchod pa'i yo byad rnying pa rnams spo zhing gsar pa rnams bshams te/ bla mas kyang mdun bskyed sgrub mchod bdag 'jug tshul bzhin du btang la/ dbang bskur ba'i cho ga thams cad slob ma so so ste re re la so sor bya ba rgyud kyi don yin te/ tshig gi 'bru myangs pas gsal lo/ /paṇa chen gyis yo byad gsar pa'i don dbang rdzas kyi yo byad la bshad snang yang / de ni don ma yin te/ slob ma snga phyi la dbang rdzas tha dad dgos pa'i shes byed med pa'i phyir/ gzhan du na da lta dbang rdzas bum chu gcig nyid nas slob ma kun la ster ba khyed rang yang mdzad/bla ma gong ma rnams kyang mdzad pa sogs sun dbyung rigs sam/ yang paṇa chen gyis/ spyod pa'i rgyud kyi dbang bskur la/ /slob ma grangs nges med gyur na/ /gcig nas bcu yi bar dag gi /grangs nges mdzad pa ji ltar yin/ /zhes dri ba gnang nas/ rang gi dgongs bzhed ni rgyud sde bzhi char du dbang bskur ba'i slob ma la grangs nges yod cing de'i nang nas spyod rgyud la grangs kha 'cham pa ni rung gi gungs ni bcu las lhag pa la mi rung ste/ rnam snang mngon byang las/slob ma dad cing rigs btsun pa/ /de bzhin dkon mchog gsum la dad/ /zab mo yi ni blo dang ldan/ /spro ba che zhing chul khrims ldan/ /bzod dang ldan zhing ser sna med/ /dpal la yid rab brtan pa ni/ /bcu'am brgyad dam bdun nam lnga / / gnyis sam bzhi las lhag kyang rung / /dpyad mi dgos par gzung bar bya//595

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dgagigrubamatha'ishana'abyedamotha'adapyodadang bcasapa'i 'bel gtom/slab ma gnyas sam/ gsum mam/ bzha la sags pa gang yang 〈cong ba yad na snga ma de la dbang bskur tshar ba dang / gzhan rnams rim pa bzhin du re re nas bos la dbang bskur bar bya ba yin te/ de'i tshul yang re re la'ang sngon du mchod pa'i yo byad rnying pa rnams spo zhing gsar pa rnams bshams te/ bla mas kyang mdun bskyed sgrub mchod bdag 'jug tshul bzhin du btang la/ dbang bskur ba'i cho ga thams cad slob ma so so ste re re la so sor bya ba rgyud kyi don yin te/ tshig gi 'bru myangs pas gsal lo/ /paṇa chen gyis yo byad gsar pa'i don dbang rdzas kyi yo byad la bshad snang yang / de ni don ma yin te/ slob ma snga phyi la dbang rdzas tha dad dgos pa'i shes byed med pa'i phyir/ gzhan du na da lta dbang rdzas bum chu gcig nyid nas slob ma kun la ster ba khyed rang yang mdzad/bla ma gong ma rnams kyang mdzad pa sogs sun dbyung rigs sam/ yang paṇa chen gyis/ spyod pa'i rgyud kyi dbang bskur la/ /slob ma grangs nges med gyur na/ /gcig nas bcu yi bar dag gi /grangs nges mdzad pa ji ltar yin/ /zhes dri ba gnang nas/ rang gi dgongs bzhed ni rgyud sde bzhi char du dbang bskur ba'i slob ma la grangs nges yod cing de'i nang nas spyod rgyud la grangs kha 'cham pa ni rung gi gungs ni bcu las lhag pa la mi rung ste/ rnam snang mngon byang las/slob ma dad cing rigs btsun pa/ /de bzhin dkon mchog gsum la dad/ /zab mo yi ni blo dang ldan/ /spro ba che zhing chul khrims ldan/ /bzod dang ldan zhing ser sna med/ /dpal la yid rab brtan pa ni/ /bcu'am brgyad dam bdun nam lnga / / gnyis sam bzhi las lhag kyang rung / /dpyad mi dgos par gzung bar bya//595

ba chen 'od thal ga sa skya'i chog༅nga gces bsdus/ ()theb/bcu tshun bshad / bcu las(lhag pa la drang ste/ lung drangs ma thag pa de dang 'brel chags su/ 'di skad ces/ gsang ba'i bdag po/ gang dag gi sngon theg pa chen po gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul sgo mtha' yas pa bsgrub pa la goms par byas pa de dag ni rdo rje sems dpa' yin te/ de rnams nyid kyi don gyi phyir grangs kyi tshad 'di byas so gsungs pa'i phyir gsungs pa snang / lung 'di sa paṇa gyis ma gzigs 'dug snyam nas/ spyod pa'i rgyud kyi dbang bskur la / / slob ma rjes 'dzin grangs nges med/ zhes gzhung bcos kyang / sa paṇa gyis ma gzigs pa min/ khyed rang gis drang ma thag pa'i lung de dag gi don ni kho bo cag 'di ltar sems te/ bcu'am brgyad dam bdun nam lnga/ /zhes pa de ni bcu tshun gyi slob ma'i grangs nges bstan pa ga la yin/ de ni skye ba snga ma gsang sngags kyi lam la goms pa rgya chen po sgoms pa sngon du song ba'i skal ldan las 'phro can gyi slob ma 'ga' re'i dbang du byas pa yin cing / skal bar ldan pa'i rigs can ni nyung bas ya mtha' bcu'i dbang du byas te skal ldan de rnams kyi don gyi phyir gcig gnyis nas bcu'i bar dbang bskur ba'i slob ma'i grangs kyi dper brjod du smros te grangs kyi tshad bzhag pa yin gyi/ spyir spyod rgyud kyi dbang bskur gyi slob ma'i grangs nges bstan pa ga la yin/ dper na 'jig rten na dngos po gang dang gang gi tshad 'jog pa na/ de'i cha shas sam mtshan gzhi gcig la 'jog pa dang mtshungs so/ /yang brtags pa mtha' bzung gi dbang du byas te skal ba dang ldan pa'i slob ma brgya stong yod srid na'ang de dag la cig car spyod rgyud kyi dbang bskur bas chog ste/ slob dpon a bha yā ka 596

'tshe' 'og thalag saskya'i chosayang gesabasdus/ ()zhesabacu tshun bshad / bcu lasalhag pa la drang ste/ lung drangasam thag pa de dang 'brel chagasasu/ 'di skad ces/ gsang ba'i bdag po/ gang dag gi sngon theg pa chen po gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul sgo mtha' yas pa bsgrub pa la gomasapar byasapa de dag ni rdo rje semasadapa' yin te/ de rnamasanyid kyi don gyi phyir grangasakyi tshad 'di byasaso gsungasapa'i phyir gsungasapa snang / lung 'di sapaṇa gyis ma gzigasa'adug snyam nas/ spyod pa'i rgyud kyi dbang bskur la / / slob ma rjesa'adzin grangasangesamed/ zhesagazhung bcosakyang / sapaṇa gyis ma gzigs pa min/ khyed rang gis drang ma thag pa'i lung de dag gi don ni kho bo cag 'di ltar semasate/ bcu'am brgyad dam bdun nam lnga/ /zhesapa de ni bcu tshun gyi slob ma'i grangs nges bstan pa ga la yin/ de ni skye ba snga ma gsang sngags kyi lam la goms pa rgya chen po sgoms pa sngon du song ba'i skal ldan las 'phro can gyi slob ma 'ga' re'i dbang du byas pa yin cing / skal bar ldan pa'i rigs can ni nyung bas ya mtha' bcu'i dbang du byas te skal ldan de rnams kyi don gyi phyir gcig gnyis nas bcu'i bar dbang bskur ba'i slob ma'i grangs kyi dper brjod du smrosate grangs kyi tshad bzhag pa yin gyi/ spyir spyod rgyud kyi dbang bskur gyi slob ma'i grangs nges bstan pa ga la yin/ dper na 'jig rten na dngos po gang dang gang gi tshad 'jog pa na/ de'i cha shas sam mtshan gzhi gcig la 'jog pa dang mtshungs so/ /yang brtags pa mtha' bzung gi dbang du byas te skal ba dang ldan pa'i slob ma brgya stong yod srid na'ang de dag la cig car spyod rgyud kyi dbang bskur bas chog ste/ slob dpon a bha yā ka 596

bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/ras da la chog rdo rje phreng ba las/ skal ba dang ldan na stong bar du'ang gzung bar bya'o/ /zhesagasungs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar na spyod rgyud kyi dbang bskur yul gyi slob ma de la skal ldan las 'phro can rdo rje sems dpa' dang 'dra ba'i rigasacan nyung shasadang / sngon sbyangs pa ma byas pa'i rigasacan dbang bskur ba'i snod rung tsam du gyur pa mtha' yas pa gnyis yod pa rnam snang mngon byang las gsungs pa yin zhing / dang po'i dbang du byas nas slob ma dad cing rigs btsun pa zhesapa nas de dag ni rdo rje sems dpa' yin te/ de rnams nyid kyi don gyi phyir grangasakyi tshad 'di byasaso/ /zhes pa 'di gsungasapa yin te / de'i dbang du byasanas grangs kyi tshad de ltar du byasapa lung nyid lasadangosasu gsal ba de yin/ gnyis pa slob ma mtha' yas pa'i dbang du byas nas sngar lung drangs pa de ma thag tu/ 'on kyang slob dpon snying rje chen po dang ldan pas sems can gyi khams ma lus pa bsgral bar yid dam bca' ba kho nar bya ste/des byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyur 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir sems can tshad med pa rnams yongs su gzung bar bya'o zhes pa 'di gsungs la/ rab dbyer/ spyod pa'i rgyud kyi dbang bskur la/ /slob ma grangs nges med par gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i lung khungs kyang 'di nyid yin/ des na skabs 'di'i slob ma la skal ldan las 'phro can nyung shas dang / de ma yin pa'i sems can tshad med pa gnyis su dbye ba ni lung drangs pa de'i tshig snga phyi'i bab bsgrigs nas go ba myangs pas shes/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni skal 8ldan las 'phro can gyi dbang du byas nas nyung shas smos te grangs kyi tshad 'di byas so/ /zhes rnam par bzhag pa 597

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/ras da la chog rdo rje phreng ba las/ skal ba dang ldan na stong bar du'ang gzung bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar na spyod rgyud kyi dbang bskur yul gyi slob ma de la skal ldan las 'phro can rdo rje sems dpa' dang 'dra ba'i rigs can nyung shas dang / sngon sbyangs pa ma byas pa'i rigs can dbang bskur ba'i snod rung tsam du gyur pa mtha' yas pa gnyis yod pa rnam snang mngon byang las gsungs pa yin zhing / dang po'i dbang du byas nas slob ma dad cing rigs btsun pa zhes pa nas de dag ni rdo rje sems dpa' yin te/ de rnams nyid kyi don gyi phyir grangs kyi tshad 'di byas so/ /zhes pa 'di gsungs pa yin te / de'i dbang du byas nas grangs kyi tshad de ltar du byas pa lung nyid las dngosasu gsal ba de yin/ gnyis pa slob ma mtha' yas pa'i dbang du byas nas sngar lung drangs pa de ma thag tu/ 'on kyang slob dpon snying rje chen po dang ldan pas sems can gyi khams ma lus pa bsgral bar yid dam bca' ba kho nar bya ste/des byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyur 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir sems can tshad med pa rnams yongs su gzung bar bya'o zhes pa 'di gsungs la/ rab dbyer/ spyod pa'i rgyud kyi dbang bskur la/ /slob ma grangs nges med par gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i lung khungs kyang 'di nyid yin/ des na skabs 'di'i slob ma la skal ldan las 'phro can nyung shas dang / de ma yin pa'i sems can tshad med pa gnyis su dbye ba ni lung drangs pa de'i tshig snga phyi'i bab bsgrigs nas go ba myangs pas shes/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni skal 8ldan las 'phro can gyi dbang du byas nas nyung shas smos te grangs kyi tshad 'di byas so/ /zhes rnam par bzhag pa 597

ba chen 'od snang la / saskya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()gcig brjod nas/ yang slob ma mtha' yas pa la bskur ba' dbang du byas nas/ rnam par bzhag pa gnyis par brjod par bzhed nas/ 'on kyang slob dpon snying rje chen po zhes pa nas tshad med pa rnams yongs su gzung bar bya'o//zhes pa'i bar gsungs pa yin te/'on kyang zhes pa'i tshig nus myang dgosaso/ /paṇa chen gyis rnam gzhag snga ma de rang la thugs rtse gtad nas/ spyod pa'i rgyud kyi dbang bskur la/ /slob ma rjes gzung grangs nges med/ /ces gzhung bcos nas ston na bde ba yin zhes dang / rang gi bcu tshan gyi grangs nges bshad pa dang / sems can tshad med pa rnams yongs su gzung bar bya'o/ /zhes pa'i lung 'gal 'du 'byung bar mkhyen nas lung phyi ma 'di slob ma rjes gzung yin gyi/dbang bskur dus kyi slob ma bstan pa ma yin zhes gsungs pa snang ngo / /'o na/bcu'am/ brgyad dam/ bdun nam/ lnga/ zhes sogs kyang slob ma rjes gzung gi skabs tsam yin par 'gyur te/ de'i mjug tu/ dpyad mi dgos par gzung bar bya / / zhes gsungs 'dug pa'i phyir/ bab lung gi don de rjes bzung gi skabs yin na'ang des spyod rgyud kyi dbang la grangs nges mi dgos par grub ste/ rjes gzung gi slob ma la grangs nges med na/ sta gon gyi dus su'ang de la grangs nges med/ de med na dngos gzhi'i dus su'ang grangs nges mi dgos pa'i phyir/ rgyud sde gzhan gsum gyi rjes 'dzin gyi slob ma la grangs nges bshad pas/ des dbang bskur gyi slob ma'i grangs kyang 'grub pa yin te/ dbang bskur gyi slob ma'i grangs sta gon gyi dus kyi grangs la ltos dgos/ sta gon gyi dus kyi de rjes 'dzin gyi grangs la ltos dgos pa'i phyir/ rje btsun gyi dbang chu chen mo las 598

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/kyang / nya shu rtsa lnga tshun la kha yar ba grangs 'a rjes 'dzin cho ga 'a skababa'isu bshad na/ de'i rgyab rten du/ mkhas pas slob ma gcig gam gsum/ /zhesasogs 'dren par mdzad pa yin/ da lta'i lam 'bras pa phal che ba slob ma rjesa'adzin sdebs gcig la byed pa ni phyis su phyag len zor yangs la song ba'i skyon du byed dgos/ don gyi 'gal ba cher med/ yang phyis su sprul sku pad+ma dkar pos brtag gnyis 'chad pa po rnams la dri bar/ snod rung gang zag nyer lnga las gzhan par/ /'jug pa bla med rgyu sde gang du bkag /bya ba'i rgyud las skabs 'dir btsan pa'i lung / /dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lor snang min nam/ /bya ba'i rgyud las bkag na de nyid kyi/ /rig gtad rjes gnang khrom la byed pa'ang 'gal/ /skabs 'dir rjes gnang dbang la dgos pa'i khyad/ /ci yang ma mthong tshigs la rtsod pa ci/ /rigs pa cho ga rdzogs par mi 'gyur lo/ /dus 'khor phreng ba'i dbang ni mang po la/ /ston bzhin de skad smras kyang mdzes pa min/ /zhes brtsad cing dri ba gnang la/ tshig dang po de'i lan phal cher ni rang lu gos kyi brda chad bshad pa de dag gis thebs la/ cung zad brjod na/ dus 'khor 'grel chen du/ sngon rgyal po 'jam dpal grags pas tshangs pa'i drang srong bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi la dus gcig tu dbang bskur bar bshad pa dang /de bzhin du ston pa sangs rgyas kyis au ḍi ya nar rgyal po in+d+ra snya ti 'khor du ma dang bcas pa gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du bcug ste dbang bskur ba gsungs pa rnams yod kyang / de dag ni dbang bskur ba po dang zhu mkhan gnyis ka sngon du skal ldan las dag pa'i slob ma la rdo rje slob dpon 'phags pa'i gang 599
