bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/rnams la dgos nus khyad par cher ma 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rjes gnang la dbang gi mtha' rten du byed pa'i rjes gnang dang / dbang las logs su sku gsung thugasakyi rjes gnang byed pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ lha mchod pa dang /sems can gyi don byed pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / brtul zhugs sbyin pa la sogs pa dbang chog rnams su 'byung ba thugs la mnga' ba de yin la/ gnyis pa ni/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang rgya mtsho la sogs pa deng sang slob ma du ma tshogs pa'i khrom la'ang byed pa 'di yin la/ 'di la khyed dbang thob kyang yin na cang mi smra/ de min khas blangs 'gal ba sogs kyi skyon btang 'dod 'dug kyang / 'di la sgrub thabs brgya rtsa lta bu la mtshon na/ bla med kyi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i lha'ang 'ga' yod 'dug pas na/ sngon du bla med kyi dbang thob pa zhig gis yongs rdzogs zhu ba yin/ yang rgyud sde 'og ma'i dbang thob na'ang 'og ma nas bshad pa'i lha'i rjes gnang rnams zhus pas chogadabang bskur ye ma thob na'ang gzungs grwa lnga la sogs pa bya rgyud kyi lha 'ga' re'i rjes gnang zhus pas chog ste/ rab dbye las/ bya ba'i rgyud la rnam gsum yod/ /don yod zhags sogs 'ga' zhig la/ /dbang bskur sems bskyed ma thob kyang / /zhes sogs gsungs pa 'di khyed rang yang lung du 'dren gyin 'dug pa / nged cag rnams kyang de ka bzhin 'dren pas mthun par snang / rig gtad la dbang dang rjes gnang gnyis su yod/ de'i dang po ni/ gzungs sgra lnga'i dbang dang / gtsug tor dri med kyi dbang dang / rigs gsum spyi'i dbang la sogs pa bya rgyud rang rkang gi dbang rnams yin/ rig gtad zer ba'i rgyu mtshan 601

yo chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()ni / gzungs grwa lnga lta bu la mtsho ni na/ lha lnga bskyed pa bum pa slob ma bor bzhag ste lha'i mngon rtogs brjod/ gzungs rnams bzlas shing bum chu ster/de'i tshe na rig pa ni lha de yin la/ lha'i bskyed chog dang sngags bzla ba slob ma la gtad pa'am byin pas na rig gtad ces bya'o/ /gnyis pa rjes gnang du gyur pa'i rig gtad ni bla med na'ang slob ma yi dam du bskyed nas/ de la chos skyong gi sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang ster ba'ang rig gtad yin zhing / gtso bor ni bya rgyud kyi lha la rig gtad mang ba yin te/ sa skya pa nas brgyud pa'i don zhags gtso rkyang lta bu dang / skyer sgang pa nas brgyud pa'i spyan ras gags kyi rig gtad dang / rngog lo nas brgyud pa'i 'jam dbyangs gang blo ma'i byin rlabs la sogs pa'ang rig gtad yin cing / de dag gi tshe na'ang slob ma lhar ma bskyed par da lta'i tha mal pa de la mdun gyi nam mkhar lha bskyed pa de'i lha ngo bstan/ sngags kyi bzlas lung 'bogs pas rig gtad kyi don tshang ba yin no / / da lta ni 'ga' zhig rig gtad dgos pa rnams la'ang de dor nas sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang gi ching sbyor ba dang / rjes gnang gi bshad khungs med pa'i lha'i rigs 'ga' re la bsgom bzlas kyi lung tsam phog pas chog pa la brgya rtsa sogs kyi 'gros sbyar nas rjes gnang byed pas/ da lta rjes gnang gi rigs mang du ka song yod 'dug chos thog tu ban+de khyi nyal gyi dpe yin nam/tshags bcad gsum pa'i lan ni/ bdag nyid chen pos/ de las lhag pa'i slob ma la/ /zhes sogs kyi lung 'dren dang bcas pa'i don ni/ brtag gnyis las/mtshan mo skye bo med khyim du/ /slob dpon la sogs rab phye nas/ /dbang ni ji 602

'tsher+sā 'odasnang las/ saskya'i chosalūng stsosabasdus/ ()ni / gzungs grwa lnga lta bu la mtshon na/ lha lnga bskyed pa bum pa slob ma bor bzhag ste lha'i mngon rtogs brjod/ gzungasarnams bzlas shing bum chu ster/de'i tshe na rig pa ni lha de yin la/ lha'i bskyed chog dang sngags bzla ba slob ma la gtad pa'am byin pas na rig gtad ces bya'o/ /gnyis pa rjes gnang du gyur pa'i rig gtad ni bla med na'ang slob ma yi dam du bskyed nas/ de la chos skyong gi sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang ster ba'ang rig gtad yin zhing / gtso bor ni bya rgyud kyi lha la rig gtad mang ba yin te/ sa skya pa nas brgyud pa'i don zhags gtso rkyang lta bu dang / skyer sgang pa nas brgyud pa'i spyan rasagazigs kyi rig gtad dang / rngog lo nas brgyud pa'i 'jam dbyangs gang blo ma'i byin rlabs la sogs pa'ang rig gtad yin cing / de dag gi tshe na'ang slob ma lhar ma bskyed par da lta'i tha mal pa de la mdun gyi nam mkhar lha bskyed pa de'i lha ngo bstan/ sngags kyi bzlas lung 'bogs pas rig gtad kyi don tshang ba yin no / / da lta ni 'ga' zhig rig gtad dgos pa rnams la'ang de dor nas sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang gi ching sbyor ba dang / rjes gnang gi bshad khungs med pa'i lha'i rigs 'ga' re la bsgom bzlas kyi lung tsam phog pas chog pa la brgya rtsa sogs kyi 'gros sbyar nas rjes gnang byed pas/ da lta rjes gnang gi rigs mang du ka song yod 'dug chos thog tu ban+de khyi nyal gyi dpe yin nam/tshigasabacad gsum pa'i lan ni/ bdag nyid chen pos/ de lasalhag pa'i slob ma la/ /zhes sogs kyi lung 'dren dang bcasapa'i don ni/ brtag gnyis las/mtshan mo skye bo med khyim du/ /slob dpon la sogs rab phye nas/ /dbang ni ji 602

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/ltar gsungs pa nyid/ /cesadang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ yul de dag gi bu mo gang / /rtag tu bu mo 'phyon ma dang / /sgrub pa po la dngos grub ster/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dang dbang bskur ba'i dus kyang ma dus su bya ba bsngags pas/ sta gon nub snga ma la btang zin nas/ dngos gzhi'i tshe slob dpon gyis srod thun nas bla med kyi cho ga yin na sngon 'gro gtor ma dang gnas yo byin rlabs/ rgyud sde 'og ma yin na mchod pa byin rlabs tsam byas nas bya rgyud rang rkang gi lugs 'ba' zhig ma gtogs phal cher la bdag bskyed sngon du btang zhing mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa dang /slob ma la ji ltar dbang bskur ba'i tshod tsam gyi 'jug pa dang dbang blang ba sogs tshar ba dang slob ma bos nas dbang bskur ba la/ bya rgyud kyi dbang du byas pa la 'jug pa dang / chu cod pan gyi dbang nyer lnga tshun gyi zung du ma gyur pa du yod la mnyam du byas nas sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang bskur ba la/ spyi rgyud las/ slob ma re re nas bkug ste/ /cho ga bzhin du bsang gtor la/ /zhesda dang / thams cad so so so sor bya/ /zhes gsungs pas re re nas so sor bskur dgos pa de'ang mtshan mo de'i nang du tshar na legs pa dang / rnal 'byor rgyud phal cher la dbang gi bab bla med las kyang sgrub mchod kyi cho ga tshogs che ba bzhugs pa dang / khyad par rdo rje rtse mo lta bu'i dkyil chog ni dus 'khor las kyang mang bar yod 'dug pa dang / bla med la bde kye gnyis sogs phal cher dus 'bor gyi cho ga las nyung kyang / mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho lta bu ni bdag mdun gyi cho ga dang sngags rnams tshogs che bar yod cing / bde kye sogs de dag kyang 6(13

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/ltar gsungs pa nyid/ /cesadang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ yul de dag gi bu mo gang / /rtag tu bu mo 'phyon ma dang / /sgrub pa po la dngos grub ster/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dang dbang bskur ba'i dus kyang ma dus su bya ba bsngags pas/ sta gon nub snga ma la btang zin nas/ dngos gzhi'i tshe slob dpon gyis srod thun nas bla med kyi cho ga yin na sngon 'gro gtor ma dang gnas yo byin rlabs/ rgyud sde 'og ma yin na mchod pa byin rlabs tsam byas nas bya rgyud rang rkang gi lugs 'ba' zhig ma gtogs phal cher la bdag bskyed sngon du btang zhing mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa dang /slob ma la ji ltar dbang bskur ba'i tshod tsam gyi 'jug pa dang dbang blang ba sogs tshar ba dang slob ma bos nas dbang bskur ba la/ bya rgyud kyi dbang du byas pa la 'jug pa dang / chu cod pan gyi dbang nyer lnga tshun gyi zung du ma gyur pa du yod la mnyam du byas nas sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang bskur ba la/ spyi rgyud las/ slob ma re re nas bkug ste/ /cho ga bzhin du bsang gtor la/ /zhes dang / thams cad so so so sor bya/ /zhes gsungs pas re re nas so sor bskur dgos pa de'ang mtshan mo de'i nang du tshar na legs pa dang / rnal 'byor rgyud phal cher la dbang gi bab bla med las kyang sgrub mchod kyi cho ga tshogs che ba bzhugs pa dang / khyad par rdo rje rtse mo lta bu'i dkyil chog ni dus 'khor las kyang mang bar yod 'dug pa dang / bla med la bde kye gnyis sogs phal cher dus 'bor gyi cho ga las nyung kyang / mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho lta bu ni bdag mdun gyi cho ga dang sngags rnams tshogs che bar yod cing / bde kye sogs de dag kyang 6(13

ba ོ 'od palas/ saskya'i chosa'abyungagacesabasdus/ ()slob dpon dbang bskur ba na/ slob ma re re nasadabang stegasal bzhag ste bskur dgosapa na/ dbang gong ma gsum gyi dngosagazhi'ang slob ma re re nasabaskur ba dang po'i phyag len la yod pas de bzhin byas na 'gor ches pas slob ma nyer lnga las lhag pa la mtshan mo de'i nang du mi tshar ba'ang shas che bas mtshan mo'i mtha'i nang sang gi skya rengs shar ba'i gong du mtshan dus byon pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams tshogs dang gtor mas mnyes par byas nas gshegasagasol thub na 'brel chags shing shisapas/ bdag nyid chen pos gdul bya rnams la thugs brtse bas 'di ltar 'doms par mdzad pa la khyed rnams kyis gzhan du log par ma rtogs shig dus 'khor dang phreng ba'i dbang sa skya pa'i rjes 'jug dag gis kyang grangs nges med par mang po la ston pa phreng ba mkhan po sogs kyi sngar nas mdzad pa'i lugs bzhin los yod mod/ de la khyed kyis sa paṇa la 'gal ba zhu rgyu med pa 'dra ste/ sa paṇa gyis grangs nges med pa la de dag gi dbang ma mdzad pa'i phyir/ phreng ba dang dus 'khor sogs la'ang deng sang nyer lnga tshun gyi grangs nges byung na shin tu legs/ lar dus 'khor gyi 'gros bla med spyi la sbyor tshe 'brug pasarigasazer ba ni skabasasu ma babs te/dus 'khor dang bla med spyi la dbang gi bab mi 'dra ba'i khyad par chen po yod pa'i phyir te/ bla med spyi la chu dbang nas bzung dam tshig gsum sbyin pa'am/yang na rig pa'i dbang lnga mdor bsdus bskur ba'i slob dpon gyi dbang gi bar gyi dbang bdun char bum dbang nyid du bzhed/ dus kyi 'khor lor ni chu/ cod pan/ dar dpyangs/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ brtul zhugs/ ming gis dbang dang bdun 604

ba chen 'od pal / sa skya'i chosang gces bsdus/ ()slob dpon dbang bskur ba na/ slob ma re re nas dbang stegs la bzhag ste bskur dgos pa na/ dbang gong ma gsum gyi dngos gzhi'ang slob ma re re nasabaskur ba dang po'i phyag len la yod pas de bzhin byas na 'gor ches pas slob ma nyer lnga las lhag pa la mtshan mo de'i nang du mi tshar ba'ang shas che bas mtshan mo'i mtha'i nang sang gi skya rengs shar ba'i gong du mtshan dus byon pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams tshogs dang gtor mas mnyes par byas nas gshegs gsol thub na 'brel chags shing shis pas/ bdag nyid chen pos gdul bya rnams la thugs brtse bas 'di ltar 'doms par mdzad pa la khyed rnams kyis gzhan du log par ma rtogs shig dus 'khor dang phreng ba'i dbang sa skya pa'i rjes 'jug dag gis kyang grangs nges med par mang po la ston pa phreng ba mkhan po sogs kyi sngar nas mdzad pa'i lugs bzhin los yod mod/ de la khyed kyis sa paṇa la 'gal ba zhu rgyu med pa 'dra ste/ sa paṇa gyis grangs nges med pa la de dag gi dbang ma mdzad pa'i phyir/ phreng ba dang dus 'khor sogs la'ang deng sang nyer lnga tshun gyi grangs nges byung na shin tu legs/ lar dus 'khor gyi 'gros bla med spyi la sbyor tshe 'brug pas rigs zer ba ni skabs su ma babs te/dus 'khor dang bla med spyi la dbang gi bab mi 'dra ba'i khyad par chen po yod pa'i phyir te/ bla med spyi la chu dbang nas bzung dam tshig gsum sbyin pa'am/yang na rig pa'i dbang lnga mdor bsdus bskur ba'i slob dpon gyi dbang gi bar gyi dbang bdun char bum dbang nyi de du bzhed/ dus kyi 'khor lor ni chu/ cod pan/ dar dpyangs/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ brtul zhugs/ ming gis dbang dang bdun 604

bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dgagi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/la sa'ajug dbang bdun du byas nas/ de kun da la 'khor 'a bar ma nusan / rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du bskur zhing bum dbang du gtan nas mi bzhed la / bum dbang dang gsang dbang sogs bzhi la mchog dbang bzhir 'jog ci+ong / de lta bu'i bum dbang ni rdulo tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du mi bskur ba'i phyiro ra / / gang du bskur na dbang mdar bstan du/ lusadang gsang ba dbang pa sems/ /rtag tu dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum/ /zhes gsum gsungasapa'i lusadakyil du bskur ba dusa'akhor ba rang gi phyag rgyun yin te/ bla med spyi'i kha skad dang mi mthun no/ /dus 'khor ba dag gtso bor bum dbang gi 'jog gzhi'i bum pa'ang rnam rgyal bum pa sogs yongs grags kyi ma yin par thabs mkhas kyi rten khyad par can gyi 'o 'dzin yongasasu rgyas pa la bum par 'jog ste/ bsdus rgyud las/ dpal ldan shes rab nu mar reg pa de nyid bum pa'i dbang du brjod/ /cesagasungasapa'i phyir/ de bzhin du bla med spyi'i dbang gong ma gsum dang / dus 'khor gyi dbang gong ma gsum la'ang dbang gi bab mi 'dra ba'i khyad par chen po yod de/ 'dir kun la thun mong du brjod par ga lo rung / bde mchog lta bu dang / dus 'khor gnyis la'i dbang thob pa zhig gis bde mchog gi dbang gong ma gsum dang / dus 'khor gyi dbang gong ma gsum la dbang gi bab mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ci 'dug bltas pas shes so/ /yang lam gyi skabs su bla med spyi'i skabs sgrub thabs rnams la mngal nas dkyil 'khor spro ba lan re las med la/ dus 'khor gyi sgrub thabs rnams la mngal nas dkyil 'khor lan gnyis spro ba sogs bskyed rdzogs kun la lam gyi bab mi 'dra ba'i khyad 605

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/la sa 'jug dbang bdun du byas nas/ de kun da la 'khor 'a bar ma nusan / rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du bskur zhing bum dbang du gtan nas mi bzhed la / bum dbang dang gsang dbang sogs bzhi la mchog dbang bzhir 'jog cing / de lta bu'i bum dbang ni rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du mi bskur ba'i phyir ro / / gang du bskur na dbang mdor bstan du/ lus dang gsang ba dbang po sems/ /rtag tu dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum/ /zhes gsum gsungs pa'i lusadakyil du bskur ba dus 'khor ba rang gi phyag rgyun yin te/ bla med spyi'i kha skad dang mi mthun no/ /dus 'khor ba dag gtso bor bum dbang gi 'jog gzhi'i bum pa'ang rnam rgyal bum pa sogs yongs grags kyi ma yin par thabs mkhas kyi rten khyad par can gyi 'o 'dzin yongs su rgyas pa la bum par 'jog ste/ bsdus rgyud las/ dpal ldan shes rab nu mar reg pa de nyid bum pa'i dbang du brjod/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du bla med spyi'i dbang gong ma gsum dang / dus 'khor gyi dbang gong ma gsum la'ang dbang gi bab mi 'dra ba'i khyad par chen po yod de/ 'dir kun la thun mong du brjod par ga lo rung / bde mchog lta bu dang / dus 'khor gnyis la'i dbang thob pa zhig gis bde mchog gi dbang gong ma gsum dang / dus 'khor gyi dbang gong ma gsum la dbang gi bab mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ci 'dug bltas pas shes so/ /yang lam gyi skabs su bla med spyi'i skabs sgrub thabs rnams la mngal nas dkyil 'khor spro ba lan re las med la/ dus 'khor gyi sgrub thabs rnams la mngal nas dkyil 'khor lan gnyis spro ba sogs bskyed rdzogs kun la lam gyi bab mi 'dra ba'i khyad 605

'tshechen 'od snang las/ saskya'i chos 'byung gcesabasdus/ ()par chen po yod de/ des na bla med la rgyud sde 'og ma' lung las dus 'khor gyi lung btsan rgyu med/ khyed kyi dgongs pa la bla med nang phan tshun yin pas btsan no bsam pa de zhan bas blta lugs dang mtshungs/ de bzhin du bla med sbyi la cho ga kha skong dgos pa rnams kyang rgyud sde 'og ma nas len pa rgyud nyid nas gsungs pas de bzhin 'thad/ dus 'khor nas rgyas 'gebs pa la lung gi zin so'ang med cing / sngar bshad pa ltar dus 'khor dang bla med spyi gnyis lam gyi srol tha dad pa re yin pas ma 'dres pa'i rnam dbye shes par bya'o/ khyed lta bu mi chos snang ngor dpa' skyes dpe bral zhig tu sgrub 'dod nas/ sa paṇa la rtsod pa'i mthu med bzhin du rtsod par byed pa 'di la bzhad gad nyams ldan gyi rgyan 'di dbul bar bya ste/ sngon tshe ston pa drug gi rang stobs kyis/ /dpal ldan stobasabacu mnga' ba'i thub dbang la/ /'gran sems spyi bos ri bor brdung ba na/ /rang gis rang nyid nyams par byas la ltos/ /pad+ma dkar po khron pa'i lag 'gro bzhin/ /rang mthong tsam gyis blo gros khengs pa yis/ /sa paṇa mkhyen pa'i rgya mtshor 'gran sems na/ /rgyal ba sras bcas thugs kyisakhrel min nam/ /zhes kyang smras so/ /de ltar gang du dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'bor dang / gang la dbang bskur ba'i slob ma'i grangs nges rnams la dogs pa dpyad nas dbang bskur ba la sngags kyi sdom pa thob mtshams ji lta bu snyam na/ de nyid kyang bshad par bya ste/ gzhung 'dir/ bla ma btsal la dbang bzhi blangs/ /de yis sdom pa sum ldan 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa 'dis bla med kyi sngags sdom gyi thob mchams bstan pa yin/ 'di la bo dong paṇa chen gyis so thar dang byang sdom 606

'tshechen 'od snang las/ saskya'i chos 'byung gcesabasdus/ ()par chen po yod de/ des na bla med la rgyud sde 'og ma' lung las dus 'khor gyi lung btsan rgyu med/ khyed kyi dgongs pa la bla med nang phan tshun yin pas btsan no bsam pa de zhan bas blta lugs dang mtshungs/ de bzhin du bla med sbyi la cho ga kha skong dgos pa rnams kyang rgyud sde 'og ma nas len pa rgyud nyid nas gsungs pas de bzhin 'thad/ dus 'khor nas rgyas 'gebs pa la lung gi zin so'ang med cing / sngar bshad pa ltar dus 'bor dang bla med spyi gnyis lam gyi srol tha dad pa re yin pas ma 'dres pa'i rnam dbye shes par bya'o/ khyed lta bu mi chos snang ngor dpa' skyes dpe bral zhig tu sgrub 'dod nas/ sa paṇa la rtsod pa'i mthu med bzhin du rtsod par byed pa 'di la bzhad gad nyams ldan gyi rgyan 'di dbul bar bya ste/ sngon tshe ston pa drug gi rang stobs kyis/ /dpal ldan stobasabacu mnga' ba'i thub dbang la/ /'gran sems spyi bos ri bor brdung ba na/ /rang gis rang nyid nyams par byas la ltos/ /pad+ma dkar po khron pa'i lag 'gro bzhin/ /rang mthong tsam gyis blo gros khengs pa yis/ /sa paṇa mkhyen pa'i rgya mtshor 'gran sems na/ /rgyal ba sras bcas thugs kyisakhrel min nam/ /zhes kyang smras so/ /de ltar gang du dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'bor dang / gang la dbang bskur ba'i slob ma'i grangs nges rnams la dogs pa dpyad nas dbang bskur ba la sngags kyi sdom pa thob mtshams ji lta bu snyam na/ de nyid kyang bshad par bya ste/ gzhung 'dir/ bla ma btsal la dbang bzhi blangs/ /de yis sdom pa sum ldan 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa 'dis bla med kyi sngags sdom gyi thob mchams bstan pa yin/ 'di la bo dong paṇa chen gyis so thar dang byang sdom 606

bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/gnyas logs su len pa dngos ga cho ga la'ang rjes zlos lan gsum byed pa las med cing / sngags kyi dbang dus su'ang rigs lnga'i sdom gzung gi rjes zlos lan gsum byed pas rjes zlos de tshar ba na sngags sdom rdzogs par thob gsungs/ de ni lham dpe zhwa la bkab pa yin te/ so thar gyi dge bsnyen dge tshul dang / byang sems kyi semasabaskyed len pa la dngos gzhi'i dus su rjes zlos lan gsum byed pa de yin kyang / 'dir ni sdom gzung gi rjes zlos las logs su sngagasasdom 'bogs byed kyi dngos gzhi'i cho ga gzhan yod pa'i phyir te / dbang bskur gyi cho ga thamasacad de yin pasaso/ /dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin ngor rdzong gnyis su grags pa'i rdzong pa chos rje kun dga' rgyal ma pas dbang bskur gyi dngos gzhi'i cho ga thams cad sngags sdom 'bogs byed yin par bzhed cing / dngos gzhi'i skabs su sngags sdom thob ces pa'i tha snyad mdzad/ sta gon dang 'jug pa'i gnasaskabs su skyes pa'i sngags sdom yod/gnasaskabasade gnyis su thob pa'i sngags sdom med de/ sa paṇa gyi skyesabu dam pa'i 'phrin yig las/ bla na med pa'i skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed la brten nas rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa skye/ de dbang gi dus su thob kyi/ gzhan du thob par gsungs pa ma mthong zhes gsungs pa 'di lung du 'dren par mdzad/des na sngags sdom la skyes pa tsam gyi sngags sdom dang / thob pa'i sngags sdom gnyis su dbye ba mdzad/ de ni rigs pa ma yin te/ sdom pa gang dang gang skyes pa dang thob pa don gcig pa'i phyir/ lung gi don ni/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags lta bu'i rjes zlos lan gsum byas pa la brten nas skyabs 'gro rtsom 607

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/gnyas logs su len pa dngos ga cho ga la'ang rjes zlos lan gsum byed pa las med cing / sngags kyi dbang dus su'ang rigs lnga'i sdom gzung gi rjes zlos lan gsum byed pas rjes zlos de tshar ba na sngags sdom rdzogs par thob gsungs/ de ni lham dpe zhwa la bkab pa yin te/ so thar gyi dge bsnyen dge tshul dang / byang sems kyi sems bskyed len pa la dngos gzhi'i dus su rjes zlos lan gsum byed pa de yin kyang / 'dir ni sdom gzung gi rjes zlos las logs su sngags sdom 'bogs byed kyi dngos gzhi'i cho ga gzhan yod pa'i phyir te / dbang bskur gyi cho ga thams cad de yin pas so/ /dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin ngor rdzong gnyis su grags pa'i rdzong pa chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan pas dbang bskur gyi dngos gzhi'i cho ga thams cad sngags sdom 'bogs byed yin par bzhed cing / dngos gzhi'i skabs su sngags sdom thob ces pa'i tha snyad mdzad/ sta gon dang 'jug pa'i gnas skabs su skyes pa'i sngags sdom yod/gnas skabs de gnyis su thob pa'i sngags sdom med de/ sa paṇa gyi skyes bu dam pa'i 'phrin yig las/ bla na med pa'i skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed la brten nas rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa skye/ de dbang gi dus su thob kyi/ g.yin du thob par gsungs pa ma mthong zhes gsungs pa 'di lung du 'dren par mdzad/des na sngags sdom la skyes pa tsam gyi sngags sdom dang / thob pa'i sngags sdom gnyis su dbye ba mdzad/ de ni rigs pa ma yin te/ sdom pa gang dang gang skyes pa dang thob pa don gcig pa'i phyir/ lung gi don ni/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags lta bu'i rjes zlos lan gsum byas pa la brten nas skyabs 'gro rtsom 607

ba chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()byed du byed pa' so thar dang byang sdom skyes pa de sdom pa 'og ma rang rkyang ma yan par sngags sdom gyi ngo bor skyes pa yin te/ dbang bskur gyi cho ga las thob pa'i sdom pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang rgyun bshags la brten nas skyes pa'i so thar dang byang sdom gnyis kyang sngags sdom gyi ngo bor skye ba de dbang dus su yin gyi/gzhan rjes gnang tsam dang / byin rlabs la sogs pa'i dus su rgyun bshags la brten nas sdom pa skye ba de sngags sdom gyi ngo bor skye bar gsungs pa ma mthong zhes dbang dus dang rjes gnang sogs kyi skabs so sor dbye ste legs par bshad pa yin te/ lung don gzhan du rtogasapar mi bya'o/ /ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rim gyi rnam bshad rdo rje myu gu'i spyi don gyi skabs na bum dbang rdzogs pa'i tshe rigs lnga'i sngags sdom rdzogs par thob gsungs pa zhig yod/ de ni kun gyis de bzhin du khas len dgos te/ bla med kyi rdo rje slob ma'i rig pa'i dbang lnga la brten nas rigs lnga spyi'i dam tshig dang / rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang la brten nas rigs lnga so so'i dam tshig rnams thob pa ni bla med phal che ba'i spyi skad yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na bum dbang gi rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi gsol gdab tu/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang / /sdom pa'ang bla na med pa stsol/ /zhes 'byung ba'i gnad kyang 'di yin cing / dbang chu chen mo las kyang / de dag gis ni dam tshig dang sdom pa mtha' dag bzung ba yin pas/ zhes gsungs pa'ang rigs lnga spyi dang bye brag gi dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams bum dbang rdzogs pa'i tshe na thob par bzhed rgyu yin no/ /dbang chu chen mor bum dbang mtha' rten dang bcas pa las dbang 608

ba chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()byed du byed pa' so thar dang byang sdom skyes pa de sdom pa 'og ma rang rkyang ma yan par sngags sdom gyi ngo bor skyes pa yin te/ dbang bskur gyi cho ga las thob pa'i sdom pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang rgyun bshags la brten nas skyes pa'i so thar dang byang sdom gnyis kyang sngags sdom gyi ngo bor skye ba de dbang dus su yin gyi/gzhan rjes gnang tsam dang / byin rlabs la sogs pa'i dus su rgyun bshags la brten nas sdom pa skye ba de sngags sdom gyi ngo bor skye bar gsungs pa ma mthong zhes dbang dus dang rjes gnang sogs kyi skabs so sor dbye ste legs par bshad pa yin te/ lung don gzhan du rtogasapar mi bya'o/ /ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rim gyi rnam bshad rdo rje myu gu'i spyi don gyi skabs na bum dbang rdzogs pa'i tshe rigs lnga'i sngags sdom rdzogs par thob gsungs pa zhig yod/ de ni kun gyis de bzhin du khas len dgos te/ bla med kyi rdo rje slob ma'i rig pa'i dbang lnga la brten nas rigs lnga spyi'i dam tshig dang / rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang la brten nas rigs lnga so so'i dam tshig rnams thob pa ni bla med phal che ba'i spyi skad yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na bum dbang gi rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi gsol gdab tu/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang / /sdom pa'ang bla na med pa stsol/ /zhes 'byung ba'i gnad kyang 'di yin cing / dbang chu chen mo las kyang / de dag gis ni dam tshig dang sdom pa mtha' dag bzung ba yin pas/ zhes gsungs pa'ang rigs lnga spyi dang bye brag gi dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams bum dbang rdzogs pa'i tshe na thob par bzhed rgyu yin no/ /dbang chu chen mor bum dbang mtha' rten dang bcas pa las dbang 608

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/gong ma gsum gya cho ga ma gsungs pa' phyir/ mus chen sems dpa' chen pos rtsa ltung bcu bzhi dang / yan lag gi ltung ba brgyad bsrung ba'i sngagasasdom bum dbang gi tshe na rdzogs par thob pa la dgongs nas bum dbang rdzogs pa'i tshe na sngags sdom rdzogs par thob ces slob ma phal che ba'i ngor gsungs pa gnang la/de la brten nas rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang ba sogs mus phyogs pa phal che ba dang / bdag chen rdo rje 'chang rjes 'brang dang bcas pa dang / byams chen rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas 'phel dang / de nyid nas gyes pa'i skyed tshal gong 'ogaganyan yod bya gshongs chos 'khor lhun po ba rnams mgrin gcig tu de ltar du bzhed/ khyad par bdag chen rin po ches dam tshig rab gsal du 'di la rtsal bton gyi sgrub byed mang po'ang bkod/ sngags sdom rdzogs pa dbang bzhi rdzogs pa la ltos dgos nga/ra 'dod pa rnams la gnod byed kyi lung rigs kyang mang du 'phen par mdzad 'dug sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin go shāka gnyis zhes nyi zla ltar grags pa'i chen po de dag ni bla med kyi sngags sdom rdzogs par dbang bzhi rdzogs pa la ltos dgos/ zhes mtha' gcig tu nges pa'i grub mtha' gting tshugs pa mdzad/ paṇa chen gyi gser thur las kyang / bum dbang rdzogs pa'i tshe sngags sdom rdzogs na/ bla ma btsal la bum dbang blangs/ /de yi sdom pa sum ldan 'gyur/ /zhes 'byung rigs pa las/ de ma byung bar dbang bzhi blangs/ /de yis sdom pa sum ldan 'gyur/ /zhes bshad pas na sdom pa'i thob mtshams de ltar du bzhed gsungs/ kun mkhyen rin po ches sngags sdom gyi thob mtshams la gnad don bye brag tu bshad pa'i zur bkol bdud rtsi'i nying khu rtsa 'grel 609

ba chen 'od snang la / sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ltas/mdzad de/ sgrub byed lung rigs rnams de dag tu blta bar bya/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po'i rjes skyong ba brag thog pa snga phyi gnyis nas brgyud pa'i sa lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal 'dzin thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa chen po kun dga' rnam rgyal rjes 'brang dang bcas pa dang / 'brug phyogs kyi mkhas pa sprul pa'i sku pad+ma dkar po sogs kyang sngags sdom gyi thob mtshams go shāka gnyis dang mthun par bzhed cing sgrub byed mang du 'god pa mdzad 'dug go /bla med kyi dbang bzhi rdzogs pa'i tshe na sngags sdom rdzogs par bzhed pa'i go shāka sogs kyi lugs de la'ang dogs pa 'di sel dgos te/ dbang gong mar bum dbang gi skabs su thob pa'i sdom pa dang rigs mi 'dra ba'i rdzogs rim gyi sdom pa gsar thob yod mod/ gong ma gsum la so sor sngar ma thob pa dang rigs mi 'dra ba'i sdom pa gsar thob re re yod dam med/ med na sngags sdom rdzogs par dbang bzhi rdzogs pa la ltos dgos pa dang 'gal/ yod na ji ltar zhe na/ 'di ltar sems te/ gsang dbang gi tshe yi ge bha ga'i dkyil 'khor la/ gsang dbang gi cho gas longs sku'i sa bon gsar du thebs pas sa bon de nyid rdzogs rim gyi sdom pa'i ngo bor skye/ de bzhin du sher dbang dang / dbang bzhi pa la'ang slob ma'i khams bdud rtsi dang snying po ye shes rlung la dbang de dang de'i cho gas rim bzhin chos sku dang ngo bo nyid sku'i sa bon nus ldan gsar du thebs pa'i tshe sa bon de dang de'i ngo bor gyur pa'i rdzogs rim gyi sdom pa gsar thob re yod dgos shing / sbyang gzhi'i dbang du byas na'ang rtsa yi ge bha ga dang / khams bdud rtsi dang / snying po ye shes rlung rnams la rim bzhin du gya nom lngar zhen gyi 610

bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/rnam rtog spangasasemasagasar thob re yod par shes par bya ste/ rab dbyer/ sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs nusapa/ /zhesapa dang / phung po khamasadang skye mched la/ /sangs rgyas sa bon btab nas ni/ /cheskosasogs gsungs pas so/ /kun mkhyen rin po ches bdud rtsi'i nying khu'i rnam bshad bdud rtsi spel bar/ gang dag dbang gi skabs su nyams myong skyes pa lta ci smos/ dmigs pa tsam yang 'dzin mi shes par dbang gral du 'jug pa tsam gyis dbang bskur thob par rloms nas sngags sdom thob par smra ba de ni/ kha cig blun po sdig pa can/ /yin yang 'dir tshogs thams cad ni/ /zhes sogs kyi phyogs snga smra ba dang khyad par med/ces gsungs pa 'di ltar na da lta dmigs pa tsam yang 'dzin mi shes pa'i blun po dang byis pa gzhon nu dag dbang gral du tshogs nas dbang zhu ba'i khul byed pa ni gtan nas mi 'thad dam/ phan yon zhig yod pa gang yin zhe na/ kun mkhyen bla mas de ltar gsungs pa ni phyag len dogs phyogs nas mtha' bsdams te bstan pa la gces spras mdzad pa yin/ don la dmigs pa 'dzin mi shes kyang bla mas cho ga brjod pa'i mthu las las 'phro can 'ga' zhig la sngags sdom skye'ang srid/ gang ltar bla mas de dag lhar bskyed/ ye shesapa bcugarigs bdag gi rgyas gdab/ rab gnas dang mchod par byas pas dbang gi byin rlabs 'jug rgyu re nges par 'ong ste/ dper na sku gsung thugs kyi rten la rab gnas byed pa'i tshe rten de dag gis dmigs pa mi 'dzin yang ltar bskyed/ye shes pa bstims nas me tog gi char 'bebs zhing su pra tiṣ+ṭhas brtan bzhugs byas pas rab gnas chags 'ong ba dang khyad med ces yongs 'dzin 611

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/rnam rtog spangs sems gsar thob re yod par shes par bya ste/ rab dbyer/ sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs nus pa/ /zhesapa dang / phung po khams dang skye mched la/ /sangs rgyas sa bon btab nas ni/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas so/ /kun mkhyen rin po ches bdud rtsi'i nying khu'i rnam bshad bdud rtsi spel bar/ gang dag dbang gi skabs su nyams myong skyes pa lta ci smos/ dmigs pa tsam yang 'dzin mi shes par dbang gral du 'jug pa tsam gyis dbang bskur thob par rloms nas sngags sdom thob par smra ba de ni/ kha cig blun po sdig pa can/ /yin yang 'dir tshogs thams cad ni/ /zhes sogs kyi phyogs snga smra ba dang khyad par med/ces gsungs pa 'di ltar na da lta dmigs pa tsam yang 'dzin mi shes pa'i blun po dang byis pa gzhen nu dag dbang gral du tshogs nas dbang zhu ba'i khul byed pa ni gtan nas mi 'thad dam/ phan yon zhig yod pa gang yin zhe na/ kun mkhyen bla mas de ltar gsungs pa ni phyag len dogs phyogs nas mtha' bsdams te bstan pa la gces spras mdzad pa yin/ don la dmigs pa 'dzin mi shes kyang bla mas cho ga brjod pa'i mthu las las 'phro can 'ga' zhig la sngags sdom skye'ang srid/ gang ltar bla mas de dag lhar bskyed/ ye shes pa bcugarigs bdag gi rgyas gdab/ rab gnas dang mchod par byas pas dbang gi byin rlabs 'jug rgyu re nges par 'ong ste/ dper na sku gsung thugs kyi rten la rab gnas byed pa'i tshe rten de dag gis dmigs pa mi 'dzin yang ltar bskyed/ye shes pa bstims nas me tog gi char 'bebs zhing su pra tiṣ+ṭha sa brtan bzhugs byas pas rab gnas chags 'ong ba dang khyad med ces yongs 'dzin 611

'tshe' 'od thal / saskya'i chosayang khesabasdus/ ()mkhas pa' dbang pos dbang phyugadapal bzang yang yang gsungs/ de skad du bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa gyis/ lha la rab tu gnasapa dang / /mi la dbang bskur bya ba sogs/ /zhes de gnyis don mtshungs par gsungs pas 'khrul pa med de/ ma 'khrul zhing mi slu bar grub pa yin no/ /sde snod gsum dang gsang chen rgyud sde bzhi'i/ /nyams len gnad kun 'khrul dang ma 'khrul ba/ /rnam par dbye ba'i chosa'adi rgyal ba'i bstan/ /kun gyi lus srung go cha mchog tu bsngags/ /bstan 'chos chos 'di ring du sbyangs rloms kyang / /don zab gting dpag dka' zhing rgyal kun gyi/ /dgongs don mtha' dag 'dir 'dus byis pa'i blos/ /rtogs min dkar ba'i bag chags cung zad bzhag /dge bcu'i khrims skyong lhag bsam rgyan gyis mdzes/ /rig 'dzin gsang chen chos kyi 'khor los sgyur/ /gzhan don la chags rgyal sras bye ba'i yab/ /rigs kun bdag po rdor sems/thabs de drug par dge /de ltar na de dag gis ni sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i glegs bam gcig pu chos dang chos ma yin pa rnam par 'byed pa'i bstan bcos chen po sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba'i gzhung gi skabs las brtsams te mkhas pa dag la 'bel gtam du bya ba rin chen mdzes pa'i phra tshom bkod pa'i legs bshad sngar bstan pa dang 'chad par 'gyur ba dag gis kyang dpyod ldan gyi skyes bu dag gi blo gros kyi khang bzangs brgyan par bya ba yin no / / de ltar phar tshad sogs gzhung chen drug gi skabs rnams la mkhas pa snga phyi so so'i yig cha dang bzhed srol grub mtha' mi 'dra ba mtha' yas pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa mchis mod/ bdag lta bu la de dag gi bzhed srol mtha' 612

'tshe chen 'od thal / sa skya'i chosang sa bsdus/ ()mkhas pa' dbang pos dbang phyug dpal bzang yang yang gsungs/ de skad du bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa gyis/ lha la rab tu gnas pa dang / /mi la dbang bskur bya ba sogs/ /zhes de gnyis don mtshungs par gsungs pas 'brul pa med de/ ma 'khrul zhing mi slu bar grub pa yin no/ /sde snod gsum dang gsang chen rgyud sde bzhi'i/ /nyams len gnad kun 'khrul dang ma 'khrul ba/ /rnam par dbye ba'i chos 'di rgyal ba'i bstan/ /kun gyi lus srung go cha mchog tu bsngags/ /bstan 'chos chos 'di ring du sbyangs rloms kyang / /don zab gting dpag dka' zhing rgyal kun gyi/ /dgongs don mtha' dag 'dir 'dus byis pa'i blos/ /rtogs min dkar ba'i bag chags cung zad bzhag /dge bcu'i khrims skyong lhag bsam rgyan gyis mdzes/ /rig 'dzin gsang chen chos kyi 'khor los sgyur/ /gzhan don la chags rgyal sras bye ba'i yab/ /rigs kun bdag po rdor sems/thabs de drug par dge /de ltar na de dag gis ni sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i glegs bam gcig pu chos dang chos ma yin pa rnam par 'byed pa'i bstan bcos chen po sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba'i gzhung gi skabs las brtsams te mkhas pa dag la 'bel gtam du bya ba rin chen mdzes pa'i phra tshom bkod pa'i legs bshad sngar bstan pa dang 'chad par 'gyur ba dag gis kyang dpyod ldan gyi skyes bu dag gi blo gros kyi khang bzangs brgyan par bya ba yin no / / de ltar phar tshad sogs gzhung chen drug gi skabs rnams la mkhas pa snga phyi so so'i yig cha dang bzhed srol grub mtha' mi 'dra ba mtha' yas pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa mchis mod/ bdag lta bu la de dag gi bzhed srol mtha' 612

bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i 'bel gtam/dag lta spros/ yag cha mtha' dag mtshan gya rnam grangs bgrang rgyu yang cher ma mchis te blo gros chung zhing sbyangs stobs zhan pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir smras pa/grub mtha'i khyad par rnam dbye ma shes na/ /lung rigs gtsang ma'i dpyad pas dag pa yis/ /'bel ba'i gtam skyes cho me kyi me long du/ shes bya'i ri mo rnam bkra su yis mthong / /mdo rgyud gzhung la sbyangs pa mi ldan na/ /sgrub thabasadakyil 'bor cho ga mang po'i phreng / /bshad sbyang tsam yin de don rtogs pa med//ngag 'don slob dpon blun po'i spun zla yin/ /cho ga'i khrigs dang man ngag phran tshegs sogs/ khres la mkhas par rlom mang dus kyi skyon/ /de phyir bka' dang rgyan drug mchog gzhung sogs/ /kun la bslab sbyang rnam dpyod bstan pa'i srog/'di na nga mkhas gzhan gyis ma rtogs zhes/ /nga rgyal tshig rtsub rgya mtsho'i rlabs bzhin 'thor/ /tshad ldan snga mar mi 'thad brgya rtsa sgrogs/ /snyigs dus rtsom 'di'ang dmyal ba'i rgyu ru mthong / /'on kyang lha yi bla ma sa skya pa/ /mkhyen yangs 'jam pa'i rdo rjes bka' stsal pa/ /spyi bos blangs byas dad dang spro ba yis/ /rnam dpyod gsal ba'i rig pa bsgrims te bris/ /de lta na yang byis blo'i nyes pa gang / /tshig gi mnga' bdag bden mthong 'phags rnams dang / /tshig la dges pa'i dpyod ldan mkhas kun gyi/ /spyan sngar thog med sdig dang lhan cig bshags/ /'dir 'bad legs byas kai la sha yi spo/ /zla 'od mdangs kyis byug 'dra gang thob des/ /'gro kun rmongs pa'i mun chen gtan bcom nas/ /yang dag ye shes snang ba rgyas par shog/ //ces pa 'di ni mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug dpal sa skya pa 'jam dbyangs 613

bod kyi mkhasapa snga phyi dag gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed mtha' dpyod dang bcasapa'i 'bel gtam/dag lta smros/ yag cha mtha' dag mtshan gya rnam grangs bgrang rgyu yang cher ma mchis te blo gros chung zhing sbyangs stobs zhan pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir smras pa/grub mtha'i khyad par rnam dbye ma shes na/ /lung rigs gtsang ma'i dpyad pas dag pa yis/ /'bel ba'i gtam skyesachos kyi me long du/ shes bya'i ri mo rnam bkra su yis mthong / /mdo rgyud gzhung la sbyangs pa mi ldan na/ /sgrub thabasadakyil 'khor cho ga mang po'i phreng / /bshad sbyang tsam yin de don rtogs pa med//ngag 'don slob dpon blun po'i spun zla yin/ /cho ga'i khrigs dang man ngag phran tshegasasogs/ khres la mkhasapar rlom mang dus kyi skyon/ /de phyir bka' dang rgyan drug mchog gzhung sogs/ /kun la bslab sbyang rnam dpyod bstan pa'i srog/'di na nga mkhas gzhan gyis ma rtogs zhes/ /nga rgyal tshig rtsub rgya mtsho'i rlabs bzhin 'thor/ /tshad ldan snga mar mi 'thad brgya rtsa sgrogs/ /snyigs dus rtsom 'di'ang dmyal ba'i rgyu ru mthong / /'on kyang lha yi bla ma sa skya pa/ /mkhyen yangs 'jam pa'i rdo rjes bka' stsal pa/ /spyi bos blangs byas dad dang spro ba yis/ /rnam dpyod gsal ba'i rig pa bsgrims te bris/ /de lta na yang byis blo'i nyes pa gang / /tshig gi mnga' bdag bden mthong 'phags rnams dang / /tshig la dges pa'i dpyod ldan mkhas kun gyi/ /spyan sngar thog med sdig dang lhan cig bshags/ /'dir 'bad legs byas kai la sha yi spo/ /zla 'od mdangs kyis byug 'dra gang thob des/ /'gro kun me+ongs pa'i mun chen gtan bcom nas/ /yang dag ye shes snang ba rgyas par shog/ //ces pa 'di ni mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug dpal sa skya pa 'jam dbyangs 613

bgechen 'od snangalas/ saskya'i chosa'abyung gtses bsdus/ ()ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung gi rnga bo ches bskul ba las don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te mkhan chen 'jam dpa'i dbyangs dbang phyug dpal bzang sogs yongs 'dzin dam pa rnams kyi bka' drin las rgyal ba'i bka' dang dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos rnams la blo gros cung zad 'byongs pa'i khungs su byas shing / bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu kun la mi phyed pa'i dad pa'i rba rlabs gting nas g.yo ba/ shākya'i dge slong sde snod 'dzin pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis dkar po zhes pa sa mo sprul gyi lo'i gro zhun zla ba'i yar tshes nas dbu bzung / tha skar zla ba'i yar ngo'i tshes lnga'i nyin legs par grub pa'i yi ge pa ni chos grags bzang po'o/ /'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che spyi dang / khyad par dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa dri ma med pa yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /sarba dwa ka phywa khaṃ bha ba tu// //614

bgechen 'od snangalas/ saskya'i chosa'abyung gces bsdus/ ()ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung gi rnga bo ches bskul ba las don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te mkhan chen 'jam dpa'i dbyangs dbang phyug dpal bzang sogs yongs 'dzin dam pa rnams kyi bka' drin las rgyal ba'i bka' dang dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos rnams la blo gros cung zad 'byongs pa'i khungs su byas shing / bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu kun la mi phyed pa'i dad pa'i rba rlabs gting nas g.yo ba/ shākya'i dge slong sde snod 'dzin pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis dkar po zhes pa sa mo sprul gyi lo'i gro zhun zla ba'i yar tshes nas dbu bzung / tha skar zla ba'i yar ngo'i tshes lnga'i nyin legs par grub pa'i yi ge pa ni chos grags bzang po'o/ /'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che spyi dang / khyad par dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa dri ma med pa yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /sarba dwa ka phywa khaṃ bha ba tu// //614
